༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi tā yu re sto tra/ bod skad du/2tshe dpag med la bstod pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ /sems can sdug bsngal ma lus rnams/ /skad cig nyid la sel byed pa'i / /sangs rgyas tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung zhing / /nyes pa kun las khyod 4grol nas/ /rdo rje lus can rdo rje can/ /rdo rje tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis/ /kun nas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /thugs rjes chags tshul ston mdzad pa/ /pad+ma tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam pa dngos kun skad cig gis/ /rang 'dod bzhin du tshim dang dpal/ /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po ste/ / rin chen 5tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid la rdzogs dang dpal/ /bsam kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing / /phrin las tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /37—259

nyes/ pa kun las rnam grol bas1/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ / tshogs kyi bdag po chen po ste2/ /kun gzigs tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo /stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te/ /ma lus mi mthun tshogs 'joms pa /ston pa sred 4med bu yi mthu/ /yon tan tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa/ /ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rnam/ par rtog pa mtha' dag spangs/ /ye shes tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog rlung gis khyod mi g.yo/ /mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba ste/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshogs 'joms pa/ /mi g.yo tshe dpag phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyis/ /khyed kyi 5mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes rgyas mdzad pa/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dze tā 6ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ grub pa brnyes pa'i snying po 7zhabs / dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis / ba ri lo tsā ba/ / mchims 7brtson 'grus seng ge/ rgya nag phug pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma dge sdings napa/ bla ma bsam gtan bzang po'o1 // //37—260

1608༄7/ /'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ā yudz+nyā nā pa ri 2mi ta sā dha māṃ/bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs/'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba sems can thams cad kyi/ / 'tshe ba la ni srung 4'dod pas/ /'phags pa tshe dpag rnged pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rim pa bri bar bya/ /dbang dang dam tshig sdom ldan pas/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i sa phyogs su/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod dang khrus/ byas/ 'a// / lus ngag yid gsum dag pa yis/ /5bla ma sangs rgyas la sogs la / /spyan drangs pa la phyag mchod cing / /bstod pa lus ngag dang ba yis / /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /tshad med bzhi bsgom chos rnams kun / /stong pa nyid du bsgoms byas la/ /sngags kyi don la bsgom par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhāḥsarba dharmyaḥswa bhā 8ba bi shusgo3haṃ / oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na 37—262

badz+ra swa bhā 1ba āt+ma kolha2haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang / /zla ba'i steng du sems nyid dhī ཿ/ /byi ru lta bur bsam byas la/ /'od zer 'phro zhing slar 'dus pas/ /'phags pa rje btsun tshe dpag med/ /sgu mdog dmar zhing 4'od zer 'khrigs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag / skyil krung gis 5bzhugs 'dzum bcas dang / /'od dpag gis mdzes ye shes bstem/ /dbang bskur rab tu brtan par bya/ /ji srid skyo bar ma gyur 6par/ /bsgom pa'am yang na sngags 'di bzlas/ /ming gi sngags dang snying po'i sngags/ /ming gis bsgyur na 7gzungs kyang bzlas/ /gzungs ni 'chi med rnga sgra'o/ /jes su bdag ni tshe ring 'gyur/ /yang na skad cig lhar bsams te/ /sngags gsum ci rigs bzlas pa'am/ /bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bdag la yang yang 'khrud par bsam/ /slar yang bstod cing gsol btab pas/ /gtor mas lha rnams mchod par 8bsam/ /srung / 'khor bcing 1 dang tshe bsgrub nga/sa / /'on kyang 'chi ltas bzlog la sogs/ /bla ma'i man ngag yod par 1 bya/ /de yi bsod nams mthu yis ni1 / /'khor ba'i 'gro drug ma lus pas/ /tshe dang/ga med pa'i sku thob nas/ /gnad gcod la sogs sbug bsngal rnams/ /zhi nas —bde ba can 'gyur shog /'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med sapa'i sgrub thabs/ /slob dpon mkhas pa dze+e tā sari dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / lo tsā ba /lce dga' ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /ming 19sngags ni/ oṃ tar+ya thā a pa ri mi tā yudz+nyā na tweḥ zhes pa'o// //37—263

1609༄/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi tā ā yudz+nyā na bi bye nā ma /bod skad du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags pa mtshan nyid ldan pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i gnas rab nyer bzung nas/ /sa yi stegs bu chag chag gdab4/ /'thas par bcags te spos kyis byug /thig gdab tshon gyis 5dkyil 'khor bri/ /'dab brgyad sgo la sogs pas brgyan/ /bum pa dgu 'am gnyis la sogs/ /tshad ldan phyi nang bcud 6kyis brgyan/ /steng du rgyal mtshan gdugs kyis brgyan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lngas brgyan te/ /khyad par shar du 'o ma yis/ /gtor ma byas te lho phyogs su/ /nya sha'i gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /nub tu khrag la byang du chang / /byin gyis brlabs te gzhag par bya/ /lho dang byang du stegs bu la/ /tshe dpag med pa'i mdo 37—265

byedaganyis bzhugs/ /de nas rnal 'byor khrus byas te/ /bde ba'i stan la nyer 'aṭarngo ga 1ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mdun byas la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro sdig bshags bya/ /bsngo dang tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom pasnari bya/ /de nas snang ba rja 2bsams te/ /gyur pas gzhal yas khang bsam bya / /de nas pad+ma'i steng dag tu/ /yi ge dī4ཿlas byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas/ tshe dpag med pa ni/ /sgu mdog dmar po zhi ba'i zhal/ /mnyam bzhag 5phyab/ na tshobum pas mtshan/ /bdag nyid lha der bskyed par bya/ /ye shes bste/mas la dbang byin brlabs/ /thugs ka'i dī ཿlas 'od 'phros te/ /sem/sa can sangs rgyas kun sbyang bya/ /de nas zla steng trī9ཿdmar las/ /gas/nga sngags 'di yis bskor bar bsam/ /oṃ na mo rja ā yudz+nyā na dhīḥ.a ro t+paka hūṃ hrīḥ/ zhes ༷dkar por bsam par bya/ /yang na gzungs kyi sngags rings bsam rka / /de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /stong pa'i ngang las rgyu bas/mas te/ /de nas 1 gzhal yas khang pa bsam/ /de nas pad+ma nyi ma'i — steng / /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med pa bsam/ /shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ /nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ / lho na sarin chen tshe dpag med/ /byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ /byang shar kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ /shar lhor ྾yon tan/ tshe dang/ga med/ /lho nub ye shes tshe dpag med/ /nub byang mi g.yo tshe dang /ga med/ /thams cad kha dog dmar ba 7la/ /zhi zhal mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag /bum pas mtshan te bsam par bya/ /ye shes bstims snal dbang byin brlabs 1/ /de nas bum pa gzhal yas khang / /lhag pa'i tshe dpag med pa bsam/ /snying gar sngags rings bkod la bzlas/ /2 yang na snying po 37——266

bkod la bzlas/ /de nas kham phor —1gsar pa'i nang / /nad pa la sogs lus bkrus te/ /chu yis bkang ste shar du gzhag2 /de la khro bo'i sngags bzlas la/ /tsha tsha rnying pa sa nag dang / /bsres la 'chi bdag chen po'i gzugs / /khru gang la sogs tshad ldan bya/ /de ni kha bub steng du ni/ /bal dang ras sam dar nag dgab/ /lho yi phyogs su bstan 4la bzhag /de dang nye bar dar dmar la/ /gzungs kyi tshig rnams bri ba'am5/ /yang na khro bo'i sngags bris gzugs/ /byang du nad pa'i gos dag la/ /bal tshon sna lnga'i srad bus dkris6/ /ku sha'i steng du gzhag par bya/ /de nas slob dpon bsrung bya ste/ /mchod dang gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /slob dpon bsnyen pa la zhugs nas/ /phreng ba 'khor tshul bzlas pa brtsam/ /bsgrub bya bum pa'i nang du bsam/ /slob ma gcig gis lhor 'dug la/ /tshe dpag med pa'i gzungs bklag cing / /tshar re zhing yang me tog ni/ /nag po 'chi bdag steng du dor//de ltar brgya'am nyi shu sogs/ /rgyas bsdus byu rigs sbyar bar bya/ /gcig gis byang du snying po bklag /tshar re zhing ni tshon skud la/ /nya yi bdug spos re re dbul/ /de yi grangs kyang gong dang 'dra/ /de nas slob dpon gtor ma kun/ /spyi gzhung dag gis byin brlabs nas/ /rang rang gnas su dbul bar bya/ /de rjes nad pa mdun byas te8/ /'brang rgyas phyed la mar byugs te//dpal phreng lnga yi phud /gzugs bya/ /—mar me gtams 1 la 'chi bdag dang / /lho phyogs dag tu dor bar bya/ /chu dang 'o ma bsres pa'i nang / /tshon sgud nad pa la dkris 1 te/ /snying po'i sngags kyis 1 mtshon gyis ni/ /bcad la byang gi phyogs su dor/ /de nas slob dpon 7khrus byas la/ /stan bzang dag 37—267

la nyer 'dug ste/ /bum pa rim pas dbang bskur bya/ /o be+e ro tsa na ā yudz+nyā na sid+dhi sa ma ya 1a bhe ṣiñca hūṃ/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i dbang bskur bas/ /sdig sgrib dag ste tshe 'phel bsam/ /lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol nas / /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel te4/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /ces bya yang na gzungs kyi 5ni/ /phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad brjod/ /shar la sogs pa'i rim pa yis/ /rdo rje la sogs ming bsgyur te/ /bum pa lnga yis dbang bskur bya/ /mtshams kyi bum pa kun gye chu/ /las bum nang du bsdu bya ste6/ /nad pa la 7sogs bkru bar bya/ /de nas chu de ma bo bar/ /chu bo che 'am lteng ka mtsho/ /chu chen rnams la dor gyur na/ /nges par 'chi las bzlog pa yin/ /de rjes slob mas bla ma la/ /yon dbul sdom pa khas blangs te/ /bla mas slob ma'i spyi bor ni/ /rdo rje nges gzung — tshig 'di brjod/ /da ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spang bar gyis / /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom pas/ /bu khyod tshe yi dngos grub brnyes / /de skad bya ste slob ma ni/ /tha mal lus su bsams pa la/ /snying gi pad+ma'i rtsa ba la/ /dbu mar rnam snang tshe dpag med/ /phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi bsam bya ste/ /spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med/ /bsams pas bdag gi thugs ka nas/ /bsgul bas bdud rtse rtachu rgyun dbab/ /rigs lnga spyi bor slebs gyur te/ /thams cad bdud rtsir zhu gyur nas/ /lus nang thams cad khyab par bsam/ /tshe dpag med pa'i gzungs kyang 'don1 / /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum bya/ /de nas mchod pa —gshegs par bya/ /mjug tu tsha tsha cung zad gdab/ /sa tshon la sogs chur dor te/ /nye bar 'khor labs 27 —268

'chi bdag gzhom/ /tshe dpag ri1med pa'i gzungs kyang 'don2/ /slob dpon dze+e tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas/ bram ze nam mkha'i dbyings 4kyi bu'i ched du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //5rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī mañju dang / lo tsā 6ba lce dga' ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/265 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༄/ /tshe dang ye shes dpa/ga tu med pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs sto/ / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉nga mi ta/ a yu dz+nyā na/ bi dhi na mā/〈〈snar 〉〉sde mi tā/ a yucho na bi dhi shā ma/ 〈〈snar 〉ra / 4〈〈snar 〉tha dang / 5〈〈pe 〉phrotshon gyis/〈〈snar 〉〉tshon gyi/ 〈〈snar 〉thacus/266 1 〈〈snar 〉〉ngadus/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sams/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gzhag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ 7〈〈snar 〉thastem/ 〈〈pe 〉skaba'i hri/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉stengs hri/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉sdu a yu dz+nyā na hriḥ.a ro lika hūṃ hriḥces pas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu ā yu skyo na t+t+waṃḥ.a ro li7 hūṃ ṭ+wāṃḥzhes/ nyu 〈〈pe 〉〉rengs bsams 〈〈snar 〉〉ngang bsam/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉bye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rja/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉zla ba'i / ྾〈〈pe 〉〉stor ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sto ru/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉sto/ 〈〈pe 〉〉po/ 8〈〈snar 〉sngagazhag 19〈〈pe 〉〉pa / 〈〈snar 〉ra stem/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlab/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉ring / 〈〈snar 〉〉 de nas/267 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya/ra/ 2 〈〈pe 〉thazhag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ba/ 4〈〈pe 〉khitan/ 5 〈〈pe 〉chus pa/'am—/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra kri/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉bye ra/ 8 〈〈pe 〉snga ste/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phod/ 〈〈pe 〉ra phyed ni nag pos byugs byas te/ / 11〈〈pe 〉ra ltams/ 〈〈snar 〉〉la tams/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga kris/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉kyi—/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉ma/268 1 〈〈pe 〉mas yu snyo na si rnyi sa ma yā/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 4〈〈pe 〉ra sa/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉kyis—/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra sdus byas te/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉pa/'i lus/ 8 〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 9 〈〈pe 〉snga la/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉byu'i/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉steb/ 〈〈snar 〉shesab/ 1 〈〈pe 〉snga zlas/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang /sa〈〈pe 〉skorakho/269 1 〈〈pe 〉7tu/ 2 〈〈pe 〉༄ ga 〈〈pe 〉thadze ta/ 〈〈snar 〉stag ta/ 4〈〈pe 〉7kha'i dbyangs/ 〈〈snar 〉7kha' 37—269
dbyangs—/ 57〈〈pe 〉〉sto// 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1536)

༄ / /'jam dpal rdo rje blo gros 'phel ba jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañju shrī badz+ra pradz+nyā brja na nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal rdo rje blo gros 'phel ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i —mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pas gnas khang dben zhing nyams dga' bar gtsang ba dri zhim po'i chus chag chag btab la/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba cig 5byas te/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ser po dbus dkar por byas la/ de'i steng du lhung bzed du shes rab 'phel bar byed pa'i rdzas/ dbang po lag pa6/ gla rtsi/ gi wang /spang rgyan dkar po/ tsan+dan dkar po rnams ba dmar po'i 7'o mas sbrus te/ril bu sran ma tsam bya'o/ /de'i steng du 'jam dpal dang dbyangs can ma gnyis zhal sbyor gyi tsa ka li cig bzhugs par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba bi shuzluḥsarba dharmāḥswa dh+wa ba bi shusgophohaṃ 9gi sngags kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid 37— 27/

du bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa cig 1bsam / de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥ ser po gur gum gyi mdog can cig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgu mdog dmar po phyag g.yas na shes rab kyi ral gri g.yon na shes rab kyi puste bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zha'/ 'dzum bag dang ldan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /mdun gyi lcung bzed kyi nang du dhī ཿdkar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ dbyangs can ma 5dkar mo g.yas na ral gri g.yon na pusnyi bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang bcas pa zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa dag bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sa bon gnyis las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas so sor bstem mo/ /yang 6'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab dang mthu dang nus pa thams cad basbus nas rang dang rdzas la bstem par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/ na mo mañju shrī bā gī shwa ri sum̐/ bā gī shwa ri hoḥ / u pa de sha pra mo da ta dha ba ni dhī ཿswā hā/ sngags kyi 'od zer bdag gi zhal nas lha mo'i zhal du9/ lha mo'i zhal nas bdag gi thugs kar thim par bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don du shes rab kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ gti mug la sogs pa thams cad bsal bar bsgom/ 'jig rten drag byed kyi pradz+nyā thams cad basbus par bsgom/ sman gyi ri lu dang bdag la thim pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsgom mo/ /'di'i phan yon ni nyin gcig bsgrubs na nyin gcig /tshigs su bcad pa stong 27—272

zin par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma gnyis bsgrubs 1na bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ / nyi ma gsum bsgrubs na skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /2nyi ma bzhi yis sangs rgyas dang pradz+nyā mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /4lnga yis ma bslabs pa'i chos la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /drug gis 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdun gyis gzhan gyi sems shes par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i tshad zhag bdun du bya'o/ /rtags ni 'od dang sgra la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /zhag brgyad na dkyil 'khor gyi lha rang dang ri lu la bstem ril bu de sgrub pa pos zos pas5/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang shes rab mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /thun mong che'i dngos grub kyang 'thob ste/ de ltar yang / 'di zos yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /lo brgya thub pa brgyad brgyar 'gro/ /dgu bcu lon pa bcu drug lta bu 6'gyur/ /skra dkar bud nas nag por 'gyur/ /bang ni rta dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /skra ni me tog pad+ma 'dra/ /lus ni dkar la sgom par 'gyur / /nyams stobs lus zungs 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha 'dre rnams kyang stong grogs byed/ /yon tan smon 'jug sems dang ldan/ /sems bskyed 8de dang ldan pa yi/ /skyes bu de ni dam pa yin/ /yon tan de dang ldan zhes smra/ /'jam dpal rdo rje blo gros 'phel ba zhes bya ba kun gyi thun mong ma yin nga slob dngo na klu sgru ba zhabs kyis mdzad nga rdzogs so // //

༄/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dpyad bzhugs sgo// 1༄7/ /mnos nas su/ bla ma de la gus par 2phyag 'tshal nas/ /ci rnyed pa yi yon mchog tshul bzhin dbul/ //gzhung las 'byung ba'i sngags be+e bzlas par bya/ /ri 4'dzin gyis kyang de nas phyag 'tshal te/ /ci nus pa yi mchod pa sna tshogs byos/ /spos chus sbyar ba'i me tog sna tshogs kyis/ /tshig sbyin de nas snying pos bzhes su gsol/ /de yi rtsa ba'i sngags ni 'dir bshad pa/ /rab tu gsang ba'i yi ge 'bru drug ste/ / wā sh-i 5shwa ra zhes pa'i thag ma la/ /oṃ ste de yis 6tha mar mu gzhag go/ /snying po'i sngags ni bā gi shwa rar 7med/ /'tshogs ma'i de bzhin 'dir ni mu mu yin/ /spyi gtsug de bzhin snga ma'i oṃ med pa/ /saṃ i / yin te de yi mtha' mar mu/ /go cha 'bar ba oṃ oṃ de nas mu/ /swā hā rtag tu tha mar nges par ro/ /oṃ i de nas mu ni rab 'bar ba/ /mtshon cha yin par sngags rig pa la bshad/ /'di ni don 37—27bye

grub pa yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dgod pa'i cho ga sngon mthong bshad pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /cho ga mchog 'di rab tu bshad par bya/ /cho ga bzhin du thog mar sngags mnos nas/ /bsod nams skye bos bcags pa dke ba'i yul/ /mdangs dga' ri bor 'bab chu'i ngogs dag tu/ /gnas nas de ru gtsang ma'i gnas byas te/ /sa phyogs de yi shar gyi ngogs 1gcig tu/ /thogs ma bye ma can gyi sa dag la/ /gzhi dang bcas pa'i rin chen stegs bu ni/ /rab tu mdzes pa khru gang tsam du bya/ /tshig sbyin pa la de ru mchod pa yang / /cho ga shes pa'i sngags pas rtag tu bya/ /de nas der ni ji skad bshad pa yin / /bzlas pa'am mchod pa zin ma thag tu bya/ /sngags kyi cho gar ldan pa'i khrus dag bya/ /bsgrub pa'i cho ga shes pas rtag tu bya/ /de la tshig sbyin snying pos drug pa ru/ /bye ma can gyi sa dag blang bar bya/ /de ni mtshogs mas de bzhin kun tu sbyang / /de la sngags pas spyi gtsug bzlas nas su//de yis cho gas 4de nas sa de la/ /cha gsum dag tu rnam par dbye bar bya/ /de nas 5de'i cha gcig blangs nas su/ /sngags pas phyogs kun tu ni gtor bar bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa cha gcig chu der gtor/ /cha gcig gis ni lus dang yan lag bsku/ /tshig sbyin gyi 6ni 'bru drug gang gsungs pa/ /de brjod nas su chu der 'jug par bya/ /skal ba bzang po rab tu dri zhim pas/ /mdangs dga'i chu la tshul bzhin khrus kyang bya/ /de ltar sngags pas tshul bzhin byas pas na/ /gtsang zhing nang gi yid kyang dag pa des/ /thog mar bdag la ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /sngags rnams kyis ni rnam par dgod bya ba/ /lus la yan lag dgos 7pa'i rim pas so/ /de ltar lus ni rung bar byas nas 37—276

su/ / /'jam mgon tshig sbyin de ni bdag yin zhes/ /mgon po yin par de lta/ra byas nas ni/ /sngon du bsnyen pa zla gsum byas pa yis/ /de 'dir tshig bi dbang po 1grub par 'gyur/ /yang dag bkod pa dang por byung na ni/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thams cad rig pa 'thob/ /de yi snying po'i sngags ni rab 'bar ba/ /sngags pas bdag gi snying khar bzhag nas su/ /de nas mtshogs ma'i sngags kyang mtshogs ma ste/ /bdag blos spyi gtsug de bzhin spyi gtsug tu/ /tshig sbyin go cha mchog ni lus la ste/ /lag pa gnyis dang tshig tu mtshon cha'i sngag4 /cho ga bzhin du de ltar lus 5byas nas/ /de ni tshig gi dbang por 'dir 6'gyur ro/ /de ni yid kyis 7rtsa ba'i sngags zlos shing / /sngags mkhan bdag gi gnas su 'gro bar bya/ /song nas de bzhin stegs bu dang bcas par/ /yid kyis mtshon bya'i sngags kyis brtsal bar bya/ /yang na yungs kar ram ni me tog gi/ /thal mo lan gsum brdabs pas khor yug tu//phyogs mtshams dag ni rnam pa bsal 9byas nas/ /blo ldan bstan ba gcig 'dug pas nan tan du/ /mchod pa ji skad bshad pa legs par bya/ /mchod nga/ byas nas mdun du de 'dug ste/ /sngags kyi nor bu mtshon chas blangs pa ni/ /gtsang zhing dge bas tshul bzhin bzlas par bya/ /de ni yid la yi ge gcig pu sems / /sgra la sogs pa phyi rol yul dang bral/ /skyon med sems kyes cho ga bzhin du bya1 / /de bzhin grangs kyang yid la bzung nas su/ /de yang de la yid kyis dbul bar bya/ /de nas bzlas pas skyo bar gyur na yang / /mchod rten dag la sogs pa'i las gsungs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i las rnams de nas bya/ /mchod rten zin pa'i tu'ang mchod pa dag /sdig pa byang ba 37—277

mthong ba'i phyir bya'o/ /de ltar gang 1gi yi ge bzhin/ /'bum grangs bzlas byas de yis de nas su/ /rang gi spyad las dngos grub gang bstan pa/ /mdun na 'dug ste thos pas 'dzin pa'ang mthong / /sngon du bsnyen pa chig 'bum sngar byas pas/ /nang par chu la bdun gsum bzlas btungs na 2/ /de ni zla ba gcig gis glen pa yang / /gdon mi za bar lan gcig smras pas zin / /rang bzo sna tshogs dag kyang legs par byed/ /gtsug lag don 'brel dka' ba dag kyang shes/ /sgra yi gtsug lag la sogs mi shes kyang / /rgol ba dag las skad cig la 4yang rgyal/ /oṃ saṃ bgo sum̐ cig char phyogs rnams su/ / /de nas bā gi shwa ras mtshams rnams su/ /rang gi sa bon mu ni dkyil du gzhag /'bar ba de ni mi shes med par byed/ /'khor lo de ni rtsibs brgyad par bshad de/ /zla ltar dkar ba snying khar bsams pa ni/ /shes rab rnor 'gyur sa bon de dgu ste/ /zla 'od gsal ba'i 'od zer dang bcas pa'o/ /'khor lo bcu drug rtsibs kyang zhi ba ste/ /sa bon de dag nyid kyis gsal bar byas / /dkyil du oṃ dang rab tu 'bar ba'i mu/ /mi shes nyes pa sel phyir 'bar ba ste/ /ka la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams dang ldan/ /snying khar bzhag pa legs par gang shes pa/ /sngags pas zla ba gcig gis ma lus shes/ /ji na/da thos pa'ang lan gcig dag gis 'dzin/ /nam mkha' de bzhin rtsibs ni med par bshad/ /'khor lo de yang 'dir ni oṃ gzhag 5ste/ /de la sna byed sa bon gcig bzhag pa/ /mi shes med phyir rab tu 'bar ba'i mu/ /'khor lo 'di ni snying khar legs bsams na/ /zla ba gcig gis thos pa 'dzin par bshad / /rab tu myur ba'i tshig kyang thams cad du/ /de nas sngags pa des 37——278

ni rig par 'gyur/ /'khor lo dkyil bzangs 1snying khar bzhag 2pa ni/ /shel sgong bzhin du rab dkar bcu drug rtsibs/ /rang gi sa bon zla 'od 'dra dang bcas/ /dkyil du oṃ bzhag mu ran gnyis/ su phyed4/ /sa bon ma lus 'bar bas mu ran brgyan/ /'od 'phros rab tu 'bar byung nyi ma 'dra/ /dri med shel gong 'dra ba'i oṃ dkyil gyi/ /dbus su mu mu rab tu 'bar ba gzhag /mi shes mun pa bsal 6phyir 'di bshad de/ /mun pa'i nang na 'di ni mdun na 'bar / /sgom pa'i tshe na lus la rab bltas na/ /thams cad shes par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /de nas 'khor lo 7mu ran legs phye ba/ /yi ge gcig pa'i sa bon gcig bzhag pa'o/ /snying por bcas pa'i 8phyi rol mtshon char ldan/ /mtshon chas rtsibs rnams rab tu gsal bar byas/ /dkyil du bzhag pa'i sa bon sngon bshad pa/ /rin chen rtse mo me ltar shin tu 'bar/ /rab tu 'phro ba 'od zer mang po 'phro/ /thub pas bsgoms na nges par ma lus shes / /bsam gtan dang ldan tshig ni rab tu gsal/ /de yi lus kyang rab tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /khams gsum dag gi don rnams ma lus pa/ / ring na / gnas pa des ni ci bzhin shes/ /de bzhin dpyad la 'bras bu khyad par can / /bstan pa rnams kyang mkhas pas 'dir bshad pa/ /brtul zhugs dam pa ji skad bshad pa ni/ /gzhon nu brtul zhugs 'di ru gdon mi za/ /gzhon nu'i brtul zhugs 'dir ni gtsor bshad de/ /dngos grub thob phyir zla ba gcig tu'o/ /byis pa'i zur phud mdzes/ pa gsum dag dang / /mgul 1 gyi rgyan yang gser mchog dag gis brgyan/ /lus kyi yan lag ngo mtshar mdzes par byas/ /dpral bar mdzes pa'i 'tshal ris gcig kyang bri/ /rgyan du 37—279

'os pa'i gdu bu bzang pos brgyan/ /gos kyang khra bo'am yang na dkar po gcig /brtul zhugs 'di ni tshangs pa mchog spyad 1bshad/ /zas su zho 'am 'bru mar tshigs ma bza'/ /byis pa'i rgyan gyes shin tu mdzes par brgyan/ /thog mar bsrung ba tshul bzhin byas nas su/ /bu don gzhon nu'i gzugs kyi spyan snga ru/ /brtul zhugs spyad cing bzlas pa'ang der bya'o/ /sngags pas bu don de 'a/ mchod pa yang / /grub pa thob phyir 'dir ni rtag 2tu bya/ /de bas bu don brtul zhugs sngon rol tu/ /bzo bo mkhas pas legs par bri ba ni/ /ras kyang khru gang tshad du byas pa ste/ /gsar la kha tshar dang yang 4rab tu bshad / /kha dog gsal ba'i mtshon bzangs sbyin med pas/ /gzhon nu'i 5sgu gzugs ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /dkar sham po la sha tshugs legs byas nas / /pad+ma'i gdan la bde bar bzhugs par bya/ /zhal bzangs gzhon nu'i gzugs las ldem bag can/ /yan lag yongs rdzogs sku ni mchog tu mdzes//mdzes pa'i ud nga/la g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /de yis 6phyag g.yas mchog ni sbyin par mdzad/ /rigs 7'dzin mang po rnams kyang mchod pa byed/ /sku gzugs de yang ri yi phug na gnas/ /cho ga bzhin du legs par bris nas su/ /ji skad bshad pa'i mchod pa rab tu bshad8/ /'dir ni mchod pa'i yi ge 'bru drug ges/ /snying ngo/sa spyan drangs gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /de bzhin pad mo'i phyag rgyas bya ba ni/ /de la yon chab dag 7ni dbul ba dang / /spyan drangs pa dang gdan la bzhugs pa dang / /gshegs su gsol ba'ang snying por bcas pas so/ /pad+mo'i phyag rgya tshul bzhin bcings nas su/ /las rnams bshad pa gzhan yang legs par bya/ /de ltar brtul zhugs spyad cing 37—280

——sngags sgrubs 1nga/sa/ /de nas sngon du bsnyen 2sogs/ byas/ /ral gri la sogs ji skad bshad kun gyi/ /'byor pa mchog gi lam rnams bsgrub par bya/ /brtul zhugs cho ga ji skad gsungs pa'i rnams/ /ma lus par ni bshad nga/ 'di yin no / / de nas gzhan yang 'jam dpal gzhon nu yi/ /dpyad las byung ba'i dpyad ni bshad par bya/ /dkar mo ma yin pa las byung ba yi/ /ba yi 'o ma tshan 4mo'i bsgrub pa ni/ /zla ba gzas zin pa la 'o ma de/ /zhor gyur na ni 'grub 5pa'i mtshan ma yin/ /de tshe 'thungs na 'dod pa'i gzugs 'gyur ba/ /kun tu gzhon nu'i gzugs 6dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ma thag tu nam mkha' la yang 'gro/ /dngos grub can de grub pa rnams kyis bskor/ /ser skya las byung mar yang de bzhin du/ /dngul gyi snod du de ni bzhag nas su/ /zla ba gzas zin tshe ni lag pas dgab/ /rtse gcig yid kyis tshul bzhin bsgrub pa ni//mar de tshar gyur dbu ba byung gi bar/ /de nas mar de myur du 'thungs nas ni/ /thams cad shes 'gyur 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /stobs kyang che ba rlung dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sngags pa de nyid tshe ring 'gyur ba ni/ /lha yi lo stong bar du thub par 'gyur/ /lha yi byad gzugs lha yi dbyangs dang ldan/ /grub pa/ de ni skra gnag nad kyang med/ /'o thug dam pas lhung bzed bkang nas su/ /mar gyis blugs la sha kha ra dang sbyar/ /zla ba gzas zen nub rma lag pas dgab/ /rab tu bsgrubs na grub pa'i mtshan 'byung ba/ /lhung bzed 'o thug gis su bkang ba ste/ /lag pas mnan kyang rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de nas lcung bzed 'o thug de 'thungs na/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba rig 'dzin rab tu g.yo/ /de 'thungs na ni dngos grub ma thob kyang / /tshe zad pa yang nad med lo brgya 27—28/

thub / /gtsug lag don rnams rang gis 'grel nus pa/ /gang zhig glen pa'ang 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /ral gri de bzhin ut+pal lo ma 'dra/ /tshad dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba la/ /thog mar bsrungs nas bsgrub par bya ba ni/ /lag pa g.yas pas legs par bzung nas su/ /zla ba gzas zin tshe ni 1ral gri de / /'bar zhing rab tu g.yo ba'i bar du bsgrub/ /de nas kun tu 'bar ba'i ral gri des/ /rig 'dzin 'gyur ba g.yo zhing nam mkhar 'gro/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi thog mar 'gro ba ste/ /ral gri grub pas de ni stobs kyang che/ /gzugs mchog 'gyur ba gser gyi gtso ma 'dra/ /skra yang rab tu 'khyil pa lcang lo bzhin/ /ldong ros dag kyang de bzhin me mdag 'dra/ /mar dang de bzhin 'o ma las btags nas/ /zla ba gzas zin tshe na sngar bsrungs la/ /dngul gyi snod du bzhag 4ste bsgrub par bya/ /ldong ros de las nam zhig grub pa na / /rnam pa gsum du 'gyur bar mkhas pas 5bshad/ /tshe bar 'gyur zhing de nas du ba 'byung / /yang na de bzhin rab tu 'bar bar 'gyur/ /tsha bar gyur pa nyid kyis rkang mgyogs par/ /gdon mi za bar de ma thag tu 'gyur/ /du ba byung na de yi rjes nyid du/ /bar chad med par mi snang 'grub par 'gyur//'bar ba byung na de nas yang dag par/ /nam mkha' dag la myur du 'gro bar 'gyur / /rkang pa dag dang lus bskus thig le ste/ /rim pa bzhin du dngos grub sbyar bar bshad/ /shu dag dkar po'am de bzhin gangs can gyi/ /zla ba gzas zin nub mo bsgrub pa ni/ /sngags pa'i kha na 'dug pa g.yo bar byed//zos na des ni thams cad rig pa 'thob/ /shes rab rno 'gyur sman gag gnas nga/ dang / /gzhan dpyad bshad pa yon tan mang po rnams/ /de dag sman gyi 37—282

dpyad las 'byung ba yi/ /cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs nas sbyar bar bya/ /dpyad 'di dag 1gis phyin ci ma log par/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'di ru bshad pa yin / /dpyad gzhan dag gis 2dngos grub cho ga rnams/ /bltas nas de bzhin 'dir ni bsgrub par bya/ /shag ti tri shul rdolcags kyu 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rma bya de yi mjug ma rnams/ /ral gri sgrub 4pa'i cho ga bshad pa bzhin/ /bsgrubs na ji skad bshad pa'i dngos grub 'thob/ /phyi 5ma mig sman rtsa ba'i dngos grub rnams/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa yi bshad pa bzhin/ /sngags rig pas ni de bzhin bsgrub par bya/ /sngags mkhan gtsang sbra che ba 6rtag 'bad pas/ /nyi ma'i rtse la lan brgya bzlas pa yi/ /chu 'thungs na ni bsnyen pa ma byas kyang / /lo gcig gis ni tshig la dbang du 'gyur/ /gtsug lag don rnams ma lus shes par 'gyur/ /'dus byas rang bzhin zung du ma 'dres pa / /lan gcig thos nas 'di ni chud mi za/ /de ni thog mar yis 7ches phyir bshad do/ /'di ni cho ga basbus nas bshad pa ste/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rab tu gsang ba yi/ /dpyad 'di tshig bcad brgya yi grangs byas pa//grub pa 'phags pa'i lhas ni 'di byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dpyad rdzogs sto/ // //37—283

༄/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sed bye ka bī ra mañju gho ṣa sā dha rgo2/bod skad du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/'jam nga/'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por 4sngags pas gdong bkru ba la sogs pa bya ste yid dang mthun pa'i bsam gtan gyi gnas gtsang zhing / me tog dri zhim pos gcal du bkram par/stan gtsang la bde bar skyil mo krung 5gis 'dug ste/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥ bispyon+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa ces/ bya ba'i sngags lan bcu'i bar du brjod de phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar a chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin skye ba med par ston par byed pa/ ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas rang gi lus gsal 37—286

bar byed pa shin tu phra ba bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pas 'od zer dkar po'i thig le shel sgong dag pa lta bu/ de rim gyis 'phel bar gyur pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs su bsam zhing / de'i steng du yi ge dhī⑫ཿde'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phro ba rin po che'i sgron ma ltar dkar ba rnam par bsam mo de nas yi ge dhīkyeḥde'i 'od zer shin tu dkar ba'i tshogs kyis a+yo 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byas pa sngon du 'gro bas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / bla ma rnams bskul te spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs la rnam par bsams la phyag bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu yid kyis tsu rang bzhin gyi mchod pas mchod par bya ba yin la/ de la mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge dhīḥ⑤las byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra dhū bhu pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge dhīḥ7de nyid las 8yang dag par spros pa'i bdug pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/yi ge dhīḥrmyede nyid las rin po che'i sgon ma spros la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge dhīḥ7de nyid las byung ba'i dri'i mchod pa'i sprin yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye zhe1hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pasazhu/ yi ge dhīḥ( de nyid las rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod du bcug pa'i zhal zas ro mchog dang ldan pa'i mchod pa'i 7sprin rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba bi shiṣ+ṭa mupū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dra ār+ṣaḥhūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ de 37—287

nyid las rin po che sna tshogs kyi gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dang / bla re la sogs pa dang / 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa byas nas de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la 2rjes su yi rang ba dang gsol ba gdab pa dang / bskul ba dang / bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byas la/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang /dga' ba dang / btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudheḥsarba dharmāḥswa 4bhā wa bi shurjolhahaṃ 5zhes bya ba'i sngags lan bdun brjod la/ 'gro ba thams cad sgyu ma dang / rmi lam dang smig rgyu 6lta bur stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar chud pa'i yi ge dhī7ཿde'i 'od zer gyi tshogs spyos pas rang gi lus stong par blta zhing / de nas bdag nyid 'jam dpal ye shes kyi sku'i bdag nyid can yi ge dhī8ཿtsam du gnas par bya'o/ /phyis yi ge dhī9ཿde yongs su gyur pa'i acal sngon po bsgoms pa ⑩la de'i dbus su yang yi ge dhīḥ 2gnas par bsam mo/ /'od zer de yis 'go ba kun/ /kun nas yongs su sbyangs nas ni/ /rang gi 'dod lha'i gzugs dag tu/ /gyur pa ut+pa/la la bstem mo/ /de nas de yongs su gyur pa las shel sgong dag pa dang 'dra ba/ dbu gcig pa dang phyag gnyis pa/ /zla ba'i gdan bzhugs zla ba 'dra'o / /zur phud lnga po dag gi thod/ /zhi ba rin chen cod pan 'chang / /rgyan kun rnam par 'dzin 'gyur dang / g.yas kyis mchog 7sbyin g.yon dag gis྾ / /ut+pal sngon po 'dzin 'gyur ba/ /a la'i steng du shes rab kyi pha 37—288

rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam yang dag par 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs su bdag nyid bsgoms la/ rang gi lus las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa 1khyab par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu nyid kyi thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge dhīḥ dkar po 'bar ba'i phreng ba gtams par bsams la/de nas rang gi snying ga la gnas pa'i yi ge dhīḥ4las 'od zer gyi tshogs kyi sprin kun tu spros pa des/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' bskul nas/ sbyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams la/snga ma bzhin yang dag par mchod de/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge bzhis spyan 5drangs nas/ dam tshig sems dpa' bdag nyid la dgug pa dang / gzhug nga/ dang /6 bcing ba dang / dgyes pa byas la/ oṃ dharma dhā tu bā gī shwa ri 7swa/ bhā ba āt+ma kolhahaṃ / zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de'i rjes la yi ge dhīḥ9las 'od zer spro ba byas la de bzhin gshegs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams la/ / dbang bskur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don du mnyes par bya ste/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen stsol mdzad pa/ /bdag la'ang bsrung ba'i don kyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i 1 rdo rje deng bdag stsol2/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sgu las byung ba'i lo tsa 5na dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / tā ras 7rin po che'e bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba phyag na bsnams pas/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bsgur ba/ /khams gsum po yis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /zhes bya ba 'don cing dbang bsgur bar bsam mo/ /dbang bsgur ba 7rdzogs ma thag rin po che'i cod pan gyi steng du/37—289

de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod 1pa bsams la/ lus dang ngag dang yid gsum byen gyis 2brlab pa'i phyir/ spyi bo la yi ge oṃ dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / gog mar yi ge āḥ4dmar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / snying gar yi ge hūṃ nag po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa rnam par bkod pa la/ spro ba dang bsdu 5ba'i spyor bas ji srid mngon sum dang 'dra bar snang ba de srid du bsgom par bya zhing / bsgoms 6pas skyo bar gyur na sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /sngags ji tsam 'os 7pa bzlas pa byas nas/ cho ga nyams pa bskang bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas nas/ ye shes sems dpa' yang dag par mchod de bsod nams su bsngos la gshegs su gsol lo/ /de la ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon napar mdzad du gsol/ /muḥzhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i yi ge brgya pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe 5no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ —rto me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha bas/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha slob/ sarba sidhim+me 7pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru t+t+waṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca babye bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /de 'a/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥdhī ཿhūṃ zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /yang 2 oṃ badz+ra tīkyā duḥkhats+tshad pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya bā gī na shwa ra/ a ra pa tsa nā 25ya te na maḥzhes bya ba ni bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs 37—290

dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i 1 sgrub thabs/ slon dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā 4ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/286 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ lta ra brkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༄/ /'jam/ pa 'i dbyangs dpa'
