〉sras/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉sdu/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra sgo ma/37—29/

༄/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1༄7/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pa yis/ /spang rgyan gla ba mtshal dkar gsum/ /yung ba tsan+dan a ka ru/ /spang spos dbang lag shu dag gsum/ /gser mdog rgya skyegs shing mngar gsum/ /dpa' bo bcu gnyis bsdus nas ni/ /zhib par btags te khru nga rtsi dang / /ba dmar 'o mas ri lu bya/ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad byas nas ni/ /ri lu rnams la dhīḥdang dhīḥ/ /bri ba'i snag tsha gur kum dang / /rgya skyegs gi wang bsres pas bri/ /rin chen snod du blugs byas nas/ /pad+ma ser po 'dab brgyad dbus/ /gong gi ri lu bzhag byas nas/ /dmar ser dar gye gur yang dbub / /shar du kha bltas stong nyid bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i gdan / /de steng pad+ma zla ba'i dbus/ /yi ge dhīḥdamar tsheg drag can/ /zhod zer dmar po 'phro ba yi/ /de las bdag nyid 'jam dpal ni/ /sku 37—293

—mdog dmar po rgyan dang ldan/ /'od zer dmar po 'phro ba can/ /g.yas nga/ ral gri g.yo/na pa na/ /puste bsnams shing rgyan dang ldan/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du 'greng / /de ltar bdag nyid bsams nas ni/ /thugs kar rja las/ 'khor lo bsam/ /lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bsko ra bar bsam/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang gzhug /mdun gyi lhung bzed dbus su ni/ /yi ge dīḥlas dbyangs can ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo gzi brjid can/ /g.yas na ral gri g.yo/na puste/ /bsnams shing rgyan dang yang dag ldan/ /thugs kar ral gri sngags kyis bskor/ /'od kyis 1ye shes spyan drang gzhug /mdun du sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang bsam/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /blo yi mun pa bsal bar bsam/ /de ltar bsams nas dang po ni/ /bdag gi thugs kar ral gri dang / /sa bon dhīḥdang bcas pa las/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ /bdag gi sna bug g.yas nas byung / /dbyangs can ma yi g.yon du zhugs/ /thugs ka'i sngags dang dīḥl thim/ /thugs ka'i gnas nas tshur la byung / /bdag gi thugs kar zhugs pa las/ /ā li kā li'i sngags su gyur/ /khong ba'i nang dang ba spu'i gseb/ /dpag tu med pas khengs par bsam/ /bar gyi sngags kyi phreng ba 'a/sa/ /'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dus gsum bla ma yi dam dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs pa'i / /sgu gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ /bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor bstem / /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /blo yi mun pa bsal bar 37—29/

—bsam / /yang gcig 'phros pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /dge bshes rnams kyi nus mthu dang / /mtha' yi nor bu'i 'od zer dang / /rtsi shing nags tshal bcud rnams basbus/ /bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor bstem/ /lus la ye shes bdud rtsis gang / /des ni shes rab 'phel bar bsam/ /bzlas pa byed pa'i dus dag tu/ /mdun du ri lu la dmigs shing / /sngags ni stong phrag bzhi ru bzlas/ /oṃ dīḥdhī ma me dī pa mañju shrī sum̐/pradz+nyā dhā tuḥdīḥswā hā/ brgya rtsas mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur/ /stong gis sgra skad kun la mkhas/ /khri phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na/ /nyi ma re re dag la yang / /sh+lau ka ni lnga stong re/ /'dzin 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /mngon nga/ra shes pa 'char ba dang / /gzhan kyi sems rgo shes pa dang / /yi ge'i rigs ni thams cad kyang / /thogs pa med par shes par 'gyur/ /sgra dang bstan bcos thams cad kyang / /bka' bzhin rtsom par nus pa yin/ /phyis ni sa yi dbang phyug 'thob/ /ri lu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na/ /shes rab 'jam 1pa'i rdo rje dang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /ri lu dbyangs can mar mthong na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'go bar 'gyur/ /ri lu nyi zlar mthong gyur na/ /sngon gyi skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /ri lu 'od du mthong gyur na/ /smra bzhi dag la mkhas pa dang / /'od dang dung dang rnga sgra dang / /rlung dang nyi ma me tog dang / /yi ge 'dri klog mthong ba dang / /snag tsha 'athrungs dang nyams dga' dang 2/ /me tog 'dzugs dang zhing rmo ba/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags su 'dod/ /de nas mdun gye sangs rgyas dang / /dbyangs can ma dang bcas pa rnams/ /'od du zhu nas ril bur thim/ /nang 37—295

ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /ril bu re re zos gyur na/ /shes rab 'phel bar the tshom med/ /dang por rjes gnang thob nas ni/ /skar ma rgyal la bsgrub par bya//gcig dang brgyad dang bco lnga la/ /bsgrubs na shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /brdzun dang sha chang sgog pa dang / /sngo ngad la sogs g.yeng ba dang / /'khon dang zhe sdang drag po dang / /grogs ngan mya ngan smre sngags dang / /sems la gnod pa'i las rnams spang / /bza' ba bdog pa thams cad kyis/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mchod nas ni/ /rtag tu lha la gsol ba gdab/ /sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom/ /gal te las 'phro yod gyur na/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba thams cad kun/ /nyi ma gcig gis grol bar 'gyur/ /'bring gis gnyis kyis rtogs pa ste/ /nyi ma gsum du bsgrubs gyur na/ /las 'phro med kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi rtsod pa bzlog pa ni/ /dpral bar dhīḥyig dmar po bsam/ /dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros nas ni/ /kho yi shes pa bkug nas kyang / /srin lag bzhi la bstim nas ni/ /oṃ tweḥdhīḥche ge mo nan hūṃ phaṭa/rtsod pa kun las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gcan gzan rgyal bo seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas / /dur khrod wa tshogs thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs dug rnams 'joms pa'i shes rab mchog /bdag gis 'jam 2pa'i dpal la rab zhus pas/ /'gro rnams shes rab gru yis 'don par shog /rje btsun dam nga rgya gar gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// //37—296

1614༄rgya/ /rje btsun 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañju shrī bhaṣ+ṭa rā ka sā dha rgo pradz+nyā tsakra/bod skad du/ rje btsun 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang mthus snying gi ma rig mun sel shes rab snang ba kun bskyed mdzad/ /sna tshogs bstan bcos rig pa dang ni gsang sngags phan pa rnams sbyin pa/ /'dod dgu'i gter gcig gzhon nu yid 'ong zur phud lnga dang ldan pa tshogang / /'jam dbyangs masgon la gus nga/sa/ btud de de bsten man ngag bri bar bya / /sngags pas rjes su mthun nga/'i gnas/ /byi dor byug pa bzang byas la/ /khyad par skyabs rten sems bskyed nas/ /gzhon nu shes rab 'khor lo bsgom/ /snying dbus bu gar ri bong 'dzin/ /ye shes sa bon dhīrka ཿyig 'od/ /skar mdog rnam par gsal bar blta/ /de las tshogs rten dkyil 'khor dgug /dngos dang 37—298

yid las byung dang gzhan/ /yang dag ye 1shes mchod pas mchod/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang sdig sel dang / /bsod nams phung po gzhan yang ngo /byams 2dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi yis//skye bo ma lus rjes chags shing / /chags bral sdom pa gzung bar bya/ /de jes gsang sngags gnyis brjod pas/ /yul dang yul can dag bya'i phyir/ /sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur/ /mkhas pas stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ4sarba dhazluḥswa bhā ba shusbyo3haṃ5/ oṃ shu n+ya tādz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kophohaṃ/ ba yig a dang dhīḥyig las grub chu skyes dang / /zla rgyas gdan la shes rab ral gri sa bon mtshan/ /dkar bsil zla ba bye ba'i gzi 'od las lhag pa'i/ /dpal gyis sa gsum shes rab snang ba 9bskyed par bsgom/ /dus gsum gshegs dang phyogs bcu'i char bzhugs sangs rgyas dang / /de sras de bzhin drang srong dang ni rig 'dzin tshogs/ /ma lus yon tan blo gros snang ba basbus nas kyang / /skad cig rnam pas 'jig rten gsum mgon 'jam dbyangs gyur / /gzhon nu'i ngang tshul ral gri puste 'khor lo 'dzin/ /rab sgeg brtan 7mdzes dul ba'i rang bzhin blo bzang po/ / bya/ la krung rab gsal rin chen dpag med 'phro ba yi / /blo ngan sel mkhas sangs rgyas sras ni sgrub pos blta/ /de snying zla steng dhīḥyig las byung ཿ'od zer gyis/ /ye shes mgon bkug tshon ྾gang gzugs kyi sasnying gar gnas/ /de snying dbus su'ang dhī ཿyig 'bar bas brgyan bsams te/ /dri rnged dkar gsal 'od tshogs phreng bas brgyan par bsgom/ /sems dpa' gnyis kyi 8gdan gang yin/ /rang snyeng zla ba rtsibs 9brgyad rgo/ /shes rab rig pa brgyad kyis mtshan/ /rdza 37—299

mkhan 'khor lo lta bur 'khor/ /rab dkar snang bas mun sel byed/ /rgon pos mi shes smag 1rum 'jig /shugs drag las dang nyon mongs gcod/ /phan tshun bzlog pas 'khrul pa 'joms/ /a ra pa tsa na dhī4ཿhūṃ/ /oṃ gyis thog mar brgyan pa ni/ /rig pa'i rgyal po brgyad par grags/ /lo phyed 'bras bu mthong bar gyur5/ /gzugs brnyan brag ca de bzhin du/ /'ja' tshon lta bur sku gsung thugs/ /mi rtog gsal bar gang gis dran/ /ma yengs yid can de yis 'grub/ /ldang bar 'dod tshe 'od 'phros pas/ /slar yang srid gsum basbu ba'am/ /yang na dngos grub blangs nas su/ /bsod nams 'gro la sbyin par bya/ /gang phyir 'di na la las sngon chad dge ma bsags/ /la las lam 'tshol la las legs spyad bar chad bya7/ /gzhan gyis de bzhin yun ring lha mchog mnyes ma byas/ /de phyir skye bo ma rig mun 'thoms / rnams 'khyams snyam/ /de dag brtse bas rab tu 'bad pa'i shugs ni 'dir bskyed pa'i/ /mthu yis mngon grub mtshan ma cung zad rnyed pa la brten te/ /'khor lo dri med rab tu dkar rgyas zla ba nya 'dra'i tshul/ /brjod pas skye bo rnams ni 'jam dbyangs nyid myur mthong gyur byug /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra ka ra gube+es mdzad nga rdzogs so // // paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang byams pa dpal gyis bsgyur cing gtan la /〈/ba 15 37—300

bsdur mchan/298 1 ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /rje btsun 'jam dpa/la shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs sto/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉ngaphags pa 'jam dpa/la rje btsun shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gzhan yang thabs dang bstod pa 'di man na mang du yod do/ / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉bhā n+d+ra swa/ 〈〈pe 〉7dbus su/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/ 6 〈〈pe 〉rdzan/ 7 〈〈pe 〉7pa/sa/8 〈〈pe 〉〉gide/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉gibar bya/ 〈〈pe 〉thasten/ 〈〈snar 〉tharten/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉dhi/ 12〈〈pe 〉ra7ra/299 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ran/ 2 〈〈pe 〉7pa/ 〈〈pe 〉thazung / 4 〈〈pe 〉wā ba shudha/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhan+d+ra swa bha ba shubho haṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dhasmaḥswa bhā ba shurngolhahaṃ/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉shu/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〉 bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ baṃ/〈〈snar 〉〉su bhā ba zhwa kolhahaṃ/ baṃ/ 8 〈〈snar 〉mas 9 〈〈pe 〉〉gib/ 〈〈pe 〉〉brten/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉dkyil dkrung / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉 'od/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉giyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉'phros/ sa 〈〈snar 〉〉mtshon/ ྾〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dhi/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/ 〈〈snar 〉〉brtsibs/2/ ༷ ༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brag na 〈〈pe 〉〉zlog 〈〈pe 〉torakhrug 4 〈〈snar 〉〉dhi/ 5 〈〈pe 〉skoragyur/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorachol/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉thul / 9 〈〈pe 〉skorathobs/ —〈〈snar 〉gdangos/ 11 〈〈pe 〉〉sgo—/ ('di'i 'og gi rdzogs so zhis pa/ rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉la rdzogs sto 'es 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) 〈〈pe 〉〉gipa/ṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang byams nga/ dang/la gyis bsgyur cing gtan la/ phab// //37—30 /

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañju shrī tsa la tsa kra/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal g.yo ba'i 'khor lo/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du 'gro ba bsod nams kyi tshogs la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rang gi bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsams la yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom dngos po thams cad rmi lam lta bu'i blo nye bar gzhag /rang gi lus dbul / de nas dri bzangs kyi chus chag chag btab la stan bde ba'i steng du ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang mthun pa'i lus kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom ste/ byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags/ swa bhā ba la sogs kyang brjod do/ /de las skyo bar gyur na gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngang las rang gi sngar gyi gdan gang na yod pa'i sar a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i 37—303

—dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge dhīḥ'od kyi phung po rab tu 'bar bar bsams la de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyi rol gyi snod dang / nang bcud kyi dngos po gang la phog pa rnams 'phags par gyur/ de rnams 'od zer gyis dhīḥl bsdu/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa1/ phyag g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon gyis thugs kar puste bzung ba/zhal cung zad 'dzum pa pad+ma 2kha bye ba lta bu'i spyan dkyus ring ba/ dbu la gtsug 4phud lnga 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan mang pos mdzes 5pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i khye'u ltar gzhon sha dang bcas pa zla ba bye ba'i gzi brjid ltar 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sgu bskyed de/ de'i thugs kar saṃ 6'od zer gyi phung po can yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa kha dog shin tu dkar zhing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba— / de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dbus su saṃ yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dbyangs/ shar du re 8yongs su gyur pa las dra ba can gyi 'od/rgyab tu paṃ / yongs su gyur pa las zla 'od/ g.yas su rtsa yongs su gyur pa las skra can ma/ g.yon du ṭaṃ yongs su gyur pa las nye ba'i skra can ma'o/ /'di dag gi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni phyi rol gyi 'phags pa bzhin no/ /sgu phyi nang thams cad dri ma yongs su dag cing 'od zer 'phros pas 7ma rig pa'i rdzab bsal bar bsam/g.yo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor lo de g.yo zhing 'khor bas rdza mkhan gyi rta'akhor lo ltar rab tu 'khor bas ma rig pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pa rnams gcod par byed do/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /rigs lngas dbang bskur te/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni gzhan dang mthun no/ /zla ba dang 'khor lo dang / lha'i sku dri ma yongs su dag pa 'ja' tshon 37—304

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā gī 2shwa ra sto tra/ bod skad du/ngag gi dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po / /ye shes sgron mas rab brgyan cing / /'jig rten gti mug mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyid kyi mdangs bzang tshogs kyis ni/ /zla ba rgyas pa zil gnon cing / /rig pa rnam par gsal 'gyur ba/ /'jam dpal khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma bgos zur phud gsal ba la5/ /nor bu 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /nyid ni kun tu 'bar ba'i sku/ /'jam dpal khyod 6la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud rtsi dri zhim 'jam la zab/ /yid 'ong gsung gi sgra sgrogs pa/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen mdzod/ /'jam dpal khyod 7la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang gā'i 8chu thigs ltar grangs med/ /'jig rten khams 27—306

kun ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs dri ma rab spangs pa'i/ /'jam dpal khyod sna—la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mche ba gcigs shing bsgyings pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i sku yi tshul gyis ni/ /gshin rje'i dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal khyod 2la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi spyan dang mdangs 'dra ba'i/ /ut+pal sngon po rab mdzes pa/ /lhung bzed phyag mchog bsnams pa yi/ /'jam dpal khyod bye la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rgya cher bstod pa spyod pa dang / /'gro ba'i 5lam ni ston pa po/ /'jam dpal khyod trel phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa rdzogs so// //

306 1 ma tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma tshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa༅/ /'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i bskor bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉she/ 0 〈〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgo sa /57〈〈pe 〉stanang / 6 〈〈pe 〉〉khyed/ 8 〈〈pe 〉toga'i/307 1 〈〈pe 〉〉khyed/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyed/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉brjod/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyed/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1543)37wa 308

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / /dpal gyi 'byung gnas 'jam dpal kun gyi dpal/ /mtha' dag byams pas khyab pas 'jam pa'i ngang / /'jam dang dpal du grags pas don dang ldan/ /'jam dpal yang dag dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhon nu'i sgu mdog gser mdangs 'od lam 'bar/ /rin chen mchog gis brgyan nga/sa sa le spa/ /byin chen dang ba'i thugs mnga' 'dzum pa po/ /gzi brjid mdzes dang ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yon tan gter gyi ut+pal phyag na bsnams / /pad+ma rgyas pa'i snying po'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lha yi 2cha lugs lha las khyad par 'phags/ /lta 4bas mi skyo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhon nu sgeg pa'i tshul du gda' mod kyi/ /ye shes thogs med mnga' bas kun 37—309

mkhyen pas/ /sems can don la nan tan don du gnyer/ /'gro ba mtha' dag sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhon nu rtasprul pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad la/ /gang gis yud tsam mthong bas 'dun pa skye/ /gang la cis 'dul de ltar spru' mdzad pa/ /thabs kyis 'dren pa'i mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsam rtog spros la dbe+en pas sangs rgyas brnyes4/ /yod med rtag chad mtha' la mi gnas shing / /gnyis med mnyam pas 5chos kyi tshul la gnas/ /yang dag don kyi mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod ni chos dbyings zab mo'i 'byung gnas te/ /yi ge smra bas rtog pa'i yul med kyang / /'dul ba'i dbang gis/ cho 'phrul gzugs ston pa/ /dam pas mthong bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid la byed pa spangs/ /rigs /‘pas dgon par gyur pa'i thabs la dbe+en/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i char gyis brlan mdzad cing / /byang chub myu gu skyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byams chen 'gran zla med pa dag gi dbang / /mtshan mar spros pa'i rtsod pa tshar bcad de/ /zhi ba mi g.yo dbyings su 'dzud mdzad pa/ /'jig rten ded dpon mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod / /dbang mkhyen chen po shes rab ral gri yis/ /lta ba dman pas bslad pa'i dra ba 'dral/ /bag yangs mi rtog dbyings su yun du bzhugs/ /skye dgu bange bar 'god la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod ni chos dbyengs zab mo'e 'byung gnas te/ /gsung rab mdo sde bcu gnyis gang la yang / /gang du khyod kyis gsungs pa lhag par zab/ /chos nyid don mchog ston la phyag 'tshal bstod / /dngos po mtshan mar chags pa'i dug 'thungs pas/ /sdug bsnga'/ nad kyis brgyal ba'i sems can rnams/ /gnyis med rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ 37—3/0

ston pa/ /bdud rtsi stobs 1par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma rig d+mo/ngas pas bslad 2pa'i mun rum nas/ /thar ba'i dus med mu cor 'khyams nga/ la/ /ye shes sgron ma'i 'od kyis gsal mdzad nas/ /snang bas thar bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yon tan rdzogs te btsal bar bya min pas/ /thugs rjes 4thugs dam btsan par gyur pa yang / /brtson 'grus skyo ba mi mnga' srid pa sel/ /sems can mtha' dag sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can mthun 5par srid pa mi 'dor zhing / /ji ltar nyes 6pa'i skyon gyis mi gos pa/ /'dam nas pad+ma gsal bar 8'byung ba ltar/ /skyon med dag nga/ khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can zad pa'i mtha' ni dpag dka' ste/ /srid pa stongs par thugs dam bcas pa yis/ / /yon tan des na byang chub gzhan las 'phags/ /thugs rje mthu stobs che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la khye'u bcu drug gis bstod pa rdzogs so// //37—3/ 1

༄༅/ /'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la bstod pa/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bā gī 2shwa ra sto tram̐1 / bod skad du/'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo4/ /gzhon nu yid 'ong mdzes pa'i cha lugs can/ /nyon mongs rnam dag puṇ+ḍa rī 5ka'i mdog /zla ba bye ba'i mdog can mtshungs med sgu//'jam dbyangs snying rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag gi nyes spangs ka la ping ka'i gsung / /stong nyid zab mo'i sgra ni 6bsgrags pa yis/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las sad mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs dag pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal le/ /gnyis med bde chen mtha' dang bral ba'i thugs/ /mkha' ltar tshad med 'gro ba kun la gzigs/ /sgyu ma'i tshul gyis 'gro don rdzogs mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs spros bral rwa thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi rtog ye shes don gyi 'khor lo dang / /dmigs med thugs rje dra bas 'brel pa yis/ /srid gsum 'khor 37—3/3

ba'i dra ba gcod mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po dra ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mig gis 'gro ba kun la gzigs/ /'od gsal dri med shes rab zla 'od kyis / /ma rig mun nag thibs po sel mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po zla 'od de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen don mtshon shes rab ma yi gzugs/ /'gro la chags pa'i spyan ni zur gyis blta1/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra chen sgrogs mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo skra can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam sgeg bud med tshul/ /thabs dang shes rab yongs rdzogs nu ma rgyas/ /gzhan don mdzad la nye ba'i dgongs pa can/ /nye ba'i skra can ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /kye ma mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mi dge'i sems las bzlog tu gsol / /rmi lam du'ang sdig pa'i sems/ /phyin chad 'byung bar ma gyur cig/bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam dbyangs khyod la rtse gcig gis/ /bsam nga/ gus pas gsol 'debs shing / /rtag tu sgrub pas mnyes byed shog /kye ma 'jam dbyangs snying rje can/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i lam chen nas/ /byang chub sems kyi shing rta dang 2/ /'dren pa'i bshes gnyen rjod kyis mdzod/ /'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga pa'i bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta thig le bum pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—3/

༄rgya/ /gur kum gzhon nu lta bu'i bstod pa/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ na ba rku ku ma sta ba2/ bod skad du/gur kum gzhon nu lta bu'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i ge sar mdangs 'dra'i sku/ /lhag par chags shing mos pa 'dzin 'di ni/ /'gro ba rjes su chags pas 'dul gzigs nas / /thugs rje nyid kyis gzhan gyi dbang du bzung / /char sprin gzhon dang zla ba lta bu'i zhal/ /gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa rab mdzes pa 'char kha'i nyi ma'i zer gyis phog pa yi/ /gser gyi pad+ma lta bu rol pa'i zhal/ /thub pa yan lag dri med rin chen brgyas/ /brgyan cing yid 'od 'od zer rab 'phro ba/ /char sprin gzhon nu glog gis bskor 'dras ni/ /spras pa khyod kyi cod pan steng na 'dzin/ /'char kha'i zer gyis pad+ma dmar phog pa'i/ /mdangs 'dra dge ba'i mtshan dang rgyan gyi gzhi/ /khyod kyi phyag na ral gri mda' 37—3/6

dag dang / /ut+pal sngon po dang ni gzhu dag 'dzin/ /khyod kyi 'od kyi phung ngo/sa phyogs mtshams su/ /thub rnams rab skyed yon tan rab rgyas byas/ /yang yang rab 'phros 1yang yang rab bsdus pas/ /gdul bya'i blo yi ma rig mun pa 'joms/ /bcom ldan srid pa'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad la/ /tshad sed mchi mas mig brlan 2bkang byas nas/ /thal sbyar spyi btud ba spu langs pa yis/ /thugs rje can la mos pas gus phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis bsdams 'gro gsum po/ /thugs rje chen pos 'grel par mdzad pa la/ /lus dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal ngag dang yang / /phyag 'tshal yid kyis gus nga/sa phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod 'bangs skye bo skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas 'di ni yang dang yang du slong lags so/ /bdag ni skye ba skye bar mgon khyod la/ /skyabs su mchi yis srid pa'i sdug bsngal sol/ /gur gum gzhon nu lta bu'i bstod pa/ slob dpon seng ge mi g.yo bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā 4ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te 5gtan la phab pa'o// //37—3/7

༄gyi/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa rte༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān ār+ya mañju shrī sā byejo na nastu ti/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba rnams kyis bstod par gyur mod de lta na'ang / /bsam pa blun po'ang bla ma la gus dbang gis kyang ni khrod kyi yon tan brjod bgyi ste/ /rab tu dregs bcas dad pa'i rgyal po'i sde dag gis bsten chu dang ldan pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /bzhad rnams kyang ni yid la rab tu dga' ba bskyed de rgyu zhing rnam par gnas par bgyid / /zur phud gsal ldan gser mchog snyan chas legs par rnam brgyan mgul ni rab tu sgeg bcas shing / /snyan gyi gong rgyan ut+pal mdzes 'dra mnga' slad khyod ni gzhon nur rab grags de lta na'ang / /kun tu bzang po 'jig rten 37—3/9

byedadabang phyug rdo rje 'dzin sogs rnga yab mchog tu mdzes 'dzin pa'i/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bla ma lta bur 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su khyod ni bsten 1 par gyur/ /do shal phreng ba'i sil sil sgrogs byed mchog tu dga' skyed snyan 2gdub mnga' ba spyi gtsug gi/ /rin chen 'od mdzes 'phro ba dang ldan gzhon nu'i na tshod dge legs mnga' ba gang na yang / /bcom ldan sa gsum dag na gus pas phyag byar 'os pa khyod ni rtse gcig nyer zhi yi/ /snod gyur mchod par 'os 'di gang na'ang de be+e da su nazhig ngo mtshar ci phyir skye mi 'gyur/ /shin tu rnam 'gyur bzhin ldan sprul stong dag gi chun po gdu bur byas pa 'dzin mdzad cing / /rno ba'i mtshon bsnams g.yul ngor rab dpa' gshin rje rnams ni rab tu skrag par mdzad pa yi4//mi bzad 'phags pa gshin rje'i gshed dang bcas par gyur 5kyang khyod ni zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /cha yi tshogs kun yongs rdzogs lus ldan ston ka'i zla ba nya ba tsholta bur gyur pa lags/ /khyod ni chos lam nye bar ston la mkhas kyang chos 'dir 'ga' yang gzigs pa yod ma yin/ /khyod ni sems can phan la dgyes kyang sems can nyid ni 'ga' yang dmigs par gyur ma lags/ /bde gshegs dgyes pa phan tshun du ni mi 'grigs 'gyur ba'i mdzad spyod mang po 'di 'gal bas / /khyod ni sa gsum ngo mtshar rgyu gcig gyur pa de slad khyod 'dir bsnyen par bgyid nga/ lags/ /gzhan don 'bras bu smin pas shing bzhin rnam par gnas pas gangs chen lta bur gyur pa ste/ /brtan 7pa yi ni ri rab dang 'dra grub pas bsten pas ri rgyal ma la ya dang mtshungs/ /gti myug rab rib zhi bar mdzad pas nyi ma bzhin te phun sum tshogs gzugs zla 'dra yi/ /mgon khyod gzhan don mdzad slad 'gro na byes pa rol 'dra'i mdzad pa yis ni rnam par rgyu/ /37—— 320

dri zhim kyis bsgos mchog tu mdzes pa'i ut+pal sngon po bsnams pas dze+eng bu lta bu ste / /shin tu rnam sgeg tshul dang ldan pas yul gyi byis pa lo brgyad lon pa dang 'dra zhing / /chos char dri ma med pa 'be+ebs pas char sprin 'brug sgra rab tu sgogs pa lta bu dang / /ngang pa'i rgyal po yid 'ong sgra skad zil gnon gsung mnga' khyod la su zhig bsnyen mi bgyid/ /skad cig nyid la yongs su 'bar gyur gti mug rab rib skad cig nyid la zad gyur cing / /thams cad du ni legs pa'i lam ston bde gshegs sdog med mya ngan 'das par gyur pa na/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis legs par spras par gyur pa yi1/ /khyod nyid gcig pu phyogs bcu rnams na da lta mchog tu snang bar mdzad pa ma lags sam2/ /mgon po kye ma khyod gzugs ri mor byas pas kyang ni ji ltar tshim pa skyed byed ltar/ /ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar zhing rab tu mdzes par gyur pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lags te/ /ut+pal sngon po mdzes pa'i dri ngad zhim pos bsgos pa'i ser bu'i 4ngad kyang ma lags shing / /lha yi bu mos bstabs par gyur pa'i ha ri tsan+dan dri bzangs 5ldan pa'ang de lta min/ /gzhon nu khyod zhabs sen mo'i 'od zer phreng ba rgya chen thun mtshams su 6shar zla 'od bzhin/ /shin tu yid 'ong dkar dmar mdog can rab btud 7lha dang lha min gtsug nor 'od zer dang / /'dres pas gang reg ral pa can gyi mi de dag kyang skye bo kun gyis phyag byar 'os/ /mgon po khyod kyi sngags 'dzin grub pa thob nas rab chags sgeg pa las byung ba'i/ /gom tshugs kyis 'gro rgyan phreng rkang gdub yid 'phrog dang ldan mdzes ma brgya dang lhan cig tu/ /sa stengs 8na rol gzhan ni lha yi dbang pos tsan+dan gtul 9ba'i dri zhim dang ldan pa'i/ /37—321

—li shi me tog dri ldan sbrang mas dkrigs pa'i tsan+dan gyi 1ni nags na gnas par byed / /na tshod gzhon zhing dregs dang bcas pas sgeg cing rnam par 'phyen byed gsal bar byas gyur pa'i/ /dri zhim la ni chags pa skyed byed sbrang ma'i tshogs rnams kyis ni rab tu dkrogs gyur cing / /pi wang gling bu ngang pa'i rgyal po dang 'dra shin tu snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan gyur pa'i/ /gnod sbyin bu mo mchog kyang khyod kyi sngags bzlas pa yi mi yis rab tu 'gugs par byed/ /'gro ba gsum kyi mgon po 'bras bu med pa'i mang du brjod pa yis ni ci bgyir mchis//khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho yang yang brjod par thub pa'i mkhyen pas spyod pa ma lags pa/ /de phyir 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan 'di tsam zhes bya 2bdag gis rtogs par nus ma lags/ /kun nas dpag med chu dang ldan pa'i rgya mtsho las ni phan tshun 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mgon po sems dang bcas pa'i mi rnams dag las su zhig 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal bar bgyid/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das be+e mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la mngon par bstod pa bgyid pa las/ /bdag gis dge 4ba gang zhig bsags pa 5des ni 'gro ba kun gyi rnyog pa zhi gyur cig /de yis bdag kyang skye ba dang ni skye bar brtan zhing mtshungs pa med pa'i snyan dngags 6dang / /rigs dang ldan zhing tshe rabs dran dang snying rje rgya chen yid 'phrog pa dang ldan par shog /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa snyan dngags 7mkhan rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can mkhas pa chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po su ma ti k+ṇirti'i zhal snga nas/ bod 37—322

༄khya/ /dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po jes bya ba'i bstod pa/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dz+nyā na gu ṇa pha la nā ma stu tiḥ2/ bod be+ed du/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdodabyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal ba4/ /ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thoms sbug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung / /'brug ltar cher 5sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 6'grol mdzad cing / /ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras 7sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel khyod la 'dud/ /gang 37— 32/

zhig lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gcig dang bdun dang / nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / brgya dang / stong la sogs pa dag 1nyin re bzhin du sgrogs pa de ni go rims ji lta ba bzhin du/ sgrib pa 'dag pa dang / thos pa 'dzin pa dang / spobs pa dang / mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang / phyir rgol ba thams cad 'joms pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po dang stobs la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nyin re bzhin du lan gsum du bstod pa byed pa de ni ji skad bshad pa'i yon tan de dag dang ldan pas shes rab dang snying rje 2lam dang sa rnams rim gyis bgrod de/ gong nas gong du ches cher 'phags nas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i krong khyer du phyin nas 'gro ba ma lus pa 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur ro/ /dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ slob dpon rdo rje 4mtshon chas mdzad pa sdogs so// // rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / bod kyi rngog lo tsā bas bsgyur bam // //537—325

༄/ /'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa/1 sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju ghoṣa sto tra / bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdigs mdzub gdong nyid bstan pa yis4/ /ri rab thon ngo/ du ma g.yos/ /ma lus rgya mtsho chen po'i chu/ /sen mo'i rtse mos gyen du blangs/ /nam mkha' 5mu med pa yi khams/ /zhabs kyi gom pa gcig gis mnan / /zad pa'i dus kyi me 'bar ba/ /zhal gyi dbugs kyis btab pas bcil / /dus mtshungs sgu yi cha gcig la/ /chu dang me yi char phab pa/ /la lar zad par sangs rgyas su/ /gyur nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /la lar nyon mongs ma lus pa/ /nub pas zhi ba'i de nyid ston6/ /dal bas dbang po bde sogs kyi7/ /gdong la rnam par gzigs pa'i spyan/ /phyogs kyi 'khor los bkab pa yis / /phyag mthil dmar po nyi ma rmugs/ /la lar 37—327

lha ma yin gyi dpal/ / mthu gyur 1dam par gyur pa 'dzin/ /khyim pa dang ni brtul zhugs pa/ /tshangs spyod rtag tu ye shes can/ /byis pa'i gzugs can 'gro ba'i yab/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'jigs pa dang stobs mnga' ba/ /thub pa'i gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ /phye ma mig sman dang mtshungs 'di2/ /khyod la skyabs su rab tu mchin/ /nyon mongs bud shing ye shes me/ /du ma mtshon pa bgrang ba 4ltar/ /'khor ba srid pa'i spyor ba dang / /mya ngan 'das la khyod mi gnas/ /mgon po rtag tu dbu ma mchog /yang dag brnyes pa ma lags sam/ /chu dang bcas pa'i snod rnams su/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ /gcig tu gdul bya g.yo ba'i yid/ /rnam pa mang po 'dra ba'i mtshan/ /nyid kyi bag chags yid gcig tu/ /ye shes grub pa'i gsal gyur pa/ /bka' drin don gnyer tshul gyis rgo/ /chags pas khyod kyi zhabs drung lcung 5/ /khyod kyi 'od zer 'phro ba'i cha/ /phyogs kyi khongs su 6rnam spros pa/ /zla ba'i 'od zer gang gyur mnyam/ /byis pa'i gzugs can mdzes pa 'di/ /tshes gcig zla ba lta mnyes 7pa/ /khyod kyi spyod pa bzlog dka' bas/ /bdud kyi mthu rtsal 'joms pas ci/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam dran pas ni/ /dmyal ba pa yi khrag dang zhag /med par skams pas dmyal ba pa'i / /'od 'phro de dag zhi bar 'gyur/ /shes rab bral bas mdun du khyod//dran pa'i yu/la/ du gyur nga/sa kyang / /mkhas pa rnams kyang je tshom gyi9/ /mdud pa dam pos 'ching bar byed/ /thams cad lta zhog skad cig tu/ /khyod kyi spyan zur gyis gzigs nas/ /rnga yab g.yob pa'i bzhad gad kyis/ /bsten pa'i dpal ldan nyid bdag gis/ /gdul bya pad+mo'i snod rnams la/ /'od 37—328

zer dra bas kha 'byed pas/ /mgon po sngon med nyi ma yi/ /rol pas nyin mtshan snang bar mdzad/ /don gsal mdzad pa'i gsung gis ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /stong pa nyid ni mngon su ma/ lta ra/ /gsung gi dbang phyug ston par mdzad/ /rnam par rtog las ma gtogs pa/ /'khor ba zhes bya ci yang med/ /rnam rtog de dang bral bas na/ /khyod ni rab tu mya ngan 'das/ /khyod kyi yon tan cha brjod las/ /byung bas bsod nams 'phel ba yis1/ /'gro ba rnams ni khyod brjod pas/ /phun sum tshogs nga/ la gnas shog /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa/rtog ge pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //37—329

༄༅/ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ra pa tsa na sādha na bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur nga/ la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pas dang por gdong bkru ba la sogs pa byas la / bsam gtan gyi khang pa dri dang byug pa la sogs pas byugs la/ stan 'jam po la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom par byas la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmā ཿswa bhā ba shurjopho haṃ/ zhes brjod la/ bdag dang gzhan stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kopho4haṃ/ de nas rang gi lus kyi mgo nas rkang pa'i mthar thug bar dang ba'i shel sgong lta bur dri ma med par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i nam mkha' la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhī5ཿston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra ba 6'od tshogs 'phro 37—331

bar bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las shes rab kyi ral gri bsams te/de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bdag nyid bsam par bya ste/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ston zla bye ba dang 'dra bar snang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bsam gtan gyis 'dzum pa'i spyan can/ pad+ma dang zla 1ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste thugs kar 'dzin pa zhal cung zad bzhad pa/ de'i thugs ka'i nam mkha' la a yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i steng du de'i sa bon gyur pa las zla ba de la bla ma'i man ngag gis 4yi ge lnga bsam par bya'o/ /de la man ngag ni 'di yin te/ de la a yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das mañju shrī sku mdog dang dbyibs sngar bshad pa lta bu/ ra las dra ba can gyi 'od/ pa las zla 'od/tsa las skra can/ na las nye skra can/ thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra bar 5bsam par bya'o/ /de nas lha lnga po de dag las yi ge lnga 'bar ba'i 'od kyi tshogs 'phro ba'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ /rang gi snying gi mi 6shes pa sbyang bar bya zhing sems kyi rgyud dri ma med par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig gis 'khor lo g.yas su 7'khor bar bsam zhing / lha rnams mi 9 g.yo bar bsams la gti mug gi mun pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo dang de bzhin du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las 'od kyi tshogs mang po byung la/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs la/ rgyud dri ma med par byas te/ slar 'ongs nas de nyid du zhu bar gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas bsgom pa la sems brtan zhing / bla ma'i man ngag gis 1spro ba dang bsdu 37—332

ba'i sbyor bas bzlas pa bya ste7/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ2—zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i yi ge rnams las sngags kyi phreng 4ba shel lta bu byung nas/rang gi lte ba las thugs ka de nyid du zhugs par bsam mo/ /de ltar ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas par byed cing bsgoms la dang ba'i sems dang ldan nas sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa myur du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dus gsum du rnal 'byor byas na ring po mi thogs par blo mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga /slob dpon shrad+dhā phya ka ra wadz+res mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/331 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༄/ /a ra pa/ tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〉 be+e dhi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 bi dhe/ 〈〈pe 〉sras bha ba shud sto/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉sto ba ad ma ko/ 5〈〈snar 〉staX/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉gib/332 1〈〈snar 〉sras/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉gidakyil 'khor gyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉 zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉ba—/ 6〈〈pe〉〉gimi/ 7〈〈pe 〉ra 'khor bas/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sams/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉'byung / nyu1〈〈snar 〉〉gi/323 1〈〈pe 〉ra sa te/ 〈〈pe 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉8sa/ 4〈〈snar 〉skaraphreng / 5〈〈snar 〉ma —/37—333
rgyud/ (155༷)

༄༅/ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ra pa tsa na sā dha rna/ bod skad du/a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar phyag mtshan glegs 2bam ral gri can/ /rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /dga' ba rgya cher thar mchog spyan ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yongs4/ /blo gros ngan pa sreg mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lo phyed rgyun du bsgom 5pa mngon spyor skye bo gang / /nges par gnas kun khong du chud 'gyur mchog gi blo/ /thob 6'gyur a ra pa tsa na ni legs 'grub phyir/ /'khor lo rin chen shin tu bsdus pa'i gdams pa brtsam/ /mnyam zhing gtsang legs yid 'ong dri zhim me tog bkram/ /dri yi chus btab sa phyogs 'gar ni sngags rig pas/ /shin tu nyams dga' 'jam pa'i stan la nyer 'dug nas/ /bde ba'i yid kyis mtshan 37—335

med byang chub sems bsgom bya/ /swa bhā ba shudha'i sngags brjod cing / /dngos po kun nas ma lus stong nyid du/ /rnam par bsgom bya slar yang bdag gi lus/ /skad cig nyid la 'od gsal nyid du blta/ /de nas nam mkhar dbyangs yig dang po las/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'phro ba bsgom/ /de nas de la dhī1ཿyig shin tu dkar/ /de ni 'jam dbyangs dri ma med par bsgom/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan gyis ni pad steng thuganas/ /chags bcas cung zad 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong / /ri bong gis mtshan bye ba'i 'od zer can/ /rgyan kun gyis brgyan rab gsal bsgom par bya/ /rang gi snying gar rab 'phro a yig mchog bsgom ste/ /'od kyi dra ba dpag med rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i tshul/ /de steng zla gzugs bsgom bya de las sngags pa yis/ /ri bong 'dzin 'od ltar dkar 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid/ /de g.yas skra can 4gzugs mdzes zur mig rgyas pa can/ / chos de'i 5nu ma zung ldan rab blta g.yon du ni/ /rab mdzes rol pa'i 'gying ldan nye ba'i skra can 6ma/ /mtha' dag yon tan gter dag tsa dang na las bsgom/ /rab dkar re pha )las byung dri ma med/ /dra ba can gyi 'od nyid mdun du bsgom/ /pa yig las skyes 'od zer rang bzhin can//yid 'phrog zla ba'i 'od de'i rgyab tu bsgom/ /yang na 'od zer 'bar ba'i yi ge rnams / /rgya cher nus mthu ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /de rnams mi shes ri bo 'joms byed cing / /rnyog pa med pa'i ye shes bzang po mdzad/ /'og tu 'khor lo myur du 'khor ba las/ /gti mug mun pa thams cad bcad par bsam / /zla gzugs 'od zer chen po'i dra ba can/ /lhar bcas g.yo ba med pa nyid du blta/ /ri bong gis mtshan las byung 'od zer gyi/ /sprin 37—336

tshogs dpag med phyogs bcur rab 'phros nas/ /sems can dri med byas nas de bzhin mthar/ /slar log bdag lus zla ba la zhugs bsam/ /yid brtan sngags kyi sgo can man ngag bzhin bsgom zhing / /sngags kyi dam pa a ra pa tsa na bzlas na/ /myur du blo ngan skyon bcom yid 'ong dri med mchog /rgyal ba'i sa dang mchog gi dbang phyug kun kyang thob/ /mchog gi bla ma dga' ba'i rdo rje dam chos mchog gi 1mdzod gyur pas/ /bde bar gshegs tshogs mdun du gang zhig cho ga ji bzhin dbang bsgur ba'i/ /blo gros bzang bo mi pham 2bshes gnyen de yis skye bo rnams kyi —ni/ /blo gros 'grub phyir a ra pa tsa na mchog 'khor lo'i gzhung 'di byas/ /'khor lo'i cho ga mchog ni legs bsgrigs las/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dri med gang thob pa/ /de yis 'jig rten ma lus sdig spangs shing / /'jam dbyangs bde ba gcig pur gnas gyur cig /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mi pham 4pa'i bshes gnyen gyes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi bhū 5ti tsan+d+ra dang / chag lo tsā ba 6dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //

༄khya/ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a ra pa tsa na sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo//dkar po ri bong 'dzin pa dang 'dra glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing / /legs par mdzes pa'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa shin tu zhi ba can/ /dga' ba rab rgyas thar pa'i mchog ster pad+ma'i 'dab ma yangs pa'i spyan/ /ngan pa'i blo gros bsreg pa la mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye bo gang dag rnams kyis a ra pa tsa na yi dngos grub phyir/ /lo phyed bar du rgyun mi 'chad par spyor ba bsgom pa gang yin pa/ /mchog gi blo dang khyad par byang chub go 'phang nges par 'thob ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo rin po che yi man ngag shin tu bsdus pa bgyi ba lags/ /dri zhim me tog gcal du bkram zhing dri yi chu yis chag chag btab/ /mnyam zhing gtsang ma sngags rig yid du 'ong ba'i sa yi cha 37—339

dag tu/ /yid 'ong 'jam pa'i stan ni ci yang rung ba dag la nyer 'dug nas/ /bde bar shin tu mtshan ma med pa'i byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /dngos don don dang bcas pa ma lus kun nas ni/ /stong par rnam par bsgom bya slar yang bdag gi lus/ /de dang de ni 'od gsal nyid du bltas byas la/ /swa bhā wa shud+dhā'i gsang sngags yang dag brjod par bya/ /de nas rang snying dang po'i dbyangs las bar snang du/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od bzang ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dir ni dhīḥyig du brjod dkar po ste/ /de ni lhag par dri med 'jam pa'i dbyangs su bsam/ /zla ba bye ba dag dang mtshungs pa'i mdangs 'dzin cing / /kun nas 'bar ba'i rgyan rnams kyis ni spras pa ste/ /chags dang bcas par cung zad 'dzum zhing yid 'phrog pa/ /pad+ma'i steng na gcig tu bsam gtan nges pas bzhugs/ /rang gi snying gar a yig mchog las 'khor lo 3rtsibs brgyad pa yi gzugs/ /rnam par 'phro ba'i mnyam med 'od zer dra ba can ni yang dag bsam/ /de yi steng du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dag la sngags pas bsgom bya ste/ /de ni ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu'i bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid do/ /g.yas su mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan skra can ma ni rnam par 'dzum pa dang / /shin tu rgyas pa'i nu ma zung ldan zur gyis de la blta ba ste//shin tu mdzes shing sgeg pa'i lus la nye ba'i skra can g.yon logs su/ /mtha' dag yon tan gter du gyur pa tsa na dag las bsgom par bya/ /dri med legs par dkar ba dra ba can gyi 'od/ /re pha las byung mdun du nges par bsam pa nyid / /'od kyi rang bzhin yid 'phrog zla ba'i 'od can ni/ /pa yi yi ge las skyes rgyab tu gzhag par bya/ /yang na yi ge bkod pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba yi//37—340

rgya cher rab tu snang ba nges pas rnam bsgom bya/ /des ni mi shes ri bo 'joms nga/ra 'gyur ba dang / /yid ni rnyog pa med pa'i ye shes dam par byed/ /gti nu/ga mun nag kun nas rnam par 'joms pa yi/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang 'dra 'od zer dra ba can/ /'og gi 'khor lo myur du 'khor bar bsam bya zhing / /lha de rnams ni g.yo ba med pa nyid du blta/ /ri bong can lta'i 'od zer sprin ni rgya chen po/ /phyung nas phyogs bcu po rnams gsal bar gyur pa yis/ /rang lus bzhin du sems can rnams ni brgyan byas te/ /slar yang 'ongs pa snying ga'i zla ba la gzhug bya/ /sngags pas gsang sngags dam pa a ra pa tsa na ni legs zlos shing / /brtan pa'i blo yis man ngag bsgoms las blo ngan sdug bsngal rab bcom ste/ /yid kyi shes pa dri med dag dang pha rol phyin pa rnams dang yang / /mchog tu gyur pa'i sa rnams dang ni gang des rgyal ba thob par 'gyur / /dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod gyur bla ma dam pa dga' mchog rdo rje yis/ /bde gshegs tshogs kyi spyan sngar cho gas gang zhig mngon par dbang bskur ba/ /blo bzang mi pham bshes gnyen des ni skye bos blo mchog grub bya'i phyir/ /a ra nga/ tsa na yi 'khor lo gzhung du yang dag sbyar ba yin/ /'khor lo'i cho ga bzang ngo/ gzhung mchog tu sbyar bas/ /bsod nams rgya chen kun nas bdag gis thob gyur pa/ /gang yin des ni 'jig rten nyon mongs las rgyal zhing / /nges pa'i bde ba gcig pu 'jam pa'i dbyangs gyur cig /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs sgob dpon chen po mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyis mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen poshrī ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' drin las/ legs par sbyar ba'i 37—341

༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs dkar po mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shukla mañju gho ṣa pū dza bi bye nā ma/ bod ska da du/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa bzlas pa dang / /bstod dang mchod pa phyag bgyi ba'i/ /yan 'a/ga drug tu rgyal bas gsungs/ /de nas sngags pas sgrub pa dang rjes su mthun nga/'i gnas mchog tu gtsang bar byas nas/ dma' ba'i stan la 'dug ste/tshags kyis yang dag par bcags pa'i lha'i chu sngags 'di lan gsum gyis sbyang bar bya'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+red ke a mṛ tai bha ba hūṃ swā hā/ de las blangs nas/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lhayichu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bkyi'o/ /oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ khrus kyi sngags so/ /de nas dz+rī t+t+waṃ oṃ hūṃ 37—37/3

khaṃ baṃ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa drug dag pa'i phyir/ dbang po drug la dgod par bya ste/ kha dang / sna dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / lus dang /snying ga rnams su rim pa ji lta bar sngon du sa bon drug brjod cing / sor mo lnga'i rtse mos reg nas srog rtsol bya'o/ /oṃ baḥswā hā/ zhes pas 1lag pa dang rkang pa dag la 'thor zhing / oṃ dhīḥswā hā zhes pas zhal bsil lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te pube+e ke tu rā dzā yā ta thā ga tā ya arta te samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/ tar+ya thā puste puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe pustebye ba/ puṣ+ṭha saṃ bha be+e/ puṣ+ṭhawa shīrje swā hā/ zhes/ pa 'di lan bdun gyis me tog sbyang ba'o/ /de nas g.yon pa'i mje bong dang srin lag gis me tog blangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /yang de bzhin du me tog gcig blangs la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī 2ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sadze+e satwa dze+e hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/'dis bdag nyid kyi mgo bor bsrung bar bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhū me badz+rī bha ba hūṃ/'di dag gis dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa la bsang gtor bya zhing sbyangs la/ de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa sathru bibyā nut+pā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas g.yon skor gyis bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas srog chags med pa'i ba byung ngam tsan+dan la sogs pa dri bzang po'i chus lag pa g.yas pas dkyil 'khor zlum por nye bar byugs la/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po bklag par bya'o/ /ba yi lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa yang dag byi dor tshul khrims dang / /srog chags phra mo'ang bsal ba bzod pa bya ba nyer gnas brtson 'grus so/ /sems rtse gcig de'i skad cig bsam gtan ri mo mdzes 'bar shes rab yin/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bgyis las pha rol phyin drug 'di dag thob 'gyur zhing / /kha dog gser du 'gyur zhing nad 27—34 /

kun las ni rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag 'gyur dang zla ba lta bu'i mdzes pa 'bar/ /'dir ni lus kyi las bgyis pa las sangs rgyas nga/ yi khyim dag tu/ /nor dang gser gyis yang dag 'byor zhing rgyal bo'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas skyong nul byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/g.yas pa'i mthe bong bzhag nas/ mdzub mos zla ba gang ba lta bu'i re khā oṃ badz+ra re khe su re khe hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas g.yas skor du bya ste/ lag pa g.yon pas me tog gcig blangs la g.yas pa'i rgyab tu me tog de bzhag nas/ oṃ su re khe sarba ta thā ga tā bye tiṣ+ṭha n+tu swā hā/ zhes pas lag pa'i rgyab bsgyur te/ me tog de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa bkrus nas g.yon nga/ dang g.yas pa dag gis me tog blangs la/ oṃ tsan+d+rarka bi ma le swā hā/ zhes nga/sa dkyil 'khor la bkram par bya'o/ de ltar zla ba dang nyi ma'i ngo bos dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gar a yig yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba 'a/ dhīḥyig bsams la/ de'i 'od zer gyi dra bas nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das snang bar byas pa/ sngags 'dis spyan drang bar bya ste/ oṃ sha rad ma la ma dh+yā ṇ+ḍi ga ga no pa ma/ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa bha ga bān mañju gho ṣa i hā gats+tsha maṇ+ḍa le a byeṣ+ṭha rgo ku ru dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor du spyan drang ba dang /byen gyes brlab pa dang / rjes su bcing ba dang / yongs su mnyes pa rnams byas nas/ oṃ pra ba ra sad+kur shrī mañju gho ṣa ar+ghaṃ pā bye aḥ ma dze+e prok+ṣa rde pra tits+tsha swā/ hā/ de nas sems gzhan du ma yengs par yang dag pa'i dad pa dang / lhag pa/'i bsam pas mchod par bya ste/ dbus su oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya badz+ra puṣ+pe dhīḥswā hā / mdun du oṃ dzā li ni pra bhā ya badz+ra puṣ+pe ram̐ swā hā/ rgyab tu oṃ tsan+d+ra pra bhā 37—3/5

ya badz+ra puṣ+pe saṃ swā hā/ g.yas su oṃ ke shi bye badz+ra puṣ+pe rtsa swā hā/ g.yon du oṃ u pa ke shi bye badz+ra puste rgo swā hā/ rang rang gi sngags 'dis/ me tog dang /bdug spos dang / mar me dang / dri mchog dang / zhal zas la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas/ gtor ma'i sngags kyis gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tād oṃ āḥhūṃ ho1ཿ'di dag gis gtor ma sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas o a ra pa tsa nā ya/ ku mā ri da ha na dak+ṣu ya/ tsan+d+ra kādhi ma ṇi pra bhā ya/ khaṅga pus+t+waṃ ka byā gā ya/ hasta yo mañju ba ni wa ra pra dā ya/ i saṃ/ ba bo/ gar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ma dhu/ sha ka rā ri/ sa hi tai/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛt+ta/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ma shāk+ṣiṃ/ puṣ+ṭi/ rak+ṣa ba ra ṇa gus+t+waṃ ku ru oṃ snyadhīḥhūṃ swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /de nas mngon par bstod par bya'o/ /de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod par bya ste/ rmongs pa'i blo yis bdag gis ci nas kyang / /nongs pa bgyis dang bgyis stsal gang ci'ang rung / /gang phyir lus can kun gyi skyabs yin phyir/ /de kun mgon po khyod kyis bzod par 'tshal/ /de nas tshigs bcad 'dis smon lam bya ste/ dge ba 'di yis bdag nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mngon gyur nas/ /'gro kun gting mtha' med pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig /de nas tshigs bcad 'dis gshegs su gsol bar bya ste/khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol/ /sa/ngas/ rgyas/ yu/'a/ du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /tshul khrims tsan+dan gyes lus byugs/ /bsam gtan dag gi gos gyon zhing / /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /de 37—3/6

nas sngags kyi rgyal po yi ge brgya pa gdon par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shri yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ'ajam dbyangs dkar po a ra pa tsa na mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba 1na rat+na'i spyan sngar/ chos 'khor lo tsā bas bsgyur ba las dge slong rgya mtshos bcos pa'o// //bsdur mchan/ /4 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa/ lta ra bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈(co 〉stanang dpe bsdur byas yod/ / 44 1 〈ṭ+wāṃco 〉7/ 〈〈co 〉thadzi/ /〈〈co 〉jat+ta/ 45 1/〈co 〉7la/346 1〈〈co 〉rko/༈47 ( (8co〉ra//37—347

༄khya/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya 2mañju shrī sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med pa dang byang chub sems bskyed de/ /sngags 'di brjod cing mi dmigs stong par bsgom/ /oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhāḥsarba dhan+d+raḥswa bhā ba bi shusgopho haṃ/ stong nyid ngang las baṃ paṃ a dkar las/ /rgya mtsho'i steng du nga/d+ma zla ba bsam/ /de steng rang sems a dkar nyid gyur las/ /'od 'phros don byas 'dus par —lhar gyur te/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin ut+pal bsnams / /rdo rje'i skyil krung 'od zer rab 'phro ba/ /dar dkar na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /ston zla'i mdog can lang tsho ldan pa bsgom/ /oṃ bā kyai rda na maḥrig sngags rgyal po 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub/ /zla ba gcig gis blo 'phel rig pa 'dzin/ /dngos sam rmi lam nyid du mthong thos 'gyur/ /37—3 9

grub pa'i mtshan ma gzhan yang snang bar 'gyur/ /nyi zla gzas zin dus su ma sha nyid / /dar dkar gyes dril lce 'og bcug la bzlas/ /myu gu byung gyur 'di ni grub pa yin/ /yang na ral gri nyid bzung rig 'dzin 'gyur/ /gre phugs a dkar dag las 'od 'phros pas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi blo gros dpag med dag /'dus nas khong du thim pas lus kun khengs/ /mi brjed 2dran pa'i gzungs ni thob par 'gyur/ /snying dbus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs drug la/ /'bru drug yi ge bkod la g.yas g.yon bskor/ /shugs drag rtse mo rno zhing rab dkar bas/ /nyes 'joms stobs ldan myur 'dzin rab gsal 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin dang bstod pa mang po dang / /mtshan nas brjod dang mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab par bya/ /'di ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma tis mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga tā la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las bod yul gyi dbus drang srong srin po'i rir lha'i skad las bod kyi brdar 'khrul pa med par bsgyur ba'o// //37—350

bsdur mchan/ /49 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snamar+ya/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉wa3/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉glapo/35༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragyur/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabarjod/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u mig—— —— — rgyud/ (1554)37wa 351

༄ / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don zab sngags kyi stobs kyis rab sbyangs pa'i/ /stong gsal nam mkha' dri med dang mtshungs las/ /baṃ yika las grub dkar mdangs bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /gting zab yangs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtsho mtha' glang chen thal kar gyis bskor zhing / /mnyen lcug 'khril sdem pad zlum dra bas khyab/ /le ma'i gur lding dkar mdzes me tog las///yid 'phrog dri bsung ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtsho chen dbus na baṃ yig las byung ba'i/ /nga da sdong yal ga lo ma phun tshogs ser/ /'dab rgyas dkar gsal ge sar dmar ser can/ /lte ba ljang ser mtho la phyag 'tshal lo /de steng yi ge mchog rab yongs gyur las/ /rab zlum 'khor lo rnam dag phun 37—352

tshogs mdzes/ /shin tu mdog dkar yid 'ong 'dzin gzugs can/ /bsil zer phyogs bcur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /der bzhugs a dkar las grub dpa' bo'i sgu/ /zung bzhi'i na tshod rdo rje skyil krung brtan/ /chu shel dri med ji bzhin rab dkar mdangs/ /mtshan mchog dpe byad 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo//thor tshugs rtse na rin chen me tog spud/ /rtse mo lnga ldan zur phud shin tu gsal/ /snya/na gong byedal dri ldan dar dpyangs 'phur/ /snyan shal nor bu 'phyang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin mgul rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub dang / /zhabs gdub ska rags do shal bzang ba 1dang / /sna tshogs na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /sil sil sgra snyan 'khrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin legs par brkyang mdzad nas/ /g.yon pas aXl sdong po thugs kar 'dzin / /srab 'jam dung mdog na bzas rab brgyan cing / /mu med 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' mchog sgu yi rnam pa dran gyur nas/ /rig sngags cung zad bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang / /dus des dar dkar ma sha'i sbyo ra ba yis/ /phun tshogs blo gros spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang gzhon nu dpa' bos legs bsten pa'i/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang ci rigs rdzas spyor gyis / /gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan ma lus kun/ /slu med nges par 'grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing / /rnam pa ma/lus chos can lhang nger gzigs/ /thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis / /srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran cing / /bsgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod nga/ yis/ /blo ngan mun nag thibs po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sprin med nyi 37—353

pa'i cho ga jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a ra pa tsa na pū dza nabi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa a ra pa tsa na'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags nga/ a ra pa tsa na la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i rim pas de ltar bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal sngon du'o/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag la 'gro la phan pa'i sems kyis/ mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o//de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā 4su la li ta/ ya li tai rna nā mā mi bha ga brnyi a ra pa ca na nā tha/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥpra tīts+tsha 5rma ku su māñja li nā tha hoḥ/ oṃ āḥdhīḥpra bar sad+ku ra ya a ra pa tsa nā ya pā bye 6pra ṭīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥtrīḥ pra ba ra sa/shī raya a ra pa tsa nā 8ya pro k+ṣa ṇa pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥdhī9ཿpra ba ra saṭ+wā ra ya a ra pa tsa nā 7ya astso 1ma rgo pra dīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥdhīḥ pra ba ra saṭ+wā ra ya a ra pa tsa nā 5ya ar+ghaṃ pra t+t+waṃts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo mañju sgo ṣa ya dhīḥ.oṃ badz+ra 37—35pya

puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo dzā li nī pra bhā ya re oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mabya pra bhā 7ya paṃ oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na maḥke shi bye rtsa oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/oṃ na maḥ5u pa ke shi bye rgo oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na maḥ.a spyo sgyu ༄/ya hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo bai ro tsa nā ya oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo rat+na saṃ bha bā ya t+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo a mi tā bhā ya s+thāziḥ.oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ o na mo a thumo gha sid+dhi khaṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na ma 6lo tsa nā ye dze+e oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na mo mā ma kye rmā oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/o na maḥpaṇ+ḍa rā yi 7r+pā oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ na ma stu rā yi ret+t+waṃ oṃ badz+ra puste hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ / 'di yi rim pas/ oṃ badz+ra dhū 11pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye hūṃ swā hā/ de rnams kyi mdun du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po rnams nye bar yang dag par dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba 1snyeta thā ga ta pū dza —me gha pra sa ra sa mu dra 5spa ra ṇa hi mo ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod pa byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /dngos po med kyang yid las byung ba'i mchod pa dbul lo/ /na maḥsarba budha bo bye satā ṭ+wāṃ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te sga ra ṇa hi baṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ yid kyis 7mchod pa byin kyis brlab pa'o/ /ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu yi 8/ /ces pa la sogs pa dang /rin chen gsum rnams phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa'ang rin chen gsum po la/ /spyig pa gang rnams brjod par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la rjes su dga'/ /chos/ kyi 'khor lo rab bskor zhing / /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs1—/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bsod nams kyis/ /bdag la kun rtog yongs su bsgyur / /zhes pa rnam pa bdun bla na med pa'i mchod pa byas nas dbang 37—356

bskur ba'i phyir/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mos 1mngon par dga' bas dbang bskur ba'o/ /rang gi rigs kyi 2ngo bor byas nas 'dod pa'i phyir bdag la dbang bsgur ro/ /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi lha rnams kyis/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs 'khrungs tshe/ /kun bkrus de bzhin bdag dbang bsgur/ /oṃ ā4ཿsa rba ta 5thā ga tā bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye 6hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhe ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha haṃ/ yi ge'i rang bzhin 'byung gnas dang / /lhan cig kun du rnam par rtog /grangs med / ā li kā li'i rka tshogs/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i rnam par 'gro/ /oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dz+nyā na sarba budha ma yo bha me hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥhoḥ hoḥ.a khaṃ swā hā/ 'di yis gsang sngags kyi phreng ba rnams byin byes brlabs la gsang sngags bzlas so/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i nye bar bshad nga/ las rtogs par bya'o/ /bzlas pa byas nas gtor ma byen gyis brlab par bya ste / yi yig gis rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /re yig gis me'i dkyil 'khor ro / /de'i steng du shaṃ yig gis sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a yig las skyes nga/'i sgod du 'chi med lnga dang rab tu gsal ba lnga po lhan cig bzhu nas/ 'chi re/daye shes bcug nas dbul bar bya ste / oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya aṅga pustu ka hastu 5ya i saṃ ba bo mkha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa / ma ma sarba satā nāñca pra t+yārja ka na ban+dha ban+dha dī dhīḥshri kham/ a ra pa tsa nā ya swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /chad pa dang lhag pa 1 dgang ba'i phyir/yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya 8/badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ rnyo rta9me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/a nu rasto me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kan+d+ra su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/37—357

ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma/ ya satwa 4āḥ bdag cag sems can don kun mdzad/ /ji ltar rjes rtogs dngos grub stsol5/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang / /slar ni byon par mdzad gyur cig /oṃ muḥswā hās gshegs par bya'o/ /smon lam gyi bye brag kyang gdab par bya'o/ /dus gsum bsags dang 6yod pa'i dge ba yis/ /bdag cag srid kun pha rol phyin nas ni/ /sems can kun bcas rin chen rtogs ldan pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur— / /'phags/ pa a ra pa tsa na'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba rdzogs so / /lung du ston pa'i bstan bcos kyi skad cung zad rtogs pa'i/ shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ grub pa'i zhing dam pa mang yul skyid grong 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po'i gtsug lag khang las/ cung zad mi ring ba'i chen po rnams kyi gdan sa/ dpal sher gyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //37—358

1((30༄7/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa/༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha rā/ sha pañca de ba sto tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /paṃ yig a dkar 4yongs gyur pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po zla steng du/ /dhīḥyig dkar po las 'khrungs shing / /g.yas brkyang rol nga/'i tshul gyis bzhugs / /gangs ri ltar gsal 5 kun+da'i mdog /g.yas pa mchog gi don sbyi na mdzad/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyes ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin / /'dzum bcas/ zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyes mdzes/ /ma chags dkyil 'khor gtso la bstod/ /pad+ma dkar ngo/ zla steng du / /ha yig dmar po las 'khrungs shing / /ma/nyam par bzhengs/ nas/ 'gro don mdzad/ /pad+ma rā ga dmar po'i mdog /zhags pa dang ni rdo rje g.yas/ /27——36/

lcags kyu bgrang phreng g.yon na 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi1/ /don yod zhags la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma nyi steng hūṃ las 'khrungs/ /g.yon brkyang gyad kyi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar po byi ru'i tshul/ /stag dang sbrul gyis rnam brgyan cing / /be con dang ni sdigs mdzub g.yas/ /'khor lo pad+ma dmar po g.yon/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang gu 'tsher/ /ha ya shrī 2la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chu skyes nyi mar pha las 'khrungs/ /nam mkha'i mdog can g.yon brkyang tshul/ /mche gcigs khro mo'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /stag gi pags pas rnam par dkris/ /ral gri zhags pa pad+ma mda'/ /'khor lo dbyig pa rtse gsum gzhu/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag na bsnams/ /ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma dkar po zla steng du/ /ṭa yig dkar po las 'khrungs shing / /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i mdog /'gying zhing ldem pa'i tshul kyis bzhugs/ /dbyig pa pad+ma dkar po g.yas/ /bgrang phreng dang ni spyi blugs g.yon/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi/ /khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—362

༄༅/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa dṛ ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/rta༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha maṇ+ḍa la de wa ga rde 2sto tra bi ma la pra bhā nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje chen pos gdul bya'i snang ngo la/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang phyug khyed la bstod par bgyi //'khor bar gnas kyang skyon gyis ma gos phyir/ /pad+ma dkar po rab rgyas lte ba la//thugs/ rje'i chu rgyun 'bebs mdzad zla ba'i gdan/ /ye shes 'gying tshul bzhugs mdzad khyod la bstod/ /'jig rten log rtog ston pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rgyal po'i rol stabs 5dbang phyug cha lugs 'dzin/ /sna tshogs thabs mnga' rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /'jig rten kun gyis bstod pa khyod la 'dud/ /don 37—36

dam chos sku nyag gcig zhal mnga' zhing / /thugs rjes 1'gro la chags pas dīḥlas 'khrungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bsgur 'od dpag med/ /ral pa'i khur na 'chang ba khyod la bstod/ /'gro drug sgrol phyir ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin / /rgyal ba'i rgyal po rin chen dbu rgyan can/ /me tog cod pan rgyal sras 'gran zla bral/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ /nor bu'i snyan 2chas 'gro la chos sgra sgrogs/ /spyan gsum dus gsum shes dang shes bya mkhyen/ /'dzum pa'i zhal mnga' 'gro ba'i don la dgyes/ /stong nyid thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun rdzob tsam du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi / /nyon mongs kun skyob bde ba'i mchog sbyin cing / /don dam rnam dag pad+ma dkar po bsnams/ /thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis phyag 'tshal bstod//sred pa'i mes gdungs rgyud lnga'i sems can la/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs g.yas na spyi blugs 'dzin/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs 4skyob g.yon pa skyabs sbyin mdzad / /'khor 'das gnyis med gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid gsum gzod 5nas dbe+en par rtogs 6pa'i phyir/ /ri dwags lpags pas sgu yi sham thabs mdzad/ /'khor 'das rang bzhin spros bral rtogs pa'i phyir/ /gangs ri kun+da'i mdangs ldan khyod la bstod/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i rgyun gyes dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'gro don la bskul nas/ /mdzad bya'e phrin las ma lus mdzad pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor bzhugs pa khyod la bstod / /pha rol phyin bcu'i yon tan rab rdzogs phyir/ /phyag zhabs kun la nor bu'i rgyan kyis spras/ /sa bcu'i stobs rdzogs ye shes mnga' ba'i phyir/ /mu tig do shal 'phyang la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu yis 'gro ba drang ba 37——36༄

dang / /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis bdud dpung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /zhabs gnyis cung zad brkyang bskum rol pas bzhugs/ /rtag par gzhan don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid pa gsum po dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar 'bar ba'i skus/ /ye shes ral 1pa'i 'od zer 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /ma rig mun pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma dang bral pad+ma'i gdan/ /nyon mongs gdung sel zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs / /'gro don yengs pa mi mnga' bzhengs tshul can/ /thugs rje chags pa'i mdog mnga' khyod la 'dud/ /thabs kyi zhags pas 'gro ba drang ba'i phyir/ /ha las 'khrungs pa'i tshul ston don chen mdzad/ /skye med zhal mnga' srid gsum gzigs pa'i spyan/ /dbu rgyan rgyal ba'i cod pan 'chang la bstod / /bden bzhi'i phyag gis chos kyi 2'khor lo bskor/ /snying rje'i zhags pas 'gro ba 'dren par mdzadan/ /rtogs pa'i rdo rjes log rtog mtshan ma 'joms/ /sgyu ma'i rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba khyod la bstod/ /mkhyen brtse'i lcags kyus 'khor ba bde bar 'gugs/ /nus ldan bgrang phreng yon tan gter mdzod 'dzin/ /'gro don mdzod mkhas zhabs gnyis brkyang bsgum tshul/ /mtshan don ldan par bzhugs pa khyod la bstod/ /ma chags pad+ma'i rigs te skyon bral steng / /mkhyen pas nyon mongs tshogs 'joms nyi ma'i gdan/ /bdud dpung mjoms mdzad khro rgyal hūṃ las 'khrungs/ /khro bas khro ba 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /rngam pa'i zhal gyis log rtog dbyings su gsol/ /dmar sel 4ral pas log 'dren bran du 'dul/ /ye shes spyan gyis khams gsum sku gsum gzigs/ /rta mgrin rta skad sgrogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /37—366

——byedardo rje'i 1dbyug pas bgegs dpung rdul du rlog /rdo rje sdigs mdzub bdud sde skrag par mdzad/ /gser gyi 'khor los 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod/ /chags bral pad+ma 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen sbrul rgyan 2klu rgyal gdug pa 'dul / /glang chen g.yang gzhi stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dpal/ /stag sham pa tis phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad/ /khro rgyal brkyang bsgum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod / / skyon bral gdan la rmongs sel nyi ma'i steng / /pha las 'khrungs pa'i bdud 'dul nag mo che/ /rngam pa'i stabs 4kyis gdug pa sgrol bar mdzad//mche ba gdags pas bdud bzhi gsol la bstod/ /rnam thar phyag brgyad ye shes rno ba'i mtshon/ /shes rab ral gris gti mug rtsad nas gcod/ /thugs rje'i zhags pa skyon bral pad+ma 'chang / /thabs mkhas brtse ba'i mda' 'phen byed phyag 'tshal/ /'khor los srid pa'i 'khor lo 'joms mdzad cing / /dbyug 5pas bgegs 'dul rtse gsum dug gsum gcod/ /spros bral gzhu yis thugs rje'i mda' 'phen ma/ /'phags lam don ldan ral gcig ma la bstod/ /khro rgyal kun 'dus 6dbu rgyan rin chen 'chang / /bdud dgra kun 'joms khro mo'i 7cha lugs rdzogs/ /stag lpags sham thabs stobs bcu'i rtsal mnga' ba'i8//rgyal ba kun skyed khro rgyal yum la bstod / // skyon bral chu skyes gdung ba sel ba'i steng / /ṭa las 7'khrungs pa'i phrin las kun dze+egs ma/ /brtse ba'i zhal mnga' phrin las rgyas pa'i phyag /ral pa'i cod pan rdo rjes brgyan la bstod/ /thod dbyug bgegs 'dul pad+mos 'khor ba skyob/ /phreng bas sems can rjes 'dzin 'gro drug la/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'be+ebs spyi blugs 'dzin/ /sgrub pa po la mchog spyod mdzad la bstod/ /rin chen rgyan 'chang sa dang yon 37—367

tan rdzogs/ /dar sham pa tis mi 'jigs lha chen 'dul/ /chags can 'dul phyir chags pa ltar ston pa'i/ /lha mo khro gnyer ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod//kun kyang ye shes 'od dpung klong na bzhugs/ /thabs la mkhas pas sna tshogs cir yang ston/ /nyam 1thag 'gro la kun tu brtse ba can/ /thugs rjes rtag tu gzigs mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ye shes rol pa chen po'i bdag nyid las2/ / /sbyin pa'i pha rol 4phyin pa rab sdogs phyir/ /sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang bde ba'i mchod 'bul ma/ /sgeg cing bzhad par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang chub yan lag 'bras bu kun ster bas/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir / /rin chen phreng ba 5'chang zhing mchod pa 'bul/ /chags bral blta bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzod 6nas zhi ba'i don la rab mos pas /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sgogs shing mchod pa 'bul/ /don dam rtogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod7/ /rgyal ba mchod par bya phyir spyo ba med/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir//sna tshogs rol pas dgyes pa'i gar mdzad ma/ /mnyes pa'i gzigs mo mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas rgyu 'bras byang chub sems yin pas/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir/ /yid 'ong me tog rnams kyis mchod mdzad ma/ /rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thar par 'jug pa dbu mar grub pa dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir/ /bdug spos sprin tshogs rnams kyis rgyal ba mchod/ /don dam go bar mdzad ma khyod la bstod/ /mi shes mun pa lhag mthong gis 'joms shing / /thabs mchog pha rol phyin pa rab sdogs phyir/ /snang ba'i sgron mas kun tu mnyes 37—368

—mdzad ma/ /ma rig mun sel mdzad ma khyod la bstod/ /nyon mongs dri nga rab tu 'joms pa dang / /smon lam pha rol phyin pa rab rdzogs phyir/ /dri mchog byug pas rgyal ba mnyes mdzad ma/ /dri rab bsnams mdzad ma khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje chen pos 'gro ba kun bsdus nas/ /stobs bcu'i sa la kun tu dgod bya'i phyir/ /lcags kyu 'dzin cing zhi ba'i 1las mdzad ma/ /shar sgor bzhugs tshul mdzad ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /byams pa chen pos sdug bsngal kun bsal nas/ /yang dag rig pa'i don la 'god 2pa'i phyir/ /zhags pa 'dzin cing rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma/ /lho sgor bzhugs tshul mdzad ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /dga' ba chen pos 'gro kun bde la 'god/ /srid gsum 'gro ba dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /lcags sgrog bsnams nas dbang gi las mdzad ma / /nub sgor bzhugs tshul mdzad ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /btang snyoms chen pos 'gro kun bdag tu mdzad/ /ma lus sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god rdo phyir/ /dril bu 'chang zhing mngon spyod las mdzad ma/ /byang sgor bzhugs ma khyod la gus pas 4bstod/ /tshangs pa drag po nyi ma zla ba dang / /dbang po gshin rje chu lha nor gyi bdag /drang srong srin po rlung dang dbang bdag ste/ /'jig rten 'dul phyir zhabs drung 'dud mdzad bstod/ /bdag 'dra las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo yis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba'i mgon po yi5/ /yon tan cha shas tsam yang ma rig pas/ /khyod kyi mdzad tshul dpag par mi nus mod/ /mun khung nang nas me khyer 'od tsam gyis6/ /khyod kyi mthu yis dad pa'i blo thob nas / /rgya mtsho che las skra rtse'i chu thigs tsam/ /bdag yid spyo bas khyed la bstod pa 'dis/ /cung zad tsam rnyed dge ba dri ma med/ /gangs ri ltar 37—369

dkar shes 1 tsam thob pa des/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gro bas nyes pa kun spangs nas/ /mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i gnas thob shog /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha bcu bdun la don rtogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/364 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bsgrub thabs dang / bstod pa'i bskor bzhugs so/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sta/ 4〈〈pe 〉ra gyis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltangs/365 1 〈〈pe 〉〉rje/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉stam/ 〈〈snar 〉thamangal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉'jig 5〈〈pe 〉thazod/ 6 〈〈pe 〉sta ga366 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(la/ 2 〈〈pe 〉7)sa/ 〈〈pe 〉thamadzad cing / /4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masar/367 1 〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉rkyen/ 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 4〈〈snar 〉〉ltangs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/ /byug 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradul/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 8 〈〈pe 〉snga yi/ 9 〈〈snar 〉〉// // rka〈〈pe 〉〉la 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/368 1 〈〈snar 〉wān/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyir/ 〈〈pe 〉7kun kyang ye shes 'od dpung klong na bzhugs/ /thabs la mkhas pas sna tshogs cir yang ston/ /nyam thag 'gro la kun du brtse ba can/ /thugs rjes rtag tu gzigs mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ye shes rol pa chen ngo/'i bdag nyid phyir/ / 4 〈〈snar 〉7tu/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉bas—/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra zod/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lo/ 8 〈〈pe 〉snga /369 1 7〈pe rnyotha 〈〈pe sku〉〈〈sna ra 〉zo/cod 4 〈〈snarngo 〉zo / 5 〈7se 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas / tshotshosnar skutha/7 〈〈snar 〉las /37༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉cha/37—370

༄/ /'dze+eg rten mgon po'i bstod pa yid 'phrog dze+eg 'joms jes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pā pa bi dā ra ṇa 2ma na ha ra na nā ma lo ka 4nā tha sto tra/ bod skad du/ 'jig rten mgon po'i bstod pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms zhes bya ba/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min mi yis zhabs la phyag byas shing / /skye rga na 'chi ma lus rab tu 'joms pa'i sgu/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje ldan pa khyod kyis ni/ /mgon med bdag la bsrung mdzad thugs rje mdzad du gsol/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil du ni nub gyur te/ /nyon mongs dba' rlabs kyis ni yang dag nyams nyes shing / /cho 5nges 'debs pa bdag 'a/ btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /khyod la bstod bgyid thugs rje chen pos bsrung du gsol/ /srid pa'i rab rib kyis ni blo mig nyer gtses shing / /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa yis ni lus sems g.yengs gyur pa/ /ji srid mi bzad mnar med gnas su ma lcung ba / /bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs kyis bdag la 37—372

bskyab tu gsol/ /rmongs pas rgyun tu gzhan gyi bud med bsten bkyis dang / /srog chags stong phrag srog dang bral ba la sogs pa/ /mgon po bdag gis sdug bsngal rgyu ni tshang bar bgyis/ /lus kyi nyes pa de dag yang dag sbyang du gsol/ /gang zhig bkur ste'i ched dang 'tsho ba'i ched du ni/ /'jig rten mi bden brdzun tshig brlang po la sogs pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug ngag gi nyes pa'i kun spyor yang / /dmyal ba'i rgyu de yun rings ma lus goms par bgyis/ /sems can rnams la rang gis gnod pa gang bgyis dang / /gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rgo 2rjes su yi rang ba'i/ /bdag gis yid kyi sdig de dag ni smre sngags su/ /'don zhing mchis pas bsal du gsol dang mgon po kye/ /lha dang mi dang lha min 4skye ba rnams dang ni/ /dud 'gro dang ni dmyal ba yi dwags rnams su yang / /sdug bsngal dang bcas 'akro ba gang gnas de dag la/ /bsrung ba mdzad ces khyod kyi lo rgyus bdag la 5khums/ /des na bdag la thugs rje yang dag mdzad du gsol/ /g.yar lus dar la bab pa yal bar nyams la khad/ /de phyir ji srid dmyal ba'i gnas su ma zhugs par/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bdag gis/ 6zhu ba gsan par mdzod//gzhan yang gzhan don la ni 7rang nyid gshegs mdzad na/ /bsod nams ma bsags bdag ni spyan sngar mchis kyang spong / /khyod kyi thugs rje bsod nams dag la ltos 8sam ci// /snyug bsngal med la snyeng rje bya bar su lags na/ /dran pa tsam gyis khrod ni yongs su mnyes nas su/ /sdig zad mdzad ces bdag gis ma khums lags sam ci/ /de phyir bcom ldan gzhan phan mdzad la phul du byung / /bdag 'dir ma dor bsrung dang bskyab pa mdzad du gsol/ /glang chen dag dang nor bu sras bcas btsun mo dang / /gnod med rgyal srid khang bzangs rnam par 37—373

bkra ba dang / /sha dang rus pa dbu ni sgu mtshal 1mthar thug btang / /grub pa'i mig sman rkang pa byug pa dag dang ni/ /grub pa'i gnod sbyin dang ni gnod sbyin mo dag kyang / /'jig rten mnga' bdag khyod ni mnyes par gang su dag /don gnyer rnams la mthar thug ma mchis sbyin par mdzad/ /gang dag rkang pa lag pa mig dang bral rnams dang / /sna tshogs bro 'tshal gyis ni 'jigs pa dang bcas rnams / /yon tan zab mo khyod mnyes pa yis de dag gi/ /yan lag sobs 'gyur bro 'tshal dag kyang zhi bar 'gyur/ /mkha' lding sbrul gdug gnod dang mkha' 'gro ma dang ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gnod kun rtag tu zhi mdzad cing / /rgyal ba khyod kyis gang la dgongs pa de la ni/ /gshin rje'i pho nya rmi lam du yang mthong 4mi 'gyur/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam par 5g.yengs pa yis/ /nyin dang mtshan du lag pa gyen du brkyang ste 6ngu / /'jig rten dbang phyug des na bdag ni 'gums pa dang / /nye ba lags na bcom ldan skyabs med 'bor ram ci / /yul dang dbang po gdul dka' sems kyang g.yo ba dang / /mnyam par ma bzhag lus kyis sdig pa mang po bgyis/ /nyams pa bdag gi 'khor bzhin du ni skye ba 'dir/ /thams cad kyis ni sdig pa 'ba' zhig bsgrubs par zad/ /de phyir da ltar khyod la thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gang gis ngan song sdug bsngal dag /myong mi 'gyur bar khyod kyi spyan sngar bde 'gror ni/ /mchi bar bdag zhu 'di ni gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni 'dod chags zhe sdang rnam par 'joms pa'i sku/ /khyod ni 'khor ba'i mtsho chen gyi ni chu lon lags/ /khyod ni ltung bas skrag pa 'dren pa'i lag pa ste/ /khyod ni brjod bcas mi dge 'dzin pa'i sgra gcan lags9/ /khyod ni bde gshegs bla med de nyid ston pa po/ /khyod 37—37

ni sdug bsngal mang ldan 'gro ba'i skyob byed yin/ /khyod ni yid 'joms gdul dka'i bdud las nges brgal 3ba/ /khyod ni srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal 3 ba lags/ /khyod ni nad pa ma lus nad ni rgyun gcod sgu/ /khyod kyi sgu ni 'gro ba'i nang na mchog tu mdzes/ /khyod ni dpe med thugs rje'i rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /khyod ni rgyu med gnyen du 'gro ba rnams kyis rtogs/ /khyod kyis g.yo ba'i dbang po 'bad pa med par btul/ /khyod ni yul la chags pa yongs su bcom pa lags/ /khyod kyi thugs ni bsam gtan mchog la /mnyam par bzhag /khyod kyi thugs ni slong ba kun la snyems par mdzad/ /thugs rje ldan pa gzhan la phan par mdzad kyang ni/ /ma rig sbrul chen rgyab tu zhon nas yul rnams kyi/ /'dod pas dge ba nyams par gyur pa bdag la 'dir/ /khyod ni gang gis yongs su dgyes par mi mdzad lags/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar g.yar chab 'byin cing smre ba yi/ /sdig ldan bdag la gang gis bsrung ba mi mdzad na/ /mgon po 'gro ba kun rten thugs rje gang lags pa/ /de ci khyod kyis nyi tshe ba ru bskyed lags sam/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes 4nam mkha' khyab pa yi/ /sprin byung char pa'i rgyun ni chu dang skam dag dang / /mthon dman yul ni kun la 'bab cing sems can gyi5/ /don du kun la nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug /de ltar bcom ldan dran pa'i bdag gi bsod nams gang / /des ni 'gro ba'i sbug bsngal mang ldan de dag gis/ /'gro nang mdzes pa rnam mang rnam par rol pa yi/ /po ta la yi ri rtser gnas pa thob par shog /'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms zhes bya ba/ shar phyogs ba ren ḍa'i 6slob dpon mkhas pa chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—375

rgya gar shar phyogs ba ren ḍa'i 3dzā ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī gekhukhus brjo/zar ba// //bsdur mchan/372 51mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa༅/ /'jig rten mgon ngo 'i bsto da pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lalpa/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉tā/〈〈snar 〉〉ga sa〈〈snar 〉〉chos/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar/373 41〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉shang / 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ zi〈〈pe 〉〉ma yin/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis ༈ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉wani/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉bltos/374 1〈〈snar 〉toratshal/ 〈〈〈snar 〉〉kadugs/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snang / tshozhe〈〈pe 〉〉—rnam par/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉steng / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag na/〈〈snar 〉〉sgrag 9〈〈pe〉〉pag375 1 2〈〈pe 〉〉rgal / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉reṇ+ḍi'i/376 1〈〈snar 〉〉reṇ+ḍi'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉gi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1559)37wa 376
