༄rgya/ /thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bathol ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā ru bhā ka sto tra tso da nain / bod skad du/ thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bskul ba/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chags pas rnam gzigs bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan ras kyis gzigs spyan zur bdag la gzigs/ /spyan zur gzigs pa tsam gyis 'gro rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag zhi mdzad khyod la mnga'/ /mtha' med g.yang sar lhang nas sa 'og gi/ /mun nag thibs por 4gtan du 'khyams pa bdag /nyam thag phongs pas thugs rje 5mchog sbyin cing / /yongs su bskyab 6pa'i dus la di ring bab/ /sbug phongs gang gis nga ni dran byas na/ /de yi nyam thag nga yis bsal lo zhes/ /khyod kyis zhal bzhes mngon mdzad deng bdag gi/ /nyam thag bsal te 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mthong dang thos dang reg dang dran pa yis/ /nad gdon 37——377

thams cad ngas bsal zhes gsungs pas/ /nad kyis gdungs pa'i 'gro ba bdag cag la'ang / /mchog sbyin nyid kyis zhal bzhes ma bsnyel mdzod/ /'gro rnams gang dag sdug bsngal de dag gi1/ /nyam thag kun tu bcad par bya'o zhes/ /dgongs nas mgon po gzhan du rnam rgyu na/ /bdag cag sdug bsngal khyod kyis ma gzigs sam/ /gang gis khyod nyid dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /de mod nyam thag ma bsal 'ga' med la/ /bdag kyang rtag tu nyam thag gzir bzhin du/ /khyod kyi drin gyis ma bskyabs skal 2chungs so/ /mthu ldan khyod kyi thugs rje'i blo gros kyis/ /lan la mi re bzhin du phan 'dogs la/ /bdag kyang khyod la skyabs su mchi bzhin du/ /sbug phongs 'di 'dra'ang mi gzigs kye ma'o brlag /ji lta ji ltar nyon mongs gyur pa dang / /ji lta ji ltar brten med phongs gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar khyod kyi thugs rje yang / /der ni phyi phyir mngon par 'phel lo skad/ /sdig ldan bdag gi nyam thag sdug bsngal yang / /shin tu brnag 4dka' rten med skyabs med bzhin5/ /de dag las bdag thugs rjes bkol mdzad na/ /khyod kyi thugs rje phyogs gcig ci ru rung / /'gro ba gang gis skyes mchog khyod dran na/ /don med gyur pa sngon chad 'ga' ma mchis / /sbug bsngal shin tu drag pos 6nyam thag 'dis/ /brlag la khad kyi mgon khyod bdag la dgongs/ /thugs rje'i gnas gyur sbug phongs ma lus pa/ /phongs pa thugs rje chen pos 'phrogs mdzad pa/ /khyod kyis gal te bdag la ma gzigs na/ /bdag gi rten gzhan gang lags gsung du gsol/ /mgon po khyod la skyabs su mchi dgu la/ /mod la sbug bsngal ma zhi 'ga' ma mchis/ /bdag kyang skyabs su mchi yis brtse ba yis/ /sdug bsngal nyam rwa thag 'di las 37—378

bskyab tu gsol/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam grag la brten pas kyang / /sdug phongs ma lus zhi bar 'gyur lags na/ /bdag gis 'bad kyang 'bras bu ma mchis pa /de 'dra'i thugs rje ci las gyur pa lags/ /khyod kyis grub brnyes bzhin du sems can rnams/ /yongs su bskyab phyir smon lam mdzad lags na/ /bdag kyang sems can grangs las ma 'das pas/ /mchog sbyin bdag gi sdug bsngal dbrog tu gsol/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa'i tshogs bcom bzhin/ /zla gsal dri med khyod ni rab bzhugs kyang / /da dung bdag ni sdug bsngal gyis non cing / /sdig pa'i mun pas non pa skal chungs so/ /skye bo rnams kyis gang zhus skyong mdzad pa/ /de nyid bdag gis zhus bzhin mi gnang ba/ /mtshams las thar bar skal ba med dam ci/ /shin tu ngan nam cir thal yi re mug /mgon po khyod ni sems can phan pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po ma spangs bzhin du yang / /sbug bsngal brnag dka'i rang bzhin gsol 'debs la//skyob pa mdun na gnas bzhin 'o dod 'bod/ /'jig rten skye bo'i pha ma'ang 'di ltar du/ /kha mchus 1btab par gyur kyang mi skyo bzhin/ /sems can phan brtson khyed la'ang 'khor ba nas/ /'khor ba'i tshe na bdag ni skyabs mchi zhing / /nag po'i las kyis nyin dang mtshan du ni/ /mngon par zil gyis non par gyur pa dang / /sbug bsngal cher gdungs 'di las thar bya'i phyir/ /nyin rer 'o dod 'bod kyis ma skyo srungs/ /de ltar bdag gis bos shing smre ba yis / /khyod thugs shin tu thugs rjes brlan gyur pa/ /de ltar skye bo sdug bsngal brgyas gzir ba/ /kun la'ang srid bcom khyod ni dgongs mdzad byung / /thugs rje'i dbang gyur thugs ni brtan pa yis/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig lcur 37—379

len yon tan ni/ /bla ma'i gnas gyur khyod ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'phrog pa'i 1nus mthu ldan pa de bzhin shog /bdag gi srid pa mthar mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /bstod bsgul 'di bgyis bsod nams thob pa gang yin des / /bcos min rab zhi'i 2bde ldan bde ba can du ni/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal gzir spangs rab tu phyin gyur cig /thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bsgul ba nyer bzhi pa/ dge bsnyen chen po zla bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan bo par me shwa ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o //bsdur mchan/t+ta77 1mtshan byang 'di chos/ tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa/ ltar babod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉7 ru ṇi/ 〈〈snar 〉7 ru ṇi 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ritso da rgo/ 4〈〈snar 〉zo ra/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉rjes / 6〈〈pe 〉71bas/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉yis nyams/ /78 1〈〈sna ra 〉〉des// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉skyobs skal/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyabs bskal/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉〉na/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉ma/nag 〈〈pe 〉ra// 6〈〈snar 〉ga // 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉kyis/ 8 〈〈snar 〉〉〉mas/379 1〈〈pe 〉ra sa/ 〈〈snar 〉thamatshus/38༷ 1〈〈pe 〉thama'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉ngang ba'in/ 〈〈pe 〉〉( ts+tsha 'gos/ 〈〈snar 〉zor tsa ba dogs /37—380

༄/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa jes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa ra sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min gyis ni zhabs btud cing / /skye rga na dang 'chi ba rab bcom pa/ /'jig rten dbang byed 2bdag la skyabs mdzad na/ /brtse dang snying rje ldan pa skyong bar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su nges lcung ba / /nyon mongs dba' klong mnyam bzhag gis ni bcom/ /kho bo 4brtan nga/ra zung zhes kun du ngu / /brtse ba chen po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mig la sred pa'i rab rib nye bar 'tshe/ /lus ni 'chi bas 'jigs pa'i rnam par du/ /ji srid mnar med nyam ngar ma song bar/ /bcom ldan kun tu gzigs la bdag la skyongs/ /gzhan gyi bud med sun par byas shing bcom/ /mi shes pa yi 5srog chags stong phrag bsad/ /mgon po bdag gis sdig pa ma lus byas/ /37—382

so so'i lus kyi nyes pa nyams par mdzod/ /gang zhig 'tsho dang bkur ste'i ched rnams su/ /'jig rten pa rnams mi 'dod mi bden smras/ /ma lus dmyal ba gang gis yun ring goms/ /de rnams 'jig rten dbang pos zhi bar mdzod/ /sems can rnams la mi phan bsam pa gang / /rang dang gzhan gyis byas la'ang yi rang ba/ /de 'dir bdag gi yid kyi sdig pa rnams/ /bsal bar mdzod cig mgon po smre sngags 'don/ /lha dang mi dang lha min skye ba rnams/ /dud 'gro dmyal ba yi dwags 'gro ba rnams/ /sems can nges gnas rtag par nyam thag gang / /de rnams srung zhes khyed gtam bdag gis thos/ /des na bdag la snying rjer kun du mdzod/ /lus kyi lang tsho ngal bar rtogs gyur na/ /ji srid dmyal ba nyid du ma zhugs par/ /de phyir bcom ldan khyed la gsol bar bgyi / /cung zad btang snyoms mdzad pa gzhan don phyir/ /bdag gi don phyir bcom ldan nyid dmigs na/ /yang na brtse ba bsod nams la ltos 1 sam/ /gang la phongs med mthong ba bskyed par gyis/ /nyid dran pa yis kun nas yongs tshim na/ /nyes pa zad par mdzod cig brtse med dam/ /de yi phyir na bcom ldan gzhan phan mkhas/ /rnam g.yeng ma mdzad kho bo 'dir ni srungs/ /glang po rta dang bu dang chung ma dang / /rgyal srid tsher ma med dang khyem sna tshogs//sha rus mgo dang khrag gi mthar thug par/ /don gnyer rnams la khyed kyis mtha' yas 2byin/ /mig sman ri lu rkang mgyogs grub pa dang / /grub pa'i sman dang nor bu rnam dag sngags/ /grub pa gnod sbyin mo ni grong la 'jug /'jig rten dbang po gang gis nyid dgyes pa/ /rkang lag rnam par lta ba'i sman pa gang / /sna tshogs 'jigs chen nad kyis 4zhu ba gang / /khyed mnyes pa 37—383

las de rnams lus rgyas shing / /nad med yon tan zab mo'i tshornam rol 'gyur//mkha' lding sbrul dang gza' dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /spyor ba pa rnams rtag par zhi 'thob cing / /khyed mnyes gang yin de yi mdun du ni/ /gshin rje'i 2pho nya mi 'gro rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de phyir lag pa spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /spyi brtol mi brtan ngag gis nyin re bzhin/ /ngu ba skyabs med bdag ni mchi ba la/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug 'dor ram ci/ /mi srun yul la g.yo ba yid dbang po/ /mi brtan lus kyis sdig pa mang byas shing / /lto ba'i ched du 'khrul zhing 'bras bu med/ /bdag gi 'di ni skye bo thams cad lugs/ /gang gi 4lus kyi sdug bsngal ma myong bar/ /khyed kyi mngon sum du ni bzang 'gro ba/ /bdag 'dir thal sbyar rab btud bdag gi de/ /'jig rten dbang phyug da lta nyid du mdzod/ /rmongs dang zhe sdang rnam par nyams pa'i rgyu/ /khyod ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i zam pa ste/ /g.yang sar lcung ba gyen du 'dren pa'i phyag /khyod ni nyes lci'i mtshan mo'i sgra gcan nam/ /bde gshegs bla med bstan pa de kho na//khyod ni sdug bsngal mang po'i sems can skyong / /rgyal dka' yid dkrugs bdud las nges rgyal zhing / /khyed ni srid pa'i mtsho las pha rol brgal/ /nad kun mtha' yas nges par gcod mdzad lus/ /khyed sku 'gro ba kun la mchog tu mdzes/ /dpe med thugs rje'i rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das/ /khyod ni rgyu med gnyen du skye bos shes/ /byed pa rnams bcom rol pa rig cing sgeg /khyod ni yul la zhen pa yongs su bor/ /lha yi bsam gtan la ni sasems mnyam 6gzhag /khyod ni slong ba po la snyoms pa'i nor/ /thugs rje can khyod gzhan la phan mdzad kyang / /kho bo 'dir ni srung ba mi mdzad cing / /gti mug lto 'phye 27 —384

chen bos sos btab la/ /yul la rlom sems pa yis dge las ltung 1/ /khyed kyi thugs rje gang de mtha' yas pa'i/ /skye bo kun la 'phro na gang gi phyir/ /sdig ldan bdag la srung ba mi mdzad pa/ /nges pa lags sam mdun nas ngud mo 'byin / /mgon po khyed kyi brtse ba mkha' yangs su/ /sems can rnams la chu 'dzin sprin 2snaji ltar/ /skam pa chu dang mtho dman yul mang por/ /ma lus rgyun tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab/ /de ltar bcom ldan dran pas bsod nams gang / /des ni kho bos 'gro ba skyo med 'dir/ /po ta la ke g.yo ba med pa'i gnas/ /rnam rol sna tshogs mdzes par skye bar gyur/ /zhes pa 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs la/ tsar+ya dī 4pa zhabs kyis bstod pa sdogs so// //sgra mkhan chen po rgyal ba'i 5snyan gyi zhal snga nas/ lo tsā 6ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //37—385

bsdur mchan/382 3 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ chos mtshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉mo mi bzhugs pas 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉stanang dpe bsdur byas yod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉khyod/ (chos tshan 'di'i nang gi khyed ces pa rnams 〈〈snar 〉〉la khyod ces 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) zhu〈〈snar 〉stanazhag me〈〈snar 〉〉bos—/ sa 〈〈snar 〉stanas/383 ) 〈〈snar 〉〉bltos/ (3〈〈snar 〉〉thang / ge〈〈snar 〉stanang / ④〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/384 97)〈〈snar 〉〉sro/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉rtse/ (kye〈〈snar 〉skorachi/ ④〈〈snar 〉nyanas/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉wani/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉/par /385 419〈〈snar 〉〉sdung / rin 〈〈snar 〉41na/ ge 〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ce)〈〈snar 〉〉ḍi/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ khya〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1561)37wa 386

1635༄ga /'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa/nye ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha pañca de ba sto tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can sdug bsngal me tshogs kyis gdungs la / /thugs rje'i char rgyun bsil bas zhi mdzad cing / /rang bzhin bde ldan gnas su 'dren mdzad pa/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo /thugs rje chen po'i zhags pas 'gro kun kyi/ /gnod pa nges sel bde la 'god mdzad cing / /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /don yod zhags par grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma chags pad+ma'i rigs kyi sprul pa ste/ /klu rgyal tshul gyis gdug napa 'dul mdzad pa/ /dbang chen bskal pa'i me ltar rab brjid 'bar / /khro rgyal rta mgrin rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid spros bral ro gcig mngon gyur tshul/ /ral pa gcig 'chang lha mo'i sgur ston cing / /37—387

༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la tsadru ṭis bstod pa/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra gya tsaspru ṭi ru tsi ta sto tram̐ / bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la tsaspru ṭis bstod pa/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mi lha min gyis ni zhabs la btud/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba rab tu bcom/ /thugs rje'i ngang can 'jig rten dbang po khyed/ /skyabs med bdag la snying rje mdzod cig kye/ /nyon mongs rlabs chen tshogs kyis 'joms byed cing / /sna tshogs sgra sgrogs 'khor ba'i chu gter dbus/ /bying ba bdag ni zung la bsrung bar mdzod/ /brtse ba chen po khyed la bstod par nabagyid/ /srid pa'i mun pas mig la nyer 'tshe zhing / /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa chen pos lus nyam chung / /ji srid mnar med mi mnyam 'gro min par/ /bsrung la bcom ldan bdag la kun tu gzigs/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi bud med gzung ba byas/ /mi shes pa yis srog chags stong phrag 37—389

bsad / /bdag gi 1sdig byas deng du mgon po yis/ /lus can skyon rnams ma lus nyams par mdzod/ /gang zhig 'tsho ba dang ni bkur ste'i phyir/ /bden min 'jig rten 'dod pa min pa smras/ /dmyal ba yun du goms pa'i smra ba can/ /de kun 'jig rten dbang pos zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag gis sems can phan min gang bsams dang / /gzhan gyis bya 2la'ang rjes su yi rang ba/ /mgon po de la du bar bgyid pa na/ /deng bdag yid kyi sdig pa bsal du gsol/ /lha dang mi dang lha min ris rnams dang / /dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal bar 'gro ba ni/ /gnas shing rtag tu gdung ba'i sems can gang / /khyod ni de rnams bsru/nga zhes bdag la grags/ /de phyir gzhon nu nyid song 4lus la ni/ /thugs rje'i gzigs pa bdag gi steng spros zhes/ /dmyal bar zhugs pa min pa ji srid du/ /smra bar bgyid 5yis bcom ldan khyed kyis gson/ /'on kyang gzhan gyi don la btang snyoms pa/ /dor zhig bcom ldan bdag don ma mdzad do / /yang na brtse ba'i dbang gyur khyod kyis ni/ /bsod nams bskyed mdzod rgud pa ma gzigs sam/ /dran pas kyang ni khyod ni yongs tshim na/ /sdig pa dor bar mdzod cig ma gzigs sam/ /de slad bcom ldan 6gzhan phan la mkhas pa/ /bdag ni 'dor bar ma mdzad 'di ru srungs7/ /glang chen rta dang bur bcas chung ma dang / /dmag bcas rgyal srid khang pa sna tshogs dang / /sha rus mgo dang khrag gi mthar thug pa/ /don du gnyer la mtha' dag khyod kyis byin/ /su zhig 'jig rten dbang po khyod mnyes byed/ /ri lu mig sman mchil 8lham grub pa dang / /grub pa'i sman dang nor bu rnam dag sngags / /gnod sbyin mo dang grong 'jug sgrub par byed/ /gang dag mig 37—390

dang rkang lag smras 1pa yi/ /sna tshogs nad kyis 'jig rten nyam 2 thag pa/ /khyod mnyes na ni de rnams yongs rgyas lus/ /rnam sgeg nad med yon tan zab mor 'gyur/ /khyod dgyes gang lags rgyal 'gyur ga ru ḍa/ /gcan gzan gza' dang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma/ /rtag tu zhi 'gyur de yi mdun du ni/ /gshin rje'i pho nya rgyu bar mi byed do/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dgyes bzhin skyabs med bdag /'dor ba ci zhes bcom ldan bdag smre ste/ /nyi ma so sor lag pa bsgreng byas nas/ /tshig 'khrugs pa yi skrag pa zhi bar mdzod/ /'khrugs pa'i lus kyis song ba'i sgre bar bdag /yul drug la ni dbang po g.yo ba'i yid/ /sdig pa mang byas 'dir ni ma lus pa/ /dbyes —pa'i rgyu yis 'khor zhing rnam par 'dzings/ /gang gis ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong bar/ /bde 'gror 5mngon sum 'gro de spyod kyis mdzod/ /deng bdag 'jig rten dbang la phyag dang zhing / /sna tshogs thal sbyar 'di ni phyag gi'o/ /khyod ni rmongs dang sdang 6ba 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /'khor ba'i chu gter chen po'i zam pa lags / /ltung zhing skrag pa slong ba'i dpung pa khyod/ /sdig lci mtshan mor byed pa'i sgra gcan no/ /bla rnged bde gshegs kyis gsungs de nyid kyis/ /khyod kyis sems can sdug bsngal mang po bskyang / /rgyal dka' yid srubs bdud las khyod rgyal te/ /kun tu grol ba sred mtsho'i pha rol lo/ /nad kun gcod par mdzad pa khyod kyi sgu/ /ma lus 'gro bar mchog tu lus mdzes pa/ /bcom ldan dpe med snying rje'i sin dhu spyod/ /rgyu med gnyen du skye bo rnams 'a/ grags / /rol pas dbang po 'joms shing rnam par byed9 / /khyod ni yul la kun nas chags pa 'dor / /lha yi bsam gtan mnyam bzhag khyod kyi thugs/ /37—39/

nor ni slong ba po dang thun mong lags/ /brtse ldan khyod ni gzhan la phan mdzad kyang / /gti mug lto 'phye chen pos sos zin cing / /yul la kun rtog dge ba las ltung ba/ /bdag ni tshim par mi mdzad ci ltar lags/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba'i don bsten snying rje gang / /khyod kyis spros de nges pa lags sam ci/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar sna tshogs sgra sgogs pa'i/ /sdig ldan bdag la 1gang las bsrung mi mdzad/ /mgon khyod snying rje nam mkha' las yangs te/ /sems can rnams la chu 'dzin chu rgyun ltar/ /mya ngan chu dang mtho dma'i yul kun tu/ /ma lus nyin mtshan bar med 'bab par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan dag 2las bdag gis bsod nams gang / /de ni 'gro 'dis bde blag thob gyur te/ /dpal ldan po ta la yi ri bor gnas/ /mdzes zhing sna tshogs rol pas skye bar shog /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa grub thob chen po tsabye ṭis mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā 4ba 'gos gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //37—392

༄/ /dpal 'dze+eg rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī khad+ma pā ṇa lo ka nā tha sā dha na nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mngon 'dod 'bras bu ster ba'i gzi ldan dpag bsam rkang 'thung ni/ /bde bar gshegs rnams bzhed pa'i don chen bzod mdzad ded dpon chen po ste/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam nga/'i dngos gyur dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /phyag na pad+ma de yis 'gro ba'i spyig pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /skye bos dbe+en pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngar langs kha gdong dag byas nas/ /'jam pa'i stan la yang dag gnas/ /snying gar zla rgyas 'od gsal ba'i/ /steng du rang gi sa bon bsam/ /snying ga'i zla 'od kyis sa bon/ /yongs bskul de yi sa bon gyis/ /khabe+e pā ṇa mgon dpal ldan/ /bla ma sangs rgyas de sras mchog /mdun gyi nam mkhar 37—39 /

spyan drangs la/ /sa bon de dag las byung ba'i/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /de nas mngon par phyag byas nas/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /thog med 'khor bar gang zhig rnam 'khor tshe/ /bdag gis mi dge bgyis dang bgyid sprul ba'am/ /gzhan gyis bgyis la rjes su yi rang ba /thams cad bcom ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras 'phags rnams dang / /gzhan dag gis kyang dge ba gang bgyis la/ /rjes su yi rang de dag ma lus pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo/ /snying rje dam pa las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos kun ro gcig rang bzhin can/ /gos pa med pa'i chos dag dang / /rab dga' la sogs sar bzhugs pa'i/ /byang sems rnams la'ang de bzhin no//sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa rnams/ /gzhan la phan phyir yun du bzhugs par gsol/ /sgrib pa thams cad dpyis 'byin gyur pa yi/ /rgyur gyur byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /bde gshegs rnam dag lam gyi dgongs pa dang / /rtag par yang dag kun nas bsten par bgyi/ /de nas rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /gcig dang du ma rnam bral stong pa nyid du rnam bsam bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes bya bas stong pa nyid lhag par gnas par byarā/ /chos 'di dag thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'o zhes lhag par gnas pa de ltar bdag nyid la'ang kun du bltas nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa 1shuljalhahaṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sgom pa pos sngon gyi smon lam gyis yang dag par bskul ba'i rnam par shes pa tsam gyi baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las kha dog sna 37—395

tshogs pa'i pad+mar/ a yig las byes pa'i dri ma med pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i steng du dīḥyig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khyon kun yang dag par gsal ba bsam par bya zhing / de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i snying por rang gi sa bon 'od zer gyi phreng bas brgyan pa blta bar bya'o/ /de nas 'di dag yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das su bsam par bya ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od ltar dkar ba'i sku can/ ral pa bcings pa la dbu rgyan dang / spyi gtsug tu 'od dpag med bkod pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ sgu la mchog gi rgyan dang ldan zhing / zhal 'dzum pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pa sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/de'i 'og tu mdog lhag par nag pa'i yi dwags gdong pa gyen du phyogs shing kha gdangs pa/ gre ba khab kyi mig can/ gsus pa che ba/ shin tu rid pa rnams phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun sim par 'bab pa mthong bas tshim par mdzad pa/snying rjes brlan pa'i dpal dang ldan zhing gru 'dzin gyi ri bo'i spo la bzhugs pa/lhag par zhi bas rnam par gzigs pa can/ sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/sna tshogs pa'i mtshan rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i mdun du sgrol ma dang /g.yas logs su gzhon nu nor bzangs so/ /de la sgrol ma ljang gu phyag g.yon pas sdong bu dang bcas pa'i a la 'dzin cing / g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'i tshul can/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa'o/ /gzhon nu nor bzangs gser gyi mdog can/ thal mo sbyar ba/gzhon nu'i gzugs 'chang zhing / mchan khung g.yon du glegs bam bcug pa/37—396

rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyab tu khro gnyer can dang / g.yon du rta mgrin te/ de la khro gnyer can ser mo/ phyag bzhi ma/ ral pa'i cha shas rdzogs pa/ g.yon pas dbyu gu gsum pa dang / spyi blugs/ g.yas pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o//rta mgrin mdog dmar po thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la sma ra dmar ser kyis spras pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ khro gnyer dang smin ma 'khyug pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba/ g.yon pas dbyug pa'i mtshon cha dang / g.yas pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul can te/'di dag thams cad rang gi gtso bo la ji ltar mdzes pa'i mig dag gis blta zhing 'dug pa rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du s+thāḥyig bsams la/ de las rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum po yongs su gang zhing sems can thams cad 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la rab tu bkod nas/ slar yang 'od zer de/sa bon gyi yi ge de la gzhug par bya'o/ /phyi nas 'od zer de nyid kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar gcig tu gyur pa'i sgur bsam par bya'o/ /de nas lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag par bya ste/ rim pa ji lta bar spyi bor oṃ yig dkar po dang /mgrin par āḥyig dmar po dang / thugs kar hūṃ yig sngon po rnams bsams la / 'di rnams las mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rtag tu 'phros pas/sems can kyi phung po thams cad kyi sdig pa'i tshogs gzhom par bya'o zhes nus pa 37—397

—ji lta bas gsal ba bsgom par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor brtson ldan sgom pa po/ /sgrib pa rab spong shes rab dang / /skal bzang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /mngon du byed pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /bsgoms pas dub na sems rtse gcig pas bzlas pa bya ste/ de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ dīḥswā hā/ 'di rnams ston ka'i rgyu skar dri ma med pa'i phreng ba lta bu'i kha dog dang 'od kyi snang ba can las / 'od zer du ma 'phro bas bzlas par bya'o/ /dub par gyur na bsod nams yongs su bsngo zhing / langs pa ji ltar bde bar lha'i nga rgyal kyis gnas par bya'o/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /yid 'ong sgrub thabs bgyis pa yis/ /bdag gis 1bsod nams gang thob des/ /'gro kun de yi go 'phang gyur/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po khabe+e pā ṇa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba grub chen pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas dang /chos 'khor lo tsā bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis btsun pa rgya mtshos dag par bcos shing gtan la phab pa'o/ //27—398

bsdur mchan/394 )tshamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/395 17〈〈co 〉〉wawa/398 5nye 〈〈co 〉〉gi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1564)37wa 399

༄/ /'jog rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa ra sha ta ka sto tra/ bod skad du/'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris mgon po'i yan lag mchog btud cod pan 'dzin la 'od dang ldan pa'i nor bu lta bu'i 'od/ /mtsho skyes stan ldan gus pas rab btud 2mgo bo la ni dzā ti'i me tog rgyas phreng 'od ltar te/ /bde 'byung 4dbu yi dbu rgyan ri dwags mtshan ldan dkar ser mi dman dman zhing nyams pa nyid bgyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs sen dri med ri bong 'dzin pa'i mdzes pa zhi slad 'jig rten la gyur cig /ral khur 'dzin pa'i zla ba rab gsal ral pa dmar ser dang 'grogs lhan cig bkra ba'i zer rnams kyis/ /nges par mi badze+e 'phrog byed kyi ni dman pa min pa'i cod pan nor bu'i 'od rnams kyis kyang min/ /lha tshogs rnams kyi skra phreng mdzes pa nag po dag dang 37—400

—'gogs 1pa las ni rnam par mi nyams pa/ /mi bzlogs 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs sen 'od zer byed rnams dag gi mun pa 2zhi ba'i be+ed gyur cig /yongs su rdzogs shing rgya che'i bang mdzod rab tu gsal zhing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyi rgyu/ /sdug pa dang ni ring du gyur pa'i skye bo rnams kyi mi bzad 'jigs pa'i dogs pa rnam par sel/ /sprin rnams kyis kyang bsgrib par mi nus mun can gdug pa'i gza' las byung ba'i 'jigs pa zhi gyur pa/ /'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs kyi sen mo bsil zer ldan pa'i sngon med zer gyis khyed rnams dag gyur cig /nyon mongs phung po'i bud shing dag ni lus pa med par sreg byed me chen mthon por gyur pa'i rtse/ /'jig rten gsum bo dag tu rab dgar gsal zhing gti mug myun gnag dag gi smag rum thibs po 4sel/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhir me yi phung po rnams la bdud rtsi'i chu bo rgya chen rgyun ni 'bras bcas pa/ /pad+mo 'dzin zhabs las 'khrungs sen tshogs 'od zer rnams kyis spyod kyi 'khor ba yang dag sel gyur cig /rang gi 'dun pas spyad 5pa'i 'dod pa sbyin la shin tu mkhas gyur yid bzhin nor bu bsam yas shing / /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dogs 6pas gdungs gyur zhi bar bgyid pa'i bsil ba'i 'od zer yid ni rab 'phrog la/ /yon tan du ma'i tshogs rnams 'dzin pa gsal bar gyur cing mdzes pa dang ldan me long dag gi gzugs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs las 7skyes pa'i sen mo des babyad 'od zer mdzes pas byed rnams skyong gyur cig /'od zer dpag med las 'khrungs che ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis mjes pa dang ldan gtsug phud chen po ni/ /mdzes ldan mgon po'i rab tu mjes zhabs sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs ni de la mchod mkhas lha rnams kyi/ /37— 0/

mgo yi rin chen mchog gi tshogs las nges par 'phros gyur shin tu rab bkra'i 'od zer tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde sogs dga' ba'i gzhu la nye bar spyod byed 'di dag gis ni spyod rnams yun ring dar gyur cig /mngon par 'dod pa'i yul rnams 'thob pa'i sbyin pa las 3ni dpal dang ldan pa'i longs spyod kyis mtho zhing / /kun tu rnam par mi g.yo'i 'od ni brten 2byed snod rnams dag gi mgu ba skyed par byed gyur la/ /dri ma dang bral mtshungs pa med pa'i gzugs ni ri bong can las lhag cing skyon gyi mun sel ba/ /nor bu'i 'od zer lta bu phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyis khyed rnams dag la tshim pa sbyin gyur cig / rab mdzes phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma las 'khrungs sen mo'i tshogs rnams dag gi 'od zer ni/ /rgyun chad med par snying rje'i chu yis nye bar bran pa de yi sku lus dag gi sa gzhi la//khyad 'phags ye shes sa bon btab pa las skyes mi chung dpag bsam shing gi myu gu'i tshogs rnams dang / /mtshungs pa gang yin 'di yis khyed kyi srid pa'i 'jigs pa rab mang mthu tshogs nyams par byed gyur cig /'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs pad las skyes sen mo'i 'od zer bdud dang dgra ste 5bdag la skrag ster zhing / /ut+pal dmar mdog dong par don yod mda' rnams mde'u 9rtse gyen du bstan bcug 'od zer ltar 7mdzes la/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i dong du rtag tu 8ldung ba'i skye bo 'dren byed sra mkhregs thag pa'i dpyangs 9 thag 'dis//shin tu rnyed dka'i phun sum tshogs pa chen po mtho ba'i go 'phang dag la khyed rnams 'god gyur cig /'od dang ldan zhing nyon mongs las kyi rang dbang med dub 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rnam par gcod la dpa'/ /skyon gyi dmigs pa las ring gsal zhing mkhas pa'i bla ma skye bo rnams kyi sgrol bar byed gyur la/ /37— /02

—kun du dga' ba rab sdug ster zhing ri bong 'dzin dpal mtha' dag 'dzin gyur dri ma dang bral ba/ /bsam yas phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs 'khrungs sen mo gang yin de yis khyed kyi bsam pa rgyal gyur cig /ci zhig bde 'byung gis 'di zla dum rnams kyis mchod par bkod byas 'od dang ldan pa'i dum bu 'am/ /yang na nges par byed 1'phags yid gyur byang chub dpal mos rin chen phreng ba bkod dam ci zhig yin/ /lha rnams kyis ni lha yi me tog rmad 2byung mtshungs pa med rnams phreng brgyus dpyangs pa min nam zhes/ /blo gros bskyed pa 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs las 'khrungs pa sen mo'i phreng bas khyed rnams dgyes gyur cig /gang du 'di ni pad+mo las skyes phyag bgyid 'chi med mgo bor nor bu'i khri stan mthon po la/ /zhabs rdul dag ni rgyun du gzims 4shing gang du yang ni 'dzin byed gzhi la mgo 'chang 5rab 'dud pa/ /de ltar rab bskyed 'od zer tshogs kyi so ring gsal zhing bzhad gad bgyid 'dra 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /zhabs skyes sen mo gang yin de dag rnams ni khyed kyi mtha' bral mun pa gzhil ba'i slad gyur cig /tsha gdung sel byed dpa' bo dkar bsil mchog ldan bdud rtsi'i 6thigs pa'i char gyi rgyun ni 'be+ebs mdzad cing / /mi bzad mda' chen char gyi rgyun ni drag po 7rab 'grems bdud la gnod byed phyi ra ltar gyur pa/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyi sen mo'i 'od zer dpal mdzad dag ges khyed kyi 'khor ba'i rnam pa yi/ /khongs chen btson rar rgya che'i snyug bsngal rnam mang 'jigs su rung rnams yang dag 'phrog par byed gyur cig /'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs las rab skyes sen mo'i gnas la snang ba dag ni shin tu bzlog dka' ba'i/ /bdud kyis kun nas rab 'phangs mda' yis khyab rnams sgrib 37—/03

par byed pa'i yol bar 'khrul pa skred 1byed cing / /kun nas nyon mongs dpung rnams brlag 'gyur gsal 2bar go 'byed mjug rings chen po'i tshogs su rtag 4bya ba/ /'jig rten gsum gyis mi nus nus pa srid pa gsum las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon chen pos rgyal gyur cig /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyi zla ba kun nas mdzes ldan 'od kyi tshogs pa lta bu yis5/ /nyon mongs nges bsregs thal ba'i tshogs rnams grol treba'i lam gyi rlung gis bdas nas bgrod pa lta bu dang / /mi bzad bdud rnams kyis ni rnam par mi byed 7mi chung rdo dkar glegs bu bkod pa lta bu yis/ /nye bar mtshon 'os phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs skyes sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung 9gyur cig /mtshan mo'i mgon po nges pa kho nar phyogs la zad cing rang nyid dman pa skyengs par gyur pas ni/ /skad cig brtag par bya ba mtshungs med mun pa spong —mkhas dri ma dang ni zad pa mi mnga' zhing / /mi dman dgra yi srin po zad byed pha rol 'gro spyong brdzi 11ba med pa'i brtul zhugs nyer mtshon pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs sen gang de rnams kyis mi khom 'phen 1 pa dag las khyed rnams srung gyur cig /phun tshogs dam pa'i sgrub byed rab tu stobs ldan pad+mo 'dzin pa'i zhabs kyi rdzong la gnas bcas shing / /'jig rten gsum dpal rgyal bar bajed pa sen 5mo'i 'od zer tshogs ni mtshungs med mngon par rab mtho bas/ /bshes gnyen 'char bas thob pa'i rab gsal rjes su 'grogs ldan shin tu phul byung 'phel ba rnyed gyur pa/ /rgud pa kun gyi dgrar gyur jeg chen yang dag 'grub pa'i rgyu des spyod rnams phongs las srung gyur cig /gtsug phud la ni zla phyed rgyan 'dzin bzhed par gyur pa'i phyugs bdag 'di ni ngo tsha dang bral la/ /37— 0

nub par mi 'gyur nor bus mngon par mdzes 'dod khyab 'jug dag kyang ji ltar mkhas pa lta bu yin/ /dbang po yi ni mgo bo che la nor bu 'di yang don yod min zhes bya ba ky-iphyag na pad zhabs kyi/ /sen mo'i tshogs 'di mthong gyur gang zhig mdzes pas sems zin 'jig rten gyis bsams de yis rgyal gyur cig /rgya khyon cher byas ring du steng du 'gro zhing 'og ༷snyetu'ang dmyal ba rnams kyi sgrol ba byed par gyur/ /bsil zer ldan pa 'char kar gyur ltar dkar zhing dgra rnams bzhin ni nag bo nyid du 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ /nus mthu rnam par shes par bya ba dka' brazhing ma lus 'gro bas mchog tu gsal bar mthong zhing snang / /dbu la sangs rgyas kyi ni zhabs pad la gnas sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /lha dbang dgyes pa'i mchod pa la mkhas lha mos zherab gtor ga pur phye ma kun nas 'thul ba yi/ /'od ltar snang zhing gus pa'i khur thogs 'phrog byed phyag 'tshal ral pa'i thal bar rnam par 'khrul pa'i sa/ /dpal mo mchod pa 'bul ba'i lag gi pad+ma'i ge sar rtse yi rdul phran zag pa ltar mdzes pa/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs las skyes gyur sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs kyis spyod rnams phongs las srung gyur cig /lhun po'i 'od zer ser po min bgyid lha yi glang chen li khri'i tshon gyis gsal byas dmar po'i dpal/ /nyams par byed la tre/dpa' zhing rta ljang can gyi rta yi mi dman ljang ba nyid kyi 3'phrog bgyid la / /sngon po'i snang ba nyams bgyid 'chi med bu mos 'o ma'i chu gter lud par ༄rnyirnam brtags skrag gyur pa/ /pad+mo 'dzin pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo las 'khrungs sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung tsogyur cig /lha rnams khyed kyi rnga yab bsil zer byed ltar dkar ba dag gis 'di la mdzes par mi 'os te/ /37—405

k+ṣa 1ye ram bhe dgos pa med pa'i ga bur phye ma gus pa'i rtsom pas yongs su 'thor ba ci/ /bde sogs khyod kyi me tog dkar po rnams kyis rab tu gtor bas ci zhes mtho ris sa yi rje/ /mchod la bsngags —mdzad phyag na chu skyes zhabs 'khrungs sen mo'i 'od zer tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /kai la sha ltar 'bigs byed mdzes skyes lha min las rgyal lus kyi nag po nyid ni nyams par bgyid/ /nag mo rtse 'jos zhemadzes ldan byugs shing nyi ma'i rta yi 'od zer ljang gu nyid kyang dkar por mdzad/ /mchod mkhas lha yi skye bos gtor ba'i kun+da'i zil las bsel zer can gyi dum bu ltar gyur rnams/ /ci zhig la dgos 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs sen 'od zer che ba'i tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /'khor ba'i chu srin bdag po pha rol bgrod pa rnams la bsdams pa'i lam chen dag dang mtshungs 'gyur zhing / /bzlog par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal me 'bar zhi bar mdzad pa bsod nams chen po'i tshogs kyi chu bo ni/ /dwangs pa rang dga' dag tu 'bab pa lta bu dbu la sangs rgyas kyi ni zhabs las 'khrungs pa yi/ /'od zer mchog tu rnam par rgyal bar gyur rnams khyed kyi srid pa myur du sel bar mdzad gyur cig /nag mo dga' ba'i zla ba'i 6mdzes pa zil gyis non 7bgyid sa gzhi 'dzin pa kai 8—la sha yi ni/ /snang ba rgyas pa gsal bar nyams shing dkar po nyid gyur kha ba can gyi dkar ba nyid kyang 'phrog /'o ma'i rgya mtsho rgyas pa lud pa dang mtshungs phyugs 9rnams kyi yang lha yi glang chen so rnams ni/ /bcag pa'i dum bu ltar mdzes 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs sen 'od zer rgyas pas khyed rnams srung gyur cig /gang zhig yongs 'du'i me tog gis mchod mtsho skyes dpal ni 'dzums shing bung ba'i tshogs rnams gar sgyur 37—406

bgyid / /gang la gnas bzhin bsnyen bkur la chags pad+ma cung zad zum zhing rang byung 'dug pa dka' bar gyur/ /gang gis lha yi chung ma gdung ba'i skyon sel nyin mo'i dpal ni nag mo min par mtshan mor gyur/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs sen zla ba mdzes pa dang ldan zla ba'i 'od 'dis spyod rnams srung gyur cig /lha yi na chung skye bo mdzes ma rnams kyis 'dod 'os su 'khrul mig tshugs 1lta zhing mchod gyur la/ /sen mo'i 'od gsal dkar zhing mdzes par gyur pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i tshogs pa lta bu 'dzin mdzad cing / /mi chung 'dod pa rab rgyas 'dod ldan lta bur gzhan gyi dbang gyur ma yi spyod la rab tu 'jug /mi dman lha yi grong gi tsan+dan gyis byugs phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /kun dga'i khur bu mi dman rab rgyas lha yi lag pas yongs 'du'i me tog rab tu gtor rnams la/ /bung ba'i don mthun nag po brtsegs pa shin tu gnag par gsal ba'i tshogs pa lta bu rab rgyas pa/ /phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyi mtsho skyes dag gi sen mo'i 'od ni dri med 'o ma'i chu gter gyi/ /dbus las 'khrungs pa'i dpal mo g.yo med dga' / ba'i rgyu 'dis khyed kyi dge legs mchog tu sgrub gyur cig /re ba rnam 4chad skyo bas 'phel ba'i me yi rtse mo gcod pa'i chu chen rab tu rgyas gyur cig /pad+ma 5mdzes pa'i rjes mthun gyis drangs sbrang rtsi byed pa'i sgrib byed rnams kyis bsgribs par gyur pa'i dpal/ /sen mo'i 'od zer dkar zhing rags la stug 6por gyur pas rang dgar khyab cing nang ni khengs gyur pa/ /sor mo chu skyes dpal la reg pa'i zhabs kyis tshegs med ma chad khyed kyi 'dod pa sbyin gyur cig /'khor lo'i 'od ni rab tu mdzes dang ldan gyur dri med sen mos bskyed pa do zla med pa'i dpal/ /mtshungs med yon tan grangs me+ed 37— /07

bsod nams rnams kyis 'thob pa'i mtshan gyi tshogs ni rnam par 'dzin gyur cing / /ma lus gling rnams gsal ba'i mthu ldan shin tu che bar phun sum tshogs pas sa yi bdag po rnams/ /phyag bgyid mgo yi 'khor los 1sgyur ba dbu la sangs rgyas zhabs kyis khyed rnams yun ring srung gyur cig /mtho ris gang gā'i gser gyi pad ljon me tog cung zad dbye bas 'di la gtor ba'i yon tan ci/ /gsal ldan mtsho skyes su 'khrul bung ba'i phreng bas glu dbyangs nyid la glu rnams kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /rab mdzes sen mo 'di la nor bu'i phreng ba rnams kyis mdzes pa nyid du bgyi bar nus min zhes/ /gang zhig mchod la lha yi dbang pos gsungs gyur phyag na chu skyes bsdams pa'i zhabs des rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig mgon po kho na'i bde bar gshegs pa'i rgyur gyur 'ba' zhig ma yin skye ba'i snod kyi yang / /gang du pad+mo mngon 'dod sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i tshogs nyid 'dab bskyod ma yin skye bo rnams kyi yang / /gang gis rab lci sa nyid shin tu bla mar gyur cing 'dud rnyed ma yin 'jig rten gsum po yang / /dbu la bde gshegs ri bong 'dze+en pa'i 'od kyis rnam par gsal ldan zhabs des 'jig rten srung gyur cig /gang zhig sten byed bung ba rnams la btud pa'i sbyin pas dga' mgu rangs pa'i tshogs ni skyed 4mdzad cing / /gang gi 5rtsa ba mi dman nges pa kho nar ljang gu nyid min mchog tu mdzes pa nyer 'dzin la/ /rdul gyi tshogs rnams 'chi med mgor nyal dpal ni gnas pa'i sar gyur sen mo'i 6'od zer bzhad pa yi/ /ge sar dang ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs kyi pad+mas khyed la yun ring dge legs sbyin gyur cig /lus 'joms nyams byed 'jigs su rung ba'i dgra 'joms sgrub pa lus can rnams kyi mtshon te 'dod pa yi/ /dngos grub 'bod 37—/08

par byed cing kye ma shin tu cher bsags mi bzad 1sdig pa'i tshogs chen zad mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs bkod pa dgra yi bsam pa'i sreg blugs 2kyis bskred sdug bsngal me chen gyis ni bsregs pa dag /sel ba'i chu klung phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs kyi 'od kyis khyed kyi zer la rnam mang phan pa sgrub gyur cig /dbu la sangs rgyas rgyan ldan zhabs kyi nye 'khor du rgyu 4tshad med pa yi pad+mor 'khrul ldan pa / /bung ba'i phreng ba sgra snyan sgrogs pa rnams ni sems can bskyab sa'i 5bya ba gcig pur rab brtan la/ /yun ring 6bzhugs par brtan par bgyi slad stobs chen snying rje dag gis sbom zhing gnag 7pa lcags kyi ni/ /lcags sgog 8bkod pa lta bus khyed rnams dag gi phun sum tshogs pa nges par g.yo med sgrub gyur cig /pad+ma'i nang gi 'dab ma'i phreng ba ltar mdzes 'jam zhing rdo rje lta bu sra la rnam par brtan/ /gdug pa'i dgra rnams kyis ni rab tu bsnun byas mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams rnam par nyams par 'gyur ba'i sa/ /dmar zhing chags pa nye bar zhi ba 'khor ba'i chu gter dag las sgrol bar bgyed pa'i byed pa po / /shin tu stobs ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i ri bong can 'dzin zhabs kyis khyed kyi skyo ba sel gyur cig /dbang po'i chu skyes rab tu rgyas shing mdzes pa'i tshogs la bung ba g.yo ldan yin yang mi g.yo zhing / /kun du dga' ba'i kun+da 'phrog byed lag na gnas pa'i tshogs la sreg ldan yin yang mi sred de/ /mdun du khyab 'jug gis gtor mdzes ldan 9yongs 'du'i me tog dri bzangs ldan la'ang dga' ba mi skye bar/ /gang du bung 7ba'i phreng ba dgar 'gyur rgyal ba 'dzin pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma des byed srung gyur cig /'od zer rab tu mang ba'i tshogs las gyur pa'i ral pa g.yo zhing shin tu rab mdzes gsal ldan la/ /37—7/09

dmar zhing mdzes pas rjes 'byel 1rab tu mtho ba sen mo'i so gcigs kun nas mdzes shing yid du 'ong / /nyes par zhugs pa'i gnyis 'thung dgra bo skrag bkyid ring du g.yo ba'i spyan kyis kun tu gzigs gyur pa/ /pad skyes ral pa'i nags nyal 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs kyi seng ge khyed rnams zhi ba'i slad gyur cig /shin tu dri ma med kyang mi chung yang ba min yang myur du phyogs kyi sgo rnams 'god par bgyid/ /'jig rten gsum po kun du dga' bar bgyid kyang stobs ldan pha rol lus khyab yongs su gdung ba'i rgyu/ /mdzes sdug 'gyur byed byug par ldan yang phul byung yid 'ong rgyal ba'i 'od zer dag gis me tog ni/ /rnam rgyas phreng ba'i thod can zhabs kyi 'od zer spyod rnams phongs pa'i zug rngu 'gog par mdzad gyur cig /gang la rgyal po'i rgyal pos me tog rnams dang 'phrog byed kyis kyang yongs 'du'i ljon shing yid 'phrog rnams/ /zla bas kun dga' ldan par kun+da rnams dang nor lha'i rgyud kyis 'od ldan nor bu mang po'i tshogs / /zhabs ldan dga' bas pā la sha ste de ltar lha yi bye bos mchod pa'i khyad par rab mang rnams/ /rjes su khrid pa'i snyan ngag lta bus mchod bgyid phyag na chu skyes zhabs des khyed rnams srung gyur cig /'od rnams rnam par gsal ba nyi mas bstod bgyis sen mo rnams la 4mtho ris mgon po yis/ /sor mo'i rtse mo'i tshogs la dbang phyug 'dren byed rnam par mi g.yo mdzes pa'i mtha' la mthar byed kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten rnams la gang gi 5thun mong min pa'i mdzes pa phul du byung ba'i yul rnams ni/ /ma lus mthong ba'i nus pa yod min mgo la sangs rgyas gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i 6zhabs des rgyal gyur cig /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od kyis rab gsal ral pa'i tshogs kyi rtsi shing 37byed//0

ldan pa che ba'i sku/ /'khor ba'i chu gter gting du 'jug byed skye bo'i tshogs kyi shin tu lci ba'i sa gzhi rab gnon zhing / /mtha' rnams dag las yang dag 1 byung ba yid 'ong zab cing dmar ba'i khams chen ldan pa'i chu rnams 'bab /grub pa'i don mthun gyis bsten pad+mo 'dzin pa ri bo'i zhabs ni spyod kyi bzang po'i slad gyur cig /'khor bo'i lam la rab bgrod 'gro ba mtha' dag ngal zhing dub ldan zhi ba'i rgyu yi grib bsil can/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i yal ga rab gsal sen mo'i me tog 'dzin cing 'dod don 'bras bu dang ldan pa/ /lha yi skye bos rab btud mgo yi phreng bas baspyor ba'i rtsa bar nor bu'i bum pa gang ba yi/ /dri med 'od kyi chus bran 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs kyi ljon shing 2tshogs kyis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /rtsa ba rab brtan nyon mongs tshogs pa'i dgra bo stobs ldan stobs rnams rtsad bcad rnyed pa chen po yis/ /rangs pa thob gyur rnam par sgeg ldan stobs ldan las rgyal mgo yi gnas la g.yo zhing rnam par rtse /chu skyes rgyas pa'i rgyun la chags shing kun du sred ldan dar dir mang po rab tu sgrogs pa yi/ /bung ba'i tshogs pa mi bzlogs mtshungs med dri bral pad+ma 'dzin pa'i zhabs kyis khyed la srung gyur cig /'jig rten gsum gyi dbang phyug dpal 'byor lag ldan chung ma g.yo ba'i sdom thag gdags sa'i dbyug pa ste/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal sbrul gdug sos zin 'gyel ba'i 'gro ba mtha' dag skyong bar byed mkhas nam mkha' lding / /mi chung dmyal ba'i grong khyer nang na bzlog dkar 'jug pa'i sgo sdom rab brtan srid pa'i chu gter ni/ /legs par rgal ba'i gdos pa gcig pu 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs ni spyod rnams 'byor pa'i slad gyur cig /'dun thus gang du lha yi rol mo mkhan rnams mdzes pas yid 37—sde//

bzung 1mchod pa bgyid par mi rnyinus te/ /gang rnams rnam pa las 'das sil snyan rig byed kha na ma tho med rnams de tshe rnam par nyams/ /dman pa min pa'i glu dbyangs mi len nyams rnams dag gis spras pa'i dngos po nyid min ngo bor gyur/ /de ltas brgya phyin nang du bzhad gyur lta bas mi ngoms gzugs can mtsho skyes can des rgyal gyur cig /dpal ldan bar med rab tu mtshungs pa med cing cher gyur 'dod pa chen po'i khang pa mchog gi sar/ /lhag pa'i stobs ldan g.yon gyi rim par mi zad 'dus pa'i bdud kyi yid rnams rab tu 'joms mdzad cing / /sems can dga' bde rab bzhed grags pa dang ni 'jam pa'i thugs ldan ngal bas skyo 4bar mi 'gyur ba/ /mgo la 'od dpag med pas khyed kyi gti mug gis bskrun rab 'joms rgya che'i 'jigs pa 'joms gyur cig /brtan pa'i ra ba 'jigs su rung bas bskor 5zhing sgra ldan bcing bas dam bcings ring por gsal ba'i sgra/ /drag po shin tu 'jigs rung dmyal ba'i grong khyer nyid kyi 7rnam par 'dzin pa'i dgra bo rnams dag ni/ /btson khang nang du gdung ba drag pos shin tu 'jigs par gyur rnams dran nas skyabs la rab gshegs shing / / bkur ster 9sgrub mdzad snying rje rab lci 'jig rten dbang phyug gang yin de yis spyod rnams srung gyur cig /bskal pa'i mtha' yis dba' 1 rlabs ltar 'phyo g.yo ba'i rlung gi stobs kyis rab gtsubs dba' rlabs phreng ba rnams/ /sgra drag sgogs shing thor thor dang ldan chu srin tshogs kyis gang ba 'jigs rung chu yi chu gter ni/ /gang zhig dmigs pa nyid na mthon mthing dri ma med pa'i tshogs chen bkram pa rtse dga' dag gi gnas/ /nyams rab dga' bar 'grub 'gyur pad+mo can de shin tu myur bar 'gro rnams 37— /2

srung ba'i slad gyur cig /du ba'i tshogs kyi 'ching bas bcings pas zla ba nyi ma'i 'od zer nyams shing 'bras bu med par byed/ /'gog pa bskyed pa'i bgegs la mkhas pa'i lha yi chung ma rnams kyang brten 1pa'i mthu rnams nyams 'gyur ba'i/ /du ba'i rgyal mtshan can yang gang gi ming brjod rgyun 'dzin 'dzin byed rnams la rab tu nyams 'gyur ba / /sangs rgyas 'dzin pas khyed la nyams dgar rgyun chad med cing sgrub byed dang bcas legs pa sgrub gyur cig / khros pas 4rab bslang lag pa dus kyi mtshon cha dang 'dra 'jigs su rung ba'i phud 5ces sgrogs par byed/ /chang gis bsgos 6pa'i 'gram pa dag tu bung ba'i tshogs gtibs glo bur gnag gyur dar zhing che ba'i lus/ /lag ldan dbang po 'ong ba gang gi mtshan gyi lcags kyu brnag 7dkas btab nas zhum zhing skrag 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten dbang po'i thugs rje 9rab 'dod yo byad de ni spyod kyi 'dod pa'i bya ba mdzad gyur cig /phud ces dbugs ni 'jigs rung khro ba'i rang gnas za bas sreg byed mi chung dug gi du bar ldan/ /so yi bza' ba mthong bas mgo bo shin tu rab tu gdengs gyur nyes byed so rtse ldan pa rnams/ /rang gi mtshan ni dug so 1 dbang po'i dgrar gyur blo la rnam par bzhugs pas nus med nyams 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten dbang de kun gyi nyon mongs phung po shin tu mi bzad mngon gyur zhi ba'i slad gyur cig /spos dris rab tu bslang ba'i dregs pa che 'dzin glang chen tshogs rnams za bar sgogs shing 'jigs pa'i shugs / /khro bas rtse gcig tu 'gro mgrin pa'i phug zab dag nas drag po'i ngar sgra zab mo sgogs byed pa'i/ /ri dwags dbang po 'khol byed kyis bkol 'os pa nyid du gang gi yon tan brjod pas ldan 'gyur ba/ /yan lag mchog 37—(//3

'thor 1bde gshegs gnas shing rnal 'byor ldan des khyed kyi ngan par 'brel pa sel gyur cig /rab mang gnod pas rjes su dpag bya brtse ba zad pa'i snying ldan 'jigs pa sgrub par byed gyur pa/ /mkha' la gnas shing ri yis nye bar gzhal bya bung ba ma he mngon 'gyur 'od lta'i lus kyi tshogs/ /sbyor thabs legs ldan sgyu ma'i rang bzhin lta bu gang zhabs brjod pas dman zhing brtson 'grus med pa dang / /rnam par nyams par bgyid ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas des khyed rnams rnam par /rgyal ba'i slad gyur cig /glang chen tshogs kyi chu srin rab rgyu ral gri mdung rings 'od dang ldan pa'i dba' sngurlabs 'khrug cing rgyug /rab bslang dkar zhing g.yo ba'i tog gi dbu ba legs par gsal ldan skrag pa'i gnas kyi sar gyur pa/ /mtshungs med sgra 5rnams yang dag sgrogs 6 pa'i sde brtan chu bo dag ni gang zhig brtan pa legs pa'i grus/ /spro ba dang bcas yang dag rgal gyur 7mtsho skyes can des khyed kyi bde min bde bar sel gyur cig /sa 'dzin tshogs rnams 'byed pa'i mthu ldan 'od zer rab mang 'byor pa'i 'od la spyod cing 'jigs byed pa/ /rab tu bkra ba'i me 'od rnam 'dzin 'jigs pas zil gnon 'byung po rnams ni rmongs shing 'khrul bskyed pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs pa'i snod kyi mngon du zhu nga ba dag ni gang la gus pa'i mthu las myur nyid du/ /rnam par nyams pa'i sar 'gyur mdzes ldan mtsho skyes 'dzin pa de yis byed kyi srid pa 'byed gyur cig /kun tu gzir bas brten nyams 'pho ba'i sgrub byed nye gyur lha ngan khros pas kha rje zhan gyur pa/ /zug gzer brnag dka' drag pos 'gog byed rnam pa sna tshogs mang po'i nad kyis rab tu gzir ba'i lus/ /gang gis bsam gtan nges brjod bdud rtsi 'dzin byed kyis bzung 37—/14

'gro ba blo ldan zug rngus mi brdzi 1bar/ /lhag par dga' bskyed mgo la sangs rgyas de yis ༷da rnams blo ni byang chub slad du srung gyur cig /ring nas 'khod 2bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bdag mtshungs med dgra rnams nyams shing rab tu gdung bar byed pa'i glu/ /drag tu len cing khrims lugs grags pa pha mes bdag po'i grags pa snye las rgyal khrims lugs dag dang ldan/ /'byor pa rnam kun brlag pa bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur khros pa'i blo can gang zhabs brjod pa'i nus pa yis/ /mchog tu mdza' bar 'gugs byed rgyal ba'i khyu mchog gnas des 4 khyed kyi 'jigs pa yang dag 'phrog gyur cig /tshangs pa dman pa nyid gyur bla ma yang ni bla ma min dang ma nyams par brjod nyams sapa nyid/ /khyab 'jug mi smra'i ngang tshul dbang phyug kyang ni tshig rnams rnam par 'god pa'i khengs pa med gyur la—/ /tshim zhing gsal bar bstod 'dod rnams kyang de ltar lha rnams gang gi yon tan brjod la mkhas min te/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi spyod yul nang gi yon tan tshogs mnga' phyag na pad+ma dag gis rgyal 6gyur cig /yab kyis ya mtshan la ste lha dgra'i dgra yis spyod pa dang ni mig gsum ldan pas mig dag la/ /rigs kyi dgra yis rigs la bla ma yis kyang gshegs pa la ste mtshan mo'i bdag pos sku 7la'o/ /grogs po yis ni byams pa la ste a tra'i bu yis 'gro kun bu ltar gyur pa'i mnyes gshin la/ /'di bstod bstod pa'i snod gang mtha' yas sbyin mdzad phyag na chu skyes de yis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /gang la tshangs pas rang gi zhal rnams mang po nyid las mang po legs par bzhad dang ldan pas bstod / /kun dgas khengs shing phung pos kyang ngo glu 8 rnams dag gi mgon pos kyang ni spyi bos 'dud par bgyid/ /brgya byin 'dren byed brgya phrag bcu 37—/15

rnams bsngags pa bgyid cing gang la rnam 1gzigs rgyun chad med par ni/ /'dren byed dga' bas phyag 'tshal bstod pa'i snod gyur 'jig rten gnyen 2des 'jig rten gsum rnams srung gyur cig /pad+ma 'dzin pa'i gdung med rab gsal 'jig rten pa rnams snang ba'i don du yod pa min nam zhes/ /mkha' yi lam la nyi ma'i 'akron po 'di ni ngal zhing snang byed 'od zer 'bras bu med par gleng / /blo yi nor can blo ldan rnams kyis bstod pa bgyis pas 'dun sar rags pa'i snang ba sgrub byed la/ /gang gi bka' drin myur du dgra rnams nyams par byed pa de las 'gro ba dge legs ldan gyur cig /phyag 'os gang la phyag 'tshal bkod pa las kyang bsod nams snod rnams shin tu mtho ba nyid 'gyur la/ /thun mong min pa'i mchod 'os gcig pu mchod kyang gus pa'i snod rnams nye bar bsags pa shin tu mang / /gang gi bsam gtan gnas pa dran pa yis kyang 'byung po'i 'jigs pa dag ni 'phral la brjed 'gyur ba4/ /mtha' yas bsam gyis mi khyab 'jig rten phan pa'i sgrub lam 'jig rten mgon des khyed rnams srung gyur cig /dbang po'i rdo rje brdzun te lha yi dgra rnams nyams par gang gis byas shing stobs ldan 'phrog byed ni/ /shin tu rno zhing yid 'phrog mngon par me tog mda' can dag la me tog can ni 'bras bu med/ /khyab 'jug 'khor lo la ni 'khor lo dan yod min zhes skye bo'i tshogs kyis nges par brjod ces nas/ /mtshon tshogs bzung ba med par dgra yi skye bo dga' bas bcom pa mtsho skyes ldan pas rgyal gyur cig /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba 'dzin par gyur kyang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po dag gis sdug bsngal ldan/ /rtag tu rjes su chags pa btang bar gyur kyang skyabs med snyug pa'i srog chags gtong ba dag 37—7 /6

las grol/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nyid du gyur kyang mi mnyam sred ldan 'gro la brten zhing 'dud pa bgyid/ /mtshungs bral bsam yas spyod pa sgrub mdzad mgo la sangs rgyas gang des khyed rnams yun ring srung gyur cig /rgyun mi 'chad par 'jig rten gsum du dpe med mnyes gshin snum blugs sbyor ba dag las zhi bar ni/ /gang zhig mi gshegs stobs ldan mi chung mu stegs rlung 'tshubs 1dag gis rab tu rnam par mi g.yo zhing / /gzhan phan rgyu la brtson pa rab brtan sdong bu mi nyams 'od zer dang ldan srid pa'i khang par ni/ /gti mug mun nag rab tu 'thibs pa sel byed 'jig rten dbang po'i sgron ma de yis rgyal gyur cig /gang du 'di ni kun la byams ldan mi bzad mang por gyur pa'i nyon mongs dgra rnams ci la bsreg /gang du grol bar nus pa'i mthu ldan snying rje'i zhags pa brtan bos g.yo ba med par ci la 'ching / /gang du btang snyoms phyogs nyid la brten gzhan la phan par bgyid slad ci la 'khrug ste de yi phyir/ /rnam bkra ngo mtshar phyag na pad+ma'i spyod pa 'gro las 'das pas khyed rnams dman las rgyal gyur cig /kun la phan zhing kun gyi rang bzhin du gsal rgya che tshul ldan dus kun du ni kun gyi mgon/ /kun gyi don chen thams cad sgrub slad gang zhig 'dul ba'i sgrub byed rnam pa 4kun ni ster bar bgyi/ /bla mar gyur cing che ba'i yon tan kun gyis kun las 'das shing khengs pa kun ni zhum par bgyid/ /kun ni kun la rab sbyin mgo la kun mkhyen des ni srid chen khyed rnams 'bras dang bcas gyur cig /dbang po rje bo ske dgu rnams bdag 'chi med bla ma 'jig rten skyong ba dag dang dbang po che/ /'od ldan dang ni dgra thul dbyug pa gzhan las rgyal ba'i stobs 5ldan las rgyal nor sbyin rgyal ba'i zhabs/ /don 37—4/7

ldan ming gi snod ni rgyal ba nyid ces khong bshad kyis khengs 'khor gyi skye bos smras pa las/ /lha mi skye bo ngo mtshar gyur rnams gang la phyag bgyid phyag na chu skyes de yis rgyal gyur cig /gtso bo 'phags pa rnams kyi mchog gyur bsdoms 17pa dag ni pha rol phongs pa rab tu sel ba'i mchog /rab tu mang ba'i mchog sbyin rgya che'i tshogs kyi chu yi char drag gsal zhing che ba'i rgyun tshogs kyi/ /sbyin pa 2mi dman rgyun 'dzin gyur cing bzlog dkar rab brten bdud kyi dgra yi dpa' bos mi thul ba/ /dpag med 'od zer 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo yis ni khyed rnams dag gi dpa' bos 4dgra rnams bzlog gyur cig /gang du phyag na pad+mo mdzes ldan nus pa mchog gyur mthu dang ldan zhing rtag tu sbyor ba la/ /'khor ba'i chu bdag lam zhugs 'jig rten mgon po mtha' dag mgon dang bcas zhes rnam par bsams nas ni/ /sangs rgyas snying rje mi chung kun gyi sgron mar gyur par 1don dang ldan pa dam bca'i khur po dag /rnam par dor nas yang zhing mya ngan 'das pa 'thob par dgyes 'phel de yis khyed rnams srung gyur cig /'gro ba'i bya ba'i 6tshogs kyi khur ni bla mar gyur pa'i bde gshegs bzhin du gtsug gis legs par blangs/ /bsngags par 'os pa pad+mo'i rgyan ni gus pa'i snod la rang nyid bzhin du lag tu legs par gtod/ /sems can tshogs kyis zhi ba dag ni 7 dmyal me bzhin du yun ring 'thob par bgyid/ /gang gi 8nyon mongs rab 'ching rnams ni shin tu mi bzad 'gro ba bzhin du zhi mdzad des khyed tsosrungs/ /gang zhig sgyu can min yang rang bzhin sna tshogs mtha' yas ston byed gsal bar grags pa'i rgyu 5 dang ldan/ /'jigs kun yang dag zhi yang shin tu snying rje ldan pa nyid kyis 'jigs par gyur pa'i kun spyod mdzad/ /khro dang bral ba yin yang 37—418

gdug pa'i bsam pa 'dul la mkhas pa'i khro ba rtag tu rjes su 'brel/ /bsam gyis khyab pa min yang chen pos bsam bya mgo la rdzogs sangs rgyas mdzes ldan des rgyal gyur cig /yan lag dam pa kho na ma lags sku lus mchog kyang dpag med 'od kyis mngon par dga' ba 'dzin/ /gang gi pad+mo kho na ma lags dgra sde dag kyang ci 'jigs bzod par dka' ba dag kyang san+d+ra lam/ /gang gis ral pa kho na ma lags nus pa dag kyang 'gro ba'i dgra 'joms byed par chas shing bsdangs—1 / /mkhas pa 'jig rten mgon 'dis gshin rje khros pa'i bzhin ni snang ba dag las khyed rnams srung /2gyur cig /ma lus sems can don gyi bya ba bgyi slad nus pa dag ni kun nas rab tu bstar byas shing / /chas kyis bsdams pa gang gi tshe na srid pa'i chu gter dag ni skams kyi 4dogs nas 'dar byed cing / /nyon mongs don mthun rab 'bros 5byang chub sems dpa' ngal so thub pa rnams kyang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /dge zhes bsngags shing gzhol byed mgo la bde gshegs gnas des khyed kyi rab 'dod dri ma zhi gyur cing / /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gnod pa dag gis rnam par 'joms pa mi bzad yid kyi'ang spyod yul min pa'i las/ /gcig tu nges par bde ba gcod pa'i 'gro ba'i dgra bo bcad pa'i slad du 6phyag na pad+mo ni/ /dbang med myos bzhin shin tu 'jigs ldan rnam par mi 'gyur gang gis sko byed mgon po dag gi yang / /lci bar 'gyur ba'i 7jo bo brtse ba des ni spyod rnams brtse med mthar byed dag las srung gyur cig /zil gyis mnan pa'i sa nyid ma yin shin tu 'jam pa yin yang ji snyed 'jig rten mkhas 8mtha' yas/ /brtson 'grus shin tu bzlog bya ma yin dus gcig la yang rab tu snang ba dag gis khyab par byed/ /ma lus 37— /19

shin tu gsal ba ma yin gzi ldan gzi yang me khyer 'od kyi cha shas rjes mthun pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gzi brjid de yis 'jigs pa zhi slad khyed kyi gti mug mun chen 'phrog gyur cig /ma lus nam mkha'i khams ni skye bo bzhin du kun nas yongs su rdzogs par byas gyur re ba'i phyogs/ /thong ba'i phung po thams cad snang ba bzhin du rnam par nyams par rab brtson phul byung med par bgyid/ /gang gi 1rdzu 'phrul che ldan yid kyi bdud ni mun pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig zhi bar 'gro bgyid pa/ /mtsho skyes ldan pa'i snang ba de ni khyed rnams dag gi 2rab mang 'byor pa 'phel ba'i slad gyur cig /gzhan gyi 'od rnams nyams byed dbang phyug cig shos 'od kyis mtshungs dka' mun pa'i phung po'i stobs 'bigs shing / /sems can 'tshe ba'i bsam pa can rnams khyad par du ni gdung byed bkra ba'i 'od zer mi nyams pa/ /sna tshogs mtha' yas g.yo med la sogs bsgribs pa'i yul rnams dag ni 4gsal bar byed pa'i nus pa 5'dzin/ /'jig rten dbang po'i snang ba gcig kyang 'chi med tshogs mtshungs de ni khyed kyi 'jigs sel slad gyur cig /gang du sems can ma lus rab mang 'dod pa'i chu la rgyu zhwaba'i bde ba rnyed dka' phun tshogs shing / /don med mu stegs ngan pa'i skye bo ri bo lta bu rgal bar dka' ba'i gting du 'gro byed la/ /bzlog dka' kun nas rab rgyas 'gro ba'i srid pa nyams par byed pa'i rlabs phreng rab tu 'phel ldan pa//phyag na pad+ma'i 'od zer chu gter khyed kyi nags me'i 'jigs pa zhi slad 7rnam par 'phel gyur cig /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i chu bo gdul bya la yod gal te dmyal ba'i me rnams zhi ba 'di ni ci/ /bcing bar byas pa ral pa'i phung po la yod gal te dgra yi tshogs rnams 'gro ba bral ba ci/ /spyi bo'i khang par rgyal ba rab 37—420

lci gnas gyur gal te mgon po 'jig rten gsum rnams dud pa ci/ /de ltar 'jig rten gnyen gyis 1rnam par bkra ba'i tha snyad dag gis khyed kyi dgra rnams 'joms gyur cig /mngon par dga' bas rgyas pa gcig pu nyid kyang sems can bsam pa'i dbang byas rnam pa tha dad pa/ /dbye dka' yang dag min pa'i rtog pa g.yo med mi g.yo dag la rtsom pa chen po rdo rje'i rtse/ /dam pa'i blo gros ku mu ti 2la zla ba'i 'od zer mu stegs don med can brjod mun pa la/ /nyams par byed pa'i nyi ma 'jig rten dbang pos 4gsungs pa'i bstan pa khyed kyi srid 'byed slad gyur cig /sna tshogs rnam par rtsod pa'i gnas kyi 'dun 5sar 'dus pa rgya cher dregs pa'i cha las smra ba 6po/ /bzlog dkar rab gyur bsnyon pa'i sgra chen ldan pa rkang 7mig la sogs dman pa dang bcas zhum gyur cing / /bag med myos pa'i skye bo rnams kyis rnam par ltung ba rab sel mkhas pa rnams kyi dga' skyed 9pa/ /mgo la rgyal ba'i sgu lus 'od zer phun tshogs dag gi dngos po skye med gsung des rgyal gyur cig /dgra rnams dbang 'gyur rgyal ldan mtshon gang 'od zer tshogs ni rab tu mdzes shing 'gro ba dag gis bstod/ /mya ngan dmyal ba'i gnas rnams dag la rgya cher gdung ba rab tu 'joms byed rnam par rgyas pa'i chu/ /dgra yis 'phangs pa'i mtshon phreng dag la stobs ldan rdo rje srid gsum mtha' dag 'jigs par gyur pa rnams/ /nyams par bgyid pa la bsngags phyag na pad+ma'i phyag ni khyed rnams chags nyams med pa'i slad gyur cig /'jig pa'i 'thor 1 rlung dag gis rab tu sadakrugs ltar yul gyi ri bo rab mthor ljon pa'i phreng ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /rtsad nas 'byin pa'i stobs dang ldan zhing dgra yi glang chen dregs pa mi chud nyams pa nyid du bgyid/ /slong ba'i sbrang rtsi 37—/21

byed 'gugs sbyin pa'i rgyun 'be+ebs 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag gi sdong po la dga' ba/ /bzang po dag ni khyed kyi dgra yi grong khyer srid pa 'joms pa'i be+ed du brtun te 'jug gyur cig /dam pa'i khongs ni gang zhig nor la sred ldan skye bo'i tshogs kyi re ba mi 'chad grub pa'i gter/ /gang zhig yu ba dag ni rdo rje'i rjes mthun dgra rnams skrag bgyid 'dab ma dam par gyur pa'i tshe / /yang dag rdzogs zer pags 4pa'i byang chub dpal mos gnas bgyis yon tan bsngags par 'os ldan rnam par ma btang ba/ /'jig rten mgon po'i phyag gi yongs rdzogs pad+ma de ni khyed rnams dag gi grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig /rtag tu sred pa rnam par 'phel zhing mgrin pa'i phugs skams dman par gyur pa'i yi dwags phung po rnams/ /kun tu dga' ba skyed byed dam pa'i bcud ldan mchog tu byang chub dpal mo lhag par gnas pa can/ /'byor 'dod yid dang ldan pa rnams kyis legs par bsten gnas dam pa'i pad+ma gsal zhing mdzes pa yi/ /tshogs kyis rab spras ze ba dang ldan 'jig rten dbang po'i chu skyes gang des khyed rnams srung gyur cig /nyon mongs nyi ma sdug bsngal tshogs kyi 'od zer chung ba ma yin stug por gyur pa'i tsha gdung gis/ /gdung zhing 5dman pa'i skye bo gang dag rnams la tshad pa'i gdugs dang mtshungs par rjes su grub 6byed cing / /mi dman gdung bar mi 'gyur ma lus 'jig rten dag la ma tshang med 'od steng gi bla rer bris/ /'jig rten dbang po'i phyag na 'byor pa'i dri med pad+mos khyed kyi sdig pa nyams par 'gro gyur cig /stobs rnams kyi gnas bdag nyid che rnams che bar dar ba'i gzhi dang 'od zer grags pa dag gi khyim/ /dgra rnams skrag par 'gyur ba'i gnas dang brnag 7par dka' ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa'i sa 37—/22

gzhi nyid gyur pa/ /sdug cing mdzes pa'i bsnyi gnas dang ni 'gro las 'das pa'i brtson 'grus phung po rgya cher gyur pa'i gnas/ /'jig rten dbang po'i dpung pa 'gro ba rnams kyi dgra mang tshar gcod gtum po'i dbyug pa nyid gyur cig /gang zhig rnam mdzes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi 'gyur bag ldan yang dgra bo rnams ni 'jigs pa kho nar bgyid/ /mthong ba rtsol bar bgyid pa min nyid de lta na yang lta byed rnams kyi dga' ba chung ba min1/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu mdzes pa'i khang pa yin yang 'gro kun rgyan rnams mdzes dang bral bar bgyid/ /'od ldan chu skyes can gyi 2gos ni gcig pu de yis spyod kyi bde min bde bar sel gyur cig /gang zhig rab mdzes rgya mtshor gzugs kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal nub cing bsod nams snod kyi lta byed rnams/ /'gro ba 'bras bu dang bcas sred pa skyes pa yang ni mi gnas rab tu g.yo bas 'joms 'gyur ba/ /mtshungs med rab tu mdzes ldan ri bong mtshan ma can sogs grangs med rnams ni gcig tu bgyis sam zhes/ /snyam 4par 'gyur zhes de yi pad+ma las kyang rgyal ldan phyag na pad+ma'i bzhin des rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig 5rgyun chad med par mdzes pa'i chu tshogs ldan pa'i sprin rnams kyis bsgribs dgra rnams snod la ni/ /shin tu rab gsal lan cig ma yin 'tshig pa ster ba'i yul ngan du gyur lus can rnams la yang / /shin tu rjes 'byel dre ma mang po'i snag tsha'e 'dam gyi tshogs kyes rab tu bsgos rnams 'khru bar bgyid/ /mgo la sangs rgyas khang pa'i bzhin rgo shin tu bzhin bzangs 7 khyed kyi rnam bkra'i bya ba mdzad gyur cig /phyag na bzhad pa'i chu skyes dag gis skyo ba med pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs dag ni rab gsal zhing / /che bar brtsigs te bkod pa'i nang na rnam bzhugs gsal ba 37—/23

dang 'dres 'od dpag med kyi 'od gsal tshogs/ /tha dad du byas 'od ni gsal ldan gyen du brtsams shing bcings pa'i steng gi stug po bkod pa ni/ /mdzes pas tshim pa mi mthong drag 1rnams rab 'jigs gsal zhing sgra 2ldan go chas khyed rnams srung gyur cig /rgyun chad med par rnam 'phro shin tu kun dga'i rgyur gyur 'od dpag med 'od chu yi tshogs lta bus/ /bran pa las ni shin tu phul byung dag cing mdzes pa'i 'phel ba rnyed gyur lhag pa'i dri bzangs /can/ /lha yi me tog rmad byung tshogs rnams 4rdzogs pa'i pad+mo 'dzin pa'i ral pa dag gi ni / /dpag bsam 'khri shing tshogs ni khyed rnams dag gi bsam pa'i don rnams phun tshogs 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang zhig bcings par gyur kyang rnam par gol bar nges par bgrod byed gang zhig lus la lhag gnas pa/ /gzhan rnams nges par spangs kyang thun mong min par mgon po 'od dpag med kyis rnam par brgyan par mdzad/ /dri bzangs thams cad spangs kyang gang zhig mtshungs med dri bzangs mang pos ma lus phyogs rnams 'gengs 5gyur pa/ /'jig rten dbang po'i shin tu che ba'i ral pa de yis khyed kyi nges par thob bya'i 'ching ba 'phrog gyur cig /ral tshogs ma lags skye bo ma lus rnams kyi yid ni 6'ching bar bgyid pa zhags pa'i phung po lags/ mdzes sdug ma lags 'on kyang sbug bsngal rnge yes rnam bcom 'gro rnams gso byed bdud rtsi dag gi rgyun/ /pad+mo ma lags ma rungs mthar byed rta rgod 'dul lcag rgyal ba'i ri bong can sbyar skra yi dpal/ /khyed kyi nyon mongs skyon rnams shin tu 'joms shing mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub sbyin par mdzad gyur cig /ma lus phyogs rnams sreg byed lhag par kun tu dmar ser gzi brjid ldan pa rnam par bkod gyur pa/ /37—/24

'jig rten gsum po rmongs shing 'jigs la skyabs med za ba'i tshogs 'bar bskal pa'i me ltar brtag bya ba/ /so bsdams sdang mig rab tu 'bar ba'i rta mgrin dag gis rjes su kun nas gtad de gzigs pa las/ /mtshungs med brtse ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug skad cig 'jigs pa'i gzigs stangs skyes pas khyed rnams srung gyur cig /'jig rten rnams ni brlag par rab gtong gsal ba ma lus sa 'dzin che rnams di ring myur bar ni/ /phye mar 'gyur bgyid 'dzin par byed pa yang ste mtha' med chu yi gter rnams skam pa nyid bgyid pa/ /de ltas gang zhig khro ba bzung ste khro gnyer rab rgyas bsdus gyur 'jigs su rung ba'i dpral ba las/ /nges 'thon 1lha mo mtshungs med dpung stobs can gyis mthong nas skrag 'gyur mtsho skyes can des rgyal gyur cig /bstod 'os rnams kyis bstod cing bla ma rnams kyi'ang 'gro ba'i bla ma phyag bya rnams kyis 2phyag byas pa/ /mi nyung bskal par bsgrubs pa'i zol med nus ldan mtha' dag 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur mtshungs pa med pa yis1/ /brtse ba rang nyid lus can bzhin du 'jig rten sdug bsngal gzhil 4phyir pad+mo can las legs 'thon pa/ /sgrol ma yis ni dzad kyi 'khor ba'i btson ra'i nang du lci bar gyur pa'i gdung byed 'phrog gyur cig /tshig mtha' ldan pa'i tshogs kyi grangs ni bgrang bar lci zhing tshig bdag mchog ge tshig ge 6sde tshan yang / /rjes su gzung bar nus pa ma yen ngang pa'i 'gros dang drag po'i tshig rnams kyis kyang gsal bar ni/ /brjod par rtogs dka' brjod bya min pa'i 7tshogs ni cha shas chung ngus 8gus pas brjod de yongs sdogs pa/ /bde gshegs tshig gis yang dag brjod bya chu skyes ldan pa'i yon tan tshogs kyis spyod rnams srung gyur cig /skye ba'i / skye ba rnams su spyan ras 37—/25
