༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa rā ya 2sto tra/ bod skad du/'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma sa gsum gyis phyag byas/ /lha dbang tshangs pa mchog gis bstod pa ste/ /thub mchog rgyal po myur du dngos grub stsol/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i ngo bo 'chang / /sna tshogs mtshan gyis spras pa'i sku lus mchog /bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /gser gyi pad+mas g.yon gyi phyag brgyan pa//dri med ral pa 'khyel nag cung zad ser/ /zla ba'i dbyibs 'dra gsal zhing rdzogs pa'i zhal/ /pad+ma ltar yangs mchog tu mdzes pa'i spyan/ /mkhur ba gangs kyi dum bu lta bur dkar/ /ri dwags rgyal po'i dga' bzhin zhal sgos dmar / /nyi ma 'char ka ltar dmar btsod kyi mdog /pad+ma gzhon nu lta 37— /30

bur mchu dmar la/ /ston ka'i sprin tshogs lta bur sgra sgrogs pa/ /dpung gnyis sna tshogs mtshan gyis mdzes pa ste/ /phyag mthil pad+ma gzhon nu lta bur 'jam / /ri dwags pags pa sku yi stod 17na mnabs/ /snyan gnyis rna rgyan g.yo zhing mdzes pa mnga'/ /phyag ni yangs shing lte ba zab pa ste/ /pad+ma dri ma med pa lta bu lags/ /gser mchog sku rags nor bu'i rgyan ldan pa/ /na bza' mjes pas sku yi smad brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba ye shes rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /bsod nams du ma las ni 'khrungs pa'i mgon/ /rims dang nad 'joms bde ba mchog bskyed pa/ /srid pa mthar mdzad mkha' la rgyu ba dang / /kun tu rgyu ba'i sku mchog la bstod pa/ /bdud rigs sna tshogs stobs ni nges par 'joms / /zhabs mchog rkang gdub mchog gi 4sgra sgogs la/ /glang po dregs dang ngang pa'i stabs su gshegs/ /bdud rtsi chen po thugs chud yongs rdzogs brnyes/ /gser bzhin rtag tu dgyes pa'i rgyan mnga' ba ri bo gru 'dzin na ni dgyes par bzhugs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug spyod la rab tu bstod5 / /dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad 6pa rdzogs so// //37—(13/

༄/ /nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa/1༄go / /rgya gar skad du/ ma ṇi dī 2pa ma hā kā ru ṇi ka de ba pañca sto tra/bod skad du/ nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu'i gling du thugs rje'i 4sgu 'khrungs dpal ldan pad+ma'i rigs/ /ri rgyal po ta la yi rin chen brag phug nyams dga' bar/ /pad zla'i dbus na thugs rje'i sku ni 'gying zhing rol pa'i nyams / /thugs rje'i sman gyis bdag nad gso ba mgon po thugs rje can/ /ma rig thibs po 'gro ba'i mun sel rje btsun rab rib sel/ /skye rga na 'chi thar dka' yang srid rtsibs drug 'khor lor chud/ /srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzlog dka' sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying / /mgon po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad thugs rje'i sku yis sgol/ /zla ba ltar dkar phyag gnyis pad+ma gdung ba sel ba'i phyag /dpag rnged cod pan rin chen mdzes brgyan 37— /33

gzhon nu zhi ba'i sku/ /thugs rje bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis zug rngu'i nad dang sdug bsngal sel/ /thugs rje ri dwags lpags 'dzin srid pa'i bla ma phyag 'tshal lo /thugs rje'i thugs gdungs spyan g.yas chab las lha mo thugs rje'i sgu/ /yid 'ong sgol ma ljang ser bde ma rin chen rgyan mdzes sgeg /pad+mo'i 1sku la phyag mtshan at+pal kha 'byed phyag gnyis kyis/ /bcud rgyas nu nams gso mdzad 'gro ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can sdug bsngal gzigs nas snying rje'i chu las mdzes ma 'khrungs/ /khro gnyer zhi ba ser mo rin chen sku brgyan thugs rjes 'gying / /rje btsun mgon gzigs phyag mtshan gus pa'i phyag rgya dbyug pa bsnams / /mchog sbyin bum chus 'gro ba'i re skong yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes phrin las dregs pa tshar gcod nadabang mdzad khro rgyal sgu/ /sbrul brgyan 'od dmar rta gdong ljang gu spyi bor rta skad bzhad/ /mgon po pa ne+e la 'dud pus btsugs 4rdo rje dbyug pa bsnams/ /pad+ma'i rigs sprul thugs rje'i brlan gyis sgeg khro phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na pad+ma'i drung na dam chos nyer zhu tshong dpon bu/ /nor bzangs sras po gser mdog skal ldan nyid bzhugs rin chen brgyan / /e ma bla ma la gus thal sbyar pus btsugs puste bsnams/ /bzhin bzangs 5 khye'u dad ldan nor bzangs bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun gsung gi dbang phyug kharba pā ṇi 6'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis gus par bstod bgyis zla ltar dge ba dri med des/ /srid mtsho skems shing thugs rje'i chu yis 8skye 'gro kun ngoms nas/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyams dga' po ṭa 9la ru skye bar shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rgya chen pha rol 7rab tu rgal gyur pa/ /thub pa rgyal ba 'gro ba'i gtso la bstod pa yis1na/ /bsod nams ci mchis des 37— 434

༄khya/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā 2 ba lo ki te shwa rā ya sto tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar dkyil na spyan ras gzigs/ /man 'dzi'i ri dang mchod phreng g.yas/ /g.yon pa pad+mo zhags pa 'dzin/ /spyan gsum dbu la 'od dpag med/ /shel gyi ri ltar dkar ba ste/ /rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par spras/ /ma chags dkyil 'khor gtso la bstod/ /don yod zhags pa sdug bsngal 'dren/ /spyan gsum phyag bzhi rgyan gyis bklubs4/ /rdo rje dang ni zhags pa g.yas/ /g.yon pa pad+mo lcags kyu dang / /'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan mtho/ /dmar skya 5phyed bskum phyed ldan bstod/ /gro dha mgrin sngon gdug pa sel/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhi ste/ /g.yas na rdo rje be+e con 'dzin/ /sdigs 37—436

mdzub pad+ma zum pa g.yon/ /sbrul dang stag lpags sku brgyan pa/ /dmar po rta 1dbur ldan 2la bstod/ /do ker gcig ma bran bzhin nyan/ /spyan gsum phyag brgyad shin tu khro/ /rdo rje ral gri be+e con dang / /thod pa g.yas na 'dzin pa ste/ /dgra ste shasti thod zhags g.yon/ /mthing nag glang gzigs dpa' gang bstod/ /khro gnyer can ni bka' bzhin byed/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhir ldan/ /bgrang phreng phyag 'tshal thal mo g.yas/ /g.yon na dbyug pa gun+dhe 'dzin/ /rin chenakhyun ldan shel ltar dkar/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar 4ldan bstod/ /tshim par mdzad dang mdzes par mdzad/ /snang bar mdzad dang bde bar mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mdzes tshul 'dzin/ /lha mo rmad byung bzhi la bstod/ /sgo yi dbus na bzhugs pa gang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril/ /tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /sgo skyong rnam pa bzhi la bstod/ /tshangs dbang drag po nyi zla dang / /phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong la sogs/ /gtsang ma rigs 5kyi srung mar bcas/ /rnam kun 'khor ldan kun la bstod/ /mi rtog ye shes khyad par las/ /sems can kun la 6thugs brtse'i phyir/ /phrin las bzhi yis don mdzad pa/ /dkyil 'khor grwa gnas bzhi la bstod/ /khyod kyi 7yon tan dpag med las/ /shin tu phra ba'i cha blangs nas/ /mngon sum lta bur dad dmigs pas/ /khyed lta ra yo na tan rab rdzogs shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—/37

༄rgya/ /thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyi bstod pa jes bya ba/ 1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ku bākya sto tra nā ma/bod skad du/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/pa thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil bzhin mdzes/ /ji ltar mkha' la nyi stong 'bar ba bzhin/ /dpa' bo 'od zer tshogs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags/ /khams gsum 'gro ba yengs kyi gnyen gabyug pu / /thugs rje'i lha khyed bdag la dgongs su gsol / /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag ni thog ma rnged pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /lam stor lam log srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams4/ /sngon tshe las log sdig pa byas pas nongs5/ /sdeg pa'i las ni ci byas rang gnong 'gyod/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i las dbang de btsan pas/ /'khor ba'i 27— /39

sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying gyur te/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i me yis rang rgyud bsregs / /gti mug myun pa chen pos shes rab rmongs/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam shes bying / /nga rgyal mthon po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan/ /phrag dog rlung nag 'tshub mas 'khor bar g.yengs/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa dam pos bcings/ /'dod pa me dang 'dra ba'i 'obs su lhung / /sdug bsngal drag po'i mda' char drag tu bab/ /me khams nyi ma'i dug 1ni steng nas tsha/ /chu khams sa yi rlan 2ni 'og nas grang / /phyi rol ser bu'i dad ni mtha' nas tsha/ /bad kan rlung mkhris nad ni khong nas ldang / /de 'dra'i sdug bsngal drag po bzod dka' na'ang 4/ /sdom pa'i dam tshig bshig par ga la rung / /sbug bsngal kun dang bsdos nas sdom bsrung zhing / /mos shing dad pas 'phags mchog mi gtong na/ /'phags mchog 'gro don mi mdzad ci la dgongs/ /byams mgon ci be+ed bdag la thugs mi brtse/ /ye shes spyan can khyed kyi spyan snga ru/ /bdag 'dras smre sngags gsol bar mi rigs kyang / /shin tu skrag pa'i smre sngags gsol lags na/ /thugs rje chen pos bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag 'dra'i skye bo las ngan spyig po che/ /las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes/ /skyes pas 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su dzad / /'a/sa kyi shugs ni chu bo'e rgyun dang 'dra/ /las dbang chu rgyun 'phral la ga la zlog /bka' la zhugs kyang bka' bzhin rngo ma thogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dbang du thal/ /las kyi 'bras bu ngan pas shin tu bsregs / /las dbang sreg pa'i rnge be+e rab 'bar zhing / /rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdungs gyur na/ /phung ngo/ sgyu ma'i lus kyis mi bzod pas/ /37— / /0

byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam/ /ye shes spyan can khyed kyi spyan snga ru/ /sdig pa'i rnam grangs ma lus mthol bshags na/ /thugs rje chen pos dag par mdzad du gsol/ /da nas bzung nas sdig pa mi bgyid spong / /bka' yi don la mngon sum phyogs par bkyid/ /nam yang spyig pa'i dbang du ma gyur cig /nyi ltar 'od gsal zla ltar 'od mdangs pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong 'tshal lags na/ /thog ma rnged nas ma rig ling thog gis/ /bsgribs shing nongs pa'i mig gis ma mthong na/ /'gro ba'i mgon khyod da lta gang na bzhugs/ /sdug bsngal drag bo shin tu mi bzad pas/ /shin tu bsregs pas skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs shing / /da dung gdung ba'i smre sngags nyid 'don 1na/ /nyam thag phongs pa'i nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /byams mgon thugs rje can gyis gsan lags sam/ /phongs pa gang gis nga yi mtshan thos na//de yi sdug bsngal zhi bar bya'o zhes/ /'gro la nyid kyi thugs rjes zhal bzhes nas//bdag cag 'gro ba sems can thams cad la/ /dug lnga dug gsu/ma nad kyis gzir lags na/ /mi bzad nad ni thugs rjes zhi bar 'dod/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje'i gsung gis bdag la sgrogs su gsol/ /bdag ne+e she 'phos lus sems brjes pa'e tshe/ /gnyen bshes grogs dang bral nas gshin rjes khrid/ /de dus 'jig rten nye dus mi phan pas/ /las kyis mnar bas bdag rang gcig pur 'khyam/ /de dus bdag la mgon skyabs ma mchis na/ /thugs rje chen pos mgon skyabs mdzad du gsol/ /'a/sa kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /thog ma med nas phyin ci log rtogs pas/ /27—/ /

khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'dam las ma thar te/ /bskal pa dpag med skye ba grangs med du/ /gdos bcas lus blangs skye ba dpag med zhig /sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam/ /rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam/ /las 'phro bsags na mtha' yas brjod mi lang / /khams gsum bgrangs shing skye ba'i kha brgyud kyang / /byas pa'i las rnams don med chud re gsan / /bka' yi gtan tshigs zab mo ma khrol cing / /shes rab zab mo'i mig bu ma bye bas/ /srid pa'i yo byad gtong bar ma phod cing / /phung po sgyu ma'i lus la chags shing zhen/ /las kyi dbang btsan nyon mongs stobs che bas/ /sha khrag dra ba'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal drag po srid pa'i btson rar tshud/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal drag po 'di 'dra na1/ /nyes pa thams cad rang gi las las byung / /thugs rje chen pos las ngan rgyun bcad de//nyon mongs las kyi rgyun ni bzlog tu gsol/ /nyon mongs las kyi rgyun ni dbang btsan pas/ /ma rig mun pa'i nang du gtan 'khyams te/ /ye shes nyi ma'i 'od kyis bsal du gsol/ /nyes byas las kyi 'bras bu mi bzad 2na/ /thugs rje chen pos phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /dug gsum sdug bsngal nad kyis gzir lags na/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman kyis gso bar gsol/ /phyen ce log be+e g.yang sar lhung lags na/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje'i phyag ges gzung du gsol/ /srid pa'i chu bos bdag cag khyer lags na/ /zag med ye shes gru yis bsgral du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan brjod yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /yo/na tan gzhung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin/ /ma lus bdag la myur du stsal du gsol / /rgyal ba'i thugs kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /phyag 'tshal 37— / /2

bstod dang sdig bshags smre gsol dang / /dge ba'i las ni cung zad ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /mi dmigs bsngo dang gsol btab smon lam dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i byin rlabs 1kyis/ /zhing rab dam pa'i gnas su skye bar shog /zhing rab dam pa'i gnas su skyes nas kyang / /rgyal ba sras bcas zhal mthong gsung thos shog /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /mchod pa'i yo byad bdag la ma mchis pas/ /smre sngags chen pos khyed la gsol 'debs na/ /mchog gi dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs / /gang dang gang la mgon dang skyabs med pa/ /de dang de yi mgon skyabs zhal bzhes na2/ /skyabs med sdig can rnams la bskyab tu gsol / /skyabs med tshe 'das rnams la bskyab 4tu gsol/ /skyabs med 'khor bar 'khyams la bskyab 5tu gsol/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /nyin re bzhin du sdig pa zil gyis non/ /las ngan sgrib pa ci mchis bsal du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag ni nyon mongs dbang du mi 'gro bar/ /sdig pa'i las ni gang yang mi byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod pa ru/ /thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzegs/ /mtshan nas brjod pa tsam gyis sbug bsngal rnams/ /zhi bar mdzad pa khyed dang mjal gyur na/ /bdag gis 'bad kyang 'bras bu ma mchis na/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /khyed kyi gzungs sngags brjod pa'i phan yon nam / /yon tan gzhung las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin/ /ma lus bdag la 37——/ /3

myur du stsal du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs/ /bdag gis khyed bsgoms snying po bzlas pa dang / /phyag 'tshal bstod dang sdig bshags smre gsol bas/ /mgon po khyed kyi zhal mthong gsung thos nas/ /khyed kyi go 'phang myur du thob nas kyang / /bdag kyang spyod ltar 'go don byed par shog /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /de srid bdag gi lus skyed 1pas/ /lus kyis 2mgon po mchod byed cing / /lus kyi tshogs ni sdogs par shog /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /de srid bdag gi ngag skyed pas/ /ngag gis 4mgon po'i mtshan brjod cing / /ngag gi tshogs ni rdzogs par shog /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs / /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe/ /de srid bdag gi yid skyed 5pas / /yid kyis 6mgon po rjes dran zhing / /yid kyi tshogs ni sdogs par shog /de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug bsten bgyis pas/ /lus ngag yid gsum skyon bral nas/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /de ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug sku gsung thugs/ /rtag tu dad gus bgyis pa na1 / /thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzegs/ /sred gsum re ba'e gnas gcig po/ /wan tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de 'dra bdag kyang 'grub gyur nas/ /srid gsum re ba rdzogs par shog /srid gsum 'dod dgu 'byung bar shog /srid pa gsum gyi sems can la/ /dngos sam brgyud pas phan thogs shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis bstod pa smre sngags su 27— — / /

༄ / /thugs rje chen po la rja sngags kyis bstod pa byin rlabs can jes bya ba/ 1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ku bākya sto tā bye tibye ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyis bstod pa byin rlabs can zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sa thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil ltar mdzes / /ji ltar mkha' la nyi 'od stong 'bar bzhin/ /dpa' bo 'od zer stong 'bar lham me ba/ /srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags/ /khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /byams mgon thugs rje'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /lam log lam stor srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyam / /sngon tshe las log sdig pa spyad pas nongs / /sdig pa'i las rnams ci byas rab 4gnong 'gyod/ /dar zhing drag 37—— / /6

pa'i las de dbang btsan pas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying gyur te/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i me yis rang rgyud bsregs/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs kyis shes rgyud rmongs/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam shes bying / /nga rgyal chen po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan/ /phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshub mas 1'khor bar g.yengs/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa dam pos bcings/ /'dod pa me mdag dong 'dra'i 'obs su lhung / /sdug bsngal drag po'i 'dam rdzab char ltar bab/ /me khams nyi ma'i dugs 3snani steng nas tsha/ /chu khams sa yi rlan ni 'og nas grang / /phyi yi ser bu'i ngad ni thad nas tsha/ /kun nas 'khrugs pa'i rlung ni khong nas ldang / /de lta'i sbug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' yang / /sdom pa'i yi dam gzhig tu ga la rung / /sdug bsngal kun dang bsdos ri nas sdom bsrung zhing / /mos pa'i dad pas 'phags mchog mi 'dor na/ /'phags mchog 'gro don mi mdzad ci zhig dgongs/ /byams mgon ci slad bdag la thugs mi brtse/ /bdag 'dra'i drun rmongs las ngan sdig po che/ /las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes/ /skyes pas 'gyod de las la yi re chad//yi chad 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su med/ /las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /las dbang chu rgyun 'bog 5par shin tu dka'/ /bka' la zhugs kyang bka' bzhin rngo ma thogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dbang du song / /sdig pa'i las dbang drag po'i me 'bar bas/ /rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdungs gyur te/ /phung po sgyu ma'i lus 'dis mi bzod na/ /byams mgon thugs rje can kyis dgongs lags sam/ /nyi ltar 'od gsal zla ltar mdangs gsal ba'i/ /thugs rje'i zhal nyid blta bar 'tshal lags na/ /37—4/7

thog ma med nas ma rig ling thog gis/ /ldongs pa'i chu bur mig gis ma mthong na / /'go ba'i mgon khyod da lta ga na bzhugs/ /sdug bsngal drag po shin tu mi bzod pa/ /shin tu skrag cing skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs nas/ /dung dung gdungs pa'i smre sngags 'di 'don cing / /nyam thag phongs 1pa'i nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /byams mgon thugs rje can gyis gsan lags sam/ /nam zhig 'chi 'pho lus sems brje ba'i tshe/ /gnyen bshes krogs dang phral te gshin rjes khrid/ /de tshe 'jig rten nye dus mi stongs te/ /las kyi dbang gis bdag rang gabyug pur dzad/ /dus der bdag la mgon skyabs ma mchis na//byams mgon khyed kyis 'khor bar bdag gtong ngam/ /las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas lam log pas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas las ma thar te/ /bskal pa dpag med skye ba ji snyed du/ /sngon chad lus blangs grangs med zhig gyur te/ /sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam/ /rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam/ /las 'phro bsags na bsam 'das brjod mi lang / /khams gsum bgrang zhing skye ba mang brgyud kyang / /byas pa'i las rnams don med chud re zos/ /skye ba grangs med ji snyed de tsam la/ /skye ba gcig gis 2kho na tsam gyi las/ /bla med byang chub don du rab 'bad na/ /de tsam byas pa'i las la'ang don re yod/ /las ni dbang btsan nyon mongs stobs che bas/ /sha khrag 'dus pa'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sbug bsngal drag pos srid pa'i btson rar tshud//mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po 'di myang na/ /nyes byas thams cad rang gi las las byung / / byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam/ /4thugs 27—/ /8

rje chen pos ngan song rgyun gcad de/ /nyon mongs las kyi rlung ni zlog tu gsol//nyon mongs las kyi rlung ni dbang btsan nas/ /ma rig mun pa'i gling du gtan 'khyams na/ /ye shes sgron me'i zer gyis mi gzigs sam/ /nyes byas las kyi 'bras bu mi bzod na/ /thugs rje can khyod phrin las mi mdzad dam/ /dug gsum bzod dka'i nad kyis gdungs lags na/ /thugs rje 1thabs mkhas sman gyis mi gso 'am/ /phyin ci log gi g.yang sar thong lags na/ /thugs rjes myur mgyogs phyag gis mi 'dzin nam/ /sbug bsngal drag po'i las dbang me 'bar na/ /thugs rjes bsil ba'i chu rgyun mi 'bebs sam/ / sdug bsngal chen pos mnar ro ra mda' mdzod/ /re sas slu bar ma mdzad spyan ras gzigs / /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad par/ /zhal bzhes mang po'i dam bca' mi mdzad dam/ /mthong thos dran reg 'byung bar ma gsungs sam / /snyigs ma'i dus kyi ngan spyod ma gzigs sam/ /ngan song rgyu 'bras bsgrub pa ma gzigs sam/ /sbug bsngal dba' klong 'khrugs pa ma mkhyen nam/ /nus mthu dpag med mnga' ba ma lags sam/ /byams mgon 'gro don mdzad par 'phyis pa tsam/ /2khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su sbyangs sbyangs nas/ /nam zhig rang gis 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mches/ /sems can las 'apo rang sor bzhag na ne+e/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes su la ci zhig bgyi/ / thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam bcas don de de ring dgongs su gsol/ /4'phags mchog khyed la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' na/ /yal yol le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par/ /snying nas gzigs shig thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha/ / re sa gzhan 37—/ // /

na med do thugs rjes zung / /byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la smre sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa byin rlabs can 'di nyid lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa/ mthong lam rgyud la byas pa'i gang zag /slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa sdogs so1// // ༄za/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro la nye ring med pas khyad du 'phags/ /sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs mdzod la/ /kun gyis rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang don du chos sgu rtogs pa/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis kyis/ mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas/ 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs pa/ 'gro ba yongs kyi don rlabs po che 'grub par byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma āt+yā ༄ ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo bye satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsakra bat+t+waṃ/ byu1 ma ṇi/ ma hā pad+ma ru ru tiṣ+ṭha/ dz+wa la ā kār+ṣa 4ya/ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags so/ /5oṃ pad+ma cis ma ṇi 6dz+wa la hūṃ/ snying po'o/ /oṃ bha rku ra ta pad+me hūṃ/ nye ba'i snying po'o// // 8

bsdur mchan/446 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos/ pa/ ltar bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉skabams gsum la ni ye shes nyin mor byed pa yi/ /dpal ldan shākya seng ge byams pa mgon po dang / /'jam dbyangs bcas pa/ yid bzhin nor dang grags pa dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal dasgongs su gsol // 〈〈snar 〉skoraphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la smre sngags kyi sgo nas/ bstod pa/ byin rlabs can slob dpon zla ba grags pa/sa mdzad pa bzhugs so// ra na mo lo ṅka shwa rā ya/ na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngarakhyams/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngang /447 1 〈〈pe 〉skoratshubs pas/ 〈〈snar 〉masab mas/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉dug 〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉pos/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsdoms—/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yond/ 5 〈〈pe 〉thazlog 〈〈snar 〉〉zlog448 1 〈〈snar 〉skoraphongs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉stanacig 〈〈snar 〉〉cig 〈〈snar 〉ge /'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉gibyam mason thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam/ /449 1 〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉gisdug bsngal chen pos mnar ro ra mda' mdzod/ /re sas sadzad par 'phyis pa/ tsam// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagar/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉githugs rjes/ 'gro dayongs su gsol //45༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉thugs rje chen po'i gsol 'debs slo ba dngo na zla ba grags pa sa mdzad pa/'o/ 〈〈snar 〉〉slor+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ni / 〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ tsi twa ma ni/ ma ha nga/d+ma me ru/ ru tirte/ dz+wa a sar/ 5 〈〈snar 〉〉giso/ /6〈〈snar 〉〉tsa ni ta ma ni/ 7〈〈snar 〉ra / 8 〈〈pe 〉〉gi༄7/ /thugs rje chen ngo/ nye ba'i snying ngo 'o// //(zhes pa/'i g.yu nga drung rtags bar gyi yi ge rnam/sa 〈〈pe 〉sngar/ mi bzhugs pa/sa 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉zodang dpe bsdur byas yod—/ )

༄/ /sgong rje la bstod pa/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ru ṇa sto tra/ bod skad du/ snying rje la bstod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+mas brgyan pa lhun po las byung ba/ /pad+ma dri med phyag gi dbus na bsnams//thor tshugs can la gzugs ldan cod pan thogs/ /spyi bo 'od dpag med brgyan phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje byams pas gzigs pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /phongs gyur 'go ba la ni khyod lta bu/ /gzigs pa tsam kyis zhi bar mdzad pa po/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis bdag la gzigs su gsol/ /mchog sbyin bdag ni rab tu sdug bsngal te/ /mun nag gtibs pa snang ba med pa bzhin/ /ri bo g.yang sa'i kha na gnas 'dra yi/ /dus 'dir thugs rje ldan pas gzigs su gsol / /phongs pa gang gis da ni dran byas na/ /de yi sdug bsngal bsal bar bya'o zhes/ /dang po'i smon lam mi 'gyur de lags na/ /bdag la de 37— /53

'dra'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /da ni mthong thos reg pa'am dran yang rung //nad rnams kun gyi gsos su gyur cig ces/ /bdag ni mi bzad nad kyis jebs lags kyis/ /mchog sbyin dam bcas de dag dgongs su gsol/ /gang zhig sbug bsngal gang gis nyam thag pa/ /de dang de yi sbug bsngal bsal lo zhes/ /'gro la dgongs pa khyod kyis rgyun 'byung na/ /mgon po ci slad sdug bsngal bdag ma gzigs / /gang gis khyod ni rjes dran tsam gyis kyang / /de yi mod la mgon pos gnod bsa'/ na/ /bdag ni rtag tu 'di na bro 'tshal kyang / /thugs dpag ma mdzad pa ni bdag byur 1ngan/ /mthu ldan sgyu med phan mdzad blo gros can/ /thugs rje ldan pa khyod la bsten 2 kyang ni/ /ci ste 'di dag zhi bar ma gyur na/ /bdag ni sbug bsngal gyur te kyi hud kyis / /gang dang gang dag sdug bsngal nyam thag cing / /gang dang gang dag mgon med gyur rnams la/ /de dang der ni khyod kyi thugs rje ste/ /mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur zhes de skad gda'/ /de ni las ngan nyon mongs bdag lags shing / /sdug bsngal bzod dkas lus gzir skyabs ma mchis/ /skyabs med bdag la ci slad thugs mi rje/ /nyi tsher gyur na thugs rje ma lags mod/ /gang tshe sngon chad rmongs pa 4'jig rten na/ /khyod nyid rjes su dran par ma bgyis pa5/ /bdag ni nyon mongs stobs kyis shin tu gzir/ /ma/pon ngo 'gum du nye na thugs rjes gzigs/ /thugs rje'i 'byung gnas thugs rje che rgyas pa ‘/ /sbug bsngal ma lus zad par mdzad khyod kyis/ /ci ste bdag ni spangs nga/ra gyur na yang / /bdag gi mgon bgyid gzhan ni su lags gsungs/ /khyod la skyabs su mchis pa tsam gyis kyang / /de yi mod la sbug bsngal sel mdzad nga/sa / mgon po khyod ni bdag gi skyabs lags kyis/ /thugs rjes mi bzad 'di 27—— /bye /

las bskyab tu gsol/ /mtshan nas brjod pa tsam gyis nyam thag pa/ /zhi bar mdzad pa khyod dang mjal 1gyur la/ /bdag gis 'bad kyang 'bras bu ma mchis na/ /khyod ni thugs rje can du rung lags sam/ /khyod kyis sems can bskyab phyir smon lam gang / /btab par gyur de'ang 'grub par 'gyur lags na/ /bdag kyang sems can grangs su gtogs pas na/ /mchog sbyin bdag gi duḥkha 2bsal du gsol / /khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchis kyang ni/ /ci ste de ni nyam thag gyur na ko/ /nyi ma mun pa'i tshogs su gyur pa bzhin/ /zla ba'i 'od zer sreg par byed 'dra gang / /khyod ni 'jig rten dag la gsol 'debs na/ /bdag ni khyod la gsol ba bgyid gyur pa/ /bdag ni skye bo ngan pa skal ba chung / /bsod nams min pa'i dri ma ngan pa can/ /mgon po thugs rje che dang ma bral bas/ /sems can don la bskul lta mi 'tshal kyang / /sbug bsngal rang bzhin du ni bdag gyur pas/ /skyob pa'i spyan sngar yang ni gsol ba 'debs/ /pha dang ma la gang zhig slong na yang / /shin tu skyo ba me+ed pa ji bzhin du/ /sems can don brtson de ni khyod lags pas/ /tshe rabs kun du bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /sdug bsngal mi bzad pas ni bdag gdungs pas/ /bcom ldan 'das la rtag tu 'bod sgrogs kyis—/ /nyin gcig bzhin du sdig pa'i las kyis ni/ /zil non 'di las bdag la srung 5 du gsol/ /de ltar bdag ges shin tu smres gsol bas / /khyod kyi thugs ni thugs rjes brlan pa ltar/ /'go ba sdug bsngal brgya yis gzir ba la/ /srid las grol bas de bzhin gzigs su gsol/ /thugs rje'i dbang du gyur cing sems brtan la/ /gzhan don brtson zhing yon tan mchog gi gnas/ /khyod bzhin bdag kyang sbug bsngal thams cad kyi/ /37— 53

1645༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a ba lo ke shwa ra sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /gzhan la phan phyir brtson pa'i go cha bsnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin dri med dkyil 'khor zhal/ 'gro ba'i sbug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /'das pa'i dus su mngon par sangs rgyas kyang / /thugs rje'i dbang gis sa bcu'i tshul ston pa/ /thabs tshul dpag med rig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i gtsug tor can/ /phyag gi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i chu 'bebs pas yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sgu/ /'gro drug 37— kye7

1646༄༅/ /dpal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa jes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī āt+yā pa ba lo ke te shwa ra gya stu ti nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /tshangs pa mchog dang 'chi med bdag pos bsngags pa ste/ /bstod pas grub par mdzad pa thub nga/'i rgyal po mchog /spyan ras gzigs pa'i dbang phyug mgon po mchog gyur pa/ /gzugs mdzes bde bar gshegs nga/'i sras po'i tshul 'dzin byung / /sgu yi mchog rgo mchan kyis 4me tog gis brgyan pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan 'dzin/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni gser gyi pad+mas rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pas yi dwags bkres pa'i gdung ba sel bar mdzad/ /dri med dmar ser ral pa gya gyu du ba 'dra / /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan yang dag rgyas shing gang 'dra'i zhal/ /mchog 37—— 59

tu mdzes pa'i spyan ni pad+ma lta bur yangs/ /kha ba 1dung ltar rnam par 2dkar ba'i 'gram ngogs can/ /ste ba'i gnas ni chu skyes dkar po dang mtshungs shing //sgu dang phyag mthil pad+ma'i 'dab ltar shin tu mnyen/ /gzhon nu'i na tshod chags pa'i tshon gyis ma gos pa/ /me tog phreng ba mang po'i spyor bas rnam par brgyan/ /zhal gyi sbubs nas ri dwags rgyal po'i nga ro dang / /ston ka'i chu 'dzin 'brug gi sprin sgra sgrogs pa bzhin/ /nu ma g.yon du ri dwags pags pas nges par bkab / /nor bus spras pa'i ska rags sku la 'chang ba ste/ /sta zur rnam par dkres pa'i ras kyi gos bzangs 'dzin/ /nor bu'i rkang gdub mdzes par brgyus pa zung gi zhabs/ /glang po rnam par rtsen pa dag dang ngang pa'i 'gros/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing 'dra 4ngo mtshar gzugs/ /dpal ldan po ta la yi gnas su nges bzhugs te/ /bsam gtan bzhi la mnyam par gzhag pa'i spyan mnga' zhing / /dga' dang snying rje'i rang bzhin g.yo zhing mdzes par gzigs / /der 5gnas don gyi phyag gis rims dang nad 'phrog byed/ /dge zhing zhi byed bde ba mang por mdzad pa'i phyag /bsod nams mang po nye bar bsags nga/'i phyag mthil can/ /srid gsum mthar byed sa dang nam mkhar spyod rnams kyis/ /bsngags pa'i sku ni rnam pa sna tshogs mi 'khrugs shing / /rā ma/'e chu gter rgya mtsho lta bur rtag tu gnas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar son/ /pha rol phyin bcu bdud kyi spyobs las nges par rgyal/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis dben par spyod mdzad dam pa'i don/ /gnyis med ye shes de bzhin nyid du rnam sangs rgyas/ /bcom ldan 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bstod phyag 'tshal/ /dge slong ma zla mdzes kyis bstod pa mdzad 27 — /60

༄7/ /'phags pa 'jog rten dbang phyug la klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bus bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po mchog la bstod pa yi/ /bsod nams gang zhing zla ba dung ltar dkar ba des / /rgyal ba kun kyi sras kyi thu bo de lta bur/ /sbug bsngal 'gro la mi 'jigs stsol ba nyid gyur cig /ral pa 'chang zhing shin tu zhi ba yangs pa'i spyan/ /rtag par rab tu dang ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal/ /lha dang lha min rnams kyis zhabs kyi 'dam skyes la/ /phyag byas nor bu pad+ma las byung mgon por 'dud/ /'phags pa 'jig rten nga/bang phyug la/ klu'i rgyal po rnge/ra rgyas kyi bus bstod pa// nga/pal na/gas kyi rin chen gyi zha'/ sngar bsod nams rnam par rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //

1( 48ra༅/ /'phags pa sngun ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1raḥ/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ke rdo te shwa ra sa ha sra ju dza sā 4dha ṭaṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /'das pa'i dus su mngon par sangs rgyas/ kyang / /thugs rje'i dbang gis sa bcu'i tshul ston pa/ /thabs tshul dpag rnged rig 'a/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang po re zhig 'jig rten dbang phyug sgru ba nga/ra 'dod nga/'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'jig rten gye bya ba thams cad spa/ngas la 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyis mi baspyod pa ri lta bu'i rnal 'byor nga/sa sa phyogs shin tu nyams dga' ba rnge tog dang 'bab chu dang ljon shing dang 'bras bu sna tshogs yod pa'i sar gnas khang shin tu nyams dga' bar sgu gsung thugs kyi rten ci rigs par bkod pa'i sar stan nang tshangs can la kha nub phyogs su

bltas nas khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams byas la/ oṃ āḥbispyon ༄1ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bsal bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi don yongs su dor ba'i bsam pas gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de la sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa dang 'dra bar 'dzin pa ni byams pa'o/ /kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub cing yun ring du sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar gyur te zhes bsams 3 la/ 'di nas lag tshar du nga yis 'khor ba 1sdug bsngal gyi rgya 4mtsho las gdon par bya'o snyam pa ni 5snying rje chen po'o/ /sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba rgyun mi 'chad pa la 'jog par 'dod pa ni dga' ba'o/ /bde ba dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / grags pa dang / ma grags pa dang /rnyed pa dang / ma rnyed pa dang / bstod pa dang / smad pa ste/ 'jig rten kyi chos brgyad po de dag thams cad tremago mnyam par rtogs pa rgo btang snyoms so/ /de nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i go 'phang thob par byas la mngal nas byes pa dang / sgo nga las skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang /rdzus te skyes pa'i sems can 'di dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag par bya'o zhes pa bsam pa brtan po bskyed la/ de nas rang gi snying gar chos kyi dbyings skye med ston par byed pa'i yi ge las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la de'i steng du s+thāḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas lus khyab sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po phyag stong par bskyed/ de'i snying ga nas tweḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam 37— 65

mkha' la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug phyag stong pa 'khor dang bcas pa 1bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bsams la/ de rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i sngags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ༄2na badz+ra ban+da rgo ka ro mi 4zhes brjod do/ /de nas gdan dbul ba'i sngags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū 3dza swas+thā nā ya yi māṃ zhwanit+yā ta yā mitsa/zhes brjod do/ /de nas tweḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas me tog thogs pa'i lha mo dkar mo dpag tu med pas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra puste āḥhūṃ swā hā/de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas bdug spos thogs pa'i lha mo gzugs dang lang tshor ldan pa nam mkha' khengs pas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra dī pe s+dzahūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rin po che'i sgron ma thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas dri mchog thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo dpag tu med pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas o badz+ra ne+e bi h+ye tsusna.ā hūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas zhal zas thogs pa'i lha mo ser skya ma sprin gtibs 7pa tsam gyis mchod par bya'o / /de nas oṃ sarba bi shis+thā pū 11dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dra 1rī.āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod cing snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 7'phros pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re ngadang / 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rin po che sna bdun la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags par bya ste/thog skemed 'khor ba'i 'gro bar gtogs pa yis/ /byas pa'i nyes byas ma lus mi bzad 'di/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams na/ /bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ sho dha ⑫da ha 37byed/66

na badz+ra swā hā/ sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /sna tshogs thabs mkhas pa yis 1phan mdzad dang / /phyogs bcu'i lo ka dag la gang dag gzhan/ /bsod nams byed pa de la yi rang ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na a nu mo da na pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa 4sa ma ye hūṃ/ rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gyur pa la gsol ba ni/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can ji snyed thams cad la/ /chos kyi sprin las char chen dbab tu gsol//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a byeṣ+ṭha 5na pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa /tshos ma ye hūṃ/ bskul ba'o / /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang nyes byas rnams/ /ma lus par ni myur du spangs nas ni/ /spyon 7med chos kyi sgu ni rnam dag par/ /bshad pa myur du rtogs pa nyid mdzod cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta na ya dhe sa ma ye sarba satwa hi dārja ya dharma dhā tu sbi tir+bha —ba tu / gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la ni phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis dge ba gang dag ci bsags pa//skye ba la sogs sbug bsngal thams cad ni/ /nye bar zhi phyir bdag gis bsngo bar bgyi / /o sarba ta thā ga ta pu ju t+yā tan pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa ris ma ye hūṃ / bsngo ba'o/ /skye sogs sbug bsngal rnams kyis nyer gtses shing / /mi shes log pas nyer brtsam bdag nyid can/ /sbog chags rnams la phan phyer byang chub sems/ /rin chen mchog gyur bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /rtag tu srog chags rnams kyi skyabs dang ni/ /gnas dang dpung gnyen spyob pa nyid gyur cig /oṃ bo bye tsit+t+waṃ ut+pā ྾da yā mi/ bo bye tsit+t+waṃ mutrī ta tai ta thā ha sa ma pi ta bo bye tsit+ta ut+pā da yā sa mi/ byang chub mchog tu sems babyed pa'o/ /de 37——/67

—nas/ rang gi dgos/ pa'i don thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas sa/ngas rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rigs kyi bu legs so zhes gsungs nas/ rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā 1ba shubyeḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bhā ba bi shurjopho4haṃ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad rang bzhin de bzhin 5nyid las mi 'da' bar stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha7haṃ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad spros bral nam mkha'i ngo bo lta bur bsam mo/ /de nas stong pa nyid du gnas nga/sa sem/sa can thams cad kyi don mi 'grub pas snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang bas paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du chos dbyings/ mtha' dang dbus med pa ston par byed pa'i yi ge a dkar po 'od du zhu bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba bsam/ de'i steng du dīḥ/ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang por gyur nas/ dīḥl thim pas gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa cig tu bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su bsgrubs nas thim pas bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzegs/ phyag sto/nga sku mdog dkar la 'tsher ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nga/ lha'i pañca li ka'i dar dmar pos sham thabs byas 1 pa ri dwags nag po'i nga/gas pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa rin ngo/ che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs du mas brgyan pa khyad nga/ra du yang lha'i rin po che rnam pa bdun gyis brgyan pa/ 5 rtsa ba'i 'al kun nas/ dkar ba spyan gsum mnga' ba g.yas pa ljang gu/ g.yon nga/ 27 — /68

dmar ba/ zhal thams cad kun nas 'dzum pa'i nyams can de'i steng ma ljang gu/de'i g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon pa dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dmar po/ /de'i g.yas ljang gu/ g.yon dkar po/ de'i steng na khro bo'i zhal mthing nag mche ba gcigs pa/ dbu skra ser po zhal bcu po ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o/ /de'i steng ma ban+d+ra ka'i me tog ltar dmar ba mgrin pa yan chod 'thon pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs rgyan spangs pa dbu'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /de 1ni skye ba rnam pa bzhis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i 'og ma g.yon pas sagaser gyi pad+ma rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi 'og mas bgrang 3phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na yi dwags 4bkres skom gyi gdung ba sel ba'i mchog sbyin 5pa/ g.yas kyi bzhi pa na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi bzhi pa na mda' 3gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas g.yas kyi phyag rnams su go rims ji lta ba bzhin du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang /sprul pa'i sgu rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / rnge long dang / shel gyi gdu bu dang /dgra sta dang / phub dang / ril ba z-iṅga ra dang / rnga yab dkar po dang /rin po che me shel 8dang / rin po che chu shel dang / skyabs sbyin pa dang /rin po che'e kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / kau rje dang / ral gre dang / lcung bzed dang /rdo rje'i zhags pa dang / rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rnams su go rims ji lta ba bzhin du rgun 'brum gyi snod thogs pa'i phyag dang / pad+mo'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa dang / rin po che'i za ma tog dang / rin po che'i shing dang / rin po che'i gzhal med khang dang / rin po che'i dung g.yas 37 — /69

su 'khyel pa dang / khar gsel 1dang / rin po che'i mda' dang / rin po che'i dril bu dang / thod pa'i khar ba dang / rin po che'i lcags kyu dang /rin po che'i mdung dang / pad+ma le brgan dang / sprin rnam pa lnga dang /rin po che'i phyag rgya dang / rin po che'i glegs bam dang / pad+ma sngon po bsnams pa'o/ /phyag stong gis nye bar mdzes pa de las gzhan pa'i phyag thams cad mchog sbyin pa phyag gi mthil na spyan re re mnga' ba'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad skyob pa'i spyan ras gzigs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 4g.yas su don yod zhags pa dang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs 'dud pa'o/ /g.yon du rta mgrin dang sgrol ma 'dud pa'o/ /phyogs bzhir rgyal po chen po 5bzhi rang rang gi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /steng gi phyogs su lha'i bu dang drang srong mchod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa lhags pa'o/ /de nas thugs/ ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la phyag dang mchod pas mnyes par byas la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ1 zhes brjod pas / dgug pa dang /gzhug nga/ dang / bcing ba dang mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar la pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du ༷byas te snying gar gzhag pa 'di ni pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ pad+mo bha bā ya swā hā/ de nas dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ nga/sa// regs lnga spyan drangs la snga ma bzhin du mchod de/ byang chub rda rjes sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen stsol mdzad pa/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga yum dang bcas pas dbang bsgur bar bsam zhing tshig tu/dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /kham/sa/ 27 /70

gsum po yis phyag byas pa/ /di ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba 1ta thā ga ta a ste ṣiñcan+tu 3rmā zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa spyi bo'i steng du gsal / de nas nga rgyal brtan par bya ba'i ched du/ oṃ yo ga dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba sat+tha phya.ākhya ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ nga rgyal brtan par bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed nas gsang sngags 'di 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ6āsde ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya / sat+tha brnya na ts+tsha da na ka rā ya/ sarba bha ba sa mu drots+tsha ṣa ṇa ya ka rā ya/sat+tha byu bye pra shā ma na ka rā ya/ sabye kyu ba dra ba bi nā sha ka rā ya/ sat+tha bha ye 6 tra rja ya/ ta su na maḥkṛ two i me/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra ta ba dī la kaṣ+ṭha nā ma hā z-i da yi a brta yi byā mi/ sadze+e arja sā dha rgo/ shu bha tse tā māṃ/ sat+tha satā māṃ/ pā pa mārga bi sho dha shaṃ/ tar+ya thā/ a ba lo ke/ lo ka ma ti/lo ka ga ti/ ā ti ba ti lo kā ti kradhe/ e bye hi/ ma hā bo bye satwa/ he bo bye satwa/ te ma hā bo bye satwa/ te spru ya bo bye satwa/ he ma hā kā ru tsā ka sma ra dz+dza da ya/ e bye hi/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra/ pa ra ma mi ṭī tsit+ta kā ru ṭī kā ya/ku ru ku ru karma/ sā dha ya bibye/ de hi de hi me wa ram̐/ kā saṃ gā ma/ bi haṃ gā ma/ sidha sidhe yo gī shwa ra/ dhu hu dhu hu bīr+yadhe/ ma hā bī6bye/ dha ra dha ra dha ren+d+ra shwa ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la bi ma lā mūrte/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra/ kṛṣ+ṭha dzi na dza ṭā mu ku ṭā lo ba/ a lo kṛ ta shā rī ra ladza pra lo ba bi lo ba/ ma hā sidzha/shudhe dha ra/ be+e ṭ+wāṃ dha ra ba la ba la/ ma hā ba la/ ma la ma la ma hā ma la/tsa la tsa la/ ma hā tsa la/ kṛṣ+ṭa baṇ+ḍi kṛṣ+ṭa pā sha nidhā ta na/ he pad+ma hasta/ tsa 37—/7/

cig brjod pas rtsa ba'i thong ba bzhi byung ba yang ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro//'di 'dzin pa'i gang zag de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po rgyun mi 'chad par mig stong dang ldan pa'i thugs rjes gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag stong gis skyob par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga dang / de dang nye ba lnga dang 1dge 'dun gyi dkor 2rku 'phrog byas pa rnams kyang lan cig brjod pas ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro/ /the tshom za ba ni ma gtogs so/ /gshis ngan du 'chi ba'i 'chi ltas bco lnga 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bzang po bco lnga yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /sus rdosnying po 'di'i ming thos pa de ni bskal pa du ma'i skye ba dang 'chi ba'i bsags pa'i las lci ba rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur na brjod cing 'dzin pa lta ci smos/ rgyun mi 4'chad par bzung 5na sa bcu'i 'bras bu thob pa la dka' ba rnged na/ 'jig rten pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu thob pa lta ci smos/ yul gang du yams kyi nad byung la yul der rgyal pos chos kyi ‘yul srung zhing rgya che ba dang gtsang mar bya/ sems can thams cad gtams las mi bcad 7do/ /nyes pa byung ba rnams la bzod par bya'o/ /zhag bdun snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi snying po 'di bzlas brjod byas na yul der yams kyi nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yul der gnas pa'i mi ma yen pa rnams la gtor ma byen la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzegs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang ldan pa'i sgu gzugs la mchod pa rgya chen po byas 'a// rig pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod nas rol mo sna tshogs kyis lan gsum du bskor ba byas na rims nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /tshon skud sna lnga la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la mgul du btags so/ /ga'/ te sa ris so sor

——— — —— —————— byedadagra rgyun tu 'ong zhing yu/la du gnas pa'i sems can rnams la gnod par byed pa dang yu/la der nad byung 1ba dang / char chu dus su mi 'bab pa dang / zla ba dang nyi ma drang por mi 'gro ba dang / ltas ngan pa de snyed byung na rgyal po des spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag pa stong dang ldan pa'i gzugs byas la gang du yams kyi nad byung ba de'i ngos su bzhin bstan la gzhag go/ /shin tu dud pa bdug pa dang me tog dang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pa ci 'byor pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos zhag bdun du brtson 'grus brtan por byas/ nas ris so so'i dgra thams cad phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ro/ /sems mthun par 'gyur4/ phan tshun grogs por 'gyur ro5/ /skye bo yongs dang rgyal bu rnams kyang byas pa / gzo zhing legs pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo'i 'khor rnams kyang de la dga' ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /nad dang gnod pa gang byung yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug lag nga/ stong dang mig stong dang ldan pa'i mdun du mchod pa byas la gzungs sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas na sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig ha la ha la'i dug zos na de gu gul gyi bdug pa dang / ga pur cha bsnyams te/ khron nga/ chu lhag mar ma gyur pa bskol / la khyor gang lus pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' meg stong ldan gye mdun du brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te 'thungs na dug zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig mig nyams te long ༷bar gyur pa dang / mig gi 'bras bu'i steng du ling tog byung ba dang / mig tu ru skyes te mi mthong bar gyur nga/ des/ a ru ra dang / ba ru ra gcig dang / sgyu ru ra gcig zhib tu btags/ la sbrang rtsi dkar po dang / khye'u'i nu ma'i 'o ma 2ḍa /7 /

byedadang sbyar bar bya ste/ spyor ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas brjod cing byis pa gsar pa btsas pa'i bud med dang / khye dang phag gis mi 1mthong bar ril bu byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' mig stong ldan gyi mdun du lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ dbe+en pa rlung mi 'ong bar 'dug ste/ nyi ma bdun gyi bar du sman 'di mi'i 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi dkar po dang sbyar te mig gi nang du blugs na mig gi 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ling thog med cing legs par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /su zhig 'byung po'i gdon nas mi ma yin pa'i nad kyis btab par gyur na gu gul gyi dud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la snar bdug go/ /yang na ri bong gi rtug 4pa tsam gyi ril bu byas la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la bza'o/ /sha dang chang dang sgog pa dang 'thab mo spang ngo / /'on kyang sos par 'gyur ro/ /shu dag dkar po la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te/ dpung pa g.yas par btags na 'thab mo las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ba lang dkar po'i gi wang 'a/ga mthil du bcug la byang chub sems dpa'i drung du lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te yan lag rnams la bsgus te dpral bar thig le byas na/ lha dang klu dang 'byung ngo/ dang / mi thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /khyo shug me dang chu ltar mi mthun par gyur na byang chub sems dpa'e mdun du ngur pa'e mjug sgra la lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas lus la btags na mdza' bar 'gyur ro/ /rin po che sna tshogs phun sum tshogs shing phyug par 'dod na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs pa'i phyag la mchod par bya'o/ /mi bde ba rnam nga/ sna tshogs kyis gtses par gyur na zhags pa thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /khong 27 /7ce

par nad rnams yod par gyur na rin po che'i lhung bzed thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /'dre gdon thams cad gdul bar 'dod na rin po che'i ral gri thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /lha'i bu'i bdud thams cad gdul bar 'dod na rdo rje thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phas kyi rgol ba'i 1dgra gzhom par 'dod na rdo rje'i tho ba thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /'jigs shing bag tsha ba'i gnas thams cad la thar bar 'dod na 'jigs pa med pa'i sbyin pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /mig mi gsal te 'od dang mi ldan par gyur na me shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /tsha ba'i rims kyis thebs te bsil bar 'dod na chu shel gyi nor bu thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /blon thabs mthon por 'dod na rin po che'i gzhu thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /grogs po mdza' bshes dang myur du phrad par 'dod na rin po che'i mda' thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /lus la nad sna tshogs kyis jebs par gyur na lcug ma thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /lus kyi bgegs ma lus pa bsal bar 'dod na rnga yab dkar po thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /thams cad mthun pa'i 'khor du 'gyur bar 'dod na bum pa thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /stag dang 'phar spyang dang dom dred dang gcan gzan 2ma rungs pa thams cad spong bar 'dod na phub thogs pa'i phyag la mtshad da/ /gnas dang dus thams cad du rgyal po'i bgegs 'a/sa / thar bar 'dod na dgra sta thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /bu dang bu mo dang g.yog 'khor gyi phyir shel kyi gdub 'khor thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyir ni pad+ma dkar po thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing yongs su dag par 4'dod na/ pad+ma sngon 37 /76

po thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /shes rab chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i me long thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mngon sum du mthong bar 'dod na/ pad+ma thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /sa'i 1gter 'byen par 'dod na rin po che'i za ma tog thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /drang srong gi lam mngon par bsgrub 2par 'dod na sprin rnam pa lnga thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /tshangs par bye bar 'dod na ril ba thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /lha'i gzhal med khang du skye bar 'dod na/ pad+ma le brgan thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phyogs gzhan kyi phyir rgol ba bsal bar 'dod na/ ral gri dang mdung thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha 'dre thams cad dgug par 'dod na rin po che'i dung thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do / /lha 'dre thams cad 'khol bar 'dod na thod pa'i khar 5ba thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs/ rgyas myur du gshegs nas phyag gis byug par 'dod na bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs mchog thams cad mngon par 'grub par 'dod na rin po che'i dril bu thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /tshig gi spobs pa gya nom pa dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i phyag rgya thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams dang klu rnams rtag par 'ongs te bsrung zheng yongs su dh+yab par 'dad na lcags kyu thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /byams 7dang snying rjes sems can thams cad skyob par 'dod na 'khar gsil thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /sems can thams cad kyis rtag par phan tshun gus pa'i bsnyen bkur brtse bar sems par 'dod na thal mo spyor ba'i phyag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i skye gnas thams cad du 37 —— 77

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang mi 'bral 7bar 'dod na sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /skye ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du — rtag par de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du gnas nas mngal kyi snying por skye bar mi 'dod par gyur na gzhal med khang thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /mang du thos pa'i shes rab rgya chen po dang ldan par 'dod na rin po che'i mdo sde'i glegs bam thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /da ltar gyi lus 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi sku la thug pa'i bar du rtag tu byang chub kyi sems las ldog par mi 'gyur bar 'dod na phyir mi ldog pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i 4sbyin pa rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba tshim par 'dod na mchog sbyin pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams myur du gshegs nas spyi bo nas phyag gis byugs te lung bstan par 'dod na spyi bo na 5sprul pa'i sangs rgyas thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /shing tog dang 'bras bu rnams 'grub par 'dod na rgun 'brum thogs pa'i phyag la mchod do/ /de ltar mngon par sgrub pa'i mchog rnams stong yod kyang / de mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin no/ /lus drang por bsrang ste snying gar thal mo sbyar nas sor mo thams cad phan tshun thad kar bsnol la g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams kyis g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams la 'khyud de mdzub mo gyen du bsgrengs la rtse mo gnyis sprad do/ /mthe bo gnyis mdzub mo gnyis 6kyi tshigs dang por reg par bgyi/ lag mthil la ma 'byar bar bkyi'o/ /'di ni gzungs sngags thams cad kyi phyag rgya yin no//bskal pa du mar tshe rabs su bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa mi dge ba rnams byang bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe phyi ma la sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /27——/78

————————sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas byang chub brnyes par mdzad pa'i tshe bdud thams cad kyis mtho btsams pa 1na phyag rgya 'dis btul te/ de'i tshe zhi ba dang bde ba dang bsam gtan dang snyoms par 'jug pa yang brnyes par gyur to/ /de'i gsang sngags ni 'di yin no/ /tar+ya thā/ sarba dharmya maṇ+ḍa khā/ ye e bye hi sarba shudhe sa tā ya swā hā/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga brjod par bya ste/ thog mar ri rnams dang nye ba ma gzhi sa gtsang zhing bkra shis pa'i sa phyogs btsal bar bgyi'o/ /der sa brkos te gseg ma dang gye mo dang rus pa dang mi gtsang ba rnams bsal la dri zhim po dag dang ba'i lci ba dang 'jim pa bsres te byug par bya/ dkyil 'khor dpangs mtho gang gi tshad du sgo bzhi gdod do/ /rin bo che du mas spras pa'i rta babs dang sgo khyud dang bcas pa tshang bar bgyi'o/ /shar gyi sgor ni yul 'khor srung / lho'i sgor ni 'phags skyes po4/ nub kyi sgor ni spyan mi bzang /byang gi sgor ni rnam thos sras/ de dag gi 5g.yas g.yon du rang rang gi 'khor thams cad bri'o / /dkyil 'khor gye dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong pa gzhag par bgyi'o/ /de'i mdun du snye sgrol ma dang khye'u gzhag ste khri'u'i steng du gzugs sngags 'di gzhag par bgyi'o/ /g.yas phyogs su ne+e don yod pa'i zhags pa'o/ /rgyab tu be+e nor bzangs so/ /g.yon du ni rta mgrin no/ /mtshams bzhir go rims ji lta ba bzhin du gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / byams nga/ dang / 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje'o / /dkyil 'khor de la bdug pa sna tshogs kyis bdug go/ /me tog sna tshogs dgram/ mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs gzhag par bya'o/ /sgog pa rnam 27— /79

—— —————dgu dang sha chang mi dbang ngo 1/ /zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par mchod nga/ gsar pa rnams brje'o/ /bstod pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' mar ni mchod rten bdun bdun la tshon sna lnga'i ba dan btsugs la gzhag par bya'o/ /de'i tshe rtsa ba'i sngags stong brgya 4rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bkyi'o/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzugs dang kun dga' bo'i gzugs kyis der 'ongs nas sgrub pa po de la ci 'dod ces gtam smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po des mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod la lan gdab par bgyi ste/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don du gzugs sngags kyi rang bzhin 'tshal lo zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /yang 'di skad du 'di ni lung bstan pa'i dus lags nga/ snyam bgyid na thugs rje dang ldan pas bdag la nges par thugs rje chen po bskyed du gso/'a// bdag ni rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang grags pa mi 'tshal gyi nam zhig na sems can thams cad 'a/ bu gcig pa bzhin du lta ba dang yongs su skyob par 'gyur snyam du sems so/ /yang 'byung po gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin du gnas par gyur cig snyam du sems so zhes brjod par bgyi'o/ /gal te yid la bsams pa 'di thob cing dngos grub de thob na ga'an la ma brjod par bdag nyid kyis 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /gal te chos 'di grub na bzlas par bgye gcig tu gzung bar bgyi'o/ /'di ni bslab pa gcig tu gsang ba'o/ /su zhig sna tshogs 'tshal ba des a ka ru nag ngo/'i chab kyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bgyis la rtsa ba'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyi'o/ /yid 'a/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa 27 /80

phyag rgya bcing bar bgyi'o/ /'on kyang 'tshal ba yongs su rdzogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe glegs bam 'di bzhin du sems shing su zhig 'di bzhin du mchod par bgyis 1na gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang pos sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bdud btul ba'i tshe lus las mig stong sprul te mig re re las sangs rgyas re re sprul te/ de dag las 2bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong 'byung ngo / /lag pa stong las lag pa nare re las 'khor los sgyur 4ba'i rgyal po re re sprul te de dag la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong 'byung ngo //bdud btul ba'i nang na byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni mchog go/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya ste/ zab pa dang phra ba'i rdzogs rim ni bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /de nas dza hi zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la gshegs la bstod pa dang mchod pas mchod la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag nyid gcig pu sdug bsngal las thar nas bde ba la gnas par 'dod pa ma lags kyis phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa'i ched du 'phags pa sgrub pa la sgu gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par byen gyis brlab pa 5dam pa mdzad du gsol zhes brjod la/ rma khyed kyes sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol6/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /be+er yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ rjo me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/37—/8/

sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha1/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥ3 ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān 4sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥge /zhes pa 6lan bdun brjod la gshegs su gsol/ gzhan yang dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po nas gsungs pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni 3 / /ngan song sdug bsngal dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /na ba'i sdug bsngal 'tshe ba'i sdug bsngal ba/ /kun nas ༄ thar bar spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs/ /gal te gsod pas me yi dong du yang / /gsad par bya ba'i phyir ni bor ba yis//spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na 9ni/ /chu btab bzhin du me dag zhi bar 'gyur / /rgya mtsho dang ni mya ngan rgal na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na rkani/ /chu yi nang du nam yang mi 'chi'o/ /rab tu sdang ba'i yid kyis gsad pa'i phyir/ /ri rab lhun po'i rtse nas bor na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /nyi ma lta bur bar snang gnas par 'gyur/ /gal te rdo rje yi ni ri dag dang / /bsad / pa'i phyir ni spyi bor 'ongs na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /ba spu'i khung tsam gtses par mi nus so / /gsad pa'i sems kyis lag na mtshon thogs te/ /dgra tshogs mang pos rab tu bskor na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /de ma thag tu byams pa'i sems su 'gyur/ /gal te gsod pa nye bar 'ongs nas su / /gshed ma'i mi yi dbang du gyur na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /de yi mtshon cha dum bu dum bur 'gyur/ /sngags dang stobs dang sman dang rig 1 sngags dang / /ro langs pa dang 'byung po lus 'jigs pa//spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /gang nas rab tu btang ba de slar 37—7/82

'gro / /dri ma med pa dri bral ba yi 'od/ /'od dpag med pa ye shes nyi ma'i 'od / /sprin gyis chod pa med par gyur pa'i 'od/ /'jig rten dag na lhang nge lhag ger mdzes/ /'phags pa lha yis gsol ba legs btab nas/ /'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs byas/ /mi dbang rgyal po bde spyod 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe 'dir 'jig rten mgon po mthong bar shog /1slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub bdag nyid chen po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer 2ldan pas drug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin yang sa dang po'i byang chub sems dpar byen gyis brlabs pa/ dper na nga'i nye gnas kun dga' bo sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin yang so so'i skye bor byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'o zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la 4'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du gshegs te/ sa brgyad pa la gnas nas lus gnyis su byas te/ gcig ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu 5med pa la mchod pa byed/gcig ni dga' ldan du byams pa la mdo 'di nyid kyi don 'dri'o zhes gsungs pa/'jig rten gyi khams dang ba'i 'od ces bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas 'od ces bya bar lung bstan pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ spyoka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā 7ba dge slo nga rin chen bzang ngo sa bsgyu ra ba'o // / /837— /83

dbe+en pa'i gnas su phyin nas ni/ /mchod sbyin la sogs sngon song bas1/ /rten dang mchod pa rim bzhin bshams zi / /de nas 'tshe dogs kun spangs nas/ /khrus byas bde ba'i stan 'dug ste/ /rang nyid snying gar dhī ཿbltas la/ /'od kyis 'phags pa spyan drang 4zhing / /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul la sogs pas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsags 5par bya/ /'gro la snying rje chen po dang / /byang chub sems kyang bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā 7ba āt+ma kopho8haṃ/ dngos rnams thams cad rab sbyangs te/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang nyid las/ /rlung dang bdud rtsi / ri rab ste/ /rgyu las rin chen gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi nga/ la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs la sogs rnam par mdzes pho brang chu skyes 'dab drug la/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de dbus pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /dīḥ/ las 'od 'phros don byas nas/ /slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sgur bskyed de/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /g.yas na mu tig phreng ba 'dzin/ /g.yon nga/ pad+ma dkar ngo/ bsnams/ /sgu mdog dung dang kun da'am / /kha ba'i ri ltar dkar ba la/ /thugs rjes yid tsam dmar ba'i spyan / /zhal ni 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan/ /sku ni mi 'gyur drang po ste/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam nga/'e skyel krung bzhugs/ /dbu skra mthon mthing lcang lo 'khyel/ / /a mi tā bhas spyi gtsug brgyan/ /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ / /le brgan dar kyi na bza' 'chang —/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon ngo/ ni/ /yum dang sras/ bcas/ bskyed nga/ra bya/ /de nas gnas gsum byin 27 /90

brlabs te1/ /spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka ru/ /rdo rje gsum mchog snying po 'di/ /kha dog gsum ldan yi ge dgod/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs spyan drangs nas/ /mchod de gsol ba btab pa yis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bsgur rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od zer spros te 'og min nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /mchod cing gnyis med bsre bar bya/ /rang sems rnam dag lhar gsal ba/ /snang ba rang bzhin med pa yi/ /chu zla me long gzugs brnyan nam/ /nam mkha' yi ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ /mtha' gnyis las grol lha yi sgu/ /sgu bcas sgu ni med pa yin/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsgom/ /de ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang / /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang sngags 'di/ /rgyun mi 'chad du bzlas par bya/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ 'di ni mtshan gyi rgyal po ste/ /mi mthun dri ma spang byed cing //'dod pa'i 'bras bu kun ster bas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'o/ /de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /snod bcud sbyangs te sgu 'a/ bsdu/ /sgu yang gsung yig rim gyis ni/ /thig le mi dmigs gzugs su basbu/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa rab zhi ba/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang bzhin kun tu 'od gsal ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du gzhag4 /de las cung zad lha yi skur//langs te spyod lam rnam bzhi ru/ /ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsgo ma/ /snang grag sku gsung thugs su khyer/ /gzhan yang bsod nams/ tshogs bsags phyir/ /mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal dbus nyid du/ /rten las dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dbyings nas ni/ /spyan drangs/ khrus gsol bstem bzhugs/ 27 /()/

shing / /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod bya ste/ /thugs nyi 1pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang sngags dmigs shing bzlas par bya/ /de nas bzod gsol ye shes gshegs/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ /rang yang mi dmigs rgyas btab ste/ /lha yi rnam par langs te gnas/ /thun bzhi la sogs thun bar du/ /chos kyi spyod pa rgya cher bya/ /de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyang / /'gro don byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zla drug bsgom pas 'grub 'gyur gyi/ /mtshan bzang mthong na don chen brnyes/ /sum byed drug 'bum thon nas ni/ /sna tshogs las kyi rim par sbyar/ /lnga brgya'i tha mar 'jig rten du/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas 'gyur 2te/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rnal 'byor gyi/ /myur du bdag gzhan don 'grub 'gyur/ /thugs rje pad+mo rgyas pa'i ge sar las byung ba'i/ /rgyas byed bcud ldan sbrang rtsi cung zad bdag gis 'thungs / /'di ni gzhan phan bsam pas man ngag zur tsam bkod/ /nyes gyur thugs rje'i ngang du bzod pa mdzad par rigs/ /'dab chags rgyal pos chu las 'o ma blangs pa ltar/ /grub pa'i rgyud las snying bo 'di bsdus dge ba yis4//mu mtha' yas pa'i sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /rnam dag pad+mo'i zhing du rgyal ba'i zhal mthong shog /thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba slo ba dngo na 'phags nga klu sgru ba kyis mdzad nga sdogs so // //rgya gar gye mkhan po slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal snga nas dang 5/ bod kyi lo tsā ba btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba'o// //27 /92

༄ / /rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ṭ+wā rā 2ka āt+yā ba lo ke te shwa ri ka da sha 4mu kha l+ya sā dha ṭaṃ/ bod skad du/ rje btsun 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lte ba zla bas rnam brgyan pad+ma la/ /'bar ba'i rgyan mnga' kun nas mun sel cing / /kha ba'i ri 'dra ri dwags lpags 5'dzin pa/ /'dzum bcas bzhugs la spyi bos btud tshobyas te/ /'gro ba de yi gnas thob 'dod pas 'dir/ /sgrub thabs cho ga bdag gis dran par bya/ /dang por re zhig gang yang rung ba'i 8 yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas legs par byugs la dri zhim po'i me tog kun tu gtor la/ de'i dbus su stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bas/ma zhing / de'i steng du dro ba rnams/ kyi bzhi pa rnge'i bu la brten pa nga ro bzhi 27— /9 /

pas kun nas 1mnan zhing gzhon nu ma'i nu mas brgyan par blta'o / /de nas sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer rnams byung bas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ de dag gi mdun nyid du phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song bas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe.āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gabye āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e —wi bye a hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs phul la5/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun du/ /sdig par bgyis pa gang gyur pa/ /skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing / /deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing / /dam pa'i skyabs la skyabs su mchi/ /de nas byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rim gyis mngon du byas la/ oṃ swa ghā ba bi shubheḥsarba dhas+thāḥswa bhā ba shusgolha haṃ zhes brjod do/ /rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang rang gi de bzhin nyid las mi 'da' bas rnam par dag par bsams te/ bdag kyang rnam par dag par bsams la/ yang khro shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes brjod do/ /kun nas stong pa nyid du bdag nyid kyang bsam mo/ /de'i rjes la mdun du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma sna tshogs pa bsam zhing / de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i dbus su yang sa/ bon gyi yi ge de nyid do/ /de nas yang de las 'od zer byung ba rnams kyis 'gro ba rnams rnam par dag par byas nas 27—— /9rwa

'ongs pa dang / de nyid la zhugs pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma lta bur gyur par bsam par 1bya'o/ /de'i dbus su yang sa bon gyi yi ge de nyid do/ /de nas yang de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dang / zhags pa lta bu byung bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bkug ste/ bdag nyid dang 2gcig pas de la thim par blta'o/ /de ma thag tu pad+ma sa bon dang bcas pa yo/ngas su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa 4spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa gangs ri'i rtse mo la nyi mas brgyan pa 5ltar dkar ba sgu'i 6yan lag rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa nor bus spras pa'i gser mdog 'og pag can/ ras bzang pos sgu'i smad g.yo/gas pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyugs pas mdzes pa/ phyag gdub dang /zhabs gdub dang / rna cha gdub kor dang / mgul gdub dang / cod pan dang / dpung rgyan dang / dbu rgyan rtse bran 9gyis gsal bar byas pa/'od zer dkar pos kun nas bskor ba/ lang tsho la bab pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing dpral ba yangs pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal kun nas dkar ba/ g.yas pa ljang gu/ g.yon pa —dmar ba/ zhal thams cad kun nas 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ de'i dbus ljang gu/ g.yas dmar po/g.yon dkar po de'i dbus dmar po/ g.yas dkar po/ g.yon ljang gus bye brag rnams/ so/ /de'i steng du zhal rnam par gcigs shing 'jigs pa/nag po mche ba snang ba/ kun du khros pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa bsgreng ba'o//de'i spyi bor ban du ka'i me tog dang / byu ru bcag pa'i mtshams ltar gsal ba/gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/27 /96

mgul pa dang bcas par byung ba/ zhi ba'i gzigs pas 'dzum pa'o/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas dang po phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na gser gyi pad+ma rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas yi dwags skom pa sel ba/ g.yon gsum pas ril ba spyi drugs 'dzin pa/ g.yas bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon bzhi pas mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po rnams kyis mchog sbyin pa 1phyag pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam pa 'di lta bu rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge gnas pa las byung ba'i 'od kyis btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ yang dag par mchod la bdag gi nang du zhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas sgu gsu/nga thugs legs par gnas pas dbang bskur ba'i mthar thug pa par bsgrub po/ /de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon kun nas dkar po 'od dang bcas pa mgo gyen du 'greng ba 4bsams te/ de las byung ba'i sgu rnams 'phros pas 'khor lo'i rnam par byung bar bsam zhing bsgom mo/ /gang gi tshe skyo ba na sa bon gyi yi ge yid la 'dzin pas nor bu'i mtshams su phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas pa'i mngon du gyur pa'i tshig spangs te/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ bye ri bye ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ibye bsne/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le ku su me ku su me/ ba re i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa lo a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dod pa bzhin bzlas so / /skyo bar gyur na ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod do/ /gsol ba gdab pa dang / bzod par gsol ba dang / gshegs par mkhyen par bya ba'i phyir dza hi zhes lan gsu/ma brjod do/ /langs nas mchod ston 827— /97

la sogs pa bya'o/ /'dir gang dag de snyed kyi phyag rgya dag dmigs par mi nus pas phyag brgyad pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag 1gnyis pa yang bsam zhing phyag gnyis pa pad+ma dang mchog sbyin par blta'o/ /sgrub thabs cho ga bkod pa yis2/ /dge ba gang zhig dri med ni/ /bdag gis bsags des 'gro ba kun/ /srid ma60 pha rol 'go bar shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 4zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā 5ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //babe+er mchan/494 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༄/ /spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig nga/'i sgru ba thabs bzhugs// 〈〈snar 〉〉ra /'phags pa/ spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dashe rlo nga ma dang la mos mdzad pa/ bzhugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sa ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rid sha 5〈〈snar 〉sko/gas pa// 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatugs/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉shig 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7la 'a ra/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nye bar/495 1〈〈snar 〉7kun nas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ lta'o/ rdo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pra tīts+tsha/ 〈〈snar 〉byu/ 5〈〈snar 〉tha/ 〈〈pe 〉mi/ (〈snar 〉snga/ 7 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7྅/ / 〈〈snar 〉ṅkarnams/49(‘ 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉ribs ma pa ra/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7dang / 1 〈〈snar 〉phros/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—'phags/ nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉zo/ thar ba/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i sgu/ spre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kukhrugs/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉por/ 〈〈snar 〉༄la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripa / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉phye ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkarnam pa/ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kugreng /497 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa// 〈〈snar 〉〉thugs / 1〈〈sna ra 〉lke/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉d+kugrel nga / 5〈〈sna ra 〉paṃ/‘〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉d+ku ma / — 〈〈pe 〉phro/ 〈〈snar 〉phro / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snyen/27——/98

༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ke zi te shwa ra sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po/ /lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa po/ /thub pa'i rgyal mchog bstod nga/sa grub par mdzad pa po/ / 'jig rten gsum kyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bde gshegs dpag med sgu mchog sku bzang 'dzin nga/ po/ /bde gshegs snang mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan 'dzin pa po/ / phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom se/'a ba ngo// /ca g.yo/na nga/'i phyag ni gser gyi pad+mos brgyan pa po/ /dri zhim ral nga/'i phreng ba dmar ser 'khyug nga/ po/ /zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bur mdzes pa ngo/ / / spyan gyi pad+mo mchog tu bzang zhing yangs/ pa po/ /kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar dri ngad ldang ba po/ / dri med 'od chags/ 1 nu/ tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po/ /27 bye00

—mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs 1dmar pos brgyan pa po/ / pad+ma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas papa po/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan zhing gzhon pa po/ /rin chen mang pos dpung pa gnyis ni brgyan pa po/ / lo ma'i mchog 4ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po/ /ri dwags pags/ pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab nga/ po /snyan cha gdu bus sgeg cing 5rgyan rnams 'chang ba po/ /dri ma med pa'i pad+mo'i mchog la gnas pa po/ /lte ba'i ngos ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po/ /gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yis zhabs yid 'ong ba po/ /gser gyi ska rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po/ /sta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham thabs 7'dzin pa po/ / thub pa'i mkhyen mchog 8mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po/ /mchog brnyes bsod nams mang po nye bar bsags pa po/ /rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po/ /rkarkagasum thar mdzad cing mkhas /spyod spyod pa ston pa po/ / lus can mchog ste bdud dpung 'khrugs las rgyal ba po/ / —tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yis dbe+en par mdzad pa po/ /ngang pa'i 'gos dang glang chen dregs 'drar gshegs 5pa po/ / tshogs kun nye bar bsags nas/ chos kun ston pa po/ /sbug bsngal mtsho dang nyon mongs kematsho las sgrol ba po/ /gang zhig rtag tu tho rangs/ langs nas gus pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing //bstod pa'e mchog 'di dag cing gsal bar 'don byed na/ /de ni byes nga/'am yang na bud med yin yang rung / / skye ba 7'di dang ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du//'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ dashe slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa sgogs so// //

1652༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pas/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dang ldan/ /thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyes 2ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i naspyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal le/ /sangs rgyas bye brag bcu gcig zhal/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni dkar po mdzes/ /ljang dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /zhi ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbus ljang g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal/ /dbus dmar g.yas ljang g.yon dkar zhal/ /spyan dkyus ring zhing zhal phra ba/ /'dzum bcas bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro zhal nag po spyan gsum pa/ /37—503

—mche gtsigs skra brdzes 1sma ra ser / /steng zhal dmar po gtsug tor ldan / /bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid thugs chud thugs kar thal mo sbyar / /thugs rje rgyun chad med pas phreng ba 'dzin/ /yi dwags bkres skom sel ba'i mchog sbyin phyag /phyag g.yas 'khor lo bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma bsnams/ /ril pa spyi blugs nyon mongs dri ma ḍa/khru/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mda' gzhu bsnams/ /rnam thar 5brgyad ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyan 6mnga' kun nas mun sel zhing / /sgu mdog dkar gsal ri dwags pags pa 'dzin/ /gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa'i 'dzum bcas zhal/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan blta bas mi ngoms sna tshogs sgu/ /thugs rje mthar phyin phyag stong 'gro rnams skyob/ /shes rab mthar phyin dri med spyan stong gzigs/ /'jigs pa kun las spyob la skyabs su mchi/ /thugs rje bsil 8mdzad zla ba dri ma med/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgu mdog zla ba'i 'od/ /skyabs sbyin rnga yab pad+ma chu shel 'dzin/ /me yi 'jigs pa skyob la skyabs su mchi/ /sems can re skong yid bzhin 'khor los sgyur / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgu mdog gangs ri'i mdog /skyabs sbyin rin chen pad+ma 'khor lo 'dzin/ /chu yi 'jigs pa dh+yab la skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rab rgyas nor bu 'dzin pa po/ /zha' gcig phyag gzhi sgu mdog gser dang mtshungs/ /skyabs sbyin nor bu pad+ma pusti 'dzin/ /seng ge'i 'jigs pa spyob la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro rnams smin mdzad nyi ma rab tu snang / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgu mdog btso ma 'dra/ /skyabs sbyin ut+pal pad+ma me shel 'dzin/ /glang po'i 'jigs pa skyob la skyabs 27— —50/

su mchi/ /sems can yongs sgrol thugs rje don yod zhags/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /skyabs sbyin lcags kyu pad+ma zhags pa 'dzin/ /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa skyob la skyabs su mchi/ /dbang sdud 1chen po chu srin 'dzin khri dpal/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ku sha'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /skyabs sbyin rgyal mtshan pad+ma gaṇ+ḍi 2'dzin/ /klu yi 'jigs pa skyob la skyabs su mchi/ /dug gsum 'joms mdzad ha la ha la che/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bai ḍūr+ya 'dra ba / /skyabs sbyin rtse gsum pad+ma ba dan 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob 4la skyabs su mchi/ /dngos po'i stobs 'joms mthu chen rab thob nga/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi in+d+ra byā la'i mdog /skyabs sbyin rdo rje pad+ma dril bu 'dzin/ /mi rgod 'jigs pa 'joms la skyabs su mchi/ /me chu seng ge glang chen lcags sgrog 5sprul/ /mkha' 'gro mi rgod 'jigs pa brgyad las ni/ /gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhis/ /smin mdzad spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo 'jigs pa kun las skyob mdzad cing / /sprul pa'i 'khor gyi gdul bya'i snang ba la/ /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang dang drag tshul du/ /skyob mdzad spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rab rgyas rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /byams pa'i na bza' thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro8/ /byang chub sems kyi dpa' rtags stag lpags can/ /'jegs gzugs spyan ras gzegs la skyabs su mche//mgon po khyod kyi yon tan brjod pas ni/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed sangs rgyas la / /de snyed phyag dang mchod byas gyur pa yi/ /don ldan spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi/ / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—bye05
