1653༄/ /rje btsun thugs rje chen po la bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭ+wā rā ka ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sto tra/bod skad du/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po la bstod pa/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /skyon gyis ma gos sgu mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i spyan kyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo / /thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ /mnyam par spyor ba'i thugs mnga' zhing / /phyag gnyis thugs kar mnyam spyor ba/ /dpal ldan mnyam spyor la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i bgrang phreng mchog /mu tig ltar dkar g.yas na 'dzin/ /rig sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyes ma gos pas// /dag pa'i shel ltar 'od gsa'/ ba/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /phyag na nga/d+ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyengs/ 27 507

1654༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ /༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ asbyot+ta rā sa — ta āt+yā ba lo ke te shwa ra sā dha ram̐/ bod skad du/ 'phags/ nga/ spyan ras/ gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad nga// /rje btsun thugs je chen po spyan ras/ gzigs/ /dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis tshogs gnyis rab 4 bsags pas/ /de nyid zab mo mngon gzigs te/ /brtse bas 'gro la 5 sna tshogs thabs/ /ston mdzad 'jig rten gsum mgon 'dud/ /stong nyid snying je las byung ba/ /rnam lnga byang chub che bdag nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thugs dag pa/ /'jig rten mgon po mkhas pas sgrub/ /pad+mo zla dbus ga'on nu'i sku/ /skyil krung phyed brkyang 'gying bag brtan/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal mdzes 'a/sa/ /sa/ gsu/ma bdag ṅgar mdzad gzigs nga/'o/ mchog sbyi na nga/d+mo'i g.yas/ dang g.yon/ /rgyal ba'i cod pan rin chen brgyan/ /'od dang/ga med kyis spyi gtsug mdzes/ / 2ḍa te()/)

—byed——————————byed byedabyed——de yi thugs ni pad+mar rgyas/ /dhīḥyig rang sems 'od gsal ba/ /sa gsum spyong mdzad yi ge bzhi/ /'khor lo rnam gsum dam tshig bzhi/ /sgyu ma brag ca mkha' 'dra'o/ /thugs rje chen po khabe+e pā ṇa'i rta sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ / thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum gtso bo zhi ba'i lha/ /thugs rjes mi bsnyel shes rab kyis/ /chags bra'/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mor spyi bos 'dud/ /gsum la skyabs song sems bskyed pas/ /byams sogs tshad med legs sbyangs shing / /brtse chen ye shes snying gi mes/ /'u/sa can sgrib nga/'i bud shing bsreg4 /rnam lnga byang chub las 'khrungs sgu/ /gzhon nu dkar mdzes phun tshogs tshul/ /mchog sbyin pad+mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /'od dpag med pa'i 5dbu brgyan bsgom/ / /de snying pad+ma 'dab bzhis te/ /lte bar rang sems hūṃ yig ni/ /oṃ dang āḥdang dhīḥt+t+waṃ bzhis/ /bskor ba'i dag gis sa gsum sbyang / /me long gzugs dang brag ca'i sgra/ /mkha' 'dra dag dang dri med dang / /ye shes phrin las sbyar ba yi / /sems 'di lha yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rje / 'jig rten dbang phyug ge sgrub thabs dze+egs so// //ra༅/ /thugs/ rje chen po ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug byams pa dang / /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms las/ /byung ba'i byang chub sems/ kyi bdag /'jig rten ma/bon po la phyag 'tshal/ /27 — pe/0

—— —————byed —byedabyed————de zhabs pad+mo la reg pas/ /'jig rten sbug bsngal bsgral ba'i phyir/ /ji bzhin ji ltar rtasgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bstan par bya/ /mkha' ltar dri med stong nyid dbyings / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar gsal ba'i dngos / /pad+mo zla ba rgyas la gsung thugs 'od 'phro sgyu ma'i rnam thar sprul pa'i sku/ /rab mdzes sgu ni gzi brjid brtan mdzes 'bar ba'i 'od zer 4dkar 'khrigs 5pa/ /skyil krung phyed brkyang dul ba'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pad+mo g.yon gyi phyag /pad+mo sdong mdzes dri gred 'dab rgyas gzhon nu sgeg mo'i thugs kar 'dzin/ /shel ltar dri med ut+pal spyan ring kun nas yid 'phrog 'od 'bar zhal/ /brtan po dkar gsal zla rgyas stong lhag ral pa'i cod pan thub pa'i gdan/ /'bar ba'i rin chen dri me+ed sna tshogs shin tu 'od sbyangs legs spras mdzes/ /mkha' la nyi ltar lham me lhang nge nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs 'od 'gyed pa/ /dpe byad mtshan rdzogs gcig pu skyob pa skyabs kyi dam pa bla med ni/ /shin tu rtogs dka' de nyid bzhir gyur snying gi pad 'dab tweḥyig gis/ /gang ba'i phyogs rnams de bzhin de gzugs oṃ dang āḥdang dīḥhūṃ bsam/ /dkar sogs kha dog dag gi phreng ba yid ni ye shes yig 'bru'i dngos/ /brtse ba'i rlung bskyod ye shes me 'bar 'gro ba'i sdig tshogs bud sheng bsreg /zhi ba'e ngang la gnyes med me dmegs mkha' ltar spros bral ro gcig ro/ /bde chen 'byung gnas ye shes dri med mnyam gzhag chen por bsgom par bya/ /de rjes mchod sogs/ dag pa'i yan lag cho ga ji bzhin ye shes sems dpa' legs bcug ste/ /rnam gsum 'khor ba dkar dmar sngo tshul go rims ji bzhin sgu gsung thugs/ /mtho ris sa steng ngan 'gro'i sar

— —sde snye ——sde————— —sde— snye———— —— sdebyed————————— sde snye —sdesdesde—sdeganas/ skye dgu'i snying rab sim byed nga/sa/ /brtan g.yo'i mtshan nyid dam pa'i zha'/ bzhin mkhas pas rab tu shes nga/ra bya/ /thugs rje chen po ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ sdogs so// //rab/ /'phags nga/ spyan ras gzigs 'khor lo gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bla dang ni sa stengs 1 sa 'og dud 'gro la sogs spyong ba yi/ /'khor lo dri med dkar dang dmar po rnam par sngo/ /spyi bo snying ga lte ba'i dbus bzhugs zla ba dang / /pad+mo nyi ma haṃ dang hūṃ dang āḥs mtshan pa'o/ /de la spyi bo bde ba chen ngo/'i bdag nyid kyi rtsibs/ sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i 'khor lo zla ba'i kha dog can no / /de'i snying po la ni gsal byed dmar pos brgyan to/ /snying gar ni chos kyi bdag nyid kyi 'dab ma/ bcu drug pa'i pad+ma 'bur pa byi ru'i kha dog can no/ /de'i snying ngo/ la ni dbyangs yig dkar pos brgyan to/ /ste bar ni sprul pa'i bdag nyid kyi 4rtsibs drug cu rtsa bzhi ral gri'i kha dog can no/ /de'i snying po la ni 'bebs pa sngon bos brgyan to/ /gsum ka'i srog shing ni rtsa mchog go/ /lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i rlung gis bsko/ra bar bya'o/ /'og mas ni sdud par bya'o/ /thog mas ni dbab nga/ra bya'o/ /bar mas ni bsre bar bya'o/ /thams cad las rgo ye shes/ rang byung ngo / /'dzag pa la sogs pa'e rem pa yang phreng ba'e 'khor lo la'o/ /rab tu gas/'a/ ba dang bde ba chen po dang rnam par mi rtog pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don to/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le nyid spyor bar bshad do/ /pha dang ma dang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i sa bon no/ /8thog ma dang tha ma dang bar ro/ /sgu gsung thugs rnam par spyong ba nyid do/ /27 da/2

— byed —byed———— — — ——'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ gnyis med/ /zab mo mngon par 'byung ba'i lam /rtog pa'i rgyal po las basbus pa/ /rnal 'byor la phan byed pa yin/ /spyan ras gzigs 'khor lo gsum bsgom pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po rgyal ba lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rnam dag dang ba'i mtshor/ /rab mdzes sdong bu lnga ldan steng / /rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rin 'byung 'od dpag med don grub/ /lnga rig rnam dag sna tshogs gzugs/ /dngos gcig rgyal ba lnga 'a/ 'dud/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can 'a/ gnas pas snying rje chen po mdun du byas la/thog ma kho nar chos thams cad stong pa nyid du 1 rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /gdod nas ma skyes 'od gsal ba/ /gang shar nyid na ngo bo med2/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /gang 'di ltar ngo bo med pa'i chos 'di dag ni zab pa'i phyir rtogs dka' bas mi shes pa'i 'gro ba lnga po ni nges par sdug bsngal ba'o zhes brtags nas dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon nga/ra bskyod pas/ skye bo nyon mongs sgrib tshogs sprin gyi phung po shin tu mthug 4po gtibs gyur la / /tsham rtsam med par drag po'i shugs kyes kun du rab tu dral zheng yongs su gtor//de yi thabs gyur thugs rje'i dbyengs kyi sna tshogs mdzad pas dbyer med cig car bsgrub pa yi/ /mgon po dam pa rigs kyi lha lnga bsgrub cing stobs lnga sogs///de la dbus sogs sdong 'dab bcas/ /zla ba'i 'khor lo gsa'/ ba la me long gzugs ltar 'bru lnga bsam/ /phrin las 'a/ sbyar sgur bskyed do/ /rnam 37 da/3

—ke————par snang mdzad ni kha ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can dīḥ'i 1snying po can 'khor los mtshan pa'o/ /rjo rje sems dpa' ni nam mkha'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can hūṃ gi snying po can rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan ni gser btso ma'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can t+t+waṃ zi gi snying po can rin po ches mtshan pa'o/ /'od dpag med ni me lce 'bar ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can tweḥ'i snying po can pad+mos mtshan nga/'o / /don yod grub pa 4sā lu ljang ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can aḥ'i 5snyeng po can ral gris mtshan pa'o/ /'di dag dbus bcas phyogs rnams su/ /rim bzhin las lnga mdzad pa la/ /brtson pas ting nge 'dzin bzhengs pa/ /bdag sbyang ba dang gzhan sbyang ba 7gnyis/ oṃ ā swa pā rārja dz+nyā na swa bhā ba shud+dhā pra kā swā hā / 'khor lo lta bu'i sngags so/ /thugs rje chen po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stong nyid tshad med bzhi'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam lnga mngon par byang chub rim/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pas legs par gnas/ /rnam dag stong pa nyid dag la/ /rgyal ba lnga ne+e bsgom par bya/ /bcu drug rgyang grags pad+mos khebs pa'e mtsho nang nas / /klu shing sdong po dri med mdzes lcug legs 'khrungs rtser/ /pad+ma zla ba dhīḥyig gis mtshan yongs gyur pa/ /dpal ldan stong nyid spyan ras gzigs ni dang por bsgom/ /de ni dkar gsal gzi brjid mdzes/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spud/ /dhīḥyig dung mdog snying por bcas/ /'gro la stong pa 27 — bye/ /

nyid ston bzhengs/ /de rjes yang dag rjes 'gro ma yin dang / /dmigs bcas dmigs bral mngon par 'du byed dang de yi/ /nges pa'i sar chud mtshan med shin tu zhi ba yis/ /yid brtan byas la lha bzhi rnam par sprul bar bya/ /byams pa tshad med la skyes shing / /dīḥyig sngos mtshan sngon po'i mdog /'od kyi dkyil 'khor sngo ldan pa/ /byams pas 'gro skyob shar du'o/ /snying rje tshad med las skyes pa/ /dīḥyig ser ldan ser po'i mdog /'od kyi dkyil 'khor ser mnga' ba/ /snying rjes 'gro spyob lho ru'o/ /dga' ba tshad med las skyes pa//tweḥyig dmar mnga' dmar po'i mdog /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar 'khyel ba//dga' bas 'gro skyob nub tu'o/ /btang snyoms tshad med las skyes pa/ /dhīḥyig ljang mtshan ljang gu'i mdog /'od kyi dkyil 'khor ljang gsal ba/ /btang snyoms 'gro skyob byang du'o/ /dkyil 'khor bzang lnga ji ltar gzhug pa'i cho ga yis/ /legs bcug lus can nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gnyen tshogs la/ /rim dang rim min stong nyid tshad med drag bsgoms nas/ /mkhas pas don bsgrub lha lnga'i phrin las rab 'byams spyo/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po tshad med bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //snga / /jo bo thugs rje chen po ye ke drug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/bde chen shes rab snying rje mchog /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o//bde chen stong pa nyid bdag lha/ /mgon po nyid dang shes rab mchog /brtse chen rang bzhin nor bu dang / /pad+mo 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bshad/ /rna'/ 'byor rgyal ngo/ shes rab thabs/ /rigs 'dzin dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /27 —bye/ 5

— — — — — —— —— —— — —————————byedabyed dang/la lda na pha ro'/ phyin drug dngos// /cho ga'i dam pa 'di gsungs/ so/ /oṃ/ ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ/ gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug /lugs 'byung ba dang lugs bzlog las/ /rgyud drug 'gog dang lam drug spyong / / /'bras bu drug 'a/ rab spyor nyid/ /de bzhin rgyud drug bskyed pa dang / /lam drug la ni spyor ba dang / /'bras bu drug ni mngon du bya/ /gzi brjid drug pa zhes bshad do/ /oṃ āḥdīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ rang bzhin gnyis med stong pa nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /'gag pa med dang gas/la med dang / /ma bsgribs 'gro 'ong rnged mtshan nyid/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥ / ma ṇi t+t+waṃ/ shes rab chen po dri ma med/ /rnam par shes kun ma' na nyid de/ /ma skyes mi gnas 'gag pa med/ /gdod nas rnam grol mngon sum pa/ /oṃ āḥ4 pad+me hūṃ/ snying rje chen po lhun gyis grub/ /dmigs pa kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /mi phyed mi 'gyur 'bral ba med/ /skyo med re ba rnam spangs pa'o/ /chos kun mtshan med mkha' 'dra'i rnal 'byor dag pa la/ /thugs/ rje'i spyan baspyod nga/d+mo zla dbus gzhon nu'i sgu/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ji bzhin phyag rgyas mtshan pa dang / /de bzhin g.yas g.yon nor bu pad+mo 'dzin nga/'o/ /dam tshig rdo rje lha gsum la/ /ye shes mkha' spyod gsum bcug la/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rim pas bzlas/ par bya/ /lha ye rim nga/sa sngags rem bzhen/ /rnam gsum dze+egs pa'i rim nga/ yang / /mkhas/ pas 'bad de bsgo/ma par bya/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das/ thugs rje chen po yid rnyog pa med par mdzad

— ——— byed————————— —— —pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa/ gsum dbang phyug lha gsu/ma 'jig rten 'od mdzad ni / /gangs ri ltar dkar skal ldan yid kyi ngal so/'i rgyu/ /bde gnas mchog spyin gcig pu rtag tu dbugs 'byen brtson gyur gang / /dpal ldan mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid rtag 'dud/ /ring nas/ dub nga/ skyabs med pa/ /rnam g.yeng rnam par gzings pa yis/ /rtag tu nyon mongs gyur pa gang / /de dag dal ba'i thabs 'di brjod/ /yid dang rjes mthun gnas su ni / /blo ldan rnyog pa med yid kyis/ /ltos 2pa thams can dor nas su/ /lha gsum rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /stong pa nyid skyes pad+ma dang / /bde chen las grub zla dkyil du/ /lus ngag sems kyi rang bzhin rim/ /dhīḥdang āḥ4dang t+t+waṃ zhes pa/ /dkar dang dmar po sngon po dag /sgu gsu/nga thugs dag spyor 5ba yis/ /bsams la 'od spro bsdu ba yis/ /phyag 'tshal nyid dang sgu blta'o/ /de la dbus su 'jig rten mgon/ /gzhon nu dkar sgeg mdzes pa'i gzugs/ /g.yas su/ khro gnyer dmar mdzes khro/ /g.yon du sgrol ma ljang ngul ma'o/ /rang rang 'dab skyes 'dab bzhi'i thugs/ /rtsa ba'i yi ge bzhis mtshan pa/ /rang gi snying po sa bon bcas/ /gsa'/ byas ye shes gzhug par bya/ /de nas dub pa ngal so'i phyir/ /cho ga'i spyor bas 'gro ba yi//sems dul dal ba rnyed pa la/ /brtsan pas gsang sngags bzlas par bya/ /rang dang rjes mthun 'od zer gyis/ /'go ba'i dub pa gang gi rgyu/ /chags/ sdang ma rig las bcas/ 'phros/ /sbug bsngal dri ma bsal bar 'gyur/ /de rjes mkhas pa dmigs bcas dang / /dmigs bral rnam par mi rtog la/ /rnal 'byor gnyug mar gnas na ni/ /ma lus ma/tshan ma rnam gro'/ bsgom/ /27 — du/7

gang phyir gang du gang gis gang / /ji ltar bcing bas bdag dub pa/ /de phyir de yis der de nyid/ /de ltar grol bas bdag dal ba'o/ /e ma'o rnal 'byor zab mo che e ma'o 'ching ba 'chi 1ba med/ /e ma'o rtag tu bde ba che / /e ma'o e ma ngo mtshar rmad/ /yang ni dmigs bral nyid yid kyis/ /lus can dmigs med dmigs byas la/ /stong nyid 'od zer dbugs 'byin pa'i / /spyor bas dub pa ngal so bya/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs srid na 2'di dag mi nga'/ sems dub rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal ni//sna tshogs kun rtog bag chags las bcas 'dzin pa'i blos bslad mngon zhen 'ching ba dam pa'i mdud pas nyer bcings pa/ /cho ga gang gis de shes gyur na skad cig de la dpag med rgyal ba'i phyag gis rjes skyabs dri rdul med/ /snying gi dbus su bde ba che thob gzha' lus 'di dang tshangs pa'i ngag thob 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig bla mar gyur/ /gang tshe skyo bas ldang 'dod na/ /dran pas brtan nga/ra byed pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam gzhag nas/ /brtse ldan dal bus ldang bar bya/ /kha na ma tho med dran bcas/ /rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog dang / /byams ldan kun tu yid gzhungs pa/ /rjes spyod dge tshogs brtsam par bya/ /sems ngal so ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs dze+egs/ so// //༄7/ /spyan ras gzigs 4yi ge med 5nga/ la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas khyod la yi ge med/ /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /lus gnas a haṃ hūṃ yig la/ /ka dang a phreng phyogs bdag bzhi/ /ye shes me lce 27——5/8

byedabyed———————lhan cig 'jug /zhu ba stong nyid rnam dag go/ /de ltar lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ yi ge can gyi rim pa gnyis so/ /1'di lta ste/ 'bar ba dang 'bad 2pa'o/ /bab pas zad par gyur pa na rtsa ba chad pas 'khor 'o/ dang 'khor lo chen po thams cad 'tshig par 'gyur ro/ /tshig pa rnam par rtog pa'i yi ge gsum yang nub par 'gyur te/ bde ldan zad pas chags pa dang / /'bar byed zad pas sdang ba nyid/ /sa bon zad phyir gti mug kyang / /brlag 'gyur yi ge las yig med/ /lus med sems ni mi 'gro mi 'ong gnas pa med / /sgyu ma'i skyes bu dga' dang gdung ba gang thob pa/ /'di nyid chos kun nam mkha' lta bur sgrub po la/ /yi ge gred pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo ston pa yin / /gang zhig yid la byed na yang / /de tshe de ni de nyid yang / /dngos po 'ga' yang mi byed phyir/ /bdag nyid yi ge med par brjod/ /gang du snang ba'i yi ge ni/ /de gnas par ni mi 'gyur te/ /gnas med gnas par rab snang ba/ /snang ba phyi nang med yi ge/ /chos kun yi ge med mtshan nyid/ /de ni gdod nas yod min zhing / /slar yang yod par mi 'gyur bas/ /yi ge thog mtha' med ces bshad/ /ngo bo gnas dang dus yig med/ /nam mkha' la ni sgra blo bzhin/ /bsam sogs reg par mi nus pa/ /de bzhin nyid yig med pa'e/ /je lta ji ltar rtog pa nub/ /mnyam par gzhag pa rād gsal brjod/ /de lta 5de ltar rnam kun rtog /thams cad de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /zab mo gog tu ma gyur dang / /byed bcas byed pa med nyid dang / /ci tsam snang ba de tsam du/ /dmigs pa chad phyir yi ge bral/ /de nas thun gyi dus la bab pa na slar yang gdul bya dang rang gi bsod nams dang smon lam 27—bye/9

byed———gyi mthus/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs btsun 1pa'i cha lugs can rgyan spangs par bltas nas/ mtshan ma g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i las bsgrub par bya'o/ /thugs rje chen ngo/ yi ge med pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄za/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa byang chub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni stong pa nyid rang bzhin/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'o / /gang zhig dbang po'i gzhu ltar dri med mngon par gsal ba'i sgu gzugs mchog /ston ka'i zla ltar rab tu dkar zhing phyogs bcur 'od mdzad khyab pa po/ /phra ba'i a dkar shin tu mi rtog ye shes ma lus bskyed pa'i gzhi / /gang gis yongs shes de nyid gzhan min 'chi ba med thob grol byed rgyal/ /tā la bdun srid steng gi mkhar/ /pad+mo zla rgyas gdan steng na/ /dpal ldan stong nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /lus can lus med ston bsgom bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'od gsal dri med kyis/ /sgu brgyan pad+mos phyag mtshan pa/ /zla ba'i zhal mnga' sdig 'joms phyir/ /brtson pas bzhengs pa'i dbang po'o / /'di yi thugs kyi 5pad 'dab brgyad/ /snang dang 'dzin pa zhen pa dang / /de rgyun yongs su spyo nga ba dang / /dre gsum spyong phyer yig 'bru brgyad/ /a saṃ s+thā6ཿbye tram̐ two khaṃ hūṃ/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po dang / /dung mdog mngon par skabs yod dang / /sna tshogs kha dog rim bzhin du/ /phreng ba dri med 'khor lo bsam/ /bsam gtan mchog gi phyag rgya la/ /gnas nas nges pa'i spyor ba dang / /yang dag sdogs pa'i rim gyis su/ /spros bral la ni spros bral 27—520

gzhag /sor gzhag lkubalta dang rang grol dang / /gnyug ma nyid dang 'od gsal dang / /lhun gyis grub dang de sbyang ba/ /yongs su dag pa nyid kyis so//'di dag bsgom dang bsgom pa yi/ /lam gzung ba dang skyon bsal dang / /de la mthun pa bsgrub blurnam gsum/ /rim pa bzhin du bstan pa yin/ /stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mar me sbar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ 'jig rten sgon ma sgron 5 ma'i dbus/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'o/ /sngags las skyes pa'i 'jig rten mgon/ /rnam dag sgon ma 'bar ba la/ /dges 5dgus rol par bzhugs pa ni/ /mar mes mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer nub gyur cing / /zla ba nya bar ma gyur pa'i/ /mtshan mo mun pa thibs po la/ /bsod nams ༄bsdus pa'i mar me 'bar/ /rdo rje thal sbyor gsang sngags kyis/ /btab pa'i rtsi mar sna tshogs pa—/ /sgron shing me lces bzhu byas la/ /snod bzangs 5 pad+mos mtshan pa yi/ /kong bu shin tu byi dor byas/ /smad 'tshong chang 'tshong gso ras ma'i/ /khyim blangs ras kyi sdong bu la/ /mgar gyi so mal mes bsregs bya/ /sgron ma'i dbus bzhugs tweḥs ⑦mtshan pa/ /sgeg po gzhon nu rol pa'i tshul/ /zla ba'i 'od 'byin yid du 'ong / /rol snyebazhi pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /de la me tog spos mchog sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pa kun kyis mchod/ /'jungs pa rnams dang dbul phongs //3snadang / /sdig ldan rgyal po'i mar dkar sbyin/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi nyer brtsams pa'i/ /chos sbyin rjes su yid byed dang / /37—521

— ——— ——snying po'i rnal 'byor mchog sngor bcas/ /thun gsum du ni rtag tu bya/ /bdun phrag bdun gyi cho ga yis/ /tho rangs mtshan ma gsum mthong ba/ /de tshe gzhon nu gzhon nu ma'i/ /ston mo byen la me tog gi/ /phreng bas mgul brgyan me long dang / /mar me'i 'khor yug dri byug dang / /maṇ+ḍal rol mo phul nas ni/ /ma/ra me'i du ba'i thig le sbyin/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ /a ka ru yi bdug pas bdugs1/ oṃ āḥdhīḥ.āt+yā ba lo ke te ā 2lo ka dz+nyā na dz+wa la dz+wa la pra kaspa ma ma tsit+ta sdir hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ/ rang lus mar me 'bar ba dang / /mkha' la lha mthong lung bstan pa'o/ /dpal khad+ma pā ṇa mar me 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sgu gsum dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ mchod sdogs sprul pa'i sgu 'chang ba/ /zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /lus can kun gyi sems dbus la gnas bde chen 'od gsal dri rnged sgu/ /de stobs kyis snang dpe byad brgyad cu de bzhin mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis// /bcu gnyis mdzad sogs ji lta ji ltar gdul bya'i rim 4bzhin de lta de/ /ston mdzad sgu gsum rtag tu lcun grub 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /drang srong mtshag gi pho brang mchog /po ta la yi ri bo yi/ /rtse nas skyob pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sku gsum zhes pa 'di baspyod bya/ /de ni zla ba'i kha dog go/ /zhal gsum g.yas sngo g.yon dmar//dbus dkar zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ /rab tu g.yo ba'i tshul yin/ /phyag drug dang po gnyis kyi/ /lte ba la 5gzhag mchog mdzad/ /g.yas kyi gnyis par 27——522

byed byed————byedabyedabyed—byed—————— —chos 'chad/ /g.yon na pad+ma 'dab rgyas1/ /g.yas kyi gsum pa mchog sbyin/ /g.yon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung brtan bcas/ /mi g.yo 'dzum zhal dang po'o4/ /de yi thugs rgo pad+ma rgyas/ /dri med mdzes dbus dīḥyig /kun da ltar dkar 'od 'phro/ /mi brjed dran pas bsgom bya//oṃ āḥtrīḥtri kā ya lo ka nā thā swā pa rābye sibye kar hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ nyi shu gcig bcas sngags 'di sngags pa yis/ /nam langs thog thag nyi ma 'char ka dang / /zla ba tshes dang tshes brgyad nya ba'i tshe/ /stong nyid bde chen snying rje'i yid kyis bzlas / /gang tshe mi rtog bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal gyur cing / /sna tshogs phrin las sems la dbang gyur thob pa'i tshe/ /ci rigs rnam bzhi phrin las mthu la sbyar ba yis/ /'gro ba 'di dag myur du de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de las sems ni dri med spros bral mi g.yo ste/ /'di ltar de ni gzung dang 'dzin pa'i g.yeng ba zad/ /de thob byed pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' drin las// /sems ni sa bon tweḥ5yig la gnas brtan pas 'grub/ /gang zhig nges pas skad cig de la phyogs bcu yi/ /rgyal dang de sras nyan thos la sogs 'khor mang po /snang dang mi snang bde chen phun tshogs ston pa'i sgu/ /dngos gsum dri med dag pa'i sku gsung thugs 'grub 'gyur/ /rtogs pas mi zad stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gang / /mthong ba'i mthu las de nyid ma rtogs sems can la/ /ji ltar gang 'dul de lta de la de ston pa'i/ /mdzad pa dpag med 'od zer phung po las sprul bya/ /ji ltar sgu gsum mdzad dang 'di dag nyid kyi las// /thub pa rnams kyis bstan pa 'dzin nga/'i sngags pa de nyid yin/ /de las nyin re'ang bsod nams phung po mtha' yas 'gyur/ /zla ba brgyad dam gsum mam 37— bye23

—byedabyed———byed———— —— byed—— —byedagacig na rtags mthong blo mchog 'gyur/ /tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los sgyur 1sogs mgos gtugs 2phyag 'tshal dang / /smin mtshams nas 'thon nyi zla skar tshogs rnam par 'phro ba dang / /seng ge glang chen sha ra ṇa gzhon phyogs bcur rgyug pa nyid/ /'od kyis lus thob 4bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun srin lag ste nas 'bab pa'o/ /yang na rkang gnyis lha dang klu dbang gis bteg mkha' la 'gro / /po ta la dang dga' ldan bde ldan gnas sogs phyin pa dang / /rin chen gzhal med sgo stong bye ba nas zhugs te stong gnas/ /mgon po nyid phyag glang chen sna ltas bdag gi spyi bor reg pa'o/ /'di dag 'thong nas blo ldan snyems med je tshom med pa dang / /brtson 'grus 5lhag bskyed be+er yang ji skad bshad pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /spyor ba lhag mos nyin re lan gsum sgom 6par byed na ni/ /mi de myur du spyan ras gzigs kyi blo gros dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /dpal khabe+e pā ṇa'i 7sgu gsum gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// //༄za/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 8mkha' spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i spyod yul te/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /srid las ring gyur shin tu 'phags pa'i sgur bstan pa/ /zla ba ltar dkar ye shes thugs kyi pad+mo las/ /legs 'khrungs phyogs char dbyangs can nor rgyun rdo rje phag /sgol ma rnam bzhi'i cod pan rin chen gyis btud rgyal/ /mtha' dang stong nyid chen po yi/ /rnal 'byor snying rje mchog gi ngang / /skye ba med las skye ba'i dngos/ /'phags pa thugs rje che bsgom bya/ /tā la bdun srid nam mkha' yi/ /ngos la sna tshogs 27—52/

—byed — byedabyed——— ———pad zla'i steng / /bdag nyid rnam par shes kyi hrīḥ/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub 1byed blta'o/ /rim gyis pad+mo dkar nyid dang / /de gyur pas ni mgon po nyid//g.yon zhabs 'khor los zla dbus mnan/ /g.yas zhabs gyen du cher bskyod pa'o / /phyag g.yas pad+mo mdzes lcug sdug /'dab stong rnam par bye ba yi/ /sdong bu'i lcug ma 'khyud skyogs kyis/ /zhabs g.yas mkhrig ma 2bteg bsnams la / /'bar ba'i rin chen lhag ge ba'i/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan / /bde chen rnam par mi rtog dang / /sbyin dang mi 'jigs rgyur bcas pa'o/ /dzaḥ4hūṃ baṃ hoḥtrīḥ5/ 'di dag rang dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /don bsgrubs 'od zer bsdu ba yi/ /sbyor bas shar la sogs pa yi/ /phyogs bzhi por ni lha mo bzhi/ /gangs ri ltar dkar blo bzangs 7'od mdzad ral gri pu ste g.yas dang g.yon/ /gser bzangs ltar ser nor mang yid 'ong nor bu snye ma 'dzin pa dang / /bye ru ltar dmar 'od mdzad gri gug mi mgo phyed khrag bkang / /in+d+ra'i mdog ljang gzhon nu sgeg mo skyabs sbyin ut+pal legs bsnams pa'o / /de rjes ye shes dgug pa yi/ /cho ga mchod rgyas khyad par bzhis/ /mchod byas gus pa gsol ba yi/ /sngags brjod de nas sngags bzla'o/ /rjes mthun phrin las lnga po yis/ /mkha' khyab don kun bsgrubs nas ni/ /'od zer lcags kyus 'jeg rten kun/ /gyen du spar ba'e rnal 'argyar bya/ /yang ne+e phyogs bsdu dngos grub bslang / /the tshom med bcas phrin las bzhi/ /lha bzhi rang gi rigs bzhin du/ /mkhas pas rjes su gzhug par bya/ /thugs rje chen po mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //

— — byed—— — ———byedabyedabyed༄7/ /thugs rje chen po mkha' spyod yul can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas / nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dri ma 1med/ /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar bsod nams brgya yi pha rol phyin/ /snang dang mi snang dmigs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyod yul las dbe+en gcig min du ma'i tshul/ /bde chen nam mkha' dri med thub la 'dud/ /dmigs pa bye ba stong phrag mang po dang / /gang zhig bdag tu lta ba mi bzad pas/ /blo gros 'chal ba don ma mthong ba rnams/ /gnas 'dir nam mkha' dri med bsgom par bya/ /yul dang dus dang rang bzhin gang / /ji lta ji tsam ci zhig ni/ /de na de tshe de nyid des/ /de ltar de tsam de rnged nyid/ /blo gros sbyangs pa rnam kun du/ /chos kun dmigs pa med shes pa/ /de ni yang dag lha mchog mthong / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /dīḥgazhan ni cig shos blo can de/ /sprin bral gsal ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /zla ba'i mdog can pad+ma'i phyag /rjes su skye dang gzhig par bya/ /dag pa'i nam mkha' ngo bo nyid/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas gzhan gyur te/ /rjes su gzhig pas de stong 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin thob rdo rje'i blo/ /mthong bas grub dang gzhig 3pa na/ /med ces rnam par rtog par zad / /rtog pa de yang dmigs su med/ /byas pas brtags te gsum spyad pa / /mkhas pas de nyid gcig mi dmegs/ /gdad nas ma skyes bskyed pa'i rim/ /nam yang mi 'jig rjes su gzhig /de ltar 'khor gsum bzhi gsum gyis/ /dmigs bral grub par mi 'gyur na/ /de tshe med dang yod pa dang / /byung ba zhig pa'ang gang zhig yin/ /rnal 'byor zab mo nam mkha' yi / /spyod yul nam mkha'i spyor ba yis/ /dmigs pas phung bar gyur 37———bye26

rnams la/ /dmigs med ston pa ngo mtshar yin/ /nam mkha' dri med kyi sgrub thabs sdogs so// //snga / /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ nam mkha'i mdzod ni brnyes 1pas te/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug lha dang mi yi gtso/ /bsod nams ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ /mthar phyin gter phyin 2nam mkha' mdzod brnyes pa/ /'jig rten mgon la 4btud de de 5bsnyen brjod/ /sngags 'chang bdag don gzhan don thams cad du/ /me 'obs 'bar ba bsil khang nyams dga' ltar/ /shes nas mi chags chags chen rnal 'byor spyod/ /mtha' yas nam mkha'i mdzod gter rgyal bas gsungs/ /phun tshogs tshal lam yang na dbul po 'am/ /yang na dgon dbe+en yid dga'i gnas rnams su/ / shin tu snye gos gyon me tog maṇ+ḍal byas/ /gdung ba spangs pas mgon po dran par bya/ /pad+mo zla steng rin chen bum bzang dang / /'dab stong u dum bā ra'i ge sar rtse/ /mnyam med sa gsum kha lo bsgyur 8mdzad pa/ /chos rgyas/ 9gser mdog 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /dhīḥlas skyes pa'i gzhon nu blta na snyug pa yid bzhin 7gyi shing la sku brten pa/ g.yon na pad+mo 'dzin cing g.yas kyis nor rnams thams cad sbyin par mdzad pa dang / phyogs gcig na 'phags pa nor 'phel rnga yab thogs nas nor kyi rgyun 'be+ebs pa dang / phyogs gcig na lha mo nor sbyin ma ril ba 'dzin pa nor bu dmar po'i phreng bas brgyan pa ste /'di dag ni btsun pa spyan ras gzigs nam mkha'i mdzod brnyes pa'i bden pa'i 37—527

byin rlabs kyi 1rnam par 'phrul pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /'di ni bsgom par bya ba'i gnas/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba sel byed pa/ /bsod nams sprin chen gsal ba'i rgyu/ /gsang sngags char chen nor sbyin gzhan/ /snying brtse dga' dang yid gzhungs pas/ /don chen byed pa rig sngags che/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas gzungs dang ni/ /sprin chen mdzod kyi rtog pa'o/ /ji skad bstan pa'i snying po bzhi/ /nus 2gnyis ldan pa sngon 'gro bas/ /'bum phrag lngar ni bzlas nas su/ /ci yod lam chen gnas su sbyin/ /shin tu phan 'dod gdung ba yis/ /mgon po la ni mchod pa dang / /rang gi 'tsho ba ma gtogs par4/ /thams cad yongs su mi gzung ngo / /de ltar chog shes gzhan dbang g.yo/ /som nyi spangs dang yang med de5/ /de ni nyin re sbyin na yang / /'byor pas gtugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /thugs rje chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ / 'phags pa 6spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gabyug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ nam mkha' kun khyab bcu gcig zhal/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub 7thabs bshad par bya'o/ /zla ba 'brug sgra nam mkha' ltar rmad pa/ /sgu gsung thugs zab stobs bcu'e pha rol phyen/ /sna tshogs sprul pas dpag med don sgrub pa'i/ /mgon 8la btud de bsnyen pa 9bdag gis bshad / /re zhig rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su gnas dang yo byad dang gos dang rgyan nye bar bsags pa a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la rang gi sems dro ba rnams kyi bzhi pa me'i bu la brten nga/ nga ro bzhi pas mnan cing 27—528

—gzhon nu ma'i nu mas brgyan pa can blta bar bya'o/ /de las 1'od phyung rol mo'i sgras/ /blo gros mi zad 2bcu gcig zhal/ /spyan brangs lus btud phyag 'tshal zhing / /mchod pa lngas ni yang dag mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ4hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe āḥt+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gabye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e be+e bye āḥhūṃ/ de nas sdig pa bsal la sogs/ /yan lag bzang po spyod kun gyis/ /dri ma dag par byas nas su/ /gnas bzhi las ni sems mchog bskyed / /chos kun rang bzhin mtshan ma med/ /gdod nas ma skyes mi 'gro ba / /bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /mkhas pas khong 7na mngon du bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥ sarba dharmāḥ9swa bhā ba bi shusgopho⑩haṃ/ gang zhig kun rtog mtshan nyid med/ /de ni bdag sems 'od gsal nyid/ /'gro 'ong gnas dang rten bral ba/ /da ni sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzhin/ /oṃ swa tsit+ta shu n+ya tā badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho haṃ/ stong pa nyid sems sgyu ma'i tshul/ /sprul pa'i mdzad pa kun sgrub phyir/ /skye ba med las skye ba'i dngos/ /pad+mo zla dbus 'phags mchog bskyed / /thugs rje'i snying po las byung ba/ /spro dang bsdu dang sdig sel ba'i//mtshan ma rgyal ba sdug bsngal gcod / /bcu gcig zhal mnga' rnam par bsgom/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar zhing / /bgrang phreng pad+mo g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /ril pa mchog sbyin 'khor lo dang / /rda rje mda' gzhu 'dzin par brtag /ti se'i gangs dang ston zla sos ka'i nyi 'od can/ /mu tig gser sogs ji snyed rgyan mang kun mnga' ba/ / zhal ni ཿbcu sa/cig nor bu me mdog ske rags can//ri dwags lpags ྾'dzin 'dzum zhal gzi brjid 'bar ba'o/ /de nas snying po'i sa bon gyis spyan drangs nas sgu gsung thugs legs par gnas pas dbang bskur 37—bye29

—byedababe+e mthar thug pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /skyo bar gyur na sngags bzlas pas 'khor lo dgye ba'i spyor ba brtsam par bya ste2/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru / ir+bhe bibye / tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su 4ma ba re / i li mi li/ tsi te dz+wa la ma pa na 5ye swā hā/ zhes bya bas so/ /gal te blo zhan rtul 6mi phod/ /zhal lnga phyag brgyad zhal gsum dang / /phyag drug de bzhin zhal gcig dang / /phyag gnyis pa yang bsgom par bya/ /spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig pa'i zhal can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //byed/ /bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs ye shes 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ dpal ldan ye shes dkyil 'khor bdag /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'dzum bcas dbus bzhugs zla ba'i zhal mang 'a dpal chen don yod zhags pa 'char ka'i mdog /bdud 'joms rta mchog me lce'i kha dog khros ma dung mdog skar ma'i 'od ldan bye ku ṭīsnye / /lcags kyu (nags pa lcags sgrog dril 'dzin nyi shu dang ni bcu drug mchod pa'i lha mos brgyan / /mnyam med ye shes 'khor lo che la spyi bos gtugs btud sa 'di de ring bkra shis gyur/ /dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par 'phrul pa las sku gsung thugs nye bar bkod pa'e bcom ldan 'das sbyan/ ras gzigs 'khor lo dang bcas pa bsgrub par 'dod pas/ thog mar snying rje chen po goms par bya'o/ /yid dang rjes mthun la sogs gnas/ /byang chub mchog zhugs sems bzung 8bas/ /snying gi 'od kyis rten bkug la/ /bso/da nams phung po yongs rdzogs bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudzhaḥ9sarba dharmāḥ—swa bhā ba 27——530

—shusgolharkahaṃ / chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /rang gi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /mkha' ltar mnyam par bzhag nas ni/ /de nas bdag lus dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /lus gang yin de gzhal med khang 2/ /sems 'dir lha yi bdag nyid de/ /sngags pa'i ngag ni sngags yin la/ /kun ni dri ma gred rtog spangs / /dhīḥpad+mo bzhi dbus 'jig rten mgon/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dang g.yon/ /mchog spyin pad+mo 'dzin dkar zhing / /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin no/ /haḥ/ shar gyi 'dab mar don yod zhags/ /phyag bzhi zhags pa lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje phreng thogs rab zhi dmar/ /me long ye shes bdag nyid do/ /hūṃ/ lho yi 'dab mar rta mchog zhal/ /phyag bzhi dbyig pa 'khor lo dang / /sdigs mdzub pad+ma 'chang khros pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes bdag nyid do/ /pha/ nub kyi 'dab mar ral pa gcig /phyag bzhi gri gug thod pa dang / /ral gri ut+pal bsnams rngam nag4 /kun rtog ye shes ngo bo'o//ṭa / byang gi 'dab mar khro gnyer can/ /phyag bzhi dbyig pa phreng ba dang / /pad+ma ril ba ldan khro skya/ /don grub ye shes dngos nyid do/ /a ā i yī u spru ṛ dṛ rba lho 5e me+e o au saṃ aḥpi wang gling bu rdza rnga rnga zlum bzhad ma dang /sgeg mo glu ma gar ma me tog bdug spos ma/ /mar me dri dang gzugs ma ro ma reg ma dang / /chos ldan lha rma bcu drug rgyan spud khyams bzher dgod/ /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bhā ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pha pha ba bha ma / ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣaḥ7/ gtor ma la sogs sprin 'dzin par / /sum cu nye ba'i mchod pa yi/ /lha mo'ang de bzhin khyams kyi mthar/ /mkhas pas de bzhin dgod par bya/ /dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ9/ lcags kyu dkar dang 37—bye3/

zhags pa ser/ lcags sgrog dmar po dril bu ljang / /shar la sogs nga/'i sgo bzhi ni/ /gtso bo las phyung rim bzhin bzhugs/ /de'i 'og tu dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bkod pa la/ ye shes pa rtabacug nas nam mkha' ji snyed pa'i sems can la phan par 'dod pas/ rang rang dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'od kyi phreng ba spyo zhing don gnyis byug car sgrub pa'i sems kyis sngags brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥdīḥn maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te ma hā kā ru ṇi mūrta ye hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ twe4ཿtre+e lo kya bi dza 5ya/ a mo gha pā sha ya/ a pra ti ha ta tweḥha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / don yod zhags pa'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā dzā haṃ khā da rja dze+e sā dā 6ya swā hā/ rta mgrin gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ e ka dza 7ṭi ma hā ro ṣa ṇi tā sa ma ye /pra sa ma na hūṃ t+t+waṃ 7phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ral gcig ma'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 1 māṃ/ sarba bha ba san+t+ra ra na hūṃ phaṭa pa tā ya swā hā/ khro gnyer can gyi snying po'o/ /spyos pas ting 'dzin ngal ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gcig dri ma med/ /lha dang sngags sogs rnam grol ba/ /ye shes mchog la mnyam gnas bya / /rtse gcig pa yis rnam par 'byed/ /bkram pa dang ni sdud pa dang / /rjes 'gro lhan cig spyod pa yi/ /rim pas rdzogs par shes par bya/ /de ltar bsam gtan la sems rton pa'i rnal 'byor pa stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen pos yongs su zin pa'i cho ga ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar de srid du yongs su bsgoms nas/ ldang bar 'dod pa na/ bkug pa dang bskyed pa'i 'khor lo gshegs par bya ba dang / dmigs pa thim pa'i man ngag gis bzod par gsol ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gzhan du ma gyur par yongs su bsngo 37—5 32

bar bya'o/ /dpal ldan ye shes 'khor lo mchog gi ni/ /gnas mthong bla ma'i zhal gyi drin thob nas/ /ji bzhin mdor bsdus sgrub thabs 'di bris pas/ /skyes 1kun thugs rje che mnga'i zhal mthong shog /dpal khad+ma pā ṇa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ yid bzhin nor bu dkyil 'khor 'khor lo che4/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /kho na nyid thugs gsung dang sgu/ /yon tan phrin las dam tshig bcas/ /dpal ldan dkyil 'khor cher btud de/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /bdag nyid chen pos phun tshogs bzhir5 / /chos kun rang bzhin nyid dran pas/ /snying rje las grub drang srong bskyed / /dhīḥyig la gnas ting 'dzin sgrub6/ /ye shes rgyal ba bcu gnas su / /nyid kyi snying po las spros pas/ /lhar bcas gzhal yas khang bsams te / /mar me las ni — mar me ltar/ /ha dīḥhūṃ phaṭa/ 'dab brgyad shar sogs phyogs bzhi la/ /don yod zhags sogs bzhi yin te/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa bzang bzhi gnas/ /'di ni ye shes 'khor lo'o/ / dhīḥmai hūṃ tweḥ / de las 'khor lo gzhan 'byung ba/ /'jam dbyangs byams pa rdo rje 'dzin / /gnod mdzes phyogs rtsibs bzhi las te/ /dzaḥ/ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ /dbyangs can la sogs yum mtshams bzhir/ /a i u ṛ t+pa e o saṃ de mthar rtsibs brgyad sems ma brgyad/ /ā yī spru dṛ lho i au aḥ/ de bzhin de mthar sems dpa' brgyad/ /rtsibs brgyad la gnas thugs gsung sgu/ /37— 533

byed——brgyad gsum 'khor lo rim gyis mdzes/ /aḥrnam dag yon tan rtsibs stong ldan / /'khor lo 'bar ba gzhan 'byung ba'ang / /bskal 1bzang sangs rgyas stong gis brgyan/ /a stong las skyes rim bzhin dgod/ /hūṃ/ de dag las kyang 'khor lo gzhan/ /rtsibs stong las t+t+waṃ stong las skyes/ /lnga brgya lnga brgya rgyal sras mdzad/ /phrin las 'khor lo zhes bshad do/ /dzaḥ2hūṃ baṃ hoḥ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags sogs bzhi/ /khyams rnams su ni mchod pa'i lha/ /khor yug dur khrod kun rdzogs ldan/ /dam tshig 'khor lo zhes byar grags/ /de rjes dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /ye shes ri mchog las bkug gzhug /me long gnyis gzugs brag ca dang / /mkha' 'drar dag pa rtogs par bya/ /ji srid gnyis med mnyam 'jog pa/ /de srid de yod mi 'gal ba'am/ /yang na ro gabyug bsam gtan gnas/ /skyo bar gyur na gsang sngags bzlas/ /oṃ āḥ4dhīḥbadz+ra dz+nyā na shirnya ma ṇi rat+na maṇ+ḍal tsakra pri 5 ti spru ti hūṃ sarba budhe ta 6tā gasgo kā ya wa kā tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sa ma ya pra sid+dhi hūṃ/ sarba ta thā ga to dz+nyā na gasgo bi shudha badz+ra ta tā a byebye na/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ spa ra spa ra/ sarba —pā pa bhek+ka rgo/ da ha da ha/ ha ra ha ra/ shān+ta ka ra ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs kun snying po 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po kun mnyes byed/ /dad dang snying brtse bden stobs mthus/ /ma lus thugs bsgul 'od 'asba 'gyur//rang rang rjes mthun don bsgrubs nas/ /sa gsum mgon po'i sras gyur te/ /bsam gtan rgyun gcig la gnas mthar/ /dngos po kun mchod sabazod par gsol / /de rjes byang chub sems ldan rka pas/ /thal sbyar yi dam gsum blangs la/ /dngos grub don du gsol btab ste / /bde bar spyod yul 37—03 /

—byed— — ———— — — — — ————— — ——————zhe— ——byed—— —gshegs par bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i dkyil 'khor che/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po bla na med/ /ma lus kun don sgrub /byed nga// /'dir basbus myur bdag gter chen gyur/ /spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs sdogs ra/ / / //༄7/ /'phags/ pa spyan ras gzigs po ta la ke ri'i rtse mo pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ ri mchog dkyil 'khor rgyal po khyod/ /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs bshad par bya'o/ /thugs rje yi stobs ri mchog rtser/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid ston/ /'jig rten gsum mgon la btud de/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor basbus bri/ /dang por re zhig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis yid nye bar brlan nga/ra byas la/ bsam gtan gyi khang bu la sogs pa'i gnas mal 4 gang yin pa po ta la ke ri'i rgyal por byen gyis brlabs te/ der gzhal med khang rin chen 6sna bdun gyi rang bzhin bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bkod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mngon par blta bar bya'o/ /dhīḥ/'dam skyes sdong bu 'dab brgyad dbus/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug bskyed / /de ni zla mdog skyil krung phyed/ /mchog sbyin pad+ma ཿ 'dzen pa'o/ /a i u e/ shar sogs phyogs dang mtshams rim bzhin/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+mo las/ /phyogs kyi kha dog gzhon nu'i tshul/ /gter chen bum pa bzhis gang ba'o/ /ā yī spru me+e/ de mthar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /phyogs mi phyogs kyi kha dog can / /gti mug rdo rje sgrol ma can/ /bag 37— 53pya

— byed— — —— — — ———— byed————— ——byedabyedachags rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags rdo rje zhags pa thogs/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ral gri bsnams/ /o au saṃ aḥ/ byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi 1yum/ /brtan pa'i rdo rje ri rab 'dzin/ /spyor ba'i rdo rje zla ba dang / /'bar ba'i rdo rje nyi ma can/ /stobs kyi rdo rje ba dan thogs/ /kha dog phyed gzugs sgeg mo'i tshul/ /ka tsa ṭa ta/ khyams kyi shar sogs phyogs bzhir yang / /phyogs mdog gar gyis rol pa mo/ /rdo rje gzugs mdzes/ me long can/ /rdo rje sgra snyan pi wang bsgreng 2/ /rdo rje dri mchog byug pa thogs/ /rdo rje ro bzangs zhal zas 'dzin/ /pa ya sha k+ṣaḥ/ de bzhin byang shar sogs grwa bzhir/ /rdo rje reg ma gos mchog thogs/ /rdo rje chos ma chos 'byung can/ /rdo rje zhing ma maṇ+ḍal 'dzin/ /rdo rje snang ma sgon ma thogs/ /yid 'ong phyogs phyed mdog can la'o/ / ṛ dṛ '-i shā / de nas shar sogs sgo bzhir yang / /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /phyogs mdog cung zad khro ba'i tshul/ /de ltar kun phyag g.yon pad+mo/ /brtson pa'i cha byad pad zla la4/ /rang gi sa bon las gyur mtshungs/ /de rjes sgyu ma ting 'dzin la5/ /gnas nas dag pa rtogs par bya/ /gnas dang lus rab rnam par dag /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes byar brjod/ /de bzhin lus dang sems rab dag /nyi shu lnga yi bdag nyid do/ /dze dze dze dze/ de nas ye shes dkyel 'khor lha/ /ji bzhin bkug la mchod sogs bcas/ /gsol btab dam tshig mthu bskyed de/ /rig pa'i ting 'dzin ldan pas bzlas/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥpo ta la ke ru tu ma hā kā ru ṭī — ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ a i u e/ ā spyi ༷/ i/ o 65 i aḥka tsa ṭa ta/ pa ya sha k+ṣa ཿ / ṛ dṛ lo shā / hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gal te dmigs pa'i spyor ba yis/ /37—bye36

byed byedabyedaskyo bar gyur na sbyor bral ba/ /shin tu dmigs med zhi ba'i rgyu/ /mkhas/ pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /nam zhig de las ldang 'dod tshe/ /snying rje chen pos blo bskyed la/ /dpal ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag /dkyil 'khor mchod sogs bya phyir 'bad/ /bdun phrag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum/ /ji ste brgya'am bdun phrag bcus/ /dam tshig bsam gtan ldan spyod la/ /dngos grub the tshom mi bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyud dang ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas 'drar bshad de/ /rgyud bral bla ma spangs nga/ la/ /dngos grub yod par ma gsungs phyir/ /mtshan ma tsam mthong bdag gis 'dir/ /bla ma'i gsung gi 1rgyud don bsdus/ /dge 'dis 'gro kun po ta la'i/ /ri mchog nam zhig bgrod 2par 'gyur/ /dpal thugs rje chen po po ta la ke ri'i rtse mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄za/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po 'khor los sgyur 4ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dkyil 'khor ston/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'khor los 6sgyur rgyal 'jig rten mgon/ /dpal ldan ye shes dkyil 'khor che/ /don kun grub byed brtag pa'o/ /rgyu skar rgyal po rgyal la bab pa 'am yang na zla ba tshes dang zla ba nya/ /sna tshogs me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa'i tshe/ /skal bzang rnams kyis mgon mchod sdig pa bsal/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rgyan gyis spras / /sna tshogs dri bsung ngad ldan pa'i/ /me tog gcal bkram lhab lcub can / /mchod rdzas yo byad sprin gtibs nas/ /stobs chen sngon 'gro nyi ma 27——537

— — — — — — — —— — ———— ——byed— — — ——— — ———byedabyedabyedadang ngo/ bum pa dang ni lha/ /lhag par gnas byas gnyis pa ting 'dzin rgyal po la gnas bzlas// /gsum pa 1mchod sbyin go rims nus sbyar bzod par gsol/ /de mthar bkra shis rdo rje chus bkrus dngos grub blang bar bya/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du/ /mkhas nga/sa dkyil 'khor bris nas/ su/ /rdo rje 'khor lo phyag rgya yis/ /lha dgu 'khor los sgyur 2 bar bsam/ /lte ba 'dam skyes ge sar 'khrungs / /rdo rjes/ mtshon pa dpal 4 chen nyid/ /shar sogs rin chen rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo rnam bdun gter chen bcas lha mo/ /khyams bzang 5rab mnyam bai ḍūr+ya yi ‘ngos la nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod pa yi/ /lha mo rnams dang de bzhin sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa sogs dges rol pa'o/ /mu khyud khor 8yu ga bkra shis kyi/ /rdzas bcu grub pa nyi shus bskor/ /dpal / med lha rdzas yo byad kyis/ /shin tu phun tshogs brtse ba yin/ /oṃ āḥ dhīḥtsakra warti maṇ+ḍa la sid+dhi phaṭa swā hā/ shes rab thabs byung skad cig spyor bas bdag nyid 'khor los sgyur rgyal gsal bskyed la/ /snying po las/ 'phros/ lcags kyu'i zer gyis ji bzhin nyid bkug mnyes byas dbyer rnged gzhug /bdag dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas bzlas rdo rje phreng rgyun yi ge rab zhugs pas/ /bum pa bzang bkang thun mtshams kun rtag mnyam gzhag che gnas dngos kun mchod brtsan bya/ /thugs rje chen po can dpal 'khor los 1 sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /dpal thugs rje chen po lus kyi 'khor lo chen bo la phyag 'tshal lo//'jig rten mgon gyi man ngag ṅgas/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po rang gi lus/ /37— 538

byed ——byed—byed—— ———byed ——byed— ————pad+ma 'khor los 1brgyan gzhal med/ /sems kyis 2lha bcu gcig bcas bsgom/ /rtsi yis lcags gong gser bzhin du/ /phung po ye shes spyod yul bsgyur/ /de dbus snying gi 'dab bzhi dang / /yan lag drug rtsibs mkhas pas bsgom/ /dīḥ / kun gzhi rnam dag thon gyis grub/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gangs ri'i mdog /ting 'dzin mchog gis mnyam gzhag pa/ /bag chags ma lus bcom pa'o/ /t+t+waṃ/ gti mug rnam dag rnam mi rtog /gti mug rdo rje nam mkha'i mdog /dus gsum bde gshegs chos ston pa/ /thabs po ma lus gtan bcom pa'o/ /oṃ/ 'dod chags rnam dag bde ba che/ /'dod chags rdo rje zla ba'i mdog /rdo rje dril bu bsnol 'dzin nga// /gdung ba ma 'u/sa gtan bcom pa'o/ /dhī tsho/ zhe sdang rnam dag 'od gsal ba/ /zhe sdang rdo rje me lce'i mdog /'bar ba'i phyag rgya sdigs mdzub bsgyings/ /'khrug pa ma lus gtan bcom pa'o/ /āḥ/ kun rtog rnam dag gya gyu med/ /kun rtog rdo rje in+d+ra'i mdog /'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam par rol/ /'du byed ma lus gtan bcom pa'o/ /'di dag ni dbus nas brtsams/ te shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma bzhi'i ge sar la bsgom ༷par bya'o/ /de nas 'gro ba drug gi rnam par dag pa dgod par bya ste/ lha rigs rnam dag 'chi 'pho med/ /dbang po rdo rje gur kum mdag /me tog phreng ba' chun po 'dzin/ /dregs pa ma lus spangs pa'o/ /a/ lha min rnam dag 'khrug pa med/ /drag po rdo rje rgya skyegs mdog /ral gri dang ni 'khor lo 'dzin/ /phrag dog ma lus kun spangs pa'o/ /i/ mi dbang rnam dag brel phongs 1 med/ /dbang phyug rdo rje dza gsar mdog /rdo rje dang ni dril bu 'dzin/ /rnam par g.yengs pa kun 27—— )39

spangs pa'o/ /u/ dud 'gro rnam dag blun rmongs med/ /seng ge rdo rje du ba'i mdog /dgra sta dang ni dbyig pa 'dzin/ /bag med btul ba kun spangs pa'o/ /e/ yi dwags rnam dag ser sna med/ /gshin rje rdo rje char sprin mdog /thod pa dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /'jungs pa'i srid pa kun spangs pa'o/ /o1/ dmyal ba rnam dag tsha grang med/ /'jigs skyob rdo rje byi ru'i mdog /bum pa dang ni lhung bzed 'dzin/ /mi bzad yang kun spangs pa'o/ /saṃ/ 'di dag ni mgo nas brtsams te g.yas la sogs pa'i rtsibs drug gi lte bar bsgom par bya'o2/ /dam tshig lus dang sems la ni/ /ye shes sku dang thugs bcug nas/ /sa bon gsung gi yi ge bzlas/ /tshe 'di nyid la mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /thugs rje chen po lus kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dka' thub can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ dka' thub chen po dka' thub mnyes/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dad pa thob pa'i skye bo sran thub pa rnams kyis/ dus dang cho ga'i khyad par la ma ltos par shin tu myur du 'gro ba bskyab par 'dod pas/ zhag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam bdun gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das drang srong chen po dka' 'thub yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bas bsgrub par bya'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug drang srong che/ /mya ngan med pa'i sdong bu'i 'gram/ /ri dwags stan can dka' thub tshal/ /rgyan spangs snying rjes gdungs pa bsgom/ /mgon 37—5/0

byed —byed—— ——byedabyed byedapo'i rten ni gang yang rung / /ye shes ldan de der bcug mdun/ /phongs pa dag ni mya ngan gyi/ /cha byad kyis smad khas phub 'dug /lag pa gnyis ni 'gram brten cing / /mi ro bzhin du rkang brkyang ba/ /bza' btung spangs dang gos bral dang / /mchi mas gdong khebs smre sngags brjod/ /spyod lam gnyis te 'gre ldog dang / /ring du zag pa dor ba'o/ /de bzhin ngag gnyis smre sngags bsngags/ /sems pa yang ni gnyis nyid de/ /snying rjes skye bo bsgral ba dang / /thabs su 'phags pa mthong 'dod pa'o/ /ji ste smra ba la mngon par dga' ba zhig na sngags kyi dam tshig 1 kyang brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥ shrī lo kya nā thā ya/ bo bye satwa ma hā satwa ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya / mā ma ta mu ke ma hā duḥkha kle sha sarba ā 4ba ra ṇa 5kha se kha se me kha se me phaṭa phaṭa/ ma ma shī s+ho a nu gra ha a nu gra ha hūṃ hūṃ/ yid la byed pa gzhan btang ste/ /lha mchog sems pa gcig pu yis/ /skye bo nyon mongs gzir 'di dag /zhi bar bya phyir smyung bar gnas/ /yu/na ring phan pa'i don mthong nas/ /cung zad bde ba ci dgar rung / /sems can tshogs mang don du ni/ /bdag gis dka' thub bzod par byos/ /bag rka med lus dang sems 'di ni/ /gnod par byed kyis phan mi byed/ /de ring dka' thub spyad pa yis/ /lus can kun kyi don sgrub po/ /je ltar dgra bo khros pa la'ang thal sbyar snying rje gye 'gyur na/ /thugs rje che mnga' 'gro don sdod/ /bdag la ji ltar gzigs mi 'gyur/ /de ltar bstan pa bzod ldan pas/ /nyin 'ga' smyung bar spyod na de/ /dngos dang gzugs brnyan rmi lam du/ /'phags pas nges par rjes su 'dzin/ /thugs rje chen po dka' thub can 37— du / /

———————————————————————— —————byedakyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rtag pa'i rnal 'byor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ spyi gtsug cod pan rtag tu 'dzin/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'jig rten mgon po 'jig rten gyi/ /rtsa lag gcig pu la btud de/ /de snying cod pan gtsug tor gyi/ /rnal 'byor cho ga bdag gis bshad/ /dben pa'i gnas 'dug 'khor ba'i me 'obs 'bar ba dang / /bde ba'i rkyen tshogs yid skyo mngon dga' drag po yis/ /thar pa'i grong khyer rdul bral skyed mos tshal/ bzangs su / /zhugs nas rjes 'jug dang ba dam pas sems dul bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor zhi ba 'dis/ /blo ldan rgyud rab brlan gyur pa/ /de nyid rjes thogs dpal gsum gyi/ /cho ga dam pa bsgom par bya/ /e ma'o spyi gtsug rin chen khang / /bkra shis mchod rten dri ma rnged/ /thub pa stong gis spras pa'i sgo/ /mgon po nyid kyis dbus mdzes pa'o / /'dam byes dmar 'dab stong gi snying / /a stong de dbus sems yig hūṃ/ /'od gsal dkar 'khye'/ rnam par 'phro/ /bum pa'i mar me 'bar ba bzhin/ /de bzhin lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /nyi ma'am zla ba la gnas nga/'e / /rlung be rgyal po me yi dbus/ /bde ba'i chus brlan mkhregs pa'i sa//rnam dag rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyu/ /'byung bzhi'i rang bzhin ram̐ yig bsam/ /de las 'od 'phros tsha reg 'dis/ /rtsa mchog 'dis brgyud skyob pa yis/ /thugs reg thugs bskul thugs byung ba'i/ /byin brlabs zhi byed dag byed dang //dri ma med byed 'od 'phro byed/ /rnam bzhi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbab bya/ /gang

— ——byedabyed— —tshe ye shes mchog 'di babs gyur pa/ /de tshe mi g.yo 'od gsal rnam par dag /kun 'byung mtsho chen nyi 1'od sgron mchog dang / /nam mkha'i yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin no/ /bde chen gnyis su med nyid la/ /ji srid bzod par nus re srid/ /mnyam par gzhag bya mi gnas na/ /de tshe dge tshogs dpag med bsgrub/ /dpal thugs rje chen po rtag tu bya ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs so// //༄za/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bla ma'i rnam par snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bla ma 'gro ba'i dges/ /2zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /srid dang zhi ba 'di dang de bzhin tshe rabs gzhan pa'i bde legs dang / /dngos grub mchog bsgrub yid bzhin nor 'dra phyogs bcu dus gsum gshegs pa yi/ /bla ma rnams kyis bsgrub pa'i snying dbus dri med ye shes mchog gzhug phyir/ /spyi gtsug gdan la nyin mtshan rgyun du brtan bzhugs byin rlabs 4mdzod / /5sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rab skems shing / /bde chen snying dkyil sad mdzad pa/ /skal ldan ston pa rdo rje can/ /bla mar 7btud de de bsnyen bshad/ /re zhig sgrub pa pos skyabs su 'gro ba dang /sems bskyed pa rab tu nges par byas nas/ dus gsum kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma dam pa kho na yin no zhes rtse gcig tu rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ kun nas dad pa'i rlan phun sum tshogs pa las byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i ljon pa legs par bskyed de/ yid dang rjes mthun la sogs sam/ /ci rigs pa yi gnas su ni/ /dad ldan rnams kyis 8dngos 37—pya 43

byed————grub rtsa/ /dpal ldan bla ma bsgrub par bya/ /tha mal lus kyi cod pan rtser/ /rgyal po rdo rje 'dze+en dbang po/ /longs spyod rdzogs sgu gsal bar blta/ /de yi thugs ni ye shes hūṃ/ /snying gi pad+mo 'dab stong dbus/ /bdag gi skyob pa mi dbang pos/ /gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /skyil krung 'dzum zhal bsgom par bya/ /'dab stong lce la sangs rgyas stong / /ze 'bru khyud skor nyan thos dang / /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ /mkha' la zla dkar ltar gsal sprul/ /de'i rjes la spyi bo'i gtsug gi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs ka'i thad so nas mdun du 'dom gang mngon par gzhal ba'i nam mkha' la rang gi rjes su 'dzin pa'i yi dam gyi lha bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i thugs ni rang gi sa bon no/ /oṃ gyis sna drangs pa'i ā li dang / āḥ sa sna drangs 4pa'i kā li dang / hūṃ gis sna drangs 5pa'i lha'i sngags rnams phreng ba'i tshul du gshibs pas mtha' bskor ba'o/ /de nas bdun rnam par dag pas mchod la/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis lhos pa 6nye bar dor ba'i sgo nas skyabs su gzung zhing 'di ltar mthong ba'i 'khor lo'i 'jigs pas skrag pa la sogs pas rten la mi phyed pa'i dad nga/ drag po dang / 'dun pa dang / mngon par dga' ba dang / yang dag par mi gtong ba'i blos gsol ba gdab par bya'o / // ji snyed mchod pa rab 'byams nam mkha'i mthas klas sa gsum gang bar gyur pa dang / /bstod dbyangs snyan pa sna tshogs rgyal ba mnyes 'gyur 'gro ba'i don bsgrub dngos gang yin/ /'di dag byas la mi bzad gdung ba yang ni rdo rje 'dzin dang yid kyi lha/ /skyabs mchog nges bya de yis mi gtong thugs rje'i lcags kyus tsham tshom med par 'dzin par bsam/ /de nas lha yi sa bon dang / /yi ge'i phreng ba 37—5//

las byung ba/ /gsal zhing dri med rnon po yi/ /'od zer gyis ni spyi bor dgye//byin gyis brlabs pa 'di yi mthus/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs bskul zhing / /de las thur du lhung ba'i 'od/ /bdag snying bla ma la reg 'gyur/ /de rjes skyob pa las spros zer/ /lha yi thugs kar dang ba yi/ /tsha zer yang ni rab tu spro / /de nas byen brlabs thag gu yi/ /brgyus pa'i ye shes yig phreng dag /lha yi smin mtshams nas byung ba/ /spyi bo'i skyob pa'i tshangs bug nas/ /zhugs gyur thugs gtams 1bdag gi bar/ /de ltar ye shes kyi 'od kyi rgyun babs pas bdag gi rgyud la de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa 'di lta ste/ gnyug ma nyid dang / rang grol ba nyid 2dang / lhun kyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i don gsum gyi lus dang sems rab tu gang ba'i ye shes dam pa gang yin pa mngon du bltas la/yi ge de dang de dag nyid gsal bar bklag pa ma yengs par bya ba ni thabs yin no / /de yis slob dpon sku gang ba/ /lhag gyur rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyo/ /de las de bzhin nyan thos sogs/ /phyi rol srid mthar spro bar bya/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa ma lus pa/ /phrin las bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /'go ba'i don bsgrub brtser bcas pa/ /skal ldan rnams kyi blo gros las/ /mdun gyi spyi bo'i lha la bsdus pa las/ /rtag tu dran pa'i rgya mi brjed pa'i gzungs nye bar gzhag pa yongs su bsam zhing / /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bla ma lha dang bcas pa'i grub pa'i rgyur rnam par 'phang bar bya'o/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po bsgrub pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //snga / /4thugs rje chen po mchod spyin gye dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /37—kye/5

———byedade nas/ gtso bo mchod bya mchod sbyin bzhes/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dpal nyid/ /gtsor bcas sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /dang bas skyabs su song nas ni/ /snying rje chen pos gtor ma sbyin/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor pas/ /lce dang lag pa snod dang bcud/ /gsang sngags rgyal pos byen brlabs la/ /gzi bskyed zab cing rgya ches mchod/ /dhīḥ.āḥt+t+waṃ1/ a ā i yī u spru/ ṛ dṛ lo lbo2/e i/ e au/ saṃ aḥlce byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /a a hūṃ hūṃ/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa shwe ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ lag pa byin gyes brlab pa'o/ /hūṃ ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya ṣa k+ṣaḥ4/ bcud byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ 5baṃ hoḥgazi byin bskyed pa'o/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sat+tha dharmā rde/ ār+ya nut+pan+da tā 6ta bi shudhe swā hā/zab par bsgrub pa'o/ /oṃ āḥdīḥ7sarba ta thā ga to a byejo 8na sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa / mu tra dṛbhā t+t+waṃ/ rgya che bar bsgrub pa'o/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥshrī lo ka nā tha sarba budha bo rnyi satwa sa ka la iṣ+ṭa de ba ta sarba dharmā pā la puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/dī paṃ/ gar+ghaṃ/ be+e be+e bye1 / shap+ta/ maṇ+ḍa la/ ba 1 lo ta/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba gardza pa ri pu bye/ ma ma rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dbul ba dang las bcol ba'i sngags so/ /dpag med 'jig rten mgon 'khor lo/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pas/ /legs bskor 'od zer ljags sbubs kyis / /bdud rtsi'i gtor ma bzhes par 'gyur/ /thugs rje chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// //37—bye 6

༄7/ /thugs rje chen po rnam par skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/dkyil 'khor bzang po dges pa po/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor bzang po 1sa nyid dang / /rin chen rang bzhin ngos mnyam la/ /dri zhim pa yi byug pas byugs / /mu tig me tog nor bu dgod/ /dbus su 'dab brgyad 'dab bzhi yi/ /me tog dmar po sa bon can/ /gzhag la de steng thub pa bzhugs/ /gdugs dkar gyis ni steng nas dbub/ /sgrub po pad+ma'i phreng ba yi/ /nga rgyal 'dzin pas rdo rje lag /gnyis gshibs gyen du bskyod pa'i rgyas/ /sa gsum gtso bo spar bar bya/ /rab tu dbyebs legs kha dog mdzes/ /dri bsung ro mchog reg bzang ba'i/ /me tog spungs pas go rims bzhin/ /gling sogs bkod pa ji bzhin brtag /oṃ āḥ4badz+ra tsa tur dī pa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbardzu 5pa yaṣ+ṭa dī pa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzāṣ+ṭa rat+na hūṃ/oṃ āḥbadzāṣ+ṭa 7mo gā 8la t+t+waṃ/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra sid+dhi bi sha ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ srur+ya tsan+d+ra t+t+waṃ / rnam dag zhing du phun tshogs gling dang rin chen dang / /bkra shis grub pa rim gsum phreng ba legs bkod la/ /gsal byed sgon ma 'bar ba gnyis kyis brgyan gyur pa/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje rol pa'i gar gyis bstabs pas dbul / /de nas lus can thams cad la/ /'jig rten mgon po nyer 'khor gzugs/ /dpag med rnam par 'phrul pa yis/ /zhing rnams kun tu yog don spyod/ /ji srid snying po byang chub par/ /de dag nam yang 'dren pa'i mthus/ /ngan 'gro'i sgra yang mi grag cing / /rtag tu dga' skyid 'tsho bar byed/ /gal te blo gsal spobs spyod na/ /sgu gsum la sogs gang bshad pa / /cho ga de dag bzlas pa yang / /gdon mi za bar bya ba nyid/ /gang tshe 27—5 7

bsdu bar 'dod pa na/ /se gol brdabs pas spar byas la/ /bzod par gsol dang smon lam gdab/ /dran pa'i rgya yis gzung bya'o/ /1thugs rje chen po'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /dpal thugs rje chen po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub kun gye rgyur gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan byed 4thabs/ /mchod sprin rgyal mtshan rtse mo yis/ /bsam mi khyab byed mchod pa bri/ /rnge tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo maṇ+ḍal rdzas/ /'byor pa'i khyad par gyis bkod de/ /nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis byin brlab/ /oṃ badz+ra puste āḥ5hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥ6hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥ8hūṃ / oṃ badz+ra be+e bi bye āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shaja āḥ7hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal la āḥ 1hūṃ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid can gyi/ /sna tshogs mchod rdzas bsam mi khyab/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i rig pa yis1 / /sprul nas 'phags tshogs mchod par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ma hā kā ru bhā ka puṣ+ṭha pū dza me gha sa mu dra ke tu rā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyak+shi bud+dhā yaḥ/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe/ puste/puste / put+pa/sa ubye be+e/ puṣ+ṭha/ a wa sa tī ra be+e swā hā/ me tog dbul ba'e sngags so/ /de bzhin du/ dhū pa dang / dī pa dang / gan+dha dang / ne+e bi bye dang / shap+ta dang / maṇ+ḍal zhes bya ba la sbyar ba'i rim byus bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri chab dang / zhal zas dang /rol mo dang / maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya'o/ /gos bzang gyon zhing rgyan bzang btags / /yi ge gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i glu gar sngon song bas/ /37——548

————sangs rgyas la sogs mchod par bya/ /bdag nyid mchod sprin rgya mtsho yi/ /dbus bzhugs mchod kun la mnga' brnyes/ /mgon po 'khor los sgyur rgyal tshul / /rgyal mtshan rtse mo gser mdog bskyed/ /ye shes snying po 'a/sa byung ba'i / /sna tshogs lha mo mdzes rnams kyis/ /re re las kyang dpag tu rnged/ /sprul pas rim gro sdogs par blta/ /mi phyed gus pas 1mang yod pas/ /gzungs 'di lan gsum cho ga 'dis/ /nyin re dus gsum mchod byed na/ /bye ba bsam mi khyab mchod 'gyur/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄za/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs smon lam gyi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis bsgrub pa ni/ /sems can rnams la phan brtson pas/ /smon lam rgya mtsho spyod pa'i phyir/ /de yi dbang gyur 'di bshad bya/ /sngon nas bsnyen pa'i rim pa la/ /'dris gyur snying rjes yid gdungs pa/ /mig dang smin mtshams snying dkyil du/ /byams sogs thig le gsum bsgom bya/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang zla ba'i 'od/ /de ni thugs rje mi phyed 'od / /lus can rnams kyi snying dang ni/ /nyon mongs me lce de nang gnas/ /de bzhin bye gtsug grangs bzhin du/ /pad+ma zlum dang ram̐ rja rje/ /gang tshe skye bo don tshol ba dang don mi tshol ba gcig dang mang po yang rung ste/ bdag gi dbang po'i spyod yul du 'bab 2pas las la sbyar du rung bar gyur pa dang / cho ga 'dis rnal 'byor du byas la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab ste / ma 'ongs pa'i dus su myur ba kho nar sems can khyed cag bdag gis 37—bye/9

byed ——— —————byed—— — —smin pa'i gdul byar gyur cig ces/ smon lam btab la/ nyi 'od thig les de dag pad+mo kha phyed 1nas/ /zla 'od can gyis gdung ba 'bar ba zhi bar bya/ /mi phyed zer kyis lus bkang rdo rje'i rgyas btab la/ /ci dgar khyed spyod ma lus myur du bdag gis bsgral/ /de rjes chos dang zang zing sbyin/ /mgu bya kun gyis sems bkug nas/ /glang chen myos 'a/ lcags kyu bzhin/ /mkhas pas 'gro ba dbang du bya/ /me tog la sogs brdas gtod pa'am2/ /yang na lag pa rkang pa med/ /yun ring dmigs ltas mda' bsnun pa'am/ /bdag nyid chen po thabs la mkhas/ /khab rnams kyis ni khab len dang / /bung ba rnams kyis me tog bzhin/ /de ni mi 'dod nyin gcig kyang / /dbang med skye bo 'du bar 'gyur/ /smon lam du bya ba sdogs so// //༄7/ /dpal bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba brnyes 4pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dpal bdud rtsi brnyes/ /bza' dang bca' dang myang ba sman/ /btung ba sna tshogs nyid mchod bzhes/ /skal ldan byin gyis rlob par bshad/ /dus dang dus mtshams 5dga' ston dus/ /bza' dang bza' min bza' yin te / /rnal 'byor rgyal po dam tshig spyod/ /rab gus mchod byed sbyin la brtson / /skad cig dran pas lhar bskyed nas/ /bzhi pa'e yi ge spyor ba yis/ /mgrin pa lce steng byen brlabs la/ /a dang ka phreng gnyis med zhu7/ /sgon ma gnyis steng rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin seng ge rnam bsgyings gnyis/ /rgyur byas thabs dang shes rab bskyed/ /phreng ba gnyis kyang dgod par bya/ /ka pā la sogs pad+ma can/ / sna tshogs bza' bas bkang byas la/ / snod bcud 37—bye50

sbyang dang gzi bskyed pas/ /gya nom gyur pa rnal 'byor tshogs/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥbaṃ hoḥ1 / dri bsal sbyong byed bdud rtsir byed/ /phun sum tshogs dang dges byed pa/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rnam pa lnga/ /'od kyi spyor bas rnam par rtsen/ /dpag med bdag lus sangs rgyas la/ /bsam mi khyab sprul rtsi yi mtshos2/ /lus lnga dag ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgrub pa pos ni mchod par bya/ /oṃ āḥtweḥshrī lo ka nā tha sarba budhe bo bye sa byu pad+ma bi shudhe a mṛta te dza ra 4bha k+ṣa ta kha kha 5khā hi khā hi/ a ne+e ka satwa tsa sa ma ya sid+dhi sma ra sma ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod pas so/ /de nas lhag ma bsnyus la gtor ma bya'o/ /bdag lus rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /phung po sangs rgyas rnam pa lnga/ /bde chen gnyis med phyag rgya che/ /dpa' bo rnam par rol pa yin/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥ.a i u 7e o saṃ/ ma hā su kha 8badz+ra ta tā sarba dz+nyā na swa bhā wa bi shudhe ho ho hoḥ9zhes glu blang bar bya'o/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i zas kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo /bdag gi lus la lhag par chags/ /nad ni rnam pa mang ldan pa'am/ /yang na bsod nams tshogs don gnyer/ /des ni lus sbyin cho ga brtsam/ /re zhig longs spyod dang lus la rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur rtogs shing 'du byed thams cad dri za'i grong khyer ram/ mtshon cha'i spyor ba lta bur yongs su shes pas/ thog ma kho nar mchod pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyi lus nye bar sbyin pa 'di'o/ /de nas —yang rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan 37—551

byedaras gzigs rnam par dkar ba 'od zer bcu drug gi rnam pa can du bsgom par bya'o / /de'i thugs ni dhīḥkun da 1lta bu'o/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyis gdug pa can 'dul ba'o/ /lte bar ram̐ dmar po las skyes pa'i me'i phreng ba gsal byed kyi 2'khor lo can no/ /de bzhin du thugs kar yang a dkar po las skyes pa'i dbyangs kyi 'khor lo yang ngo mi dang lha dbang klu rgyal gyi/ /mgo gsum sgyed pu'i steng du ni/ /lha yi smin mtshams las byung ba'i/ /pha ti ka yi gri gug gis/ /bdag gi thod phyed bcad 4nas ni/ /phru ba'i tshul du dgab par bya/ /lha yi lte dbus ram̐ yig las/ /me khyepe bskyod pa 5sbar bar bya/ /de yi nang du bdag nyid lus/ /gcer 6bu tsog krung 'dug pa yin/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum bsams la/ /khu ba dmar pos bzhu bar bya/ /'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /dag par byas dang bdud rtsir bya/ /phun tshogs dgyes pa'i rgyu bsams te/ /thugs ka'i tweḥlas bdud rtsi dgug /dam tshig ye shes 'dres gyur pa7/ /rdo rje kha phye'i phyag rgya dang / /oṃ āḥbadz+ra kā ya shudhe bi shud+dhā kā ro mu khaṃ a mṛ ta swa bhā wa 9ma hā ba lo ta pū dza me gha sa mu 11dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ kha kha khā hi khā tī/ sarba satārja hoḥ / sngags 'dis 1 lan gsum bar du dbul/ /mgron gsum rnal 'byor cho gas so/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī mi tri'i 1 gdams pa / lus sbyin pa'i cho ga sdogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po rgyun gyi phreng ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje chen po can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ yi dwags la sogs pa phongs pa rnams la 37——bya pya 2

chu'i sbyin pa sbyin 1pa la brtson par bya ste/ rgyu gcig sngon du song ba yis/ /'phags pa nyid ni dran byas la/ /mgrin pa lag pa 'khor lor bcas/ /rdzogs pa'i sbyor bas sdogs par byas/ /phyag g.yas zla dbus ye shes can/ /a phreng gis bskor gsal ba yi/ /ming med rtse nas mi 'gyur bdun/ /'bab pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun rab 'dzag2 /pad+mo rgyas btab rin chen snod/ /bsil zhim dwangs pas bkang ba'i chu/ /pad+mo'i mtsho la char rgyun bzhin/ /ye shes bdud rtsir 'bab pas bsre/ /'jungs pa'i mya ngan rgad pa yi/ /gzugs can ji snyed 'jig rten rgyu/ /de snyed phyag mthil 'od zer gyi/ /mdun bdar sa gzhi gang bar bya/ /oṃ āḥtweḥ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pra sā 4da sarba pre ta pra byud ta sī s+t+waṃ 5dza dza dzaḥ 6/ de rjes 'od zer skar mda' yi/ /sngags dang phyag rgya gsal ba yis/ /ma lus lce la 'bar ba yi7/ /sbubs bsams yi ge bzhi brjod sbyin/ /oṃ a tweḥnahūṃ/ zas kyi bdud rtsis 9tshim byas nas/ /gnas gyur lha lus thob pa na/ /bde gshegs bka' yi tshig sbyin pas/ /dub pa'i sems kyang tshim par bya/ /mthar ni smon lam gyis smin pa'i gdul byar byas pa la lam bsten pa'i phyag rgyas bka' bsgo la ci bde bar dengs su gzhug go/ /chu sbyin kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mchod sbyin mang po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas snying rje chen po can chu gtor gyi 1 mchod sbyin la mngon par dga' bas gang na ri dang thang dang 'bab chu dang ne'u gsing 11dang / lha khang dang phug la sogs pa ci rigs pa'i gnas su yo byad phun sum tshogs par 37—5pya 3

byas nas bde ba'i yid dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ gsum la skyabs su 1song nas brtsams te/ /byang chub mchog tu sems gzung bar/ /byams sogs tshangs pa'i gnas bcas pas/ /nges par byas te cho ga brtsam/ /thams cad stong pa nyid dbyings las/ /pad+ma zla dbus sa bon mtshan/ /yongs gyur spyor bas lha mchog bskyed/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis yongs su bcing rdo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba/ /gnyis brkyang gung mo mdzub gnyis mdud/ /mthe bong rdo rje bsten 4sbyar la/ /spyi gtsug steng du gsal gzhag ste5/ na maḥs man+ta budzha māṃ badz+ra uṭī ṣa hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bya bas gtsug tor gsal bar bya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo gnyis sbyar las/ /gung mo gnyis brkyang srin lag mdzub/ /rtse sbyar phan tshun khyud bskor nas/ /gtsug tor steng du gsal byas nas/ /oṃ āḥdīḥ badz+ra a mṛ te pasbyi ti hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bya bas 'od dpag med kyi cod pan bsgrub par bya'o/ /klu mchog chos 'chad las skyes pa/ /gung mo dang ni mthe bong gnyis/ /gshibs brkyang rtse mo lhan cig pa/ /dmigs la nye bar btud nas ni/ /oṃ āḥdīḥbadz+ra dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra sa ka sa hūṃ/ zhes bya bas ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pas gsal bar bya'o/ /lag gnyis mnyam pa'i thal sbyar bas/ /mdzub gnyis gung mo la mdud cing / /mjeb gnyis gung mo la btud nas/ /lus kun kun tu bskor nyul bas/ /o āḥs+thāḥbadz+ra rgo badz+ra tsakra bha ba /wa ka pa ṭa hūṃ/ zhes bya bas rdo rje zhub —kyi go bgo bar bya'o/ /de rjes/ rnam dag chos/ nyid rgya chen nam mkha' mdzod dang bdud rtsi thab sbyor dang / /shugs chen skar mda' dbang du byed bshad rgyal ba spyan ras gzigs dbang rgya/ /sngags bcas grangs kyi dri dral 1 bsam yas bdud rtsi'i mtsho chen sprin 'khrigs 37—55

byedadang / /dpag med lus kyis phun tshogs mchod sprul ma lus ci rigs dgos dgur mchod/ /oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudhaḥ1 sarba dharmāḥ2swa bhā ba bi shusgopho4haṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te 5bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ6sarba tarja ut+pa te sga ra ṇa hi rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te sa man+ta be+e ra ṇa 9ra smi bha bā sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi 7du ru 1 z-i da ya dza la ni hūṃ/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhā ba dzo ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te sam hā kā gluru ṇi kā ya swa ra shrī a ba lo ki te ma hā a byeṣ+ṭha na dz+wa la dz+wa la nā nā pū dza me gha spa ra ṇa 8hūṃ/ paṃ las pad snod rgya chen ni/ /'bru gsum las gyur sna tshogs bcud/ /zab cing rgya che'i sngags phyag rgyas/ /byin brlabs de steng sman shing bskyed/ /a dang ka sogs las grub pa/ /grub pa nyi shu sogs rdzas kyis / /legs spras dam tshig gtor ma la/ /ye shes bstems la ji bzhin mchod / /dpal ldan thugs rje che stobs mthus/ /sri zhu yon tan phan 'dogs dang / /snying rje'i gnas gyur ltos chags mgron/ /tshim byed mchod sbyin 'di rab bsngags/ /dpal thugs rje chen po'i chab gtor gyi cho ga rdzogs so / / //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug me dpung 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs myur du/ /dngos grub byed dang zang zing rnyed/ /gzi brjid bskyed dang mthu bskyed dang / /sdig 'joms bya phyir me dpung mchod/ /dam tshig can gyis sngon du lha 'dris par byas nas 37—553

nags dbe+en par song ste/ khru bzhi pa dang 1/ khru gang pa dang mtho gang ba'i tshad kyi shing bu bzang po bsrung ba blangs te/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang lhan cig pa'i dad pa drag pos mchod pa'i yid ma brjed par byas la/ji tsam rigs 2par mchod rten gyi gzugs lta bur brtsig go/ /ji skad zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tu/ /gang bsrung sreg rdzas mchod pa'i rkyen/ /de dag thams cad 'di shes bya4/ /khyad par du ni rab bsngags brgyad/ /sa yi bdag po'i yo byad rung ba sna tshogs phye mar byas pa dang / /dbang phyug rnams kyi 'bru nor dang ni de bzhin tshong dus chen po'i sa/ /gzi ldan mthu chen skra 5dang sen mo'i 'tsho ba'i dang por byas pa'i phud / /rang nyid lus skyes dri ma sna tshogs phun sum tshogs min ling ga'o/ /de la thog ma kho nar me sbar ba dang cho ga ji lta ba bzhin byas te/ 'bar ba'i dbus su ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas sreg rdzas 7dbul zhing rab tu bsngags pa'i chus yang dang yang du khrus gsol ba dang bsang 8gtor bya'o/ /de nas yang mchod pa la sogs pa thams cad byas te glu dang gar dang rol mo la sogs pa btab 9cing pi wang bsgreng ba dang lhan cig tu man ngag dang ldan pas phun sum tshogs pa ma yin pa'i ling ga bsregs la 7bzla'o/ /oṃ āḥtwe11ཿa ki ni dz+wa la dz+wa la ma hā dz+wa gā tro/ ma ma ta mu ge las che ge mo thams cad sedha sidhe ma hā kā ru ṇi / ka hoḥ7 / ces bya bas so/ /me dpung 'bar ba spyan ras gzigs dbang me yi las / /mchod pa gang brnyes zhal gcig phyag gnyis dza ka'i mdog /shin tu gzi brjid sgrub 15po'i bsod nams sgrub slobartson pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu me thab g.yas g.yon 'dzin pa yin/ /de yi las sgrub 7me yi bu zhes bya ba'i lha/ /37—556

rkang pa gnyis bteg dga' ba'i gzi mdangs dkar dmar mdog /rin chen phreng thogs nyid kyi thugs ka las 'ongs nas/ /sbyin bdag mdun sdod don kun nges par bsgrub pa'o/ / de yis 1sras bcas lha mchog 2gnyis/ /mnyes gyur rmi lam nang du ston/ /de nas gshegs gsol thal ba bsdus/ /dpung pa g.yas su gdags par bya/ /thugs rje chen po me yi lha/ /de yi nyin mo tshur bcad 4la/ /rtag tu bu sbug lta bur ni/ /dgongs gyur 5'dod pa thams cad sgrub6/ /me'i mchod pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /thugs rje chen po sgu gsung thugs ye shes rnam par 'phrul pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas sku gzugs kyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ mtshan ma mthong ba'i sgrub pa pos dam tshig sbyangs te/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i sku la bdar ba'i chus lus bkrus la/ gnas phun sum tshogs par bdag gi ltos pa dor bas brtsam mo/ /rgyu dang ngo bo kha dog dang / /rab tu gnas pa rnam par dag7 /yon tan dang ni phrin las rgyun8/ /brgyad po la ni cho ga brgyad/ / thugs dang sku dang gsung nyid dang / // ye shes dang ni de kho na/ /lnga ni yi ge lngar bcas la/ /gzhan gsum rang bzhin yi ge —gsum/ /hūṃ oṃ āḥdī 1ཿte hoḥ5phaṭa swā hā/ 'jim pa dang rdo dang shing dang ras dang rus pa dang rtsig ngos dang rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu rnams ni rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug gi nga rgyal kyis snying gi pad+mo'i dbus kyi hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i thugs rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyis gang zhing gtams par bya'o/ /zhi ba dang khro ba dang tshul gnyis pa la sogs pa'i sgu gzugs kyi ngo bo rnams ni 'khor lo —can dbang phyug gi nga 37—557

rgyal gyis snying gi 'dab ma'i dbus kyi oṃ 'khor lo sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i sku thugs 1rje rnam par rol pas rab tu brjid pa'i bdag nyid du bya'o/ /dkar ba dang dmar ba dang ser ba dang ljang gu la sogs pa'i kha dog rnams ni pad+ma can dbang phyug gi nga rgyal gyis snying gi 'dab ma'i dbus kyi āḥ2pad+mo'i sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i gsung nye bar bkod pas shin tu khyab par bya'o/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes rnams ni rin chen 'dzin dbang phyug gi nga rgyal gyis snying gi pad+mo'i dbus kyi dī4ཿrin chen sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i ye shes chen po bsam gyis mi khyab par mngon par byang chub par bya'o/ /dag pa dang dri ma med pa dang ye shes chen po'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa rnams ni sna tshogs spyod dbang dbang phyug gi nga rgyal gyis snying gi pad+mo'i dbus kyi he/ sna tshogs sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i rnam par dag pa mthar son par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu bral ba dang phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams ni sgu gsung thugs ye shes kho na lnga po nyid gnyis med dbang phyug gi nga rgyal gyis snying gi pad+mo'i dbus kyi hoḥ5gnyis med sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o / /lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun 6mi 'chad pa la sogs pa'i phrin las rnams ni sgu gsung thugs ye shes de kho na lnga po nyid rang byung ba'i dbang phyug gi 7 nga rgyal gyis snying gi pad+mo'i dbus kyi phaṭa rang byung sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i phrin 'a/sa rtag tu rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa rnam par 'phrul par bya'o/ /sgrub pa po dang rjes su 'jug pa la sogs pa'i rgyun rnams ni sku gsung thugs 9ye shes de kho na lnga po nyid nye bar spyor ba'i dbang phyug gi nga rgyal gyis snying gi pad+mo'i 27—558

dbus kyi swā hā nye bar sbyor ba'i sems dpa' las 'phros pa'i rgyun nam mkha' ji srid par spyor ba dbang du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /rang rang cho ga rjes mthun pas/ /ji ltar bsgrub pa dga' bzhin du/ /dka' 1yang skyo ba med spyod na/ /mi de myur du dngos grub byed/ /gang zhig gang gi don 'dod pas/ /lhag ma 2rab tu snying brtses 'jug /de dag rang bzhin stong nyid shes/ /rtul phod 'phags sras phyir mi ldog /sku gzugs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gzi brjid rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /'jig rten mgon po mnyes bya dang 4/ /mnyes 'dod dad pa thob pas kyang / /mang po'i spyod yul 'gyur bar ni/ /mchod rten la sogs brtsam par bya/ /gzi brjid rgyal po zhal gcig pa'am/ /yang na dpag tu med zhal phyag /bsam gyis mi khyab spyan mnga' ba/ /bsod nams bsgrub phyir spyan drangs mchod/ /bdag nyid dīḥyig las 5skyes pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i rgyal ba gang bsgoms pa/ /de yis byin brlabs dbang bskur nas/ /rgya mtsho la ni char rgyun bzhin/ /'jim pa la sogs yo byad la/ /rdo rje 'bar bas bgegs bsal te/ /rig pa'i rgyal pos gzi bskyed la/ /rnal 'byor ldan par 6byin kyis brlab/ /oṃ s+dzadz+rīḥsarba a bye ka na na 7ha ra ha ra pra ha ra hūṃ hūṃ 8phaṭa/oṃ tshitweḥ tshosarba dhan+d+ra nirma la bi shusgo swa bhā wa sarba ma hā ghu na a nu brnyi ta ye swā hā/oṃ ā hūṃ hoḥ de nas rten la tshogs bsags te/ /stong pa nyid dang bsam mi khyab—/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dgongs mdzad par/ /sngags dang mchod rten bzhengs par bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ lo ke shwa rā ya/ pra bha rā dzā 537—559

ya / ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyak+shi bud+dhā 1ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ su sgre su sgre 2sa me sa ma ya/ shādhe dārnye/ sa ma ro be+e/ a nā lo/ ta ram̐ be+e/ya sho wa ti/ ma hā te dza/ nir ku le/ nir bā na4/ sarba budha5/ a byeṣ+ṭha na/ a byekhye 6te swā hā/ gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing las la 'jug pas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug dran pa dang mi 'bral bar byed na/ des ji srid yo byad la gnas pa'i rdul phra rab ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi mchod rten sku gzugs byas par 'gyur ro/ /de rjes gzi brjid nyid dpal gyis/ /ye shes spros la rab gnas bya/ /nam mkha' ji srid bzhugs gsol nas/ /bzod par gsol te mchod pas mchod/ /sgu gzugs dang mchod rten gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /bcom ldan 'das ye shes 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa mchog zhugs de nyid ye shes ma mthong dang / /mthong ba 7ji srid rnal du mi gnas res 'ga' nyid/ /de bzhin rnam g.yengs thibs por gyur dang mthar mi 'akro / /blo gros lam lhos de dag las 'phags 'dir bshad bya/ /bdag lus spyi gtsug cod pan la/ /dpal ldan bla ma brgyud pa'i rim/ /ye shes shing rta'i rtsa mchog lam/ /drang dang bar ma chad dang dngas/ /de mtha' slob dpon rdo rje rtse/ /bdag gi tshangs gnas nam mkha'i sgor/ /āḥhūṃ gnyis mtshan reg bsgoms la/ /steng rim nas ni gsol ba gdab/ /ma lus ye shes can rnams kyis/ /yang dag rim mdzad sa bon hūṃ/ /pad+ma la ni ge sar bzhin//mkhas pas rab dad thugs kar bsgoms8/ /zla ba la yang skar ma ltar/ /rdo 37—560
