rje 'chang chen 'od mthar ni/ /bcu dang gnyis bcas a phreng gis/ /bskor bltas gsang sngags bzlas par bya/ /oṃ rat+na gu ru shrī a ba lo ki te shwa ra 1sarba iṣ+ṭa de ba ta ma hā tiṣ+ṭha ne+e ma ma tsi ta ta ta ta dz+nyā na dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra ti dz+wa la pra ti dz+wa la/ pra sgo da pan+da z-i da ya dz+wa la dz+wa la spa ra ṇa sa 4hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ gsang sngags rgyal po rig pa che/ /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa gdon mi za/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya nges pa 'dis5/ /thugs bsgul ye shes 'bab par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbang phyug sa bcu'i snying / /bum pa las ni rgyun bzhin du/ /rim gyis bdag snying sa bon la/ /bab gyur de yi gzi brjid bskyed/ /'char ka'i 'od ltar dmar ba dang / /zla rgyas dkyil 'khor ltar dkar nyid/ /dbang po'i gzhu mdog lta bu yi/ /'od kyis bdag lus gang bar bya/ /gang phyir bskal pa bye bar yang //'bad byas dal bas yang min la/ /bde chen 'od gsal rnam 6mi rtog /bla ma'i drin thob thob par 'gyur/ /chu gter 7che las brlan pa'i rlangs 8bskyod dri med mkha' la mi zad sprin 'khrigs dka' ba med/ /rta bdun shar tshe thibs pos ma rungs gling rnams mi gsal 9snang bar byas la dka' ba med/ /nam mkha'i ngos la shugs drag drag 'khrugs glo bur sprin bsgribs dwangs par byas la dka' ba med/ /de bzhin bdag gi muchos kyi rjer gyur dam pa'i mthus kyang ye shes 'bar bar dka' ba med/ /ye shes sbar ba'i gdams pa sgogs so / / //༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig byang chub sems bskyed na/ /bdag gam gzhan gyi 1 don 'jug pa/ /de 37—561

tshe shes dang mi shes pas/ /dri ma rab tu mang skye 'gyur/ /de la mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bkru ba dam pa 'dir bshad do/ /rab tu gnas pa mchog gnas pa'i / /rten gang byin gyis brlabs pa zhig /mdun bdar me tog bdug spos sogs/ /mchod pa du mas legs mchod bya/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gshegs pa yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rin chen gsum/ /sprin gyi phung po ltar dkrigs pas/ /nam mkha'i ngos la gang bar blta1/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang dran pas/ /gdung ba'i yid kyi 2'gyod pas ni/ /thog med nas bsags sdig pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus so sor bshags shing bsdam/ /'gro ba dge ba'i rtsa rnams la/ /rjes su yid byed yi rang ba/ /'di ni bsam mi khyab pa'i las/ /ming las phun tshogs khyad par 'dod/ /de nas 'phags tshogs spyan sngar bdag /gus pas phyag 'tshal rab dang bas/ /sdog ldan bdag la skyabs 4pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs su gsol/ /gti mug thibs pos non pa bdag /mi bzad 5sdig pa'i dbang gyur te/ /'gro ba ngan song nges pa'i sar/ /gdon mi za bar myur ltung 'gyur/ /de bas skyob pa rnams kyi mthus/ /mgon med bdag gi gnas skabs 'di/ /gzigs nas myur du bskyab tu gsol/ /khyed las skyabs gzhan bdag ma mchis/ /de ltar sna tshogs gdungs pa yis6/ /smre sngags du mas smre brjod la/ /rtse gcig ma yengs thal sbyar nas/ /re ba'i yid kyis mdun du 'dug /de tshe lha mchog 'dus pa yi/ /tshogs rnams thugs rje'i thugs bskyod de/ /de dag las sprul 'jig rten mgon/ /dkar bzang 7bum pa 'dzin 'ongs bsam yang ni 27——bye62

—mi phyed dad dang dang / /mchod byas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de rjes mgon po'i thugs ka nas/ /'od phyung mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sgras/ /dbyings 'byin dri ma bsal ba dang / /bkrus dang yongs su sbyang ba bya/ /de las 1'od zer rnon po yis/ /dri ma bsregs pa dang pos te2/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun phreng ba yis/ /bkru ba gang yin gnyis pa'o/ /yang dag ye shes mnyam gzhag la/ /mnyam 'jog yongs su spyong ba bshad/ /dag dang dri med 'od gsal dang / /sgrub pa las la sbyar ba yis/ /don bsgrubs 5nas ni dkyil 'khor gnyis/ /slar bdag snying gar bsnyu bar bya/ /dri ma rnam dag gi cho ga rdzogs so// //snga / /bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo//sngags pa gang zhig yul lam dbang po dang las kyi stobs kyis gal te phyi dang nang gi dam tshig nyams pa 'ga' zhig lta bu byung bar gyur na/ des 6'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dran par byas la/lus dang longs spyod dang / gdams ngag la lhag par chags pa yang spangs te/cho ga rnams las ji snyed 'byung ba'i bshags pa dang / sbyang ba rnams kyis shin tu gus par rab tu dag par bya'o/ /de'i yang cho ga rnams kyi gtso/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum rgyal po/ /dri ma sbyong ba'i brtag pa las/ /gang bshad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di/ /pad+mo dkar rgyas 'dab stong rnam par bye ba yi/ /lte bar rang sems dri med hūṃ gi snying po can/ /sgrib tshogs chags 7nyams du ba khug rna dngul gyi tshul/ /me long ngos la g.ya' dag ji bzhin khebs par bsam /37—563

de yi gtsug tor nas brgyud pa/ / dhū tī 1rin chen spangs pa yi/ /sbu gu dkar po gyen 'greng ba/ /spyi gtsug bar du gsal bar bya/ /bdag nyid cod pan nyi zla'i gdan steng 2'bar ba la/ /bla ma mgon dang a haṃ yab yum phyi nang rim/ /ji bzhin snyoms 'jug bde chen stong nyid bsam gtan la/ /rtag tu dges bzhugs bdag gi nyams pa gso mdzad bsgom/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa dang / /bstod sogs rgyas par byas nas ni/ /'gyod dang sdom dang dang bar bcas/ /rtse gcig blo yis gsol bar bya/ /thog ma kho nar bla ma snyoms zhugs byang chub sems kyi rgyu rab dmar/ /sbyor mtshams ge nas sam nyid kyi rdo rje rdo rje rnam dag rtse lnga las/ /byung ba'i me lces bdag lus kun khyab rlung gi shugs bcas dkrugs pa dang / /dngar 5ba'i shugs kyis ji snyed chags nyams dri ma ma lus bsreg par bya/ /rdo rjes lha yang snyoms 6par zhugs / /thig le dkar hūṃ bkru ba dang / /de bzhin thabs dang shes rab kyang / /snyoms 'jug thig le sngon pos gso/ /cho ga dam pa 'di yis ni/ /mi gang shes dang mi shes dang / /ma dad nga rgyal mang ba dang / /bsnyen sogs rgyu yis lam nyams pa/ /de dag myur du gza' las thar ba'i zla ba bzhin/ /zla ba gcig gam yang na gnyis nyid de ste gsum/ /brtson dang gus drag the tshom yid gnyis bsal nas ni/ /rig ma mchog bcas snyoms par zhugs na nges par grol/ /chags nyams gso ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu snga bar langs nas ni/ /dri zhim chu yis bkang ba yi/ /bum par 37—564

brtson mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /bzhu ba'i rgyun kyis lus bkru bya/ /dke ba'i khang bu dam par ni/ /brtse ldan skyes bu che rnams kyis/ /dul ba'i blo gros dran pa dang / /bag yod dbang po rab bsdams pas/ /zhugs la sna tshogs mchod pa yi1/ /rdzas rnams chal par bkram bya zhing / /dri bsung bdug pa mchog gis bdugs2/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags bzlas bya/ / ā+oṃḥ.a bispyon sarba to 4ṣa pra ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji bzhin bskyed dang rdzogs pa yi/ /cho ga rim pas sngon btang la/ /pha ṭi ka yi sbyor ba brtsam/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang / /smin mtshams 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /brtson pa'i 'jig rten gsum dbang po/ /skad cig tsam gyis mdun du drang / /shel ltar dri med yangs 5pa yi/ /pho brang rin chen sgron ma can/ /rab tu nyams dga' lham me ba/ /rgyan 6rnams kun gyis phun tshogs lha/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i g.yer kha 7rab snyan bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/ /bstan pa gang dag shin tu rnam nges rtag dang bde dang gtsang ba dang / /bdag tu chags pa'i lta ba'i kun sel mi rtag sdug bsngal mi gtsang dang / /bdag med chos ston nam mkha'i mthar thug skye dgu'i snying rab sim byed bsam/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi/ /gzhal med khang brtsegs dam pa dag /kun tu 'od 'tsher rgyal ba yi1 / /sgu mdzes mang pos rab brgyan pa'o/ /khang bzangs re yang mchod pa yin1 / /lha mo bcu drug bcu drug gis/ /mngon par rol byas rtag tu rtsen / /thams cad ting 'dzin bskyed brtson pa'o/ /de yi phyi rol nye 'khor du/ /phyogs skyong bcu yi bu rnams kyis/ /brtson 1 byas mchod pa'i sprin phung las/ /lus phyed mngon phyung 37—56ka

btud pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /smin mtshams mdzod srur 1byung ba yi/ /skar mda' ltar dkar 'od 'phros pas/ /khang bzangs rgyal ba'i thugs bsgul bya / /'di ltar rnam par g.yengs kun gyi / /rtsa ba 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa ting 'dzin myur 'dod pas/ /'dzin pa mtha' dag spang bar bya/ /de 5'dzin pa ni rnam 6bzhi ste/ /longs spyod bshes dang lus nyid dang / /dge ba'i tshogs la mngon zhen pa'o/ /'di dag gzhan gyi don du bsngo/ /de nas me long zla rgyas dang / /dbang po'i gzhu dang 'od kyi khyim/ /ston gyi nam mkha'i gung rnams 7kyis/ /spyor ba brtan pas rnam par bsgom/ /'jig rten mgon po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /thogs med 'od dpag med nyid kyis/ /dbu brgyan dīḥ yig snying po can/ /smin mtshams nyi mas mtshan gyur blta/ / oṃ āḥdīḥm ma tsi tra sa ma ya dhi badz+ra mu tra pra ngh+rud ta phe phe phe dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sngags 'di rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs / /ting 'dzin dbab pa'i phyag rgyas te/ /rang bzhin pad+mo 7'dab stong dbus/ /thig le dkar 'tsher rdo rje'i rgyu/ /nyi ma'i zer gyis pad+mo dbye/ /thig le las ni 'od tshogs spro/ /de yis 1mun pa kun bsregs pas/ /thogs med bsam gtan rang byung 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin myur du bskyed pa'i gdams ngag sdogs so// //༄7/ / spyan ras gzigs ting nge 'dzin rab tu brtan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig ting 'dzin ri dbang po ltar g.yeng ba'i rlung gis mi bskyod cing / /shin tu 'od gsal ston ka'i mkha' la nyi 'od dra ba bkram 'dra ba/ /37—566

gnyis med bde chen rtogs dka'i rtog pas rtog tu dges bzhugs 'dzum pa'i zhal / /bsam gtan mchog gi phyag rgyas mnyam gzhag mnyam med mgon po nyid rtag 'dud/ /sgrub po gang zhig sgrub 1pa'am/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnyed pa yi//ting 'dzin rab tu mi brtan pa/ /de dag brtan pa'i thabs 'dir bshad/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i gnas nyid du/ /lus dang sems ni rab dal bas / /rgya chen mchod sbyin byas nas su/ /man ngag gsum gyi dang po bsgom/ /ma lus 'gro la byams sogs tshad med tshangs pa'i gnas pas legs gnas la/ /ji skad bshad pa'i ting 'dzin phyag rgyas dpa' bo chen po mnyam gzhag bya/ /de rjes mtshan bcas mtshan med cho gas mgon po la gus gsol btab ya/ /spyor ba gsum pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal pos rtse gcig brtan par 4yang dag bsgom/ /tha mal rang lus dkyil 'khor dbus/ /snying dkyil pad+mo dbye ba'i nang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa legs bsgoms 5la/ /de yi nang na'ang mgon po nyid/ /de bzhin de yi snying po ni6/ /dus gsum rgyal bas byin brlabs pa/ /sgrub po'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i rgyu/ /ye shes chen po dhīḥyig go/ /de ni gnyis su med sems rgyu/ /de la sa bon yang dag brtan / /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes dngos / /'bru bzhi phyogs bzhir rnam par bsam/ /mgon po nyid mthar ā li ste/ /bla ma'i mthar yang kā li'o/ /dbus nas brtsams te sngags bzlas shing / /'od zer spyor bas don gnyis bsgrub/ /skye ba las ni phyogs bcu'i mthar thug 9gang dag bsam gtan ma thob pa'am/ /thob kyang gang zhig rnal du mi gnas ri yi rtsa rtse ltar g.yo ba/ /de dag de ltar skad cig yud la ri rab sra 7ltar brtan pa yi/ /ting 'dzin la bkod bde chen ro myang 'chi med mnyam 37—567

gzhag cher gzhag 1bya/ /bsdus 2pas phyi ma phyi ma'i rim/ /thim gyur nang ma nang ma la/ /ngag dang dri med brtan pa zhes/ /bya ba'i ming can ting 'dzin gsum/ /go rims ji bzhin bsgoms nas ni/ /gcig tu 'gro ba snying brtse bas/ /thun gsum zhag bdun yid byed na/ /de yi ting 'dzin ri ltar 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin brtan par byed pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gang sems g.yo 'gog 'dod pas/ /skad cig spyor ba 4srun ras gzigs/ /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho dus drug tu/ /mtshan ma drug ni bsgom par bya/ /de la g.yo ba 5brtan par byed pa 6ni/ phyi'i mtshan ma ri mo dang ri mo med pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'o/ /nang gi mtshan ma yi ge med pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'o/ /gsang ba'i mtshan ma skye ba dang skye ba med pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba brtan par byed pa ni phyi'i mtshan ma rgya mtsho dang nam mkha'i sbyor ba'o/ /nang gi mtshan ma bum pa lta bu dang ri mo lta bu'i spyor ba'o/ /gsang ba'i mtshan ma ni thig le snyoms 7pa'i spyor ba'o/ /phyi nang gsang g.yo mi g.yo bas/ /dbang gyur dmigs par rang gnas na/ /de yang de tshe byed bral du/ /dub pa ngal bso mkhas pas shes/ /sems brtan par byed pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal ting 'dzin gyi rgyal po byin kyis brlabs pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan pad+mo 'dzin dbang gis/ /sngags mthu ma grub 37—568

grub pa dang / /nyams chags gso ba'i cho ga ni/ /mkhas pas 'bad de bsgom par bya/ /tha mal lus kyi snying 'dab dbus/ /phyogs kyi kha dog can hūṃ yig /rnal 'byor rgyal po rang sems gzhi/ /dkar 'khyel gzi brjid 'od mdzad bsgom/ /kha dang rna ba sna gnyis dang / /mig gnyis bshang dang gci ba'i sgo/ /de bzhin rkang pa lag gnyis ni/ /gtso bo las spyos rdo rje bdag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /pad+ma ut+pal rdo rje phra/ /nyi zla rdo rje hom khung zlum1/ /rgya gram rdo rje rtse mang nyid/ /a phreng ka phreng dkar dmar gyis/ /bskor bas 2khrag 'thung 'jigs pa'i sngags/ /thugs rje 'phros pa'i 'od zer las/ /skyes pa'i spyor ba yi dgas 4bya/ /dam tshig rdo rje hūṃ yig las/ /ye shes dpal 'dzin bcug nas ni/ /mchod sogs cho ga bzhin btud nas/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' rtse gcig bya/ /rnam par rtog pa kun shigs 5dang / /ye shes phyag rgya mchog spyor la/ /mnyam gzhag phrin las bcu lhag spyod/ /mkhas pas som nyi med par spyod/ /rtag tu sems can la phan dang / /lhag pa'i lhas de de nyid shes/ /rnal 'byor cho ga la brtson pas / /zla ba drug na rtags mthong 'gyur/ /lus nang me 6lce 'bar ba 7ltar tsha me 'od rnam par 'khrugs pa dang / /rdo rje'i sru skyes kha nas me 'bar skye bo mang po'i mgo btud bstod/ /lag na rdo rje ral gri 'bar thogs ha la'i sgra sgrogs phyogs bcur rgyug /mig 'bras rab gsal sgron ma'i 'od 'char blo gros nye bar zhi ba'o/ /byin rlabs 9mi zad pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo re 37—569

zhig sngags pa blo gros dam pa phul du sbyangs pa dag gis zla ba rgyas pa'i tshe kha shar du bltas la btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bas / thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa la mngon par brtson par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu tshangs pa'i gnas pad+ma la legs par gnas pa'i shes rab shin tu sbyangs pa yid la bya'o/ /me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa dang / sngar byas pa la 'gyod pas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa ji skad bshad pa de dag nyid kyang ngo / /de nas rang lus rgyal ba yi/ /pho brang 'khor lo dkar mdzes su/ /skad cig tsam gyis mngon bltas la/ /rnam dag gsum po bsgom par bya/ /de la mgo bo g.yas g.yon lag /gsang ba'i rdo rje g.yas g.yon rkang / /'di dag rtsibs drug gsal ba ste/ /lte ba lte ba yin par bshad/ /hūṃ dang oṃ dang t+t+waṃ 1 dhīḥ.aḥ / /phaṭa ces bya ba sngon po dang / /dkar ser dmar ljang dung mdog rnams/ /rim bzhin me long gzugs ltar dgod/ /sgyu ma smon lam rnam thar gyis/ /don du grub pa med pa yang / /snang ba mi dmigs rgyud du 'brel / /rtog pa mtha' gnyis las krol ba'o/ /de rjes lte dbus sems kyi gzhi / /brten pa'i dhīḥyig dkar bsams te/ /de steng bde chen thig le bsgom / /spyor ba gsum pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsdu dang dbang du bya ba dang / /nges nga/ra rtogs pa'i rim gsum gyi/ /mkhas pas bde chen 'bar ba yi / /khu ba zhu ba bsgom par bya/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rdo rje yi/ /'khor lo mgal 4me bskor ba zhes/ /bya ba 'di yang bla ma yi/ /man ngag gis 5ni de rjes brtsam/ /brtse chen byang chub sems bzang gi/ /rlung bskyod ye shes 37—570

'bru lnga yi/ /phreng ba 'khor lo bskor ba las/ /chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan bsgrag bya/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med stong / /mtshan med smon pa zad pa yi1/ /gsung rab drang dang drang ba min/ /phyogs bcur mkha' khyab bstan par bya/ /lhan cig don gnyis byed pa 'dis/ /byug car bdag gzhan don bsgrubs nas/ /mthar ni brtan dang g.yo ba yi/ /'khor lo spar ba'ang shes par bya/ /de bzhin 'gro dang 'dug dang smra/ /gnyid log la sogs dus kun tu'ang / /brtan pa mi phyed dran ldan pas/ /rtag tu spyod pa spyad par bshad2/ /'khor lo 'bar ba rdzogs so// //byed/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gsung dbang gi rgyal po rnam par rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi dbang phyug ngag gi bdag /rtag tu spro bas 4mchog bskyed mdzad/ /so so rang 5rig mgrin par gnas/ /dpal ldan spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /blo ldan rab dang snying rje'i chab kyis rtog pa'i myu gu rnam brlan dang / /gang zhig skal ngan dag gi 6dpa' nyams skye bos rab brnyas 7ma rungs nyid/ /gzhan dag sngags rig mthu bskyed 'dod dang de bzhin pha rol byad bzlog8'dod/ /de dag gus pas shin tu yid dga' ngag gi mthu bskyed gsung gi / rol pa 'di bsgom bya/ /re zhig sngags pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang dbang bsgur ba yang dag par rjes su dran pas lha'i rnal 'byor chen po yud tsam gyis mngon du byas la/dīḥyig las yongs su gyur pa'i pad+mo sdong bu can gyi 'dab ma'i lce dang steng du a dang hūṃ las zla ba dang rdo rjer bskyed pa nas de'i mthar ā li dang kā li dang phrang 37—571

—ba 'bar ba dkar dmar g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba'i bar du ste/ ji skad 'a6/gas pa'i lce byin gyes brlabs 1pa'i mdo las 'byung ba ltar bsam par bya'o//de nas lhag bsam rnam dag pas/ /'gro ba'i ngag gi dri bsal zhing / /mthu bcu spobs pa bskyed 'dod pas/ /thog mar a la sogs pa zla2/ /de'i phyir de ཿdag las 'od kyi phreng ba dkar po dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang gur phub pa dang / gzha' ris kyi rnam pa lta bur shar bas sems can ma lus pa'i ngag gi dri ‘ 5 bsal zhing / byang chub sems dpa' gsung gi dbang po'i rgyal po rnam pazari rol pa zhes bya ba'i ngag gi mthu rnam pa bcu po dag yongs su bskyed pa dang /tshur 'dus pas de dag gi ngag gi nus pa 4gang yod pa de dag kyang mar me ltar blangari sa shing / yi ge nyid las mngon par thim pa dang / a sogs rdo rje dpo/ra po dang / /de bzhin lhag bsam sngon 'gro 5bas/ /ka sogs ral gri'i bar bsams te/ /ral gri rdo rje rnam par sel6/ /de la ral gri ni gnyis gnyis so/ /rdo rje ni re re'o/ /mthar phreng ba phreng rgyud gcig la dgod par bya'o / /rdo rje'i las ni ngag gi skyon 'jig par byed do7/ /ral gri'i las ni ngag gi mthu rnon po yang dag par 'byin par byed pa'o/ / rdo rje 8yi ge de dag gipo/ mtshan rdo rje'i mchog dang rno ba yi/ /ral gri 'bar ba spu gri'i so 'dra 'od zesnari dkar dmar lhag ge ba/ /mkhas pas de tshe skad cig mngon bltas tshigs bca) da bklag cing ma yengs pas/ /rang gzhan don phyir bro gar 'gyu byas spro dang ri basbu ba'i 'od dbyung bya/ /de ltar sbyor ba dam pa 'di nyid dang ldan pas nacha/ langs pa'am/ nyi ma 'char ka'am srod thog thag gam mtshan phyed dam rtag tu pathang rung ste/ gzhan la brtse ba drag po dang bcas pas gang grub pa'i dge 37——572

ba nyid kyang bdag nyid lhag par chags pa med par gzhan la yang dag par phan par 'dod na/ 'di'i ngag gi nus pa ni drang srong dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /gang tshe bzlas pas yid skyo zhing / /'gro don ldan par 'dod pa na/ /sngags gsum bzlas pas phreng ba yi/ /'khor lo bskor ba 'od du zhu1/ /dpal ngag gi mthu bskyed pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags pas shin tu nyams dga' ba'i/ /gnas su rab tu mtho ba'i tshal/ /bsil khang rlung rgyun rtag 'bab par/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /dīḥ.oṃ āḥ2hrīḥhūṃ/ blak+ṣa'am byang chub shing lo 'am/ /de bzhin rtag tu rlung gis bskyod/ /kha dog dri bzang tshal pa'ang rung / /bsrung ba byas nas 'khor lo bca'/ /ci tsam g.yo bar sla ba yi/ /bzo bcos lte ba pad+mos mtshan/ /brgya phyed —la ni rdo rje yi/ /ral gri mi bzad gzugs bya'o/ /pho brang gnas su sa bon las/ /mgon po rlung gi 'khor lo can/ /rtsibs rnams la ni shes rab thabs/ /yongs gyur sngags grub lha mo bsam/ /dngos dang byin rlabs 5gzhug pa yis/ /gzi byin bskyed la mchod pas mchod/ /rang nyid 'khor lo 'dzin bsgoms nas/ /'od bkye 6sngags bzlas 'khor lo bskor / /thun gsum thog mar brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gsang sngags myur du grub 'dod pas/ /gsol btab rlung la bka' bsgo ste/ /rang nyid ci bde 7spyad par bya/ /gang du 'khor lo rab 'khyil ba/ /thugs rje che mchog rig pa'i mthus / /sgrub po'i ngal ba 'jig byed pa/ /der ni sdig ldan mi brten no/ /37—573

de ltar 'khor lo chen po rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mthus rigs lnga bcu rtsa lnga zlos 1par mdzad pa ni dam tshig can rnams kyis 2thabs yin par blta bar bya'o/ /me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa ji snyed pa la gang zag med pa'i zhes le lo dang brnyas pa mi bya'o/ /kha na ma tho ba phra rab dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu thams cad la bag yod pa dang / brtson pa lhar bya'o/ /dkar po'i phyogs gcig gis bsnyen 4pa thams cad yongs su sdogs par 'gyur te / 'di la je tshom mi bya'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i man ngag zab mo'i drin/ /gang thob skal ldan ngal ba med par ni/ /gsang sngags sgrub byed lus med shugs can gyi/ /'khrul 'khor 'jig rten mgon nyid las gzhan min/ /gsang sngags myur du grub pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la skyabs song sems bskyed ldan/ /'gro la phan 'dod bdag dul 5ba'i/ /skyes bu dam pa bsam gtan gyi/ / khang bur zhugs 6la rmi lam bsgom/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgu/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog ldan pa/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas dang po/ /'jigs skyob de bzhin g.yon du ni/ /pad+ma dmar po gnyis pa gnyis/ /ting 'dzin mchog ge phyag rgya'o/ /thugs kyi pad+mo kha zum nga/'i/ /dbus/ su sems dngos dhīḥ7bsam bya/ /'di 'dra'i 'phags pa nyid du bdag /skad cig tsam gyes bsgoms 8nas ni/ /dge dang brtse dang dad pa yis/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po gnyid log bya/ /gang tshe gnyid du nye ba na/ /s+thāḥyang thig le gnyis la bsdu/ /rim gyis 9thig le 'og ma yang / /37—57

de bzhin thig le gong ma la'o/ /de las 1sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /rang gi lus la bsdus nas de/ /pad dbus thig le nyag gcig la/ /chu la chu bzhin ji bzhin bzhag /sems ni dri med zung 'jug bdag /dngos gred dngos bral rnam par dag /'od gsal chen po nyid la nyid/ /mngon sum mi g.yo brtan par gzung / /tshul 'di rang bzhin mkha' 'dra ste/ /rnam pa thig le bde ba che/ /ngo bo kun tu ma 'gags pa'o/ /sbyangs sdom can gyi chos gcig bzhed / /de ltar sgyu 'dra chos kyi 2rang bzhin med/ /gzhan la ma rig bdag nyid snying dkyil brtan par gnas/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul gcig yin ma nor ba/ /bsgoms na de rjes rmi lam nyid du'ang de mthong 'gyur//gal te sgrib tshogs bud shing tshang tshing gis bsgribs pas/ /yang dag ji bzhin de tshe mngon du ma gyur na'ang / /rnal 'byor rgyal pos re ba chad par mi bya ste/ /goms pa cung zad cig tu brtson 'grus g.yel mi bya/ /mdun gyi mkha' la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal lha yi tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i4/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin gyi phung bo ltar mthong 'gyur/ /de tshe de nas ring po mi thogs 'od gsal 'thob/ /rnam dag 'khor lo pad+mo 'dam nas skyes pa bzhin/ /gnyid 5kyis myos 'gyur ma rig gis bslad blo gros 'di/ /rang gis rang dben mkha' la nyi ltar spros bral du/ /rtsol ba rnged nyid rang dbang mngon sum 'char bar byed/ /rmi lam skyes bus rmi lam gyi//grong du dga' dang mya ngan la/ /bzung ba rlom 6sems can yin la/ /de tshe de yis shes par 'gyur/ /me long gzugs brnyan gsal ba ni/ /yod dang med dang gnyi ga dang / /gnyis pa 7ma yin brjod min pa/ /de tshe yid ches 37—575

mthong bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i ngos la dbang po'i gzhu/ /de bzhin ser sprin 'brug sgra can/ /thog mar skyes dang 'gag mi dmigs/ /'od gsal la gnas skyes bus 1shes/ /ji ltar smig rgyu'i rgyun 'bab pa/ /shar sogs nas ni gang zhig nas/ /ma 'ongs gar yang mi 'gro ba/ /rmi lam mthong ba de yis shes / /dril bu dang ni pi wang sgra/ /brag ca la sogs 'du byed ni/ /rnam par thar pa gsum gyi sgos/ /zab mo rnam par dbe+en pa yang / /snang dang mun pa thibs po dang / /'od gsal bye brag med gyur pa/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser bzhin du/ /dri bral rnam par dag pa rmad/ /ji srid 'dzin pa mang po la/ /zad dang mi skye bsre ba yin2/ /ro gcig nyid du spyor shes pa/ /rmi lam las gzhan rnal 'byor rmi/ /de ni sad pa nyid na'ang / /yid kyi dbang po tshim pa dang / /'dod pa'i srid pa las blo ldog /chos 'di brjod pa tsam rtogs so/ /de ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ /dri ma dri ma bral ba dang //bral ba rang bzhin rnged pa yang / /yid kyis mngon par 'du mi byed/ /'phags pa'i mig ces bshad pa ste4/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi mthu yis so/ /rmi lam dri ma me+ed pa'i bsgom 5pa rdzogs so// //༄za/ /bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs ral gri 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo// /mi gang gnyid kyis log pa na/ /ma 'ongs bkra shis min pa yi/ /ltas gang byung bar 6gyur pa de/ /dga' ba'i ltas bstan 7mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di la btsun pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dad pa thob pa dka' thub can/ /brtse ldan dbang po dul ba yis8/ /bzlog pa'i cho ga gsungs pa yin/ /nyi ma 37—) 76

'char ka'i 'od 'phro tshe/ /gso spyong yan lag la gnas pas1/ /shar du kha bltas gos bzang gyon/ /gdong bkrus me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /gsum la skyabs song brtse chen gyis/ /sna tshogs mchod rjas legs bshams la/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs shig /mdun du bdar te sdig pa bsal2/ /skad cig cho gas lha mchog gi/ /rnal 'byor byas la de yi sku/ /zhal brgya phyag spyan stong ldan dang / /'od phreng dkar po las grub pa'i/ /rdo rje ral gri be con dang / /dgra sta lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje dbyig pa rdo rje zhags/ /'di brgyad re re las kyang stong / /sprul pas khor yug bskor bar blta/ /'khor lo rnam gsum bzlas pa yis/ /bcad dang gtub dang bsreg pa ni/ /ltas ngan rnam par bshig par byed/ /sna tshogs mchod pa sngon 'gro bas/ /gtor ma stong ni rab tu sbyin/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ /ngag bsdams pa yi rgyun chags so/ /oṃ āḥ4ma hā ta thā ga ta aṣ+ṭa sa ha 5ma hā lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ba bo ta pū dza me gha 6sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa hūṃ hūṃ lan gsum gsum gyis so/ /mthar ni 'di'o/ /ma ma ku ṭiṣ+ṭi ku kan+d+ra 7sarba rbad tra sarba tha sha na ka rā phaṭa/a ka ru yis legs bdug cing / /lha mchog mdun du rnam bsams pas/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i sgra phyung ste/ /mkha' la gzha' ltar zhi bar bsams/ /sdig pa dang ni bkra shis min/ /dgra dang gdon kun rab 'jig / pa/ /cho ga'i rgyal po ye shes mchog /spyan ras gzigs kyi brtag pa'o/ /rmi lam gyi lta ba ngan pa rnam par bzlog pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lte dbus las 37—577

—skyes byi ru pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can re/ /snying gnas 'ongs kha bdud ltar dkar ba'i bdud rtsi dīḥ/ /smin mtshams las brgyud in+d+ra mkha' 'dra'i thig le'i rgyal po a/ /gtum mo rnams kyis shaṃ bsreg dṛ 1spyong thig le mchog gso rgyal/ /re zhig byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog la rab gzhol bas/ /sems ni gcig tu rnam par nges shing g.yengs par ma gyur pa/ /'gro ba lnga po rnams la byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang stoms byang chub kyi sems yang dag par bsgoms pa dag gis skye bo gdul bar dka' ba ma rungs pa tha dad pa dmu rgod du gyur pas/ rgyud ma rungs par byas pa rnams kyi khro ba bsal bar bya'o/ /gang phyir srid pa'i sdug bsngal rtsa/ /nyon mongs de yi rtse phyir dang / /bsod nams mang po gzhig phyir dang / /bdag la brten nas gzhan brlag phyir/ /de la bdag nyid bsgom par bya ba'i gnas ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 2rnam par dkar ba zhes bya'o/ /de'i zhal ni brgya pa'o/ /phyag ni stong ngo / /spyan ni rab tu mang ba'o/ /spu re re zhing yang 'od kyi zer glog gi me lta bu rnam par 'phro ba'o/ /sgron shing dang tshil chen po'i mar me la dgyes pa'o/ /a ka ru dang tu ru ska dang / gla rtsi'i bdug pas yang dag par bdug pa'o/ /tshes gcig dang gsum dang bdun la sogs pa'i spyor ba la zhugs parā/ /tshes brgyad dang bzhi dang bco lnga la rgyun gyi sbyor ba la gnas pa'o//bcu drug dang bco brgyad dang gnam stong la sreg 4pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa'o/ /gcig dang gsum dang bdun dang ni/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /bcu drug bco brgyad gnam stong la/ /byis pa'i ston mo grangs rim 5bzhin/ /'di ni zla ba dang po la'o/ /de nas rim bzhin yang phyi mar/ /mas bzlog 37—578

grangs kyi bud med ston/ /de bzhin de phyir 1ci 'byor mchod/ /tshul 'dis sbrul gdug nag po yang / /lcags bsregs 2snod du mar gsar bzhin/ /ring por mi thogs snying brtse can/ /zhu bar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /khro ba bsal ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal thugs rje chen po gdug pa 'dul ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje che ldan sngags pa yis4/ /shin tu gdug pa can gnas sam/ /mi srun skye bos gang ba'i gzhir/ /dpal ldan gdug pa 'dul 5mdzad bsgom/ /ji skad 'byung ba nyid dpal che/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan ldan pa/ /spyi bo 'od dpag med kyis spras/ /s+thāḥyig ye shes snying po can/ /gsal 6byas de thugs nyi ma yi/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong lha mchog stong / /gdug pa 'dul phyir mnyam gzhag pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyis 7skad cig bskyed8/ /spyi gtsug bshang sgo rdo rje'i rtse/ /sbu gu dkar po tal phyin dang / /lte ba lte ba nyid yin te / /de steng 9mgon po nyer mtshan pa'o/ /de dbus su ni rang sems dīḥ/ /khros pa drag po rab gnas bsam/ /brtse bas rtsal bskyed cher 'phel bas /'od 'phros gdug pa bkug mdun bdar/ /cho gas gtor ma sbyin byas la/ /de snying pad+mo gcig dbus hūṃ/ /gdug pa'i sems gang yin pa bskyed/ /cho ga gsum gyis de bsreg go/ /kun du sdang ba med nyid dang / /ltos bral gcig tu snying brtse can/ /dpal ldan mgon po tshe nyid la/ /drin sdod de yis dgra rnams 'jig /gang tshe rmi lam nang du yang / /byams sems zhugs pas snying g.yo zhing / /gzhan don mchi ma 'khrug 'gyur ba/ /de tshe gdug 37—579

pa thul bar 'gyur/ /rlom sems 1dregs pa zhi ba dang / /rtag tu byams ldan snying ston pa/ /mi de'i dam tshig zab mo ni/ /mchod sbyin byang chub sems bsnun bshad/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po gdug pa 'dul ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang de nas skye bo gdul bar dka' ba rnams kyi snying dregs pa zhi bar byed pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ bdag nyid 'phags pa zhal brgya pa/ /phyag stong spyan dpag med ldan sku/ /dkar zhing dri med 'od 'bar ba/ /mi 'jigs sgra sgrogs bsgom par bya/ /shar du ha la zhal gsum khros/ /phyag drug mda' gzhu rdo rje dril/ /be+egs kyu zhags pa 'dzin dung mdog /sbrul dkar gyis brgyan bzhad pa'o/ /lhor ni khro bo ha ha che/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje dril/ /dgra sta kha ṭ+wāṃ thal mo bsdams/ /nam mkha'i mdog can sbrul ser brgyan/ /nub tu gtum chen dmar nag dpal/ /zhal gsum phyag drug lcags kyu zhags/ /nyi zla sdigs mdzub tshangs pa'i mgo /sbrul dmar gyis brgyan rngam pa yin/ /byang du za byed thal mdog can/ /zhal gsum phyag drug glang chen lpags/ /mdung thung 2nge con ral gri phub/ /sbrul nag gis brgyan rgyu ma gsol/ /'di dag dpa' bo khros pa yi/ /cha lugs stang stabs drag bcas pa/ /spyan mangs kyis spras sru sgo nas/ /kun nas me 'bar 'khyil ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga las ji skad bshad pa'i cho gas mchod pa la sogs pa byas la/ bde ba chen po'i pho brang gi rnam par thar pa zab mo dang bcas pas 37—580

ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ yang mchod pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gang dag kun nas nyon mongs pa gang dag gang gi dbang las skyes pa'i nga rgyal gyis 1sems rab tu dregs shing mngon par mtho bar 'gyur ba/ lta ba phyin ci log dang sems phyin ci log gis kun nas dkris pa'i/ 'ching ba dam po'i dbang du gyur pa de dag nyid blos mdun du bya'o/ /de la mkhas pa sdang ba dang / /brnyas bral zhi ba'i sems ldan pas/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms las byung byang chub sems/ /yang dang yang du brtan bsgoms te/ /de yi sems ni rlung gi rta/ /thig le rtsa yi spyor ba can/ /rnam par shes dang gcig gyur ni/ /de gdan pad+ma dmar 'dab bzhi/ /phyogs bzhi'i char gnas bhu baṃ ram̐/ /yo zhes dkar sngo dmar ljang mdog /go rims bzhin du dgod par bya/ /phyogs kyi lha dbang rnam bzhi yi/ /thugs las dbyangs dkar gsal byed dmar/ /phreng ba'i yi ge 'bru gsum gyis/ /mtshams spel khab la khab len bzhin/ /bdag nyid snying ga 4pad 'dab bzhi'i/ /ste dbus rnam par shes bdag hūṃ/ /bsams la dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi/ /'khor lo g.yon du bskor ba yis/ /mthu bsgrubs nas ni grub pa dang / /rmi ltas dkar po bzhi mthong ba/ /de tshe chos sbyin gtor ma sbyin/ /de 'og bstan pas las sbyar bya/ /che ge mo'i duṣ+ṭa tsit+tha shāje 5ku ru ye swā hā/ rjes su gdags pa'i sngags so/ /las ni 'od zer mda' gzhu dang / /me dang mar gyi gong bu dang / /'khrul 'khor bskor dang nyi mun gyi/ /spyor ba bla ma'i man ngag bzhi/ /i ti6// //37—58/

bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo /sngags pa yan lag drug rtsibs drug /'khor lo 'bar ba dri ma med/ /de nang pad+mo stong 'dab la/ /bskal bzangs sangs rgyas brgya phrag bcu/ /lte ba pad+mo can nyid de/ /de snying rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ /de yi thugs ni ye shes che/ /gnyis med thig le dkar 'tsher ro/ /oṃ āḥdīḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ g.yas dang g.yon lag mgo bo dang ni de bzhin rkang / /g.yas g.yon rdo rje yan lag bzhi la go rims bzhin/ /zla mdog me dang nam mkha' in+d+ra dang / /mar me'i dud mdog gnas drug dag gi bdag nyid bsam/ /dzaḥ1hūṃ baṃ hoḥ2/ ji bzhin ye shes gzhug pa yi/ /man ngag gis ni lha bcings la/ /rnal 'byor mu khyud bzlas pa yis/ /dpal phreng gsum gyi sngags ring 4brjod/ /sna tshogs kha dog can 'od zer/ /de bzhin dkar dang dmar ba nyid/ /spyo dang bsdu ba'i spyor ba yis/ /don gsum rtag tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥtweḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ a ā/ i yī/ u u/ ṛ dṛ/ t+pa shā/5 e i/ o au/6saṃ aḥ/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa snya ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ/ rnam dag ye shes thig le las byung bde ba'i rgyun gyis bla ma dang / /de las kyang 'phros pad+ma 'dzin sku shel ltar rab dang rab tu gang / /yang des rdzogs sangs rgyas dang 7nyan thos sras bcas de bzhin 'khor lo yig 'bru nyid/ /mu khyud 'khor lo zag med ro myang byang chub sems rgyun gyis khyab spro/ /de rjes de nyid rim pa yis/ /ye shes 'od gsal phyung bas kyang / /yid kyi mun pa kun bsal zhing / /lus can la yang bdar 8bar bya/ /ji skad bstan pa'i cho ga yis/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dag 37—582

gyur pa ni/ /dmigs bya dmigs byed dmigs bral ba'i/ /rnam par mi rtog rang skye 'gyur/ /dpal 'khor lo rnam dag gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //byed/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po dug thams cad 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can gyis slob ma'i 1snying gi dug spyong ba/'jig rten gsum mgon rtag pa mchog /rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya/ /lnga phung rgyal ba rnam lnga bdag /spyan ras gzigs dpal sngar byas na/ /rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje che/ /rnam dag rdo rje 'bar ba'i dbus/ /legs gzhag 2shin tu dwangs pa yis / /mchod pa kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /de'i —mthar yi ge bzhis brgyan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab 'od zer 'phros/ /snying gi mun pa sel mdzad ni/ /dran pa'i rgyas gdab mkhas pas bsgom/ /skye bo thibs po thams cad la/ /brtse chen rlung bskyod ye shes rnge/ /a phreng sogs bcas phyogs kun du/ /spyo zhing bsdu bas don gnyis bsgrub/ /de 'og rdo rje 'dzin pa yi5/ /thugs kar 'od zer gsum rim gyis6/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bkug nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'gog pas bzlas par bya/ /sngags las skyes dang sku las skyes/ /'od zer las skyes a phreng gis/ /ji srid slob dpon sgu gang ba/ /de srid ma yengs brtson par bya/ /nam zhig snyeng la dga' bas khyab/ /ba spu gyen 'gro mchi ma g.yo/ /sems la ting 'dzin rang byung ba/ /de nas bdag lus kun khyab bya/ /snying gi dug spyong ba rdzogs so// //snga / /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye dgu kun 37—583

kyis 1mchod pa'i gzhi/ /lus yin grol ba'ang de bzhin no/ /de bas 'ching dang grol 'dod pas/ /mgon po'i man ngag 'dir bsgom bya/ /rta bdun bskal pa'i 2me 'od can/ /lte bar hūṃ las yongs gyur pa'i/ /ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la reg bsam/ /hūṃ brjod rdo rje spel bar bya/ /lhag pa'i me lce cher 'bar bas/ /gdug pa thams cad rnam par bsreg /mtha' dag bar chod ma lus bsrung / /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ/sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ /gsum pa rnam gsum rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje me ri rlung dmar rnams/ /rgyud 'brel bar ma chad bsgom bya/ /de nas de dbus lte bar ni/ /thugs rje che khros bzhad pa'i sgu/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog mthing ga can/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin lhas mtshan bsgom/ /ser sprin ltar gnag khro bo'i zhal/ /rab tu bgrad cing mche ba gabyugs/ /brkyang bsgum zhabs gnyis stang stabs tshul/ /dbu skra smin ma smar ser 'khyil/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bzhad pa 'di/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje yi/ /khros pas gdug pa kun 'dul ba/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya gnyis pa yin/ /de nas bsrung ba 'di yi rjes/ /rnam par gzhig pa'i rim pa yis/ /stong par rnam par bsgoms nas ni/ /skad cig tsam gyis rgyal gzungs bsgom/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas skyed sgu/ /dze+e rje mdud pa bsdams pa dang / /rdo rje thos sor zhes pas bsdam//de bzhin rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte4/ /bde chen longs 5spyod chos sprul gyi/ /'khor lo mdzes pa dkar dmar sngo/ /kha dog sna tshogs go rims bzhin/ /sum cu gnyis dang bcu drug dang / /bzhi dang drug cu bzhi pa'i rtsibs/ /kha sbyar kun nas sbug sbug po/ /rtsa mchog srog shing 37—58

dang bcas bsam/ /g.yas g.yon la la ra sa nā/ /'khor lo rnams kyi lte bar khyud/ /gzhan du ngos gnyis 'khrog 'khyog po/ /'dir rgyud ye shes rlung gis gzhug1 /lcags kyu zhes pa'i rlung bzung la/ /'og rlung steng rlung 'then par gyes/ /gnam lcags zhes pa'i rlung nyid kyang / /gzung la steng yang 'og tu mnan/ /gnyis 'dus lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang du bya ba'i rlung sbyangs la/ /goms pas rab tu 'dris par bya/ /lhag par bsnyen 2pa shin tu gces—/ /gang tshe drod stobs kha dog shugs/ /thob nas rtsa mchog rdo rje rtse/ /nor bu lcags kyu'i rlung gis drangs/ /hūṃ gsum brjod pas lte ba'i dbus/ /a gsum brjod pas mgrin pa dang / /de bzhin ha gsum gyis 4spyi bor/ /rim pa bzhin du drang bar bya/ /rdo rje'i mdud rtse gyen phyogs la/ /gnas bzhin mdud pa bzhi btab nas/ /dbu yi gtsug tor cod pan gyi/ /thig le ro myang bsam gtan bya/ /nam mkha' yid kyis lha yi dbang / /snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyis shin tu dri med pa/ /bde chen zung 'jug dag pa 5yi/ /thig le ldung bas 'khor lo dgrol/ /ji ltar sngar ni bcings pa'i rim/ /de bzhin byang chub sems gang bas/ /mdud pa ma lus rnam par bshig6 /tshul 'dis lus kun bde ba yis/ /mngon par gang 7bar gyur pa na/ /gsal dang mi rtog zhes pa gang / /rdo rje 'dzin pas gsal ba'i skur/ /gang bshad gdon mi za bar rnyed/ /de dang de ni ro mnyam du/ /'jug pa'i blo la mi ltos par/ /yid kyi byed pa gcig gis so/ /e ma rnal 'byor rgyal po che/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i ro/ /gang gis skad cig gcig nyid la/ /mngon du 'gyur ba zab mo'i thabs/ /lus kyi 'khor lo 37—583

—bcing ba dang / /dgrol ba'i man ngag rdzogs so// //byed/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs rdo rje thod pa can la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin dang bde ba che/ /mgo phyed khrag bkang nyams dgu'i 1gar gyis rol par bzhugs/ /me tog 'dab dbus ge sar rang gi snying po bzhin/ /lha mchog gis mtshan ye shes lha mo bzhis btud 'dud/ /blo ldan cho ga bzang shes pas/ /bde chen dngos grub nye ba'i phyir/ /ka pā la 'dra'i gnas su ni/ /ka pā la yi dngos grub bsgrub/ /mtshan bzang rin chen mgo phyed la/ /ga pur gla rtsi tsan+dan sogs/ /sna tshogs dri zhim byugs byas te/ /gso spyong can gyes rdodakyil 'khor bri/ /seng khri nyi zla pad+mo dang / /dbugs bral gdan la bzhag 4nas ni/ /lnga mtshan lnga phrag lnga rab dgang / /bde gshegs ring bsrel 5snying por gzhug /'dab 6brgyad rtsibs brgyad mu khyud phreng / /bkra shis brgyad dang rin chen brgyad/ /brgya phrag grub pa'i rdzas 'dzin pa/ /sgeg mo mdzes lha mos bskor dbus/ /'dab bzhi rdo rjes 7mtshan pa'i rtser/ /rgyal po'i pho brang khri bzangs can/ /legs bskyed de mtha' phyogs bzhi'i char/ /lha mo bzhi yi thod pa dgod/ /glang chen myos pa'i mche ba rgo dang smad 'tshong chang 'tshong me long dang / /sa dbang mnga' bdag cod pan dpa' bo sen mo de bzhin dka' thub 'dzin kha sru/ /bde gshegs sku khrus tshil chen dang ni g.yas su 'khyel ba'i dung dkar rnams/ /phyogs mtshams rin chen bum pa bzang la brgyad par bya/ /de nas sngags pa kha shar bltas/ /gos mchog phyi dang dkar dmar lhub/ /me tog phreng bas spras gon te/ /37—586

g.yas g.yon rdo rje'i thod gzung 1'dug /'jig rten mgon po bde chen sku/ /dkar la dmar gsal mdangs mnga' ba/ /rdo rje rin chen rus pas srud/ /rdo rje thod 'dzin nga rgyal bya/ /de mdun rdo rje phreng ldan ma/ /dmar la dkar gsal shin tu mdzes/ /rdo rje gri gug mgo phyed can/ /bcing ba'i phyag rgyas 'khyud pa'o/ /phyi nang gsang bcas rnal 'byor gyis2/ /cho ga bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /mchod byas ye shes pa bkug la/ /'dod pa drag pos gsol ba gdab / /bde chen 'jig rten gsum mgon ni/ /shes rab rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /snying rje chen po ka pā la/ /gnyis med ye shes dhīḥyig 'dzin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje can/ /dkar mo sgeg mo bde ster ma/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa thogs/ /gtso chen gtso mo nyid phyag 'tshal/ /e ma'o stobs bdag brtse slad du/ /ka pā la ni bde chen snod/ /dngos grub phyir ni shes rab thabs / /snyoms par 'jug pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar bstod dang gsol ba yis/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar bsgul ba na/ /'dab bzhi lha mo phyogs kyi lhas//rang rang rjes mthun mchod par bya/ /de nas shes rab thabs snyoms zhugs/ /dkar dmar a phreng ka phreng rgyun/ /bde chen phyi nang sgyug sbyangs nas/ /ring bsrel 4la ni lha bsnyim bya/ /'tsheg dang 'gul 5dang 'phar ba dang / /'od 'byen pa dang sgra grag dang / /rdzas rnams 'phyur ba mthong nas ne+e/ /mchod pa chen po brtsam 6par bya/ /dpal rdo rje thod pa'i dngos grub sgrub 7pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /spyan ras gzigs mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /37—587

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pa brtan 1pa yis /sngags la phyi nang gsang dag gi/ /bar du gcod pa las sems bsrung / /rang lus ji srid rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin rin chen shel 'od mdzes/ /bkra shis sgo stong mchod rten dbyibs/ /bcu drug phrag brgya rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nas sems ni snying gi pad+mo gsar pa'i 'dab/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags ge sar bye ba stong gi rtser/ /a stong ye shes 2sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ /chu dang me long zla ba byad kyi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /dbus su dpal chen thugs cha 4 che / /sor rtse bcu drug gzi brjid brtan/ /bcu bdun sum cu brgyad zhal phyag /dhīḥyig gnyis phreng gis brgyan pa'o/ /pho brang mchog la rab tu gsal ba'i 'od zer sngags bcas gzi chen kun bkram 'bar ba yi/ /rdo rje'i rdul dang ral gri be+e con dgra sta mdung zhags kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug 5mda' chen dang / /tsha zer glog 'khyug gya gyu 'phros las rno ba'i lce phyung 'jigs pa'i rgyu gang 'di dang gzhan / /ma lus da ltar byams pas nyer brlan snying rje'i stobs yid gcig pus nyer zhi brlag par bya/ /mgon po yi ni sngags brjod cing / /bdug pa mchog gis bdug byas la/ /'gro ba'i 'jigs pa 'jigs med byed/ /mkhas pas stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /mtsho chen nang du ri rab gzugs shar de nang rnge long dri med la/ /'dam skyes mdzes 'khrungs sna tshogs bung ba dar dir sgra sgrogs khyu mang 'khyegs/ /mkha' la 'od 'gyed glog rgyun 'bab pas rmi lam yul gyi dgra 'joms pa/ /dpal chen rnams kyi rig sngags bla med ma lus 'jigs 6pa kun skyob yin/ /dus dang dus min 'chi ltas dang / /mya ngan phongs pa ltas ngan dang / /phun sum tshogs min dgra rnams las/ /legs 37—588

skyob 'jig rten gsum mgon rtog /dpal mi 'jigs pa spyin pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba dung dang kun+da 1gangs ri ltar 'tsher ba/ /gzhon nu rab mdzes rin chen phreng bas rnam brgyan cing / /mchog sbyin pad+mo 'od dpag med kyi g.yas g.yon phyag /spyi gtsug legs spras 'jig rten gsum mgon la phyag 'tshal/ /rang lus dkyil 'khor pho brang 'dab stong gsal ba'i dbus/ /zla rgyas mdog lta'i sems nyid ngo bo ye shes dīḥyig 'od 'bar gyis/ /thig le rnam dag bde chen rang bzhin rlung sems bcud gang yin pa de/ /legs bsdus nas ni blo ldan dpa' rnams gnyug ma mchog la brtan gnas bya/ /de yi snying po las spyos pa'i/ /'od zer lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang po ta 2la'i/ /dbus nyid nas ni 'phags pa bskyod/ /shin tu dkar gsal ston gyi zla ba bye ba brgya yi 'od 'khrigs pa/ /bdag gi blo gros pad+mo rgyas pa'i kha dbye'i phyir ni bde gshegs 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas/ /skad cig yud la rta bdun lam gang mgon po nyid mchod sprin rum 'khrigs pa'i dpung bkod pa/ /shes rab snang bas gsal bar bltas la mchod sprin rgya mtshos rab tu mchod/ /lha yi dbang phyug pad+mo'i rigs/ /pad+ma stong ldan sdong bu 'dzin/ /phyogs bcu nas 'ongs phyogs bcu'i char/ /bzhugs bltas de dag mgon mchod bsam/ /tshangs dbyangs sna tshogs sku gsung thugs bstod mnyam med ngag gi skyon bral bas/ /yon tan kun brjod 'dod pa drag pos shin tu gsol btab gus byas la/ /37—589

dzaḥ1hūṃ baṃ hoḥ3sa bde gshegs sa bon zla 'od 'bar ba la bstem bya/ /thim gyur rjes thogs thang cig de nyid bcu drug phyed phyed thig ler gyur/ /de yang yud kyis de bzhin du/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gzhon nur gyur/ /de bzhin de yi thugs kar yang / /rgyal ba'i snying po tweḥbasam mo/ /de las zer bskyod dad pa'i zhags sra rdo rje'i thig gu bzhus pa yis/ /thub dbang thugs stabs skad cig de la thugs rje che mnga' thugs bsgul gyur/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i 'dren pas byin rlabs 4phun tshogs 'od zer dmar mdzes zhing / /gyen du 'greng ltas smin mtshams mdzod spu'i sgo nas thogs med tal phyin phyung / /zla 5zer 'di ni nyi ma yi/ /zer yin de yi lces reg pas/ /snying gi 'dab stong kha dbye zhing / /phye ba'i dbus ni bskyab pa'i sku/ /'od dpung rgya mtsho gang ba 'dis/ /zhag bcu phrag gsum nyid na de/ /blo ldan yid kyi mun sel zhing / /dri ma ma lus rnam par 'khrud/ /rjes la drang srong nyid kyi sku/ /sbud byed rlung gi shugs can gyis/ /'dab stong bdud rtsi'i bum 'thung ba/ /ting nge 'dzin yin 'khrul 'khor mchog / khar+ya pā ṇa 6pad+ma kha 'byed kyi man ngag rdzogs so// //snga / /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po gzugs brnyan gyi rnam par snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin goms pa'i gang zag gis7/ /bden rtog ma lus bzlog phyir dang / /lha yi dri ma'ang spangs pa'i phyir/ /gzugs brnyan gzugs can man ngag bri/ /skye bos rab dbe+en nyams dga'i gzhir/ /'dab brgyad pad+mo phye ba yis8/ /maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong legs bris la/ /de dbus 37—590

———'dren pa snang bar bya/ /shar gyi 'dab mar khri btsugs la/ /de steng shin tu dri med gzugs/ /brtson pa'i cha byad rgyan mang mnga'/ /dkar dmar la sogs bdag yid ltar/ /chu nang rab dang zla ba dang / /gzugs ltar de yi sprul pa gsal/ /shel dang me long la sogs ngos/ /dkyil 'khor lte bar mngon par bzhugs/ /drang srong gtso bo sgyu ma'i rnam thar ni/ /gdul dka' 'dul 1phyir sna tshogs skur ston yang / /de tshe de don de nyid gzugs mi mnga' / /de nyid 'dir ni stong nyid gzugs zhes brjod/ /ma dag lus kyi dri ma thams cad las/ /shin tu ring gyur phun tshogs skur snang la/ /de nyid mkha' ltar dmigs pa rab zhi ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes sgu yin no/ /byis pa rnams ni kha dog dbyibs dbye bas/ /snang ba ji bzhin don de bzhin zhes rtogs/ /mkhas rnams ji ltar snang ba sna tshogs nyid/ /gang snang de ltar de tsam zhi bar shes/ /ji ltar lha yi spyor ba 'dir mtshan med/ /de ltar gzugs sogs dngos kun yang dben na/ /shes rab kyis brtags blo gros rim gnyis la/ /mkhas pas mtshan mar mi bya smos ci dgos/ /de ltar lha dang lha'i rang bzhin dang chos thams cad kyi dag pa rtogs par byas nas rten cing 'byel bar 'byung bas mngon par sprul pa'i lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po dmigs te/bdag nyid rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sku gsung thugs mtshan ma 4nye bar zhi ba'i mthar thug 5par gyur pa 6dang bsre bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus dang byug pa la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang bskor ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas sdig pa spang ba dang tshogs bsgrubs te7/ dngos su 'byor pa dang yid las byung ba'i yo byad dpag tu med pas yang dag par mchod de/ dri ma sbyang 37—59/

—balnga( phyir sngags 'di bzla'o/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥm hā ka pra ti bi pa ru pa 1bi shudhe ta tā 2dz+nyā 0 nā ma ma tsija ma bye pra tis+thā rdor hūṃ/ rnam dag ye shes mchog sprul pas/ /sgu brta3na nyid kyi thugs tweḥyig /'od mdzad me yis 'gro kun gyi/ /'dzin pa gaX rtes bsregs gzugs brnyan gyur/ /dri ma med dang rnam mi rtog /gdul bya ཿdang ni yang dag la/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med gzugs/ /bsgrub pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /thugs rje chen po gzugs brnyan la brten pa'i sgrub thang/sa rdzogs so// // ༄za/ /'phags pa me tog gi snying po'i ge sar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad ldan mang du thos blo sbyangs/ /g.yeng bral rtse gcig yid byed pa/ /de yis 4'phags pa me tog gdan/ /dngos grub nye phyir bsgrub pa'o/ /yul gang me tog kun gsal rgyas/ /'bras bu bzang rnams smin pa dang / /nyams dga' byi dor rgyas ldan par/ /sdig pa spangs nas brtson 'grus brtsam/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser dang sngo/ /kha dog gnag dang kha dog gcig /sna tshogs kha dog can me tog /bsung zhim dri yis bsangs byug bya/ /gser sogs nor mang bkod pa dang / /mu tig la sogs rgyan de bzhin/ /gdugs sogs yo/ byad lhab khrub bcas/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor brgyan phyir dgod/ /gang tshe rang yid dga' bas khengs/ /spyo bas don kun bsgrub brtson pa5/ /dang/la chen dngos grub nyer spyod pa/ /de yi dus ni de yin no/ /gcal bkram pa dang phung po dang / /tshom bu stegs 6brtsegs chun 'phyang lding / /dra ba dra ba phyed khengs — brtsegs/ /ji srid mchod 'os de snyed do/ /sngon du

bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas1/ /dri zhim khang par dad pa yis/ /g.yas bskyod zhugs la rnal 'byor gsum/ /dran byas khri bzang la mnyam gzhag2 /shin tu byin brlabs lhag pa'i lhas/ /dngos grub phyir bsten mgon po'i sku/ /me tog kun bkod mdun bdar la/ /rim gnyis las byung bzlas par bya/ /rer 'jog skyes dang skyes lam 4gyi/ /dhī5ཿyig bdud rtsi'i bum gang bzang / /cig car rtag tu pad+mo'i dbus/ /dam tshig la ni ye shes 'jug /thun mtshams rtag tu bya ba dang 6/ /khrus gsol me tog phreng sogs gdags/ /bsam mi khyab dang mchog rab zhi/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas 'dab stong mchod/ /khyud kor kun du dga' ba yi7/ /lha bu lha mo dad pas yid/ /myos 'dung re re'ang dpag med rdzas/ /mchod phyir thogs pas brtson bskor bya/ /thub sogs dngos grub ma lus dbang can yang / /mchod bsnyan bsgrub 8bya don phyir thugs g.yos pas/ /du ma gcig gyur me tog rdo rjes mtshan/ /phreng rgyun tshangs dbang lte ba'i sbugs su 'jug /oṃ āḥdhīḥ.a a a a a a a/ tri hri hri hri hri hri hri9/ ho ho ho ho ho ho ho7/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ dpal me tog gi gdan can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma can la phyag 'tshal lo//thub dbang mtshan ltas bde gshegs me tog 'dab stong dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i pad+ma 'dab brgya phrag 11mtshon pa/ /skal bzang rgyal ba byang chub phyogs brgya'i lha tshogs can/ /chos 'chad phyag dbus g.yas g.yon sdong bu mdzes rgyas mdud/ /skal ba bzang pos snga dro'i dus/ /dben pa'i gnas su 37—593

byed—maṇ+ḍal bri/ /rin chen khri bkod pad+mo'i steng / /rgyal dang de sras rin chen bzhugs / /bstod dbyangs sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ /rkang pas bro brdung lag gar bsgyur/ /se gol gtogs pas spyi gtsug gzhag1 /khrus gsol de nas rgyan sogs dbul/ /mchod pa lnga dang ldan pa yi3/ /gtor ma chen po dbul byas la/ /rol mo dang ni bdug par bcas/ /lan grangs nyi shu gcig bskor bya/ /me tog du mas bkang ba yi/ /bum pa bzang po bzhi bcas te/ /ba dan dmar po bzhi mtshan la/ /me tog snod bzhis kha rab brgyan/ /phreng ba spel legs mdzes pa la/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sngags btab nas/ /g.yas su 'khyel pa la sogs dung / /snod bzung dal bus dor bar bya/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal mtshan/ /ri dbang rtse nas spyan drangs te/ /bdag lus mchod sbyin byas nas su/ /sems ni sku la bstem par bya rdo rje'i sku mdog 'od bzang mkhregs / /thub dbang ring bsrel do shal thogs/ /gzhon nu'i cha lugs gar mkhan tshul/ /pi wang lhan cig dgyes pa'o/ /ye shes can las ye shes sgu/ /gzhan sprul bum bzang dpag tu med/ /thogs nas dri mchog khrus gsol zhing / /me tog snying pos mchod char dbab/ /phyogs bzhi nas ni dam tshig can/ /sngags pa lhub lhub gos gyon nas/ /rol mo dbyangs dang lhan cig pas/ /me tog sna tshogs char dbab po/ /o s+dzas+thāḥbadz+ra dz+nyā nā bi shubye ma hā bi na bi phube+e 5dha ra/ sarba tāzwa ma ma sarba kā ya wāka tsit+tha pā paṃ ā ba ra ṇa sho dha 7ya/ sho dha ya/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ saṃ ha ra/ ā kār+ṣa ya/ ā kār+ṣa 9ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya gabye dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas gang bdog sa'abyor pa rnams kyis 1 37byed59

bsti stang bya ba dang / /gus pas me tog blangs nas spyod yul kun la khyab par gtor/ /snying po mchog nyid shing lo'i ga pur gzhug cing dri bzang byug /de yi khrus chab bdag gdong bkru bgo 1thams cad bsgrub/ /me tog la brten pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po ri khrod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu yid dga' nags kyi dbus/ /me tog 'bras bu 'dud 2pa yi/ /shing drung rtswa yi spyil bu nyid/ /chags bral rnyog pa med bzhugs 'dud/ /de nas sgrub po ljos pas 'jigs pa dang / /rnam par g.yeng bas dal ba ma thob pa yang rung ste/gcig pu dag dben pa dang yid byung ba'i blo can kyis/ dus bzang po'i tshe nags su song la gang na ljon shing bzang ba la yal ga dang lo 'bras gya nom pa dang ldan pa/ grib ma bsil bas lus skyob cing drung na 'dug na skyid skyid ltar snang ba yod pa zhig btsal te/ de'i 'gram du gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du btang nas rtswa'i spyil bu mdzes pa bcos par bya'o/ /de'i nang gi steng gi gzhir rje btsun spyan ras gzigs spyil bu can gyi rten byin gyis brlabs pa dang ldan pa zhig bzhugs la/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas / me tog gis snyim pa bkang ste/ tsog bur 'dug la sngags 'di brjod4/ /oṃ āḥs+thāḥb na lo ka nā tha/ /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba budhe dz+nyā nā gar+bha ma ma tsit+ta kad+dhā hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/de nas spyil bu de dang rten/ /pho brang mchog dang lha nyid du/ /byin gyis brlabs la me tog gtor/ /skad cig de la bsam gtan bya/ /snyom 5med mi g.yengs 6brtan pa yis/ /zla ba drug gam gsum mam gcig /nges par byas 37—595

na nags kyi nang / /mgon po gang rung gzugs su ston/ /de yi smin mtshams pad+mo 'dra'i/ /ri mo'am thig le gsal bar 'gyur/ /brtson pas ma 'khrugs dkyil 'khor bya/ /mgo btud zhabs la gtugs te gsol/ /oṃ āḥdīḥpū ra pe pra dīts+tsha surmar ho/ thal sbyar mig mi 'dzums pa yis/ /me tog bstabs la sngags 'di brjod/ /de tshe bdag ni byu 'dra yang / /skyob pas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /spyil bu can gyi sgrub 1thabs rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /thugs rje chen po rnga bo che sgra dbyangs rnam par rol pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnga chen gang zhig tsan+dan sogs shing gla rtsi ga pur gur gum byugs/ /phyogs gnyis drang srong ri dwags mo pags 'brug sgra grag dang lhan cig g.yogs/ /pad+mo dmar dang 'khor lo dkar dbus nga ro che bcibs rnga chen brdung / /grags chen dbang phyug sgra dbyangs rol pas sa stengs 2ma lus rgyal gyur cig /dang po re zhig rig pa goms pas mthu thob pa'am/ /gang yang bstan la dgra bo rnam par gnon pa nyid/ /de bzhin sngags myur grags pas grong khyer 'khrug 'dod pa/ /de dag kun yid snying rje ldan sbyar cho ga brtsam/ /'dab chags nga ro chen po'i lo/ /skar ma rgyal la bab pa'am/ /yang na dbyar gyi sgra sgrogs dus / /mkhas pas rnga chen bcos par bya/ /tsan+dan sdong bu dkar dmar ram//sgra sgrogs shing dang snyan pa'i 'dab/ /seng ldeng glang sna bu 'bod dang / /ti ti ra sogs rgyu yin brtag4 /nyi ma shar dang zla ba shar/ / srod kyi dedus la bab pa na/ /gla rtsi ga bur gur gum byug /rdo rje khros pas bgegs tshar bcad//byams pa'i nyi ma gang la bab/ /khri snyan mo yi pags pa sbyangs/ /nam 37—596

mkha'i sgra gsang sgrogs pa na/ /lho ru kha bltas g.yogs 1par bya/ /de nas dri mchog dam tshig can/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pas legs byugs la/ /dbang thob lha bzo skad mthon pos/ /sgra dbyangs mgon po bri bar bya/ /dbus su pad+mo dmar bzhi'i steng / /gzhon nu'i mdangs rgod nga ro bcings/ /phyag gnyis rin chen rnga chen brdung / /zla ba'i mdog can brjid pa'o/ /shar sogs 'dab bzhir grags chen dang / /'brug sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs can dang / /nga ro mi bzad gnod sbyin bzhi/ /phyogs kyi kha dog ji bzhin gnas/ /brtson pa'i cha byad rgyan gyis spud/ /phyag bzhi dung dkar kā la hā/ /dril bu dang ni gaṇ+ḍi thogs/ /mig dmar dga' ba khros pa'i tshul/ /de mthar 'khor lo brgyad rtsibs rim/ /bkra shis brgyad 'dzin lha mo brgyad/ /shin tu sgeg mdzad dul ba'i tshul/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar sna tshogs mdog /mu khyud rdo rje'i sprin 'khregs pa/ /'ur 'ur skad 'byin 'jigs pa dang / /glog rgyun phreng bas mdzes pa ni/ /mkhas pa —ting 'dzin ldan pas bris/ /de'i 'og tu ji skad bsngags pa'i gnas nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo can gyi rnga bkug nas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas te 5rjes su gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas lte ba mu khyud kyi nang gi khyud kor du yi ge chen po lnga dang nye ba'i yi ge lnga bcu byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'dres pas bri zhing / sngags de dag nyid sgra chen po lan bdun bklags 7la rol mo gsel ba dang bro brdung bar bya'o/ /de rjes mkhas pas brgya byin gyi7/ /lag pa 'dra ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /rtsol ba spangs nas rnga brdung zhing / /bdag nyid rnal 'byor brtson pas bya/ /sgrub pa po yi ngag med kyang / /ji tsam bsnyen pa'i mtshan bshad sngags/ / /de yi 37—bye97

phyed kyis 'grub par ni/ /nges par je tshom mi bya'o/ /de yi 'og tu 1 g.yul bzlog pa'am/ /grags pa mtho 'dod de bzhin gzhan/ /thams cad snying rje ma bral bar/ /rnga 'di brdungs pa tsam gyis 'grub/ /'jig rten gsum 2grags mtha' yas pa / /thugs rje chen pos nyid sprul pa/ /rnga chen rgyal po brtag 4pa'i las/ /don kun sgrub 5par byed pa yin/ /thugs rje chen po rnga sgra'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /rgyal ba nyi ma dang zla ba'i phyag mtshan can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po rtul po nyid dang gang / /de bzhin 'jig rten don bsgrub 'dod/ /gzhan dag bsod nams nor 'dod pa/ /de ni nyi zla'i mtshan can bsgrub/ /sprin tshogs rdul dang khug rna du ba dang / /rlangs bral dri med bai ḍūr+ya bcag 'dra'i / /mkha' la dpal bzang nyi zla 'char bar byed/ /de tshe dad ldan smra ba bcad nags 'jug /drang srong bu dang lhan cig nags bzung du/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal skyon ni dran byas la/ /bdud 'dul thub pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya che / /mngon sum bcas te pad+ma'i mig gnyis bskyod/ /de'i 'og tu mchod pa thams cad sta gon byas nas/ bdug pa dri zhim po thams cad 8kyis bdug cing / rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /stobs bcu'i 'od zer chen pos 'gro ba gsum gyi mun pa sel ba dus tshad med par brtson pa'i chos kyi rgyal po nyi ma dang zla ba'i mtshan ma can de ring rgyal bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa'i dbang po rtul po dang / don bsgrub pa dang / bsod nams gnyer ba rnams kyi phrin las thogs pa mi mnga' bar mdzod cig /ces lan 37—pya98

gnyis lan gsum ched du brjod pas ched du brjod do/ /nyi ma zla ba las kun la sngags bdun 'don rnam las 1brjod pa gang yin dang / /thugs rje'i lhas bstan drang srong a bhis shar du kha bltas chags bral rnyed tshe mngon bstod gang / /de bzhin gang gzhan glang po spyong dang gter bdag gser srung 'od ma'i tshal du sngon byung dbyangs/ /de dag ma lus mgrin bzang rnams bsdebs mgrin gcig mchod bcas dad pa drag pos dngos grub stsol4/ /de rjes rta bdun chu yi snying po 'od kyi dra ba can/ /snying brtses thugs brtul glo bur lhag ge byon pas gdong bsal gyur5/ /de tshe ring par ma 'khrugs mchod bya gsang sngags bzlas/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis dbus pad phyag nyi zla'i rgyan can 'bar ba'o / /'khor lo dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog can brtson pa'i cha byad gti mug dang chags pa dang / sdig pa gsum sel ba dang / sbyang ba'i phyir bsreg 6pa dang / bsil ba'i mtshan nyid can no/ /rgyun gyi mthar dran pa'i rgyas btab pa zhes bya ba dang / spyor ba'i rgyas btab pa zhes pa gnyis ci rigs su dran par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥdīḥbadz+ra srur+ya tsan+d+ra kā dza sedhe 7sa ma ya sa ma ya sma ra sma ra a nu smṛ 8ti ka ra hūṃ/ nyi zla sgron ma'i cho ga sdogs so// //snga / /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po grags pa'i rgyal mtshan can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / /'dir 'jig rten pa mang po chos dang ldan pa'i don bya ba la sbyar ba'i phyir/ re zhig dam tshig can yon tan tshul na gnas pa'i che ba bsgrags pas gnas gang du skye bo 'du ba'am/ mang pos mthong ba dang thos pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa zhig bcos la/ rdo rje thab spyor la sogs pas bgegs 37—599

——bsal zhing der khang bu brtsegs pa'i dkyi'/ 'khor rim pa gnyis pa grong khyer pa dang pho brang pa man ngag dang ldan pas brtsig cing bri bar bya'o/ /1de'i khor yug 2'a/ sogs par mchod pa thams cad kyis brgyan cing / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa klog pas phyogs bzhir sgra sgrogs 4par byas la/ rnal 'byor can bdag dang skal ba lhag pa dang mnyam pa thams cad la rnam pa thams cad gus pa'i ched du brjod pas 5ched du brjod pa dang / skal pa dman 6pa rnams la snying rje'i lcags kyus zin pas ji tsam don bya bar bzod pa de srid 'bad par bya'o/ /gang phyir grags pa ma yin rgyun7/ /mi snyan brjod sogs don min phyir/ /mkhas pa grags pa bzang skyong 'dod/ /des ni sdig pa bsal phyir 'bad/ /gdug 8pa'i ngag gi / mtshon rnon pos/ /gzhan gyi grags pa gcod byed cing / /tshe rabs kun tu bdag gi yang / /snyan pa ma yin kun skyed pa'o/ /mi gang bdag nyid skyon brjod kyi/ /gzhan gyi yon tan mi 'phyar 1 la/ /nam yang nyes par smra mi byed/ /de ni grags pa bzang ldan 'gyur/ /ston pa la sogs gud ston byed/ /pha rol grags pa ngan sel brtson / /bdag nyid sdig pa spang la mkhas/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan cho ga bzhi / /sdig pa nyung ngu dang bsod nams mang po can ni 'phags pa dgyes pa'i gang zag ste/ grags pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi tshogs snyan pa mang po rnyed par rung ngo / /des nam du yang khong khro bas gzhan spyo bar mi bya'o/ /slob ma log 1 par zhugs pa la sogs pa 'khrug pas mi snyan par brjod pas slar bzlog pa ni ma yinas / dkyil 'khor bris nas rtsod pa can gyi skyes bu bsten ྾par mi bya'o/ /rtag tu byams pas non pa'i yid/ /'jam zhing yid 'bab snyan smra dang / /37—600

—kha na ma tho med kun spyod/ /rnam 1zhi la grags pa 'grub ste/ /de la 'dir rtsa ba'i rig 2pa sngon du bsnyen pas dbang gyur pa thob par byas nas grong khyer ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rang nyid ci tsam du grags pa bsgrags par 'dod pa de tsam nye bar dgod do/ /pho brang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad nga/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa sprin gyi phung po'i rum phrag na gnas pa rgyun ma —chad par 'brug gi sgra zab mo sgrogs pas mdzes pa'o/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dbus bzhugs la/ /sgra 5ldan brgyad kyis dung 'bud bskor/ /phyogs gzugs mtshams ni phyed gzugs mdog /'dab brgyad la gnas las sgrub brtson / /de bzhin rtsibs rim 6dga' ba dang / /mi phab 7dbyangs bzang nga ro che/ /snyan pa'i tog dang kun khyab byed/ /yid gzhungs don bsgrub / ces bya brgyad/ /dkar dang dmar ser ljang dang dmar/ /dkar dang ljang dang ser bas te/ /lha yi rnga chen brdung ba dang / /sgrub ༷pa po yi bsngags pa brjod/ /g.yer kha la sogs snyan pa'i sgras/ /gong khyer la ni sems byed cing / /pho brang lhan cig 'brug sgra yis/ /ma lus grags pa sgrogs par byed//de ltar dkyil 'khor sa bskyed nas/ bdag gi smin mtshams kyi tweḥlas 'od phyung bas po ta la nas grags pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ de nyid bzhugs pas byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas phrin las la sbyar bar bya ba'i phyir sngags bzla bar bya steḥ/ oṃ āḥdīḥsarba lo ka ma ma krirti sga ra sga ra/ gardza gardza / pra kā sa pra kā sa sa ma ya hūṃ/ ji srid ngal bar ma gyur paras/ /dkyil 'khor rjes mthun don grub byed/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas 'bad byas mthar / /mchod pas glumanyes byas gshegs su gsol/ /grags pa bskyed 37—60/

pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po gzi brjid 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags pa gang zhig lus rid nyam chung dang / /bzhin bzang 1mthong bas 'gro ba dang 'gyur nyid/ /spro ba lhur len skye bo sbud byed pa / /de dag phyir ni gzi brjid bskyed pa bri/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba brjid pa'i sgu/ /ras ris la sogs mdun bzhugs la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad mtshan bstod pa yis/ /gus bstod me tog phreng ba gdags/ /gzhon nu ma brtul me long ngam rin chen sogs 'od brdar ba yis/ /sku bkram me tog spos sogs dbul/ /me yi las kyis dngos grub blang / /sprin bral nyi ma zla ba dang / /mar me 'bar ba'i 'od reg pas/ /sku gzugs gsal bar byas nas su/ /dīḥyig gzi brjid snying po bskyed/ /de la sku mchog bstems la sku/ /rang 'dra dpag tu med 'phros pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs gzi brjid bsdus/ /'go ba gzi brjid bskyed bdag don bsgrubs pas/ /phyi nang lus dang snying gi dbus/ /'khor lo pad+ma pad+mo can/ /gzi brjid rgyal po 'od 'bar ba/ /sdig 'joms rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang chos/ /sangs rgyas sras po gze bskyed la/ /gzi chen 'bar ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /stobs bskyed bya phyir rtag tu dbul/ /sems can gzi byin —chung ngu gang / /de dag la yang cho ga bzhin5/ /bzang dang 'gran zla ma rabs rim/ /dga' dang 'dun pa snying rjes spyod/ /lhag pa'i sems dang lhan cig tu/ /rlung dang 'od dang 'od 'byung zhing / /spro bas skye bo thams cad kyi/ /yid 'ong rlom pa zhu 37— 602

bar byed/ /mi gang 'jig rten mgon la dad/ /'bar ba'i mtshan mas rtag lus mtshan/ /de ni dud 'gro 'dra na yang / /'gro ba'i mig sngar lha ltar sdug /oṃ s+dzadhīḥm hā dz+nyā na swā hā/ oṃ āḥs+thāḥm hā kā ru ṇi 1ka swā hā/ oṃ s+dzat+t+waṃḥm hā dz+wa la ga to swā hā/ lus las me 'bar 'od 'byung dang / /nyi ma la sogs snang bar reg /rin chen sgron ma lag na thogs/ /'di dag gzi brjid sgrub pa'i ltas/ /de nas blo ldan grong khyer sogs 'jug rang gi khyim du de brten la/ /'od 'bar mdog bzangs 4mar me dri zhim bdug pa can skor snyan pa'i sgras/ /legs mchod su yang ji srid bdag song de srid mthong ba 'bab bkag la/ /slar log don bsgrub gtor mas mnyes bya slob ma bzang la rgyu mchod bsgoms/ /gzi brjid bskyed pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzi brjid phung po mthong tsam kyis/ /skye bo kun kyi yid 'phrog cing / /rgyal po'i ngag bzhin thams cad la/ /bsgos 5pa don yod byed rig bshad/ /thog mar brtan g.yo nam mkha'i spyor ba yis/ /ngag bcad 6de las pad+ma zla ba bskyed/ /de steng a dang ka phreng ze'u 'bru can/ /'dres gyur mgon po yid 'ong gzugs can bsgom/ /shel ltar rab dwangs rda rje lta bur mkhregs pa'i sku/ /dkar la dmar dwangs shin tu 'od gsal rnam par dag /bltas pas mi ngoms dpe byad mtshan rab kun rdzogs pa/ /skyabs sbyin chu skyes g.yas g.yon phyag rgyas btab pa'o/ /brgya phrag 'od 'bar rgyan rnams las byung phan tshun 'od zer rnams 'khrugs pas/ /nyid kyi sgu 37—603

bkab dra ba dang ni dra ba phyed dang rdo rje g.yung drung 'khyel/ /zer phog pa dang gzugs brnyan rab 'dres tig tig gong bu 'khyil 'gyur te/ /spu sgo kun la rin chen 'od 'dzag mkha' 1la nyi ltar mdzes bdag gyur/ /de'i snying por yi ge gsum nga/ 'dus pa la nu ma gnyis kyis brgyan pa bltas la/ dad pa dang lhan cig pa'i 'od kyi 2zhags pas po ta la nas gzhon nu 'bar ba nyid bkug la/bcu drug dang brgyad dang / nyi shu dang bcu dang / bdun dang lnga la sogs pa'i lha mo lte ba'i sgo las mngon par 'phro ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod nas/ phyogs kyi gzhon nu ma bzhis yid 'ong mtshungs med la sogs pas bstod nas lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang / dril bu'i rang bzhin gyis bkug byung bcug ste bcings 4la dgyes par bya'o/ /de nas thugs ka dang ljags la yi ge bzhi dang bcu drug gi pad+mo dang 'khor lo nye bar bkod de/ byams pa chen po'i yid kyis bzlas la/ nam kyi tshe skye bo bdag gi ming thos pa dang / gzugs mthong bas dbang po mngon par g.yo ba'i tshe/ de dag gi snying la dhīḥdamar po bsams nas/ sna bug g.yas nas spyos pa'i sa bon las 'od kyi 5mda' bkye ba bsnun te/ de las bdud rtsi rgyun zags pas lus thams cad la khyab par bya'o/ /byams pa'i lta bas rnam blta zhing / /rtag tu kun la snying rje 'jug /chags bral sdang ba yang med pa/ /sgrub po 'gro ba kun yid 'phrog /dbang po rab tu dul ba dang / /dregs med bka' blo rab tu bde/ /'jig rten mgon la lhag par dad/ /yid gzhungs gang yin skal ldan mtshan/ /ci ste 'di brtsams kyis ma spobs/ /de nas sbrang rtsi rma bya'i mdongs/ /me tog bzang po kun 'dab che6/ /spos chus 37—604

sbyar ba smin mtshams byug /byang chub sems dkar dmar thig le/ /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba seng sdeng spags1/ /tsan+dan dmar po ga pur bcas/ /dpral bar byugs la gsang sngags brjod/ /spyan ras gzigs dpal yid 'ong mthus / /dam bcas dam tshig rjes dran phyir/ /rtag 2pa'i rgyal po las byed 'dis/ /skye bo kun yid mngon sum 'phrog /sems can mgu bar byed pa rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po rab tu snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bar 'gyur ba nges par mi shes pas ci bya gtol med par gyur te ldongs pa rnams kyis 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rab tu snang mdzad la re ba bskyed la/ zhag gsum mam gnyis sam gcig gi bar du yid la byed pa gcig dang mi 'bral bas rig pa bzla zhing smyung bar gnas par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ na maḥshrī āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa 4rā ya/ bo bye satā ya5/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ dar+sha dar+sha/ pra dar+sha pra dar+sha/ sarba budzha dz+nyā na gasgo 6tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha ma ma sa pa ṇa twoṣ+ṭha 7pra dar+sha hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ 'jig rten mgon po'i mchod rten la/ /me tog dkar po sogs bdug bcas/ /mchod pa mang pos nyer mchod cing / /phyag 'tshal kun tu bskor bar bya/ /lus kyi 'dab skyes 'dab bzhi la/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos po bzhi/ /man ngag bzhin du ri mor dgod/ /ge sar rang sems me long ngo / /de nas lhag pa'i lha dran pas//sdig la sogs pa bsal nas ni/ /'phags pa'i zhabs la mgo gtugs 8la/ /snang ba gsal pos snyoms par 'jug /sangs rgyas sras po thugs rje can9/ /37—605

—kun mkhyen lus can kun don bsgrub/ /'od 1ldan yul la rtags skugs ltar/ /dus drug gzigs des mkhyen pa 'jug /tho rangs dge slong dkar po dang / /pad+mo'i rtags can bud med kyis2/ /'dod pa'i don gang yod pa de/ /me long nang gi gzugs ltar ston/ /rmi lam ston pa rdzogs so// //byed/ /mgon po mya ngan med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse chen ring nas gdug 3pa spangs pa'i rgyus/ /rnam kun skye bo mya ngan sel mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan mgon po mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ /ji bzhin sgrub thabs bdag gis 'dir bsdu bya/ /rkang gnyis skyil krung lag pa mnyam par bsnol/ /mig phab rdo rje skyil krung brtsegs 4nas ni/ /rta mchog rgyal po dal bus rjes 'gro dang / /'ong bas rgyud rab rtse gcig gyur pa na/ /bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sgu gsung thugs kyi yon tan dran par byas pa mchod pa rgya chen po sngon du 'gro bas bcom ldan 'das spyan drang bar bya'o/ /rim pa gang dang ldan pas gsol ba btab la/ de'i snying po ri bong can las 'od dang bdud rtsi dang yi ge tweḥ'i 5rgyun gyis bstar 6ba'i phreng ba phyung ste/ bsgrub bya'i snying gi ze'u 'bru'i rtse mo nas brlan par bya'o/ /bde gshegs zla ba dkar mdog mun sel ba / /rnam par me rtog 'od mdzad mya ngan med/ /cig car ting 'dzin chos sgo brgya phrag la/ /mnyam gzhag chos ston til gyi gang bu bzhin/ /rdul bral dgra bcom dbang po rab zhi dang / /kun spyod brtul zhugs thogs med rnal 'byor can/ /mkha' rgyu stobs chen sa yi lha mo sogs/ /skad cig gis lhags gre tog gtor ma sbyin/ /snying dbus dkar 'tsher a dang drag po'i mig gnyis 27byed606

la / /yi ge bdud rtsi 'od gsal phreng ba mas rim 1bzhin/ /mya ngan med cing mya ngan de bde dang / /mya ngan rnam dag bla ma'i gdams ngag bzhin/ /kun mthong ri bo'i rtser gnas rtswa zil la/ /brag ngos me tog snying po bzhag 2nas ni/ /rjes mthun skye bo yid rab zhi ba yis/ /dbyangs brjod mya ngan med mgon dran pas sbyin/ /gnas gang na 'bab chu dang ne+e'u gsing dang me tog sngon po 'am/ dkar pos brgyan pas/ dus dang nye bar sbyar ba'i gtam grags pas sems tshim par byed cing / snying rje chen pos bsten pa'i gzhir lha'i rnal 'byor la snying por byed pa'i grogs dang lhan cig pas nyi ma bdun nam/ dgu 'am bcu gcig la sogs pa'i bar du gnas par bya'o/ /rtag tu lha yis dbugs 'byin dang / /pha rol sems dang yon tan dran/ /'jig rten mgon la yid rton 5pas/ /skye bo'i mya ngan mya ngan sel/ /oṃ āḥ6dīḥka ra ka ra a/ tsa ra tsa ra i/ ṭa ra ṭa ra u/ ta ra ta ra e/ pa ra pa ra o/ ya ra ya ra saṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ/ sho ka shan tā pa ha ra ha 7ra/ a sho ka pā ha ra pā ha ra a sho ka ni/ swa bhā ba shu n+ya 9tā a phaṭa swā hā/ yid 'gyod pa bsal ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po longs spyod mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /re zhig sgrub pa po 'byor pa dman pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa rgud pas zil gyis 7non te bag zhum pa dang 1 / yod kyang myur du 'dzad pas ma rungs par byed pa de dag thams cad/ chags pa dang brnab sems kyis rang dang gzhan gyis 1 yongs su bzung ba la mngon par gdung ba spangs te/37—607

————byeda'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs rgya mtsho'i gter gyi bdag po la skyabs su dong bar bya'o / /shel dang bai ḍūr+ya dag 1dang / /nī la rin chen las grub pa'i/ /gzhal med khang mchog dbus su ni/ /mgon po longs spyod mi zad bsgom/ /gser gyi bum pa bzang bkang ba/ /nor bu tshom tshom sgyug pa'i kha/ /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa'i gseb/ /sprin grib la ni yongs su rtsen/ /g.yas dmar g.yon sngo dbus dkar zhal/ /snang mtha' rdo rje thig le'i brgyan / /nor sbyin byen rlob skyabs mdzad dang / /gter dang lcags kyu pad+mo'i phyag /skyil krung phyed brten kun da'i mdog /'dom gang 'od gsal 4'khor lo so/gas / /rin chen bdun 'dzag mu tig 'bru'i/ /char 'be+ebs g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'o5/ /de'i phyag rgya nor sbyin par mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi can gyi mthong thos las/ nor bu dang 'bru dang sman gyi char dong tshe brtsegs pa lta bu rgyun ma chad nga/ra 'ongs/ bas bdag gi 6longs spyod thams cad kyi sbubs su 'jug par bya'o / /oṃ āḥdīḥshrī āt+yā wa 3lo ki te shwa ra ma ma sarba saṃ bho ga / rat+na rasne/ma hā byed sam ṇi dha ra dha ra a k+ṣa ya a smro pa tisru ti hūṃ/ bdag nyid btsun mo pad+mo can gye ting nge 'dzin gyis me tog dmar po dang dkar po sil ma thogs la/pog phor bdug cing thal mo sbyar ba 'am/ 'dud pa sngon du song bas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas ji tsam longs spyod pas zad pa de tsam 'phags pa'i phyag nas blang ngo / /bla ma dang lha mchod pa dang phan pa'i gnas dang / mgon med pa la sbyin pa'i rim pa lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ma bral ba ni dam tshig go/ /grub pa'i 'bras bus lus can la/ /bsngo dang nga rgyal med nyid dang / /byin pas dbul dang phongs 'gyur zhes/ /dogs bral de yis 5spyad mi bya/ /27—608

longs spyod mi zad pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po dpag bsam gyi shing can la phyag 'tshal lo /dpag med bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab smin pa'i rgyus/ /gang sgu mi gtong dpag bsam shing chen bsil grib can/ /'gro ba'i don du shin tu rmad byung sku ston pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che mnga' 'dir mnyes brjod/ /thog mar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o / /phyi dang nang la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa sgyur ba'i rim pas rgyas btab la/ bdag ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i ngang la gnas pas/ rin po che'i sa gzhi las mngon par byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga dang / me tog dang 'bras bu bsam gyis 1mi khyab pa rgyas 2pa/ spos kyi ngad zhim pos bsrung zhing de las grub pa'i sil snyan gyi sgras chos kyi sgo thams cad yang dag par ston pa/lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis bstod cing phu dud byas pa'i sdong bu chen po la bzhugs pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kun nas 'od zer bkod pa'i rgyal po/ kun du zhal kha dog bzhi pa phyag brgyad kyis rab tu mdzes pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis mi g.yo bar bzhugs shing / 'od dpag tshad gcig pas btsun mo dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor lham me lhang nger 4gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /chags bral chags pa'i kha dog can/ /nor bu 'bar bas brgyan pa'i sgu/ /blta bas mi ngoms btsun mo dang / /lhan cig 'jigs skyob la sogs 'khyud/ /gzhan dag sdong bu las phye ba/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu dgu yal ga /zla ba nyi ma sogs steng du/ skal bzang sangs 37—609

rgyas 'dzum pa mdzad/ /shākya'i rgyal po thugs ka dang / /'od dpag med dpal cod pan dang / /smin mtshams na ni mi bskyod pa/ /phyag mthil rdo rje mgrin sngon nyid/ /gang dag 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan/ /bkra shis rdzas dang nor dang 'bru/ /me tog rgyan dang mchod rdzas sman/ /gang yod ma lus 'dir sprul bya/ /bai ḍūr+ya rang bzhin sdong bu rab tu kun nas brjid chags 'khrungs pa yi/ /yal ga bzang gyes phyogs bcur 'dud rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khur khyer zhing / /'bras bu g.yur snaza me tog kha phye phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin ston pa/ /mkha' khyab dri ldang 'jig rten gsum skyabs dga' ba skyed 2par byed pa yin/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gus pas rdzas dang bcas pas rim gro rdzogs par byas la/ sdig pa bsal ba dang / 'gro ba'i don du gsol ba btab ste4/ rang gi spyod yul du gnas par bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu dpag bsam gyi mchod pa dbul 5ba dang / lhan cig tu rig sngags bzla zhing gar mkhan dang rol mo mkhan dang / glu mkhan la sogs pas dgyes pa bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥkalpa z-ik+ṣa hūṃ/ nam zhig skyo bar gyur na yang / /ye shes rten la bsdus nas su/ /dam tshig dran pa'i rgyas btab ste/ /tshogs brdar ba ni mkhas pa'i lugs/ /dpag bsam gyi shing can gyi sgrub 6thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po bum pa bzang po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gter chen bum pa gser gyi mchog /dpag bsam shing ltar 'gro ba yi/ /re bzhin yal ga bzad dgyed 7pa/ /de yi dbus bzhugs nyid dpal 'dud/ /27—610

gang yang sgrub 1po blo gros che/ /dad dang ldan yang dbul gyur pa/ /de dag gis ni 'byor pa dang / /dngos grub lhan cig 'phags pa bsgrub3/ /re zhig phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas sam bum pa bzang po lta bu'i dbyibs kyi gzhir de dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bu bcos la/ gang du 'jug 4pa'i mal du mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bum pa bris te/ rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya la bab pa na spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snyan gsan phab la/ zla ba gcig gi bar tshangs par spyod pas btsun pa dka' thub chen po can mnyes par bya'o/ /slad kyis yang zla ba rgyas pa'i nyin mor gyur pa na/ gos bzang po gyon/ skra dang kha spu ni bcos/ rgyan du mas ni brgyan/ rol mo mang po ni dkrol 5te/ 'phags pa'i rten la phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa 6bya zhing / snying gar tweḥbasams nas de'i 'od kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bum pa la bstem mo/ /gzhal med khang mchog rin chen bum pa bzang 'khyel la/ /lha rdzas mgul bcings yid bzhin yal ga 'bras bus brgyan/ /de 7dbus sdong bu me tog u dum bā ra'i rtser/ /'jig rten gsum skyob dmar mdzes nor gyi rgyun can bsgom/ /dpag med lo 'dab me tog tshogs 'khrungs pad+ma'i yang / /ge sar rtse la rgyal sras chos mang ston pa dang / /rtse dga' mchod pa'i lha tshogs rnam par 'apo ba yis/ /sa 'dir ma lus cig car cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul/ /mig gi dze+e bskyod rkang pa ya gcig bteg 9pa dang / /lag pa dkur brten 'dzum pa'i mdangs legs 'gying ba sogs / /mi yi bu mo bzhin bzangs rnams kyang bka' bsgo la/ /bu 7 bzangs mdun byas 'phags pa mchod la brtson par bya/ /oṃ āḥs+thāḥsarba budha 37—6/ /

be+e ma 1rid+dhi rat+na 2—dha ra dha ra bye ri bye ri dhu ru dhu ru badz+ra dz+nyā na kā ru ṇa —ye/ rat+na gha ṭa bha dra saṃ pūrba/ su 5saṃ pūr+ṇa ku ru choswā hā/ srung 6skud dri ldan lag tu thogs / /me tog phreng bas mgo bcings la/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas sngags bzla zhing / /bum bzangs 3las ni dngos grub blang / /dkar nag phyed phyed phyogs kun la/ /dbul po tshim par bya ba dang / /rnyed pa'i dang pos bla ma mchod / /kun la chags med mchod sbyin spyadabye/ /bum pa bzang po can gyi sgrub 9 thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po lam gyi bzhi mdo can la phyag 'tshal lo rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten la/ /thugs brtses dben pa spangs nas ni/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor kun don spyod/ /spyo ba med skyob sgrub skyethabs bri/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po can gyis shā1bdag nyid grags pa la sogs pa'i phyir ma yin par lam kyi bzhi mdo dang tshong 'dus skyechen po la sogs par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bsgrub par bya'o/ /de ni thugs rje shes rab kyis/ /dben pa spangs phyir chags med phyir/ /lam chen zhugs dang ltos 1/med phyir/ /'du 'dzir 'du 'dzi med pas grub zhe/ /re zhig skye bo mang po'i spyod yul du byed pa'i gnas ni 'phags pa dgyes pa'i gnas yin pas der spyil bu 'am khang bu la sogs pa gnas mal kha dog dkar po pad+mo'i tog can legs par bcos la/ ji snyed 'byor pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis 'phags pa nyid mchod pa'i phyir brtson par bya'o/ /skyob pa skyob pa skemed gcig pu/ /ljon shing bzang la sku brten ltete/ /pad+mo dang ni 'bras bu ster/ /bcu drug na 37—612

tshod mdzes pa'o/ /cho ga bzang shes bdag dang lha/ /tha dad rim go bya byed du / /bltas 1te dus gsum mchod pas mchod/ /de mnyes bya phyir rig pa bzlas / /oṃ āḥ2dz+rīḥsarba lo kārja sarba sid+dhi sid+dhi t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sarba satālbā pa ri pū ru 4pūrba sa ma ya sma ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba tsit+ta saṃ duṭ+wān 5bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ pra trut+pan+da su 6saṃ bha ba ka ra hūṃ t+t+waṃ t+t+waṃ zhes bya ba'i 7'bum phrag gcig bzlas la/ de'i phrin las yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ lam gyi bzhi mdo la sogs par mchod rten bzhengs par bya'o/ /de'i nang du pad+mo'i sdong bu dbus ma la bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs skyo ba rnam par spangs pa dang / shar la sogs pa'i sdong bu bzhi la lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang be+egs sgrog dang dril bu can gyi thugs rje chen po/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /ljang gu'i kha dog can rnams bcos la/ rab tu gnas pa cho ga ji lta ba bzhin byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /skye bo mang po don gnyer la / /skye med dkyil 'khor sprin gyi tshul/ /mkha' la lding bas steng brgyan pa/ /mgon po rnams kyi yid bzhin nor/ /srog chags gang gang dad yod dang / /dad med shes dang mi shes pa'ang / /kun tu lam chen 'dir rgyu na/ /de dag ngan 'gror 'gro mi srid / / rang gis mthong dang thos dang dran/ /grib mas reg dang so sor rtog /de dag rnams kyang ma thogs par/ /'jig rten mgon gyi zhing du skye/ /lam chen po'i sgrub —thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /wa ti'i rgyud can gyi thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar bsil ro brgya bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab nyid kyi phyag /glang chen sna phub lha 27—6/3
