brgya'i cod pan gyis gtugs 1pa/ /ma lus sa stengs zhi ba bsgrub mdzad mchog gi bu/ /dpal ldan dpal chen spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid rtag 'dud//dgar dang mya ngan ha cang sdig mang dge ba sogs/ /'gyur ba'i las kyi dbang po gang yin de gzhan 'gyur/ /de tshe lha mchog wa ti'i rgyun 'be+ebs dus gsum du/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rnam pa kun du mi g.yeng bsgom/ /de la rgyun 'bab pa ni gnyis te/ yid kyi las can dang / dngos po'i las can no/ /yid kyi las can ni mtshan mo la'o/ /dngos po'i las ni nyin par ro/ /gang na 'jug ngogs bde zhing dri ngad ldang ba me tog ljon shing g.yur za bas mdzes par / nyid kyi phyag dpung pa tshun chad —yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ /mkhrig ma'i bar du yang rung ste/ de lta bu'i gzugs gdu bu dang sor gdub la sogs pa 5rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dang bcas 6te/ mdog bzang pos bsgyur 7la / zla ba nya ba dang nyi ma shar ba'i dus gang rung la rab tu gnas par bya'o//rnge tog char dang bdug pa'i sprin gtibs rol mo 'brug sgra cher bsgrags shing //9ba dan rnga yab glog gi rgyun 'khrigs ro bzangs zhal zas kyis mchod de/ /bar snang 'gro bas phrin las rjes bstod tshangs dbyangs nga ros dril bsgrags la/ /rdo rje dril sgogs dgyes pa'i gar bskyod rdo rje dga' bas bro gar dbul/ /de nas yi be gsum sngags kyis/ /byen gyis brlab pa'i rgyun phab pa'/ /pad+mo'i phyag gis ming med kyi / /rtse nas legs bstar snying po sabatung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i dang po dbang / /dag byed dri med bde ba che/ /de 'dir pad+mo sems dpa' che/ /rnam rta dag 'od gsal rmad yin no/ /ji lta ji ltar spyi gtsug nas/ /rgyun 'bab de la de ltar ni/ /skal ba bzang po'i lus ngag 37—6/

yid / /dri bral mi mnyam 1mnyam par 'gyur/ /gzhan dag phongs pa sna tshogs dang / /phun sum tshogs min gang gyur pa/ /de dag kyang ni skad cig gis / /spang 2gyur 'thungs pa tsam gyis so / /dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug wa ti can gyi sgrub 4thabs dze+egs so// //snga / /thugs rje chen po gtsug tor nas byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo / /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i skye bo ldongs pa yang / /gang gis shes rab thugs rje 'bar ba yis/ /mi gtong rtag tu spyi gtsug rtsa mchog rtser/ /brtan bzhugs bdag gir mdzad pa dgongs grub shog /mi ni ring nas dad dang mngon 'dod yod/ /de la drang srong nam yang mi ring ste/ /thag ring mtsho nang pad+ma skyes pa yang / /bung ba nags na gnas pa nyin rer brtul/ /'di na tshangs sogs grags chen mthu can yang / /na 5rgas skye 'chi srid pa'i dgra tshogs las/ /rgyal bar ma gyur ya nga 6ma spangs na/ /nus pa bdag la byu zhig bde ba yis/ /sa gsum dbang phyug 'jig rten skyob nyid 'dir/ /mchog dman bar ma'i yid can skal rim bzhin/ /snying dbus spyi gtsug ring nas skyob dam bcas/ /de bzhin skyabs 'dod gtsug tor cho ga bsam/ /dkyel 'khor bstan bcas mig phab ste/ /smyug 7ma lta bu'i tshigs rgyun gyis/ /sgo gnyis nas ni dbugs bzlog la/ /rtsa mchog rtser ni thugs dbang lha/ /rta mchog lam ni sdong bus te/ /dkyil 'khor gang yin rgya mtshos/ /spyi gtsug 'dab ma bye bas te/ /de steng mtho gang 'phags pa lha/ /lnga ldan yal ga dbus 'dab la/ /mi g.yo'i phyag rgya pad+mo 'dzin/ /rtsa skyob rlung skyob thig le 37—6/pya

skyob / /ting 'dzin skyob rnams phyogs bzhi'o/ /dīḥyig snying ga las 'ongs sa bon dang / /ri dbang nas bskyod ye shes lha/ /'dus gyur bde gshegs bzhir bcas yum/ /sgrub pa bos ni rnam par bsgom/ /'od dang thig le mnyam par gzhag1 /rang gnas snyoms par 'jug pa dang / /'du 'bral 'du byed nga/ dang de/ /zhi ba nyid dang 'od gsal rtag /thog ma bar dang mthar rim bzhin/ /smin mtshams tshangs sgo nam mkha' yi/ /lam nas 'jug cing 'bab dang gnas/ /nyid kyi sngon du dam bcas pa'o/ /gang dag rnam par mi g.yeng bas/ /thun gsum du ni rtag tu dran/ /snying rje chen pos kun spyod pa/ /kha na ma tho med 'grub rgyu/ /pad+mo'i sdong bu can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal thugs rje chen po dri ma 'jig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang 'dir bshad par bya ba'i dus/ /snga dro 'dab chags sgra sgrogs 5tshe/ /dpal ldan po ta la rgyal ba/ /dad pa drag pos dmigs nas ni/ /me tog dmar po dri ngad bzang po gsungs pa 6ji snyed tshogs pa btus la/ gser gyi snod dam kham pa'i ཿ snod yol mor srungs te/ zangs sam mtshal gyis byugs pa'i bum pa rgyan dang bcas pa lnga tshan lngas gang ba dkar po'i chu dang sbyar bas yog pa lhag ma'i rgyun mchu gtigs nas 'bab pa steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /ldong ros dang gla rtsi dang ga bur la sogs pa dri dam pas byugs pa'i sgu gtsug tor du bzhugs so/ /shar dang lho dang nub byang rim/ /me long byug pa rnga yab rgyan/ /btags la thun mtshams phrin las dbul/ /thal sbyar mi g.yeng 37—6/6

gus bstod mchod/ /de nas gtor ma dang mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa thams cad kyis rgya cher phu dud du byas te/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang lhan cig pa'i rol mo phul la bstod nas/ lag pa rdo rje'i khu tshur bcangs pas rdo rje byin gyis brlab cing / rdo rje dang pad+ma mtshon pa'i pi wang bsgreng zhing snyan pa'i nga ro gsangs 1bstod pas sngags ni bzla'o/ /oṃ a i u e o saṃ dī2ཿbadz+ra a mṛ ta dza ra dza ra phe phe phe phaṭa swā hā/ 'od zer dmar po rgyus pa yi/ /sngags phreng dmar po 4'khor lo can/ /cig car rtag tu bar ma chad/ /rgya mtsho la ni char rgyun bzhin/ /bdag nyid dri ma 'jig pa yi/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal kyis/ /ye shes bstims pa'i rjes la bum pa steng gi lha bdag nyid ji bzhin du bskyed 5de/ bdag dang de'i srin lag nas 'bab par rig par bya'o/ /dngos sam nyams sam rmi lam na/ /lha mthong ba dang lus bkrus dang / /bum nang pi wang sgra sgogs 6pa/ /grub pa'i ltas yin de nas spyad/ /spyan ras gzigs dri ma 'jig pa'i bum pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po kun nas 'bar ba'i mtshan ma can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā oṃ āḥdīḥbadz+ra badzobye wa sarba dhadz+re ni/ swa bhā ba rū 7pe ta gar+bha ḍir+bha dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra ti dz+wa la pra ti dz+wa la ha na ha na pra ha na pra ha na/sarba ta thā ga to tsit+ta sdi ra t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ lte dbus rta bdun 'bar ba nyid/ /dhīḥyig 'phros pas mtshams bsgoms la/ /spro dang basbu ba'i spyor ba yis/ /tshogs sgogs rdo rje sgeg par blta/ /hūṃ brjod rim gyis 'phel 'gyur te/ /a brjod bdag lus bzhu ba ni/ /rdo rje la bcug hoḥ/brjod pas/ /kun du 37—6/7

bskor zhing spang bar bya/ /lte bar hūṃ mtshan rtsa ba a dang de bzhin ho/ /a sogs ka sogs bde chen bdun pa'i yi ge'ang de mthar phreng ba'i tshul/ /sngags brjod rab zhi gdug pa'i sems skrag ye shes me lce 'bar/ /mi bzad sgra grag nam mkha'i ngos la ser sprin 'brug gi nga ro bzhin/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po gzi brjid che/ /thugs rje khros pas 1drag pa'i thugs/ /dpal ldan rnam par rgyal phyag 'tshal/ /dgra gdon 2spyig pa kun sel ba'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'bar ba'i bsrung ba chen po'i man ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po spyan 'khor lo rab tu 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo / /thugs rje chen po gdul bya yi/ /don du lhor bltas 'khor lo bri/ /nyi shar zla rgyas skar mda' 'phro/ /'brug sgra grag dang char drag 'bab/ /sprin med pa dang rnyed pa thob/ /de tshe sngags gsum rim bzhin no/ /ga pur tsan+dan dkar thig le/ /sku gdung khrus chab spyor ba yis/ /mu khyud a phreng dkar ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rab dkar bri/ /oṃ āḥ4trīḥhūṃ hoḥ5phaṭa swā hā/ gla rtsi tsan+dan dmar zla mtshan/ /snying rje chen po'i me tog chus/ /ze'u 'bru dkar phreng dmar ldan pa'i/ /pad+mo 'dab brgyad rab dmar bri/ /tweḥshrīḥbye sgo dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ gu gul sbrang dang rmyas byed chu/ snyeng rjes zags pa'i mchi mas sbyar/ /thabs shes thig le gnyis ldan pa'i/ /lte bar bde gshegs snying po bri/ /sngags gsum rdzas gsum go rims bzhin/ /ming dang rus dang sa bon dgod/ /rak+ṣaḥ6gnyis kyis mtha' rten la/ /mi 'gyur thig les mtshan par bya/ /de nas dkar phyogs gza' skar shis/ /ye shes 27——6/8

bkug nas rab gnas bya/ /me tog dkar dmar sngo gtor la/ /mchod pa kun gyis mngon mchod gdags/ /srung 1ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs so// //༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med rnam par mi rtog dag /zhi ba'i dbyings su bsrung sdogs nas/ /thugs rje'i stobs kyis gzhan skyob dpal/ /'jig rten mgon po la btud brjod/ /ya nga mya ngan phongs pa yi2/ /gnas su bdag nyid de nyid tshe/ /pad+mo can gyi lcags kyu yis/ /rdo rje chen po'i bsrung ba brtsam / /bde gshegs mdzad pa'i lhag ma can/ /lte ba rwa rtse pad+ma lhas/ /mtshan pa lhag par gnas legs byas / /sor bzhi sor gcig tshon gang tshad/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bkod dbus su / /sgron chen bzhis bskor pad+mo'i steng / /grags chen phyag rtse nas 'bab pa'i / /'o mas khrus gsol mchod pas mchod/ /pad+ma rdo rje dam tshig che/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran pas/ /bdun phrag gcig tu bzlas bsnyen te/ /ye shes rgyal po mngon bzhugs bstod/ /oṃ āḥ.āḥ.āḥdīḥdhīḥdīḥ4t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/tha mal lus dbul rdo rje brtul5/ /rdo rje'i yi ges rnam brgyan pa/ /rang ming bzlas pas spel ba dang / /lus bzhu rdo rje'i gzugs su 'gyur/ /rtse gnyis rwa dgu go rems bzhin/ /khro phaṭa 'bru dgus dbus brgyan pa/ /de nyid sngags pas me dpung 'khrug /thugs rje khros pas rngam par byed/ /lta stangs 6bsreg dang bskrad ཿ pa dang / /gzhig dang bsnun dang gsod pa'i 8las/ /brtan pa rnams kyis kun spyod la/ /nam yang 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /gnyid dang myos dang rnam par g.yeng / /nad dang mya ngan glo bur dgra/ /drug po 37—6/9

las ni rdo rje yi/ /thod par lus bcug rdo rjes bcing / /zhu lub ba spu glang chen gos/ /mgal dum ga'u gzhal med khang / /rnal 'byor chen po bdag dang gnas/ /bcing bas bcings par 1shes par bya/ / ra ba 2bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po thugs rje khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus yon tan rgya mtsho'i mthas klas pas/ /'gro ba'i don du rmad byung shin tu grags / /stobs bcu lha dang mi lus rnam rgyal ba/ /gtso bo nyid gcig thugs rjes khros la 'dud/ /snying rje shes rab 'od gsal shes rab dag /gnyis med gnyis su rab ston pa/ /de ming thugs rje chen po'o/ /gdul bya'i don mthong rang bzhin dang / /cig shos zhi dang zhi bral dang / /gdul bya rnams kyi don phyir ni/ /dpal ldan 4bzang khros par snang ba5/ /nyin mtshan zla ba dkar dang nag6 /dul ba dang ni gdug pa dang / /gnyis la gnyis mdzad mgon po mchog /cha lugs gnyis kyis gnyis bya'o/ /bdag nyid rdo rje chen po yi/ /bsrung bas gzi byin bskyed pa'i rjes/ /de yi gnas dang lus bskyab pa'ang / /ji bzhin cig car thog thag brtag /oṃ āḥdīḥhūṃ/khro āḥbyeḥho / a āḥdhīḥhaḥ / e āḥdīḥphaṭa/ rgya gram gzugs kyis bzhad pa'i zhal/ /gnam lcags rgyun sgra sngags kyi lces/ /bsrung ba bya dang brlag bya ba/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor las gzhan min/ /gzhan bskyab pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //37—620

༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rdo rje'i rgyas btab pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la dad pa thob pas tshor bas gzir ba dang / gdon gyis glags btsal ba dang / rkun po dang dgras 'jigs pa'i nus pa'i 1dbang ba bsrung ba la sogs pa'i don du snying rje chen pos srung sgud 2bcing bar bya'o/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+mo sna tshogs kha dog can/ /ras dang dar dang bal dang bcas / /pad+ma'i skud pa shin tu bsngags/ /gzhon nu gos dmar gos dkar gyon/ /rgyan dmar rgyan dkar de bzhin du/ /cod pan thabs dang shes rab 'dzin/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin g.yas g.yon 'dzin4/ /mchod pa kun sngon 'gro ba yis/ /'dab brgyad pad+mo bris dbus su/ /gnyis kyis srad bu bzhag 5nas ni/ /bgegs bsal gtor ma sngon song sbyar6/ /de rjes lhag pa'i lhar bskyed nas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug pad+mo dang / /srad bu bsnams pas dgyes bzhugs la/ /'od 'phros mdud pa dor bar bya/ /lus ngag sems gsum babyungs pa yi/ /rgya gsum phyag rgya bsam pa ste/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum sngags gsu/ma rim/ /slob dpon mi g.yeng la gnas pas/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings dang / /sdigs 7mdzub rdo rje rtse gcig nyid/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /'od phyung rda rje'i rgyas 8btab pa'o/ /a āḥdīḥ9kā ya badz+ra kā ya kaṇ+ḍa hūṃ/oṃ āḥdhīḥwāka badz+ra wāka kaṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ 4dhīḥtsit+ta badz+ra tsit+ta kaṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ dam tshig srad bu dung dang byi ru gser 'od bai ḍūr in+d+ra'i mdog gsal ba/ /rgya gsum 'bar ba'i rdo rje sku gsung thugs dag skal ldan lus ngag yid btab pa/ /slob dpon mthu chen po ta la yi 'phags pa sras mchog snying rjes shin tu non pa'i yid//37—62/

keting 'dzin lcags kyus de nyid bcug la gus pa bzang ldan mgul dang dpung pa bcing / /srung rtaskud kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /dpal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po gzhon nu sgeg khros tshul/ /gzhon nu gdon las rnam rgyal ba/ /gzhon nu skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gzhon nu bsrung phyir 'dir bshad bya/ /re zhig nam langs ma thag tu kha shar du 2bltas te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan par byas la/ de'i dkyil 'khor gzhon nu khros pa zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥs+thāḥ ku mā ra kro dha sadz+dza dubye 4na ha ra ha ra ku mā ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ khri snyan nag po'i stan 'dug la/ /gzhon nu khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /shar sogs phyogs bzhir 5gtum mo bzhi/ /rang bzhin ma yengs blta bar bya/ /de la lus bsrung dpa' bo gnag /zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar sngo/ /rdo rje dril bu dgra sta zhags / /ral gri a la bsnams pa'o/ /srog bsrung dpa' bo dmar bo ste6/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sngo ser dmar/ /gri gug thod pa 'khor lo dbyig /rgyal mtshan mgo bo 'dzin pa nyid/ /stobs bsrung dpa' bo sngo ljang ser/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ser dmar ljang / /be con sdegs mdzub mdung tho ba/ /rdo rje mda' gzhu thogs pa'o/ /dpal bsrung dpa' bo dkar pos te/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sngo dmar dkar/ /gnam be+egs kha ṭ+wāṃ 7skyabs sbyin sgrom/ /mnyam par gzhag 8pas zhi zhing khro/ /gzhon nu'i sngon mo sngon song bas/ /'a/ga tu rdo rje dril thogs shing / /rkang pa rdo rje'i 'gros bskor bas/ /gzhon 27——622

nu rab tu bsrung 1bar bya/ /lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /gzhan la ltos 2pa med nyid kyis/ /'od zer rdo rje'i gur phub cing / /ka pā la yi spyor ba brtsam / /rang nyid rdo rje spar pa yis/ /rnal 'byor gzhon nu khros pa yi3/ /ting nge 'dzin la brten pa dang / /gzhon nu dran pa'i rgyas bskyab bya/ /gzhon nu bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /jo bo thugs rje chen po nad thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum dbang rnam par rgyal / /'gro ba'i nad ni sna tshogs dang / /de rgyu nye dang ring ba bstsal4/ /ma lus pha rol phyin phyag 'tshal/ /blo ldan bdag gam gzhan gyi don/ /rtsol 5ba che la zhugs pa na/ /dgra dang gdon nyid dang las dang / /de bzhin rkyen gzhan nad skyed byed/ /de la dpal ldan spyan ras gzigs/ /sdug bsngal can la 6thugs brtse bas/ /srung dang skyob dang sbed rim bzhin/ /snying dbus spyi bo phyag mtshan bshad/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa nyid/ /'og ma'i rims 9drag sna tshogs rigs/ /mdze can dang ni skran dmu chu/ /thibs non la sogs kun des skyob/ /sgrub 1 po dang ldan byams yid brlan/ /pho brang mchog tu sabaltas pa 1 de/ /khrus byas gos dkar bzang gyon la/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pas legs gnas bya/ /sna tshogs mchod mdzes dpag med dang / /'byung po rnams kyis don grub 7rdzas/ /stobs can dkar dmar mang dang ldan/ /bdug pa mchog gis bdag gus mchod/ /oṃ āḥsas+thāḥsarba byu bye pra ti pra ha na hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bdag nyid 'dab spyoskyes stong dbus su/ /ji 37—623

skad 'byung ba'i rgyal ba 1nyid/ /'od dpag med kyi snying por bcas /dkar gsal rnam par mi g.yeng ba'o/ /de nas dad pa drag gdung bcas/ /'gro la brtse dang gzhan ltos med/ /gcig tu rnam par nges yid kyis/ /skyabs gsol mgon po spyan drang bya/ /dpag med sprin tshogs mchod pa'i lhas/ /lha mchog mdun du bdar nas ni/ /ring bar thub chen 'khor mang bcas/ /brtse phyir steng gi mkhar bzhugs blta/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri bzang ro brgya'i bza' dang lhab lhub gos mang rgyan mchog dang / /pi wang dung dang rnga chen gling bu 2dbyangs snyan 'tsher ba sna tshogs mchod pa'i lha mor bcas/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kun du bzang sogs ji snyed mchod 4mdzad bdag gi'ang zab cing rgya che sprul/ /de rjes gzhan yang bstod dbyangs kun brjod mi bzad yid kyi nongs pa ma lus yang dag bshags/ /de nas dad pa mang ldan dang / /skye dgu rnams la snying brtse bas/ /yid bzhin nor la nyer mkho bzhin/ /sna tshogs nad las bsrung gsol bya/ /bdag gi lus dang lhag bsam nyid/ /drang srong gi ni thugs rje dang / /smon lam stobs kyis mdzad pa yi/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab gyur5/ /rnga yab dkar brgya 6ser bu'i ngad bskyod brtan 7par mi nus g.yo bar byed/ /mtsho chen gting zab drag po 8rdzis 'khrug lha dbang thugs kyang btsun mos bzhu/ /tsha bsil zer can nyi zla 'bar ba'ang rta bdun rlung g.yos gnas gcig min/ /de bzhin nyid thugs rnyog med zhi ba'ang gdul bya'i don mthong rnam pa kun du mi bzad 'gyur/ /de tshe dbang phyug thugs dkyil du/ /bdag gi lha mos bde bsnun pas/ /thugs rje'i thugs bskyod byin rlabs rgyun/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ltar dkar phreng dbab/ /37—62

g.yas phyag ming med rtse nas su/ /zla ba kha ba kun+da dung / /pad+ma dkar mdog las lhag pa/ /yul dus rnam kun bar ma chad/ /rgyun bzang spyi gtsug rtsa mchog nas brgyud nas/ /snying dkyil lha mchog nyid sku gang byas la/ /ches lhag zer kun lus kun rgyas gyur dang / /de las 'od phyung 'dom gang dkyil 'khor bskor/ /gang tshe gnyid log 'du byed g.yengs gyur na/ /g.yon phyag nyid kyi pad+mo bdag 'byin la/ /de dbus bdag bzhugs 'dab stong 1ldan/ /slar zum spyi bo'i phrag nas bdud rtsi blang / /dpal spyan ras gzigs kyis nad bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //snga / /'phags pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus nad rnams kun kyi gzhi/ /chags sdang gti mug phrag dog dang / /ser sna'i dug 'joms spyan ras gzigs/ /bdud rtsi'i bum 'dzin la phyag 'tshal/ /nad med nad kyis 'jigs pa dang / /nad bcas sbug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ /de dag 'phags pa nad 'joms kyi2/ /spyor bas 'jigs pa bskyab par bya/ /rin chen sbyangs pa'i snod dag par/ /nam mkha'i chu yis gang byas pa/ /bde gshegs ring bsrel snying po can/ /mdun gzhag 4yid kyis 5dkyil 'khor bsam / /de la dkyil 'khor rnam gsum ste/ /ma dag dag par byed pa ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /nad 'joms mgon po dkar mdzes so/ /de ni mtshan mo zla shar dus/ /shel mdog dhīḥyig las skyes pa/ /bdud rtsi bum pa dkar bsnams shing / /phyag stong bcu gcig zhal mnga' ba'o/ /dag pa dri med 'khor lo la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /nad sel 37—62pya

mgon po dmar mdzes te/ /nyin mo rta bdun 'char tshe yin/ /dri med phyir mi ldog pa yi/ /'khor lo de ni phyed gsum dus/ /sna tshogs pad+mo la gnas pa//nad bral mgon po in+d+ra'i mdog /bud med byis pa bde ster te/ /zla tshes zla rgyas nad 'jig dus/ /nyi shar nyi zer nad med pa/ /de bzhin phyed gsum nad spangs so༄1/ /de phyir mkhas pa nad med lus/ /don gnyer 'dod pas 'di dag dus/ /ston mo nye ba'i ston mo dang / /dga' ston chen po sbyin par bya / /gang yang rnal 'byor lus spyin gyi/ /gtor ma rgya chen bya ba dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i/ /mchod pa rim bzhin brtsam par bya/ / srun ras gzigs kyis nad bsal ba'i cho ga rjogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu chen gdug pa klu yi nad/ /myur du bde blag gso byed pa/ / sabhesrun ras gzigs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /snying rje ldan pa rnams kyis zubasgrub/ /de la mi gang zhig sngon gyi las kyi rnam par min pa'am/ glo bur gyi rkyen gang gi stobs kyis lus sam sems la nye bar gnod pa'i mtshan ma 'ga' zhig mthong na de'i sgrib pa bsal bar bya ba'i don du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi cho ga 'di la rab tu brtson par bya'o/ /ba dmar thugyi 'o ma dang / klu shing gi lo 'bras dang ri5/ dar skud dmar po dang / mkhal ma dang / snying dang / mtsher ba dang zho thusha la sogs pa dang / rtsi sman sna tshogs dang /klu sman thams cad dang / rin po che dmar po dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas dang / spos dang me tog la sogs pa dang /37—626

'bras yos dang snum khur la sogs pa ji sted 'byor pa'i yo byad bsham 1par bya'o//mdor na klu gso ba'i cho ga rnams las ji snyed bshad pa thams cad do/ /klu skyob mgon po dkar bzang zhi ba zhal mnga' ba/ /spyan gsum brtse ba'i mche bas rab bskyod smin ma g.yo/ /ltos 'gro rgyal po phuḥ yis 'gram gong mgo rgyan 4can / /ba sru re re'ang bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i khur khyer ba'o/ /g.yas phyag mchog sbyin thal mo pad+mo mdzes bcug kha phye glang chen sna 'dra'i sor mo bkram/ /ming med rtse nas klu rnams rab dga' sman mchog ro brgya 5phan mdzad nyid kyi sa bon can/ /rab tu dang zhing g.yo ba'i 'od 'dzag dri ngad phyogs bcur ldang ba'i thigs pa bdun brtsegs 'bab/ /phyag mthil a las ye shes 'od 'phros dbyangs dang gsal byed bdud rtsi yig 'bru rnam bcus brgyan/ /oṃ āḥdīḥsaṃ nā ga bo ṣā t+t+waṃ swā hā/ zla ba la ni skar ma bzhin/ /klu sbyang 'khor lo dkar po 'di / /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ /snang ba dri med bsgom par bya//byams pa'i gzhu bkang snying rje yi/ /mda' bzung gsang sngags bde bsnun pas//rdzas rnams dri ma gzhom pa dang / /byin gyis brlab pa 6mchog tu bya/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa bdun pa las/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba'i sgud pa ltar/ /phra zhing grims pa'i rgyun phab la/ /mchod rdzas rnam dag rgya mtshor bskyed / /phyag mthil 8a las zer spros pas/ /gdug pa de dag spyan drang ngo / /oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra 9sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ1 / rdo rje bsdams pa byas nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul gyis so/ /mtsho chen rab dang dpag med rin chen chal par bkram pa'i nang / /khang bzangs mang brtsegs klu tshogs sna tshogs zhi bas gnas pa dang / /gtum 11pa'i tshul can longs spyod rgya cher 'byor pa la sogs 37—627

dang / /de bzhin sa dang rir 1gnas rtse shing rten sogs ma lus blta/ /thams cad lce la thub pa yi/ /'khor lo'i sngags las 2'od 'phros pas /'od kyi sbu gu dam pa dag /re re las kyang skar mda' bzhin/ /de nas sbyin pa'i sngags 'di dag /brjod pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag dang / /bcas te klu rnams tshim par bya/ /snying rje chen po dam tshig yin/ /oṃ āḥtweḥm hā kā ru ṇa shrī lo ka nā tha sarba nā ge sta yi sa tre+e 4ma hā sa tre+e a byeṣ+ṭha nai sarba lo kā sarba na gā do ṣa pra ha na ha na ha na 6hūṃ phaṭa/ bo ṣā pra kyuta 7po ṣa a t+yan+ta pra ti pra byuta po ṣa 8swā hā/ tshad med bdud rtsi'i thig le bzhis/ /nyer btsas 'phags pa nyid bzhugs pa'i/ /khu ba'i chu rgyun dag pas kyang / /klu rnams lan mang bkru bar bya/ /byad ma dag gis rig sngags bzhin/ /de dag gnod pas sos gyur na/ /bdag gi gang gang gnod yod pa/ /de yang ring por 9mi thogs 'dzad1 / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis 1 klu gso ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /dpal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo//sngon nam tshe 'di 'am glo bur kyi/ /las dbang gis khebs klu yi nad/ /rigs/ bzhi gang gis jebs gyur pa/ /de dag gso ba 'dir bshad bya/ /brag ri nags tshal phug gam ljongs/ /me tog dkar pos rab brgyan par/ /thub pa 'od dpag med kyi sras/ /nad bral 'jig rten mgon po bsgrub/ /gang na klu gnyan sa bdag dang / /lha dang lha min gyis bstod pa'i/ /rten la mchod pa byas nas ni/ /mdze can rnams la bkur ste bya/ /de nas lhor ni mngon 37—628

bltas la/ /bdag lus 'khor lo 'bar ba yis/ /spyi bo snying gar mgon po t+t+waṃ//dkar dmar gsal bar bsgoms nas ni/ /'bar dang 'dzag dang dbang du bya//lus can gdug pa gdul bya'i phyir/ /de'i rten dpal ldan thugs rje gtso/ /klu mgon brgyad kyi gdengs ka can/ /dug sel bdud rtsi'i ril 'dzin pa/ /spyan mang 'od dpag med pas 1mtshan/ /de yi thugs rje'i 2mi bzad thugs/ /snang mtha' ye shes snying po'i bdag /lus can gdug pa 'dul bya'i phyir/ /dpag med dug 'joms ting 'dzin zhes/ /bya bas dhīḥyig mnyam gzhag pa'o/ /lha 'di klu 'dul cod pan zhes/ /mdo las rab grags de bzhin sems/ /stobs mthu dpal dang bcas pa yis / /ngo bo yi ge rgyal po'i 4snying / /oṃ āḥtweḥsarba budhe 5gasgo shrī lo ka nā tham ma sa ka la byā bye 6pra ti pra ha na ka ra ka ra hūṃ ha ra ha ra hūṃ/ bā rats+tsha bā rats+tsha/ bī bā rats+tsha bī pā rats+tsha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/sngags 'di rtag tu bzlas nas ni/ /bdag gi dad dang mgon po'i mthus/ /nyid kyi thugs bskul 'od dpag med/ /dug 'joms rgyal po dug sel dang / /dug gsod nges par 'byin pa dang / /dug mthar mdzad dang dug med dang / /dug bral slar mi ldog pa yis7/ /'od zer phyung bas snying dbus spro/ /oṃ āḥdhīḥhūṃ / oṃ s+dzadīḥram̐ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdīḥkhaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtweḥsha baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdīḥpho hūṃ/ i āḥdīḥpaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdīḥbaṃ hūṃ/ khro āḥdīḥte t+t+waṃ/ i āḥdhīḥsaṃ t+t+waṃ/mthar byed bdud rtsi 'dzag pa yi/ /rgyun gyis gso dang byams pa yi/ /'od kyi byug pas sbyang bar bya/ /de rjes 'gro ba'i dug sbyang ngo / /yang na mtho ris sa steng gi/ /spyor ba gnyis kyis gsad 8dang gso/ /sbyang ba'i cho ga rnam pa gsum/ /dpal ldan dug sel rgyud las bshad/ /mdze nad gso ba 27—629

sdogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs gzhan gyis mi thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma rā ga byi ru me ltar kun nas rab 'bar 'od 'phro'i sgu/ /pad+mo nyi zla bgegs rnams 1snamago mnan mi bzad rngam pa'i sku chen po/ /zhal gsum phyag drug spyan stong mnga' ba'i rgyal ba dpa' bo 'jigs shing rab 'jigs pabazhad pa pokyi/ /g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar dmar ba'i 4zhal ldan de bzhin ral gri mchog dang dgra sta dang / /sdigs mdzub dang ni dril bu zhags bcas tshangs pa'i mgo bsnams stag gi pags pas smad g.yogs pa/ / bskal pa'i 5me ltar ye shes 'bar ba'i rlabs 6'khrugs rab tu 'jigs pa'i 'ur sgra can/ /khrag gis zhal bkang nga ro mi bzad sgra sgrogs sbrul gdug khros pas sgu rab brgyan/ /dbang bdag brgyad cu'i mgo bo rlon pas do shal phreng thogs brdabs pa'i gad rgyangs 'byin pa'o/ /lha 'di dpa' bo dpa' chen po/ /bdud kyi dgra las rnam 7rgyal zhing / /gzhan gyis mi thub mthu bo che/ /pha rol dpung rnams 'joms pa yin/ /sngags pa gang zhig nad dang dgra/ /sngon bsags bsod nams ma yin dang / /sna tshogs mya ngan 'jigs rnams las//sgro'/ ba mi pham spyor ba 'di/ /rnal 'byor brtson par byed pa des/ /zla 9ba drug ni lon pa dang / /stag dang seng ge glang chen dang / /mkha' lding nor bu sgron mthong 'gyur/ /de tshe snying dkyil pad dmar 1 gyi/ /'dab drug yi ge drug dgod bya/ /oṃ āḥdīḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de yis de dbus sasnying po yi/ /snying po sa bon dīḥ'aphros pa'o/ /sngags 'di 'khor lo bskor ba yi/ /tshul 37—630

gyis zhag bdun bzlas nas ni/ /gang gang bzlog pa de 1bsgrub pas2/ /las de la ni sbyar bar bya/ /las gang yang dag grub 'grub pa// /de nyid skye bo gzhan la yang / /sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /khrus kyi cho ga spyin pa yi/ /glo bur ring por mi thogs par/ /ma lus dbang du 'gyur bar bshad//gzhan las rnam par rgyal ba'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug pha rol rnam par gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig sgrub pa po brtson 'grus can the tshom mi za bas / dgra dang gdon dang nad la sogs pa pha rol gyi 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir/ dang po kho nar byang chub tu sems brtan par bya'o/ /de nas sems can thams cad la/ /snying rje chen po mdun gzhag 4ste/ /bsgrub pa'i bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ /srung 5ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rang lus pad+mo 'dzin khros sku/ /rdo rje sdigs 6mdzub 'khor lo 'dzin/ /'bar ba'i lte ba rnam par gnon/ /brgya phyed ral gri'i rtsibs 'pho 7ba'o mi pham snying po dīḥyin te/ /gcod byed brgya phyed a kas mtshan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /dpa' bo rdza mkhan 'khor lo bzhin/ /pha rol byad ma la sogs bgegs/ /rnam par gnon mdzad thugs rje che/ /nyid kyi thugs skyod 8khros pa yis9/ /ye shes spyan drangs gsang sngags gsungs/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥpa re 7a dzi ta ma hā kā ru bhā ka kro dha sa ma ya sma ra hūṃ/ khazhe saṃ sho dha ya ma na sarba pā paṃ bispyo sa t+t+waṃ byu dhi aṅgi sgu ṭa zwa ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ mā ra mā ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ sarba pa ro pra 2tā rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ 37—63/

phaṭa phaṭa/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs la 'jug pa bcom ldan 'das pha rol rnam par gnon pa'i de kho na nyid ting nge 'dzin byed pa dang ma bral bas gsang sngags kyi rgyal po chen po bar ma chad par rjes su bzla zhing gnod pa thams cad bsreg par bya'o/ /rig pa 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pas 'phags pa nyid snying la 'jug cing yid la snang ba'i rnam pas bgegs la sogs pa thams cad rnam par zlog 1par byed do/ /sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad kyang yongs su gtong bar byed do/ /ya nga ba dang 'jigs pa gzhan dag kyang rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du mi 'byung ngo //de la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang rtag tu dgongs pa mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /ting 'dzin ldan pas sngags bzlas brtson 'grus can/ /'bar ba'i ral gri me lces bzhus pa'i zhun/ /dmar 'khrug rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro bar byed/ /skad cig de la dgra rnams thal bar 'gyur/ /skyo bas thun gyi mtha' la bab pa na/ /snying rjes yid brtul nga rgyal spangs pa yis4//brtan pa'i dran pas g.yo ba rgyun bcad la/ /rgya chen phyi nang mchod pas 'khor lo mchod/ /pha rol kyi gnod pa bsrung ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /ba6ma ldan 'das pha rol gyi dpung las rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtan pa rnams kyis chos kyi srid/ /pha rol 'jigs las bsrung ba'i 5phyir/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed thugs rje khros/ /gzhan gyis mi thub cho ga brjod / /de la pha rol gyi dpung bzlog pa ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ nges par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'jigs par byed pa'i spyor ba'o/ /37—632

'dir 'jigs par byed pa'i sbyor ba ni/ thog mar mtshan ma grub pa sngon du 'gro bas/ ring bsrel 1gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten nam/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rab tu gnas pas gnas par byas pa'i rten gyi mdun du song ste/ rang bzhin ma lus kyis —gsol ba btab la/ 'dod pa drag pos thal mo spyar te shin tu rab tu gus pas re bar bya'o/ /rten gang thugs dkyil thugs rje khros/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu drug sor/ /mi bzad rngam zhing rnam 'gyur ba/ /bsgoms la ye shes bstim /par bya/ /rang snying nyid dbus hūṃ ngam dīḥ/ /'bar ba yongs gyur 4rdo rje blta5/ /de nyid brjod pas 'jigs byed nyid/ /kun du me 'od 'khrigs pa'o/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ma te'i 6zhal/ /de g.yas 'bar ba sngags 7phyag rgya/ /gnam lcags me dpung rlung dmar dang //nyi ma dang ni mkha' lding ngo / /g.yon du sdigs 9mdzub rdo rje zhags/ /zla ba dang ni dgra sta'o/ /nyi shu gcig dang brgya rtsa brgyad/ /yang na stong phrag gcig bar du/ /rdo rje 'bar ba yi ge gcig /dpa' bos rngam par rnam par bzla / /de nas lha la lus bstems la/ /sgu chen ri rab mnyam pa yis/ /yi ge gcig brjod 'od phyung la/ /pha rol rjes skyob zil mnan bya/ /rkang pa g.yas ni bteg nas su/ /zhags pas drangs te mgo bo badze+e/ /g.yon brkyang nga ro 'bar ba yis/ /gsus pa dral nas rgyu ma mnan/ /pha rol dmag dang g.yul 'khor bcas/ /phyag rgya lnga yi las rim kyis/ /thal ba tsam du'ang ma lus dang / /yang na rdo rje zhags pas bcings/ /oṃ āḥdīḥphe dze dze oṃ āḥdhīḥre ram̐ ram̐7/ oṃ s+dzatweḥdzaḥdzaḥtsha/ oṃ āḥtweḥ dhīḥdīḥtweḥ྾/ oṃ āḥdīḥdzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ / phyag rgya 'phang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ aXdhīḥbadz+ra brnya bad+dhā mā ra ya rbad/37—633

rdo rje zhags pas bcing ba'i 1sngags so/ /rdo rje rtse dang thabs chen shing / /ri gzar rtswa dang gtsub shing me/ /bya rgod kyi ni dang ru g.yas/ /yungs kar phye ma thal chen bsres/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'bum bzlas la/ /dmag tshogs myos pa 'ongs pa yi/ /gdong du khros pas gtor byas te/ /phaṭa ces drag pos skrag par bya'o/ /wa rnams la ni seng ge bzhin/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dngang 4'bros pa'am/ /ro langs la ni gsang sngags bzhin/ /rengs 'gyur g.yo ba'ang mi 'thob po/ /ji ste spogs 5pa'i cho ga ni/ /myos byed rdzas bdun sbyar ba dang / /'jigs byed chen po 6sku phyar la/ /bdug pa lnga bsregs rnga chen brdung / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs dpal che/ /rab tu gsad pa'i rtog pa las/ /legs phung pha rol dpung bzlog pa/ /snyigs dus bstan pa bsrung ba yin/ /pha rol gyi sde gzhom pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu snying rjes 7non pa'i yid/ /lus can mya ngan 'das pa las bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer ba/ /de yis pha rol bsdu bar bshad/ /nam langs myun pas sleb pa dang / /gnyid du nye bas sad pa'i dus/ /dga' dang gdung ba skyes nga/ di/ /de ne+e rwacho ga spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag ge lus gang lha yin te/ /ngag ni yi ge bzhi nyid do/ /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog sems/ /snying rje che dang stong pa nyid/ /mig gnyis nyi ma 'bar ba dang / /lce steng ā kā'i phreng bas brgyan/ /lte ba me thab 'khyel pa'i dbus/ /dpal ldan 'dod pa'i lha mo'o/ /mi gang dbang du bya ba de'i/ /smin phrag gnyis dang lte ba'i 27—63 /

dbus / /dga' dang dad dang gdung ba nyid/ /thig le pad+mo a yi gzugs/ /byams pa yi ni a yi rgyun/ /bdag gi sprul pa la skyes reg /rab tu mi bzad snying rje can/ /dga' ba'i lta bas rnam par bzhu/ /btang snyoms tshad med blo gros che/ /yi ge lnga brjod pad+mo 'byed/ /oṃ āḥbyeḥdzaḥhūṃ/ 'bum phrag lnga rab ma yengs 3dang / /lhag bsam bar chad spangs bsnyen bsgrub/ /bde gshegs ring bsrel sku khrus sogs/ /brtse ldan rnams kyis sngags chur bcas/ /me tog dmar khus gdong bkrus la/ /lce dkyil sbrang rtsi ldan sngags brjod/ /oṃ yi dhīḥshrī lo ka nā tha 2ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ho/ sa ma ya haṃ/ che ge mo tsit+ta ma hā pā ra dha tsa la tsa la pra tsa la pra la dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ/ blo gros bzang po snying rjes myos gyur pa/ /skye bo 'di dag thabs gang phrin las kyis/ /bde bar rung na bdag cir 4'gyur blo'o zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu yid byed mi 'bral na/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po brtag pa 'dis/ /zhag gsum drug gam dgu nyid na/ /lcags kyus bzhus pa'i yal ga ltar/ /gdon mi za bar de dbang 'gyur/ /pha rol dbang du bya ba rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pha rol rnam par gnon pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang chen lpags 5bsnams bcu drug phyed phyed gdong pa can/ /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo mda' thogs de bzhin g.yon/ /dril bu sdigs mdzub kha ṭ+wāṃ gzhu 'dzin rngam pa'i sgu/ /gtum chen zhabs brgyad bgegs brgyad mgo mnan rgyal gyur cig / 'jig rten 6thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir/ /pha rol rnam gnon mthing ga 7drag /gdug pa kun gyis sgu brgyan pa/ /me dpung 37—635

rab 1'bar dpa' bo 3bsgoms/ /snying rje khros pas sku bsgyur la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas cod pan 'chang / /rus pa'i gdugs phub 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /'khor gnyis kyis ni las byed pa'o/ /oṃ āḥspyoḥm hā kā ru ṇi ka tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇi 4bha ya ha ra ṇi rak+ṣa ba ra khaṃ gu pa ti pa re bi dze swā hā/ gcan gzan 5drag po rnams kyi mche ba dang sder mo'i rtse mo la ni rgod dang rgyal po'i khrag gam son 6mo'i chus byugs la rig pa brgya bzlas la dpung par bcing ngo /'jigs skyob khro bo drag shul che/ /mdun nas 'gro zhing chom rkun gsod/ /dga' byed drag po phag khrid pa/ /phyi bzhin rjes 'brang mi 'jigs sbyin/ /ji srid ya nga'i lam bskyab 7nas/ /spyod yul phyin par gyur pa na/ /gnyis 'dus mgon po rgyan med zhi/ /sku gzugs rnam pas mchod pas mnyes/ /sna tshogs 'jigs pas ya nga nyam thag dang / /gang yang pha rol dregs pas btul byas nas/ /go 'phang mchog 'dir dngos grub sbyin 'dod pa/ /rgyal ras 8 bzang la grogs mchog 'dir 'gyur ro/ /khro dang nga rgyal mang ba dang / /sred pas zang zing don gnyer ba/ /da 9ni gus par gyur na yang / /cho ga 'di las ring bar byed/ /chom rkun bcing ba rdzogs so// //༄7/ /bde bar gshegs pa pad+mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin pa gang zhig slob ma phan gdags 'dod pas blo dang ldan pa'i gang zag don du gnyer ba dang bcas pa gang glo bur du lhags pa'am gnyug mar gnas pa yin kyang rung ste/ dul bas mdun du bdar bar gyur pa de dag la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pad+mo dam pa can gyi byin gyi rlabs kyis snying gi 1pad+mo kha phye 37—636

bas shes rab gsal po bskyed pa'i cho ga 'di dran par bya ba yin no/ /skal ldan skye bo lhags pa na/ /der ni de ma thag tu de/ /paṃ brjod pas ni pad+mar bskyed / /de yi snying yang de bzhin no/ /de la snying gi pad+mo ni/ /'dab brgyad dkar po zlum pos te/ /dbus su dhīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ /spyi bor thig le sum brtsegs pa'o/ /dkar dmar bdud rtsi nam mkha'i mdog /rim bzhin rab tu dang bar bsam/ /smin mtshams nas zug snying gi dkyil/ /rtsa mchog sbu gu dkar zangs so/ /mkhas pa rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bdag /byams sogs tshad med las skyes pa'i/ /thub dbang shes rab 'od zer 'chang / /spyan ras gzigs su myur bar bskyed/ /spyan gsum 'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar ldan / /rnam dag 'od bzangs dkyil 'khor can/ /btsun mo gnyis kyis sku brten 1cing / /rnga yab dkar g.yob dgyes bzhugs pa'o/ /de rjes gzhan la phan brtson pa'i/ /yid kyis de yi don bsgrub phyir/ /rnam gus pa yi spyor ba yis/ /bdag gi dgos pa lha mchog reg /de bas de la gsol btab pas/ /spyan drangs bdag nyid la bstem bya/ /de nas phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi/ /mthil skyes ma las yongs gyur pa/ /nyi ma rdo rje snying po can/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed kyis brgyan bsam/ /dhīḥbacas sngags phreng gnyis brjod pas/ /nyi 'od tsha zhing rab rna yi/ /zer 'asbas pas ne+e pad+mo dbye/ /dīḥlas de bzhin thig le'o/ /de las thog mar dkar thig le/ /pha yi sa bon zhu bar bshad/ /dmar po ma yi sa bon te/ /de bzhin mkha' 'dra kun gzhir bzhed/ /de mthar zhu ba'i thig le'i rgyun/ /dbyer med phan tshun rnam 'dren pa/ /bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /blo gros pad+mo rab rgyas gsungs/ /cho ga'i rgyal 37—637

po dam pa 'di/ /gang gang skal bar ldan pa'i mthus/ /brtse ldan gus pas sngon song ba/ /de yi thos sogs rnam dag 'phel/ /slob ma la shes rab babyed pa sdogs so// //༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan 'od zer gzi brjid 'bar ba'i rgyal po ser sprin rab mthug sreg 1par mdzad/ /yig gnyis 2gdug pa'i stobs 'joms nga ro mi bzad nam mkha'i ngos la gad rgyangs sgrogs/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar mthing ga in+d+ra'i mdog ldan rdo rje mda' gzhu thal mo brdebs/ /me dpung sdegs 4 mdzub ral gri'i gshog bsnams dbang po'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas ser ba bzlog pa bshad par bya ste/ lha dang klu la sogs pa khros pa dang / 'byung ba nyid kyi dbang ngam/ grong khyer pa rnams kyi don ma yin pa'i las kyi stobs las kyang rung ste/ dus dang dus ma yin pa'i gnod pa ni 'di lta ste/ du ba'i mdog dang / rgya mtsho rlung gis bskyod pa'i rlabs lta bu'i sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs shing 5/ 'brug gi sgra kun du mi bzad pas klad pa 'gems pa lta bu dang / gnam lcags dang ser ba drag po 'bab pa'e ltas ngan / mngon du gyur pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' grong khyer pa rnams dang / skye bo mang po la snying brtse bas gdung ba'i yid can/ bdag gi don btang nas gzhan gyi nye bar mkho ba la lhag par chags pas zil gyis mnan pa dag /'byung po dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug drag po chen po 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzi brjid 37—638

kyi rgyal po ltas ngan pa thams cad rnam par 'jig par mdzad pa'i rigs 1kyi rgyal po 'di yang dag par dran par bya'o/ /de zhal g.yas dkar lha bsrung ba/ /g.yon pa dmar po mi yi rje/ /dbus gnas mthing ga klu —'dul grags/ /spyan gsum mche gcigs khros pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon dang po mda' gzhu'i phyag /gnyis pa gnyis ni thal mo brdebs/ /gsum pa'i phyag na me dpung ste/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba nyid/ /sgon shing dud mdog sku chen 'gying / /ral gri'i gshog brgyangs sngusru 'thul 5pa/ /shin tu za byed rngam pa che/ /'jigs pa'i zhabs bgrad 'jigs 6pa'o/ /thugs ka lte bar pad nyir ni/ /hūṃ phaṭa sngo dang dmar ba yi/ /yi ge gnyis bsam 7sngags kyis bskor/ /de gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ /oṃ s+thāḥ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya a ti kro dha ma hā dza 9la sarba tu sa ra ha ra ha ra/ da ha da ha/ shīs+t+waṃ lu bye mā ra ya 11phaṭa/thal mo g.yas la pha dkar dang / /g.yon la ṭa nag bkod nas ni/ /brdabs pas me lce 'bar ba yis/ /dpa' bos ser ba rnam par bzlog /mig gnyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /smin ma khro gnyer glog rgyun dang / /shangs las me stag zhal las kyang / /lce 'bar phuḥ1 yis btab pas kyang / /de las rang nyid 'dod thag gru/ /mkhas pas yid kyis mtshams bcad de/ /sprin tshogs 'o ma can gyi khye/ /bsnol bas chu gzhag gis byug bya/ /gang tshe dus la bab gyur pa/ /de tshe rngam pa'i stang —stabs kyis/ /rngam par byas la me dpung 'bar/ / bskal pa'i 5me ltar mkha' g.yogs sa'agyur/ /sngags phreng gsum mam bdun nam dgu/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ /skad cig de la rdo rje yi/ /pha bong nyid kyang zhu bar 'gyur/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs 37—639

—khros pas ser ba bzlog pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la 1skyabs song sems bskyed ldan/ /'gro la phan 'dod bdag dul 2ba'i / /skyes bu dam pa bsam gtan gyi/ /khang bur zhugs la rmi lam bsgom//btsun pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog ldan pa/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas dang po/ /'jigs skyob de bzhin g.yon du ni/ /pad+ma dmar po gnyis/ pa gnyis/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /thugs kyi pad+mo kha zum pa'i/ /dbus su sems dngos s+thāḥbasam bya/ /'di 'dra'i 'phags pa nyid du bdag /skad cig tsam gyis bsgoms nas ni/ /dge dang brtse dang dad pa yis/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po gnyid log bya/ /gang tshe gnyid du nye ba na//dhīḥ4yang thig le gnyis la basbu/ /rim gyis thig le 'og ma yang / /de bzhin thig le gong ma la'o/ /de nas sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /rang gi lus la basbus nas de/ /pad dbus thig le nyag gcig la/ /chu la chu bzhag de bzhin bzhag/sems ni dri med zung 'jug bdag /dngos gred dngos bral rnam par dag /'od gsal chen po nyid la nyid/ /mngon sum mi g.yo brtan par bzung / /tshu'/ 'di rang bzhin mkha' 'dra ste/ /rnam pa thig le bde ba che/ /ngo bo kun du ma 'gags pa'o/ /sbyangs sdom can gyi chos gcig bzhed/ /de ltar rgyu 'dra chos kun rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ /gzhan la mi rag bdag nyid snying dkyil brtan par gnas/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul 5gcig yin ma nor ba / /bsgoms na 6de rjes rmi lam nyid du'ang de mthong 'gyur/ /gal te 27—6/0

sgrib tshogs bud shing tshang tshing gis bsgribs pas/ /yang dag ji bzhin de tshe mngon du ma gyur na'ang / /rnal 'byor rgyal pos re ba chad par mi bya ste/ /goms pa ma zad gcig tu brtson 'grus g.yel mi bya/ /mdun gyi mkha' la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal lha yi tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin gyi phung po ltar mthong 'gyur/ /de tshe de nas ring po mi thogs 'od gsal 'thob/ /rnam dag 'khor lo pad+mo 'dam nas skyes pa bzhin/ /gnyid kyis myos 'gyur ma rig gis babe+ed blo gros 'di / /rang gis 3rang dben mkha' la nyi ltar spros bral du/ /rtsol bral med nyid rang dbang mngon sum 'char bar byed/ /rmi lam skyes bus rmi lam gyi//grong du dga' dang mya ngan la/ /bzung ba rlom sems tsam yin pa/ /de tshe de yis shes par 'gyur/ /me long gzugs brnyan gsal ba yis2/ /yod dang med dang gnyis ka dang / /gnyis ka ma yin brjod min pa/ /de tshe yid ches mthong bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i ngos la dbang po'i gzhu/ /de bzhin ser sprin 'brug sgra can/ /thog mthar skye dang 'gags 4mi dmigs/ /'od gsal la gnas skyes bus shes/ /ji ltar smig rgyu'i chu 'bab pa/ /shar sogs phyogs ni gang zhig nas/ /ma 'ongs gar yang mi 'gro ba/ /rmi lam mthong ba de yis shes/ /dril bu dang ne+e pi wang sgra/ /brag ca la sogs 'du byed ni/ /rnam par thar pa gsum kyis bsgos5/ /zab mo rnam par dbe+en pa yang / /snang ba mun pa thibs po dang / /'od gsal bye brag med 'gyur ba/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser bzhin du/ /dri bral rnam par dag pa rmad6/ /ji srid 'dzin pa mang po la/ /zad dang mi skye bsre ba yis/ /ro gcig nyid du spyor 37—6/1

keshes pa/ /rmi lam las gzhan rnal 'byor min/ /de ni sad pa nyid na yang / /yid/ kyi dbang po tshim pa dang / /'dod pa'i sred pa las blo zlog /chos 'di brjod pa tsam rtogs so/ /de ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ /dri ma dri ma bral ba dang / /bral ba rang bzhin med pa yang / /yid kyis —1mngon par 'du mi byed / /'phags pa'i mig ces bshad pa stesnye/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi mthu yis/ so/ /rmi lam dri ma med pa bsgom pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug slob ma la phan par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas gang dpa' bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dzin pa'i ri bo brtan 'jig byed/ /bla ma mchog gi drin thob pas/ /slob ma la phan byin rlabs gyur4/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi/ /mchod rdzas ma lus kun bshams la/ /zhi ba'i yid kyis skyil krung bya/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor blos blta'o / /bdag gi gtsug tor nas brgyud pa'i/ /skyob pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phreng / /ye shes sa bon hūṃ yig gi5/ /mtshan ma rdo rje sbu gu'i rgyun/ /smin mchams nas 'phros slob ma yi/ /dhū tī'i 6rin chen pho brang du/ /zhugs gyur de snying pad+mo'i bar/ /bar chad med 'byel brtan pas bsgom/ /de nas bla mabe+e man ngag gis/ /ye shes dbab pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /byang chub sems khengs ye shes kyi/ /me lce dal bus sbar bar bya/ /babs par gyur na lus gcig nges/—/ /sngon chad ma myang 7ro myang med/ /spu g.yo ba yis 'dren pa gsungs/ /bdug pa mchog gis bdug bya zhing / /sgra chen glu dbyangs rol mo yis/ /dpa' bo'i gar bya brtul zhugs 87can/ /rtse gcig mnyam par gzhag pas 37——642

mchod / /de rjes rgya mtsho dang ba la/ /ri rab ston ka'i mkha' 'dra dang / /nyi shar zla tshes skar mda' yi/ /rim 1can nyams myong skye bar byed/ /ting 'dzin mchog gis btul byas pas/ /glang chen lcags kyus dul ba ltar/ /zhi gyur sems rab dang ba la/ /sems kyi gzugs brnyan mthong bar 'gyur/ /de la snying po'i chos rnam bzhi/ /stong pa'i mtshan nyid sems gnas lugs/ /de yi snang ba glo bur ba/ /dbyer med mtshan med rnal 'byor ro/ /sor bzhag de yi mtshan nyid gsum/ /rab tu gsal zhing rnam mi rtog /bde chen blo sgra dpe bral ba/ /bsam gtan phyag rgya la brten bsgom/ /ngos bzung ba ni blta ba dang / /bsre dang mnyam par gzhag 4pa'o/ /sgo gsum rim dang rim min pas/ / dran rtogs 5glo bur nyid rtog 'gyur/ /ji ltar gang zhig gang du gang / /dran rnams dga' gdung der shar ba/ /de nyid de ltar de der med/ /'di ni gnyis med mtshan nyid do/ /'gro 'ong gnas dang mi gnas dang / /skye dang 'gag dang rten bral sogs/ /rjes su 'grogs dang gzhig pa yi/ /gdams ngag gis ni mtshan med 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru sarba dz+nyā na 6ḍā ki dī ma ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta 7ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dzā la dzā 8la be+e ra sga ra sa 9dze dze/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags so/ /rdo rje dril bu me long thod/ /sbyin pa rdo rje mkha' 'go yi/ /brtul zhugs sngon du song ba yi tshil chen mar me sbar bar bya/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra badz+ra ma hā badz+ra badz+ra dz+wa la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ oṃ a 7gaṇ+ḍa gaṇ+ḍa ma hā gaṇ+ḍa dz+wa la āḥ.āḥ.āḥ oṃ a darba na ma hā darba na dz+wa la/ dhīḥdīḥtwe ཿoṃ a ka pā la ka pā la ma hā ka pā la dz+wa la ho ho ho/ byin gyis brlabs nas sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /mthar ni spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /bsrung bas bsrung 37byed6 3

ba bya ba ni/ /thugs rje khros pas margad kyitsho/ /bde chen 'khor lo zhes pas bshad / /slob ma byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po ye shes 'be+ebs pa la phyag 'tshal lo /e ma'o/ mgon po mi rtog bde chen ster mdzad sgu/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'dzin bcas brgyud dang bltas/ /spyi bo nas brtsigs ye shes phreng ba dang //gzhu nyid pad zlas ye shes 'khor lo 'bar bar 'gyur/ /shin tu gus bcas gtong ba che/ /bzod ldan je tshom med rtog bral/ /g.yeng ba spangs shing dbang po dul/ /slob ma de ni rjes su bzung / /sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar ldan/ /ze'u 4'bru rdo rje me phreng gis/ /legs spras byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbus/ /skal ldan bzhag 5la bgegs bskrad bya/ /oṃ āḥ6bibyān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ bdug pa mchog gis rab bdug cing / /me tog dmar po gcal 7bkram la/ /mar me 'bar ba du ma yis/ /kun nas khor yug bskor bar bya/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal du byas la/ rdo rje la ni yi rlung gi shugs can no/ /de ni rgyal ba rnams kyi rang bzhin no/ /gtsug tor du haṃ thig le'i snying po can no / /de ni 'jig rten mgon po'i rang bzhin no/ /steng na 'dzag pas ni mi 'grib bo/ /smin mtshams nas gri 'asbas pas ni slob ma la 'bab par 'gyur ro//slob ma'i 'og tu ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ni spyor ba 'og mas bskyod par byed do/ /sprul pa 9ni yang lha mo nyid do/ /de ni spyor ba bar mas spyor bar byed do/ /snying gar ni yang bde gshegs snying po nyid do/ /de ni sbyor ba gong mas 'bebs par byed do/ /spyi bor ni yang mgon po'o/ /de ni sbyor ba 37—61

thog mas 'be+ebs par byed do/ /ma phebs na spogs 1pa'i cho ga ni/ /rdo rje sna bug gi sbyor bas so/ /shin tu spogs pa ni rdo rje spyi gtsug gi sbyor bas so/ /babs par gyur na sru 'greng zhing / / gdong bsgyur 2'od gsal ba nyid dang / /brjod par mi nus yang na gtso/ /mi rtog bde bas myos par 'gyur/ /ye shes gzhug pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //snga / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lhun gyis grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig byang chub sems dpa'i blo gros sbyangs pa dag /chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa dang / bdag gir 'dzin pas chags pa sdug bsngal ba dang / phongs pa rnams kyis 'gyur ba mthong bas mi bzad pa skyes nas/ thog mar gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor 'jug pa na bdag gi ltos 4pa ring du spangs nas snying rje chen pos gzhan gyes ma bskul bar bdag 'jug par ting nge 'dzin gyis 5byin gyis brlab 6par bya'o/ /brtan pa'i gnas dang g.yo ba lus dang ngag dang yid/ /rnam kun nyer spyod gzhal med khang bzangs rdo rje'i sku/ /gsang sngags dam tshig nga ro bcu drug mthar gnas dang / /pha rol phyin bcu lha yi spyor ba rnam dag bsgom/ /'di na gang dag don min spyod/ /smad pa'i gnas la blo rab chags/ /ldongs pas sdig pa mang ldan pa/ /de dag rang bzhin zhi ba'o/ /chos gang la ni rnam par shes / /de shes nyid ni pha rol 'gro/ /'di ltar gang la don gsal 'thob/ /sem 'gyur 'od gsal bde chen bsrungs7/ /e ma'o 'gro ba yang dag spyod/ /gang spyod de yin gzhan mi 9'gyur/ /gnas min gnas sogs gang brtags pa/ /37—6/5

nam yang skye sogs mi dmigs pa'o/ /'on kyang log pas cig shos su/ /bsgribs nas dri mar khrid pa yang / /bdag gi las gsum yan lag lngas/ /dag bcas lhag mar mi bya'o/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon nyid dam bcas/ /spyad pa spyod pa'i rim ji bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sras po brtse chen yang / /pha rol ltos pa mi 'chi'o/ /'di ni 1ji ltar bdag nyid dang / /sdug bsngal mngon 'dod mi 'dod pa/ /de bzhin lus 2can thams cad kyang / /mtshungs na bdag gcig bde ba brtson/ /yon tan phrin las thams cad la/ /rgyas btab rgyal sras 'bad par bya'o/ /gang zhig phan btags drin shes pa/ /de yang kun gyis bsngags 'os na/ /ma bcol rang dga' byin rlob pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po cis mi bsngags/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs sdogs so// //snga / /dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur 4ba la phyag 'tshal lo / /gang zhig dpal ldan bdud bzhi'i dgra bcom byang chub mchog dbang nyid brnyes nas5/ /thugs rjes mi bsnyel lus can gzhan yang zhi ba bla med lam bzang du/ /smin mdzad dbang stsol 6sa gsum bdag po spyan ras gzigs dbang 'a/ btud de/ /skal ldan ting 'dzin ye shes sems spyod rnam dag dbang bsgur cho ga bshad / /7yid 'ong gnas su bde ba yi/ /rkyen sogs dam tshig kun ldan pas/ /snying rje chen bo mdun gzhag la/ /gus pas sngon du gsol gdab bo/ /'dom gang srid 'phags nam mkhar ni/ /thub pa chen po 'khor los sgyur9/ /bde chen yum dang lhan cig skyes/ /dpag med sras 37—6 6

bcas bsgom par bya/ /sna tshogs dngos kun mchod pa'i sprin/ /kun du bzang spyod ji bzhin du/ /mchod byas sdig pa bsal nas su/ /rnam dag dbang bskur de rjes nod/ /lha dang bdag lus gnas gsum du/ /rdo rje 'bru gsum mngon bsams7la/ /dad dang thugs rje dam tshig gis/ /kha dog rim gsum 'od zer dbyung / /sku mchog snying po oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang / /gsung rgyun dri med āḥlas de bzhin dmar po'i 'od/ /rnam dag thugs bdag t+t+waṃ las rnam 'phros rab sngo zer/ /bdag lus ngag yid gnas gsum la reg dri gsum sel/ /de rjes bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo/ /dag byed rnam gsum man ngag bzhin/ /de 'og ye shes rnam gsum gzhug /mthar ni gnyis med bzhi pa'o/ /thig le gsum rgyun sbyor ba ni/ /de rjes blo gros chen pos bsgom / /dbang bsgur nas ni gshegs su gsol/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa pad+ma'i phyag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi snying la rdo je 'dzin pa'i thugs rje'i gzhus bskyod byin rlabs 2kyi/ /mda' rtse rgos bsnun yud tsam gang la nag po'i phyogs kyi rtsa lag dang / /bdud kyi bu mo g.yo ba'i mig gis rnam kun blta bar mi nus pa'i/ /dpal gang bde chen rab tu 'bar byed 'khrul 'khor rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas 'phags pa thugs rje che / /ye shes 'khrul 'khor 'bar ba zhes/ /bya ba rang lus rtsa mchog gi/ /bu ga thog mar bsam par bya/ /rab dmar rdo rje rnon po'i 'od/ /khro zhing ha har bzhad pa'i nyams/ /thugs ka las brgyud ye shes mes/ /zhal bkang 37—617

bdag don brtson pa po/ /lcags kyu pad+mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /brtul zhugs 1drag po rtsal 'gyed pa/ /gzhan gyis mi thub stobs po che/ /tshon gang bar ni bsgom par bya/ /lte bar ye shes sbar ba'i rlung / /rtsibs brgyad gshog pa rgo ldan dang / /de dbus ri yig gis mtshan bcas/ / dhū dī yangs pa'i rkang zug pa'o/ /de dbus nas zhugs ye shes rlung / /rab tu rdo rje'i rkang sogs can / /snying dkyil pad+mo 'dab brgyad rtsa/ /bsdus shing grims par bzung ba yin / /de lte bde gshegs snying po yi/ /sa bon yi ge hūṃ dkar 'khrigs4 / /bltas te dgang ba'i rnal 'byor brtsam/ /sprul pa'i gnas kyi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsol ba'i rlung shugs 'dis bskyod pas/ /mgal 5me bskor ba ji bzhin du/ /sgra grag 6'od zer 'khrug pa yi/ /mi bzad rab tu 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de phyir ye shes shugs las kyang / /me lce g.yo ba de bzhin du/ /de 'bar srog shing rlung gis kyang / /thog med srog ragayo snying gar 'gyur/ /de tshe phe sgra dang bcas pas/ /steng nas lha yi bdud rtsi dbab/ /bde chen rab tu gsal ba'i dngos/ /'bar ba rab 'bar cher 'bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ye shes btung ba yi9/ /chang gis myos par mi 'gyur ba⑩/ /de tshe rang dbang med par ni/ /lus sems spro bas non par 'gyur/ /dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor dze+egs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po tshe rabs dbang du gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal ba 'dis lam dbang du ma gyur pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das tshe rabs dbang du gyur pa'i brtags pa bsgom par bya ste/ ji ltar spyod pa'i 37—648

gnas nyid du/ /'jig rten pha rol dran byas nas/ /ji skad bshad pa'i man ngag gis/ /dbang gyur 'phags pa mnyes par bya/ /dal ba ring du mi gnas dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bus rjes 'brel la/ /som nyi spangs nas srid pa las/ /yid byung zhi la dga' ba bskyed/ /bdag gis yongs su gzung ba gang / /ji tsam chags pas rjes bsrungs pa/ /de dag de tsam skyo ba yis/ /mchod sbyin byas te gcig pur gnas/ /zhing 'dir gdug pa 1drag po dang / /mi g.yo la sogs 'dun pa che/ /ltos bral lhag par mos bcas pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po nges par bya/ /de'i 'og tu bdag nyid kyi 2snying po gsum lha'i mtshan ma gsum du bsgyur te/ tha mal lus las 'das nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mngon par 'du byed pas bcom ldan 'das tshe rabs dbang du gyur pa'i gzugs kyi 'du byas pa la zhugs te bla ma dang lha rjes su dran pa dang ma bral ba bzhin du rig pa mchog gi sngags 'di brjod par bya'o / / oṃ āḥdīḥm ma pa ra dzān+d+ra 4rak+ṣu ba ra ṇi gubhi bir+ya bya ma he swā hā/ oṃ āḥdhīḥsarba duṣ+ṭa na 5ma ma kṛ 6te dze+e bha ya / ste bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/oṃ āḥtweḥm hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ma ma pa ra dzādz+re dzāspra ta ra sarba pra sbe 7be+e rāk+ṣa ba ra khaṃ gubhi sma ra sma ra pra ti dz+nyā ma hā sa ma ya su sma ra swā hā/ brtson pa'i cha lugs gnas zhabs gnyis/ /gang du 'dod pa'i zhing der bskyod/ / chu skyes la sogs sdong bu'am/ /rin chen pho brang mchog bdag 'jug /rmi lam rmis pas bar chod pa/ /do mod mtshan mo'i bar skabs 'bras/ /mkhas pas dogs pa med byas te/ /lha bsnyen ji ltar 'dod bzhin skye/ /skye bo kun gyi mngal sgor ni/ /snying rje chen po spangs pa'i rten/ /sa bon sdig pa bsams 37—6/9

nas ni/ /rtag tu 'jigs pas 1goms par bya/ /dpal ldan shar sogs yongs dag zhing / /mngon dga' drag pos rtag goms pa/ /smon lam lhan cig drang srong mthus/ /skar mda' lta bur thogs pa med/ /skye ba bsdams pa'i cho ga sgogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa srun ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub bo gang zhig 'chi ba dang / /'chi ba ma yin ltas gang dag /gang tshe mngon du gyur pa na/ /mgon po'i slu 2ba 'dir bshad do/ /'jig rten g.yeng ba ma lus las/ /rnam dben dal ba bsgrubs nas ni/ /mchog gsum skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /ci rigs chos spyod brtsam par bya/ /longs spyod bshes dang lus nyid dang / /byang chub phyogs kyi mngon par zhen/ /rnam bcu rnam gsum spangs nas ni/ /ltos 4pa thams cad rnam par dor/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /stong pa nyid kyi rnam thar gyis5/ /'khor ba'i gnas la yid phyung zhing / /mya ngan 'das la mngon par dga'/ /de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par bya ste/ kha lho phyogs su bltas la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid la byed pa dang ma bral bas/ mig me 'dzums 6par mdun gyi nam mkha' la rgyal ba lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor mngon par gsal bar 7bya'o/ /gal te spros par nus na ni sku gsung thugs ye shes phrin las mdzad pa dam tshig rnam pa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bdag nyid kyi snying ga rlung sems kyi ngo bo byeḥgasal po bsil ba'i 'od zer can la shes pa gtad nas ji bzhin dgug pa'i spyor bas gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i 37—650

'og tu rang gi nyer bsdogs kyi dngos po gang yin pa 'di dag nyid lha'i rnam par dag par dmigs1/ mngon par chags dang yongs su sdang / /rab tu mi shes gzhi gsum gyi/ /dbang gis 2las gang mngon gyur gang / /de 'dir mgon po gsum du mos/ /dbus su mthing ga rdo rje can/ /g.yas su dmar mdzes ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon du dkar gsal zhags bsnams pa/ /thams cad g.yon du pad+mo mtshan/ /rgya chen pho brang lhar bcas pa/ /skad cig gis ni lha gsum 'dir/ /bsdus la rim pa ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i 'chi bdag sngar bslu bya/ /gang phyir 'chi bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs gsum yin de yi rkyen/ /las phyir de yi mi mthun phyogs/ /stobs chen spyan ras gzigs dbang brten4/ /de bas 'chi ba bzlog 5'dod pas/ /sgu dang de yi nyer bstan dang / /bsam pa'i thugs rje che zhes pa/ /rnam gsum rim gyis bsgom par bya/ /cho ga 'di yis 'gro rnams kyi/ /snying gi bum pa chags sdang bcas/ / bcas shing 6de yi spyor ba dang / /yan lag rnam par gzhig pa'ang 'bad/ /'di yi 'grub pa rnam pa bzhi/ /ma lus 'chi ba bdag len dang / /de dag 'chi ba bzlog 7nyid dang / /sman mchog spyor ba nyid dang ni/ /'chi ba rnged dang brtse chen gyi/ /ltos 'dor khyad par nges pa'o/ /gal te 'byor ldan skye bo 8'ga'/ /nus na dkyel 'khor chen po yi/ / sgrub pa'i / tsha ga ji bzhen du/ /mkhas pas 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /ji srid 'chi bdag sgra gcan la/ /rnal 'byor tshe yi zla ba nya/ /grol 'gyur de tshe rmi lam du/ /gsung gi dbugs 'byin thob par 'gyur/ /de nas dga' ston tshogs bsags phyir/ /dpag med mchod pa'i rgya mtsho yis/ /phyi nang gsang dang yang dag gis/ /spyan ras 37—65/

gzigs dbang mchod par bya/ /'chi ba slu ba'i gdams pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo /sngags pa bde chen grong 'jug pas/ /bco brgyad e dbyings phyag rgya bca'/ /g.yo ba mi g.yo bzung nas ni/ /lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor bya/ /sprul pa'i gnas su ri bong 'dzin/ /ma lus byang chub sems bsdus gzugs/ /zla ba bzang ba bde ba che/ /'od mdzad drod rlung srog bdag bsam/ /trīḥ/ lha dbang lhan cig skyes pa'i sku/ /zhal sbyor spyi gtsug gzi brjid bzang / /sor bzhi pas ni bar chod bcas/ /bsams nas 'od kyi snyoms 'jug bskul/ /spyor mtshams dkar dmar rgyun lhung bas/ /bdag lus dri med byas nas su/ /thog mar gang bskyed phyis de bzhin/ /bde mchog zla ba bzang stobs bskyed/ /de nas kun sdud rdo rje yi/ /rlung bzung nas ni 'dus pa'i 'od/ /shing rta lam chen sbyang 1byas nas/ /lcags kyu lta 2bus drang byas la/ /gtum mo ye shes sbar ba'i mes/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor spros pas ni/ /me dpung la ni lan tshwa bzhin/ /mi bzad sgrar bcas gyen du 'phar/ /de tshe spyi gtsug rdo rje 'dzin / /shes rab nyid la bsnyus byas la/ /de yi pad+mo kha phye bar/ /rnam shes bung ba gzhug par bya/ /skal ldan ngo bo nyid dbang du/ /bde ba mchog gis rgyud tshim zhing / /chos kun rmi lam 'drar shes dang / /gang bsgyur sems ston grub pa'i rdzas/ /de nas 'og gi pho brang lha/ /'od zer dkrugs pa'i spyor ba yis/ /zhu byas de ni gong mar bstem/ /thim gyur rang gnas brtan par 'dod/ /dpal lha'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rdzogs so// //37——652

༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon zhabs kyi/ /cho ga ting 'dze+en rgyal po yi1/ /yongs dag zhing du rnam par shes/ /'phro 2ba rdo rje'i skar mda' brtsam/ /shin tu yid dga' grub pas byin brlabs sam/ /lha mchog legs gnas ting 'dzin grub pa'i gzhi/ /yang na dur khrod chu bo shing gcig 'gram/ /skal ldan chags bral the tshom med par zhugs/ /rgya chen mchod sbyin re ba med yid dag pa 4dang / /bcas la rgyal ba lha yi pho brang dga' ldan du/ /rtse gcig yid byed gang la chags pa'i gnas/ /me 'obs dong ltar mi dga' skyo ba drag bskyed bya/ /skyil krung rgyal po rdo rje'i mdud pa brtan pa la gnas la/ /spyi bo snying ga lte dbus haṃ dang hūṃ dang saṃ rim bzhin/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar po 'od 'phro rtsa chen sbubs nang gzhug /pha ma sems dbyings lus rlung srog bsdus yi ge gsum la bsdu/ /skye med las skyes me yis rab bzhus rgyal sras 'od 'dzag 5sprul pa bskyod/ /lcags kyu zhags pa rdo rje rlung gis haṃ saṃ hūṃ gsum gcig gyur cing / /ye shes 'od phyung dhū dī'i 6lam byung shin tu dmar gsal dag byas la/ /rje btsun phyag mthil pad dbus a las 'od sbubs dmar po yang drang bya / /7de la rje btsun spyan ras gzigs nyid gdul bya'i /don la gcig tu thugs rnam par brtse bas bdag gi ltos pa thams cad nye bar dor ba thugs bskyod pa ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod gang gi tshe che'i dus byed pas nying mtshams spyor ba'i 'jigs pas rab tu 'jigs par gyur pa de'i tshe/ kho bo'i thugs rje dang byin gyi rlabs kyis byu nas kyang / khyod ji ltar 'jigs 37—653

pa med pa de ltar yang dag par skyob par 'gyur gyis thams cad kyi thams cad du rnam pa thams cad 'khor ba'am ngan song du ya nga ba dang 'jigs par ma byed cig /rigs kyi bu che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod rjes su 'dzin pa'i lha ni nga yin no zhes gsungs pas 1dbugs phyung ste/ ji skad brjod 2pa dang / skye ba drag po gnyis kyis gnas gnyis la mngon par dga' ba dang / gdung ba nyid dang lhag pa'i lha la gus pa mi bzad pas skyabs su gsol ba ni thabs yin no/ /de nas stobs ldan sprul pa'i dbus/ /legs bcug dhū tī'i dbus nas su/ /sbubs dag nas ni sran 'brum bzhin/ /mkhas pas rnam shes 'phro bar bya/ /tshangs dbang za dang 'gul dang 'phrig /dmigs pa rang dbang gyur nyid dang / /gsol btab ngal bsos gdon mi za/ /brtan pa'i 'phro 4ba grub pa'i ltas/ /rdo rje skar mda'i man ngag rdzogs so// //byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ngan song sbyong ba la phyag 'tshal lo//snying rje chen po yid gzhungs 5pas/ /spyan ras gzigs dpal bsnyen byas te/ /lus can mi 'dod bzhin du thong 6/ /de dag ngan 'gro bzlog par bya/ /sngon nas sbyangs pa nyid dang ni/ /gzhan dag glo bur bya ba nyid/ /de bzhin phyi nas gzhan gyes te/ /mchog dang bar mtha' grangs bzhin 'dod/ /bdag nyid gang la lhag par dad/ /me tog lhung ba nyid dam snga/ /goms par bsnyen par byas pas lha/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs kar dgod/ /de nyid lhag 7pa'i lha yin na/ /sa bon nam ni lha yi sgu8/ /yang yang goms par rang gi sems/ /de yi thugs bcug ting 'dzin bya/ /mi g.yo ba dang rtse 37—65

gcig dang / /kun du sdud pa zhes bya ba'i/ /ming can 'od zer 'du sngon 'gros / /g.yeng ba spangs la brtan par gnas/ /spyi bo snying ga lte ba ni/ /haṃ dang hūṃ dang e bsams nas/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis gcig tu/ /basbus nas 'phen pa thabs yin no/ /de nas rten la yid 'phrog cing / /dmigs pa brtan par gyur pa na/ /'od kyi sbu gu'i spyor ba yis/ /rten de nyid dang de yi zhing / /mkhas pas bdag dang bdag gir 1bya/ /cho ga'i rgyal po 'di yis ni / /rnal 'byor bar dor 'jug pa na/ /dran pa tsam gyis goms pa yis/ /rten la blos 'jug 'jigs med 'gyur/ /de ltar ring nas lam goms pa'i/ /blo ldan dus las 'das gyur tshe/ /'phags pa ngan song spyod dpal gyi/ /cho ga bdun phrag bdun du sbyangs / /ro 'am rus pa'am gos sam ming / /rten de'i mdun du bzhag nas su/ /ma dag pa dang dag pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis la rten gnyis gzhag /brdeg dang bsreg dang bkru ba yis/ /dri ma gzhig gzhom dad pa dag /dkyil 'khor nag po bya bas te/ /brtan dang dbang bskur bya ba la'o/ /yungs kar bye ma thal chen la/ /rig pa bzlas nas bsnun bya zhing / /sbyin sreg cho ga'i bya ba yis/ /rten bcas bag chags 'bad de bsreg /ngan song spyong ba'i sku gsung thugs/ /bzhu ba'i chus bkang bum pa blugs/ /rdo rje'i glu blang reg pa bzla/ /ma lus dri ma bkru bar bya / /oṃ āḥtweḥsarba durga ti ba ri sho dha ne+e rā dz+wa ya/ a mu ke kā ya wāka tsit+ta 4sarba pā paṃ to ṣa wa ra ṇa dzha ga dzha/ ḍa ha ḍa ha/ bār ts+tsha bār ts+tsha5/ sho dha ya sho dha ya phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de rjes dri ma dag pa'i sems/ /lhag pa'i lha la bcug nas ni/ /ji bzhin dbang bsgur byas te mchod/ /dga' ston chen po 37—655

sbyin par bya/ /tshe 'das pa la bya ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po gzi brjid kun nas 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal ba don yod dus las 'das pa dang / /sdeg mang ngan 'gro'i sgor zhugs de bzhin du/ /ya nga bar ma nying mtshams sbyar ju1ba'i tshe /de rten cho ga rgyal pos rnam par sbyang / /slob dpon shin tu snying brtse can/ /rig pa rgya mtsho pha rol son/ /brtan zhing mi 'phrogs mkhas pa yis/ /dbugs bral slob ma mdun du gzhag /chus bkrus dris byugs rgyan btags te//brdeg 2dang bkru sogs cho ga bzhin/ /de nas sngags bcas bdug pa yis/ /bgegs bskrad 'khor lo babyungs nas ni/ /spyi gtsug bla ma yab dang yum/ /snyoms zhugs thig le ma lhung ba/ /goms pa'i lha rten mdun gnas kyi/ /shangs bug nas ni myur basbus zhes/ /de yi thugs dkyil pad+mo bsgom/ /rdo rje'i rgyas btab zum pa'i nang / /mi 'gyur yongs 'gyur lha gzugs bskyed/ /slar byung zhing mchog de sras gyur/ /dogs su mthar phyin gru 'dra yis/ /phung po ma dag dag pa dang / /dag pa dri med bsreg 4rdzas su/ byin gyis brlabs la rtog bral mchod/ /sngags chu dri ldan yungs kar dang / /ral gri la sogs ma/tshon brdar phye/ /mar dang til sbyar drug cing bsreg /me lce 'bar ba'i ltas rnams 5brtag /gson tshe goms par byas pa yis/ 'bras bu de ring dus yin gyi/ /bu khyod 'khrug par ma byed par6/ /brtan par rnal 'byor dran nga/ra gyis/ /khyod kyi lus kyi grong khyer ni/ /rten 'di yin te de yi thugs/ /bu khyod sems dang gnyis med nyid/ /khyod kyi rtag gnas 'di yin 7te/ /27—— 656

yongs dag zhing ni rtag pa'i yul/ /rjes 'dzin ju1bshes gnyen 'di yin te/ /'di dag gnas skabs 'byel pa'o/ /gang yang gnas dang lus 'di dang / /spyod yul 'di la nyes dmigs dang / /yongs dag zhing dang rten dang ni/ /spyod yul mchog brjod nges par bya/ /gzhan yang 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /sdig dang dge legs skyon yon mang / /sngags mtshams dal bus rnyed nas su/ /skyo dang spro bas dbugs dbyung 4ngo / /de rjes gtor ma bzang byin la/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab/ /dam tshig 'dzin pa'i sngags bzla zhing / /rus pa bsdus la 5mchod rten bsgrub/ /ro bsreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /spyan ras gzigs me'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas me lha'i 6gtso bo sbyin sreg mnyes7/ /zhes 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'bar ba'i dbus na brjid pa'i sgu/ /me thab dang ni pad+mo 'dzin/ /dmar ba'i 'od kyis gdug pa bsreg /sgrub po'i don mdzad rgyal gyur cig /sdig pa gzhig dang dpal bskyed phyir/ /las kun sgrub 9par byed pa'i rgyu/ /rnge yi las ni phyogs gnyis la7/ /mkhas pas 'bad de rnam par brtag /pad+mo lta bu'i thab dkar mdzes/ /khru bzhi khru gsum khru gang tshad/ /zlum po rgya 11phyed slar brus pa/ /sor bzhi phyir bskyod kibye dor byug /kha khyer stegs ngos pad+ma dang / /rin chen dra ba dra ba phyed/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad pa/ /sgo bzhir bcas dang pho brang nyid/ /'o ma 'dzag dang dri 'byin dang / /bkra shis byed pa'i yam shing tshad/ /ci rigs dri zhim sngags byugs la/ /bsangs nas gtor ma sngon 'gro bas/ /rol mo mkhan dang me tog brgyud/ /bram ze'i 37—657

khyem nas blangs pa'am/ /yang na rdo rje yam shing la khrul 1me/ /bsil yab kyis ni g.yabs te sbar/ /mar dang til dang 'bras dang nas/ /me tog sman dang 'bras bu sbrang / /zho zan yungs kar drur 3ba shing / /mthar byed sngags kyis bsang bar bya/ /arga la sogs byin brlabs la/ /lha yi sbyor bas me lha bskyed / /me dang yo byad yam shing sbyangs/ /ye shes bkug pa dbul bar bya /oṃ badz+ra asna ye swā hā/ mar dbul ba'o/ /o badz+ra sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra swā hā/til dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra san tuṣ+ṭa na ye swā hā/ me tog dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra nir byā di swā hā/ sman dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba pha la ye swā hā/ 'bras bu dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a nu smṛ 4te swā hā/ sbrang dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ ba de 5swā hā/ zho zan dbul ba'o/ /o badz+ra āḥbispyon 6swā hā/ bgegs bsal ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ drur 7ba dbul ba'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bo bye z-i k+ṣa 8ye swā hā/ yam shing dbul ba'o/ /oṃ s+dzatweḥn maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ oṃ 9agha ye a mu ka gya sarba karma sedhi ku ru 7swā hā/ bsreg rdzas thams cad kyi mgo'am mjug du dgang blugs dbul ba'o/ /gzhan yang mchod pa thams cad kyang / /ci rigs mkhas pas shes byas te/ /dgang dang blugs pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /mnyes byas khrus dang bcas pas mchod/ /mthar bzod par gsol ba dngos grub blangs la gshegs su gsol nas bde ba la reg par gnas pa bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /thugs rje chen po bkra shis kun du snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /37——658

de nas kun du snang ba bkra shis byed/ /ces 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o / /slob dpon gang zhig gdul bya'i don mthong bas blo rab tu phyogs te/bsil khang gi rnga yab lta bur gzhan gye dbang gis g.yo zhing mi brtan pa thob pa na/des bdag la dad cing ltos pa dor ba rnams kyi don du 'phags pa zla ba'i kha dog can yid la byas la/ dkar po'i tshes brgyad dang bcu dang bco lnga la ji snyed 'byor pa'i yo byad dang ldan pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /bkra shis bzang dang bkra shis nor 'bru sman/ /bkra shis mchod rdzas dang ni bkra shis rgyan / /dpal ldan bkra shis dkyil 'khor cher bri la/ /bkra shis rgyal po spyan ras gzigs dbang dgug /gang dag gang gi 4phyir dang gang du ji ltar bya ba'i rang bzhin thams cad la bkra shis zhes sbyar ro/ /shis pa brjod pa'i dbyangs dang sems dang rjes su mthun pa'i rol mo dang glus mchod do/ /me tog dkar dmar dang tsan+dan dkar dmar dang rgyan 5dang dri'i khyad par nges pa'o/ /yo byad glo bur ba dang gsar du skyes pa mtha' dag la rgyal bar gyur pa'i tshig sngon du song bas so/ /sbyin bdag gam slob ma'i lus bkrus la bkra shis kun du snang ba'i rgyas gdab po/ /dge ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar/ /kun du 'od mdzad thugs rje che/ /bkra shis brgyad ldan pad+mo 'dzin/ /sa gnon ting 'dzin mchog gis 6brjed/ /de nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la gdugs la sogs pa brgyad do/ /mu khyud la grub pa nyi shu'o/ /steng nas bkra shis kyi 7rdzas sna tshogs pa'i char 'be+ebs pa 8lha'i sgu brgya stong phrag mang po'o/ /mchod pa'i sprin du ma las 'brug 1sgra dal bus sgrogs pa dang / glog 'byin pa yang 'god par bya'o/ /'og nas klu'i rgyal po 37—659

rgya mtsho la sogs pas bum pa nor bus gang ba 'bul ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje slob dpon kun du snang / /bkra shis rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /sngags brjod bum pa dgu gang bya/ /bum pa gang ba dgu la sngags kyi phreng ba dgu dgu bzhu bas byin gyis brlab po/ /rdzas snod dang bcud ma lus pa la ni lha rdzas kyi nor bu rdo rjes 1mtshan pa re res brgyan par ro/ /phyag dang bskor ba byas nas bgegs bsal te bkra shis sbyin par bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu dpa' thogs la/ /snying rjes kun du bskor zhing rgyug2 /gnas dang gang zag rnal 'byor rnams/ /ma lus bsrung ba'i bkra shis stsol / /oṃ āḥdīḥ/a i u e o saṃ aḥshrī āt+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra saṃ ga la sidhi a byeṣ+ṭha ne+e na dā na pa ti che ge mo'i sarba pa ri gra hā swa 4ste ma hā saṃ ga la su saṃ ga la pra ti saṃ ga la sid+dhi sid+dhi hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ bkra shis kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal spyan ras gzigs sgu gdung rnam par snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mchod rten gyi ni cho ga brjod/ /ji bzhin brtags shing sbyangs pa'i sa/ /dri zhim chus bran gsang sngags brjod/ /mgon po snying rje che rnal 'byor/ /sangs rgyas bstan la rab gus pas/ /yongs dag dkyel 'khor mdun byas te/ /mchod sogs cho ga ji bzhin brtag /de'i rjes la bsrung ba'i dkyil 'khor sngon du song bas mtshams 5bcad de/ oṃ s+dza bispyo ta kṛ 6ta hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /oṃ tweḥbadz+ra kha na kha na t+t+waṃ/ sa rko 7ba'o/ /oṃ dhīḥbadz+ra ā yu ṣe hūṃ/ sa blang ba'o/ /oṃ tweḥbadz+ra a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ chu sbyang ba'o / /oṃ dīḥ.a badz+ra bhū mi bhu li pañca rat+na hūṃ/ sa dag par bya ba'o/ /oṃ 37—660

dhīḥbadz+ra bha ba ni swa bhā 1ba bi shudha a sgo ye hūṃ/ bsres nas badze+e 2ba'o/ /oṃ dhīḥbadz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ brdung zhing mnal ba'o/ /oṃ trīḥ badz+ra ubye ba 4ya swā hā/ 'be+e 'bi bya ba'o/ /oṃ dīḥbadz+ra a ra dze swā hā/ til byug pa'o / /oṃ s+thāḥdharma dhā tu gabye swā hā/ 'bi 'bi gzhug pa'o/ /oṃ dīḥdharma dhā tu gasgo badz+ra rū 5be+e nirma na ya 6swā hā/ phyag rgyas 7'debs pa'o/ /oṃ s+thāḥbadz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa gardza sirnye ho swā hā/ tho bas bskyod pa'o/ /oṃ dīḥbadz+ra lo ka nā tha nirma na pra ka se swā hā/ dbyung ba'o/ /oṃ dīḥbadz+ra su pra tiṣ+ṭṛ ta badz+re swā hā/bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /oṃ tweḥbadz+ra tsa kra pra brta na swā hā/ 'khor lo gzugs pa'o/ /oṃ s+thāḥm hā stso tro la hūṃ swā hā/ gdugs dbul ba'o/ /oṃ dhīḥpañca li ka bās+t+ra hūṃ swā hā/ na bza' gsol ba'o/ /oṃ dhīḥsarba de sha ya a bi di k+ṣu ma ka ra hūṃ swā hā/ bzod par gsol ba'o/ /oṃ dhīḥ.ā ka sa dharma swa bhā ba bi shudhe hūṃ swā hā/ lha mchog nga rgyal brtan las dad pa yi/ /g.yo ba 'od kyi phreng ba dkar bskyed de/ /ye shes spyan drangs sgu gsum rang bzhin la/ /de nyid rdo rje brtan pa'i sngags brjod gzhug /oṃ āḥdīḥbadz+ra tri kā ya pra tiṣ+ṭṛ 2 ti hūṃ swā hā/ rab tu gnas pa'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa tre+e rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyak+shi bud+dhā ྾ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne rat+na bi dza ye swā hā/ i āḥs+thāḥt+t+waṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rten yongs su dag par bya ba dang / cho ga phun sum tshogs par bya'o/ /tsha tsha 'debs glupa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄7/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gser mdog can la phyag 'tshal lo//yon tan ma lus rgya mtsho yi/ /mthar phyin gser 'od kha dog can/ /mdzad 37—66/

pa gcig gis gdul bya yi/ /dpag med don grub nyid zhabs 'dud/ /sngon du goms pa thob pa yis/ /tshogs pa tshang bar byas nas ni/ /snying rje can gyi pags ri1pa la/ /mi g.yo rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 'dug /me yi las sam gtor mar bcas / /gus pa drag pos mchod sngon 'gro/ /rim dang cig car bskyod pa'i rim/ /mkhas pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ /ji snyed /rmyesku gsung thugs rten yod/ /de snyed ston pa nyid yin te/ /rab tu gnas pa mi 'thad mod / /lhag par gnas phyir rab gnas brjod/ /de la sku khrus byug pa sogs / /phu dud byas la mdzes zhugs te/ /slob dpon lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /ye shes basbus la gnyis pa gzhug /oṃ āḥs+thāḥdzaḥ/ oṃ āḥ— bhebyāḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥ cho dīḥbaṃ / oṃ āḥtredīḥhoḥ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud tredu sbrel/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni lcags kyu'i tshul/ /rgyu 7'di ye shes dgug pa'o/ /de las mdzub mo gnyis bkug dang / /rdo rje bsdams 8dang gar bsgyur ba/ /dgug pa bcing dang dgyes bya ba/ /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /ji ltar bdag nyid la bcings pa/ /de bzhin rten la yang yin te/ /bcings nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang / /mchod pa la sogs bdag 'jug bzhin / /oṃ āḥs+thāḥbadz+ra kā ya wāka 9 tsit+ta pra tisbi rā hūṃ hūṃ trebadz+ra dz+nyā na a dhiṣ+ṭha 11 ni sarba lak+ṣa ṇa pa ri pū ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sarba dharmāshā2ཿswa bhā ba bi shud+dhā nyune+ebi ma la da ma hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje'i lus kyi pad+ma'i lag /rin chen me tog snyim par bzung / /'khor lo'i gar bsgyur rgya gram gyi/ /phyag rgya ldan pas gtor bar bya/ /de nas me tog rtsi thog bcud/ /dri bzang mang dang ldan pa yi/ /gser gyi thur ma rdo rjes mtshan/ /thogs la mkhas pas spyan dbye'o/ /oṃ āḥs+thāḥtsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu 37—662

1655ra༅/ /phrag stong spyan stong gi sgrub thabs/sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha sra bhū 2 dza nai tra sā dha rna/ bod skad du / phyag stong spyan stong gi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten rnams kyi mgon po mchog /dkar po thugs rje rtags 'chang ba'i/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis 'gro 'dul ba/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bdag nyid dran phyir sgrub thabs gang / /nges pa'i shes pas 4bri bar bya/ /'gro ba rnams kyis 5dben pa yi/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs/ su/ /sa/ gzhi legs par byugs byas la/ /me tog dri zhim bkram byas te//gcig dang sbyar bas 'dug pa'i stan/ /bde ba la 'dug byas nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed la/ /snying gar ram̐ las gyur pa yi/ /'od 'byung dmar po bsam byas nas/ /de steng thugs yid las gyur pa'i/ /gnod mdzes rgyal por bdag bsams te/ /chu shing ram shing sbyar ba'i sgras/ /37—678

phyogs bcu dag tu sdigs mdzub snadang / /sngags kyis yang dag bskrad par bya/ /oṃ sarba bispyon ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ de nas bdag nyid snying ga las2 / /a las ri bong can bsams nas/ /de ni thugs mchog bsgom par bya'o / /de las 'od zer nag po dag /sa gzhi dag la spros byas pas/ /sa gzhi la sogs 4rdo rjer gyur/ /de las 5'od 'phros ra ba dang / /gur dang bla re 6dra ba dang 7/ /shin tu mngon par bsgom par bya/ /de nas nam mkhar bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /sngon du mngon sum dmigs pa la/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa dang / /sdig pa bshags dang yi rang dang / /bsod nams bsngo dang skyabs 'gro dang / /sems bskyed pa dang gnas bzhi dang / /mthar ni stong nyid bsgom pa'o/ /don gyis dngos por bsams nas ni/ /sngags 'di myur du bklag par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmāḥ9swa bhā ba shusgopho—haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha1rtahaṃ/de dag nang du bsam bya ba/ /ya wa ra la rnam bzhi pa/ /steng du sna ldan gzhag pa las/ /dbang chen chu bdag 'bar ba dang / /skyed par byed pa rnam bzhi yi/ /dkyil 'khor kha dog rnam bzhi rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du rnam par bsgom/ /de steng sum̐ las ri rab ni/ /rin chen sna bzhis yang dag gnas//de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ /khang pa bstegs pa bsam bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan/ /ye shes sna lnga'i rtsig pa dag /phyogs bzhi dag tu brgyan nas kyang / /dra ba dra phyed dag dang ni/ /rin chen pha bu 5dag dang ni/ /gru bzhi par ni brgyan pa yin/ /twa sar na ni bzhis brgyan cing / /mdzes pa'i pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / /rdo rje thig sgud 37—679

'od 'bar ba'o/ /grwa 1bzhi dag tu dpag bsam shing / /chen po bzhi dang klu rgyal dang / /sprin dang phyogs skyong zhing srung rnams/ /yang dag par ni dgod par bya/ /de dkyil thig ni bzhi btab pas/ /dkyil 'khor dgu ru gyur pa la//dkyil du bcom ldan phyag stong pa/ /kha dog dkar po sdem bag can/ /zhal gdong bcu gcig phyag bco brgyad/ /dbu ma'i zhal gsum dkar la mdzes/ /lhag ma khro zhal 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /kun kyi steng na 'od dpag med/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi phyag rgyas btab/ /dang po phyag gnyis snying ga na/ /thal mo nges par sbyar ba yin/ /de 'og g.yas na dgra sta dang / /de 'og gri gug rnon po yin/ /pad+ma ral gre zhags pa dang / /ljon shing me long bsil yab dag /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa yin/ /g.yon pa'i phyag ni de 'og dag /rdo rje dril bu mda' gzhu dang / /lcags kyi bum pa 'khor lo dang / /gdugs dang rin chen 'bar ba rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du bsnams par mdzad/ /rdo rje bsnams pa'i phyag gis be+e/ /lha mo pad+ma'i sgrol ma la/ /gnyis su med pas 'khyud par mdzad/ /lha mo de ni zhal gcig ste/ /phyag ni drug tu nges pa ste/ /dang po'i g.yas pas ut+pal gye/ /steng na pad+ma brgyad bsnams pas/ /thugs rje che ba 'khyud par mdzad/ /de 'og gri gug pad+ma bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i dang pos me long dang / /bsel yab bum pa bsnams par mdzad/ /hūṃ dang paṃ las gyur pa yi/ /phyag stong yum bcas de ltar bsgom/ /de yi shar gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /yi ge baṃ las gyur pa yi/ /rdo rje pad+ma zhes bya ba4/ /zhal gcig kha dog dkar po can/ /phyag g.yas dang po ut+pal gyi/ /steng na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /de steng rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /sngon po nyid kyis bsnams par 27—680

mdzad / /de 'og 'khor lo zhags pa dang / /g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu 'dzin / /de 'og lcags kyu dgra sta dag /phyar ba nyid kyis bsnams par mdzad / /lho phyogs dkyil 'khor sngon po la/ /yi ge ram̐ las gyur pa yi/ /rin chen pad+ma bsam bya ba/ /g.yas kyi dang po ut+pal gyi/ /steng na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /de steng rin chen zur brgyad pa/ /'bar ba nyid kyis yang dag 'dzin/ /lhag ma shar gyi bcom ldan ltar/ /phyag mtshan rnams ni bsnams par mdzad/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po la/ /sum̐ yig 'bar ba las gyur pa'i/ /thub pa'i pad+ma bsgom bya ba/ /g.yas kyi dang po rang nyid kyi/ /mtshan ma rnams ni bsnams par mdzad/ /lhag ma shar gyi bcom ldan ltar/ /phyag mtshan rnams ni bsnams par mdzad/ /byang gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu la/ /bcom ldan las 1kyi pad+ma ni/ /yi ge kai las gyur pa ste/ /g.yas kyi dang por rang nyid rtags/ /phyag gzhan gong ma rnams bzhin no/ /shar lhor 2rdo rje sgrol ma ni/ /lha mo sku mdog sngo skya la/ /zhal gcig phyag ni drug pa'i dbyibs//g.yas kyi dang po ut+pal te/ /chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa la/ /rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams par mdzad/ /phyag gzhan gri gug pad+ma dang / /me long bsil yab bum pa bsnams/ /baṃ yig las gyur de ltar bsam/ /lho nub rin chen sgol ma ni/ /ram̐ yeg las gyur dmar ser mdog /phyag g.yas dang po rang nyid rtags / / lha mo /rdo rje sgrol ma bzhin/ /nub byang thub pa'i sgrol ma ni/ /sum̐ yig las gyur ljang dmar mdog /dang po rang gi rtags 'chang ba'o/ /byang shar las kyi sgrol ma ni/ /ge yig las gyur ljang skya'i mdog /phyag g.yas rang gi rtags 'chang zhing / /phyag gzhan gong ma rnams dang mtshungs// /grwa 427—68/
