bzhir rin chen bum pa bzhi/ /kha dog rnam 1bzhis rnam par gnas/ /de yi phyi rol snam bu la/ /ling 2tshe bcu drug bri bya ste/ /phyag na rdo rje 'jam dbyangs dang / /kun gzigs sgrib pa rnam sel dag /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa la/ /kha dog rnam bzhis rnam par gnas/ /g.yas na rdo rje ut+pal dang —/ /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams/ /'gying bag tshul du gnas par mdzad / /g.yon pa dang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de dag kun gyi g.yon rol du/ /sgeg mo rin chen phreng ba dang / /dbyangs dang gar gyis mnyes mdzad rnams/ /rang rang phyag rgyas yang dag gnas/ /byams pa nam mkha'i snyeng po dang 5/ /kun bzang sa yi snying po dgatsho /rang rang kha dog phyag rgya yis/ /de yi cha la rnam par gnas/ /de g.yon me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab lha mo rnams / /rang nyid kha dog phyag mtshan gyes/ /yang dag par ni gnas pa'o/ /lha rnams de dag thams cad ni/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan7/ /pad+ma'i steng na nyi zla yi/ /steng na rab tu gnas pa'o/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /sgo rnams na ni sgo skyong dag /shes rab mthar byed gshin mthar byed/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar rnams/ /dbu gsum phyag ni drug pa la/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs kyi cha lugs can/ /phyag g.yas dang po ral gri dang / /rjad dbyug nga/d+ma rgya gram 'dzen/ /lhag ma lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /rtse gsum lcags sgrog dam pa'i bdag /rdo rje brag gi steng gnas pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /thugs las 'od zer spros nas kyang / /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas/ /mdun du yang dag mchod par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas spyor shes pas/ /dam tshig 'khor lo myur du gzhug /de nas rang gi 37—682

sa bon las/ /'od zer nam mkha'i phyogs spros nas/ /pad+ma'i sgrol sogs lha mo lngas/ /ye shes lnga yi bum pa yis/ /chu yis bdag la dbang bskur ba'o/ /oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu rmā lo ka nā thā 1ya hūṃ/ de nas bdag nyid snying ga la/ /ri bong can dang shing rta bcu/ /kha sbyor phur mar gnas pa yi/ /nang du chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad/ /de steng dug gsum yi ge ni/ /kha dog dkar po rnam par gnas / /de la bstod nas dkar po ni/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'o/ /'phrog dang nang dang kun gyi steng / /dug gsum yi ges rnam par brgyan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu spros pa las/ /'gro ba sems can thams cad ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad sbyangs byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ngo bos gnas/ /de dag rim par bsdus pa las/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /bsgoms pas skyo na sngags bzlas pa/ /mu tig phreng ba'i tshul gyis su/ /steng nas steng du 'bar ba ni/ /rang bzhin 'khor bar rnam par bsam/ /dang po dag dang bar gnas pa'i/ /tha ma dag gis bsdus pa yi//sngags kyis yang dag bzlas par bya/ /oṃ pad+ma hastu ya/ sa ha —sra badz+ra bhu dza nai 5tra/ dī la kaṇ+ḍa lo ke shwa rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma tā re hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nga/d+me t+t+waṃ / khro rat+na pad+me hūṃ/ rma mu ne+e pad+me hūṃ/ a karma pad+me hūṃ/ khro badz+ra tā re hūṃ / oṃ mu ni tā re hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na tā re t+t+waṃ/ oṃ karma tā re hūṃ/ o badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/oṃ mañju shrī hūṃ/ oṃ sa man+ta ka ka 6hūṃ/ o ni ba ra ṇa bi skam+bhi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye 8t+t+waṃ/ oṃ rat+na mā le hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma 9gī ti hūṃ/ oṃ karma ni rti hūṃ/ oṃ mai tri ya hūṃ/ oṃ a gang saṃ gu ra be+e hūṃ/ oṃ sa man+ta bha dre t+t+waṃ/ oṃ k+ṣi ti gabye hūṃ/37—683

oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na puṣ+pe hūṃ/ o pad+ma ā lo ke hūṃ/ oṃ karma gabye hūṃ/oṃ pra dz+nyā n+ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ pad+mā n+ta ka hūṃ/ oṃ bispyon 1ta ka hūṃ/mchod pa dag ni nyi shu yi/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas yang dag mchod/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /rtag tu 'don pa nyid du bya/ /lam du zhugs dang 'chags 2pa'i tshe/ /spyod lam la ni spyos pa na / /rdo rje rtse gcig phyag rgyas ni/ /'od byung steng la snying po yi/ /sngags de yongs su gyur pa dang / /cho ga gsum las rtogs 4pa yi/ /rim pa bzhin du lha bsams nas/ /yan lag bzhi la rab tu bstem/ /cho ga'i phyag rgya dpa' bo lnga/ /phyag rgya 'di yis lus mdzes pa'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /bdag nyid phrin las rnam bzhi yi/ /rnal 'byor yang dag bsam byas la/ /las kyi dang po zhi ba mchod/ /dkyil 'khor khru gang zlum po la/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas nang bskor zhing / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng ba dag /de yi phyi rim 5bri byas la/ /dri zhim dkar po zhor ldan pa'i/ /bsreg cing ku shas bcings te gzugs/ /gu gul me tog ku sha dang / /mar dang 'bras thug til dang ni/ /'o thug lung thang sngon po dag /las kyi sngags ni mthar sbyar la/ /me lha de yi snying ga yi/ /mkha' la 'khor lo bsam byas te/ /bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi / /rim pa bzhin du mchod nga/'o/ /bya ba rnams ne+e thams cad la/ /de ye ngo bos mnyam par gzhag7 /de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gye gzugs kyi sku/ /chos kyi sku ste ga'an kyi mchog /sngags kyi mgon po mchog gi lha/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes rdo rje stobs po che/ /shin tu nges pas zhi ba'i tshul / /jeg pa chen po'i go 'phang thob/ /rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /27—68/

shin tu dag pa'i dpa' bo che/ /mchog 1gi dbang phyug kun gyi mgon/ /dam chos mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i/ /ji bzhin 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /cir yang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ral gri bsnams/ /mi rtog ye shes go cha can/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor de la yang / /ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru gsum 'bar ba bsam byas nas/ /de dkyil tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang / /gsal bar rab tu bsam byas nas/ /snod ni rab las rin chen ni / /rang bzhin 'bar bar bsgom byas nas/ /der ni kha zas sna tshogs rnams / /bsams nas de dkyil rdo rje ni/ /rtse lnga rab tu 'bar ba las/ /bdud rtsir gyur par rab tu bsam/ /de nas rang gi sa bon las/ /'od zer kha dog sna lnga dag /nam mkha'i phyogs su 'phros pa las/ /phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mdzod spur zhugs nas thugs kyi ni/ /bdud rtsi blangs nas de nyid du/ /'dres par bsams nas sngags 'di yis / /byin gyis brlabs nas bza' bar bya oṃ āḥhūṃn / bdag gi 4'jig rten mgon po yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di byas pa yis / /sems can 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /nyon mongs sgrub pa kun bsal nas / /sgu gsung thugs kye rda rje can/ /lha ye sgu ne+e thob par sheg /slob dpon chen po dngos grub brnyes pa/ ta thā ga ta badz+ra'i 5zhal snga nas mdzad pa/bcom ldan 'das phyag stong spyan stong gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas shar phyogs rja ga la'i/ /nyi ma 'byung gnas zla ba zhes bya ba/ /mkhas pa chen ngo/ de yi zhal snga nas/ /bod kyi lo tsā dge tshul 37—68pya

kyi 'i snyi po 'ikhyung grags sa/ /'dul ba bstan pa nga ra gnas pa sa/ /dpal ldan rgyan gong gtsug lag khang de ru/ /bder gshegs bstan la phan phyir bsgyur 1 lags kyi2/ /rnal 'byor spyod rnams nges par brtson par mdzod// //bsdur mchan/678 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag/ /phyag stong spyan stong bi sgru ba thabs bzhugs/ 〈〈snar 〉skoraphags pa phyag stong spyan stong sga sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉ku/〈〈snar 〉〉bhu/ 〈〈snar 〉d+kug 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 5〈〈pe 〉tha/679 1〈〈pe 〉thasdigs 'dzub/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sna tshogs/ 5〈〈pe 〉phro/6〈〈snar 〉bre/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉rag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 711〈〈snar 〉ri3 / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyod/ 1 〈〈snar 〉ṭhags/ —〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༄/ sa〈〈snar 〉〉to/68༷ 1 〈〈snar 〉lbā/ 2〈〈pe 〉ra/ra mkhyud/ 〈〈pe 〉7 mkhyud/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/681 1〈〈snar 〉d+kudas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzag ma/ 4〈〈snar 〉wā/6/2 1〈〈snar 〉〉rnams/ 2〈〈pe 〉'a/ 〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/ 4〈〈snar 〉7dang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉rang / 7〈〈pe 〉〉rgyan/683 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thañca tu ram̐ 'o la nā tha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom// 4〈〈pe 〉wā sa/5〈〈pe 〉༄ dza de/ 6〈〈pe 〉phron ta kri ki/ 〈〈snar 〉7n+ta ki ki/ 7〈〈pe 〉stod ba ra na ni skam bi/〈〈snar 〉wā bar ṇa bi smi ma bhi bye/ 8〈〈pe 〉'a/ 〈〈snar 〉7/ / 〈〈sna ra 〉tha/d+me/ 〈〈pe 〉〉te gar be/〈〈ñca ra 〉〉rte sasgo/684 1〈〈snar 〉'aṭ+wāṃ/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉d+kuchag 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉lke/ 4〈〈pe 〉d+ku rdzogs/ 〈〈snar 〉phros rdzogs / 5〈〈snar 〉jol / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'as/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag685 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/dog 〈〈sna ra 〉tha/ 〈〈snar 〉rjaḥ/ 4〈〈pe 〉thas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadz+re/ ‘〈〈pe〉phro/686 1〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/ 2〈〈pe 〉sum̐s/27—686

༄khya/ /'phags pa 'jog rten dbang phyug gi yid bathen gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ki 2te shwa ra byun+ta ma ṇi tsakra wat+t+waṃ sā dha ṭaṃ4/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba spyob mdzad thugs rje chen po'i gtso/ /zla ba'i nor lta'i sgu mnga'i thugs rje dang / /tshomachog sbyin de la gsum gyes phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyi ma'i zer gyis mun bsal chu skyes kha 'byed ltar/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis ma rig mun sel snying gi pad+ma 'byed mdzad pa'i/ /sgrub thabs dam pa bka' drin dran phyir bri bar bya/ /me tog ra ba la sogs gtsang ma yid dga'i gnas su ni/ /rnam lnga dhīḥyis bsngags pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs par bya/ /kha dog dkar po'i me tog la sogs mchod pa ldan byas la/ /yi ge gsum ldan khrus kyis dri ma gnyis bkrus te/ /nyon mongs/ mtha' dag gzhig phyir bde ba'i stan la 'dug /yi 27byed688

——ge gsum ldan dhīḥyis gnas bdag rnal 'byor bsrung / /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du s+thāḥ1yig dkar po bsam/ /'od kyis 'gro ba'i don byas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan drangs te/ /yi ge gsum ldan dīḥ2yis me tog la sogs mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas sdig pa bshags shing mi bgyid —sdom pa blang / /rjes su yi rang skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol mdzad thugs rje'i 5'od kyis blta/ /byam sa pa'i 'od kyis sems can 'jig rten mgon gyi gzugs su mthong / /dba' ba'i 'od kyis sems can bde ldan rgyun mi 'chad par bsam/ /btang snyom/sa 'od kyis gzung 'dzin cha spangs chos nyid mthong bar blta/ /gzung ba das phyir sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudzhaḥsarba dharmāḥ6swa 61 wa shurjopho7haṃ/ 'dzin pa dag phyir sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dri med nam mkha' lta bur kun blta sa te/ /dbus su paṃ 9skyes pad+ma dkar po sdong por bcas/ /lte bar spyoḥ las byung ba chu shel 'od dang ldan/ /de dbus dīḥ yig las byung yid bzhin nor bu 'bar/ /dīḥ ldan 'od kyis 'gro ba'i don byas te/ /phyogs bcu'i rgya' sras bkug ste nor bu byin brlabs pas/ /de yongs gyur te 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhengs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'gyeng bag 'ed zer dkar po 'bar / /gu lang dkar po'i mdog bzhin gzhon nu rgyan cha can/ /phyag gang /sa sbyin pa bzhi yi gter sasbyin yid bzhin nor bu 'bar/ /phyag g.yon 'khor ba sgrol phyir 'khor lo rin chen ldan/ /spyi gtsug thor tshugs steng na gsu nga gi dbang phyug bzhugs/ /thugs rje'i snye'od kyis 'gro ba kun khyab byed/ /37—689

rang snying pad steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /nor bu'i dbus na dīḥ1yig dkar po gsal/ /de 'od las byung sgrol ma khro gnyer can sogs phyogs bzhi'i lha / /pad+ma zla ba'i steng na 'gying bag ldan par bzhugs/ /phyi rol rgyal chen bzhi dang mchod pa'i lha mo sprul/ /de dag sku mdog so so'i phyag mtshan gtso bor mtshungs par blta/ /kun kyang thugs kar zla ba la gnas nor bu sa bon bsam//'od zer lcags kyu dang mtshungs nam mkha' khyab spros te/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs me tog la sogs pas/ /yongs su mchod nas legs par sngags 'dis gzhugan /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs 'o ma chu ltar tha dang med pa'i 'khor lo la/ /skye mched gnas su zla ba dhīḥyig bsam/ /sgu gsung thugs la yi ge gsum bltas la/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa bskul/ /mchod bstod byas nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣiñca tu saṃ4//de nas de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /lha yi chu ldan bum pas ni/ /'khor lo la ni dbang bsgur te/ /spyi bo 'od dpag med pas brgyan/ /gzugs sogs rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /'khor lo la ni legs par mchod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /de dag gis ni bstod par bya/ /de nas thugs kyi sa bon las/ /yi ge sngags kyi phreng ba ni/ /mar me lta bur rab bltas la/ /'od kyes sems can thams cad ni/ /'jeg rten mgon por bsgrub 5byas te/ /yi ge'i phreng ba rnams la bstem/ /zhal dang lte ba'i bar du ni / /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phreng bar bsgom/ /oṃ byudha ma ṇi tsakra brti ma ṇi pad+me āḥdīḥ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma bha ra ta ke ā7ཿdhīḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la sogs pa rnams//she7——690

sa bon yi ge gsum dang ldan/ /swā hā phaṭa ces bzlas par bya/ /'od zer la ni yig 'bru dgus/ /rdo rje sgud pa lta bu yi/ /'khor bar bzlas pas lus khyab nas/ /sgrib pa gnyis spangs ye shes kyi/ /'khor lo gsal bar ston par byed / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /lha rnams kyis ni bsnyen 'gyur te/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar byed/ /bye ba gsum rdzogs sngags pa yis/ /rab dga' la sogs sa thob nas / /sa bcu'i 1dbang phyug mthong bar 'gyur/ /sngags bzlas dus su cho ga ni/ /gtsang mar byas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /gu gul tsan+dan a ka ru/ /puska sa dus tso ri ka /go ro tsa na shing gi bcud/ /legs sbyar dung ngam nya phyis su/ /bzhag ste brtse ba la sogs pa'i/ /gzungs sngags stong phrag bzlas nas ni/ /phyag g.yas zla ba dri bcas pas/ /dkyil 'khor khru do la sogs byug /pad+ma dkar po la sogs pa'i/ /me tog lha yi gnas su bkod/ /der ni paṃ skyes pad+ma ni/ / dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ni/ / rim pa gsum du gnas par bsam / /lha rnams thugs kyi sa bon las/ /lha yi 'khor lo sprul byas te/ /pad+ma rim pa gsum dag la/ /rim pas lha rnams bzhugs par bsam ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs bstem/ /dbang bsgur cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /skye mched gnas gsum byin brlabs te/ /a ka ru dang shel spang ka /bra ma tsa ri la sogs pa'i/ /dri zhim spos kyis mchod par bya/ /pad+ma dkar po tsam pa ka /dz+wa ya kun+das mchod par bya/ /ga pur go ro tsa na dang / /tsan+dan dkar por ldan pa yi/ /dri zhim mar gyi mar me dbul/ /sā lu dkar po zho zan dang / /sbrang bcas 'o ma dbul bar bya/ /dri zhim dkar po chu yis ni/ /37—69/

sku la byug pa dbul bar bya/ /na bza' rgyan dang me tog phreng / /gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan dang / /rlung yab la sogs rgyan rnams dbul/ /dril bu pi wang rdza rnga dang / /gling bu rnga rings pa ṭa 1ha/ /sgra mchog rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma 'khor lor 2bcas pa la/ /bstod nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /'khor lo'i lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /thugs kar pad steng zla ba la/ /tweḥ yig sngags kyis bskor bar blta4/ /'od zer sngags kyi phreng ba ni/ /zhal nas byung ste rjes gnang tshul / /bdag gi zhal zhugs thugs kar thim/ /de dag khri phrag sngags bzlas 5nas/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag po/ /sngags phreng kha dog bzhir shes nas/ /mdun kyi dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ /rjes su mthun pa'i gsol ba gdab/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /'khor lor bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /gang 'dod dngos grub sbyin par bsam/ /de nas lha rnams thugs kar basbu/ /de ltar cho ga byas nas ni/ /mchod bstod gsol gdab sngon 'gro bas/ / gzungs sngags bzlas pa brtson par bya/ /6bsnyen pa rdzogs par gyur na ni/ /gang zhig bdag gam nad pa'am/ /gdon chen nyen dang tshe nyams dang / /'jigs 7pa brgyad kyis nyen pa la/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga brtsam par bya/ /shes par gyur pa'e nyi ma la/ /ras sam sheng lo gro ga ni/ /dri zhim spos kyis bdugs 8pa dang / /nye ba'i snying po stong phrag gcig /dīḥ bcas sngags kyis byin brlabs te/ /gur gum go ro tsa na dang / /kor se sha ldan khu ba yis/ /'khor lo legs par bri bar bya/ /me tog dkar po'i yu ba yis/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad bri/ /dbus su dīḥ chen bris pa'i nang //27—692

sgrub pos legs par bri bar bya/ /phyi rol pad+ma'i lte ba la/ /yi ge gsum ldan nye snying po/ / s+thāḥ1yig bar du sgrub pa po/ /rak+ṣa ku ru ldan par bri/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la ni/ /snying po spel sngags ldan par bri/ /pad+ma'i mu khyud tha ma la/ /rtsa ba'i gzungs sngags gong dang mtshungs/ /gtsang sbra 2ldan pas bris nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dri yis legs byugs la/ /me tog dkar po dri zhim po/ /sil ma legs par bkram pa yi/ /steng du 'khor lo legs par gzhag /lha rnams thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /'khor lo'i 'od kyis sems sbyangs te/ /paṃ bskyed pad+ma'i gnas rnams 5su/ /gzungs 6sngags mar me'i phreng ba bzhin/ /'od ldan gsal bar bsgom par bya/ /de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /lha yi 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ /mchod dang bstod pa byas nas ni/ /'khor lo la ni bstem par bya/ /lha rnams thugs ka nas spros pa'i / /rtsa ba'i gzungs sngags la sogs/ pa'i/ /khri phrag bzlas pa 'khor lor bsnyim/ /des ni srung 7ba'i sgrub pa rdzogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub sgrub 'dod pas/ /gong gi dkyil 'khor legs byas te/ /dbus su gtso bo la sogs pa/ /lha rnams cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ /ye shes spyan 'dren la sogs pa / /cho ga'i yan lag thams cad kyang / /gong gi mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyes / /dus gsum legs par mchod byas la/ /ye ge grangs kye 'bum phrag bzla / /thun mtshams gsol gdab bskor ba ni/ /brgya 'am stong phrag re re bya / /de tshe thugs rje byin rlabs kyis/ /'khor lo zhal stong 1 yang na ni/ /dngos grub rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ /lus la 'od zer 'byung ba dang / /dri zhim shel gyi mdog dang mtshungs/ /sems can thams cad dad gyur cing / /27—693

gcan gzan 1ri dwags 'bros mi 'gyur/ /nam mkhar 'phur dang shing rta zhon/ /rgya mtsho sgrol dang ri rgyal 'dzeg2 /nor bu 'khor lo rnyed pa dang / /pad+ma dkar po zla ba mthong / /s+thāḥ bcas yi ge zhal zhugs mthong / /rang mdog dkar po khrus byed na/ /de dag 'grub pa'i rtags su bshad/ /de nas sman mchog ri lu bsgrub4/ /bum pa bzang po'i nang du ni/ /yungs kar ba yi rnam lnga dang / /ru rta tsan+dan dkar po dang / /shi ri khaṇ+ḍa 5ga pur dang / /rnam par rgyal ba'i a ru ra/ /sman lnga 'bru lnga rin chen lnga/ /dri lnga snying po lnga bcas te/ /rgyu skar rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ /bum par stsal 6te dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su legs par gzhag par bya/ /de steng gdugs dang ba dan dang / /phyogs bzhir rgyal mtshan gdags par bya/ /der ni lha yi 'khor lo ni/ /cho ga gsum gyis bskyed par bya/ /ye shes spyan drangs la sogs pa/ /cho ga rdzogs par byas nas ni/ /dus gsum mchod dang bstod par bya/ /'jig rten mgon po'i — thugs kar ni/ /paṃ bskyed pad+ma zla ba'i steng/ /a las bum pa bzang por gyur/ /nang du dhīḥs mtshan ri lu bsam/ /gtso bo la sogs lha rnams kyi / /thugs las rtsa ba'i snying po dang / /nye snying spos nas ri lur bstem / /thun mtshams bskor ba brgya phrag byas/ /de tshe ri lu lhar mthong na//'jeg rten mgon po 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri lu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na/ /zhi sogs phrin las 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri lu nyi ma zla bar mthong / /mkha' la 'gro 'gyur je tshom med/ /ri lu 'khor lo nor bur mthong / /yid bzhin dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /de tshe bum pa'i gzugs mthong na/ /sa 'og dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /'od mthong lha yi spyan dang 'dra/ /sgra byung 37—69

lha yi snyan dang ldan/ /ral gris shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /du ba byung bas tshe 'phel 'gyur/ /dri yis nad rnams zhi byed 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bzlas pa la sogs pa'i/ /sgrub 1pa gzungs kyi cho gar shes/ /bdag gis sgrub thabs 'di brtsams pas/ /de yis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /'jig rten mgon po thob par shog /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur 2ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dze tā rdo ris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa tīrti dang / sna nam rdo rje bla mas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/688 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod 〉 da du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'phags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bi yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor lo sa sgyur ba'i sgru ba thabs bzhugs / 〈〈sna ra 〉〉༄'phags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyus yid bathin nor bu 'khor lo sgyur ba'i sgru ba thabs bzhugs so // 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra / 〈〈smi ra 〉lke/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉〉bha rnyi swa da na/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phri 'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rjes/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉bye/689 1 〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉d+ku / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thagyod/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rje/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shut+ta sa rba darmā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉gi3/ 8 〈〈pe 〉mos ma/ sgo ca/ 〈〈snar 〉mas ko ha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉gi2 / ཿ〈〈sma ra 〉〉( na/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉s+thā/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sgo ra 〉snga cu/sa〈〈snar 〉sngagator/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉〉rje/69༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉'dis bzhug/ 〈〈sna ra 〉sngaradi sazhus 〈〈pe 〉7sa / 4〈〈co 〉〉〉// 5 〈〈pe 〉〉sgru ba/ 6〈〈sna ra 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉gi.ā/691 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sma ra 〉thacu/ 〈〈pe 〉ṅkadasar ngo 'dab ma brgyad pa ni// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉lkebra/692 1 〈〈pe 〉ra/ 〈〈pe 〉nga sa/ 〈〈sna ra 〉la / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 4〈〈ñca ra 〉7/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈stsa ra 〉thongs /37—695

༄༅/ /'dze+eg rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ke shwa ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo//je btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgom par 'dod pas/ dang por skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed byas nas rang gi snying gar yi ge a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du yi ge s+thāḥ2dkar po gcig bsgom par bya'o4/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pas ri bo 5 ta la na rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs pa de mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te de la rang gi lus dpag tu med par 6sprul nas yid kyis phyag byas par bsam zhing snying ga'i dīḥ'i 7'od zer gyis mchod pa lngas mchod de/ spyig pa thams cad ni so sor bshags so/ /bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gis bla na med pa'i ye 37— 697

shes thob par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /de nas ye shes pa de'i thugs ka'i yi ge dīḥ1las 'od zer byung ste/ rang gi snying ga'i yi ge dīḥ2la thim de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa gnyis dag par byas te rang rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug sgu mdog dkar po zhal gabyug phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na nor bu'i bgrang phreng /g.yon gye gnyis pa ni nga/d+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan kun gyis spras shing / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang ldan pa cig tu gyur par bsam de nas ye shes pa de rang dam tshig pa la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsgom/yang rang gi snying ga'i yi ge dīḥ4las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog ste de rnams kyi sgrib pa gnyis dag par byas nas thams cad rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gyur par bsgom zhing / de rnams kyi 5ngag tu sgra ci grag pa thams cad kyang yi ge drug pa zlos par 6bsam/ rang gis zlos pa'i tshe de thams cad kyis yi ge drug pa di ri ri zlos par bsgom zhing dag par bzlas so/ /mthar yongs su dag pa'i bsngo ba bya'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //slo ba dngo na klu sgru ba kyis ma dzad nga / chag lo tsā ba chos rje dang la gyis nyung ngur basbus te bsgyur ba'o// //27—698

1658༄/ /yi ge drug pa'i rgyud kyi rim pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣā ṭa a k+ṣa ra tan+t+ra kra ma maṇ+ḍal tsakra u pa de sha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ yi ge drug pa'i rgyud kyi rim pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig dang por ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa phyogs su zhugs nas/ thal mo sbyar la spyi bor bzhag nas shar phyogs su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ban+da rgo ka 4ro mi zhes phyag bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na ban+da rgo ka ro mi/ zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ban+da ṭaṃ ka ro mi/ zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du byang phyogs su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma ban+da nai ka 1 ro mi/ zhes bya bas phyag bzhi byas la/ g.yas pa'i khya tshur spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ubye ba ya swā hā/ zhes bya 27 — 700

bas lus dang ngag dang sems byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /khu tshur de nyid kyis kha la/ oṃ pad+mod bha bā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas ngag byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ badz+red bha bā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas sems byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la cho ga 'dis bgegs bsal 1bar bya ste/ oṃ a mṛ ta ha na ha na sarba bispyo 2da ha da ha/ sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces bya ba brjod la thal mo sbyar nas/ mje bong bar du bzhag pa de la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba'i yi ge 'bar ba'i rnam par bkod la/ thal mo de las phyogs bcur 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phro bar bsams nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta ha na ha na sarba bisprun da ha da ha/ sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba 'di lan bdun brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdabs nas se gol yang lan gsum brdab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sngar bshad pa'i 'bar ba'i rdo rje las rdo rje dra bas bgegs thams cad bsal bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du re pha las me 'bar ba'i rnam pa bsams la rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha/sarba karma su tsa rnge/ tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma mā me muñca pad+ma badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥzhes lan bdun brjod do/ /spyi bor a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid la yi ge oṃ gyis brlabs la bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags brjod pa'i rjes nyid la snying ga'i gnas su re pha las me sbar la lus thams cad bsregs la 37—70/

yang spyi bo'i zla ba'i bdud rtsi 'bab par bsam mo/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje thal mo bcings la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pasgra nā ya āt+ma rgo nir+ya 1ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sha ma se ta sarba satwa rgo sarba sidhe ya saṃ par+yan tai/ sarba ta thā ga taṣ+ṭa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha two/ zhes bya ba 'di nyid lan gsum brjod la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis nam mkha' yongs su gang bar lhag par mos la de rnams yid kyis mchod nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs nga/ bya'o/ /oṃ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi / /sdog pa thams cad so/ sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung 2/ /zhes bya bas sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsarba dharmāḥ swa bhā ba shuzlopho4haṃ/ zhes brjod la/ byang chub kyi sems tsam la lhag par gnas pa sems kyis mthong nas/ oṃ dharmā 5dhā tu swa bhā pa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes mngon par brjod nas/ byang chub kyi sems de yi ge paṃ gyi rnam par yongs su gyur par mthong nas/ de nas sna tshogs/ nga/d+ma chen por bskyed la/ de'i steng du yi ge a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yang yi ge a las zla ba'i dkyel 'khor/ de'e steng du zlo dkar po/ de las mchod rten dkar po/ de las yang / rnam pa gsum du spros pa nyid kyis bum pa dang / kha khyer thams cad kyi steng du yang yi ge t+t+waṃ bsams la/ bum pa de'i nang du yang a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de la yi ge drug las 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dmar po/ mtshams kyi 'dab 37 —702

ma bcu gnyis pa/ de'i steng du yi ge tweḥ1las 'dab ma drug pa'i pad+ma dkar po/de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/zhes bya ba yi ge drug pa gong nas gong du nang du zhugs par rnam par bsgoms la / de gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das sgu mdog dkar po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig pa phyag drug pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan can bsgom mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas pa'i dang po ni ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya de'i rtse mo la cung zad dbu 'dud pa'o/ /gnyis pa la phreng ba/gsum pa'i phyag skyabs sbyin la rin po che zur drug pa bsnams pa'o/ /phyag g.yon gyi dang bos pad+ma'i steng du rin po che zur drug pa gnas pa la pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa la dbyug pa/ gsum pa la ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa'o / /de'i g.yon gyi pad+ma la bcom ldan 'das pad+ma sgrol ma oṃ pad+ma tā ri pa hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis de'i rnam par bsam mo/ /khyad par ni pad+ma dor la ut+pa la'i steng du rin po che zur drug pa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa bsnams pa'o/ /shar du oṃ badz+ra pad+ma hūṃ/ lhor oṃ rat+na pad+ma hūṃ/ nub tu oṃ mu ne+e pad+ma hūṃ/byang du oṃ karma pad+ma hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi rim pa 'dis/ rdo rje pad+ma dang / rin chen pad+ma dang / thub pa'i pad+ma dang / las kyi pad+ma rnams bcom ldan 'das nyed kyi rnam par bltarā/ /khyad par di pad+ma'e steng du rin po che zur drug pa'i steng du rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / 'khor lo dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /me'i phyogs su oṃ badz+ra tā re hūṃ/ bden bral gyi phyogs su oṃ rat+na tā re hūṃ/ rlung gi phyogs su oṃ mu ne+e tā re hūṃ/ dbang ldan du oṃ karma tā re hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis go rims bzhin du bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi 37—703

rnam par rdo rje sgol ma dang / rin chen sgol ma dang / thub pa'i sgol ma dang /las kyi sgol ma dag bcom ldan 'das la mngon du bltas pa'o / /1khyad par ni ut+pa la'i steng bzhin du/ rin po che zur drug pa'i gnas su rdo rje dang /rin po che dang / 'khor lo dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs par bsam mo/ /phyogs mtshams 2kyi 'dab ma la shar phyogs su oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ/ lho ru oṃ pradz+nyān ta ka hūṃ/ nub tu oṃ pad+mān+ta ka hūṃ/ byang du oṃ bibyān+ta ka hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi ngo bor khro bo bzhi blta bar bya'o/ /khyad par ni g.yas brkyang ba/ mi'u thung gi rnam pa la zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ sna gong nyag pa dz+ren ma ser skya nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas nga/ra bsgom mo/ /thams cad kyi g.yon pa'i rtsa ba'i phyag dag ni sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag dag la tho ba'o/ /gnyis pa la ra'/ gri'o/ gsum pa la zhags pa'o/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis la pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed la snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dkar ngo// de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me t+t+waṃ zhes snga ma bzhin du yi ge rnams bsams la/ de las 'od zer spros nas sems/ can thams/ cad yang dag par sbyangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kye ngo bor bsgrubs nas/ yang bsnyus te de nyid du zhugs 4so/ /de'i rjes la sngags kha nas byung nas rdo rje'i lam nas rjes su zhugs nas mu tig gi phreng ba ltar bsams nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa byas nas snying ga'i sngags las cig car dkyil 'khor gye 'khor lo phyi rol du spros nas mchod par bya'o/ /'di 27 70/

dag gi sngags ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ ar+ghaṃ gyi 1sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pube+e pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ me tog gi sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ mar me'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa byu ha hūṃ/ byug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rā sa e gro bi ta ni 2a ha ri na san+ta ra pa ya me pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/lha bshos kyi sngags so/ /de ltar mchod pa byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyi yi ge la gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bstod pa dang / smon lam yang btab nas/ langs la rang gi lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /yi ge drug pa'i rgyud kyi rim pas 4dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bstan pa'i sgrub 5thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dza na dang / lo tsā 6ba gzhon nu 'od kyis bsgyur ba'o// //37—705

1659ra༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khaso pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra kharba pa ṇa pa sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kharba pā ṇi'i na sgrub thabs / mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid dang mthun pa'i phyogs gang yang rung bar ji ltar bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ras ris la sogs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku mdun du bzhugs par dmigs la/ phyi nang gi mchod pas legs par mchod de/ sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bdag nyid dbul ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'go ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung 4/ /zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rang gi snying gar yi 37—707

—ge a / las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 1'od zer dang bcas pa de'i steng du yi ge ṣ+ṭṛrjaḥ'od zer 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs de dag gis chos thams cad drangs nas 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams dhīḥnade nyid kyi nang du zhugs pa dang / thal mo lan gsum brdabs la tshig 'di lan gsum brjod do/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥ sadze+e dhazwaḥ4swa bhā ba shusgolha5haṃ/ de'i 'og tu chos thams cad bdag med par 6bsgom par bya'o/ /tshig gi don dang bcas par bsams nas/ zla ba bye ba dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer yongs su gyur pa las ral ba'i cod pan gyi dbus na gnas pa'i rgyal ba'i sgu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i 7phug gi nang na pad+ma chen po dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung la g.yas pa cung zad brkyang ba/ /phyag g.yon pa na pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yas kyis mchog spyin pa zhi ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs na bcom ldan 'das ma sgol ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 9pa ut+pa la'i snying po kha 'byed par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon logs su khro gnyer can cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang / spyi blugs bsnams pa g.yas gnyis kyis phyag byed pa dang / mchog sbyin pa'o/ /spyi gtsug las skyes pa'i mchod rten gyis brgyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon na khro bo chen po rta mgrin phyag g.yas pa phyag 'tshal ba dang / g.yon pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas na nor bzangs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs pa de ltar bsam mo/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni 'phro ba yis/ /rnal 'byor 'di 'dra bsgoms na ni/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od chen po/ /tshe 37——708

'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /bsgoms pas dub par gyur na/ rang gi snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags mu tig gi phreng ba dang 'dra ba bsams 1te bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/brgya 'am stong du bzlas par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag nyid kyis mchod pa legs par bya'o/ /oṃ khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol2/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gshegs pa dang slar byon par bsgul nas bzod par gsol bar bya ste/ gang yang bdag blo gti myug pas/ /'dir ni nyes pa gang byas pa4/ /gang yang lus can skyabs gyur pas/ /mgon po khyod ni bzod pa bzhes5/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas / /ma tshang ba dang ma rnyed pa'i/ /'dir ni bya ba gang byes 6pa/ /mgon khyed de ni bzod par mdzod/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob nas kyang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal dka' las/ /'gro ba ma lus sgrol bar shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khaso pa ṇa'i 7sgrub thabs rdzogs so8// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyu ra ba rdzogs so // //

1660༄༅/ /'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ṣa ṭā 2k+ṣa ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo / /dang por re zhig sngags pas gdong bkrus nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/sangs rgyas la sogs par 4bsams la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /bdag ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba yin no zhes/ mos par 5byas nas/sems can ji snyed sems can du bsnyu bas yang dag par basbus pa7/ sgo nga las skyes pa'am/ mngal las skyes pa'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa'am/rdzus te skyes pa'am/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min te/ ji srid du sems can ni khams gsum du gdags pas/ btags pa de dag thams cad bdag nyid kyis phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyengs su dgod 37—7/ /

par bya'o zhes bsam/ de nas oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudha1ཿsat+tha dharmāḥ2swa bhā ba bi shurjolha haṃ / de nas stong pa nyid du basbu bas bsdus pa tsam gyis bsgoms la/ de'i 'og tu rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge dīḥlas 'od zer brgya stong 'byung bar bsgoms te/ yang de nyid kyis thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa ma lus pa mtha' dag rnam par dag par byas nas/ bdag nyid kyi snying gar zhugs pa las/ bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgu mdog dkar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas na bgrang phreng g.yon na pad+ma bsnams pa/ gzhan gnyis kyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog dang phyag la sogs pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ /g.yon du 'bru drug pa'i rig pa 4chen mo phyag bzhi pa ston ka'i sprin lta bu'o/ /de nas oṃ ma hā su kha 5badz+ra satwa/dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ a la la la la ho/ a a a a zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms nas de'i 'og tu 'jig rten dbang phyug gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la phreng ba 'dra ba dkar po zhal nas byung zhing lte bar byugs te 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po 'di mtshan ma rnged pa'e tshul gyes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas lus g.yo ba dang bcas pa la sogs par gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa dad pa dang snying rje dang / bla ma la gus pa dang ldan pas ni ring po mi thogs nga/ra 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes de ltar bzla'o/ /de nas ldang ba'i dus su sngags 'di brjod par bya'o / /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/37—7/2

dṛ bye me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/sarba sid+dhim+me )pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ / bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥde ltar bzlas nas ci bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //slob dpon chen po pū dza badz+ras mdzad nga/'o// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā 4ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/711 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod ska da du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'phags pa/ yi she drug pa 'i sgrub pa/'i thabs bzhugs so// / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉khu ṭa/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈ñca ra 〉〉 pa'i/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra nga/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sdus pa/sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉btags /712 1〈〈snar 〉〉shuste/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉darma/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉dhadrwa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7lha/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku gas /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ sa 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉8 'o/713 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ad+dhi me/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thadzi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉phro/

1661༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang zhebyu1ga ga byu/ba thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra sā dha ram̐/ bod skad du/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje las byung ba/ /rnam lnga byang chub che bdag nyid/ /sgu gsung thugs kyis thugs dag pa/ /'jig rten mgon po mkhas pas bsgrub / /pad+ma zla dbus gzhon nu'i sku/ /skyil krung phyed brkyang 'gying bag brtan/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal mdzes pas sa gsum bdag gir gzigs mdzad pa'o/ /mchog sbyin pad+mo g.yas dang g.yon/ /rgyal ba'i cod pan rin chen rgyanan/ /'od dpag med kyis spyi gtsug mdzes/ /de yi thugs ni pad+mar rgyas / /dhīḥyig rang sems 'od gsal ba/ /sa gsum spyong 5mdzad yi ge bzhi/ /'khor lo rnam gsum dam tshig bzhi/ /sgyu ma brag ca mkha' 'dra'o/ /6thugs rje chen po khaso pā ṇa'i sgrub thabs tshigs su/ 37—7/bye

bcad pa bzhi pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/715 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༅/ /'phags nga spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sga sgru ba thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgru ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rgyal / ca〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbya ngas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉mkhas 'dra ba'o/ / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉skab sang ṇi'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1588)/rkangangag go /sngar/dngartarātshan sarā/rka——ba/——sha19nga ——rte'er+sha 22kābaka228na 261na( rtse261ba 196na —196na7nga ༄—bye /——/wa dngawa wa 5 4 3 //—rjes zang — ———/————/1/ 1/ 1/ 1/dazerngathabakhyim / 16(2 178 166 166 /bhewa ———

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga 2 sā ra ཿ/ bod skad du/rdo rnal 'byor snying po/ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// /mi rtag sdug bsngal dran byas nas/ /snying rje chen po rab bskyed de/ /spyi bor bla ma snying gar lha/ /rang sems ma yengs bsgom capar bya/ /gang shar thams cad de yin te/ /de ni gang du'ang ma shar ba'o/ /de phyir gang skyes de ma skyes/ /ma skyes pa nyid skye ba'i tshul/ /gang byes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir/ /de shar dran pas ma brjed na/ /gang snang stong pa nyid bdag tu/ /rnal 'byor rgyal por gdon mi za/ /ma rtogs 'gro la rang dbang du/ /rnam kun dmigs/ pa rnged yid kyis/ /snying rje chen po ngang gis 'grub/ /de yi thabs sbyangs/ byang chub bzhed/ /rnal 'byor snying po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen ngo/ shrī dza ga ta mi tra'i gdams pa i thi // //

༄ga /dpal kharba pa ṇa 'dze+eg rten dbang —phyug ga sgrub thabs/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī khaso pa 2 ṇa lo ki shwa ra sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ dpal kharba pa 4 ṇa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo /rnal 'byor dbang phyug byams pa dang / /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms las/ /byung ba'i byang chub sems kyi bdag /'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /de zhabs pad+mo la reg pas/ /'jig rten sbug bsngal bsgral ba'i phyir/ /ji bzhin ji ltar sgrub tshopa'i thabs/ /mdor basbus bdag gis bstan par bya/ /mkha' ltar dri med stong nyid dbyings las dbang po gzhu ltar gsal ba'i dngos/ /pad+mo zla rgyas thugs gsung 'od 'phro sgyu ma'i rnam thar sprul pa'i sku/ /rab mdzes khru ni gzi brjid brtan mdzes 'bar ba'i 'od zer dkar 'khrigs pa/ /skyil krung phyed brkyang dul ba'i phyag g.yas mchod sbyin gsal po g.yon gyi phyag /37———7/9

pad+ma'i sdong mdzes dri med 'dab rgyas 1gzhon nu sgeg po'i thugs kar 'dzin/ /shel ltar dri med ut+pal spyan ring kun nas yid 'phrog 'od 'bar zhal/ /brtan po dkar gsal zla rgyas stong lhag ral pa'i cod pan thub pa'i gdan/ /'bar ba'i rin chen dri med sna tshogs shin tu 'od sbyangs legs spras shing / /mkha' la nyi shar lham me lhan ne+e nam mkha'i mthar gtugs 'od 'gyed pa/ /dpe byad mtshan rdzogs gcig pu skyob pa skyabs kyi dam pa slu med de2/ /shin tu rtogs dkar de nyid gzhir gyur snying gi pad 'dab dīḥ yig gis/ /gang ba'i phyogs rnams de bzhin de gzugs oṃ dang āḥdang tweḥdang hūṃ/ /dkar sogs kha dog dag gi phreng ba yid ni ye shes yig 'bru'i dngos/ /brtse ba'i rlung bskyod ye shes me 'bar 'gro ba'i sdig tshogs bud shing bsregs/ /zhi ba'i ngang ni gnyis med mi g.yo mkha' ltar spros bral ro gcig ro/ /bde chen 'byung gnas ye shes dri med mnyam gzhag chen po bsgom par bya/ /de rjes mchod sogs dag pa'i yan lag cho ga ji bzhin ye shes sems dpa' legs bcug ste/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo tshul go rims bzhin du sku gsung thugs/ /brtan po'i mtshan nyid dam pa'i zhal bzhin mkhas pas rab tu shes par bya/ /thugs rje chen po kharba pa 4ṇa'i sgrub thabs/ grub pa 5brnyes pa'i byes bu chen ngo shrī shābye la// rari trī ma dzad ༄ rdzos/sa so// //bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //

༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dze+eg rten dbang phyug lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar be+ed du/ pañca de wa ta thā ga to lo ka shwa ra sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/rgyal ba lnga 'a/ phyag 'tsha'/ lo/ /shin tu rnam dag dang ba'i mtshor rab mdzes sdong bu lnga ldan steng / /rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rin 'byung 'od dpag rnged don grub/ /sa rigs rnam dag sna tshogs gzugs/ /dngos gcig rgyal ba lnga la 'dud/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can la gnas/ pas// snying rje chen po mdun du byas la/ thog ma kho nar chos thams/ cad stong pa nyid du rab tu bsgom na par bya'o/ /gdod —nas ma skyes 'od gsal ba/ /gang shar nyid na ngo bo med/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /gang 'di ltar ngo bo nyid med pa'i chos 'di dag ni zab pa'i phyir rtogs par dka' bas mi 5shes pa'i 37 72 2

—'gro ba lnga po ni nges par sbug bsngal ba'o zhes brtags nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon par bskyod gyur pas/ /skye bo nyon mongs sgrib tshogs sprin kyi phung po shin tu mthug pos 1gtums gyur pas / /tsham/ tshom med par drag po'i shugs kyis kun du dral zhing yongs su gtor/ /de yi thabs gyur thugs rje'i dbyings skyes sna tshogs mdzad pa dbyer med cig car bsgru ba pa yi/ /mgon po dam pa 4rigs kyi lha lnga dri ma lnga spyong las lnga bsgrub cing stobs la sogs/ /de la dbus sdogs sdong 'dab bcas/ /zla ba'i 'khor la 5gsal ba la/ /me 'o/nga gzugs ltar 'bru lnga bsam/ /phrin las la sbyar sgur babyed do/ /rnam par snang mdzad ni kha ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can dīḥ'i snying po can 'khor los mtshan pa'o/ /rdo rje sems/ dpa' ni nam mkha'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can/ t+t+waṃ gi snying po can rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan ni gser btso ma'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can/ ṭ+wāṃ gi snying po can rin po ches mtshan pa'o/ /'od dpag med ni me lce 'bar ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can/ /dīḥ'i snying po can pad+mas mtshan pa'o/ /don yod grub pa ni sā lu ljang ba'i mdog can ji skad 'byung ba'i phyag rgya can/ aḥ'i snying po can ral gris mtshan pa'o/ /'di dag dbus bcas phyogs rnams su/ /rim bzhen las la mja da pa la/ /brtson pas ting nge 'dzin bzhugs pa/ /bdag sbyang ba dang ga'/na sbyang gnyis/ /oṃ a swa nga/ ra dz+nyā na bi shubhe 7kra sa t+t+waṃ/ 'khor lo lta bu'i sngabs so/ /thugs rje chen po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen ngo/ shrī mi tra ā nan+da'i 8gdams pa rdzogs so// //

1((65༄༅/ /seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sau ha nā da sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas kha bshal ba la sogs pa byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas / rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du yi ge dhīḥdakar po bltas te / de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs te mdun du bsams la/ de'i rjes la mchod pa dang sdig pa bshags pa la sogs byas te/ stong pa nyid rnam par 2bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko34haṃ/ zhes pa 'dis byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas skad cig gis paṃ gyur pa las pad+ma dkar po de'i steng du yi ge tsi yongs su gyur pa las seng ge dkar po de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge dhīḥlas yang dag nga/ra byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgrar bdag nyid bsam par bya/ dkar 37—— 72bye

ngo/ 'od dpag tu rnged nga/'i dbu rgyan dang ral pa'i thor cog can spyan gsum pa phyag gnyis/ nga/ dka' thub nga/'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ rgyal po chen po'i 'gying bag gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis pa'i g.yon pa na pad+ma gyen du langs pa'i thog na ral gre 'bar ba/ g.yas na rtse gsum dkar po sbrul gyis bcings pa/ yang nagayon ngos su dri bzangs sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'phro ba sprul pa'i sgu chen por bsam par bya'o / /bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥdīḥsau ha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ de'i rjes su gzungs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā/ ya/ na maḥ āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo bye satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 4ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/oṃ a ka ṭi/ bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi/ ka ro ṭi/ ka ro ṭaṃ/bīr+ya 5swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi spyan sngar snga dro'i dus su ba'i lco ba sa la ma lhung bas maṇ+ḍal brgyad byas la maṇ+ḍal re re la yang lan bcu gsum brjod par bya'o6/ /de nas lci ba lhag ma la sngags lan bdun bzlas la byin gyis brlabs te/ nad gang du byung ba'i sar bsgus na nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma bdun nam bcu gsum mam nyi shu rtsa gcig byas na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yin du zin kyang grub par ma gyur na ngas ma /tsham sa med nga lnga byas nga ra 'gyur ro/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra 'i sgru ba thabs / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa sdogs so// //dpyal chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //

༄ / /'jog rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ki shwa ra sau ha nā da sto tra nā ma2/bod skad du/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis 'jig rten nyes pa ma lus dbang gyur ji srid legs nga/'i lam la ma cabakod pa/ /de srid de dag 5yang dag gdon tshophyir bdag ni byang chub mchog tu bgrod par byed ma gyur/ /gang gis khams gsum 'di dag seng ge'i sgra chen mchog gis gsal bar gang gyur nga/sa// /rdu ga bsnga'/ can dag bskyab phyir thugs rje'i spyan dang seng ge sgra ldan khyod la bstod/ /ral pa rgya che'i dbyebs can dri med zla 'dra shin tu dkar ba'i zhal mnga' ba/ / bska'/ pa rwa du mar tshogs bsags brtul zhugs chen po shin tu dag byed dang ldan pa/ /'gro ba ma lus phan mdzad lha dang lha min grub pa rnams kyis rab btud pa/ /shin tu rgya che ba yi sgu mnga' khyod la rtag tu gus 37— —728

pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dmar po rgyas pa zla ba'i gzugs dang ldan pa'i 1gdan / /seng ge'i gdan gyi steng na rgyal po'i rol pas rnam par mdzes /chos kyi mnga' bdag 'byor pas dri med gsung ni bka' stsal pa2/ /'jig rten mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i dpal gyis dbu la mtshan la na'adud/ /g.yas kyi phyag ni pad+ma gsal ba lta bur 'jam pa yis/ /khams gsum nyes pa gsum po zhi bar bya phyir rtse gsum pa/ /'od zer 'bar 'khrigs sbrul dang ldan pas rtag tu gang 'dzin pa/ /bdag gi thub pa seng ge sgra de la ni rtag tu phyag bgyi'o / /khams gsum po la thugs rje chen pos 5gnas kyang skyon gyis ni/ /khyod la gos pa med kyang de dag spang phyir khyed kyis ni/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis ral gri dam rdzas dang bcas pad+ma bsnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras po khyod la rtag tu bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /nga rgyal la sogs tshogs kyis tshogayengs pa'i sems can rnams la ni/ /dmigs nas rgyal ba lnga po yang dag spros nas de rnams la/ /ji lta ji ltar dag pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa rnams / /gang la dgongs pa de mnga' phyag na pad+ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gang la tshig gi go skabs med pa ni/ /thos pa la sogs bral bas khyed la mos dang gus pa sked/ /de dag rnams kyis mkhas pa'i mchog nyid dag ni thob pa yi /mnyam med dpal ldan seng ge sgra la bdag ne skyabs su mchi/ /skye ba gzhan gyi mi dge mdze yi rnam par gyur pa rus pa dang / /sna nas rkang lag srin bus skad 'gags ldan pa dag /khyod bstod pas ni skad cig gis ni gser mdog lta bu'i lus su gyur/ /thub pa seng ge sgra khyod la ni de nyid de la / skyabs su mchi/ /klu yi mnga' bdag gyur pa chu lha dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /dus min char dang 37—729

char med mdze dang skyon dag 1zhi don dang / /'gro ba'i don dang don med tshogs dag rab tu sel bar mdzad pa yi/ /brtson 'grus brtan par rab brtsams khyod la kun nas 'dud/ /mang du brjod pas ci zhig khyod kyi mtshan dang sku dag dang // /gang zhig la la gus pas 'dzin pa dang ni sems dga' dag4 /skye bo de ni longs spyod rgya che ba dag thob par gyur nas kyang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal dkar brgal 5nas mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /ngag gi dbang phyug la sogs gang gis kyang ni rje btsun gyi6/ /yon tan phyogs gcig cha tsam bskal pa du ma ru/ /'bad pas kyang ni brjod par nus pa ma yin na/ /ji ltar bdag 'dras 'khrul kyang gus byas 'di dag bzod par gsol / /'jig rten gsum po'i sbug bsngal 'phrog / byed mchog gi dges byed can/ /dpal ldan seng ge sgra yi bstod pa las thob bsod nams gang / /dpag med kun+da ༷do shal dgod 1 pa dkar po dang 'dra ba/ /de yis skye bo byang chub 'gyur med go 'phang ri myur thob shog /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po ti la kas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba mal gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //37—7 30

༄༅/ /seng ge sgra'i srung ba'i 'khor lo jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sau ha nā da rak+ṣa tsakra nā ma2/ bod skad du / seng ge sgra'i srung ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje mchog dang ldan pa yi/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal te / /sems can kun gyi nad dang gdon/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /dus dang tshes grangs bzang po la/ /mchod rten maṇ+ḍal bshams nas ni/ /lha yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis4/ /ras sam shing lo gro ga la/ /khrag gam rgya skyegs gur gum gyes// /rim nga/ lnga ru bskor bar bya/ /dang po pad+ma'i lte ba yin/ /gnyis pa mu khyud phra bar bskor/ /gsum pa cung che pad 'dab brgyad/ /bzhi pa lnga pa'i rim pa rgo/ /nga/d+ma'i phyir la phra ba bya/ /yi ge dgod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /dbus su oṃ gyi spyor yig dang / /de mthar ming dang bsrung tshig bri/ /de yi phyi rim mu khyud la/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug bri/ /gsum pa pad 'dab 27— 7 32

brgyad pa la/ /oṃ spangs yi ge brgyad po bri/ /rim pa bzhi pa'i mu khyud la/ /gzungs sngags bsrung tshig bcas pa bri/ /rim pa lnga pa'i mu khyud la/ /gsal byed sum cu bzhi pa la/ /bsrung bya las sngags 1ldan pa dgod/ /de ltar bri ba rdzogs nas ni/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du 'khor lo bzhag /mchod dang gtor ma gcig btang ste/ /'khor lo'i oṃ yig las spros te/ /rje btsun 'khor lo'i steng du drang / /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las / /lha mo lnga la mchod pa dang / /rdzas kyi mchod pa rnam lngas mchod/ /bstod cing bsrung bar gsol ba gdab/ /de zhu yig 'bru'i rnam par gyur/ /de la byen rlabs 2bya phyir sngags bzlas pa/ /o āḥtweḥsau ha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo sarba ka te rak+ṣa ku ru shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ oṃ a ā/ i yī/ u khru/ṛ dṛ/ li shā/ e e/ o au/ saṃ aḥ4che ge mo la rak+ṣa ku ru shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru/puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya zhes pa'i gzungs dang / ka kha ga gha nga /zhes pa'i gsal byed la yang ming dang las sngags sbyar te sngags de rnams brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam thebs bdun bzlas la gtor ma btang bsrung bar gsol ba gdab/ de nas dril te gdags 8par bya'o/ /de yi rjes la bya ba ni/ /rang gi ye shes bcug gyur nas9/ /mchod de bzod gsol gshegs par bya/ /rang la byed dam gzhan la 'ang / /bsrung ba btags pa'i phan yon ni/ /tshe ring bsod nams che ba dang / /sdig pa thams cad byang ba dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren 'tsho skyob dang / /rje btsun srung 'khor byas pa yis / /dge des sems can bar chad zhi/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra'i srung 'khor bla ma'i zhal nas 'ongs pa rdzogs so// //

༄/ /don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣibe+e 2a mo gha pā sha sā dha nai/ bod skad du/don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po dīḥyig las byung zhing / /thugs ni thugs rje yis brlan pa/ /don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba'i/ /'jig rten mgon la bdag phyag 'tshal / /sdig pa bshags sogs byas nas ni/ /stong pa nyid sogs mthar thug pas / /skad cig rna/ma pas rje btsun ni/ /ji lta'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /sna tshogs chu skyes steng bzhengs nas/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag brgyad pa/ /mi 'jigs pa dang mchog sbyin dang / /zhags pa bgrang phreng rab mdzes g.yas/ /dbyug pa rtse gsum glegs bam dang / /pad+ma'i spyi blugs 'dzin pa g.yon/ /dkar thub chas 'dzin mdzad pa yis/ /stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ /g.yas g.yon nor bzangs rta mgrin dang / /sgol ma khro gnyer can yang ngo / /mgon po 37—735

1669༄༅/ /don yod zhags pa'i gtor ma'i cho garka༄7/ /gtor ma ni/ rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/snod gtsang mar sha khrag dang bral ba'i gtor ma legs par bshams la/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge paṃ las byung ba'i rin po che pad+ma'i snod du/ gtor ma'i rdzas rnams yi ge a 2dkar po las lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod cing ji ltar 'dod par byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ phyag btsal zhing mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ lha rnams kyi stong pa'i rang bzhin las ni yi ge hūṃ las de nyid kyis mtshan pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od zer gyi spu gu dang ldan pas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'dren par bsam zhing / oṃ a mo gha pā sha tweḥ.i oṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa 4ma ma sarba pā paṃ shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan lnga'i bar du brjod de/ se gol gyi sgra bya 37—737

1670༄༅/ /gso spyong blang ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ po sha dha ka ri 2ṭī ya/ bod skad du/gso spyong blang ba/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems 'di bskyed par bgye/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags bgyid cing / /bsod nams la yang rjes yi rang / /'phags pa'i gso spyong yan lag brgyad/ /bsnyen pa la ni spyad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas bzung ji srid nas/ /nyi ma'i 'od ni ma shar bar/ /srog chags gsod dang gzhan nor 'phrog /mi tshangs spyod dang bden min smra/ /myos pa bskyed dang bzhon pa dang / /dus ni ma yin pa yi zas/ /phreng ba kha dog glu dang gar/ /khye stan mthon po la sogs pa/ /thams cad bdag gis spang bgyid byung / /'phags pa'i yon 27—739

tan brgyad spyad dang / /gso sbyong khrims sdom yi dam 'di/ /sems kyi rgyan 1sems kyi yo byad rnal 'byor gyi tshogs 2mchog tu don dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/thob pa la ni 'od 'dis reg gyur cig /byang chub mchog gi sems 'di bskyed bgyis la/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba dge slong rab mchog dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/739 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄7/ /gso sbyo nga blang ba bzhugs so // 2 〈〈pe 〉〉dha la ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉la ra/740 1 〈〈sna ra 〉〉brgyan/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〉don gyi mchogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1597)dgobazhisme tshar rgyud/ rgyud 'grel / rgyud/ rgyud/ lnge rtarā7———lngewa —— nyu nyu 6tshan grangs/ 66 61ldeb/ 200na4— 200ba 233na4— 233ba 266na wa 266ba2phreng / 6chis chang / 271 4 271 /tsheg khyim/ 463 47237wa 740

1671༄༅/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gso sprung gi cho ga'i man ngag1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha bo ṣa ta bi bye e nā ya/bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gso spyong gi cho ga'i man ngag /'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥ.āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo bye satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mo gha shī la ma hā shubye satwa/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra2/ pad+ma be+e bhū ṣi ta bhu dza dha ran/ sa man+ta a ba 4lo ki te shwa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ 5phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs 'di 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gso spyong gi dus su nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya'o/ /de'i cho ga ni dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la brtul zhugs kyis bsdams 6par gyur pas khyad par du bklag par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das don yod zhags pa la yang dag par mchod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /chu tshod la sogs kyi khongs su 'o ma dang / ka ra dang dkar gsum gyi zas bza' bar bya'o/ nyal ba'i dus su ku sha 37—7/ /

—bting ba la seng ge'i nya'/ thabs kyis mgo la bcom ldan 'das lhag par mos par bya ste/ phyag byas/ mchod par bya'o/ /tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs kha 1shin tu gtsang mar bkrus shing sngags kyis dag par gyur pa dang / rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i dīḥyig dkar po'i 'od zer gyi dra bas rang gi lus la sogs pa sna tshogs gsal bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bya'o/ /oṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha bha ga wān a mo gha bā sha lo ki shwa ra āḥsngags 'dis phyi rol du ba lci la sogs pas byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun po rnams su lhag par mos pas bzhugs par bya ste/ re re la gzungs 4lan re bklag cing mchod par bya'o/ /mdun du chu'i bum pa bdun dang /'bras zan gyi kham phor bdun gzhag par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la ngag kun bsdams par gyur cing / dad pa brtan pa'i sems kyis ran por bklag 6par bya'o / /de'i jes la gzungs tsam ngo/ — lan lnga'o/ /bdun pa la sngar rang bzhin du myo/ngas su/ sdogs pa nyid do/ /chu tshod bdun gyi khongs su dkar gsum gyi zas bza' bar bya'o/ /de ltar gnyis pa gung gi thun la yang ngo / /de nas de bzhin du dze+e1na gsum pa la/'o/ /de'i rjes la mchod pa bdun po rnams kyis yang dag par mchod la/ bskor bar zhe bya zhing yan lag smad lngas phyag byas te bla na med pa yang dag nga/ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /tshes dgu la yang tshes bdun nga/ bzhin du thams cad byas la/ gso spyong gi brtul zhugs la rjes su yi rang ba dang bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /tshig 'di yin te/ 'di bdag gis/ don yod zhags pa'i gso spyong gi brtul zhugs tshul khyems kyi sdom pa'i yi dam gyis sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad dang /37——7/2

༄༅/ /dpal 'dze+eg rten dbang phyug mkha' la gshegs pa'i grub thabs rgyas pa ba41gas so// 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kha sar pa ṇa lo ke shwa ra sā dha na bste ram̐/bod skad du/ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug mkha' la gshegs pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhar gshegs mgon po sdug bsngal ba'i/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bsdus pa las/ /cung zad rgyas par bri bar bya/ /dang por re shig sngags pas lag pa dang rkang pa la sogs pa chu yis rab tu bkrus te mchog tu gcang bar gyur nas bye bo dang bral ba'i ri'i phug gam/yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas gtsang mar 'jam pa'i stan gyi steng du 'dug pas rang gi snying khar dbyangs dang po yongs su gyur pa'i mtshan mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnyog pa dang bral ba sems kyis bltas te/ de'i dbus su ston kha'i zla ba brgya phrag gcig tu byas pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba ltar rab tu gsal 37 ———7/ /

ba'i tīḥyig gi sa bon blta bar bya'o/ /de nas dīḥyig sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer 'gro ba rmongs pa'i mun pa'i tshogs 'joms par byed pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pa rnams kyi phyogs bcur gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rab tu gsal bar byas nas de rnams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs med cing tshad med pa rnams nam mkha'i phyogs su spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /phyi nas nam mkha'i phyogs na bzhugs pa mchog gi thugs rje can bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams la me tog dang bdug spos dang / mar me dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang chos gos dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod pa phul du byung ba dang ldan pa bsgrubs nas / sdig pa bshags par bya ste/ gang cung zad skye ba 'di'am skye ba gzhan rnams su thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar kun nas 'khor ba bdag gis sdig pa'i las lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bgyis pa dang bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyid bzhin pa dang rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de thams cad bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum gyi dga' ston chen po bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyan sngar so sor gshags par bgyi'o zhes pa'i cho ga 'dis bshags shing be+er mi byed par sdom pa bzung nas/ bsod nams la rjes su yid rang bar bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams dang khams gsum gyi khongs nas gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba gang yin pa de thams cad la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o zhes so/ /de'i rjes su dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 27—7/ 5

su 'gro ba bya ste/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o ces so/ /de nas lam la brten par bya ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i lam de bdag gis brten par bgyi zhing gzhan ma yin no ces pa'o/ /de'i rjes su gsol ba gdab par bya ste / sems/ can gyi don 'khor ba ji srid par mdzad cing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' chen bo rnams yongs su mya ngan 'a/sa mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol ces pa'o/ /de'i rjes su bskul bar bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam pa de ltar gang gi sems can rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zab mo las sgrol bar byed pa dam pa'i chos ston pa bla na med pa bstan du gsol zhes pa'o/ /de'i rjes su bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bya ste/ mchod pa bla na med pa bdun las gang dge ba skyes nga/'i thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ched du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o ces pas so/ /yang na mdor bsdus pas bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i rnam nga/ bdun gsal bar byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bklag par bya ste/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis bgyis pa yi/ /sdig gang rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags//'jeg rted gsu/ma gye dge ba thams cad la/ /rtag tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la rtag tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /rgyal bas gsungs nga 'i lam 'dir brten par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can don ma/dzad gsol/ /de sras rnams kyang rtag tu srid pa ru/ /skye dgu'i yab rnams ji srid srid pa'i bar/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mi mdzad bzhugs su gsol/ /27—— 7 /6

mthu chen ldan pa rnams kyis de bzhin chos/ /yang dag bstan pa de rnams mdzad du gsol/ /gang gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /bde blag myur du 'gro bar bye ba'o/ /gang 'dir bsod nams rab tu mang skyes pa/ /de kun byang chub ched du bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba rnams dang de sras dang / /bla ma dang ni 'go ba bdag /bdag nyid dngos po kun gyis ni/ /thams cad dus su btang bar bgyi'o/ /ces pa 'di rnams kyis mchod pa rnam pa bdun bsgrubs te/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su tshad med pa bzhi po byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms rnams 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pas bsgom par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni byams pa ste sems can thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa phul du byung ba bu gcig pa lta bur brtse ba'i mtshan nyid can no/ /snying rje lta bu zhe na/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mchog tu gting dpag dka' ba'i nang du ldung ba'i sems can gyi khams rnams yang dag par gdon par bya'o snyam pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'o /dga' ba ci lta bu zhe na/ khams gsum na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la gang rnams legs par spyad pa de rnams la gus pa dang / dbang phyug dang bcas pa la sogs pa rnams la dga' ba'i sems nyid do/ /btang snyoms 'di ci zhe na/khong khro ba dang rjes su chags pa dang rjes su 'brel ba rgyur byas nas phan pa dang ma phan pa'i sems can rnams la mchog tu phan par kun tu spyod pa'o/ /tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i bar ma chad par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa nyid bsam par bya ste/ chos 'di rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis te rang gi ngo bos yongs su dag pa rnams te/ kho bo yang rang bzhin gyis yongs 37——7/7

su dag pa'o zhes pa la sogs pa la mngon du phyogs par bya'o/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa 'di kho na/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud bye haṃ zhes pa 'dis brtan par bya'o/ /'o na chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa yin na 'phral du grol bar thal bar 'gyur zhe na/ bden mod / thal bar 'gyur ba gzhan 'di yin te/ yan lag med pa'i phyir ro/ /ga las zhe na/ yang dag par rtogs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba'i rgyu 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams stobs dang bcas pa nyid phyir te/ chos rnams thams cad pa'o/ /ci ltar de dang bral bar 'gyur zhe na/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam bsgom pas te/ des de 'gag pas so/ /de nyid kyi phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'gog pa mngon du bya'o zhes so/ /de'i phyir chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'o zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig 'thad pa kho na'o/ /ces pa mang du bshad pas chog go/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa nyid la mngon du phyogs par byas nas chos thams cad bsgom par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni stong pa nyid te/ 'di ni yid tsam kho na ste/ de dang de'i rnam pas rab tu gsal ba'i bdag nyid du so sor snang ba ni rmi lam du ji lta ba bzhin no/ /yid las phyi rol gyi gzung bar bya ba med ceng / gzung ba med pa'e phyir 'dzin par byed pa'e yid kyang med do/ /des na chos thams cad yid kyi rang gi ngo bo can te/ de rnams kyi bzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa mtha' dag gis spros pa stong pa nyid te/ de kho na nyid dam pa'i don zhes par 'gyur ro/ /don ni 'di yin te/ gnyis su med pa rab tu gsal ba tsam gyi bdag nyid du 'gro ba rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i mi 27 —7 /8

rgyu ba bsam par bya'o/ /stong pa nyid 'di kho na/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āta ma ko haṃ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /de'i rnyog pa bcas pa'i mtshan ma la nges par grol ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig dkar po shin tu dag pa la bcom ldan 'das dpal ldan mkha' la gshegs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug ston pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med par gyur pa shar ba ltar shin tu dkar ba'i sku can/ mchog tu sgyeg pa cher gsal bas dga' bar 'os pa'i lus can/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par gsal bar byas pa'i sku can/ ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dkar po rnam par rgyas pa lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rin po ches spyi bo'i phyogs mdzes par byas pa/ bsil ba'i 'od can dang 'dra la rol cing dag nga/ra byas pa lta bur 'od gsal bas khyab pa'i sgu can/shing rta'i 'khor lo'i tshad tsam shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i chu skyes dkar po'i steng na gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnyog pa med pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i skyil krungs phyed pa can/ phyag g.yas kyis mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon pas yu ba dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po rnam par rgyas pa 'dzin pa ste/ de lta bur gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das grub par byas nas de'i ngo bor bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas kyi ngos su yang 'phags ma sgrol ma dang nor bzang dag dang / g.yon logs su yang khro gnyer can dang rta mgrin dag bsam par bya'o ces pa'o/ /dbu la rnyog pa med pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig dang / mgrin par dri ma dang bral ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥyi ge dang / thugs khar ku mu da'i gnyen gyi dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i steng hūṃ yig 37—7/9

byedabalta bar bya'o/ /de 'di'i rim pas ji srid 'dod pa de srid du bsgom par bya'o//de'i bar ma chad par dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bo'i bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten mgon po 'di'i thugs khar gnas pa'i rnyog pa'i mtshan ma las rnam par grol ba'i ri bong can gyi dkyil 'khor la yongs su gnas pa zla ba chu shel dang kun dang mtshungs pa'i sa bon s+thāḥyig las rnam par skyes pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs mu mtha' med pa rnams kyi 'jig rten gsum gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa nges par 'phrog pa rnams song nas thog ma med pa nas yang dag par grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo/ bzhugs pa'i phyogs shin du ring ba nas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /spyan drangs nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs su bzhugs su gsol nas/ rin po che sna tshogs pas spras par gser la sogs pa'i sdod du dri bzang po'i chu dang dri shin tu zhim po'i me tog gis/spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo 'jig rten mgon ngo/ de'i zhabs la mchod yon phul nas/ de'i rjes su lha'i me tog dang bdug pa dang sgron ma dang zhal zas dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang phyi dang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i cho gas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa'e bdag nyed de la mchod par bya'e/ /yang dag yang du mchod cing bstod nas / dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge bzhis phyag rgya bstan par bya ste/ thal mo sbyar ba cung zad gyen du blang bar byas nas/ gung mo rtse mor bya zhing / sor mo lhag ma rnams/ cung zad bsgums te/ yang dag par phyogs pas ma 'byar bar gzung bar bya'o/ /mthe bong dag bsdigs 'dzub gnyis dang nye bar gzhag

par bya'o zhes pa 'di pad+ma rnam par rgyas pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan nyid can spyan drangs pa de nyid yongs su mnyes te/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bo la nang du bcug nas/o āḥhūṃ zhes pa 'dis 'di dag gnyis su rnged par lhag par mos par bya'o/ /de'i bar ma chad par rnyog pa'i tshogs las nges par grol ba'i 'od dkar can kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rol pas gnas pa'i dīḥyig gi sa bon sman gyi dbang po brgya phrag gi 'od zer gyi tshogs mchog tu 'bar ba can las 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rje btsun mkha' la gshegs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug grangs med cing dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'jug par mdzad pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams du ma rnams snang bar byas nas/ der gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang gser dang nor bu dang mu tig dang dngul dang dar dang byi ru dang bai ḍūr+ya dang in dra byā la la sogs pa rin po che'i char pas dbul ba nyid la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal 'phrog par mdzad cing / skad cig ma dang bdag med pa la sogs pa'i chos bstan pa bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi rgyud kyis de rnams tshim par mdzad te/ yang dang yang du rgyun mi 'chad pa gzhan gyi don rnam pa sna tshogs pa mdzad nas/ 'gro ba yang bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug ji ngo bor grub par byas te/ bsel zer can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gnas pa'i dīḥ yig gi sa bon shel dang nor bu dang mtshungs pa de nyid la/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams yang dag par byon nas nang du gzhug par bya'o/ /'di lta bu la sogs pa'i spyo ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas ji srid spyo ba ma skyes nga/ de srid du bsgom nga/ra bya'o/ /de nas kyang bsgom pas skyo na sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de

——————la sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ dīḥswā hā/ sngags 'di ni bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten mgon po'i snying po ste/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i mthu can/ rgyal ba mchog rnams thams cad kyis mngon par mchod byung bsnyen bkur byas la phyag mdzad pa ces pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs pas / 'gro ba 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzugs su bltas nas/ de'i nga rgyal gyes ji ltar 'dod par gnas par bya'o ces pa'o/ /cho ga 'di yis bcom ldan 'das mang du bsams pa las/ ral gri dang mig sman la sogs pa bde blag tu bgrod pa'i grub pa chen po'i rkang 'thung rnams 'byung na/ dngos grub phra mo rnams lta ci smos te/ 'on kyang de rnams ni shin tu nges pa nyid do/ /gang rnams skye bo dang bral ba'i nags dang dur khrod dang ri bo dang phug la sogs par gnas nga/sa/ bcom ldan 'das bsgom par byed pa de rnams ni/ yun ring po mi thogs pa nyid du bcom ldan 'das kyis mthong bar byed cing / bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis de rnams la dbugs 'byin pa dang gtso bo nyid la sogs pa sbyin par mdzad do/ /gang ming du brjod par bya bas ci bya ste/mchog tu shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas nyid kyang de rnams la lag pa'i 'thil du bab pa'i rgya shugs gi 'bras bu bzhin du nges par gnas so ces pa'o/ /dpal ldan mkhar gshegs mgon po yi/ /sgrub thabs dam pa byas nas na/ /bsod nams cung zhig bsags pa des/ /'jig rten thub grong 'gro bar shog /dpal mkha' la gshegs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas nga/ / gnas brtan dpe med bsrung bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni sngar lo tsa ba gzhan gyis bsgyur du zin kyang / rang nyid la bod

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha ram̐/ bod skad du/dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgu dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje ye shes kyi sku can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje mnyes par 'dod pas/ dang por gsang sngags dang / rig sngags thams cad grub pa'i rgyud dam tshig gi gnas rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtang bar bsru/nga bar bya ste/ de la dam tshig ni 'di dag go/ /dken mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /sngags dang phyag rgya slob dpon dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang / ste/ /de dag mchod cing rim gror bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la zhugs nga/ yis/4/ /dge slong rnams la gus bya zhing / /lha dang bla ma la mi khro/ /'jig rten lha sogs mi smad do/ /sems can rnams la byams pa dang / /27 — 7bye /

snying rje chen po bskyed nas kyang / /de yi gnod pa bsal 1bya zhing / /bdag la gnod byas bzod par bya/ /ser sna ring du bsal 2nas ni/ /sbyin pas sems can phan gdags so/ /dam tshig med par gyur pa la/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sbyin mi bya/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /mdor na bdag dang gzhan rnams la/ /phan pa 'ba' zhig ldur bya zhing / /khri la nyal bar mi bya'o//de ltar dam tshig bsrung ba la 'bad pas dang por mal nas tsog pur 'dug la chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags lan gsum mam/ bdun bzlas so/ /oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudhe sarba cedhadz+re te 5badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la rigs gsum 'khor 6dang bcas pa dang / dpal phyag na rdo rje mdun du dmigs la phyag bya ste )/ 'di skad gsol ba gdab po/ /'phags pa thams cad kyis thugs rjes gzigs te/ mgon ma mchis pa dag myur du sangs rgyas grub par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo mnol 8ba med pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas snying ga dang / lkog ma dang smin mtshams dang spyi bo dang / gnas bzhir bzhag ste bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol sa la sogs par 'gro bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcas la mje bong bsgreng ba ni khro bo mnol 9bheb med pa'i phyag rgya ste sngags oṃ badz+ra rngo dhā na hūṃ dzaḥphyi rol sa la sogs par 'gro ba'i tshe bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags 'di bar chad med par lan bdun bzlas na ༄ de'i tshe bag med par spyad kyang bgegs rnams kyis mi baspru'o 1 zhes lung nas 'byung ngo / /de'i sngags la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ rdasgo ta ka ṭa bye rā saya/ a si mu sa la dha rā ya / pā ra shu pā sha 37—75pya

—byedabyedahastu rkaya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍin / gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/sarba bispyo bi nā ya kā māṃ / ma hā ga na pa ti dz+re bi t+t+waṃ 4 ta ka rā ya hūṃ swā hā/ phyi rol nas/ slar log pa dang kha lag bkrus te nye reg bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo bkan la gung mo dang srin lag yid tsam bkug pa'i bar du chu blugs la sngags 'dis btab la mgo dang lus kun la gtor la lhag ma rnams btung ngo / /oṃ shuzlen tu sho dha na swā hā/ de nas rgyud dang mthun pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar khrus byas kyang rung ma byas kyang rung ste/ nyes pa med de tshad med pa bzhi bsgo mas nga/sa sems kyi rgyud sbyangs la/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gdon par yid la 'dus pas sku gzugs la sogs pa'i spyan snga'am/ gzhan yang rung ste/ phyag btsal ba dang mchod pa bshams pa dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs te rim bzhin byas nas/ theg pa mchog las mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir skyil mo krung bcas te/ dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i phyir dam tshig gsum kyi phyag rgya la sogs/ pas byin gyis brlab — pa cho ga 'di bzhin du bya'o/ /de la dam tshig gsum gyi phyag rgya thal mo sbyar la mje bong gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rgya chen te/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa rnams kyi yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tsheg ne+e/ /phyag rgya 'de la rab tu gnas/ /de'i sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā dzā/ a sa me tri sa me 8ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgyas/ bdag rnam par dag par bya ba ni lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur bcangs la mje bong gnyis nang du bcug la/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ngo / /phyag rgya 'di phyag rgya chen ngo/ ste/ chos dbyengs rnam par spyong ba'o/ /de'i sngags la/27 — 756

—byedan maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 1ṭ+wāṃ/ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha haṃ/ rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab pa ni lag nga/ gnyis sor mo rgyab tu bsnol la/ mthe bong gnyis lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du gzhug go/ /rgyal mchog dpal dang ldan pa yi / /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur 4ba yi/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yis / /'khor lo rab tu 'di sgyur ro/ /de'i sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta badzā rde 6badz+ra āt+ma kopho7haṃ/ yi ge ram̐ dkar po yang spyi bor bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis 8gnas lngar gtugs na go gyon par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyag rgya la thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar mje bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar ro/ /sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta badzā rde / badz+ra ka ba tse hūṃ/ de nas bgegs thams cad rnam par sel ba mi bzad pa'i rig sngags chen mo rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i phyag rgya ni thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste nang du gzhug gung mo gnyis rtse sprad srin lag gnyis brkyang mthe'u chung gnyis cung zad dgug pa ni srung ba chen mo'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ rkasarba bha ya rkarnabi ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā 1 haṃ khaṃ rak+ṣa ma hā ba le/ sarba ta thā ga ta pu ne+e nir dza te/ hūṃ hūṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ bgegs dang mi bzad nad thams cad 5/ /srin po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can rnams/ /'di ni dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /de dag thams cad 'byer bar byed/ /de nas yon chab kyi snod chu gtsang ma dang dri chu dang me tog bzang pos bkang la chos kyi dbyengs kyi yi ge dang / rigs kyi snying po dang 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyis/ btab ste/ g.yon phyogs su gzhag go/ /bsang gtor dang mchod pa'i yo byad gzhag go/ /de dag kun yang bsang ba
