— — —byedabyed——dang sbya nga ba'i phyir mi g.yo mgon nam/ bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi sngags kyis gdab po/ /de nas bskrad nga/ dang mtshams bcad pa dag byas te bsgom par bya'o / /bskrad pa dang mtshams bcad pa yang de dag nyid kyis bya'o/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi yi ge ram̐/ /rigs kyi snying bo badz+ra byeka /mi g.yo ba'i phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis brkyang la/srin lag dang mje'u chung gnyis kyi rtse mo mje bos mnan la lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du byas te mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis g.yon pa'i mthil du gzhag go/ /mi g.yo mgon po'i ral gri shubs su bcug pa ste/ bskrad pa'i tshe ral gri shubs nas phyung nas g.yon nas bskor/ mtshams bcad pa'i tshe g.yas nas bskor sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta badzā rde )a tsa la kā ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa sgo ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ḍa 2haṃ mo lan gsum bya'o/ /bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgya thal mo sbyar nas gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de brkyang mje'u chung bsnol te nang du bcug pa'i nang du srin lag gnyis bzhag pa'i rtse mo mje bong gnyis kyis mnan la mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i phyi rol nas rgur por byas te nas gang tsam ma reg par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi thab spyor phyag rgya rtse gsum pa las 4thams cad pa ste las kun la 'di 5sbyar ro/ /sngags ni oṃ a mṛ te ‘hūṃ phaṭa/ yang na sngar gyi sngags mang ngo/sa sbya/ra ro/ /de nas rja rje sems dpa'i skyil rma krung du 'dug la snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge bsams te/ de las chos thams cad tshig gi lam dang bra'/ lo zhes sgra byung nas dngos po thams cad stong par bsgom/ de 'a/sa/ 'od zer spro ba dang bsnyu ba'i rim gyis bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i sgu re ba thams cad yongs su/ skong bar byed pa/ mdog me tog pri yang 2ḍa 7rwa8

——— —byedabyedabyed—byed —ku ltar ljang ser ram/ yang na rin po che markata ltar ljang sngon phyag gnyis pa dbu rgyan can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nga/ stod g.yogs dar la/ smad g.yogs dar ba ti 'am/ dar tshig 1 gu bsnams pa 'od zer gyis bskor ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa phyag na ye shes kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams par bsgom mo/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ge ram̐ dkar po yang spyi bor bsam mo/ /mig gnyis su t+t+waṃ dmar po gzhag ste/ byams pa'i lta bas blta bar bya'o/ /de nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir de nyid kyi phyag rgya bcings te gnas lngar 4gtug go/ /lag nga/ gnyis khu tshur bcangs la gung mo gnyis gshibs 5te bsgreng / mdzub mo gnyis bkug la ngos gnyis su bzhag la rdo rje ltar bya'o/ /mthe bong gnyis dang mje'u chung gnyis gzhibs 6te bsgrengs la bzhag srin lag gnyis lag pa'i nang du gzhug go/ /phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i rgya/ /mi shes grong khyer 'jig pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes 'di/ /nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs te bstan/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste/ rdo rje la'o/ /sngags 'a// na maḥs man+ta badzā rde tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa t+t+waṃ/ de nas yan lag rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bcings la spyi gtsug tu gzhag go/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings la gung mo gzhibs te bsgreng mdzub mo gnyis ngos/ nas bkug ste sbyar ro/ /gtsug tor phyag rgya rgya chen te / / /gtsug tor zhes ni grags pa yen/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /rgyal ba'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /de'i sngags la/na maḥs man+ta badzā māṃ rka hūṃ t+t+waṃ/ de nas ye shes kyi spyan bsgrub ngo// /lag nga/ g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la gung mo srin 'a/ga brkyang mje bong bi drung du ba'ag go/ /'di ni sangs rgyas mgon rnams kyi/ /ye shes las byung spyan yin te/ /mig 27 7da()

gi steng du mkhas pas gzhag /de las ye shes spyan du gyur/ /de'i sngags la/na maḥs man+ta busgye māṃ1/ ga ga na be+e ra ṇa k+ṣa ṇa/ ka ru ma hā ta thā ga ta tsak+ṣu swā hā/ de nas yum gyi phyag rgya bcings la gnas lngar gtug go/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la gung mo gnyis gzhibs 5te bsgreng mdzub mo gung mo'i phyi rol nas bkug la bar nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par bya/ mthe bong gnyis srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u 1chung gnyis nang du gzhug jego/ /'di ni yum mā ma gī'i phyag rgya ste rdo rje rtse gsum pa'o/ /de'i sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta badzā t+t+waṃ 5dṛ shwe dṛ bhā tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha dza yan ta swā hā/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya bcings la go bgo ste phyag rgya dang sngags gong du bstan no/ /de nas mdun du gzhal med khang bsams 6te/ de'i rim pa yang dang por chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ge re gyis gnas kun stong pa'i rang bzhin kyis rnam par dag par bsams la de'i 'og tu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du yi ge a gser gyi mdog can las gser kyis gzhi gru bzhi — rdo rje'i rang bzhin can rdo rjes mtshan brgya 8snadang khyon dpag tu med par bsam mo/ /de'i steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du yi ge baṃ 9mdog dkar po gangs dang shel lta bur dngas shing gsal ma ba las chu'i rgyun 'o ma dang mu tig gi 'bru lta bu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa 'byung ba1te /gser gyi sa gzhi bkang ste dpag tu med pa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam mo/ /de'i nang nas yi ge lo las ri rab chen po sna bzhi las grub pa gru bzhi pa rgya dang khyen dpag tu med par byung rība'i steng du rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal med khang brtsegs —ma'i nang na pad+ma dang seng ge'i gdan chen po pad+ma'i gdan mang pos bskor bar bsams te/ de dag ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du gyur par sngags 37—760

byedabyed ——byed—— ———— ——————— ——'dis byin gyis brlab po/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ1 / oṃ a na ma/ཿsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ca uṅga te r+sha ra ṇa hi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/'di 5ltar de dag thams cad de bzhin du gnas nga/ra 'gyur ro/ /yang na nam mkha' mdzod kyis kyang de bzhin du gnas nga/ra 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje spyan drang bar bya ste/ nyid kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings nas mje bo 6gnyis nang du g.yab cing sngags 'dis rang gi pho brang nas/ spyan drang bar bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde‘ / e bye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṭī ka badz+ra pā ṇi 9 sa nga/ ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas/ gshegs te mdun gye nam mkha' la dmigs la sngar bstan nga/'i dam tshig gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang /rang gi phyag rgya dang yum gyi phyag rgya rnams bstan te so so'i sngags brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig can du gzigs pas/ mnyes par bya ste1 / gzhan la phan 'dogs par bzhed pas sngags pa ji srid 'dod pa de srid du byen gyis brlab po//de nas 'phags pa mi g.yo mgon nam bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas snga na gnas pa dang / phyi nas 'brang ba'i rka bgegs rnams bathi da par bya'o/ /de nas gzhal med khang gi nang du gshegs par bya ba'i phyir mchod yon sngags kyis btab pa blangs la tshigs/ su bcad pa 'dis mchod yon sbreng zhing nang du byon par bsam rma/ /bdag ge dad dang dam tshig ges/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsolarka / /de nas byon te dbus kyi ྾pad+ma dang seng ge'i gdan la dpal phyag na rdo rje dang 'khor gyi pad+ma'i gdan rnams/ 'a/ gsang sngags dang khro bo la sogs nga/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs 'bring gi 'phags pa rnam/sa

——— — —— — — byed byed —byedabazhugs su/ gsol lo/ /de nas/ mchod yon gyi sgod du spos 1 gtsang ma blugs la zhal dang zhabs bsel dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i sngags la/ oṃ pra wa ra sad+ku ra pradīts+tsha swā/ hā/ bdag kyang 'phags pa'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i pho brang gi phyi ro' du 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i 'am/ bdud rtsi thab 2spyor gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mtshams bcad do/ /de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag bya ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod do/ /mchod pa rnams rim pa bzhin du dbu'// bcom ldan thugs rjes 4byon pa legs/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol/ /zhes/ dang por mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i sngags ni/ oṃ sarba de ba ta thā a tsi ta a mṛ ta da rā ya swā hā/ de nas dri dbul te/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas/ dam pa'i dri mchog dag /bdag gis 5dad pas 'bul ‘lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges nga ra ma/dzod/ /ā ha ra ā ha ra bha ga bān sarba bit+yā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā/zhes snga gas/ 'di tshigs bcad kun gyi mjug la brjod/ de nas me tog dbul te/gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam/ pa'i me tog 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi / /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /de nas bdug sgos dbul te/ nags tshal bcud ldan ye gar 'ong / /dre zhim rgyas pa'i bdug pa'i mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi / /bzhes/ nas/ bdag la dges nga/ra mdzod/ /lha bshos dbul te/ sman rnams bcud gtsang 5yi gar 5'ong / /sngags/ kyi 'al zas bshos 'di dag /bdag bis dad pas 'bu'/ lags kyi/ / /bzhes/ nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /

mar me dbul te/ gdon rnams 'joms shing bkra shis padzo/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam 2sel ba/ /bdag gis rngudad pas 'bul lags kyi / /bzhes nas bdag la dges /༄5par mdzod/ /ā 6lo ke sarba bibyā dha ra tsopū dzi te hūṃ swā hā/dri la sogs pa dngos su ma 'byor na yang / de dag gi phyag rgya bcings la yid kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa'i mchod pa bya'o/ de la mchod yon gyi phyag rgya ni thal mo bkan la mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs gsum par sbyar la srin lag gnyis dbus su bkug la mthe bong gnyis glor sgyur 8 ba 'di ni bdud rtsi rgyun gyi phyag rgya ste mchod yon gyis sbyar ro/ /dri'i phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bya ste/ lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig tsu ma nas bzung 7 ba'o/ /me tog gi phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis sor mo phan tshun bsnol la lag pa'i nang du bcug la mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo nyu snagacig tu sbyar la gdu bu'i tshul du byas la mje bong glor gzhag ste /2thal mo ltar bya'o/ /bdug spos kyi phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis kyi mje'u —chung dang srin lag dang gung mo'i sor mo rnams phan tshun du rgyab tu sbyar te so so'i sor mo'i drung du bkug nas mdzub mo gnyis gzhibs te bsgreng / mthe bo —gnyis glor gzhag go/ /lha bshos kyi phyag rgya ni bzed pa'i thal mo las mdzub mo cung zad bkug pa'o/ /mar me'i phyag rgya ni mje bong dang gung mo'i sor mo gnyis gcig tu sbyar te gtod la lhag ma rnams khu tshur du bya'o/ /mchod yon gyi sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ dri'i sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ bi shud+dhā sagan sgosgo bā ya swā hā/ me tog gi sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta busgye māṃ/ ma hā mu tra muṅga tshite swā hā/ bdug pa'i sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta busgye māṃ/ dharma dhā tu 37—763

muṅga te swā hā/ lha bshos kyi sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta 1ga te pū dza rngu na sa ma ye hūṃ / mar me'i sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā dzā/ ta thā ga ta a tsi rngusga ra ṇa a ba bha sa ga ga me da ra ye swā hā/ 'di dag kyang mchod pa tsam du zad de / bdag gi nus pa dang 'jig rten na bsngags pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po gzhan dag kyang ci 'byor ba dbul lo/ /de nas mchod pa spyi'i phyag rgya bcings te / sems rab tu dang ba'i sgo nas yid kyis mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/de'i thabs kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mthu dang /chos kyi dbyengs kyi thumathu dang / bdag gi bsod nams dang ye shes dang smon lam gyi mthu dang dam pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab pa'i mchod pa chen po'i sprin chen po dang / rgyan dam pa dang / bstod pa sna tshogs pa rnams 'phags pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'byung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis brlabs par gyur cig ces bsam zhing tshig tu thu brjod la/mchod pa'i sprin chen po 'byung bar byed pa'i rig sngags 'di lan gsum brjod do/ /mchod pa spyi'i phyag rgya ni lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la spyi bor gzhag go/ /'di'i sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ/ a bhe sa ma ye spa ra ṇa hi 'u saṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta saṃ7/ sarba ta thā ga tā sapa ri shudha maṇ+ḍal la /ma ma pra ṇi bye pubye rka dz+nyā na ba len dhaskye/ sarba ta thā ga ta a byejo na mub len tsa swā hā/ de ltar mchod pa'i sprin chen po 'phags pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du de bzhin du gnas par 'gyur bar yid ches par bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu lag tu blangs la dril bu dkrol zhing bstod pa 'dis bstod do/ /dpa' bo chen po thabs brnyes pa/ /sku 37—764

gsung thugs ni rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje mchog gi lam ston pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang zhing / /theg mchog rtogs par thugs su chud/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gsang 'dzin pa/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po/ /gdul dka' ba dag 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / sdom pa gzung ba la sogs pa bya ste/ 'di skad du 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab po//bcom ldan 'das bdag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la skyabs su mchis kyis bdag la thugs brtse bar gzigs te/ 'gro ba ma lus pa bskyab pa'i mthu bdag la stsol nyucig ces brjod do/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus par sems can gyi don du 'gyur bar bya ste2/ 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcu'i zhing ༄ rab 'byams thams cad du sems can gyi don mdzad pa kha dog dang tshul dang / spyod lam rnam pa sna tshogs su ldan pa kun du bzang po'i sprul pa mang po rab tu 'byung bar gyur cig /des kyang sems can thams cad kyi phyi nang gi gdon jethams cad rab tu zhi zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rab tu bsngags la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang de dag gis thob par gyur cig par bsams nas byin gyis brlab pa gsum gyis byin gyis brlab po/ /sems can gyi don byin chogyis rlob pa'i rig sngags ༄ nam mkha' mdzod du byung bar mdzad pa 'di lan gsum brjod do/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+ya ཿsarba thā khaṃ 7uṅga te sga ra ṇa hi rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ 'dis lan gsum bzlas pas ji ltar 37—765

bsams pa'i don rnams sems can gyi 3khams rnams su de bzhin du 'gyur bas 2sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mkhyen kyi gzhan shes rab chung ba rnams kyis mi shes so zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa'i jeg pa pa rnams kyis yid ches par bya'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par bya zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas pa des bdag gi lha'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyi ༄ yi ge bkod pa la sogs pas bdag nyid lha'i skur bsgyur la yi ge khaṃ dkar po de'i spyi bor gzhag ste thumadun du lha bzhugs pa'i thugs kar bzlas pa bya ba'i yi ge thuphreng ba bkod la dbugs dang dran pa rab tu bsdams 6nas slar sdud pa'i tshig gis non par yid la thushib bur mi drag mi dal zhing 8mi skyo bar ji tsam 'dod pa'i bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas kar nyid kyi 9dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te bdag dang lha'i thugs kar bzung la de nas nor bu lag pa g.yas pas blangs nas snyim par bcug la bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags bzlas te/ de'i 'og tu yang yum bzlas snying ga'i thad kar bzung la bzlas pa re la nor bu re re bgrang zhing mgo mjug tu phyag bya'o / /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde 1tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ ji skad bstan pa bzhin ma nus na yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar dmigs te sems can gyi don phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bar dmigs shing bzlas so/ /de nas ngal lam gtong bar 'dod na bzlas pa gtad de ne+ebazlas pa rnams yid kyis dpal phyag na rdo rje la gtams pa'i tshul gyis phul la las kyi rdo rje sems dpar bsgyur te 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa ji skad bstan pa bzhin du bya zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba yang rgya cher bsngo'o / / 1 'phags pa rnams la 37—766

mchod pa'i phyir bdag las kyi rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ na maḥs man+ta badzā rde 3zhes bya'o/ /de nas mchod yon dbul te 'di skad brjod pas dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa slar gshegs su gsol lo/ /gdon mi za bar bdag la yang / /rjes su brtse bar dgongs nas ni/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /ci bde bar yang gshegs su gsol/ /de nas dam tshig gsum gyi phyag rgya spyi bor gyen du bkrol 2sngar dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa rnams gshegs par bya'o/ /mtshams bcad pa yang yid kyis dgrol lo/ /de nas chos kyi dbyings kyi phyag rgyas chos kyi 4dbyings su byin gyis brlabs la rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas las kyi 5rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab po / /spyi bor chos kyi — dbyings kyi yi ge ra yig bsam mo/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgyas kyang go bgos la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas nas dge ba'i las bya bar rab tu bsam zhing ldang ngo / /langs nas kyang mdo sde zab mo bklag 3pa la sogs pa dge ba'i las ci nus pa bya'o/ /de nas zas za ba'i tshe na bdag nyid rigs kyi snying pos bsrungs la sngags 'di bzlas la lan gsum btab ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ges sbyangs la zas kyi 8ro la ma chags par rigs pa dang ldan par ran par bza'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā dzāshe/ oṃ a mṛ todha bā 7ya swā hā/ nyal ba'i tshe na yang rigs kyi yum gyi snying pos bsrungs nas glo g.yas pas nyal lo/ /ji skad bstan pa bzhin du ma nus pas mnyes par bya tso mi nus so snyam pa'i bsam pa mi bskyed do/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i skal ldan pas/ /zhabs la gtugs nas bsdus pa yin/ /rnam dag lam chen mdzod yin pas/ /skal ldan byang chub mchog gis spyad/ /37—767

༄༅/ /gos sngon po can gyi dngos grub nye ba jes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dī lāsba ra dha ra u pa 2sed+dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ gos sngon po can gyi dngos grub nye ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i chu rgyun bdag po la/ /rtag tu brjed med yid kyis mos/ /mchod rten sngon po'i gdams ngag bshad/ /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus drag po yis4/ /dbang dang gdams ngag thob nas kyang / /myur du nus pa 'byung ba dang / /dngos grub rnam gnyis nye ba'i phyir/ /nye byed sgu gdung mchod rten bsgrub/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig la gnas pa6/ /bla ma'i man ngag byin rlabs kyis/ /'grub ste the tshom mi bya'o/ /rgyu dang byin gyis brlab 7pa dang / /dbang bskur ba dang mchod pa dang / /bskor ba bya dang yon tan no/ /gser dngul zangs lcags dung yang rung / /rwa shing 'dag 8pa la sogs pa/ /hūṃ gi bskyed rim

—ldan nga/ yis/ /drag po'i gtor tshogs/ mdun du ni/ /dbang bskur chas bsgyur bzo 1bo yis/ /bai ḍūr+ya 'dra legs par byug /bum pa'i nang du rgya shog la / /sgu gsung thugs dang yon tan la—/ /snying po thams cad bris te gzhug /bla ma grub thob brgyud pa dang / /rtsa ba'i lha yi mtshan dag dang / /ming dang gsang mtshan gzhug 5pa ni/ /sku gdung byin rlabs 6snying po gzhug /srog shing la sogs me tog phreng / /mdzes pa'i rgyan kyis spras par bya/ /dbang bskur du ma gzhung bzhin bya/ /mchod pa phyi nang rtag tu dbul/ /gas/la zhing ma 'dres thig le ste/ /de las sa bon kā ya lnga/ /de nyid mchod rten dag tu bstem/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma'ang de bzhin no/ /gtso bo 'khor gyis bskor ba ste/ /shin tu gsal bar de bzhin bsgom/ /brgya stong nus tshad bzlas shing bskor/ /lha tshogs bla ma'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer byung ba kun du 'phros/ /mtha' yas sgrib bsregs / dag par sprul/ /slar 'dus rang gi lus la thim/ /rtog sgrib rags pa ji snyed pa/ /skad cig gis bsregs sbyangs nas ni/ /rang lus shel gyi nor bu bzhin/ /gsang ba nyi shar rdo rje bgo/ /phyag dang gsol bstod me tog mchod/ /thog med sgrib bsreg 1 dngos grub nye/ /khyad par du ni yi dam myur/ /sgrib pa sbyangs pas mi 'dod yal/ /rtag tu bzlas pa bskor ldan pas/ /bskor bas lus kyi sdig pa 'dag /bzlas pas ngag gi sdig pa 'dag / bla ma lhar bsam yid sdig dag / rkadag pas 'dod pa phyogs med 'phel/ /mdor bsnyus phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub/ /rang sems chos sgu lhar ldan na 5/ /mchog dang thun mong 'di la spyor/ /snod kyi bye brag ldan par sbyin/ /legs nyes rin chen dug dang mtshungs/ / de bas ྾

gsang sngags legs par sba/ /sgod ldan rnams kyis 'grub par shog /1slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dngos grub nye bar byed pa'i mchod rten gyi man ngag rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā 2ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/771 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod skad du smos pa ltar brkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /bos sngo na ngo can gyi dngos grub nye ba bzhugs so/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉phyag na rdo rje gos sngo na ngo/ can gyi sgru bas thabs dngos grub nye ba bzhugs so// 2〈〈snar 〉〉( ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 4〈〈snar 〉(4/ 5〈〈snar 〉ra rna/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra/sa/7〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 8 〈〈pe 〉thamadag 〈〈snar 〉sngaradags/772 1 〈〈pe 〉sngagazo/ 2〈〈pe 〉skoradrar/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉gil / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/ 5〈〈pe 〉ra zhug6〈〈pe 〉7sung byin rlabs/ 〈〈snar 〉thadung byin brlab/ 7〈〈pe 〉thazhug 8 〈〈pe 〉dz+ra sgo 7 〈〈sna ra 〉dz+ra smyo 7 〈〈pe 〉〉stegs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉thasregs/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibla ma/ lhar bsam yid sdig dag/1 〈〈pe 〉mosar/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa// ཿ〈〈snar 〉ra dug 5〈〈pe 〉〉des na/ 〈〈snar 〉〉de nas /773 1〈〈pe 〉〉// // 2〈〈pe 〉〉lots+tsha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉lo tsa/

༄7/ /mthu stobs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /gang gi stobs kyis gdug pa 'joms byed pa/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje can la 'dud/ /'gro ba 'di kun phal cher gnod mang ba/ /de sel bdud rtsi 'di ni brjod par bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa nyams dga'i phyogs 'dug nas/ /rnam par sbyangs pa'i sa gzhi dag pa la/ /rab sngo mchod pa'i rten sogs mdun byas nas/ /thub dbang rdo rje'i bdag po'i go 'chang ba/ /bsod nams tshogs bdun rab tu rdzogs byas nas2/ /de rjes su ni sngar nyid pad+ma'i rang bzhin snying gar 4paṃ las der bsam bya/ /de dkyil re las byung ba'i tsha zer can ni dmar po bltas byas nas/ /der ni srog gi rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi dngos nyid yi ge hūṃ du 5blta/ /'og tu dbugs nyid yi yig las skyes rab sngo gzhu 'dra ba/ /g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan 6de g.yos pas ni rab dkrugs 37——77pya

— — — —— —— —byed——byed ——nas / /me/ (pe rang bzhin nyi ma/ yang ni sba/ra byas hūṃ yig gis / ni 'bar gyur pas / /mthopa ri dang reg nga/'i dug sogs rgyu can nad kyi dngos/ bsregs nas// /rab tu tsha ba'i ceshe lce'i ri sgra 'a/sa rigs pa'i sgra bsgrags la/ /ma yengs sems kyi skyon spa/ngas/ sngag/ma rgo rab tu bzlas byas nas/ /dbugs/ ni 'byung dang drub nga/'i rlung gis 'u/'a/ kyi steng 'og cha ni rim bzhin bsreg /zla drug goms/ pas lus/ 'a/ drod thob la sogs mtshan ma bzang ngo/ rnyed/ /gso bar dka' ba'i nad rnam/sa 'joms (regyur sa mchog rnams kyang rim gyes 'thob/ /langs nas bza' tshe kha zas tshogs na gang gnod shar bsam bsreg par bya / /4 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ cha/dzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/775 /ma tshan byang 'di 〈〈sde bstan da7ra chas 〉d+ku ra babod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sma ra 〉7ni/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7ni/4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sne ra 〉〉nyid/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉rihūṃ du/ 〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉7nyid/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉tha yis /776 1 〈〈pe 〉tha sa// 〈〈sma ra 〉lke 'i/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smi ra 〉sum̐s// — 〈〈pe 〉〉// //

167(‘༄༅/ /rdo rje byab pa'i las tshogs/1༄7/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo2/ /lag pa brdabs pa'i sgras 'jig pa'i/ /rdo rje byab pa'i las tshogs ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bsgoms 4nas kyang / /bsam rgyu 5rang gi lag mazil la/ /a dang ma las dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /ma 6las sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam/ /mu khyud rdo rje'i bum dkyil la/ /thun mong khyad par gsang sngags bsam/ /sor mo hūṃ las bde gshegs sku/ /mtshan rnams dag dang yang dag ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras/ /me yi mkha' la rnam par bzhugs/ /me dpung chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /nad dang gdon dang dug sogs la/ /lcags kyu'i ting 'dzin spyor ba yis/ /dbyung ba'i tshul du phyung nas kyang / /zhi ba'i gzugs brnyan dag la bstem/ /dkar gsum klu sman dag dang bcas/ /gang gnod phyogs su bskyal bar bya/ /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las ni/ /rdzus 9 skyes 27—778

1677༄༅/ /yan lag bdun pa'i grub thabs/ 1༄4/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yongs su bsnyen par 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pas/ bsam gtan gyi khang par maṇ+ḍal 2sngon po bya ste/ mchod rten sngon po dang / gta' gtor dang / bum pa dang /4 mchod rdzas dang / rten khyad par can bzhag la/ dang po khrus byas la/ de nas skyabs su 'gro/ rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/rkyen byams pa dang snying rje bsgom/ thabs pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas pa de rgo thabs kyi bsrung ba'o/ /shes rab kyi bsrung ba ni stong pa rang gsal bar bsgom pa'o/ /de gnyis su med pa'i bsrung ba ni rgyud rkyang lam du khyer la nyams su blangs pa'i man ngag ni/ ye shes lnga ldan yig 'bru las/ /kha dog lnga yi 'od zer 'phro/ /nyon mongs lnga dang klu dug lnga/ /rnam smin lus kyi nad lnga bsreg /de yis tshode dag bsregs nas kyang / /lhag ma lus par gyur pa 37—780

————— ——— byed——byed—— —————— ———————byed —rnams / /spogs pa yi ni /spyor bas bsreg /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gsungs pa yi/ /gsang sngags skyon spangs bzlas par bya/ /de la man ngag rnam gsum ste/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin rtse gcig la/ /gnyid kyi bar chad rab tu spang / /gzhan gyi gtam gyis bar 2mi bcad / /bdud dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /rgyun du'am thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor bya/ /de nas spyod lam dus dag tu/ /bskyed 4bsdu mi dmigs rgyas btab la/ /brgya pas bshags shing dge ba bsngo/ /rtags rnams sgyu ma lta bur gzung 5/ /dad ldan brtson byas yid ches na/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub 'gyur te/ /de bas the tshom med par ni/ /shin tu dad pas 'bad de bsgrub/ /zla drug bsnyen 6pa de ldan na/ /thun mong mchog gi 7dngos grub 'grub/ /des na bsgrub 8bya 'dren pa'i lha/ /dge slong dpal dang ldan pa yi / /klu zhes bya bas de skad gsungs/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byams snying rje/ /bsgoms te pha rol phyin drug lam/ /de dag thabs kyi bsrung ba'o/ /shes rab zung 'jug lam bsgoms te / /skyon spangs sngags bzlas dge ba bsngo/ /yan lag bdun ldan sgrub thabs 'di/ /'bad pas tshogs gnyis bsags nas ni / /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob nas kyang / /gdug pa'i nad las gol bar shog / slo ba dpon 'pha sa/sa nga klu sgru ba kyis mdzad nga dze+egs so// //

༄/ /gnod sbyin gyi sgo dpon chen po lag na rdo rje jes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs ༄ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ti 3bhebadz+ra pā ṇi sā dha na 3nā ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sgrub thupa'i thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gang gā'i bye snyed rjes gnang ba'i/ /mche gabyugs spyan dmar dbugs rgyu me ltar 'bar/ /'jigs pa'i nga ros klu rnams rgyan du brgyanasnye/ /gshin rje'i gzugs can khams gsum 'jigs par mdzad/ /klu rnams 'ching mdzad de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi gzungs la brten nas sgrub thabs 'di/ /ji lta ba ni bdag nyid dran phyir bri/ /dang por sa phyogs bzang ba'o/ /dur khrod dam ni shing gcig gam/ /dbe+en pa'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri lnga yis/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po 4legs par byug /dri yi thig le dgu bkod la/ /dbus su mchod rten sngon po gzhag /bum pa gta' ltegator mchod rdzas bsham— sna/ /37byed783

— — ————phyi nang dag pa'i khrus byas te/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pa nyid/ /bde ba'i stan 'a/ rab 'dug ste/ /dang por byang chub sems bskyed 1la/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de yi steng du hūṃ bsams te / /de las 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs/ /sngar gyi gnas su thim pa las/ /phyi nang thams cad dag par bsgom/ /swa byā ba bi shudhaḥ sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ badz+ra sid+dhi hūṃ4/ snying ga'i yi ge mtshan ma las/ / las kyi rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ / de las 'od zer rnam lnga 'phros/ /bla ma la sogs lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dkon mchog gsum po spyan drangs te/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /yi 3rang bsgul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /skyabs 'gro lus dbul dge rtsa bsngo'o/ /de nas bgegs dgra'i ting 'dzin gyis//las rnams thams cad pa yi sngags/ /bzlas shing khro ba'i 7sprul pa 'phro / /btul zhing sbyangs te mkha' gang gyur/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom//oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na ⑩badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha haṃ/ chos rnams thams cad stong par bsgom/ /e yo ram̐ baṃ khaṃ lo saṃ/ /e las chos kyi 'byung gnas te/ /de bzhin 'byung ba rim bzhin bsgom5/ /lo las ri rab lhun po'i steng / /saṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed/ /de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros/ /rdo rje gur dang ra ba dang / /martsan cha'e 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ /dbus su rgyu 1 las gzhal yas khang / /be+e ḍūr+ya ltar thams cad bskyed/ /tsa las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng / /chu byes nyi zla'i gdan stengs sus/ /kha dog mthing ga'i sa yi ge hūṃ / /de nyid las ni 'od 'phros pas/ /sgod bcud dag ni sbyang rka byas nas//rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gyur te/ /tshur 'dus khro bo'i rdo rjer gyur / /de yi 27—78/

bum dkyil hūṃ sngon las/ /'od 'phro 1khro bo'i rigs bkug nas/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ /thams cad 'joms pa'i stobs ldan pa / /gnod spyin sde dpon chen po ni/ /mdo nas ji ltar gsungs bzhin bsgoms / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing / /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub4//'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /gos sngon na 5ra'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /stag gi 6smad dkres seng stod g.yogs/ /klu chen rnams ni rgyan du brgyan/ /dbu skra sma ra ser la 'jigs/ /smin mtshams dpral bsdus mche gcigs mtshams/ / ha ha a la la zhes 9bzhad/ /brkyang bskum klu brgyad zhabs kyis mnan/ /rdo rje mchu yis klu brgyad gzir7/ /nyi zla dang ni pad+mar bcas/ /dbus kyi cha la rnam par bzhugs/ /de nas rang gi snying gar ni/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i gos sngon bskyed/ /dbang po drug la'ang de bzhin bsgom/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /hūṃ 'phros 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng / /'phro 'dus phyag mtshan yig 'brus mtshan/ /de dag yongs gyur sde dpon bzhi/ /shar du rdo rje gnod sbyin te / /lho ru srin po za ba po/ /nub tu rdo rje gdon chen bdag /byang du rdo rje ro langs te/ /sde dpon chen po bzhi rnams kyang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin/ /g.yon rnams sdegs mdzub tre shu la/ /ral gri dbyug to 'khor lo 'o/ /klu chen brgyad ne+e rgyan du byas/ /smad dkris na bza' sngo bkra dang / /ra ga za hor tsan dmar brgyan / /pa ti khra bo'i sham thabs can— / /stod g.yogs sngon po'i chos gos 'chang / /dbu skra sma ra gyen ser 'greng / /a la la yi gad rgyangs sgrogs྾/ /brkyang bsgum rigs bzhi'i klu rnams mnan/ /brgya byen mdzes dang nyi mar sa 37——785

—— —bcas / /me 'bar dbus su bskyed par bya/ /bgo 1ba dag kyang yig 'bru las/ / /ji bzhin du ni bskyed byas 2te/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya yis/ /gnas lngar gtug cing lus bsrung bya/ /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde 4badz+ra ka pa tsa hūṃ5/rdo rje lnga yi 6phyag rgya yis/ /brtan par byas te lus byin brlab/ /thugs ka'i t+t+waṃ 7las 'od 'phros nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod sdig bshags te/ /sgu gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas/ /mchod rten sngon po dag la bstim/ /'od zer 'du 'phro'i byin gyis brlab/ /thugs las 'od 'phros bde gshegs bskul/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas bye snyed rnams / /spyan drangs mchod bstod sdig bshags te/ /gzungs ltar rjes su gnang mdzad nas/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs 9de nyid thim/ /dbu la mi bskyod rdo rjes mtshan/ /thugs mtshan la sogs bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba las/ /spro bsdu'i rim pa gsal bar bsgom/ /sangs rgyas gang gā'i bye snyed kyis/ / gsungs pa'i gsang sngags skyon spangs 1 bzlas/ /phar 'phros pa rkaci ni mchod pa'i tshul/ /de las 'od byung gdon sdig sbyangs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par bsam/ /ji ltar nye bar ma gyur par/ /gshegs su gsol dang thun mtshams med/ /mchod rten sngon po dag la'o/ /yang na rig pa 'dzin pa yis/ /thun mtshams mchod bstod gtor ma btang sa/ /tha ma'i thun la gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams thugs kar basbu/ /de nyid mi dmigs stong par bsgom/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod 'a/ma bya/ /bsten dus rig pa 'dzin pa yiglu/ /rtsa sngags yig 'bru bcu bdun bzlas/ /oṃ 1 byā ṭ+wāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā ba ya ti swā hā/ 'di yis las rnams thams cad ) ḍa — 786

༄ / /phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha rgo zhenā ma/ bod skad du/phyag na rdo rje sgrub 4pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad sbrul sogs brgyan/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub thabs kyi 5ni go rims rnams//bla ma 6ji ltar gsungs pa ltar/ /man ngag brjed byang du bkol la7/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bsnyen 'dod pas/ /gnas ni dur khrod shing gcig gam/ /yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khyem/ /bkra shis nyams dga'i gnas dag tu/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po legs byas la/ /me tog la sogs mchod rdzas dgram/ /bde ba'i stan la rab 'dug ste/ /gdong la sogs pa khrus byas la/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /hūṃ yig las ni mdog nag pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rab bsgoms 937—794

te—/ /dpa' ba'i nyams kyis yungs kar la/ /skad cig ma yi ting 'dzin gyis / /sngags bzlas khro bo'i sprul pa spro/ /gdug pa tshar bcad tshur 'dus pas—/ /rdo rje gur dang ra bar gyur/ /de nas rang gi snying gar ni/ /a dkar zhu bas zla ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor nya gang lta bur bsam/ /de steng 1t+t+waṃ sngon zhu ba las/ /rdo rje sngon bo rtse lnga bsam/ /de yi bum par hūṃ sngon po/ /de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lhag pa'i 2lha dang bla ma rnams/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi mkha' la bzhugs/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsags pa'i phyir/ /phyag 'tshal mchod sbyin 4sdig bshags rnams/ /bdun po yongs su dag pa yi5/ /tshig tu brjod de tshogs bsags bya/ /spyan drangs rnams ni gshegs su gsol/ /de nas ye shes tshogs bsags 6phyir/ /phyi nang snod bcud 'od zhu nas/ /bdag nyid kyi ni thugs kar thim/ /de nyid 'od zhu hūṃ la 'dus/ /hūṃ zhu zla tshes thig ler thim//chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid las byung ba yi/ /sngags 'di yang dag brjod par bya/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko37haṃ/tshig gi 8don dang bcas par bsgom/ /chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor de/ /ram̐ las me yi kha dog lnga/ /dbus su paṃ las shā pad+ma bsam/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi steng du hūṃ sngon las/ /de zhu rdo rje sngon po ni/ /'od zer sngon po 'phro bar bsam/ /de yi bum par hūṃ sngon bsam/ /de las 'od zer hūṃ phra mo/ /'phros nas phyi nang snod bcud sbyangs / /tshur 'dus rdo rje phra mor gyur/ /sngar gyi gnas su thim pa las/ /de zhu rdo rje sngon po ni/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bsam/ /de yi 37—795

bum dkyil hūṃ sngon las/ / sgu mdog nam mkha'i mdog can la/ /1de las 'od byung bcud sbyangs te/ /tshur 'dus phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sku ni phra mo'i tshul du 'dus/ /de las phyag na rdo rje'i sgu/ /mdo nas ji ltar gsungs bzhin bsgoms pa / /de nas dam tshig sems dpa'i sku/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su bsgom pa ni/ /sku mdog nam mkha'i 'od can la/ /zhal gcig phyag kyang gnyis pa ste//spyan dmar mche ba gcigs pa la/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub/ /shin tu gdug cing khros pa ste/ /klu chen brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /stod g.yogs sngon po legs bsnams shing / /na bza' chos gos sngon po 'chang / /smad g.yogs ba ti khra bo dang / /stag gi smad g.yogs seng stod g.yogs/ /nyi zla'i steng na gar byed dgyes/ /bdag nyid dang ni sbrul rgyan gyi/ /kha nas ha ha'i sgra sgrogs pas/ /log 'dren tshogs rnams 'joms par byed/ /de ltar khro bo'i rgyal por ni/ /bdag nyid rnam par bsam par bya/ /bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla ba rdo rje hūṃ/ /'phro 'dus ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /thugs kar nyi ma rdo rje hūṃ/ /sran ma nas tshad yungs 'bru la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam4/ /rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya yis//gnas lngar gtug cing lus bsrung bya/ /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde ka ba tsa hūṃ/dze+e rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya yis/ /sngags 'di brjod de brtan par bsam/ /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde 1 badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa 8ma hā ro ṣa shā ya hūṃ/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs byung nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /'og min gnas mchog dam nga/ yi/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rjes 27—796

gnang ba'i/ /gsang bdag 'phags pa gos sngon can/ /'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren gyis1/ /'dir gshegs mchod pa dam pa bzhes/ /oṃ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa ma ya maṇ+ḍa la ma dhe ā gats+tsha ya/ ā gats+tsha ya/ pra be sha ya / pra be sha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha ya tiṣ+ṭha ya/ a ba lo kā ya hūṃ dzaḥmadun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ /snying ga'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /oṃ dī dze+e ba ra dha ra 4badz+ra pā ṇi/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra phe ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/badz+ra dhū 5pe hūṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ/ badz+ra gabye 6hūṃ/ badz+ra be+e wi 7bye hūṃ/badz+ra gī ti ga ta ga ta hūṃ swā hā/ sngags dang tshigs bcad rab brjod pas/ /dngos sam yid kyis mchod pa dbul/ /de nas bstod dang phrin las bcol/ /mdun du gta' yi gtor ma la/ /a las ban+dha gzhal yas khang / /thun mong gdan dang nyi ma'i steng / /hūṃ yig las ni mdog gnag pa/ /las kyi sems dpar bskyed par bya/ /ri rab chen po'i lho shar nas/ /be+eng lo can gyi bskul tshig dang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs bsnyim/ /mchod dang sdig bshags la sogs bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa yis/ /ye shes sems dpa' bstem par byarta / /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum rab bkod de/ /yi ge bcu gsum 'khor lo bsgom/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho haṃ/ sgu gsung thugs su byen brlabs nas/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas bye snyed rnams/ /spyan drangs mchod dang sdig bshags te/ /rjes su gnang ba gsum ldan gyis/ /dbang bsgur byin brlabs gnyis med thim//oṃ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dubyen / sarba bubye sa pa ri wā ra —badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ chos kyi rgyal por dbang bsgur ro/ /thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems 37—797

——dpa' la/ /gtad de sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /bdag dang las kyi sems dpa' la/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rim pa rnams/ /ji lta bar ni gsal bar bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yi/ /gsang sngags skyon spangs bzlas par bya/ /bsnyen dus lha la gtad de bzlas/ /sgrub pa'i dus su sngags la gtad/ /bzlas 1dus gzas pa po rnams la/ /gtad de sngags kyi 'phro 'du bya/ /de nas bdag dang rgyan cha yi / /sbrul gyi kha nas sngags bzlas pas/ /me yi 'tshubs ma dmar nag dang / /khro bo grangs med 'phros/ pa las de yis de dag bsregs nas kyang / /lhag ma lus —par gyur pa rnams/ /spogs pa yi ni spyor bas bsreg /de ltar byas nas bsgom zhing bzlas/ /de nas dang po'i thun thon nas/ /skyo 'am dub na mchod byas te/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te dbul/ /bstod dang phrin las bcol bar bya/ /ji ltar nye bar ma gyur par/ /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs mi gsol/ /mchod rten sngon po dag la'o/ /thun ni gnyis dang gsum pa la5/ /ye shes sems dpa' mchod pa dang / /thun ni tha ma bsgom pa'i tshe/ /dang po'i thun ni mthun par gsungs / /yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ /de nas ldang ba'i dus dag tu/ /rig sngags las kyi lha la gtad/ /de ltar ma nor bsgoms byas na/ /dngos grub dam nga/ ce 'dod pa/ /gang la dmigs pa de 'grub 'gyur/ /bsnyen rdzogs mtshan ma bzang ba dang / /ye shes sems dpa' gshegs mi gsol/ /gshegs na dngos grub yal 'gyur bas/ /lha ni rgyun du 'khor ba yi/ /man ngag zhal las shes par bya/ /gtor ma bka' las phab nas/ ni/ /gta' yi bdag po mchod byas/ nas/ /gta' gtor bsgu‘pa tshig bcas la gtad / /27— 798

— ———bsgrub bya'i phyogs su dmar lam bstan/ /gta' yi bdag po gshegs su gso' //las kyi sems dpa' bdag la bsdu/ /hūṃ t+t+waṃ zhes bsdu mi dmigs bsgom/ /skad cig ma yi nga rgyal gyis/ /spyod lam ci bder gnas par bya/ /bsnyen/ rdzogs mtshan ma bzang gyur nas/ /drag po las la sbyar byas te/ /mchod rten sngon po sku gdung ldan/ /me tog sngon po drir bsnyugs kyis/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig tu mchod cing / /bdag nyid gos sngon chas gon la/ /rak+ka 1rus pa'i phreng ba bgrang / /sngags ni brgya dang brgya lnga bcus/ /thun bdun gyes rgo 2rnal 'byor bya/ /rdo rje'am seng ldeng phur pa la/ /gzungs sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ /bsam gtan rdo rje thogs pa yi/ /drag sngags lnga bcu rtsa gcig bzlas / /gzas pa po la bsnun gyur na/ /des ni las rnams thams cad 'grub / /bdag gis 'di byas dge ba yis/ /blo chung rnams kyis don rtogs te/ /'bad pas tshogs gnyis bsags nas rgo/ /phyag na rdo rje thob par shog /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi man ngag /slob dpon su wā gī shwa ra tīrtis gzungs kyi 'grel pa ltar mdzad pa 'grel pa las gzungs sgrub thabs su mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyu ra ba'o// //37—799

༄/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ri1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ be+e waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha rna nā 2 ma / bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po khro bo gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad klu rnams rgyan du mdzad/ /gtum zhing rngam pas gshin rje'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /khro rgyal gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bdag nyid dran phyir bri/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nye bar bsgrub nga/ra 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dbe+en zhing nyams dga' ba'i sar maṇ+ḍal bya ba ni bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa lus sngo ba/ sna nyag pa khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ shin tu khros pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa sa len du bcug ste/ lho nub mtshams nas sa 5sngon po'am nag po len du bcug pa6/ dri zhim po'i chu la srung ba'i sngags bzlas te/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi satwa arja sidhi ku ru rak+ṣa zhes btab 37—802

—byed——————byed— sde ——byedal / maṇ+ḍal sngon ngo/ rgyar khru gang ba la/ dpangs su mtho gang ba brtsigs te/tsan+dan dang / a ka ru dang / dzā ti dang / e la dang / rams dang / so/ ba 1shing gi lo ma dri chus byugs la/ me tog sngon po'am dri'i thig le dgu byas la/ mchod rdzas rnams dgram nga/ra bya'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs ltar lha dgu'i rang bzhin bsgom mo/ /de 'ang sgrub thabs las gta' bcas la mchod do zhes pa ni gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs 'di'o/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi gta' gtor 'di la brten la rtag tu sgrub 4pa ni gtor ma'i snod rin po che'i rgyu las byas te/ de'i nang du 'bras chan dang / nas dang /gro la sogs pa las gtor ma byas te/ spyan gzigs dang / sha dang mar dang / mngar la sogs pas brgyan par bya'o/ /de'i nang du thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan bsham 5pa 'am/ bskyed par bya'o/ /rja las ri rab bsams te/ de'i steng du a las thod nga/'i sgu mkhar/ steng du ma las nyi ma/ paṃ las pad+ma / bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ 'a/sa 'od 'phros te/ /bsgrub bya bkug ste thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan la bstem/ yang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i tsha tsha 'phros pas lha dang phral la gcer bu byang thang la bor ba ltar bsam/ steng du hūṃ las gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon / bskyed do/ /sgu mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dze+e rje/ /g.yon rtse gsum 'phan can 'phyar ba/ bzhin khros pa/ smin ma glog stong 'od du 'gyu ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bcings pa ste/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mig 'bras hūṃ las me'i phung po 'dra ba/ zhal nas ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ ṅga sgra sgrogs pas khams gsum pa brgyal bar byed pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la rnam par 37—803

———brgyan pa/ sgu che la yan lag rags/ nga// ri rab la rnam nga/ra bzhugs nga/ ste/zhabs/ gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyang la/ dbu bar snang na khams na 'phyo ba/'khor gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba cig bskyed do/ /de ci 'dra ba nacig ri rab rtse nas spyan drangs la phyag btsal/ mchod pa dbul/bdun rnam dag bya ste/ bstod pa dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab ste/dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstems la/ gta' bdag las kyi 4gnod sbyin phyag na rdo rje drag po'i sgo nas thugs rjes bzhugs pas gzas pa po'i nyon mongs/ pa dang / rig sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / snying po dang /phyag rgya dang / phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bzhugs te/ drag pos drag po 5sgrol bar bsam mo/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi z-i da ya ṇa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dpal gnod sbyin gyi yang snying yin pas bsnyen pa'i dus su bdun 'bum nyi khri gdon no / /8mtshan ma bzang ba dang sgrub pa la 'jug ste/bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis thugs ka'i t+t+waṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas las kyi gnod sbyin gyi thugs dam bskul te 'od zer dmar po / me'i 'od lta bu byung ste/ gzas pa po bsreg pa dang sdig pa la sogs pa sbyangs te/ slar bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ oṃ yak+ṣa dī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ma/ hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ che ge mo a mu ka l+ya mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces sngags bzlas/ pas zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba me'i 'od dang bcas te las kyi lha'i zha'/ du thim/ thugs ka nas 'thon te/ be+er bdag nyid kyi snying gar thim ste/sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bas gzas/ pa po sngags kyi phreng bas bsregs shing 'du'/ bar bya'o/ /sgrub pa rtags bzang ba dang las la sbyar te/ rgyud las 27—80/

byed —byed—kyang / 'og tu me yi dkyil 'khor 1bsam/ /me 'bar klong chen dkyil du gzir / /bsam gtan rdo rje thogs pa yis/ /gdul bya'i steng du dbab par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas bsregs bskrad bcom btags/ par bsam//dmar lam bstan pa ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dgongs pa bya zhing drag sngags bzlas te / tar+ya thā budha budha/ bi bud+dhā ma hā pā 4p+ta/ ha ra ha ra nā ga māṃ/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga māṃ/ stson+da stson+da nā ga z-i 5da ya rgo/ byen+da byen+da nā ga da 6mā ni/pi si man dha nā ga sha rī ra ni/ bi sgo ṭa ya/ nā ga ya nā ni/ tar+ya thā hūṃ phaṭa/nā ga bi da 7ra na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga uts+tsha ṭa nā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga mā ra na sod sod / nā ga mā ra na bying bying / nā ga mā ra na mugs mugs/ nā ga mā ra na ha la ha la/ nā ga mā ra na shig shig /nā ga mā ra na du na du na/ nā ga mā ra na myos myos/ bying byeng thum ri li li dzaḥ/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu mi yengs mi myur bar smra ba gcad do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dgongs pa gsal la drag por bya'o/ /kha zas kyi dus la bab pa 'am ldang bar 'dod na ye shes sems dpa' che la mchod pa dbularta / gtor ma bsngo/ bstod pa bya/las kyi lha la gtor ma dbul ba ni phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las a las bad+dhā'i 'og tu yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor de'i chosteng du ram̐ las me gru gsum/de'i steng du hūṃ gsum/ de'i steng du bad+dhā'i gzhal yas khang / de'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ yi las rlung byung / me 'bar/ mes thod pa bskol/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur pas mchod/ rtsa sngags la ba bo ta khā hi zhes btags la dbul/ las kyi dus su gtor ma sha khrag tu dmigs la dbul/ rtsa sngags la ma ma sarba sha t+t+waṃ btags la dbul/ skabs su gtor ma bskul/27—805

1681༄༅/ /'khor go'i man ngag ces bya ba/she ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsakra u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/'khor lo'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor sngon du bsnyen byas pas/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bya ste/ /las spyor cis kyang ma thul na/ /'khor lo'i las la 'jug par bya/ /sbyor ba 'di la zhugs gyur na/ /brlag par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /drag po'i las kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshon yin te/ /rtse gcig bsgoms nga/sa 'grub pa las/ /kun gyis 'grub par mi nus so/ /'di ni zhe sdang 'khor lo ste/ /drag po 'khrugs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /dmigs na lha 'ang brlag par 'gyur/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs brtol 4nas/ /gzungs sngags drag po'i 'khrul 'khor 'dis/ /myur du bsgrims te bsgral ba na/ /nam mkha' nyid kyang 'jig 'gyur na/ /bsgrub 37—808

bya'i rnam shes smos ci dgos/ /'di ni dgug nga/'i 'khor lo ste/ /sga tsha thal chen grog mo'i zhing / /bong bu'i sbangs dang sa gnyan las/ /klu rigs rnams kyi gzugs bya ste/ /snying po ti shādang ming bcug la/ /dgug pa'i dgongs 2pa 'di ltar bya/ /tha ma'i phaṭa las dzaḥ'aphros te/ /dzaḥlas lcags kyu'i dbyibs byung nas/ /bsgrub bya'i rnam shes bkug par bsam/ /khugs 4nas sgrub pa'i las la 'jug /de nas gsad pa'i 5'khor lo brtsamasatsho/ /stong nyid ngang las e las ni/ /mthing ga gru gsum chos 'byung dbus/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor te/ /re las me ri lnga yi dbus/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo bskyed par 8bya/ /zlo badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ /zlo las srid pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /spu gri gcod pa'i 'khor lo bskyed/ /badz+ra rdo rje'i 'khor lo ni/ /me 'bar dpal dang bcas par bsam/ /tsakra phyogs mtshams 'khor lo ni/ /rdo rje ra ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ /rak+ṣa zhes pas steng srung ba'i/ /byin gyis brlabs 1 pa'i 'khor lo bskyed/ /hūṃ rnams las ni bde gshegs sku/ /cho ga yan lag gsum kyis bskyed/ /thugs kar ye shes 'khor lo bsgom/ /ye shes sems dpa'i ཿthugs ka ru/ /nyi stengs 7dpa' bo 'bru lnga dgod/ /mu khyud rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ /bde gshegs bka' dang dam tshig las/ /mi 'da' ba yi 'khor lo la/ /zil gyis mnan pa'i sngags rnams dgod/ /phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i 'khor lo la/ /gnad la dbab pa'i sngags rnams dgod / /rdo rje srid pa'i 'khor lo la/ /tshar bcad pa yi sngags rnams bsam / /byin rlabs srung 7ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ /mi baspyod zhe sdang rdo rje ste/ /mthing nag sdigs mdzub rdo rje bcas/ /sems dang/'i skyil krung nyi 37—809

zla'i gdan/ /'khor lo yi ni rtsibs/ dag la/ /bcom ldan gtum po khros pa'i sgu / /rdo rje dang ni sdigs mdzub bcas/ /zhal nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pas//log 'dren tshogs rnams 'joms par byed/ /de ltar 'khor lo chen po bsgoms1//ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ /mchod bstod sdig bshags la sogs bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis nade la bstem/ /sgu gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs / /rjes su gnang ba gsum 4ldan gyis/ /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bsgur te/ /de nas 'khor lo bskor 'dod na/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dam bsgul/ /de las 'od 'phros sngags la phog /sngags las 'od 'phros 'khor lo bskul/ /'khor lo 'od zer 'bar ba yis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor lo bskor/ /thub cing rab tu bsreg par bsam//bdag nyid kyis ni sngags bzlas pas/ /sngags kyi 6'khor lo rim par bskor/ /gzas pa po yi snying ga ru/ /ya yis bskyod de hūṃ gis bsdu/ /phaṭa kyis rnam par 'thor zhing bsregasarwa/ /srid pa rdo rje'i 'khor los gtub9/ /phyogs/ mtshams mtshon cha'i 'khor lo yis/ /phog na thams cad brlag par 'gyur/ /tsit+ta thugs kyi sgrub pa ste/ /shin tu gnod na khong du bskor/ / 'phral du gsod na rten la bskor/ / skabs su gnod na dgug cing bskor/ /bsko/ra nas brlag nga/ra gdon mi za/ /'khrul 'khor 'di yi spyor ba yis/ /gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags dang / /byad dang bka' nyan pho nya dang / /'khor lo'i ting 'dzin la sogs rnams/ /gnod sbyor thams cad 'jig byed cing / /gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcod/ /rig sngags drag po'i gzungs sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba/ slob dpon su bā gī shwa ra tīrtis 27——8/0

༄ga /dpal phyag na rgo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi dī waṃ ba ra dha ra dh+wa ra ṇi ka la paṃ ba la ti sdebi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon dang ni sgrub pa pos/ /bsnyen pa dang ni sgrub pa dang / /dkyil 'khor dang ni sbyin sreg dang / /gzhan yang lha rnams mnyes pa dang / /bgegs zhi ba dang nyams pa bskang / /'khrul 'khor tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / /phan gdags pa dang tshar bcad dang / dgar dang gsad dang dgug pa dang //gzir dang bcings tredang mnan pa dang / /rgyas dang bsdus dang shin tu basbus//zhi dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi5/ /las rnams nye bar 'grub pa dang / /thun mong mchog dang dngos grub dang / /bsod nams chen po thob bya'i phyir/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / /37—8/3

—byed—byed— —— byed—byed—byedabargyad dang bcu bzhi nya stong ngam/ /yang na rgyun nam dus drug tu/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las rnams bya/ /rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag lnga/ /'bru dang shing thog sman rnams dang / /chan thug khur ba dkar gsum mngar/ /sha khrag rus pa snying sna rnams/ /dgra'am 'byung po bgegs kyi gzugs/ /sbrul dang sbal lcong 1 nya sha rnams/ /de sogs drag po'i thun rdzas so/ /cho ga gsum mam skad cig mas/ /'dod pa'i lha rnams bskyed byas la/ /tshogs bsags sngon 'gro rjes 'jug rnams/ /bsnyen sgrub dus dang mthun par bya/ /bdag mchod lha rnams mnyes bya'i phyir/ /mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā lar༄ / /rdzas rnams kun gyis/ bkang byas te/ /yo las rlung ste ram̐ me sbar/ /de steng a las ka pā lar//de 'og ye shes lnga ldan gsum/ /go ku da ha na las ni/ /lcags kyu lnga po bskyed par bya/ /bi mu ma ra shu las ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin bakhyed/ /dpa' bo lnga yis rab sbyangs te/ /zla stengs 4oṃ 'a/sa rdo rje hūṃ/ /de gyur rtse lnga de nyid can/ /sngo bskyod rnge sbar rdzas rnams bskol/ /'od kyis ri bong rtse lnga zhu / /thim pas bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gnas/ /ye shes lnga yi yig 'bru las/ /'od kyis gang gā'i klung sogs kyi/ /bdud rtsi drangs te gnyis med bstem/ /'bru gsum sngags kyi byin kyis brlab / /lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma dang / /darkan ma/tshag gsu/ma/ dang chos dh+yang rnams/ /lce yi rdo rjes bdud rtsi len/ /oṃ dī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ba bo i rda kṛṇ+ḍi kṛhā khā hi khā hi bye dza ho ba lip+ta khā hi / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ 4āḥt+t+waṃ zhes bsnyen pa'i dus su dbul lo/ /de rjes sgrub pa'i dus dag tu/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlab 1zi nga/ ni/ /a las bad+dhā'i nang dag tu/ /saṃ las sha yi phung po bskyed/ /27—— 8/ /

—byed ——byed—ne+e las rus pa'i pho brang las/ /ra las rak+ta'i rgya mcho bskyil/ /sha khrag rus par byin brlabs la/ /dug gsum dmar gyi mchod pa 'di/ /drag po'i sngags kyis 1dbul bar bya/ /oṃ be+e māṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi2/ ma ma sarba sha bye a mu ka'i madz+dza me dā bā sa māṃ sa dz+re baṃ bu shaṃ ru bye ra dī 4ya ku ru bhak+ṣa ni i rda ba bo kṛ ṇ+ḍi kṛ ṇ+ḍa khā nyi khā hi bhuñja 5ho/ rak+ta bī pa ta a ti kra ma sa ma ye swā hā/zhes sgrub pa'i dus su'o/ /las spyor drag po'i dus dag tu/ /gta' yi gtor ma dbul ba ni/ /sbal lcong nya sha'i gtor ma bsham/ /gzas pa po yi ling ga la / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzus skyes tshul du bskyed bya ste7 / /bkug ste gru gsum kha bcab/ gzir/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i/ /las kyi gnod sbyin tshogs la dbul/ /yak+ṣa dī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ// ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye che ge mo'i srog la shag shag ma ma sarba sha t+t+waṃ a mu ka zhes dbul lo/ /de nas bstod cing smon lam btab/ /thod chen rnga brdung 'phrin las bcom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yis/ rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /go bgo lus bsrung brtan rka par bya/ /rang nyid nga rgyal byu bder gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ slob dpon su wā gī shwa ra k+ṇirtis mdzad pa dze+egs so // //37—8/ dwa

thug /phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa jes bya ba/tso ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi no pi ka sā dha rgo snyenā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa ri zhes bya ba/ khro bo gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi gsang sngags dbye ༄ba bshad/ /oṃ nas swā hā bcu bdun par/ /gtso la bsnyen pa dbul ba'o/ /de nas sgrub pa'i thabs dag la/ /'bum du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas nas/ /myur du gsad 5pa'i las la 'jug /klu dang gnyan dang sa bdag sogs/ /gzhan yang gnod spyor mtha' dag rnams/ /bzlog cing mi tshugs bya ba'i phyir/ /las kyi gnod sbyin sgrub thabs brtsam/ /sngags bdag nag po'i sgrub pa la/ /sngags kyang du ma rnam pa bzhi / /bod pa rbad pa gsad 6dang mchod/ /gdams ngag can gyis nan tan bya/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha/ badz+ra dha ra badz+ra kharge dha ra/ badz+ra kha 37—8/7

la ru pā 1sha dha ra/ badz+ra tsakra dha ra/ nā ga mā ra 2ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha/ badz+ra dha ra nā ga ru ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha khaṅga dha ra nā ga mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha kha la ru pā sha dha ra nā ga mā ra ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ khro badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha tsakra dha ra nā ga mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa gro dha hūṃ/ ha ra ha ra nā ga rgo / pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga rgo7/ che ge mo mā ra ya sod sod/ nā ga mā ra ya bying byeng / nā ga mā ra ya mugs mugs / nā ga mā ra ya shig shig /nā ga mā ra ya myog myog9 /nā ga mā ra ya dun dun/ nā ga mā ra 1ya thum ril dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa kro dha badz+ra dha ra 1 badz+ra khaspyo dha ra kha la ru pā sha dha ra tsakra dha ra/ yak+ṣa kro dha che ge mo'i srog la shag shag ma ma sarba sha t+t+waṃ 15a mu ki yi rka6ma dz+dza ma dha bha sa māṃ sa dz+re baṃ bu ga ru bye ra dī yo bhak+ṣa ni ba bo i rda griṇ+ḍi griṇ+ḍi khā hi khā hi bhuñja ho/ rak+ta bī pa ho / mā ti kra ma sa ma ye swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bzhi'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa'i gu ru su wā gī shwa ra tīrtis mdzad pa / paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o// //37—8/8

༄go/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum ji 2snyed kyis/ /rjes gnang las kyi khro bor dbang bskur ba'i/ /mthu stobs bdag po gdug pa'i gnyen po la/ /dang bas phyag 'tshal sgrub pa'i go rims bri/ /dang por gnas dang dkyil 'khor bshams / /mchod rten sngon po bum pa bcas/ /gta' bcas mchod rdzas khrus byas la/ /mchod rten sngon po bum pa dang / /gta' gtor mchod yon byin kyis brlab/ /sems bskyed sno da bcud sngags kyis sbyangs4/ /tshogs bsags mgron gyi lha rnams gshegs / /bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad tshad med bsgoms5/ /stong nyid bsgoms la 'byung rnams bskyed/ /ri rab steng du srung 6'khor bsgom/ /de dkyil gzhal yas khang dang gdan/ /yig 'bru rnams las lha rnams bskyed/ /thugs kar ye shes 'khor lo bsgoms7/ /byin rlabs 8lus bsrung brtan par 37—820

bya / /ye shes 'khor lo dgug gdan dbul/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod sdig bshags bstem/ /byin rlabs 'od zer gsum 'phro 'du/ /dbang bskur lha rnams spyan drangs mchod/ /sdig bshags gzungs ltar rjes gnang bya/ /dbang bsgur byin rlabs 1de nyid bstem/ /lce ni byin rlabs skyon spangs 'das2/ /bsnyen dus lhar gtad spro basbu bya/ /thun mtshams bye la mchod gtor gtang / /gshegs gsol bskyed bsdu mi dmigs bsam/ /bsnyen pa rtags ldan dngos grub blang / /gta' gtor nam gung tho rangs dus/ /dbang bskur rgyas 4gdab bum lha gshegs/ /lus bsrung spyod lam rnal 'byor bya/ /rtags rnams sgyu ma lta bur gzung 5/ /de don gzhan la smra mi bya/ /sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag 'di/ /tshig rkang sum cus de nyid don basbus nas / /shes par byed pa'i don 'grel sgron ma 'di/ /byas pa'i dge ba sems can kun 7la bsngo/ /nongs pa mchis na 'phags pas bzod par gsol/ /slob dpon gsung gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—82/

༄gro/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sku gsung 2sras bcas kyis/ /rjes gnang las kyi khro bor dbang bsgur ba'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dug dgra dregs 'joms la/ /dang bas phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs go rims bri/ /grags dang dus dang mtshan ma yi/ /bsnyen rdzogs dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /gnas dang phyogs dang sngon 'gro bya/ /thig gdab tshon dgye phyag mtshan 1dgod/ /khyad par rdzas bsog bum pa bca'—/ /dngos grub rten dang mchod rdzas bsham/ /sdom bsrung smyung gnas chos gos brgyan5/ /tshogs bsags 6sngon 'gro rjes 'jug dang / /bskyed rim mchod pa bsnyen dus bzhin/ /bum nang lha bskyed spyan drangs mchod/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs 7bum nang thim/ /gzungs thag btags te rig sngags bzlas/ /steng dang 'og gi lam gnyis las/ /thun mong khyad par spro 37—823

༄/ /bum pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/lku ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka la sha sā dha rgo sdenā ma/ bod skad du/bum pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa'i dgrar gyur mi shigs 'dzin/ /khro rgyal spyi bos rab btud nas/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan bya'i phyir/ /bum pa'i sgrub pa bri bar bya/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po'i steng dag tu/ /rdzas rnams mngon par 'dus byas la/ /bdag nyid yi dam lhar bskyed de/ /bum pa ye shes gzhal yas su/ /sman lnga 'bru lnga snying po lnga/ /rin chen lnga dang dri chu lnga/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs la/ /cho ga bzhin du lhar bskyed de/ /de nas sgrub po'i gnas mal bcas/ /gzhon nus bkal ba'i skud 4pa yis/ /bdag dang lha ru 'brel bar bya spro ba gsung gi rang bzhin la/ /bsdu ba sngags kyi yan lag yin/ /skyo bar gyur na gzungs thag gzung / /steng dang 'og gi lam gnyis la/ /brten pas 37—825

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ tata twa pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/de kho na nyid sgon 2༄ma zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs kun gyi bdag po ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bsnyen sgrub las spyor la sogs pa'i/ /rtags kyi rim pa bri bar bya/ /de la rtags ni bzhi yin te/ /lha grub gdon rnams thub pa dang / /nad phyir byung dang mi ldog pa'o—/ /lha ni nye bar 'grub gyur na/ /yang dag rtags dang bdud kyi rtags/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ /dang po rnam pa gsum yin te/ /mngon sum rmi lam nyams myong ngo / /dbang po'i mngon sum dag tu yang / /lha yi sgu mdog phyag mtshan gzugs/ /rten dang lus las 'od byung ba/ /mig gis mthong ngam nyams su 'byung / /rna bas dag pa'i gsang sngags thos/ /des ni dngos grub gnyis ka 'byung / /'bring ni rmi lam gsal po la/ /dngos dang 37—827

phyag mtshan 1mchod rten dang / /me tog sngo dang khye chung sngo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / /ri bor 'dzeg dang lha yul mthong / /dngos grub 'grub tu nye ba ste/ /bsnyen pa'i rtags su shes par bya/ /rang gi nyams su 'byung ba ni/ /lus la srog chags sdar pas ni/ /phyi dang nang du nyung ba dang / /rig pa shin tu bde ba dang / /nyon mongs rnam rtog shas chung ba'o/ /gong du bstan pa de rnams kyang / / ya nga 2'jigs dang bcas pa dang / /kha dog skya la mdangs med dang / /'od kyang sngo 3zhing mi rtag dang / /nam gung man chad rmi lam na4/ /sad nas 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ /bdud kyi rtags su/ shes par bya/ / 'byung po bsad dang yan lag bcad/ /brdung 5btags skad ngan 'don pa dang / /phyugs dze+e byas dang mer bsreg 6sogs/ /gdon rnams thub pa'i rtags yin no/ /bshang gci dor dang bshal btang dang / /srog chags lus la phyir 'thon 8dang / // sngar gyi rtog pa spangs 7pa ni/ /nad rnams phyir la thon pa'i rtags/ /gzugs brnyan bsregs par thal bar 'gyur / /dgra bo yu/la nas thon gyi rmi/ /'og tu bcug pas dngos po brlag /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags yin te/ /de rnams las bzlog ngan pa yi/ /rtags su nges par shes par bya/ /'di la brten nas 'dir zhugs rnams/ /'di mi dngos gru/ba thob nga ra shog / // 4de kho na nyid sgron /gam zhes bya ba/ slob dpon su bā gī shwa ra shīrtis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37——828

༄ / /phyag na rdo rje'i sprur bsad las tshogs bsdus pa bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen sgrub rtags dang ldan gyur nas/ /spur zhing bsad pa'i las dag brtsam/ /de yang las tshogs bsdus pa las/ /zhi bar ma gyur gdon bgegs la/ /smyug 2shad bal po se'u yi/ /sngags bzlas lcug 4mas byabs sam brabs/ /'jigs pa brgyad kyi rdzas kyis gzir/ /zhes pa ni spur bsad kyi sbyor ba'o/ /de'ang spur pa ni bskrad pa'i las te/ thog mar rig pa 'dzin pa nyid kyis zhugs/ nga/ bzhi'i mtshan nyid brtags la/ nad rnams dbyung 5zhing gnod 6pa gdon par bya ba'i thabs ni/ rgyal po bram ze rje rigs kyi/ /gzhon nu gtsang ma shar bltas te/ /dkon mchog gsum dang gos sngon la/ /phyag 'tshal sems bskyed rmyag shad blang / /dag byed sngags bzlas chus bsangs la/ /yungs kar rma bya tshon sgud bcings/ /byab pa'i rdzas de rtag tu bcang / /de 37—830

nas rin chen snod dag tu/ /gtso bo klu chen brgyad po dang / /rigs drug rigs bzhi'i sa bdag gnyen/ /gzugs brnyan byas te klu sman dang / /dkar gsum rin chen dar zab bcas/ /shing snas mtha' bskor tshon lngas brgyan—/ /gzhan yang mchod rdzas thams cad bsogs(7/ /rig pa 'dzin pas 3)sgrub thabs ltar/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i las rdzogs bya/ /gtso bo gdan gyi klu brgyad las/ /paṃ las 'dab brgyad dze+e gyis mtshan/ /de gyur sbrul lam klu chen brgyad/ /btsun mo sras bcas blon po dang / /sprul pa yang sprul rnams bskyed la/ /de dang 'dra ba bkug bsnyim mchod/ /dbang bskur gtor ma byin rlabs thusbyin/ /oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ta k+ṣa ka karko ṭa thupad+ma ma hā pad+ma shaṃ kha pā la bhe la bhe (1 hu thad hu thad 5ta ge ni ba 'di yid rda/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛhā khuta/ nyi tad nyi/gtor ma byin pas gdug rtsub zhi/ /de nas bdag nyid khro bor bsgom/ /gzungs sngags bzlas shing lcug mas byab/ /nā ga rā dza ba su ki z-i da ya dha 7ra ya 8 phud phud/ dza ye phuḥ1bi dza ye phuḥ7/ dzi ti dzi ti phuḥ ji/ dzi ti saṃ ge phuḥka/sa ma ya phuḥ12/ shaṃ shaṃ 5ru te phuḥs/ a la uste phuḥtshi/ gra te ka ra phuḥ —/sa ma ya phuḥ/shā/ nā ga sarba ni phuḥ / z-i da ya dha ra ya phud phud/ nad pa la byab 1gzugs la dbab/ /dug phyung khro bo'i che brjod la/ /zla dkyil steng bzhag yo las bskyod / /nā ga sga ra ṇa phaṭa ces/ /klu bro bsgags ( cing dam tshig bsgrags༄ / /gzungs brgya bzlas la phur 5zhing bskrad/ /de ltar brgya 'am stong byas na/ /klu yi nad las grol bar 'gyur/ /gzugs brnyan sa 'am chu bor dor/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal te/ /zhi dang spur bas mi thul zhing / /rig sngags 'chang gi bka' 'das na/ /de la 'jigs pa'i las 37—83/

—— ——brgyad brtsam/ /grog mkhar bdud 'chang 1tshub ma yi2/ /sa las mthing nag gru gsum brtsig /zur gsum lcags kyu brtsegs mas mtshan/ /dbus su ling ga sngon dmar gyis/ /bcings te byad bcug phur la btod5/ /mgyogs phur rtsang dang phur pas bskor/ /bye tshan gze ma yungs kar dang / /tsha la zangs lcags dur blugs bcas/ /dmar gtor dug gtor dug thun bsham/ /gru gsum dur khrod g.yam pas bcad7/ /dur khrod ras la nam mkha' lding / /gser mdog zhal gsum phyag drug gis/ /ba su ta yi klu rnams 'dzin/ /spyan mig nyi zer rdo rje'i mchu/ /'khor lo'i gzhug sgro ral gri'i gshog /lus rnam/sa rdo rje'i spu yis gtams/ /de 'dra rgyal rigs kha bstan gzhag /khra spyang nya khra gcan gzan gyi/ /mche sder la sogs khyu 8rnams bsog /drag ngo/'i mchod yon bsham byas la/ /de nas rig pa 'dzin pa rnams/ /na ra'i gos/ gyon gos sngon gyi9/ /so so'i bsam gtan la zhugs nas/ /bsnyen sgrub spur dang gsang sngags bzlas/ /zhi bas dug phyung gsad pa yi/ /rtse gcig bsgoms te brtson 'grus kyis/ /bar chad med par las la sbyar/ /nag po'i tshes brgyad nas brtsams te/ /zhi ba byams pa snying rje bsgom/ /gzungs kyi sngags dang shāṅgi bzlas/ /nad dang gdug rtsub zhi bar bsam/ /spur ba gong du bstan nga/ bzhen/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba'i drag sngags ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa hūṃ yig las/ /gyur te nag po char sprin mdog /smin mtshams dpral bsdus ha ha bzhad/ /rdo rje tshar gcod sdigs mdzub bcas/ /de 'drar bsgoms te yungs kar la/ /sngags bzlas tshangs pa'i gnas su brab/ /shi sa drag po 'di yis gdab/ /yak+ṣa byā lālba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye 1 37—8 32

——de ba ku ru sha na dha 1ra/ thog thog thog ril thog thog dar byams sad/ /che ge mo'i lus la rum rum/ snying la shag shag ma ma shādhi rbad pu nadhita sri rbad pu nan / nā ga sa khrag pu ma mā ra ya phaṭa/ yungs kar 2yungs nag ske tshe dang / /tsha la zangs lcags bye tshan char/ /gnam lcags drag po'i sngags des brdeg /gcan gzan mche sder bya khra'i mchu/ /mkha' lding rgyal po'i sngags bzlas brab/ /shī la ya dang bcas pa'i sngags/ /dus drug phur pas gzir bar bya/ /'og nas drag po'i rdzas kyis bdug /smyag shad bal po se'u yi4/ /lcug mas brdeg 5cing rig sngags bzlas/ /g.yas nas gsad cing g.yon nas spur/ /mi bzad rdzas kyis de la byug /gag pa lhog pa byung ba bzhin/ /drag po'i sngags kyis de la gdab/ /bdun nam rtsa gcig bdun tsho bdun/ /de la sogs te bsgrubs gyur na/ /nā ga rā dza karko ṭa/ /des zin pa yang grol 'gyur nges/ /phyag na rdo rje'i las bsdus 'di/ /paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis mdzad pas ( / /mi ma yin rnams skrag cing brgyal/ /des na rnam smin sdig pa'i rgyu/ /de phyir shin tu gsang bar gsungs/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i spur gsad las tshogs bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon su bā gī shwa ra shīrtis mdzad pa rdzogs so / / // a kra ma/7 tar+ya thā/ i bi pu le pra ba 8 ra nā ga /ma hā nā ga z-i da ya/ a 1 pa ra te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba nā ḍi ta ya ni/ ki m+bi ki m+bi/nā ga ku la bidz+nyā sa ni/ ha na ha na/ sarba nā ga duṣ+ṭa ḍi ta ya ni/ da ha da ha sarba dubye / nā ga bha ba na ni/ pa tsa pa tsa ya sarba dubye/ nā ga māṃ1ca/a kra ma ྾sa mu dra spe sā ga ra tsa le me le/ t+pā ki mā ma hā nā ga te dza pa re swā 27—833

—hā / zhes nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i drag sngags kyis gsad 1pam / /nyug na mo bud+dhā ya/ 2nā ga du tsun+de /mi li mi li/ ban+dha ban+dha nā ga ni 4swā hā zhes phur pa gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsa ta tsa ta/ bi tsi ti bi tsi 5ta/ sha ta sha ta/ bi sha da6/ nā ga bi sha da 7swā hā/ klu 'bros pa'i sngags i this// //bsdur mchan/8 ༷ 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamag 〈〈snar 〉raba'u/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉bcug 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyung / 6〈〈snar 〉sngagadon/831 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sog 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 4〈〈snar〉〉giṭa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉—hu 'u / 6〈〈pe 〉that+na grit+na/ 〈〈snar 〉tsāt+na kṛt+na/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉hri da nad/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tri rda da/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉pang // 4 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉7 saglu / (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉tri da na dha ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉hri rda dha rā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyabs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉gis bskyod/ 〈〈snar 〉〉las bskyod do/ 2chi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srur/832 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cad/ 2〈〈snar 〉stanan/ 〈〈snar 〉rabartsigs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉yi brtseg 〈〈snar 〉〉gyu'i rtsags 5〈〈pe 〉ra rtod/ 6〈〈pe 〉thatsang / 〈〈pe 〉sngagacad/ 〈〈snar 〉snga cas/ 〈〈pe 〉rnamachu/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ca/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉gyis/ 7〈〈snar 〉stan/8t+ta2 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang ni/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ga 4〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉brjeg 〈〈pe 〉〉nga/ 'a sa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.a kra ma/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈9sma rngo 〉〉hri rka 〈〈r+ṣa 〉〉〈〈sna rngo rizo 〈〈pe 〉〉sgyi dh+wa / 〈7snar sku༅ t+t+waṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈sgyusnar 〉〉ḍi 〈〈pe 〉〉duṣ+ṭin 〈〈sna ra 〉〉duṣ+ṭi/ 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉duṭaṃ/ nā ga na/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7a kra ma/ ྾〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉twa/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7le/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉rnyi kri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ste kri/834 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thasad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7badz+ra tī li ki khā ya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉tsun dhe/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈ñca ra 〉ra ta bi tsa/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉bhi sha dhe/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈/ /i bhā/ 〈〈snar 〉ge //37byed83/
