1689༄7/ /phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi man ngag lag tu blang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ kyi ༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yo/ngas su bsnyen par 'dod pa'i 4rig pa 'dzin pas dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sar sa bslang ba dang / gnas brtsig pa dang / dgos pa'i yo byad dang /mthun pa'i sbyor ba dang / mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bsogs la sngon du 'gro ba'i las 5bya ste/ dang por dkon mchog mchod/ de nas chos skyong dang rigs drug la sbyin/ gtor ma rgya chen po btang / de nas bsam gtan khang pa byi dor byas te/ me tog gcal du bkram la rgyan rnams kyis brgyan te/ de'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal sngon po gru bzhi pa cig gi steng du/ mchod rten sngon po sku gdung dang ldan pa'i drung du me tog sngon po la sogs te/ mchod pa rnam 6pa lnga dang /gta' gtor dang / bum pa bca' thabs rdzogs par byas la dang por khrus bya ste7 / de nas rig pa 'dzin pa nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dang por 37—836

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ de nas a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po bsams/ te sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /khro sarba dharma/ tā badz+ra sidhi hūṃ zhes pas snod bcud dang rdzas thams cad dag pa chen por bsam mo//hūṃ de nyid las skad cig tu lha'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bla ma dang / lhag pa'i lha dang / dkon mchog spyan drangs te/ e h+ye hi bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta budhe dharma 2saṃ gha badz+ra pā ṇi/ ma hā gu ru/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ t+t+waṃ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa mdun du byon par bsam mo/ /pad+ma kā ma la 4ya s+t+waṃ zhes gdan dbul lo/ /phyag btsal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul 5ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang /gsol ba gdab cing skyabs su 'go ba dang / lus dbul zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'o/ /de nas yi ge brgya pas tshogs sogs lha rnams gshegs su gsol/khro āḥbibyān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ zhes pas bdag nyid bkegs dgra'i ting nge 'dzin gyis yungs kar la sngags bzlas te/ khro bo'i sprul par spro ste/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ/ sarba bispyon+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa ces phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcur sngags bdun bdun dang bcas te mtshams gcad rwapar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra gro dhā ya/ ma hā rdasgoṅka ṭa bye ra bā ya/ 9a si mu sa la dha 1 rā ya/ pa ra shu pā sha ha stu ya 1/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā nyi/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha bad+dhā/ ha na ha na/ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyo bi nā ya shā/ ma hā ga na pa ti/ dz+re be+e tān+ta ཿka 27—837

rā ye swā hā zhes mtshon cha'i char phab la btul zhing sbyang bar bya'o/ /de nas khams gsum kyi sems can thams cad snyug bsngal dang dbral 1bar bya'o snyam pa ni snying rje tshad med pa'o/ /bde ba la dgod par bya'o snyam pa ni byams pa tshad med pa'o/ /bde ba 2dang nam du'ang mi 'bral bar 4bya'o snyam pa ni dga' ba tshad med pa'o/ /de'ang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byed pa ni btang snyoms tshad med pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā 5ba āt+pa ko3 haṃ/zhes/ pa stong pa nyid du bsams la/ de'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i dbus su yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/khaṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi/ rja las me ri lnga'i dbus su/ lo las ri rab kyi steng du/ saṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i gur dang / ra ba dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i dbus su/ rgyu 9sngon po 'phro 7'dus pa las gzhal yas khang sngon po gru bzhi sgo bzhi / sgo khyud dang ldan par bsgom par bya'o/ /tsa ser po las 'khor lo sngon po 1 rtsibs bzhi'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma/ ram̐ —las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i ྾dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mazing nag bsams tesnye/ 'od 'phros pa las 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas snang ba thams cad rang gi lhag nga/'i lhar gyur te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha dog sngon po 'od zer gyi phreng ba rnam par 'khrugs pa lte ba hūṃ gis 8mtshan par bsam mo/ /de'i 'od zer gyis 19khro bo'i rigs rnams bkug nas de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung phrag 'bum bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang ba/37—838

mche ba gtsigs pa dang 'tsham pa'am / sgu mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje/g.yon sdigs mdzub klu chen po 2brgyad kyis gzungs nas 'byung ba ltar brgyan pa / stag gi sham thabs dang / na bza' chos gos sngon po dang / seng ge'i 4stod g.yogs dang / gdan dbang po dang / nyi ma dang pad+ma'i steng na klu chen po brgyad nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po dang bcas par 5yang dag par bskyed de6/ de nyid kyi snying gar ye shes sems dpa'i 'khor lo gos sngon po 7can rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /dbang po drug la'ang de dang 'dra ba'i gos sngon po can re bsam par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i hūṃ las hūṃ re 'khor lo'i steng du gnas pa las phyag mtshan tri shu la dang / ral gri dang / dbyug tho 9dang / 'khor lo hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las shar gyi 'khor lo'i steng du las kyi gnod spyin lag na rdo rje g.yas rdo rje/g.yon tri shu la rtse gsum 'phan can 'phyar ba/ na bza' mi bzad sngo bkra gsol ba/ gdan klu rgyal rigs mnan pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje srin po g.yas rdo rje g.yon ral gri/ na bza' pad+ma rā ga /gdan bram ze'i rigs can mnan pa'o//nub tu rdo rje gdon chen g.yas rdo rje g.yon dbyug to / gdan rje rigs mnan pa/ na bza' za hor btso dmar gsol ba'o/ /byang gi 'khor lo'i steng du rdo rje ro langs g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon 'khor lo/ na bza' ba ti khra bo gdan klu dmangs 1 rigs mnan pa'o/ /sde dpon de dag kyang rta sgu mdog gtso bo dang mthun pa/ klu rnams kyis rgyan mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i —me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bsgom mo/ /dzaḥhūṃ sabaṃ hoḥbazhi las sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma dang / zhags pa ma dang / lcags sgrog shām dang / dril bu ma dang / khro 37—839

—mo de dag kyang stag gi sham thabs dang / sbrul gyi rgyan cha dang / nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgyas gnas lngar gtugs te/na maḥs man+ta badzā rde ka 1ba tsa hūṃ zhes brjod pas lus thams cad rdo rje ra bar 2bsgom mo/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas te/ na maḥs man+ta badzā t+t+waṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ zhes brjod nas gnas lngar rgyas btab pas lus thams cad 4rdo rje'i dra mig rnams khro chung tshon 5gang bas gtams par bsams te byen gyes brlab bo/ /de nas de ltar dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed nas6/rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa 7ni/ 'og min gnas mchog dam pa yi / /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rjes gnang ba'i/ /gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren gyis/ / pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang gi mthu/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po gos sngon can/ /ri rab chen po'i lcog bzhi yi/ /lcags ri nag po'i gzhal yas nas9/ /spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /yak+ṣa nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na ba ta ye/ badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra khaṅga dha ra/ badz+ra dī la dha ra/badz+ra tsakra dha ra/ sa ma a 1maṇ+ḍa la ma bye1 / ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ pra be+e sha ya pra we sha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha ya tiṣ+ṭha ya/ a ba lo kā ya/ a ba lo kā ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ gdug pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ /mchod rten sngon po'i 5gzhal yas 'dir/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon gyis/ /las kyi khro bor dbang bskur ba'i/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon 'khor dang bcas/ /phyag 37 —840

byedadang zhabs gnyis bsil nas kyang / /'tsham pa'i gdan la gzhugs 7su gsol/ /yak+ṣa nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se na 2nga/ ta ye/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ sangs rgyas mang pos dbang bsgur ba'i/ /gnod sbyin kun pas 4khyad par 'phags/ /mthu stobs kun gyi bdag po ste / /stobs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi gnod sbyin chen po rnams/ /'jigs su rung ba'i cha lugs can/ /thams cad ma lus 'jigs par byed/ /rigs bzhi klu yi gnyen po ste/ /'jigs byed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul 6ba ni/ /shel ltar dag pa'i snod mchog tu/ /bkra shis 'o ma'i chab kyis gtams7 / /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul8 / /yak+ṣa — dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi t+t+waṃ/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/badz+ra pa ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā yak+ṣa kro dha/ ro ṣa ṇa ya/ badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra khaspyo dha ra/badz+ra be+e la dha ra/ badz+ra tsakra dha ra/ badz+ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa he/ ā ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra 1 spa ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ me tog dam pa 'di dag dang / /de bzhin lha rdzas me tog rnams/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bulas/ /badz+ra puste pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa/ ma ye swā hā/a ka ru dang tu ruṣ+ka// /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /lha rdzas dam nga/'i bdug spos 'di/ /gsang bdag 'phags pa gos spon gyi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul5/ /badz+ra dhū pe 5pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/tsan+dan ga pur dzā spyo5ti dang / /gur gum chu gtsang sman sbyar 'di/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bulas / /badz+ra gabye pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ mun pa'i tshogs ni 'joms byed cing / /37—8 //

phyogs bcu gsal ba'i mar me 'di/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul1/ /badz+ra ā lo ke dī baṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra be+e ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul2 / /badz+ra ne+e bi rdobye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston pa'i/ /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul4/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir bzhes 5su gsol/ /badz+ra gī 6ti ga ta ga ta hūṃ/spa ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā/ bla re snye rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs/ /dpung rgyan do shal se mo do/ /na bza' chos gos sngon por bcas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul8/ / oṃ was+t+ra a waṃ ka ra bi byu ṣa ṇa pū 9 dza be+e ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ 7 swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la khro bo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod la/bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yis / /las kyi khro bor dbang bskur ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs dang phrin las las/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon bzhi sprul pa/ /ri rab chen po'i spyog la gnas/ /kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /g.yon pa so so'i phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /na bza' la ba spyon ngo/ gso/la/ /mi bzang spyo bkra —stag sham can/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sa sgu la brgyan/ /dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yi/ /dkyil nas 'od zer mtshon cha 'phyar1spyo/ /klu rigs bzhi la 'bebs mdzad pa/ /sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yan lag bdun pas sdig pa bshags la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing phrin las bcol te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes ye shes 37—8 2

kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams bstem par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang snying gar dkar po dang dmar po dang / mthing ga dang / sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la yi ge bcu gsum pa bkod de/ rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de nyid las spro bsnyu'i rim pa ni/ oṃ 1sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta 2badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ zhes phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bye ba phrag brjod kyis mi lang bar 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyis 'phags pa rnams la yang dag par mchod cing gnyis su med par thim nas de dag gi gsung rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan rnams kyi 'od zer bdag nyid la thim pas sgrib pa sbyangs te/ thugs ka'i 4'od zer 'gro drug la phog 5pas rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas/ sems can gyi don byas te/slar bdag nyid la bstem pa dang / spro bsdu'i rim pa yang nas yang du bya'o/ /de nas dbang bsgur bar bya ste/ rigs kyi bdag po mi baspyod pa dang /sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang / de'i sras khro bo rnams sbyan drangs pa dang / mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa6/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i gzungs las ji ltar 'byung 7ba ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs mi bskyod pa/ rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang sangs rgyas gang gā'i 9klung gi bye ma snyed dang / rigs kyi yum rnams kyis bum pas dbang bskur zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags yi ge brgya pas sgu khrus gsol ba ni/ lha'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ sku rdo rjer byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /mdo nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar sngags kyi gnang ba thob pa ni gsung rdo rjer byin kyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan sarba budhe sa 37—843

—pa ri wā ra 1badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang 2/ dbang du bya ba dang / tha mi dad par byas te/ sgu gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thugs gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin par gyur te/ ji ltar skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /skyo bar gyur na bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i gzungs kyi phreng ba kho na la sprul 'khril ba ltar bzlas shing rdo rje gsum gyi dgongs pas bdag nyid kyi 4lus kyi nad dang / sdig sgrib dang / klu'i dug dang gdug rtsub rnams zhi bar bsgom mo/ /thun mtshams su bzlas pa gtong bar 'dod pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' mchod rten sngon por bzhugs su gsol te/ me tog la sogs pas kyang 5mchod cing bstod la gtor ma btang ba'i las bya'o/ /tha ma'i thun la/gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /zhes bzod par gsol la/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces gshegs su gsol lo/ /bskyed pa thugs kar basbu/ mi dmigs par bsam/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ spyod lam gyi dus su skad cig mas lhar bskyed/ lus bsrung / go bgo /nang ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang / phyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo gsal gdab / 'khor lo kha sbyor bsdam / rtag tu lha'i nga rgyal gyis 7spyod lam la gnas par bya'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i blos dge ba'i las 'ba' zhig la 'bad par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags yi ge 'bru bcu bdun pa dang /las kyi phyag na rdo rje'i yi ge bcu pa la rtag tu bzlas shing nang nub bum pa la gzungs sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bsnyen pa dbul lo/ /gta' gtor la'ang de bzhin bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi tshad ni bye ba'am bdun 'bum mo/ /27—8/ /

rtags kyi mtshan ma thob nas bsnyen pa thon nas1/ nam gung la gta' gtor btang / tho rangs bum pas rang ngam slob ma la dbang bskur/ gta' bdag las kyi gnod sbyin ri rab kyi lcog la gshegs su gsol/ bum pa'i lhas bdag la rgyas gdab/ khrus byas/ dngos grub kyi rten phud lha la dbul/lhag ma dngos grub tu dmigs la rang za2/ bskyed pa bsdun/ mi dmigs par bsam/ lha rgyun du 'khor ba'i man ngag la gnas par bya'o/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi man ngag lag tu blang ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po bīr+ya tsan+d+ras 4mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/836 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉lhar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpa/la / 〈〈pe 〉7la / 4〈〈pe 〉ra/sa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rnams/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉 sa te/8 7 1〈〈pe 〉d+kurba dharmā/ 〈〈snar 〉༄za dharmā/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉dharā// 〈〈pe 〉〉dza/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉dzaḥ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras ma/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabul/ 6〈〈pe 〉(6spyota/ 〈〈snar 〉(5 snanata kṛ/ 4 〈〈sna ra 〉waspyo ta/8〈〈sna ra 〉snga cad/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉dang sbyong / kha da be ra ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sta ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sta—/ 〈〈pe 〉ra / 〈〈snar 〉〉 tar+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le kha kha/ khā hi khā nyi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya / —〈〈pe 〉〉 snan bī nā ya ga /ma hā ga ṇi/ ṭī bi tan ta/ 〈〈snar 〉(gaspyo/ bi dzā ya ga /ma hā ga rte—/ dzi bi haṃ/ ta/838 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thal / 2〈〈pe 〉7de/ 〈〈pe 〉ṅkami/ 4〈〈pe 〉7mi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bha/6〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7྅/ 7〈〈pe 〉7sa/ 8 〈〈pe 〉ṅkasu/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shaṃ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phros / 1〈〈snar 〉〉gisgo bzhi/ 〈〈snar 〉thamar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisngon ngo// 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/sa〈〈snar 〉〉gizla ba'i/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉gite/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorakhrug 〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 9〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/839 1〈〈pe 〉tha/ 2〈〈snar 〉ringo// 〈〈snar 〉thazungs nas byung / 4〈〈snar 〉'aṅge/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha /37byed845
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1616)

1690༄7/ /gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod bzhugs/hūṃ༄go/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbe+en zhing nyams dga'i gnas dag tu/ /rnal 'byor sngags kyi skyon gyur pa/ /sgra ches skyon gyur 'byung po dag /snod med gyur pas thos gyur na/ /sgra ches bar chad mthu med gyur 2/ /sgra chung snagyur na dngos grub med/ /skyen 4gyur lus kyi phrad pa nyams/ /des na sngags kyi mthu med 'gyur/ /bul zhen bzlas pa'i grangs med pas/ /dus 'das bar tregacod spyor ba 'byung / /glo dang g.yal dang dz+red pa dang / /gnyid la sogs pas bar chod na/ /des ni yi dwags bdud la sogs/ /spyo nas myur du bar gcod 'byung / /sngags kyi bsnyen pa byed dus su/ /me dang 'dra ba'i zhe sdang gis/ /sngags kyi 'bras bu sreg par byed/ /kun nas dkris pa'i 'dod chags kyis/ /yon tan rgyu rnams 'ching bar byed/ /mun pa lta bu'i gti mug gis/ /dngos grub ster ba 37—848

rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sgang bu lta bu'i nga rgyal gyis/ /dngos grub chu 'dra rtse la min//sngags kyi yon tan sprin 'dra la/ /phrag dog rlung gis 'thor bar byed/ /dngos grub bye ma'i rgyun 'dus 1pa'ang / /brtson 'grus rdo rje'i brag med na/ /le lo'i dba' 2rlabs chen po 'khrug /dngos grub bar du gcod pa bcu/ /lnga las 'byung bas lnga bcu ste/ /mi dge bcu zhes gsungs pa yin/ /ma byin len dang srog gcod g.yem/ /tshig 'khyal ngag rtsub phra ma rdzun/ /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta/ /dge bcu'i bar du gcod pa ste/ /yang dag don gyi sgra zhes bshad/ /'di ltar dngos grub kun bral bas/ /sngags kyi 'bras bu 'dod pas spang / /de spangs 'bras bu myur du 'thob/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod me dpung la/ /bsam gtan rlung gis sbar gyur na/ /sdig pa stobs can mi bzad pa'i/ /ljan ljin thams cad sreg par byed/ /bzlas brjod me yi rgyun 'dra yang / /bsam gtan bral bas mi 'grub ste/ /sdig pa chu dang 'dra bas gsod/ /de bas bsam gtan ldan par bya/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhes gsungs pas/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sgur bsgoms te4/ /phyi dang 5shin tu nang dag dang / /dgug dang gdon dang yang dag dang / /o gyi don dang la sogs pa/ /de la dmigs nas bzlas par bya/ /gang zhig don 'di med gyur pas / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas gyur pa/ /mun la bye ma'i gser phye tshol / /mi 'dod 'du yi 'dod pa min/ /slob dpon chen po bīr+ya tsan+d+ras 6mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi 7bzlas brjod rdzogs so// //37—8 49

1691༄khya/ /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/—1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ba ti rā dza tuṇ+ḍi sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig dang por 3dbe+en pa'i gnas su/ rig pa 'dzin pa des khrus bgyis te gtsang mar bgyis la/ gos gsar pa bgosabye / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing /gtsang sbra'i spyod pa dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal ba'i rnam lngas byugs la spos kyi dkyil 'khor bgyis te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gzugs sam/ mchod rten sgu gdung dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su bzhag 4ste/ spos chab kyis bkru bar bya'o/ /me tog dang bdug pa la sogs te/ mchod rdzas rnams bshams la stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la de'i rang bzhin a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yongs su bsam 5par bya'o/ /37—851

de'i 'od zer kyis bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mdun du bkug ste/ phyag btsal ba dang / mchod cing bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang zhing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba 1bsngos te gshegs su gsol/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sgu mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bskyed la/ snying rje dang byams nga/ dang / btang snyoms chen po'i ngang gis sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /na mo/ bha ga ba te/ shākya mu na naye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ tar+ya thā/ bhu dza sa ma ye/bhu dze ta thā bhu dze/ pra ba ra ju dze/ sa man+ta a ka bhu dza/ tu ru tu ru swā hā/sa/ ma ya pā lā ya swā hā/ klu mi bgrungs 4pa dam tshig mi 'tshal ba rnams slar bzlog cing bskrad pa'i phyir lan bdun brjod do/ /swa bhā ba be+e shud+dhāḥ5sarba dhan+d+raḥ swa bhā ba bi shuzlopho7haṃ zhes brjod pas de nyid kyi ngang las badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa zhes rnam pa dang bcas te hūṃ ngo bor gnas pa las de nyid yongs su gyur pa 'a/sa / rin po che 'bar ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba rnam par 'khrugs par gyur/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las ra 1dzi sri dza hūṃ zhes pas nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser gyi 'dab ma can/ rdo rje'i mchu can bdag nyid chen po'i lus 'bar ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ khro bo 'jigs su rung ba rtsal can/ rin po che tha dad pa sna tshogs dang / mu tig dang / man shel dang / gser gyis spras pa'i rgyan mgo la thogs pa/ gser gyis bklubs ྾ pa / dregs pa'i gzugs 7'gying bas blta ba/ klu chen po brgyad gdan du bcas pa/ klu mgo dgu pa rgyan du byas pa/ klu mgo gsum pa g.yas na 37—8pya2

thogs pa/ nor bu 1rin po che'i dbyig pa g.yon na thogs pa/ lus thams cad rdo rje 'bar ba gser gyi rang bzhin gshog pa'i 'dab ma brkyang bas klu rigs dbang du sdud zhepa/ g.yog 'khor nam mkha' lding gi tshogs kyis bskor ba cig 4tu bsam par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dun ti mi li mi li swā hā/ de nas brtan par byas te lus bsrung bar bya'o/ /de dang 'dra ba'i nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ yang dag par mchod cing bstod la de nyid kyi 5rten la bstem par bya'o/ /de nas ji ltar skyo / bar ma gyur gyi bar du spro ba dang / bsdu ba'i rim pa bya'o/ /de nyid gsal bar ma gyur na skyon spangs pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa be+e ge ta hūṃ hūṃ dza dza rā sri 7dza hūṃ phaṭa ces nyin gcig bzhin sngags stong ngam khri brjod do/ /nam lus kyis 8mi thub par skyo bar gyur pa'i tshe kha zas dkar po bza' bar bya ste/ yang khrus byas la bsgrub par bya'o/ /gu gul kyi dud pas bdug go/ /me tog dang /bdug pa dang / yon chab dang / mar me dang / bshos gtsang la sogs te/gtor ma'i rdzas ci 'byor pas mchod cing / yang dag par bstod nas nyan la /dge ba dang mi dge ba ston par 'gyur zhing las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur la/mchog dang thun mong thams cad sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /ci bsgo ba des byed par 'gyur ro/ /grub nas kyang rtag tu mchod par bya'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga slob dpon bīr+ya tsan+d+ras rka mdzad pa rjogs so// //37—853

1692༄ / /phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/hūṃsngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du / phyag na rdo rje'i grusgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /drag po'i stobs kyis 'dul — dka' 'dul/ /bde gshegs kun gyi thugs ngo bo/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bslab pa gsum ldan gedage slong ngam/ /dge tshul dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas pa/ /bya ba'i rgyud mos de yis bsgrub/ /gzhan gyis de lta trem yin no/ /dang por sa phyogs gtsang mar gyerang nyams dga' ba'i phyogs su/ stan bde ba la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas la/ dri dang me tog la sogs pas dkyil 'khor mdzes par byas la/ mdun du rig sngags kyi 7bdag po dang / bla ma bsams la/ ji skad gsungs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ sdig pa bshags pa dang / byed pa bsdam pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang 37—855

chub tu sems bskyed par bya/ /de nas 1swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bhā ba shusgopho4haṃ zhes lan gsum brjod pas thams cad stong par bsam mo rang sems dag pas paṃ pad+ma/ /dkar po 'dab brgyad dbus zla ba/ /dbus su hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur/ /lte ba'i dbus su hūṃ mthing ga /gyur pa bzhi pa rdo rje 'chang / /brkyang bsgum sems dpa' khros pa ste/ /mthing ga na ra'i rgyan gyis spud / /'jigs byed mgo skyes gyen du badze+es/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin me dpung 6bzhugs / /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis bsam/ /rang snying zla bar snying po dgod / /sngon du bsnyen pa sum 'bum bya/ /gsang sngags 7rgyal po 'di lan cig bzlas pas sdig pa thams cad sreg 8pa dang / thams cad srung bar byed do / /'byung po'i gdon gyis zin pa la sogs pa la bsnun na 'byer bar byed do / /kha ti rtakhas kham phor la bris te sgo la dbyangs na sri'u srung bar byed do/ / spra tshil la gzugs sor bzhi pa byas la/ de'i snying gar dgra'i ming dang sngags sbrel 5nas tsher mas kha la btsugs na phyir rgol ba'i ngag rengs par byed do/ /snying la btsugs na khros pa zhi ba dang / gsad pa'i sems kyis gsad par 'gyur ba dang / rkang lag gang la btsugs na zha bar 'gyur ba dang / rtags la btsugs na nus pa med par 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rje ngar gyi phur bu'am lcags phur la bsngags te gang la ྾bsnun pa rengs par 'gyur ro/ /mi thod la sngags bris la/ de'i nang du mi khrag gis bkang ba dur du sbas na rigs rgyud 'chad do/ /dug blugs te klu yod pa'i gnas su sbas na mdze nad kyis/ 'dzin to/ /dgra'i sgor sbas na 'byer bar byed pa dang / zhing dkyil du sbas na zhing la mi skye ba dang / phyugs lhas su sbas na mi 'phel ba dang /37—856

chur sbas na 1chu skems so/ /skyes bu mtshon gyis bsad pa'i thod pa la sngags sadang / yul lha'i ming spel la bris nas yul lha'i gnas su sbas la/ de'i thog tu phur pa la sngags mang du bzlas la yul lha'i snying gar dam du gdab/ de'i steng du tsher ma can gyi shing la gdug pa'i me btang la/ rta dang / mi dang /ba lang dang / khye dang ma he la sogs pa'i sha khrag bsregs la/ lha khyod kyi nayul 'dir thog ser phob shig /ma phebs na bskal par mi gtong ngo zhes brjod la/ phebs na rdzas rnams 'o mas bkrus 4la btang / ma phebs na gzhag /las de dag thams cad ni sngags dang ming spel ba'i dbye bas shes par bya'o/ /gsang sngags ni oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa che ge mo hūṃ phaṭa/ gzhan yang gong gi gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar ming 'ba' zhig bris la/ mchod rten nag po mtho gang ba'i nang du bcug la/ thong bzed kyi 'og tu maṇ+ḍal byas la gzhag /de nas dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam/ dge bsnyen phyag na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa sngags bzlas 5pa po bzhi yan chad kyis dben par nub bco lngar nam gung la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla zhing bskor bar bya/ bcu drug pa la bskor bar 6bzlog la gzugs bsregs na/ ji skad sngags dang spel ba bzhin lo las mi 'da'o/ /ser ba la sogs pa bzlog pa la 'khor lo la bri ba'am rnga la'o/ /g.yu 'a du 'jug na ral gri la so gas nga 'o/ /nad thams cad la chu dang yungs kar la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'di'i yon tan ni brjod par mi nus so/ /phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po shradhe ka ra warmas mdzad pa sdogs so// //37—857

༄ / /rten 'brel gyi srung ba bzhugs/hu‘ ༄go/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ klu rigs lnga la dug lnga ste/ /'gro ba gzhan la gnod pa byed / /gnod pa'i mtshan nyid 'di lta ste/ /brag bar grog po gting rings dang 2/ /ri phug dog dang sgo dog mor/ /mi shong bzhin du 'tshang ba dang / /lha khang khang hrul nyams mi dga'/ /chu dang 'dam rdzab zag pa ngan/ /g.yag dang ba glang ra lug dang / /ri dwags gcan gzan khyi yis 'tshe/ /gzar ba'i ri la 'dzeg 'bab rmi/ /lus dang shes pa lci ba dang / /gnyid che sems skyo snang glu len/ /spro thung snying mi 5dga' ba 'ong / /bcom ldan 'das kyis 6bka' stsal pa/ /de dag bsrung dang gso bya'i phyir/ /7rdzas kyi spyor ba bstan par bya/ /thun mong sprur ba bshad bya ba/ /ri dwags lte dri 'dre gsod chu/ /nags kyi rtsi dang rtsi bo che/ /dri chen nya yi mkhris pa dang / /byi 37byed859

sku bdun du sbyar ba yis1/ /klu gnyan sa bdag nag mo dkor2/ /'byung po rnams kyis mi tshugs shing / /mdze 'bras shu ba za kong dang / /bas ldag g.yan pa me dbal dang / /gag pa lhog pa rma rims 4dang / /tshad rims rgyu gzer 5'byung po'i nad/ /bza' dang gdags dang byugs 6dang bdugs7/ /thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i mchog /khyad par spyor ba rnam pa bzhi/ /lte dri shing kun a ru ra/ /dri chus sbyangs shing khong du btung / /skad snyan tshe ring nad skems srung / /lte dri 'dre gsod thang chu dang / /nags kyi rtsi dang rtsi bo che/ /byi sku ha la dzā 9ti dang / /a mṛ ta sbyar ba bcang ba'o/ /lte dri 'dre gsod ru rta nag1 /bdud rtsi rgya tshil sa tshil dang / /byi sku ha la mi phag 5bcud / /byug pa'i rdzas su bshad pa yin/ /rus chen mnan la bdug pa bya//nyi ma'i 'od la mun pa bzhin/ / jo bo rje dang / rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur / / // 37byed860

༄ga /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/she ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi byesā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i khro rgyal skyon kun las rgyal ba/ /rnam dag byang chub sems can don mdzad pa/ /gos sngon phyag na rdo rje la btud de / /de yi sgrub thabs sems can phan phyir bshad/ /'di la lhag par dbang ba'i sngags pa ni/ /snying rje yis ni yid ni gcugs gyur cing / /lhag par mos pa brtan po'i yid can ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam pas rab tu brgyan / /dkon mchog gsum la gcig tu skyabs su song / /bla ma'i rjes gnang thob cing yon tan ldan/ /rang 'dod lha dang bla ma dbyer med lha/ /shin tu brtson ldan dbang du gyur pa yis/ /snga bar langs te snying gar nyi ma la/ /hūṃ yig sngon po bung ba lta bu'i 'od/ /'od gsal ba ni blo ldan gyis bltas 4nas//37—862

kha la sogs pa rab tu dag par bya/ /tsan+dan a kar dzā 4 ti e la dang / /rams dang so ba shing gi lo ma yis/ /bsres pa'i dri zhim chu yis byugs pa la/ /me tog sngon pos nye bar brgyan byas te/ /sha khar 37 dri sogs bdug pa dag gis ni—/ /bdug cing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa yis / /nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'jigs pa rnam spongs te/ /yangs shing 'jam pa'i stan la rab 'dug nas/ /de nas khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /bdag nyid khro rgyal gtso bo dag tu ni/ /rnam par bsgoms nas g.yas kyi sdegs mdzub la/ /re yig dmar po rnam par bsgom par bya/ /de nas de las byung ba'i nyi ma la/ /hūṃ yig sngon po las ni byung ba yi/ /mi bzad pa yi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /'od zer rab tu 'phros pa 4 bsam par bya/ /de nas phyogs bcu dag tu ni/ /khros pas sngags ni brjod bya zhing / /go rims ji bzhin se gol gyis/ /gnas bdag rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya/ /de la gnas la sogs pa bsrung ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sarba bispyo lkuha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā zhes bya'o/ /de nas sngon gsungs nyid kyis ni/ /dri zhim chu yis dkyil 'khor yang / /byas nas me tog dgram par bya / /ar+ghaṃ 6la sogs hūṃ bzlas bya/ /de nas rang gi snying gar 7'od zer gyi phreng ba'i lcags kyus bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun kyis ༄ nam mkha'i phyogs su nye bar gnas par lhag par mos te/ de rnams la yang dag pa'i dad pa nye bar bskyed de/ de kun — bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun bya'o/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gus rgya che'i mchod pa yis/ /bde gshegs rnams la nye bar mchod/ /'jigs pas de mdun ma 37—863

lus pa'i/ /sdog pa byas pa bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas sogs bgyis bsod nams la/ /deng 'dir rjes su yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad du/ /bde gshegs rnams la bskul bar bgyi/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /de rnams yun ring 1gnas gsol 'debs/ / gsung mchog 2rang bzhin bsod nams dang / /dge ba gzhan yang bdag gis ni/ /gang de thams cad byang chub dag /gcig tu bsdus nas bsngo bar bgyi / /de nas skyabs su 'gro 4bya ste/ dus gsum 5'byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / /jeg chen dam chos 'di dang ni/ /dge 'dun sangs rgyas sras tshogs la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /de nas bdag nyid dbul bya ste/ /bdag nyid 6thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul bar bgyi / /bdag kyang rab tu bzhes mdzod la/ /ji ltar dgyes pa bzhin du spyor/ /de nas byang chub tu 8sems bskyed par bya ste/ ngo mtshar che mchog byang chub ni/ /bla med dag ni thob nas su/ /shin tu mthar thug mya ngan 'das/ /'gro ba myur du dgod par bgyi/ /de nas lam ni bstan 9bya ste/ /gong 'dir rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /snying rje mchog gi bstan 7bya ba/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med / /mchog gyur snying po bsten 1 par bkyi/ /de nas snying rje bsgom byas te/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma brgal ba'i/ /'gro ba sam lus rnams bltas nas/ /sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa yi/ /snying rje mthar thug bsgom par bya/ /de nas stong nyid bsgom bya ste/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa mi ldan pa'i/ /ma dpyad dngos po yod ma yin/ /de phyir 'gro kun stong pa nyid/ /gnyis su med pa bsgom par bya/ /de nas o shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra —swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho྾haṃ zhes bya 37—86 /

—ba 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rgyu mthun pa las yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rnam pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de la lo skyes ser po ste/ /mthar ni ma lus rdo rjes mtshan//gru bzhi pa la rab rgyas pa'i/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de nas baṃ 1skyes dkar po ni/ /zlum po bum pas mtshan pa ste/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor zlum po de/ /steng du gnas pa yang dag bsam/ /de nas ram̐ 2gyes dmar po ni/ /gru gsum ro gyis rtse mtshan pa/ /'bar zhing 'phro ba steng du ni/ /me yi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de nas yam̐ 4skyes sngon po ni/ /sbyar gzhu lta bu 'od 'bar ba/ /ba dan dang bcas mnyam gzhag pas/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor blta bar bya/ /'byung ba bzhi ni yang dag gyur/ /rgyas 'phro gzhal yas khang pa ste/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ni/ /thar pa'i grong mchog bsgom par bya/ /grub bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /mchod snam 5bzhi yis yongs su bskor/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes /rdo rje thig gis rab tu bskor/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /bla re 6rnga yab gre long dang / /gos dang me tog phreng gis brgyan/ /mchod pa lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /'dod yon lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /glu dang gar sogs mchod pa ni/ /lha rdzas bsnams pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /ba dan rtse mo rlung bskyod pa'i/ /dril bu dag ni phyogs sgor 'khrol/ /kha dog lnga yi 'od tshogs kyis7/ /ma lus pa yi khams ni gsal/ /de yi lte bar pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs 'dab ma ge sar bcas / /dga' bo la sogs klu brgyad ni/ /gdan du rnam par bsam par bya / /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi ru/ /de bzhin gdan ni bsgom bya ste/ /37—86pya

sdebyed——pad+ma 1'jigs byed stag dang ni/ /chu srin ma 2ni rim bzhin no/ /de nas phyi 'phar bzhi po la/ /ro langs dasngon po bris pa yis 4/ /dkar dang nag dang sngo skya dang / /de bzhin ser skya bsgom 5par bya/ /de nas dbus gdan shes rab ni/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug ngo bo nyid/ /rab rgyas zla ba bsgom bya ba/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng sum cu rtsa bzhi yi/ /gsal byed snying rje'i bdag nyid ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od gsal rnam bsams 6pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /de steng baṃ gyis 7hūṃ byas pa/ /yang dag skyes las rtse lnga pa'i/ /rdo rje lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan/ /so sor kun rtog 8ye shes bsgom/ /hūṃ las sangs rgyas spro bya ste/ /basbus te de la de rnams bzhugs9/ /yang dag 'dus nas dbyer med pa/ /de ni bya ba grub par bsgom/ /zla ba nyis 1 mtshan hūṃ yig las/ /skyes pa'i rang nyid gos sngon can/ /rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /yun ring phyag na rdo rje bsam/ /dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'greng / /khro gnyer spyan ni dmar ba ste/ /mche ba gcigs pa yi ni zhal/ /glog gi ljags kyis 'jigs byed pa/ /'jig dus rlung gi dbugs dang ni/ /hūṃ yig 'don pa yi ni zhal/ /ha har dgod —pa rtsub cing drag /rgya mtsho chen po lto che bas/ /pad+ma dbu la rgyas par ro/ /dga' bo nyer dga' rna cha ste/ /pad+ma chen po tshangs skud do/ /dung skyong tak+ṣa lag gdub po/ /rigs ldan karko dbu rgyan slote / /lhag can nor rgyas rkang gdub po/ /phrag pa zla ba nyi mas brgyan/ /seng ge rkang brgyad pags pa'i gos/ /rdo rje lcags sgog rked par dkris/ /brang 'go chen po gsol bas so/ /rang mdog rdo rje rtse gsum ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /rdo rje dbyug chen mi bzad pa/ /g.yon gyi phyag na 37—866

bsnams pa'o/ /nyi ma'i gdan dang rgyab rten brag /g.yon brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /de nas dbyug pa'i steng bsam pa/ /mkha' la 'gro bdag bya khyung ste/ /khros zhing 1lus ni che la dpa'/ /kha gdangs sna tshogs mdog can no/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis sbrul rgyal po/ /za bzhin pa ni nyid du byed / /zlum zhing dmar la 'bar ba'i spyan/ /'jigs shing kun tu seng seng lta / /de nas snying gar nyis 5mtshan hūṃ/ /de nyid 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de bzhin spyi bo mgrin pa snying / /oṃ āḥhūṃ yongs 6bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni spyor ba dang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas snying gar nyis 7gnas pa'i/ /sa bon las byung zla ba ni / /'jigs byed la sogs brgyad la dgod—/ /de rnams nyi gnas de bzhin no/ /de la zla nyi spyor ba las/ /de bzhin sa bon brgyad du gyur/ /hūṃ hūṃ sum̐ kuñja shaṃ re saṃ/ /thig le nā da ldan rim bzhin/ /de rnams yongs 7su gyur pa las 1/ mtshan ma brgyad ni go rims bzhin/ /'og nas 'byung zhing sgrub pa pos1 / /rang rang sa bon yang dag ldan/ /de nas zla ba nyi ma dang / /mtshan ma sa bon las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor ba ni go rims bzhin/ /rang rang gdan gnas bsam par bya/ /de la 1 khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ /kun du sngo ba 5'bar ba'i sku/ /rtsa zhal gnag cing dkar ba ni/ /g.yas pa'i zhal te spyan mig dmar/ /g.yon zhal dmar zhing sha rgyas la/ /cung zhig mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ /stag lpags gos gyon ྾khros pa ste/ /nyi gnas rnam par 'phro ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje ral gri lcags kyu rgo/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /dril bu zhags pa mi mgo ni/ /g.yas las cig shos phyag na bsnams/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs gnas pa/ /37—867

shar gyi gdan la bsam 1par bya/ /sgeg cing lang tsho dang ldan zhing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bsam/ /lho phyogs gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /nag po chen po de nas blta/ /spyan gsum po ni dmar ba ste/ /gnag cing khros pa mche ba gcigs/ /skra ni kham pa gyen du 'greng / /gang yang rung ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /sbrul mchog mchod phyir thogs pa ste/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /rtse mo rno zhing 'jigs pa yi4/ /tsan+dan phur 5shing g.yas na bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na 6zhags pa ni/ /bsnams shing mi bzad pa yi gzugs/ /nub kyi gdan kyi zla ba la/ /klu yi rgyal po ba ru ṇa / /dkar po gdengs ka bdun 9gyis sgeg /mnyam pa'i zhabs kyis yang dag gnas / /sdong po dang bcas pad+ma phye/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /de nas g.yon pa'i phyag gis ni/ /phyag byed tshul du bsgom par bya/ /byang gi gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug rnam thos sras/ /ser zhing bzang la mchog tu dga'/ /lha rdzas rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'phro ba/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /gser gyi ne+e'u le kha 'og bltas/ /g.yon pa yi ni phyag na bsnams/ /rtag tu bsam pa yongs rdzogs byed/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /srun ni kun du dmar zheng che/ /lto ba che zhing spom pa bsam/ /de nas phyi 'phar bsam bya ste/ /shar gyi gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /srog za dag ni che zhing gnag /gri kodang sdigs mdzub kyi ni phyag /lho phyogs gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /de nas dbugs 'phrog pa ni blta / /drur ba lta bu ljang zhing ring / /pags pa dang ni sdigs mdzub phyag /nub kyi gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /dmar po khrag za bsgom par bya/ /sbal ba'i khrag 37—868

gis gang ba yi/ /thod pa dag ni phyag na bsnams/ /byang gi gdan gyi nyi ma la/ /sha za ba ni rnam par bsam/ /thal ba'i mdog can dri dang zhag1 /phyag bsnams 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di ni stobs dang ldan/ / bang mtho 2grims pa yi ni lus/ /mche ba gcigs shing mi sdug pa/ /sma ra smin ma mgo skyes ldan/ /ha har bzhad bcas ljags na'adril ba/ /zlum zhing dmar ba yi ni spyan/ /smin ma 'khyog 4cing gsus po che/ /'jig 5dus kyi ni me yi 'od / /drag po stag lpags kyi ni gos/ /thod pa'i rus pas rnam par brgyan//zhal gcig phyag gnyis khros pa ste/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis gnas/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes sogs nas/ /mdangs 'phrog ma yi mthar thug par//snyeng gar sa bon gdan mtshan ma/ /de nyid gsum dang ldan pa bsam/ /gzhan yang yongs sdogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngags rig pa yis bltas nas su/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo yongs su dgug /de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag bzhugs/ /hūṃ gis bgegs ni bskrad bya ste/ /bsang gtor la sogs sbyar bar bya/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ6sa dgug pa dang / /gzhug 7dang bcing dang dgyes par ni/ /cho gas dam tshig ye shes ni/ /gcig tu gyur par rnam par bsam/ /de nas snying sngags 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha'i rgyal ba bkug nas su/ /bzhugs gsol me tog la sogs mchod/ /brtul zhugs dbang bskur gsol ba gdab/ /de nas ye shes chus gang ba'i/ /rgyal bdag rin chen bum pa yis/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor bcas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bsgur bsgom/ /de nas dbang bsgur chur gyur pas/ /kun gyi dbu la mi bskyod de/ /ral pa'i dbu 37—869

rgyan gyis/ brgyan nga/'i/ /mig sman lta bur 1bsgom par bya/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon 'od/ /byung ba'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /yang dag mchod bzhin bdag nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag ldan par bsam/ /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor pa kun gyi 2glu gsum gyes dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug gi bdag nyid la bstod bzhin par blta'o/ /gsang ba'i bdag po gtso chen po/ /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra ba'i 'od / /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje'i sgu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gsang ba'i bdag po gtso chen po/ /sangs rgyas gzungs 4dang 'dra ba'i ngag /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gsang ba'i bdag po gtso chen po/ /sangs/ rgyas thugs dang mtshungs pa'i yid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i 5rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis pa'o/ /de nas rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs kyis ‘'gro ba'i don byed pa 7la rjes su gnas par bya ste/ snying ga'i 'od kyis bsgul te dkyil 'khor pa kun gyis 'od spyo zhing rang gi lus la sdud par bsam par bya'o/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rang gi 'od yongs su spros te / sems can gyi don byas shing rang nyid la rang nyid kyi 'od ma lus par bsnyu bar bya'o/ /zhes/ nga/ ni las rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum nga/'o / /gzhan yang bsgoms pas skyo na ngal bso zhing 9yongs su bzlas par bya ste / sngags kyi yi ge phreng ba nying rkaka'i nyi ma la dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par go rims bzhin du rnam par bltas nas/ sgra khro bo'i rkangag gis rab tu bzlas so/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa mgal me'i 'khor lo'i rim pas gzhan nyid kyang ngo / /ji srid 37—870

mi skyo ba'i 1bar du bla ma'i man ngag gis bzlas so/ /sngags ni tar+ya thā/ sgo bho pan nā ga a bye 2pa ta ye/ i rda byā dze+e ba ra dha ra sha rī re/ badz+ra pā ṇi z-i da yo/ yaḥs ma ti kra ma tha/ u 4da dzā/ bha bi byu ti5/ tar+ya thā/budhe budhe/ bi bubye bi budhe/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ha ra ha ra nā ga māṃ— / pra ha ra pra ha ra/ nā ga māṃ / stson+da stson+da nā ga dṛ 9da yā ni/ bhin+da byen+da nā ga marma ṇi/ bi sa ma da nā ga sha rī re/ bi sgo ṭa ya nā ga ya nā ga ya rkatar+ya thā/hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇa saya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā gā u dā ya phaṭa/ ṭī dze+e bā sa nā ya ྾phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la/ pa ra kra mā ya ྾phaṭa/ kri tād+dhā ya 7 phaṭa / shrī tān+d+ra ru pā ya 1 phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ tā sā nā ya phaṭa/ kuṣ+ṭha ṇ+ḍid+mā ya 1 phaṭa/ pre ta bi shā tsi bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pas+thā ra bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ na sha ya na 5sha ya/ sarba bispyo/ bi nā 6sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba sha t+t+waṃ saṃ gha bi nā sha ka rā ya 9phaṭa/ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā zhes bya'o/ /bzlas pa dang bsgoms pas skyon sngags pas skyo ba yongs su spang ba'i phyir lus gso ba'i cho ga bya ste/ bdud rtsi lnga zhu gang ba yi/ /spyi bo'i steng du zla dkyil 'khor / /oṃ yig byin rlabs bsgom par bya/ /de yi 'od zer dkar spros te / /ye shes bdud rtsi sangs rgyas la 5/ /'bad pas yang dag dgug par bya / /de dag nyid las bsgrub bya ste/ /ro gcig gnyis med dag tu bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdams pa las/ /de nas legs rgyun la babs pas/ /bdag nyid lus la sogs pa ste/ /gso bzhin par ni blta bar bya/ /de nas langs par 'dod na ni/ /smon lam dag kyang gdab par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje 27byed871

gos sngon can/ /go 'phang myur du thob par shog /bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba ni/ /ma lus pa yis thob par shog /de nas de nyid gsum brjod pas//rang snying sa bon rang dkyil 'khor/ /bsdus te lha yi rnam pa yi/ /nga rgyal dag gis gnas par bya/ /nyin mo thun gnyis rnal 'byor pas/ /rang nyid sa bon las byung ba'i/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor kun/ /sngon bzhin du ni rab tu bya/ /de ltar nub kyi thun mtshams su/ /'on kyang khyad par yo/ngas 1gyur te/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /'khor lo rang gi gnyug mar basbu/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad2/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngoyogrub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'di ru byon par mdzod/ /muḥ zhes bya'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ /gnyug mar dkyil 'khor bsdu bya ste/ /mal stan klu ru bsgom bya zhing / /blo ldan seng ge bzhin du nyal / /sngon gsungs klu ni gsum po yis4/ /tho rangs bdag la bskul bzhin par/ /klu dbang rang nyid bsam par bya/ /langs nas sngon gyi zhag bzhin du/ /bsgom pa'i rim pa rab tu bya/ /dngos su thun ni so so la ji srid dngos grub gyur de bzhin/ /bgegs rnams nye bar zhi don du/ /sngags rig nga/ yis thun la ni5/ /ji lta'i gdams ngag gis sbyangs te/ /cho ga bzhin du gtor ma sbyin/ /rgyal bas dbang bskur bar 6bsams nas/ /rang nyid rnam par dag 'dod bya/ /rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod nas su/ /blo ldan byams pas gsol bar bsam/ /rkang 'og sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /hūṃ yig las ni byung bar bsam/ /de yi steng du hūṃ skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa bsam/ /37—872

de steng 'bar ba'i rdo rje yi/ /gur ni hūṃ las byung ba ste/ /bgegs kun zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bsgom pa rnal 'byor pa yis 1bya/ /sgrub po'i bsgom dang rmi lam dang 2/ /mtshan ma rnyed gyur de nas ni/ /stegs bu rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lha rnams kun la mchod par bya/ /ri bo dbe+en pa skyed tshal dang //rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang chu bo'i ngogs/ /yid 'ong byang chub sems dpa'i 4gzhi/ /ma mo'i khang pa gnyug gzhi 'am/ /gzhan yang sa yi cha la ni/ / nye bar 5'tshe ba bral ba ru/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga'i 6phyir/ /sngon gsungs dri yi 7chag chag gdab/ /bcu drug lo lon mig yangs ma / /lus rgyas mgo skyes gnag /pa yi/ /khro zhing sna ni nyag gyur pa'irka/ /bu mo blo ldan gyis bsgrub bya/ /blangs te chu dang 'o ma dang / /dri zhim chu dang ldan pa yis/ /khrus byas gos sngon sar pa ni/ /de la yongs su bskon par bya/ /me tog sngon po'i phreng ba dang / /skra yi zhags pas dkri bar bya/ /dpral bar thig le byas nas su/ /de la lcags kyus 1 bri bar bya/ /lcags kyu rtse mo rnon po ni/ /de nas lag pa g.yas su spyin/ /mkhrang zhing gsar du byas pa yis/ /snod ni de yi g.yon du sbyin / /bsrung ba'i sngags kyi bzlas pa yis / /de la yungs kar brdeg par bya / /'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags 'di ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod par bya//de la 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi —ye sarba arja sid+dhi 7ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /de nas sngags pas rngan byin te/ /thun mong sbyin pas 'di mnyes bya/ /bden bral mtshams gnas bzang po yi sa ni 'di yis blang bar bya/ /zhi ba'i sngags ni brjod par bya/ /sa ni nag po brko bar bya/ /phyung ste snod du blugs sanas su/ /rung ba'i gnas su blangs la 37—873

ba'ag /de nas/ sa ni blangs pa la/ /dri zhim chu bzlas der gdab bya/ /mtho gang dang bcas sra ba yi/ /khru gang mtho ba'i stegs su dge/ /sa ni nag po dang bcas pa'i/ /sngon gsungs dri yis byug par bya/ /stegs bu me tog sngon po yis/ /dus gsum du ni nye bar brgyan/ /stegs bu'i 1'og gi sa la ni/ /de nas gos sngon rnal 'byor gyis / /ting 'dzin gsum ni rab byas te/ /bum par lhag par gnas par bya/ /nag nog rtsa ba med mchu 'phyang / /mgrin ring lto ba che ba la/ /'bras dang 'bras bu gsum 'o ma/ /rin chen sman dang yang dag ldan/ /me tog 'bras bu ldan gyur pa'i/ /yal ga dag gis kha brgyan te/ /sngon po mgul bar gos ni sngo/ /sna tshogs me tog dag gis brgyan/ /gsam gtan dkyil 'khor yang dag ldan/ /rjes su mthun pa'i gdan la gnas/ /ji srid brgya rtsa brgyad du gnas4/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal dgu yi rim pa ni/ /de nas stegs bu ngag la bya/ /lha yi gnas su yang dag gnas/ /dkyil 'khor rgon po 'phro 5zhu las/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor dge ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor steng du yang dag blta/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bkug nas su/ /yang dag mchod de rab tu gzhug /bcing dang dgyes bya'i cho ga yis/ /yang ni ar+ghaṃ 6la sogs spyin/ /sna tshogs mchod nga/sa mchod nas ni/ /bstod dang sngags ni rab tu bzla/ /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /de ltar nyin re bzhin du bya/ /sngags pas bzlas pa khri phrag gcig /nyi ma re rer 7yongs su bkang / /de ltar byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /mngon spyod las ni thams cad du/ /des ni nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyon rnams thams cad zad 'gyur te/ /yon 37—87 /

tan thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /dug dang nye ba'i dug dang ni/ /klu yi dug ni med par 'gyur/ /'jigs pa brgyad ni 1nyams 'gyur zhing / /rims dang nad rnams de bzhin no/ /mi ma yin ni 'bros 'gyur zhing / /rgyal po rkun po dbang du 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal skal ngan dbul ba dang / /rtsod pas 2sdig pa bsags pa rnams/ /mi 'dod pa yi sbyor ba yang / / rim gyis zad cing zil gnon 'gyur/ /g.yang 4dang tshe dang legs stobs dang / /rig pa dag dang 'khor gyi 5rigs/ /phyugs dang nor ni thams cad dang / /nor dang 'bru yang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang spyor ba ni yang dag par bskul ba rtsa ba'i sngags ni 6chu la lan gsum bzlas te/ shar phyogs su kha bltas pas g.yon pa'i lag pa phyag byed pa ltar byas te sngags pas khyor ba gsum btung bar bya'o/ /zla ba drug gi nang du shes rab dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sor lnga brkos pa'i 'og gis dkar po dang / 'bras zan la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ rkun po la mngon par phyogs te gtor na rkun po rengs par byed do/ /mi ma yin pas bzung ba la de bzhin du de'i dpung pa la yongs su bzlas te skud pa sngon pos bcings na pol bar 'gyur ro/ /byi la 'dug pa'i sa la de bzhin du yongs su bzlas te dri 8chu rma bya'i sgro'i chun pos gtor te/ grub pa'i don du chag chag byas na bye la rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ba glang 9gi ske 'am rwa la de bzhin du 7bzlas te/ sgud pa sngon po la mdud pa brgya byas na phyugs kyi nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi mang po 'chi ba'i sar sngar bzhin du bzlas pa'i dri chu la 'bu ka'i gshog pas gtor zhing yungs kar ser po gtor na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /khrag dang nya dang / sha dang 'bras dang /37—87pya

mon sran gre'u 1bsres pa'i zan dang / kha dog kun dang til dang / spos dang / mon sran gre'u btsos pa la sogs pa sa'i kham skyong phor 2gang ba la de bzhin du bzlas te/ gtor ma de gang gi khyim du gtor ba de rtsa rgyud 'chad do/ /rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma las spros pa'i rab tu gtum pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis khams gsum du gtogs pa'i dug bsregs bzhin par rnam par bltas la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i rab tu dkar ba'i 'od zer gyi bdud rtsis rgyas par snang bzhin par blta bar bya'o/ /khams gsum gyi dug nyams par byed pa'i spyor ba'o/ /nam mkha' la bskyod pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la khaṃ 4ser po rnam par bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las mdog ser ba'i dug gi 5 phung por nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma las byung ba'i dug gi 'od zer gyi tshogs kyi zeg ma'i rnam pa rmugs 6pa lta bu thong ste/sems can gyi 'jig rten dang snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis khyab par bya'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba dug tu bya ba'i spyor ba'o/ /gal te yang dug de med par byed 'dod na/ gong du bstan pa'i sbyor bas bya'o/ /dug bslang ba'o/ /klu 7rnams tshar bcad par 'dod na/ klu'i gnas su sngags de nyid khro bo'i tshig gis bzlas par bya'o/ /klu 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi 'bros na de rnams spyi bo dang mig 'gags so/ /mtsho yang skam mo/ /gzhan yang chu'i skye bo 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /klu la sogs pa tshar bcad pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i sngags kyi sbyor ba brjod par bya ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ/ tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā —pa ta ye/ a na le/ pa ra le / hūṃ ru ra swā hā zhes pa rta'adis ske tshe'i mar khu la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/37—876

de'i 1rkang pa la byugs na 2dpag tshad bcu ru 'gro zhing song yang mi 'chad do/ /rkang pa'i nye bar spyod pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ oṃ kā me ka ma ya ka badz+re ni ka ma la yan/ kā ma bā se ni ka me 4shwa ri ni ming ti ka 5ma badz+re ni/ ā nā ya la ghu che ge mo/ me ba sha ma 6nā ya swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gro ga 7la tshon sna ma lus pas sor brgyad kyi tshad phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis na sa bon gyis gang ba'i shing thog dang / rdo rje bsnams pa'i rdo rje 'dod ma bris la snying gar dri zhim po'i me tog la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing snying gar dus gsum du brdeg par bya'o/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum na phyag rgya'i spyor bas brgya byin gyi bu mo yang 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /de la phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis phan tshun sbyar te/sor mo'i rtse mo kha blta bur byas te/ rdo rje'i rnam par mjeb chen gnyis sdigs mdzub gnyis la sbyar bar bya'o/ /dbang dang dgug pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na maḥ9tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa 7ta ye/ tar+ya thā/ na maḥ tsaṇ+ḍi yak+ṣi ni/ i pospru ni/ tsā be+e sha hi sa da dzā me da ma hā 1 swā hā zhes bya bas shar kyi grwar phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs kyi mdun du stong phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o / /de nas phyag na rdo rje la ci 'byor pas mchod pa byas la/ sngags brgya brgya'i bar du bzlas pa byas la nyal bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe gang bsams pa de 'grub pa'am mi 'grub pa de nyid rjod —par byed do/ /rmi lam brtag pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ5tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/oṃ bā rā tīlo/ ma hā bā rā ṭī—/ badz+ra bā rā tī 8/ ma hā badz+re/ ma nu ṣa badz+ra/ ā be sha 1 ya/ de ba z-i da ya/ ā be sha ya/ yak+ṣa z-i da ya/37—877

ā be+e sha —1ya/ gan+dharba z-i da ya/ ā be+e sha ya/5 rda t+tha ma rda t+tha/ ā 3be+e sha ya / ā 4be sha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ gardza gardza/ thor+ṇa gh+rar+ṇas / narda narda/shaṃ pa shaṃ pa/ ā 6be+e sha ya/ ā dza be sha ya/ bhū bye/mo pa ta ya/ sidzha tsutsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes bya bas arka dkar po'i shing la sor brgyad kyi tshad la mi'i rkapags pa bsnams 71pa'i rdo rje phag mo mdun du bzhag ste/'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa mubya'o/ /de nas nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes —brgyad nas nub gsum du smyung —bar gnas pas/ lha mo'i mdun du bum pa'i chu la brgya phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags pa mubyas la/ me tog gi phreng ba yang dag par bzhag ste/ ji srid rang nyid la ma babs sakyi bar de srid 7du bzlas pa bya'o / /de nas dgos dgu byed pa'i g.yog pos bum pa'i chus khrus byas la/me tog gi phreng ba rked pa la dkris na de nas bab pas 8legs par gnas par 1 'gyur ro/ /de nas bzung ste mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad la phebs par 'gyur ro/ /spra tshil dang myos byed kyi rang bzhin gyi sbrul la brgya phrag brgyad mngon par bzlas te/ lha che ge mo shig ces kyang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sbrul gyis 1'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /chu bos bar du chod pa'i gong yang 'dzin to sa/ /de yang gzhan gyes 'tsho ba'i nus pa med do/ /gzhan yang 'tsho bar 'dod na bzung ba'i mi lha mo'i mdun du khrus byas la/ lha mo 'o mas khrus byas na de nas sos par 'gyur ro/ /tsha ba gsum kyis lho ba bkang ba'i spra tshil gyi rang bzhin gyi gzugs byas te/ myos byed kyi tsher mas phug la seng ldeng gi me la nyin zhag bdun du dus gsum gdungs na gang gi ming nas gzung 5ba de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar pho ba ris dkar po'i sbyin sreg zhag bdun du byas na de 37—878

1695༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/kye ༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi sā dha ṭaṃ/ bod skad du/phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes bcu drug lon/ /ye shes mnga' bdag gzhan snang mdzad/ /lcang lor gsang ba btul nas bzhugs/ /dpal ldan de la phyag 'tshal te/ /'gro ba bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis sgrub thabs 'di brtsam mo5/ /de la dang por dbang thob pa'i/ /dam gnas rigs ldan rnal 'byor des/ /nyams dga'i gnas su bsam gtan bya/ /khrus byas bde ba'i stan 'dug nas/ /sems can don phyir dran bya'o/ /rang nyid zla steng hūṃ las ni/ /'od 4spros bla ma sangs rgyas sogs/ /nam mkhar dmigs la phyag 'tshal mchod/ / sdig pa chobashags sogs rmebadun pa bsam/ /de nas byams sogs bsgoms nas ni⑩/ /brtan g.yo srid gsum stong par bsam/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma 37—883

kopho1haṃ / de nas tweḥdang saṃ yig las/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dkyil 'khor/ /de steng t+t+waṃ bsam de las 'od/ /'od 'phros gur dang sa gzhi sogs/ /dra ba ra ba rdo rje 'bar/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rdo rjer gyur/ /de las sgur gyur sprin dkar mdog /rdo rje gtum po 'jigs pa che/ /g.yas pa rdo rje thugs kar gsor / /g.yon pas 2khu tshur dku ru brten/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bas mdzes/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan ldan zhing / /ye shes sku la dri mas stong / /gnas gsum oṃ sogs byin gyis brlabasan/ /de nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las ni/ /'od 4'phros ye shes sems dpa' dgug /mchod bstod byas la dgug gzhug bya / /de nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i thugs kar phog /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /bum chu thogs pa'i lha mo yis/ /dbang bsgur dag byas rigs bdag po/ /mi bskyod rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin / /de nas hūṃ las lha mo sprul/ /mchod pa kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /yon chab me tog bdug spos 5snang / /dri dang lha bshos sgra yis mchod/ /bstod la thugs kar nyi gdan la/ /hūṃ bsams sngags kyi 'od zer tshul/ /bskor ba'i tshul kyis bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dubyen+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams rab bkug nas/ /gtor ma bdud rtsir bsams la bsngo/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā dzā/ ār+ya nud parja tāta o s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tshim par byas la gnas su gtang / /oṃ ā hūṃ muḥ de nas ye shes sems dpa' dbye/ /mchod bstod bzod gsol smon lam gdab/ /gshegs pa'i sngags kyis gshegs su gsol / /dam tshig sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /spyod lam kun du gnas 37—884

par bya'o/ /gzungs sngags phan yon ji ltar gsungs pa kun/ /'di la mi gnas de dag 'byung ba min/ /bdag gis bsgrub pa'i nus pa de med kyang / /snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'dus pa 'di bshad pas/ /sgu gsum yid bzhin rin chen thob par shog /phyag na rdo rje gos dkar po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //lo tsā 1ba rin chen bzang bos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan /883 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈snar 〉d+ku mi bzhugs pas 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉rang dpe bsdur byas yo da la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sgru ba thabs bzhugs so / /2〈〈pe 〉ra rtsams so/ 〈〈pe 〉skabangs/ 4〈〈pe 〉mdzad/ /zer/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉gisdigapa/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra yan lag 7〈〈pe 〉ra sgom pa ste/884 1 〈〈pe〉ṅkapho/ 2 〈〈pe 〉8// 〈〈pe 〉tharlab/ 4〈〈pe 〉glod/ zer/ 5〈〈pe 〉thadus spos me tog 6〈〈pe 〉〉dharma/ rna/ ar+ya a nud pa/na nad twad/885 1 〈〈pe 〉tsha/37—885
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1622)37wa 886

1696༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal bi byeḥ ra/ bod skad du/phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje dang / /bla ma la gus phyag 'tshal te/ sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga brtsam/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i don du dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di bsdu bar bya'o/ /de la sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ni sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin du bdag nyid lhar bskyed la snying po 'bum bzlas pa bya ba'am/ yang na ji srid mtshan ma thob par ma gyur gyi 4bar de srid du bsgom pa dang bzlas pa ni sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas sa'i cho ga bya ste/ gtsug lag khang ngam/kun dga' ra ba'am/ nags tshal la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su sa babe+eng ba dang / sa sbyang ba dang / sa gzung 5ba dang / sa byin gyis 37—887

brlab par byas te/ de la bslang ba ni gnas kyi bdag po la bslang ba dang /maṇ+ḍal dang dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu bya ste/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas oṃ a pra ti bi ka ra sha hūṃ dzaḥ1zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo 2gnyis brkyang la sa la reg par byas pas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ sa'i lha mo mchod pa dang / de'i 'khor lo gtor ma byin nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya ste dkyil 'khor bri / /zhes lan gsum kyi bar du brjod la/ sa byin par bsams te mchod la gshegs su gsol/ de nas sa 4sbyang ba ni drag po dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 5bya'o//'dom gang nye 'khor du lte ba nub tsam mam pus mo nub tsam brkos la gseg ma dang / gyo mo dang / rus pa la sogs pa bsal la spos chus bran la/ sa de nyid kyis bkang nas sa'i ltas brtag par bya ste/ sa sbyang ba'i cho ga'o / / de'i rjes la sa bzung ba ni gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / bla re la sogs pa bres la sgu gzugs bkram 9nas phyogs bzhir spos rgyun mi 'chad par btul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa der gtugs te / yi ge brgya pa bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya ste/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa ni sa gzung ba dang byin gyis brlab pa ste sa'i cho ga'o// //de nas bdag nyid khrus bya zhing dris byugs la/ gos sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs bgo zhing / rgyan gdags shing rdo rje dril bur 37—888

ldan pas gal te nus na smyung 1bar gnas pa'am/ ma nus na zas dkar gsum bza' bar bya'o/ /de la re zhig sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la tshogs bsags 2pa dang / srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsgom par bya ste/ de'ang yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje chen po nam mkha'i tshad dang mnyam pa khong stong bsam pa ni srung 4ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i nang du rja 5las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs dang bcas pa bskyed la/ dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum du byin gyis brlabs 6pa'i bar du byas la sa'i lha mo mchod nas gso'/ ba gdab pa'i bar du bya'o / /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs pos mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal dbus dang phyogs bzhir ni/ gos sngon can 7rigs lnga skad cig gis bsgoms la/ lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis dkyil 'khor sa bzung bas8/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes so/ /slob ma bzhi yis phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di dag go / /rdo rje gos spon rigs kyi gtso/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i sgu/ /zhe sdang chen po tshar gcod phyir/ /rdo rje rigs kyi sa bzung mdzod/ /rin chen gos sngon rigs kyi gtso/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i sku/ /nga rgyal can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rin chen rigs kyi sa bzung 7mdzod/ /pad+ma'i gos sngon rigs kyi gtso/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i sku/ /'dod 37—889

chags can rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ /pad+ma rigs kyi sa bzung 1mdzod/ /las kyi gos sngon rigs kyi gtso/ /mnyam pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i sku/ /phrag dog can rnams gdul ba'i phyir/ /las kyi rigs kyi sa bzung 2mdzod/ /ces so/ /de nas mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon par ṭa las zla ba /rkang mthil 4du sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed nas langs te sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas 5bdag lha'i sku gsal bar dmigs te/ dbus kyi gtso bo nam mkhar bteg la khro bo'i bstod pa bya'o/ /de la bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa'i rnge dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas6/ /dpa' bo — stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg 8par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod la bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i / /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin 'byer bar gyis//ci ste nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis/ /bye bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /rnam par 'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /zhes bya ba dang / deng 9rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug che ge mo zhes bya bas rdzogs pa'i slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba byang chub tu rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir dang /dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhig rtsom gyis gang su rung 37—890

bas phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / gnon po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / rig 'dzin la sogs pa rgan po dang / rgan mo dang / 'khor dang / g.yog tu bcas pa 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /de ltar phyag na rdo rje'i bka' thos pas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun du 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta ༄pere zhes lan gsum brjod de/ rdo rje chen po'i gar dang / rdo rje chen po'i 'gros kyis sa gzhi lan gsum bskor zhing / rang gi lus las khro bo'i tshogs phyung la thusdang ba thams cad bskrad ( par bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ gis srung 3ba'i 'khor lo byas la/ phur bu lnga stong phyag na rdo rje smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bur bskyed nas/oṃ badz+ra kri li tī lā saya sarba bispyon tre/brnya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/dbus dang ④grwa bzhir oṃ gha gha ghā ru— ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṭ+wān 9hūṃ phaṭa/ kri khā kyeya khri la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī li tī khā 11ya badz+ra dha ra 1 ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra shī khā ༄ ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas btab la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅgar ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas brdung bar bya'o/ /de nas srung / skud bcing ba dang / gu gul gyis bdugs mupa dang / me tog phreng ba btags shing dri'i thig le byas nas byams pa'i go cha kabaskon par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam nyu lnga dang / snying po bzlas pa'i dri chus byugs la/dbus su dri'i thig le byas te me tog gi tshom bu bkram nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sngags kyis bteg pa'i lha tsho/bzhugs su gsol lotso(/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa 37—891

dang / dbang bskur ba dang / yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum du byin gyis brlabs / mchod pa lnga dang / mchod pa rgyas pa dang / bstod pa byas nas snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /rig 1 sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma kun la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya ste/ lha lhag par gnas par bya'o / /2de nas bum pa gnyis legs par bkrus na mas mgul pa bcings te/ldum bcas lcug mas kha brgyan la/ rin po che lnga dang / sman lnga dang /'bru lnga bcug nas lhag par gnas par bya ste/ de nas bum pa bdud rtsi 'khyel pas bsangs nas/ rgyu 4las gzhal yas khang dang / baṃ 5las 'o ma can gye rgya mtsho dang / dhīḥ6las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas de'i steng du dh+ri 7las phyag na rdo rje bskyed de/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas nas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/gos gtsang mas bkab la bzhag ste/ phyi de zhag gsum du bzlas pa bya ste bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o / / de nas/ 'byor pa yod na sbyin sreg gi mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin du gtor ma btang nas/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa bya ste/ khrus byas la me tog lag tu thogs te slob dpon gyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab ste rgyun bshags bya'o/ /dga' chen khyod la bdag 37—892

dga'o / /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig chen po stsal du gsol / /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags tshul chen spyod pa dag /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgoms pas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i1/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug par rtogs nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ / des na 2kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas lhar bskyed nas mchod pa bya ste/ so shing dor ba dang / ku sha sbyin pa dang /srung sgud gdags pa dang / zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bshad par bya ste4/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams5/ /u dusmra ra'i 6me tog bzhin/ /brgya 7lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / bskal pa 8bye ba du ma ru/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro don mnyam med byed par 'gyur / /gzhan yang theg pa chen po yi/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang 37—893

ldan / /khyed rnams der ni dod 1pas na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu thob / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /des na bu yis brtson par gyis / /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de ltar lhag par gnas par byas nas/ /nang par nyi ma shar ba 3dang mchod pa bshams la / dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg ste/ sa gzhi ba'i rnam pa 5lnga dang dri chen pos byugs nas thig skud byin gyis brlabs la cho ga bzhin thig gdab par bya'o/ /de nas tshon dgye bar bya ste/ tshon byin gyis brlabs 6la dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan 7la rdo rje rtse lnga pa bris pa dang / phyogs kyi rim par tshon dgye ba dang / rtsig pa la phyi rim dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / nag po dang / kha khyer dmar po dang 8/ rin bo che'i 9pha gu ser po dang / dra ba dra phyed nag po/ mda' yab ljang gu/ rta babs ci mdzes pa/ rdo rje me ri dang bcas par 1 bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas dgongs ka'i dus su mchod rdzas rnams 1bsags nas bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor bteg la yid kyis nang du zhugs te/ lhag pa dang ma tshang ba'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir lan bdun bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog gi phreng ba dor la slar rang gi mgo la babyung bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la mdun gye lha yang sa bon gye yi ge yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje las 'od zer spro bsdu byas nas/ lhar bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa la sogs pa byas nas/mchod pa rgyas par phul bstod pa byas nas bum par bcug ste/ bzlas pa byas 37—894

nas chur —1zhu ba las sgu khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg bya ba dang / gtor ma btang nas slob ma la dbang bskur bar bya ste/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga dang / slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga yang tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag byas la/gnang ba nod par bya ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas rdo rje slob ma yi2/ /spyod lam legs par gsungs pa yi1/ /bla ma chen po khyed kyis ni/ /byang chub chen po'i lam ston pa'i / /bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod4/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol / /gdong g.yogs bcing ba dang / rgyun bshags bya ba dang / sdom pa gzung 5ba dang / lhar bskyed cing las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / lha'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ mthu stobs phyag na rdo rje ni/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyi/ /tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshul 'di smras na yang / /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas tsan+dan gur gum la sogs pa'i chu khror bar drugs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na tshig par byed/ /gal te gsang sngags dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrags te ‘/ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i 7las nyon cig /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyis brnyas na ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis sreg par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su bsreg /ces pa'o /37—895

ye shes dbab pa ni1/ de nas rdzas kyi dud pa btang / rdo rje slob dpon thugs ka nas/ /kha dog dmar ba'i a bton nas/ /slob ma'i snying gar gzhug 2par bya/ /slob ma rnams kyis bde ba bsgom/ /'phar dang ldeg pa'i rtags byung na/ /de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag bya/ /ye shes dbab pa'o/ /phreng ba dor ba dang / gdong g.yogs dgrol ba dang / dkyil 'khor lta 4ba byas nas lhar bskyed la/ rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid las/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug ma yi gnas/ /dri med 5rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bu khrod kyis ni blta bar gyis/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol te 'khor lo'i lha6/ /de bzhin nyid ni bstan par bya/ /gtso bo sgo mar bcas pa bstan/ /chu dang / cod pan dang / rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / ming gi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs kyi brtul zhugs la sogs pa bsgur ro/ /de yang dang po/ yon phul nas ni gsol gdab bya7/ /bum pa'i chu kun basbus nas bya8/ /slob ma la ni dbang bskur bya/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas pas/ /ji ltar phul bas mchod pa che/ /bdag kyang bsgral ba'i don du ni/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /zhes brjod la/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ rdo rje dbang bsgur chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /gsang gsum gzhi las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje gos sngon chu dbang sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra bhā lto ba ra dha ra 9a bhe ṣispyo mi/ de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bsgur te/ sangs rgyas yon tan las byung ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba che bsams pa thams cad 'byung ba'i 11gnas/ /rin chen gos sngon dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bye ṣidzi mi/ de nas rdo 37—896

rje'i dbang bskur te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bsgur byas pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab bsgrub phyir/ /pad+ma'i gos sngon rdo rje zung / /oṃ pad+ma bhā waṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi a bye ṣiñca mi/ de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur te/ /chos kun sgyu ma'i sgra sgrogs te/ /stong pa'i don las sad par byed/ /shes rab dril bu'i dbang bsgur bas/ /las kyi gos 1 dbang thob par 3shog /oṃ karma be+e dze+e ba ra dha rā ri dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a r+bha ṣilnga mi/de nas ming gi dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje'i ming ni bla med pas/ /cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pas/ /bla med byang chub nges thob pas4/ /bde gshegs gos sngon dbang thob shog /oṃ budhe nī māṃ ba ra dha ra nā ma a bhi ṣa.ā+oṃ 5mi/ de nas phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur te/ dbang stegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ /de steng slob ma bzhag nas ni/ /tshig gis gsol ba gdab par bya/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang stsol cig /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i de nyid rnams/ /bdag nyid slob dpon bgyid par 'tshal/ /de nas bum chus dbang bskur te6/ /gsang ba byang chub sems kyi chu/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa ste/ /dri med rdo rje chu yi dbang / /rdo rje rigs mchog chu dbang sbyin/ /rdo rje dam tshig sbyin te/ t+t+waṃ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje dang po'i 7bdag po'i gtso/ /yang dag thog ma med pa yi/ /skyes bu chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /oṃ badz+ra a rnyi ṣi.ā+oṃ mi/ dril bu'i dam tshig sbyin te / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyings zhes 'gro bar 'dod/ /rtag tu khyed kyis kyang zungs te / /rgyal 37—897

ba'i byang chub mchog tu bzhed/ /oṃ badz+ra dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi /sna.a bhi ṣidzi mi/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig sbyin te/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rgya/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /'khyud pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang //oṃ kā ya mu tra a sti ṣiñca mi/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni de nyid dang / /slob dpon de nyid rab tu sbyin/ /de ba maṇ+ḍal gu ru a bhi ṣilnga mi/ de la lha'i gnang ba sbyin pa'o / /sems can rnams la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor / /rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rtag tu khyod kyis kyang bzung ste/ /lag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan4/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya/ a ti te sha s+t+waṃ dha 5ra ya mi 6badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi 7hūṃ zhes brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /de nas slob dpon gtso bor bsgoms te/ chos gos gyon pa'i tha ma lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis snying gar bzung 8la/ lag pa g.yas pas 9mchog sbyin du byas /kye 'dod chags rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes bos la/ sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ jur bhu ba swaḥ / de nas lung bstan te/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu yang dag pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'o1 / /mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya chen ngo/'i mthu dang / sngags kyi mthu nges par 'ong gis dad par gyis 2 shig ces lung bstan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga sbyar ba yisas/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun/ /phyag na rdo rje thob nas ni/ /'gro don ma lus byed par shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gye cho ga /slob dpon klu sgrub dang /27—898
