sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi 3sto tra/ bod skad du/dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i skur snang ba/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po khros pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing nag la/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnun pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 'chang ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes cod pan can/ /dbang bskur sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa yis mdzes/ /smin basbus smin ma glog stong 'od du 'phro/ /spyan gsum 'bar ba khro bo'i lta bas mdzes/ /mche ba gcigs shing dbugs rgyu me ltar 'bar/ /a la la yi gad rgyangs chen po sgogs/ /ha ha'i gad mos stong 37—901

gsum brgyal bar byed/ /hūṃ gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /phaṭa kyis thog 'bebs rdo rje ser chen 'bebs/ /gshin rje'i gzugs can rgyan dang cha lugs ldan/ /sku stod seng ge'i pags pas rnam par brgyan/ /na bza' chos gos sngon po 'chang 1ba bsnams/ /stag gi smad g.yogs ba ti khra bos brgyan/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i sbrul gyis dbu brgyan cing / /dga' bo nye dga'i snyan chas rab tu mdzes/ /gdug pa 'bar ba zas su gsol bar mdzad/ /klu nag se ral kha ru brgyan pa ste/ /'dab bzang 2dkar pos ska rags rnam par bcings / /nor rgyas bus ni phyag dang zhabs brgyan te/ /nyi zla'i steng na khro rgyal gar byed dgyes/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la rnam par bzhugs/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog bcom ldan gtum po ste/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ bskal pa'i me 'bar klong na bzhugs pa ni—/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog mthing nag ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'byel pa'i rtags/ /rdo rje rtse lnga g.yas na bsnams pa ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan dug lnga 'joms pa'i rtags/ /g.yon pas sdigs 5mdzub thugs kar 'chang ba ni/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa ni/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 'dren pa'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa yis brgyan pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dgongs pa'i rtags/ /smin basbus smin ma glog stong 'phro ba ni/ /thugs rje'i thabs kyis gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /mche gcigs dbugs rgya 6me ltar 'bar ba ni/ /thabs kyi spyod pas nyon mongs sreg pa'i rtags/ /spyan gsum dmar ba khro bos blta ba 37—902

ni / /sku gsung thugs kyi don dang ldan pa'i rtags/ /a la la yi gad rgyangs sgrogs pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i rtags/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs stong gsum brgyal ba ni/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags / /hūṃ gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba ni/ /khro bo'i rigs rnams dbang du snyud pa'i rtags/ /phaṭa kyis rdo rje'i thog ser 'be+ebs pa ni/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /gshin rje'i gzugs can rgyan dang cha lugs ni/ /sgu che yan lag rags te che ba'i rtags/ /sku stod seng ge'i pags pas brgyan pa ni / /chos nyid don ldan spros dang bral ba'i rtags/ /na bza' chos gos sngon po 'chang ba ni/ /tshul khyems don ldan dri ma med pa'i rtags/ /stag sham ba ti khra bos brgyan pa ni/ /zhe sdang 'dul mdzad sgrub mchog skyong ba'i 1rtags / /rin chen 'bar ba'i sbrul gyis dbu brgyan pa/ /'dod dgu bsam pa re ba skong ba'i rtags/ /dga' bo nye dga'i snyan chas brgyan pa ni/ /bram ze'i klu rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /gdug pa 'bar ba zas su gsol ba ni / /gdol pa'i rigs rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /klu nag se ral kha ru brgyan pa ni/ /dmangs rigs klu rnams dbang du sbud pa'i rtags/ /'dab bzang 2dkar po ska rags bcings pa ni/ /rgyal rigs klu rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /nor rgyas bu yis phyag zhabs brgyan pa ni/ /rje rigs klu rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /nyi zla'i steng na gar byed dgyes pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel pa'i rtags/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog bcom ldan gtum po ni/ /thabs kyi 4spyod pas 'gro don byed 37—903

pa'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu 1bstan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad pa'i rtags/ /sgu yi yan lag rags te dpa' dpa' 'dra / /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan te sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad stag gi sham thabs can/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan/ /nyon mongs 'joms 'dzad me dpung k+kong na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /bcom ldan gtum po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje la don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa rjogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā 2ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o // //bsdur mchan/9༷1 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa/ ltar bkod/ 〈〈co 〉dze+e/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dze+es/9༷2 〈〈pe 〉toraphyang / 2〈〈pe 〉thazangs / 〈〈snar 〉〉rnams / 4〈〈sna ra 〉skoradi/ 5〈〈pe 〉stanag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rgyu/ 〈〈pe 〉rabags / 〈〈snar 〉ra sreg9༷2 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉skyo ba pa 'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thazangs/ 〈〈snar 〉thazung / 4〈〈snar 〉rang /9༷4 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉rar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgro/ 〈〈pe 〉ṅkabadz+ra pā ṇi sernyi// //37—90/
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1624) 37wa 905

1698༄khya/ /bcom ldan 'das phrag na rdo rje la bstod pa/sna—༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān badz+ra pā ṇi sto tra/ bod skad du/bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /hūṃ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad cing / /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /ngag gi nyes pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /sngags rnams gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /rnam rtog ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mdog sngon po 'od zer 'bar/ /rdo rje'i stobs kyis 'byung po 'dul/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi gnod sbyin chen po rnams/ /'jigs su rung ba'i cha byad can/ /ma lus thams cad 37—906

'jigs par byed/ /'jigs byed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rig ①sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa rdzogs so// //④ bsdur mchan/9༷6 gyomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/9༷7 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staregs/ 38〈pe 〉〉skomaṅgāle/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1625)37wa 907

sngag /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/sto1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān ni 2dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa dha sdenā ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gar kyis ni/ /ri bong 'dzin la bde bar bzhugs/ /klu rigs rnams kyi dgrar gyur pa'i/ /khro rgyal spyi bos rab btud nas/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /ji lta'i rim pas sgrub pa yi/ /bdag nyid de ltar dran pa yis/ /'di ni bdag gis dri khyebar bya/ /de la khro bo'i rgyal po yang dag par sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas / /thog mar gdong khrus byas la phyag bya ste/ sa gzhi rnam par dag pa la me tog bkram nas de'i dbus thu stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar yi ge hūṃ 7kha dog sngon po bsams 8la/ de'i 'od kyis rje btsun phyag na rdo rje gos 37—908

sngon po can dang thabs gcig pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams yang dag par bskul la mdun du bsams —1nas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ad ma 2ko haṃ/ de'i 1don dang lhan cig tu stong pa nyid kyi don rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkhar yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge dh+ri sngon po 'od zer dang bcas pa bsam par bya'o//de'i 'od kyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs nas rnam par grol bas so sor gos sngon 4can gyi sgu'i ngo bor byas la/ de nas 'od kyis basbus nas sa bon gyi yi ge'i dbus su gzhug par bya'o/ /de 5rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 6'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad drangs nas rdo rje la gzhug par bya'o/ /de ni yongs su gyur pa las/ sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /shin tu khro bas dregs pa yi / /g.yon brkyang ba yis bde bar bzhugs/ /na tshod bcu drug lon pa gzhin 7 / /drag cing khro ba'i 8nyams dang ldan/ /klu brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan / /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa9/ /rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis /snun 7pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin mdzad cing / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 'chang ba dang / /na bza' sngon po 'chang ba bsnams/ /spyan dmar mche ba gartsigs pa ste / /dbu skra nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin/ /dbu skra gyen rdzes 1 cod pan can/ /ha ha'i sgra ni cher sgrogs pa/ /khro bo'i bdag po 'jigs par byed/ /log 'dren la sogs bsreg ༄ par mdzad/ /bdag nyid de 'dra 7bsam par bya/ /de nas rang gi snying gar yi ge hūṃ bkod la ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya'os//de nas mdun na bzhugs pa de la mchod pa ྾byas la/ dzaḥ1 dh+ri baṃ hoḥzhes bya 37—909

bas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya'o/ /yang lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis rlab /mipar bya ste/ mgo dang shog ma dang snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ āḥhūṃ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du bkod la/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang nag po dang bsam par bya'o/ /phyi nas ji srid nus par spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rims kyis 2mi skyo ba'i rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /skyo bar gyur na gsang sngags yid kyis bzlas par bya ste/ myur ba dang / dal ba dang / gsal ba dang / mi gsal ba spang ba'i —log pa'i rnam par rtog pa spangs la bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pas skyo na/ o ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma rde ar+ya nut+pan+da twata oṃ āḥt+t+waṃ swā hā/ gsang sngags 'dis gtor ma gtong ngo / /de nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas par bya'o/ /de'i de ma thag tu ye shes sems dpa' mchod la khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun par dngos grub gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o4/ /de la bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ be+e dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa de bzhin du brjod par bya'o / /skal bar ldan pas sgrub thabs 'di la 'bad pas na/ /rang gi 'bad pas bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi ni/ /'thungs na 5lus ni yongs su rgyas pa bskyed pa dang / /rnal 'byor gcig gis byang chub sa ni bde thob 'gyur/ /skye ba snga ma'i yang dag skal bar ldan na yang / /nyes pa 'di dag ji ltar spong bar nus par 6'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis man ngag thob par gyur pa na/ /bsnyen pa med kyang dgos 7pa 'di dag thams cad ni/ /de yis myur du dngos grub thob par gyur pa dang / /dam pa'i gdam ngag phan pa'i bdud rtsi yi/ /37—9/0

thig ༄1 pas sdug bsngal phung po 'jig 3par byed pas na/ /skye ba rnam rtog rdul rnams zhi bar sgobyed par 'gyur/ /khro bo'i rgyal po chen po gos sngon po ④can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon 'go bzangs khye snying po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta te dza de ba dang / bod kyi lo tsā trib dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyis 3bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/9༷8 sgyusna mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉lhar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉tha mi bzhugs pas 〈〈pe 〉phro gzhir bzung nas 〈〈snar 〉rang dpe bsdur byas yod/ zhe 〈〈snar 〉rja/ sna〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa bā dha ni/ je 〈〈snar 〉〉bo—/ sa 〈〈snar 〉rab/ dzi 〈〈snar 〉thadag 〈〈pe 〉〉(/ ('di'i 'og gi hūṃ dang oṃ rnams 〈〈snar 〉rol zla tshes med kyang bsdur mchan du brkod med/) 〈〈snar 〉thasam/9༷9 te 〈〈snar 〉thasam/ 2 〈〈snar 〉mas/ 〈〈snar 〉7sgra'i/ 〈〈snar 〉7po/ zhi 〈〈snar 〉7'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pas bltas la de nas de las/ 6 〈〈snar 〉ra ni/ 7 〈〈snar 〉thazhin/ sa 〈〈snar 〉shesa'i/ she 〈〈snar 〉ra/'i/7〈〈snar 〉snga snun/ 〈〈snar 〉snga dze+es/ na〈〈snar 〉〉rgyal/ 〈〈snar 〉snga sregs/ rja〈〈snar 〉skaradrer/ sa〈〈snar 〉〉bya / 7〈〈snar 〉thar/ ( 〈〈snar 〉7dza/91 sna 〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉rem kyis/ 〈〈snar 〉〉spangs pa'i/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉gibar bya'o/ 5 〈〈snar 〉〉nas—/ 6 〈〈snar 〉ra / 7 〈〈snar 〉〉dgongs/911 1 〈〈snar 〉〉thigs/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉ngajigs/ 〈〈snar 〉ma ga pa/ra/ ༄ 〈〈snar 〉〉gipo/ zhe 〈〈snar 〉ra zang /dzi 〈〈snar 〉〉lots+tsha/ 7 〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/37—91 1
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1626)

༄go/ /3skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje wal gyis bsgoms la lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ 3sarba dharmāḥziswa bhā ba shusbyo3haṃ gezhes brjod pas chu gtor gyi snod de stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo ⑥ser po las gtor ma'i snod rin po che'i khang bu brtsegs pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi tshad tsam du bsams te/ de'i nang du gtor ma yi ge khaṃ ljang gu las kha zas ro brgya pa/nam mkha'i tshad dang mnyam pa bsams te/ de'i nang du/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā māṃ dz+wa.ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta tsu.oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes 'jig rten pa'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ 26hūṃ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabakye// ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidha lo tsa na sarba arba sā dha na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags dang / nam mkha' 37—913

mdzod kyi sngags kyis spel ba ni/ oṃ na maḥ༄1sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo—2/ bi shwa ༄mu khe bh+yaḥ4sarba thā khaṃ u te sga ra ṇa hi me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams su tweḥlas pad+ma dpag tu med pa bsams te/ de'i steng du yi dam lha la sogs pa 'gro drug thams cad spyan drangs la/ de rnams la yang 'od phog pas sdig sgrib dag nas yi dam gyi lhar byas la/ bdun rnam dag byas la bgegs bskrad pa ni oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a mṛ te 5kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa ces bya'o6/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ā dz+nyā pa ya ti i rda ba bo kṛdzā tu sa ma ya/ rak+ṣ-i tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi 7me pra yats+tshan+tu ma ma sarba karma sā du swā hā/ zhes pas yi dam rnams la dbul/ mgron gzhan rnams la yang sbyin pa na/ na ma smarba 8 ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ zhes brjod pas byin gyis rlabs 9kyis phan tshun zhe 'gras pa med pa dang / 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par byas nas sngags 'dis yid la ci 'dod pa dang / mig sngar ci mdzes pa mngon par dga' ba dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro / /oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi rta lo tsa na sarba arja sā dha na ya muswā hā/ sngags 'di gnyis lan bdun bdun du brjod do/ /de ni zang zing gi sbyin pa'o/ /chos kyi sbyin pa ni rten 'brel snying po dang / de nas / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs / /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge spyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs / /sdig pa ci yang mi bgyi ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par sbyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /37—9/

bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa nyid ni thob par shog /ces pa'o/ /de nas bden pa bdar ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang /rig sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / /bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis sems can thams cad kyi gnod pa thams cad zhi nas bar chad dang gnod pa thams cad spangs te byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis/ /klu rnams gnod pa myur du zhi ba dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren 'tshe ba med pa dang / /bdag gi las rnams thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod la—1/ badz+ra muḥ2zhes pas so sor rang gi gnas su gshegs par bya'o / /rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi chu gtor gyi cho ga slob dpon 'gro bzangs snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta te dza 4de ba dang / bod kyi sgra bsgyur 5gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab kyis zhus shing gtan la phab pa'o// //37—915

༄/ /phrag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi klu gtor gyi cho gahūṃ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi be+e dze+e ba ra dha ra nā ga tshub bo bi bye / bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi klu gtor gyi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /yang nas yang du bsgom byas nas/ /mdun du paṃ las pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dmar po 'dab brgyad de/ /phuḥrngu/brgyad las ni klu brgyad bskyed/ /de nas snying ga'i 'od zer dang / oṃ dze+e phuḥchozhes pas klu chen brgyad/ /'khor dang bcas pa bkug la bsnyim/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir bcas/ /dam tshig ye shes klu rnams mchod/ /de nas gtor ma byin brlab stede/ /snod ni khaṃ las rin po che/ /shin tu mdzes shing blta na sdug /yangs la rgya ni che bar bsgom / /rin chen snod mchog de nang du/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum 37—917

bdud rtsir bcas/ /snod ni shin tu gang bar bsam/ /de yi steng du yi ge gsum / /kha dog dri dang ro sbyangs dang / /bdud rtsi ro mchog brgyad 1dang ldan / /g.yas pa mchog sbyin phyag rgya la/ /ha hoḥspyoḥ2baṃ dag las ni/ /dpag bsam shing chen bsam byas la/ /lo ma yal ga thams cad la/ /rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis gang / /dpag tu med pa bsams snyenas ni/ /bye las bdud rtsi'i char babs pas/ /gtor ma yongs su gang bar bsam oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan ra0gsum brjod/ /mgron zhernams thams cad lce las ni/ /hūṃ las rdo rje sbu gus rngub/ /oṃ ba su ki i oṃ ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ tak+ṣa ka i 6rma ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi7/ oṃ karko ṭa/ oṃ hu lu ta ka /chig pad+ma/oṃ ma hā pad+ma/ oṃ shaṃ kha —pā la/ oṃ ku li ka yaḍa/ oṃ nā ga pa na saṃ khru ha ra ha ra i rma ba lo ta rkyekha kha khā hi khā hi/ i rma ba bo rtsa kyel gdags/ oṃ dze+e skru klu'i rgyal po sog ma med/ i saṃ ba lo kha kha tertakhā hi khā hi/ oṃ mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba zla ba spyi gtsug che/ /snying po med dang hu lun+ta6/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che/ /gdung ba dang ni gdung ba che/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs bzang snyedang / /gzugs chen 'od dang sbrul bzang glulho 'phye che/ /smig rgyu dang ni smig rgyu che/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes —/ /mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtshor bcas//rin chen phreng ba'i them 15skas can/ /klu yi gnod pa skyob byed pa/ /mthun 37—918

pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /klu las gyur pa'i nad rnams ni1 / /mthong ba'i dug dang kha rlangs dug /bsam pa'i dug la sogs pa kun/ /de dag thams cad zhi gyur cig /bdag pas gces pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed par/ /rtag tu byams pa'i sems dang ni/ /pha ma lta 2 bu'i sems kyis ltos/ /gzhan yang las las gyes pa yi/ /bka' dang dam las thogs pa yi/ /gdug pa can gyi tshogs rnams kun/ /bka' yi pham 'bab rngu'adi snoms la/ /so so rang re'i gnas su dengs/ /nyon cig nyon cig rigs kyi bu/ /ji ltar sa bon tsha ba la/ /myu gu tsha ba 'byung ba ltar/ /so so rang re'i gnas la spyon4/ /'byung bzhi so sor 5gyur yang srid/ /bde gshegs bka' las 6'gyur ba med/ /las 'bras 'gyur zhing slu mi srid/ /de las khyod spyig mi byed par/ /dge ba'i bsam pas gnas par gyis/ /bden pa bdar la chos bshad bya/ /de 7rjes yi ge brgya pa brjod8/ /ye shes klu rnams gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig pa ni mi dmigs bsam/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho chen po 'am/ /yang na gnod pa'i phyogs su gtong spu/ /rdo rje gos sngon gyi klu gtor cho ga slob dpon 'gro bzangs sasnying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—919

༄༅/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra 2 nā ma/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa 'dul byed rdo rje can/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal te/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi cho ga bshad par bya/ /gnas khang dbe+en zhing nyams dga' bar/ /phyag dar chag chag — byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor yang 4 ni rab bzhengs la/ /yang na maṇ+ḍal sngon por bya/ /gdugs dang ba dan la sogs dbul/ /rdo rje can gyi rten rnams dgram/ /mchod pa lnga dang ldan par bya / /gtor tshogs rnams kyang bzang du bsham/ /bdag nyid yi dam lhar ni bskyed/ /mig gnyis dag tu nyi zla bsgom/ /de steng hūṃ ni bsam par bya/ /phyogs rnams kun tu bltas pas bsreg /de nas gnas 5ni bsrung bya'i phyir/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ 6phaṭa/ shar gyi phyogs su rab 'phros pas/ /rdo rje rigs 37—921

kyi khro bo ste/ /sku mdog dkar la 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /dpag tu med pas gang ba bskyed/ /oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/rin chen rigs kyi khro bo ste/ /sku mdog ser la 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /dpag tu med pas gang bar bskyed/ /oṃ kṛṭ+wā pa ya kṛrje pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ pad+ma rigs kyi khro bo ste/ /sku mdog dmar la 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /dpag tu med pas gang bar bskyed/ /oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān 1bibyā rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ las kyi rigs kyi khro bo ste/ /sku mdog sngo la 'jigs pa'i 2gzugs/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /dpag tu med pas gang bar bskyed/ /phyogs gsum spros pa shes par bya/ /rdo rje gur dang ra ba gsum / /de la me dpung 'bar ba bskyed/ /de nas mgron rnams spyan drangs la/ /bdun po yongs su dag par bya/ /de nas gtor ma gtor chog bzhin/ /rgyas par rab tu dbul bar bya/ /de nas tshogs la bgegs bskrad la/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni / /de nas tshogs bdag bkod pa ni/ /tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /tshogs kyi bdag po bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum bla ma rnams dang ni/ /jo bo dkon mchog gsum po dang / /bstan pa srung 4ba'i chos skyong dang / /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs/ /tshogs/ kyi bdag por bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas tshogs ni dbul ba ni/ /dus gsum bla ma rnams dang ni/ /yi dam lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa dbul lags na/ /thugs rje cher dgongs 5dngos grub stsol/ /a la la ste mchod pa bzhes/ /lha rnams 'dul phyir gos dkar can6/ /sku yi 37—922

dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas la/ /lha srin 'dul phyir gos dmar can/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas la/ /klu rnams 'dul phyir gos sngon 1can/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas la/ /bla med dkon mchog 2gsum bo la/ /bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong la/ /lhag ma yul bdag rnams la sbyin/ /de nas tshogs la longs spyod pa/ /lhag ma 'byung po'i gtor ma gtong 4/ /glu dang gar dang bskor 5ba sogs/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs dbul/ /de nas mjug skugi las rnams su/ /mchod bstod yi ge brgya pas bshags7/ /bzod par gsol zhes gshegs pa ni/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs spyad na'adi la nyes pa gang / /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma tshang ba dang ma chog 9pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod / /t+t+waṃ khyed kyis 1 sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /nyid kyi yul du gshegs su gsol/ /nyid kyi yul du gshegs nas kyang / /thugs kyis brtse bar slar dgongs la/ /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ1nayis gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon 'gro bzangs —snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—923

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la bi 2dhi/ bod skad du/phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje dang / /bla ma la gus phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga brtsam/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgrub ༄1par 'dod pa'i don du/ dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di bsdu bar bya'o/ /de la sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs las zhe'abyung ba bzhin du/bdag nyid lhar bskyed nas/ snying po 'bum bzlas par bya ba'am/ yang na ji srid mtshan ma ma byung gi bar de srid kyi bar du bsgom pa dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ni sngon du bsnyen pa byed pa'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar sngon du bsnyen nga 'i cho ga rdzogs nas/ sa'i cho ga bya ste/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ kun dga' ra ba'am5/ nags tshal la sogs pa yid du 'ong 37—925

ba'i gnas su sa bslang ba dang / sa sbyang pa dang / sa gzung ba dang / sa byin kyis brlab par bya ste/ tshad brtag pa dang / dbyebs brtag pa dang /kha dog brtag pa'o/ /de la sa bslang ba ni/ gnas kyi bdag po la bslang ba ni1 / maṇ+ḍal dang dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu byas te/ mchod pa dang / gtor ma bshams nas/ oṃ bi ti baṃ sa ā kār+ṣa 2ya dzaḥbya ba dang /rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba sa la reg par byas pas/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ sa'i lha mo la mchod pa dang / de'i 'khor la gtor ma byin la/ gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la//lha mo khyod ni dpang —du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis5/ /ji ltar bdud sde bcom pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis 6bdud kyi sde/ /pham 7par byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod la/ byon par bsams te mchod la gshegs su gsol —/ de nas sbyang ba'i 9phyir drag po dang 7zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang / 'dom gang nye 'khor du lte ba nub tsam mam/ pus mo nub tsam brkos 11la gseg ma dang gyo mo dang / rus pa la sogs pa bsal te/spos chus bran te/ sa de nyid kyis bkang nas sa'i ltas brtag par bya ste 8/sa bslang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de'i rjes la sa gzung ba ni/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / bla re la sogs pa bres la/ sku gzugs rnams bkram nas/ phyogs bzhir spos rgyun mi 'chad par btul bar bya'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yas pa der gtugs te/yi ge brgya pa lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /sa gzhi rdo rje'i 37——926

rang bzhin du byin hūṃ gyis brlab pa ni/ sa gzung ba dang byin gyis brlab pa ste/sa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas khrus bya zhing dris byugs la gos sngon po'i stod g.yogs bgos la rgyan gdags shing dang 3rdo rje dang dril bur ldan pas/ gal te nus na sgyung — bar gnas pa dang / ma nus na zas dkar gsum bza' bar bya'o/ /de la re zhig dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ tshogs bsags pa dang / srung tshu ba'i 'khor lo dang / gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de la yi ge hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje chen po nam mkha'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i khong stong bsam pa ni srung 5ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i steng du zlo 6las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa bskyed la/ dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la/ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang / dbang bsgur ba dang / yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum du byin gyis brlabs 7pa'i bar du byas la lha mo mchod nas/gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs pos mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod la gsol ba gdab ste/ mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma3/ g.yon par ṭa dang a 9snalas zla ba / rkang mthil du a las sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed nas langs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas nas/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gsal bar byas nas/ dbus kyi gtso bo nam mkhar bteg la khro bo'i bstod pa bya'o/ /de la bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /37—927

bskal pa 1rnge ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas2/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs brkyang bsgum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg 4par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod nas bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /da ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin 'byer bar gyis/ /ci ste nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis/ /spyi bo tshal pa brgyar ni rab 'gems shing / /rnam par 'jig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /zhes bya ba dang / deng 5rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug che ge mo zhes bya bas / slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba/ sdogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhig rtsom gyis/ gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang brjed byed dang 'byung po dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi 'am ci dang / rig 'dzin la sogs pa rgan po dang / rgan mo g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ 'dir ma 6gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /de ltar phyag na rdo rje'i bka' thos pas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun du 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ rdo rje chen po'i gar dang / rdo rje'i 7'gros kyis sa gzhi lan gsum bskor zhing / rang gi lus la khro bo'i tshogs phyung la/ sdang ba 37—928

thams cad bskrad hūṃpar bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge hūṃ gis srung 2ba'i 'khor lo byas —la/ phur bu 4lnga stod phyag na rdo rje smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bur bskyed nas / oṃ badz+ra tī li tī khā 5 ya sarba bispyo 6ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ dbus dang grwa bzhir/ oṃ gha gha ghā 7ta ya ghā ta 8ya sarba duṣ+ṭhan tsophaṭa/ shī lā ya tī khā ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī li tī lā 1 ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā 2pa ya ti kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī lā 1 ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas btab la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko saṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bas brdung bar bya'o—/ /de nas srung sneskud bcing ba dang / gu gul gyis bdugs mupa dang /me tog gi phreng ba shāgadags shing dri'i thig le byas nas/ byams pa'i go cha bskon 1(par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor ba'i rnam lnga dang / snying po bzlas pa'i dri'i chus byugs la/ dbus su dri'i thig le bya'o/ /me tog gi tshom bu bkram nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i sngags kyis bteg pa'i lha bzhugs su gsol la /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / yi ge gsum kyis gnas gsum du byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa lnga dang / mchod pa rgyas pa dang / bstod pa byas nas snyan gsan dbab par bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma kun la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal / /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs / /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya ste/ lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas 'byor pa yod na sbyin sreg gi mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho ga nas 'byung ba bzhin du gtor ma btang nas/ slob ma lhag par gnas 37—929

par bya ste/ khrus byas la/ me tog lag na thogs te/ slob dpon gyi zhabs gnyis la phyag byas nas/ gsol ba btab ste rgyun bshags byas te/ de nas lhar bskyed nas / 2 mchod pa byas te/ so shing dor ba dang / ku sha sbyin pa dang /srung 3skud gdags pa dang / zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bshad par bya ste/rgyas par ni bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i cho ga las shes par bya'o/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o // // de ltar cholhag par gnas pa phyebyas nas/ nang par nyi ma shar ba dang /mchod pa bshams la dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg ste/ sa gzhi ba'i rnam lnga dang / dris byugs nas/ thig byin kyis brlabs la cho ga bzhin du thig gdab par bya'o/ /de nas tshon dgye bar bya ste/ tshon byin gyis brlabs la dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa bri ba dang / phyogs kyi rim par tshon dgye ba dang / rtsig pa la phyi rol dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /ljang gu dang / nag po dang / kha khyer dmar po rin po che pha gu ser po dang /dra ba dra phyed nag po/ rta babs ci mdzes par bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas/ dgongs 4ka'i dus su mchod ⑦pa'i rdzas rnams bsags nas 8stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor bteg 9la yid kyis dkyil 'khor nang du zhugs te/ lhag pa dang ma tshang ba'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ lan bdun bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog gi phreng ba dor la slar rang gi mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la/ mdun gyi lha yang yi ge yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje7/ de 37—930

la 'od zer spro 1bsdu byas nasan/ lhar bskyed la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa la sogs pa rdzogs par byas nas mchod pa rgyas pa dbul bar bya'o/ /bstod pa byas nas bum pa bcug ste/ bzlas pa byas nas chur bzhu la sgu khrus gsol bar bya'o / /de nas sbyin sreg bya ba dang / gtor ma btang nas slob ma la dbang bsgur ba'o / /de la dang por gsol ba btab pa dang / gdong g.yogs bcing ba dang / rgyun bshags bya ba dang / sdom pa gzung 5ba dang / lhar bskyed cing las thams cad pa'i bum pas sku khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / lha'i dam tshig bsgrags pa dang / slob dbon gyi dam tshig bsgrags 6pa dang / ye shes dbab pa dang / phreng ba dor ba dang /gdong g.yogs dgrol ba dang / dkyil 'khor blta 7ba byas nas/ lhar bskyed nas/ chu dang cod pan dang / bdag po dang / ming gi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs kyi brtul zhugs dang / spangs pa dang / ye shes la sogs pa'i dbang dang / rjes su gnang ba dang / brtul zhugs kyi dbang la sogs pa bya'o // //8dkyil 'khor cho ga sbyar ba 'di'i9/ /dge ba gang des thob pa kun/ /phyag na rdo rje thob nas ni/ /'gro don du ma byed par shog /phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon 'gro bzangs 7snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //37—931

༄ / /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ nyu༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra pā ṇi byā dze+e ba ra dha ra sā dha na tsiste 2ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs yid bzhin kyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig dang po rnal 'byor pas shing gcig la sogs pa'i sa phyogs su stan 'jam pa la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po bsams nas de'i 'od zer kyis nam mkha' la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bltas te/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms zhes bya ba tshad med pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsams la/ gcig dang du ma dang bral bas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa dang / bdag nyid kyang stong par bsams la tho 37—931

rangs kyi skar ma dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mi dmigs shing / oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa yi kophotshohaṃ zhes bya bas ni brtan par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge paṃ 2 las byung ba'i pad+ma nag po'i lte bar yi ge dh+ri 4las byung ba'i pad+ma 5nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ 6kha dog nag po dang ring ba'i sprin 7sgra'i yi ge hūṃ 8bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsam zhing de'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' la khro bo'i rigs kun bkug la de nyid gzhug ste/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sku mdog nag po sprin lta bu/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal khro gnyer can/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi dbus na mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon 9pos brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ 1 phyag g.yas pas rdo rje phyar te gnas pa/ phyag g.yon pa khro bo'i khu tshur gyis gdug pa gnon pa'i sdigs mdzub 1 'chang ba rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ nag po dang ldan pa/ gos sngon po'i ga sha dang / sham thabs bsnams pa/ rigs kyi klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis la 'jog po dang rigs ldan dmar po/ zhabs gnyis la mtha' yas dang nor rgyas kyi bu nag po/ snyan gnyis la pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po ser po/ mu / ska rags su bcings pa ni dung skyong dkar po/ ral pa gcig pa'i srad bu ni hu lun+ta —ljang gu 'dzin paka/ bdud thams cad dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / khyab 'jug la sogs pa mu stegs pa'i lha'i snegazhung dang gzugs 'joms par mdzad par bsams la/ de dang 'dra ba'i gos sngon po can mdun du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs par bsams la 37—935

rang gi snying ga nas spyos pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis 1mchod la/ dzaḥ2hūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sngags kyis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / tha mi dad par bya ba'o/ /de nas lce la yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa de nyid kyis mtshan par bsams la ye shes sems dpa'i 4 thugs ka na yang rdo rje ste lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsams te/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po drug la yang yi ge hūṃ drug yongs su gyur pa las de dang 'dra ba'i gos sngon po can drug bkod de/ yi ge gsum gyis sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs te/ ru dā k+ṣa'i 5phreng ba la 6bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ m+bi dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags 'di yi ge bcu gsum pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po yi ge bdun pa'o/ /de dag la yang sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na drag po'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gsad pa'i las ni dur khrod du phyin la/ me thab gru gsum bcas la bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / ske tshe dang / dha —/—du ra dang / khrag dang / dug la bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan byas la/ bcad cing bsregs na zhag bdun na 1'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa spangs pa'i spyor ba de nyid kyis mngar gsum swā hā'i mtha' can gyis bsregs na zhi bar 'gyur ro / /rgyas pa la ni oṃ gyi mtha' can gyis so/ /dbang la hoḥrta 'i mtha' can gyis so/ /dgug pa la ni dzaḥ'i mtha' can gyis so/ /bdud rtsi lngas sani las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / de nas lnga.oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+parja tāta ces pa'am/ snying po'am nye ba'i snying bos gtor ma gtang 7bar bya'o/ /gtor ma gtang ba'i rdzas ni bza' ba dang / bca' 37—936

sprun sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/zu༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra pā ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa 2ho ma ta bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po la/ /gus pa'i spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ /bgegs dang gnod rims zhi ba'i phyir/ /de yi sbyin sreg cho ga bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das gos sngon po can sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dur khrod dam chu ngogs la sogs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar/ sbyin sreg gi cho gas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de la cho ga 'di yin te/ zhi ba 'ba' zhig gi las la/ thab khung rgyar khru gang pa/zabs su de'i phyed la kha khyer sor bzhi phyir dor ba dang /1 sor bzhi dpangs su brtsigs /pa dang / sor bzhi phyir dor la/ tha mar gru bzhir byas te/sgo bzhir sgo khyud dang ldan par byas la/ sa gzhi la kha dog dkar po byugs te/37—939

dbus su zhi ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po bri'o/ /de'i phyi rol rim pa gsum la/dang po la zhi ba'i rdo rje phreng ba dang / gnyis pa la khro bo'i rdo rje bri'o/ /gsum pa la me 'od dang bcas pa bris nas/ mtshams su zla ba'i rdo rje bri'o/ /de nas de'i phyi rol du ba'i rnam lngas byugs la/ me tog sil mas mdzes par bya'o / /de nas rdzas bsags te 1/ yam shing dang / mar dang / til dang / nas dang / gro dang / 2'bras so ba dang / sran ma dang /sran ma sha dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / zhal zas dang / dzā ti pha la dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / bil ba dang / tar ga dang / u dus+thā ra 5la sogs pa shing lo ma can gyi yam shing dang / gser dang / dngul dang / dar dkar po dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dang / 'o ma dang / zho dang / 'bras chan dang / ku sha dang / drur 6ba la sogs pa bsags la/ dgongs mo'i dus su sbyin sreg bya ste/ bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du lhar bskyed nas/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥ7sarba dharmāḥ8swa bhā ba shuzlolha/ haṃ zhes brjod pas snod kyi 'jig rten stong pa nyid du bskyed la/ yo las rlung / re las me/ baṃ las chu/ lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ sum̐ las ri rab/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje der hūṃ las thab khung gzhal yas khang du bskyed de snod bcud thams cad phyag na rdo rje zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par bsams la/ de'i nang du ram̐ las me gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ zur gsum la oṃ s+dzahūṃ yongs su gyur pa las me lha zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sgu mdog dkar po phyag gnyis 1 rdo rje rtse gsum dang phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang gudhe 1 bsnams par bskyed la ra la 37—9/0

bcibs ༄nyepar bsams la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa srin lag gi rtsa bar mthe bong btsugs la spos snod bzung ste/tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg drugs zhal zas 'di snoms la/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes bya ba dang / e bye hi ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza ya satwa ma kri yu tai hūṃ ma hā rasmi asmin sadz+re hi to bha ba oṃ ba bā asna ye swā hā/ zhes pas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas bsang gtor bya ste 'thor 'thung dang nye reg byas nas4/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba dang / dgug gzhug bya ste dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bsgrubs nas—/ chos kyi phyag rgya lce la ram̐ bsgoms nas/ las kyi phyag rgya gar las byung ba dang / phyag rgya chen po phyag mtshan dang bcas pa bsgom mo/ /de nas phyir byung la dbang bsgur ba dang / rtags su rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgom mo/ /de nas mchod pa lnga byas nas bstod pa bya ste/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po yongs kyis dbang bsgur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la mngon par bstod/ /ces pas bstod5/ me sbar te/ me gso ba'i phyir mar gyi dgang blugs gsum mam bdun dbul bar bya'o/ /mar gyi dgang blugs dbul ba'i dus su dgang gzar blugs gzar kyi kha la yi ge gsum dgod pa dang me lha'i zhal du re bsam par bya'o/ /de nas me'i pra brtags te / bgegs yod na yungs kar la oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa mā ra 7ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya bas bsal bar bya'o//de nas mchod par bya ste/ dang po mar la de nas til/ /de nas yam shing 'o ma zho/ /nas dang so ba 'bras dang ni/ /sran ma ma sha gro dag dang / /sman 37—9//

dang drur 4ba ku sha sogs/ /ci 'byor pas ni mchod par bya༄ / /zhes 'byung ba ltar mchod par bya'o/ /de la dbul ba'i sngags ni oṃ badz+ra a na la 5 ma hā byu ta dz+wa la 4sarba bhasmi 5 ku ru sarba duṭ+wān hūṃ/ zhes pas mar gyi dgang blugs kyi'o/ /oṃ agha 6ye swā hā mar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha nā ya swā hā til gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra agha 7ye swā hā yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang 'o ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā be+e gā ye swā hā nas kyi'o/ oṃ be+e dzā ya 8 sā hā/ nas so ba'i 'o oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra muñja ye swā hā/ sran ma ma sha'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma ra 9ye swā hā/ gro'i 'o / /oṃ badz+ra sho sa —ye swā hā/ sman gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a pra hi ha ta pa lā ya swā hā/ ku sha'i 'o/ /o badz+ra ā yu ṣe kaswā hā/ drur ba'i 'o/ /gzhan dag ni rang rang gi ming dang me nyid kyi sngags kyis dbul lo/ /de la yam shing ni 'bar ba'i 'od la'o/ /zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal la'o4/ /me tog dbu la'o/ /bdug pa shangs la'o/ /mar me spyan la'o/ /dri thugs kar ro/ /lha bshos zhal du'o/ /rdzas gzhan phyag tu'o/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsa gcig gam lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'am brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gtum po'i sngags kyis me bsangs la 'od du bzhu'o/ /ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ dang rdo rje las phyag na rdo rjer bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa dang /dbang bskur ba dang / yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ /mchod pa lngas mchod pa dang / bstod pa bya ste/ hūṃ gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar brjid / /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams / /bdud dgra khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bya ba la sogs 37—942

pas bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas dgang blugs dbul te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags kyis ci nus par sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas bstod pa snabyas la dang por gsol ba btab 3par bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas bgegs zhi ba la sogs pa las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg byed na/ oṃ ma ma shādhid+ku ru —swā hā/ oṃ de ba shārnyid+ku ru choswā hā/ oṃ nā ga shādhid+ku ru phyaswā hā/oṃ be+e shā tsa shābyeṅku ru 6swā hā/ oṃ ki ra ṇa shābyed+ku ru 7swā hā/ o ma ho ra gan shādhid+ku ru 3swā hā/ oṃ u pa dra 9ba nā sha ya swā hā/ oṃ a kā la mṛ kyu nā sha ༄ 1 ya swā hā/ oṃ ro ga shārnyid+ku ru 5swā hā/ oṃ rāk+ṣa sa shābyed+ku ru 1 swā hā/ oṃ byu ta shābyed+ku ru 7swā hā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / thog ma dang tha mar bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcom ldan 'das kyi sasngags dang spel la/ yungs kar ram til ci nus par bsreg par bya'o/ /de'i 7gdug pa can kun ye shes kyi mes zhi bar bsam mo/ /gal te sdig pa bsreg 7par 'dod na/ sdig pa'i gzugs snying ga nas drangs la bsreg par bya'o/ /oṃ byā dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ༄ 8ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dmigs pa rtse gcig pas bsreg go/ /klu gdon can la sbyin sreg byed na ye shes kyi thugs ka nas bye tshan gyi char babs — pas bsgrub bya'i lus la byug par bsam/ mngar gsum gyi dgang blugs byin te/ oṃ nā ga shārnyid+ku ru bheswā hā zhes brjod cing sbyin sreg mngar gsum gyis bya'o/ /de nas rgya mtsho chen por gshegs par bsam ste 1/gzugs brnyan mngar gsum dang bcas te chu bo chen por dor ro/ /de yang 37—943

dang por sa gtsang ma la sbrul kyi gzugs byas hūṃl/ tshon gyis khra bor thubyas te/lus bor la der phyung ste/ mngar gsum gzhug go/ /de nas chu bor 'dor ba'i tshe dam bsgrag par bya ste/ klu rnams khyed kyis bdag gi ngag mnyan na/ /yid bzhin nor ltar bsam pa 'grub pa dang / /mkha' lding rigs dang bye tshan gnod 5zhi ste/ /'dod yon lnga la bde bar longs spyod shog /ci ste nga yi bka' las 5'das gyur na/ /mkha' lding bye tshan rims kyi char phab nas/ /dus rnams rtag tu nad kun ldang ba dang / /phyag na rdo rjes mgo bo ( 7 bkas gyur cig /ces brjod klu la gtor ma gtang 7ba dang / rnam thos sras kyang spyan drangs te gtor ma rgya chen po btang ngo / /bsgrub bya bsrung ba ni/bcom ldan drang srong chen po khyod8/ /sum mdo'i rigs mtshan ldan pa la/ /ji ltar bsrung bar dam bcas pa/ /de ltar 'di la bsrung 9bar mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ de nas mar gyi dgang drugs phul te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ bzod par gsol te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs bshad 'di la nyes pa gang / /lus can kun gyi skyabs gyur pa'i/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo 7nus pa ma mchis shing / /ma 'tshal ba dang ma rnyed pas/ /bdag gis bgyis pa gang bgyis pa/ /de kun makan pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces brjod do/ /oṃ khyod 1kyis sems cad don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sprul/ / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /4sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la gshegs par bsam/ de nas dam tshig sems dpa' rang la bsdu/ de nas byin za la mchod bstod byas nas 27byed9/4

me lha'i zhabs drung gi thal bas bdag dang yon bdag bsrungs te/ smon lam gdab po/ /rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khrod kyis mdzad lags kyis / /rang gi yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol / /e bye hi gats+tshaḥ1zhes bya bas 2gshegs su gsol/ /de nas dam tshig gi me lha rim gyis tha mal pa'i me la thim par bya'o/ /de nas thal ba slong ba la sbyin no/ /'byung po thams cad 'dul ba'i rgyud chen las/ /btus te sbyin sreg cho ga mdor dran byas/ /des ni 'gro ba'i gdon dang sdig zhi nas / /klu rnams kun gyi 4gnod pa bral gyur cig /rje btsun phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ slob dpon bram ze nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //sbyin sreg gi dus su bstod pa ni/ hūṃ gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar / /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams / /bdud dgra khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ /hūṃ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi5/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ta kṛta bya ba'i khro rgyal gyes/ /deng gi dgug bya 'dir khug sbug /nam mkha' stong pa 'gugs byed na/ /gzugs dang ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /sems med ri bo'ang 'gugs byed na/ /sems dang ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang ni/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i spyor ba yis/ /bar du gcod pa'i bgegs chen rnams/ /ched dang don du 'dir khug cig /rnam thos sras klu brgyad dang bcas pa 'gugs na/37—9/pya
