༄/ /phyag na rdo rje rdo rje snying po'i man ngag ces bya ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/3 ༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo je snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar rnal 'byor pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su byi dor bya ba dang / ba'i rnam lngas byug pa la sogs pa rgyud nas ji ltar 'byung 3/ba bzhin byas la/ yo byad tshogs pa dang / stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa mdun kyi nam mkha' la sbyan drangs te / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa dbul ba dang / yan lag bdun pa byas la de'i rjes su 4tshad med pa bzhi bsgom 5par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ3 sarba dharmāḥsteswa bhā ba shusgo38haṃ zhes bya bas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rnam par dag par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la mdun du paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du hūṃ/ de 'phros 'dus pas sems can gyi 37—918

—sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bsal nas slar 'dus pa las rdo rje'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bstan pa/zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gdug pa'i tshogs kyis sgu la brgyan par bsgom/ de nas sprerang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la mchod nas rang la bstem par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya ste/ rang gi spyi bor mi bskyod pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te ji srid du sems mi 'phro bar gzhag par bya'o/ /mi rtog pa bsgom par bya'o / /drag po'i las byed par 'dod na rdzas la sogs pa ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/de las 'od 'phros pas rdul phra rab thams cad rdo rje'i snying por byas te 'dus pa las rdo rje'o/ /de las rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer bsgom par bya'o/ /yang na skad cig gis stong par bsams te/ cho ga gsum gyis phyag na rdo rjer ldang bar bya'o / /yang na badz+ra badz+ra t+t+waṃ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis skad cig 4gi tshe chu las nya ldang ba 5ltar rdo rje snying por ldang bar bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms nas ldang bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying gar sa bon gyi mthar/ badz+ra badz+ra hūṃ zhes brjod pas rang brtan par byas la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dug 'jig par 6byed pa'i sngags brgya'am lnga bcu la sogs pa thog 7ma nyid du zlos par bya ste/ des klu'i dug 'jil bar byed pa'o/ /de nas mtha' yas bskyed rapar bya ste/ mdun du 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho'am/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du phuḥ las/klu ma/tha' yas sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod mi/ smad 37—97/9

sbrul / mgo la sbrul mgo dgu yod pa/ sbrul rigs lnga'i gdan la bzhugs pa/rang dang 'dra ba'i btsun mos 'khyud par 1bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ klu'i gnas nas mtha' yas rang rgyud la bkug la bstim par bya'o/ /de nas bdag la bka' nod par byas la/ klu'i srog snying dang bcas pa bzlas te/ 'di ni bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ /de yang tshogs sogs pa la ni/ rang dang klu gnyis ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ 'dus pas sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /drag po la ni 'od zer nag po dang dmar po dang me lta bu 'am/ yang na rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo'am rlung grangs med pa 'phros te/ de dag gis gnod pa dpag tu med pa byed par bsam mo/ /de yang rgyun du ni bsnyen pa nyid do/ /gdon thams cad la ni sngags thams cad do/ /yang na gang yin pa de nyid do/ /'jog par 'dod na gtor ma btang la bstod nas phrin las bcol zhing gshegs par mkhyen par byas nas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang gi sa bon la bsdu bar bya'o / /de nas smon lam gdab pa dang / 'dod don 4la sogs pa ci bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /bla ma'i bka' drin mnos pa la brten te/ /sgrub 5thabs man ngag sbrang rtsi rab tu btung / /'thung byed rab tu dang bas de dag la/ /rdo rje 'dzin nga nyid kyis skyo ba byed shog /rdo rje snying ngo 'i man ngag sgru ba nga 'i thabs zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na shrīs 6mdzad pa sdogs so// //37—9pya0

bsdur mchan/94/ hu7mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /rdo rje snying po'i man ngag sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// (yi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / 37〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ /④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/⑥⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa3/949 ①〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapar bya'o/ ge〈〈snar 〉mi badz+ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉 gi lhag 〈〈snar 〉〉 gis lhag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wab/ yi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya) dug 'jil bar/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉thogs/ 9kye〈〈pe 〉〉skyed / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/95༷ 1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya ste/ de nas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pado 'don pa/ ge)〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/ ༷'u7〈〈snar 〉〉sdi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1633)37wa 951

༄khya/ /rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga bzhugs/tsa ༄7/ /'phags pa gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga ni/ /rgyud chen mdo dang mi 'gal bar/ /bdag gis dran phyir bri bar bya/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /dang por bsnyen par bya ba ni/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod yon mchod pa dang / /tshul bzhin gtor ma bshams nas ni/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bskyed la/ /ye shes lha ni spyan drangs la/ /mchod pa lnga yis mchod de bstod/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du sgu gzugs gzhag /dam tshig lha ru byin brlabs nas/ /sgo bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /gnyis med gos sngon bsnyim byas la/ /mchod dang bstod pa gong bzhin bya/ /med na maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad legs bris la/ /de dbus hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ /dam tshig lha ru bskyed byas nas/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor 37—952

bsnyim zhing mchod/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /'bum mam khri yi bar du bzlas—/ /mtshan ma byung na 1dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /dang por sa gzhi brtag byas la/ /khru gang yang na khru do ru/ /brus nas skyon rnams bsal bar bya/ /nang du nor bu rin chen gzhug /'thas par bcag 2la dri yis byug /lha yi dkyil 'khor bskyed byas la/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma la/ /mchod bstod gsol btab bka' yang bsgo/ /dam tshig can gyi srung ma la/ /gtor ma sbyin la phrin las gzhol4/ /pus btsugs lag tu spos thogs la/ /ye shes lha la gsol ba gdab/ /de nas sa yi bgegs rnams kyang / /drag po'i 5sngags kyis bskrad par bya/ /skyon bral dngul gye bum pa ni/ /lto ba che la mgrin pa ring / /rgyan dang mchu ni rdzogs byas la/ /byin brlabs gos sngon lhar bskyed cing / /spyan drangs mchod yon mchod pas mchod/ /bzlas pa brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sta gon ni/ /me tog bkram zhing gsang sngags bzlas/ /gdan dang lha ru bskyed byas la/ /de la mchod cing gsol ba gdab / /lan gsum rab tu brjod par bya/ /de nas blo ldan slob ma la/ /khrus byas lus ni dris byugs la/ /me tog thogs la phyag 'tshal gzhug /gsol gdab gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /skyabs 'gro sdig bshags la sogs kun/ /yan lag bdun pa nyid kyang brjod6/ /slob dpon gyis brjod slob mas nyan/ /de nas sems bskyed cho ga ni/ /slob dpon slob ma gnyis kas bzlas/ /de ltar slob ma snod ldan la/ /dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /dri yi thig le gsum byas la/ /nyi ma zla ba pad+ma gsum/ /snying ga la sogs dgod par bya/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gi 7yi ge las/ /'bras bu sgu gsung thugs lhar bsgom/ /me tog 37—953

spos la sogs pas mchod/ /srung skud la sogs sbyin byas la/ /chos bshad rmi lam brtag par bya/ /nang par sngar langs dkyil 'khor bri/ /'dab ma brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dbus su gos sngon dgod par bya/ / dhū pe 1la sogs lha mo dang / /sgo ba bzhi yang dgod par bya/ /ba dan la sogs rgyan rnams dang / /mchod pa gtor ma dgram par bya/ /de nas ting 'dzin tshul bskyed la/ /gzhug pa'i cho ga bya ba ni/ /gtor ma btang 2la 'thor 'thung bya/ /gsol btab gdong g.yogs bcings pa dang / /bka' bsgo me tog dor byas la/ /mig phye lha yi ngo yang bstan/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang bskur te/ /dang por bum pa lag thogs la/ /bkra shis glur blangs bum dbang bskur1/ /oṃ sid+dhi sid+dhi zhes bzlas/ de nas sngags ring gi mjug 4la/ /a bhi ṣidzi 5zhes btags la/ /chu yi 6de ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dbu rgyan la sogs pa/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang mthun pa yi7/ /byas la rjes su gnang ba sbyin/ /de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la sogs pa thams cad bslab 8la/ /de nas lha la mchod bstod bya/ /de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas gos sngon can bsgrub 9cing / /bye brag gi ni las thams cad sgrub 11tu rung ngo / /de nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po nag po pa dang / tshul khyems rgyal bas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //37—95/

bsdur mchan/952 3mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa༅/ /rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /953 (kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉das/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bcags/ (ge〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉gcol/ (1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉poske/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis bya/ phya〈〈snar 〉〉wagi/954 —19〈〈pe 〉〉du pe/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dhu po/ 2)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉togatang / sa 〈〈pe 〉〉skur/ 67〈〈pe 〉〉rings kyi 'jug 〈〈snar 〉〉rigs kyis 'jug (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣiñca/ ge〈〈pe〉stanas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapa yi/ tshoskye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las bslabs/ por〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrubs/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyanas/ 31〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'grub/ nyu5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1634)37wa 955

༄/ /phrag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/nyu༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nī dze+e ba ra dha ra 2badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon —can la phyag 'tshal lo//nyes pa kun bcom de nyid rtogs gyur kyang / /thugs rje'i rgyun gyis 'jigs pa'i sku sprul pa/ /klu dbang la sogs gdug pas phyag byas pa'i/ /gos sngon phyag na rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig mthong bas sbug bsngal sel 'gyur zhing / /gang du smin pas dngos grub skal gyur phyir/ /dri med rgyud mang mthong dang bla ma yi/ /drin thob gyur pas dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /gang zhig dbang rnams rim thob dam tshig ldan/ /brtan zhing dul ba bzod ldan blo gros che/ /dpa' zhing brtson ldan drang 4la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi 37—956

sbyor ba rab shes dang / /de nyid bcu shes dkyil 'khor dz+re bar mkhas/ /mtshan nyid dang ldan gyur pa'i bla ma la/ /skal ldan slob mas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ /snod ldan gyur na bla mas gnang ba sbyin/ /slob ma'i lte bar hūṃ gi yi ge ni/ /du ba'i mdog can 'od zer 'bar ba bsam/ /snying kar shaṃ yig nag po sdig pa yi/ /rang bzhin bltas te hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /sna rtser bton te ltung bas sdig pa ni/ /mi sdug gcer bu skra gol nyam 1thag cing / /til mar kyis bsgos gnag la rid pa bsam/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje gnod sbyin la / /badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs sngags kyis zos pa'am/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i phur bus gdab par bya/ /saṃ las kun tu bzang po bskyed nas ni/ /snying gar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bsam/ /spyi bor gtugs te rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis / /bzlas te slob ma yongs su bsrung bar bya/ /dbe+en zhing nyams dga'i gnas su bdag nyid ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum ldan mtshan ma thob pa'am /bzlas pa 'bum rdzogs yang na zla gcig dang / /zla drug la sogs bsnyen pa dze+egs par bya/ /de ltar bsnyen pa yongs sdogs nas/ /khang stong dag gam dur khrod dang / /sbrum med drag po'i las can dang / /de bzhin tshang tshing mi bzad 'jigs/ /de la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /drag po'i las kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /yang na yid ni gang dag tu/ /nges par dga' ba skye 'gyur ba/ /mdor na sa gzhi nyams dga' dang / /mdangs gsal shar du gzhol bar bshad/ /yul der dkyil 'khor bri ba yi/ /las ni legs par sbyar bar bya/ /tsan+dan a ka ru sogs la/ /dri zhim chu dang ba sogs kyis4/ /chag chag legs par gdab par bya/ /phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma ni/ /37—957

spyin par byas te gsol ba gdab/ /sa yi lha mo sku mdog ser/ /phyag gnyis bum pa bsnams pa ni/ /blos bkug mchod de gsol ba gdab/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin pa yis1/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes brjod nam mkhar 'degs 2par bya/ /bdag dang slob ma sa bdag sogs/ /zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dang ni/ /bgegs rnams bzlog par bya ba'i phyir/ /zhi dang drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas pus nub 'dom gang bar/ /brus te rdo dang rus sogs bsal / /slar yang sa yis rīde nyid 5dgang / /gal te lhag par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub yod par ston pa yin/ /de ltar sbyang ba byas pa dang / /dri zhim chu dang sbyar ba'i sas/ /gru bzhi shin tu 'thas 6byas te / /dri zhim chu dang ba yi lngas/ /shar nas brtsams te legs byugs la/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi khang brtsegs ma/ /rta babs skar khung dra ba can/ /me tog chun 'phyang sogs ldan pa'i/ /khang pa'i nang chud rgyan sogs dgram/ /de nas hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ zhes pas/ /rnam par dag pa'i nam mkhar bsam/ /hūṃ sum̐ hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i ri rab bskyed/ /de steng hūṃ lo hūṃ byung ba'i / /gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi pa/ /babyed de thal bcings kha sbub la/ /sngags kye byen gyes brlab par bya/ /i me dī ni badz+rī bha ba ban+dha hūṃ/ /de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal rgo/ /bsrung ba'i sngags kyis bsrung bya ba/ /sa yi cho gar gsungs pa yin/ /de nas bdag nyid khrus byas shing / /shin tu sngo ba'i gos bgos te/ /ji snyed rgyan gdags dri zhim bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus nas shar du bltas/ /ji ltar sgrub thabs las bshad pa'i/ /ting 'dzin 37—9pya8

gsum ni bsgom pa dang / /bzlas pa dag la brtson pa la/ /grog 1mchog rnams kyis bstod gsol gdab/ /gsang ba'i bdag po brtson chen po/ /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra ba'i lus/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i bdag po brtson chen po/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang 'dra ba'i ngag /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i bdag po brtson chen po/ /sangs rgyas thugs dang 'dra ba'i yid/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag /rdo rje thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul byed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de ltar gsol gdab bdag po yi/ /nga rgyal brtan pas langs nas ni/ /bdag nyid rang bzhin rdo rje can/ /phyag na rdo rje'ang 2 bdag rang yin/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen rnal 'byor can bdag yin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal po'i bdag /phyag na rdo rje brtan bdag ste/ /byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro/ /zhes brjod badz+red tiṣ+ṭha 4yis/ /dkyil 'khor mkhar bteg ma ṭa yis5/ /nyi ma zla ba hūṃ mtshan nyid / /rkang 'og hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsam byas nas/ /bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis yongs bskor bas/ /bgegs bskrad 6ra ba sa gzhi kun/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du bsam/ /de nas dbus su gnas nas ni/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson/ /bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor gyis/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba po/ /brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs/ /sa 27—959

'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs/ /gal te dam tshig la 1'das na/ /rdo rje khro bo bzhin 'bar ba'i/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas zhing / /zhig par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /zhes brjod byang shar nas brtsams te/ /khro bo'i gar gyi 'dor stangs kyis/ /drag tu lan gsum bskor byas la/ /dbus 'dug bden pa'i byin rlabs 27brjod/ /bdag slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas/ slob ma che ge mo zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyis kyang bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dri bas lha dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / brjed byed dang / 'byung po dang / mkha' 'go ma dang / mi 'am ci dang / rig sngags grub pa rgan po dang / rgan mo 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang ba'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig/gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni/ phyag na rdo rje t+t+waṃ zhes bya ba rab tu 'bar ba khro bzhin 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis mgo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par byed do/ /de ltar brjod nas dbus su ni/ /mthun pa'i stang stabs —shar la sogs / /phyogs bzhir stang stabs 5bzhi yis ni/ /bgegs rnams tshar gcad srung / 'khor bya/ /de nas phur bu lnga la ni/ /dri byugs me tog srad bu dmar / /btags te zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /smad ni mdung ltar byen brlabs te/ /phur pa'i gsang sngags legs brjod la/ /gha gha la sogs kyis gdab bya/ /de nas dbus su dris byugs la/ /baṃ las sa yi lha mo bskyed/ /37—960

bkug ste mchod la gsol ba gdab/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde1/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes ni lan gsum brjod de bstem/ /de nas dri yis legs byugs la/ /dri yi thig le dgu byas te/ /me tog tshom bu lhar bskyed la/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor phab mchod bstod/ /rdo rje 'chang ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kyi bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha 2rnams ba/nga / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang yang rdo rje spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams / /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni / /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse bas ni dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes ni lan gsum gsol btab 4la/ /mchod dang bstod pa rgyas par bya/ /de nas bum pa dgu 'am bcu/ /mtshan nyid dang ldan bkru byas te/ /rigs kyi mtshan mas mtshan byas la/ /sman 'bru rin chen lnga dri chu/ /stsal te mgul bcings kha brgyan la/ /rnam rgyal bum pa 37—96/

—gtso bo'i mdun/ /lhag ma phyi rol dag la dgod1/ /las byed bum pa sgo 'gram 'god2/ /baṃ las bum bskyed de'i nang du/ /lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed la/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug sogs bya/ /mchod bstod byas te gtso bo la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sa bon de nyid gsum ldan be+e / /lhag ma rnams ni bzla bar bya/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i/ /slob ma nang du bos byas la/ /sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan / /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya / /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces brjod slob mas gsol ba gdab/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khrod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig 4de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon ngo/ bdag di 'jug par 'tshal/ /te ltar lan gsum brjod nas rgo/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /bu tshur jeg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun 27—962

gyis 1gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dgra yang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod slob mas bshags sogs bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgye/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes su 4rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub tu sems bskyed/ /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du/ /khu tshur spos chur ldan pa yis/ /thig le byas te zla ba dang / /pad+ma nyi stengs yig gsum dgod/ /sku gsung thugs su byin brlabs nas/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /'khor lo'i 5nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /dus kun du ni bde bar mnos6/ /zhes brjod me tog sogs kyis mchod/ /a shwat+pā 7sogs so shing ni/ /sor bcu gnyis dang 8srog chags med / /rtse mo me tog gis btags sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi la / /shar ram byang du bltas te dor/ /byang shar lho nub steng 'og tu/ /zhi rgyas mngon spyod dbang rig 'dzin/ /sa 'og dngos grub phyir khrung med/ /khro tweḥsogs sngags skyor chu blud/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal bzlas pa yi9/ /ku sha stan dang sngas su sbyin/ /sngags de bzlas pa'i srung sgud ni/ /mdud pa gsum ldan dpung g.yas bcing / /de nas bzengs bstod 11phyir 'chos pa/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung ngo / /gsang 37—963

sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa bgyis par kye 'gyur ba gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas 'byung 5bar 'gyur lags 1ran/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla med thob par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros rtag tu mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu//sbug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med di ring rnyed/ gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /spyod rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen po pa//'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /de ltar chos bshad spro bskyed la/ /bzhin bzangs longs la song shig dang / /sang ni thar pa chen po yi/ /grong khyer mchog ni mthong 'gyur zhes/ /brjod la nyal du gtang bar bya/ /slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /mtha' logs dag tu nyal bar bya/ /de ltar lhag gnas rdzogs byas nas/ /nang par skya rengs shar ba dang / /lha yi rnal 'byor ldan byas te/ /slob ma'i rmi lam brtag byas la/ /ngan na sbyin sreg gis bzlog bya/ /nyi ma shar kar gyur pa dang / /dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg byas la/ /thig gdab pa ni brtsam 537—964

par bya/ /sar pa legs par bkal nas kyang / /tshad dang ldan 1pa'i mdzes pa ni/ /kha dog so sor bsgyur byas la/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ dīḥ.āḥ2hūṃ bkod de/ /'bar ba'i lha rnams bkug nas ni/ /gcig tu bsgril bar bya ba yin/ /a spyo n+ya a 4nu ga ta sarba dharmā sga ra sga ra 5sarba dharmā at+yan ta a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā 6ti kra ma hūṃ/ grogs mchog khams gsum rnam rgyal du/ /dmigs te dzaḥ7gsum gyis thig drang / /shar dang byang ltar tshangs thig gdab/ /mer gnas byang du bltas pa dang / /rlung nas lho ru bltas pa dang / /de nyid nas ni shar bltas dang / /me gnas nub tu bltas pa yis/ /phyi yi thig bzhi gdab par 9bya/ /me dang bden bral du gnas te/ /mtshams kyi thig gnyis gdab par bya/ /de bzhin tshangs pa'i thig nas ni/ /phyi yi thig gi bar du ni/ /ngos rer bdun bdun gdab par bya/ /de bzhin sgo khyud logs dang ngos/ /'gram dang ya phubs kyang gdab bya/ /sgo ni 'khor lo brgyad kyi cha//sgo khyud lha rnams sgo yi tshad/ /kha khyer dra phyed de yi phyed/ /tshon sna lnga ni kha khyer phyed/ /rta babs sgo yi sum 'gyur ro/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /mchod snam bzhi yis yongs su bskor/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs su bskor/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /bla re rnga yab me long dang / /gos dang me tog phreng gis brgyan / /lha rdzas bsnams pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /ba dan rtse mo rlung baspyod ldan / /de ltar legs par thig btab nas/ /tshon dgye ba 7ni brtsam par bya / /rin chen lnga yi phye ma 'am/ /yang na sa yi phye ma ni/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan pa la/ /sa bon lnga dang ldan byas te/ /'bar ba'i lta bas sangs rgyas lnga//37—965

spyan drangs tshon la bsnyim par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ phur bu'i bu ga bkang nas ni/ /dbang ldan nas brtsams bri bya ste/ /ma chad ya yo med par bri/ /dkar po ser po dmar dang ljang / /sngon po nang du bri bar bya/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar ba ste/ /lho dang nub dang byang dang dbus/ /ser po dmar po ljang dang nag1 /legs par bris nas mtshan ma dgod/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang 2/ /sbrul brgyad mjug ma bsnol ba la/ /nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje che/ /sngon po rtse lnga 'od zer can/ /shar sogs le tshe bzhi la ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 4steng 'jigs byed dang / /stag dang chu srin mi rnams la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ldan par bya/ /chu srin steng du zla ba bri/ /de rnams steng du rdo rje che/ /rtse mo dgu pa nyid dang ni/ /tsan+dan bud shing pad+ma dang / /rin po che rnams bri bar bya/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan rnams la/ /gri gug sbrul gyi pags pa dang / /sbal pa'i khrag ldan thod pa dang / /gri ste mtshan ma bzhi bri bya/ /de ltar legs par bri byas la/ /me tog chal pa bkram 5nas ni/ /gzhan yang rgyan rnams legs par dgod6/ /de nas dgongs 7ka'i dus su ni/ /khrus byas nang du zhugs byas la/ /gzhal yas khang bslang shugs 'jug bya/ /oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/oṃ/ badz+ra be gā kra ma t+t+waṃ/ lhag chad bskangs te me tog ni/ /bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya/ /de nas sgo phye phyir byung ba/ /dang po spyor ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /gnas nas lha rnams spro bar bya/ /so sor gnas su gdan bskyed la / /bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /zla nyi sa bon ldan spros pas / /de las so sos mtshan par gyur/ /de las lha rnams kun rdzogs bsgom/ /37—966

nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bkug 1nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgom par bya / /bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /nam mkhar rgyal ba spyan drangs la/ /mchod bstod gsol btab dbang bsgur ba2/ /kun gyi dbu la mi bskyod pa/ /lha rnams kun gyi gnas gsum du/ /de nyid gsum gyis byen brlab bya/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mchod bstod bya/ /phyogs skyong la sogs gdon tshogs la/ /gtor ma rgya chen sbyin par bya/ /de nas zhi ba'i thab khung du/ /lha rnams sbyin sreg gis tshim bya/ /de nas bum pa so so la/ /sngar bzhin bzlas pas mnyes par byas4/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid ni5/ /'jug dang dbang bsgur ba yi rim/ /slob ma'i rang 6bzhin 'dir spyad bya/ /de nas slob ma gzhug don du/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs 7brjod par bya/ /nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag 'grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dga' ba kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub r+shamadzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /37—967

sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur zhing / /'dod chags dam tshig gyur pa'o/ /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par bskyed1/ /bden pa 'di yis 2dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /de ltar slob dpon bdag zhugs la/ /slob ma 'jug pa brtsam par bya/ /las byed bum pas khrus byas la/ /ras sngon gdong g.yogs phyi rol dgug /'dod pa dag pa gang yin smros / /bdag ni skal bzangs 4zhes brjod de/ /de nas slob dpon phyag byas la/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyed ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol btab la/ /me tog thob pa'i slob ma yis/ /sdig pa bshags la sogs pa bya/ /slar yang gsol ba gdab bya ste/ /gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /thub pa'i nyi ma ma lus nga// /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba'i/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor lo sbyor/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen po 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba thams cad bsdus pas ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /37—968

skal ba chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag 3ldan/ /sangs rgyas sgu ni yid 'ong ba'i/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur chen po rmad byung ba'i/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyi/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis2/ /che ge zhes bya /'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin pa'i/ /dam tshig mchog dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'di ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de ltar gsol btab 'dod don dri/ /gsang chen po yi rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba chen po yongs 'dzin par—/ /bdag nyid chen po 'dod dam ci/ /des kyang 'tshal 5zhes brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan par 'gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo chen khyod kyis gzung 6bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin7/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ /37—969

gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ / spangs shing 1dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i thong bar shes par bya/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho spom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi spyod cing / /rdzun 4du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa la 5 bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi 6las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi rnams dang / /yid kyi 7rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su spongs / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can rnams /la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yod mi spong / /rtag tu mya ngan 'da' mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya zhing / /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khrod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar byarka/ /des kyang 'di skad brjod bya ste/ /slob dpon 'di ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid 'tshal zhes/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin khas blang bya/ /de nas slob ma sems bskyed de/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi / de nas snying gar rdo rje ni/ /sngags 'dis rab tu gzhag par bya/ /su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sid+dhi ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas slob ma lhar bskyed la/ /dri la sogs pa lngas mchod bya/ /me tog thogs pa'i slob ma yis/ /bla ma yon 37—970

gyis mnyes byas la/ /las byed bum pas dbang bskur te/ /gung mos me tog bzung 1byas la/ /sgo bzhi nas bcug shar du gnas/ /deng khyed de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gi 2 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob 4na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis5/ khyod dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ de nas sngags 'dis chu 'thung gzhug /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis6/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badzod ka ṭhaḥ/deng 7nas brtsams te khyod kyis 8phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /yid 9mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ de nas gdams 1 ngag ji lta bas1 / /slob ma'i rgyud la dbab par bya/ /legs par babs par shes pa dang / /'di ltar bdag gis rka slob ma ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni les/sa bcug nas/ /'di yi bsod nams ci 'dra las/ /lha yis rim bzhin 'bab par shog /'di ni dngos grub gang gyur dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod gyur dang / /bsod nams mthu ni ci yod dang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /de nas rnge tog bcom ldan gyi / /dbu la brtan pas dor bar bya/ /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ /deng ngame tog be+er bcings nasas/ /pra ti kṛṇ+ḍi sal sogs brjod/ /dngos grub gang 'grub mtshan ma ni/ /ci zhig mthong zhes dri bar bya/ /sngags 'dis gdong 7 g.yogs bkrol 8byas te/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' khyod la deng / /mig 'byed 37—97/

pa la brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed 'tshal te/ /rdo rje'i 1mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ de nas lha rnams legs bstan la/ /dbang bskur ba ni brtsam par bya/ /slob ma bzhag 2ste lhag byas la/ /gnas gsum de nyid gsum 'god de/ /dri la sogs pa lngas mchod bya/ /bkra shis brjod cing bum pa yis/ /chu yi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bye ṣidzi4 / sa bon lnga las skyes pa yi/ /cod pan mgo bor bcing lhabyas la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /di ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab grub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ a bye ṣispya mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu gnyis/ /'khyud pa'i tshul du 'dzin du gzhug /de nas rdo rje dril bu gnyis/ /slob dpon spyi bor gzung bya 6la/ /badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣidzi 7mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nā ma a ste ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa zhes ming 'dis dbang bsgur bar bya/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol ba gdab/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don kyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba/ /thugs rje can khrod bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la di ring stsal du gsol/ /de ltar gsol btab hūṃ las ni/ /rdo rje rab tu bskyed byas la/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma bdag po'i gtso / /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /āḥ9las dril bu bskyed bya ste / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod/ /khyed kyis kyang ni rab 1rtatu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu 37—972

rgyal ba bzhed/ /slob ma'i lag tu sbyin bya la/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pas/ /srid pa 1dag pa'i mchog tu byed/ /de ltar brjod la dkrol bar bya/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes byar brjod/ /gang gis lus kun brtan 2byed pa/ /de nas phyag rgyar rab tu grags / /de rjes dkyil 'khor dag pa dang / /lha yi rnam dag slob dpon gyi/ /bya ba'i rim pa legs par bslab / /de nas gser gyi thur thogs te/ / ji ltar 4mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal 5ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam̐ byāḥ6/ de nas me long rab bstan la/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung 7du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /rang bzhin dag phyir bdag med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams 9shes byas nas/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ / āḥyis dril bu rab byin la/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yis/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /hoḥ11yis mda' drug gzhu byin la/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams mnyes gyis shig /brjod la mda' drug 'phen du gzhug /badz+ra satwas me long bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid gtso / /rkang pa'i bar du 'khor lo ni/ /badz+ra he tus bcug byas la/ /oṃ 37—973

—badz+ra 1bha ṣa re gyis ni/ /lag pa g.yas par dung byin la/ /g.yon par po ti legs sbyin la/ /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis je tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ /sngags mchog tshul gyis gdug pa rnams/ /skye bo rnams kyi 4don du chom/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /khyod la rtag tu skul bar 5byed/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dul gyur 6sna tshogs pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor7/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen pad / /las kyi 'khor lo'i rjes gnang sbyin/ /de nas lung bstan 8 dbugs dbyung 9sogs/ /ji skad gsung bzhin sbyin par bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /rtag tu khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha ra yā mi hi nyi hi hi hūṃ—/ zhes pas brtul zhugs sbyin par bya/ /de nas 'byor pa'i yon bdag gis/ /bla ma rjes su mnyes par bya/ /zhi ba yi ni thab khung du/ /sbyin sreg gis ni tshim par bya/ /de nas rdul tshon la sogs ni/ /'dod pa'i mi la sbyin pa 'am/ /chu bo chen por dor bar bya/ /klu rigs kun gyi dgrar gyur pa'i/ /gos sngon dkyil 'khor cho ga byas//'di la 'khrul pa mthong na yang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /'di byas dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rdo rje can kyi zhal mthong nas / /sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol bar shog /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 37—97

gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /slob dpon chen po stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin snying rtarje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta don yod pa'i rdo rje dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa ba ri dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/956 —1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉g.yo/ /phyag na rdo rje rgos sdon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi cho ga bzhugs so/ /2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dha ra/ 〈〈snar 〉7ngo// 4〈〈snar 〉〉drangs/957 —1 〈〈pe 〉〉〉mas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉la/ 2 〈〈pe 〉rolas/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sam/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/958 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshan/ 2 〈〈pe 〉stanas nam mkhar gdeg 〈〈snar 〉donas mkhar gdegs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉gsal—/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉giyis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉 kyis/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉'das/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/959 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉gi'ang / 〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉ti ṣa/ 5〈〈pe 〉skrus/6〈〈pe 〉〉skra da/ 〈〈pe 〉tha// rjed/ 〈〈snar 〉tha// brjed/96༷ 1 〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 4 5〈〈pe 〉〉thabs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung /961 1 〈〈pe 〉〉gis bdud kyis sde/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi bdud kyi steng / 'e 〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dri na/ 〈〈snar 〉toradri/ 4〈〈pe 〉sngagatab/962 —1 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedagod/ ri 〈〈pe 〉〉la/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉〉gas/963 1〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/ —〈〈snar 〉ge rna'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉chen po/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(na/ 5〈〈pe 〉ra 'i/ 〈〈snar 〉da 'i/6〈〈pe 〉sngaganos/ — 〈〈snar 〉〉shāt+tha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drang / 9 〈〈snar 〉(yis/ 7〈〈pe 〉ra srung / ba〈〈pe 〉〉gzengs stod/964 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagyi bar/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skarabyang / 〈〈snar 〉phrog 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ang /5〈〈snar 〉mirtsams/37—975

༄/ /khro bo rdo rje 'dze+en ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/she༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra kro dha dha ra sā dha na thunā ma/ bod skad du/ khro bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa la gnod pa yi/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsrung ba'i zuphyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin mchog sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'bad pa'i blo yis bsgrub par bya/ /dang por stan bde la 'dug ste/ /skad cig gcig gis rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal por bskyed pa yi/ /snying ka'i sa bon 'phros 5pa las/ /'gro ba sbyangs pa 6snarnam gsum bya/ /mchod pa'i lha rnams spyan drangs te/ /mnyes pa'i don du lus sprul bya/ /snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga dag kyang / /spro bsnyu'i tshul/ gyis brgyan par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta a gar+bha 3badz+ra puṣ+pe t+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dhū 8pe hūṃ/ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ badz+ra gabye hūṃ/ badz+ra ne wi bye hūṃ/ shede nas pus mo sar btsugs te//37—978

rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /rab tu gus pas 'di brjod bya/ /bsags sdig ji snyed bshags par bgyi/ /tshogs rnams kun la rjes yi rang zab mo'i 'khor lo bskor bar bsgul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dge ba thams cad mchog tu bsngo/ /lus nyid kyang ni rnam par dbul/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskyed bya/ /bdag gis sdogs sangs rgyas thob shog /de nas byams dang snying rje dang / /dga' ba 1btang snyoms bsgom par bya/ /de nas snod bcud rnam par sbyangs2/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta/ ces brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /t+t+waṃ las rgya gram dra ba'i mchog /pad+ma zla ba'i steng dag tu/ /hūṃ las khro bo'i sgur bskyed bya/ /badz+ra hūṃ ka ra zhes pas/ /rab tu 'jigs pa'i khro bo ni/ /in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog can/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum 'jigs pa 4bzhin/ /sma ra mgo skyes ser la mdzes/ /sbrul sngon za zhing mche ba gcigs/ /g.yas na rdo rje gdengs pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa bsdigs pa'i mdzub mo ste/ /sbrul nag se ral kha ru bzung / /a la la yi gad mo sgrogs/ /klu brgyad dag gis brgyan pa'i sgu/ /pad+ma'i gdan la brkyang bsgum bzhugs/ /stag gi 5pags pas smad dkris pa/ /brgyan la ye shes sems bsgom bya/ /sa bon 'od kyis mchog bkug nas/ /gong gi mchod pas mnyes byas te/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yang brjod/ /oṃ na maḥ6swā hā ri shusbyo pa yo na maḥ7shud kri badz+ra pā ṇi na maḥ8sa ro na paṃ sarba wa shāṭī ṣa ka ri te he te7/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med nas/ /lha mo bzhi las dbang blangs pa'i/ /rtags ni mi bskyod cod pan rtser/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bzlas pa ni/ /37—979

tar+ya thā sgo bho 1zhes bya ba nas/ rā dz+nyā 2pa ya ti swā hā zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /sgra che ma yin chung ma yin/ /rang bzhin gsal ba'i bzlas pa ni/ /mi skyo bar du ci bder bya/ /de nas spro basbu ji snyed pa'i/ /mtha' la bsdu ba byas nas kyang / /stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /slar la bskyed la phyag rgya dkrol/ /oṃ āḥ t+t+waṃ muḥde nas spyod pa ci bder spyad/ /dam tshig nga rgyal gtang mi bya/ /de thun bzhi yi spyor ba yis/ /brtson par byas na nges par 'grub/ /dad ldan bla ma ldan pa dang / /dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin mchog gi/ /mchog gi dngos grub nyer rnyed 'gyur/ /khro rgyal rdo rje 'dzin mchog gi/ /sgrub thabs dam pa 'di dag nyid4/ /bdag gis brtsam par mi rigs kyang / /rgyud 'grel 5dgongs pa las btus byas/ /'di las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /'gro rnams rdo rje 'dzin par shog /khro bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //slob dpon ba su dha 6badz+ras mdzad pa'o// //37—980

༄/ /rdo rje 'dze+en pa'i sprun sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/kye7༄go/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sa gzhi shin tu legs pa la//thab khung rgyar ni nyakhru gang zhing / /zabs su khru phyed brkos pa dag /kha khyer sor bzhi gnyis dor bya/ /ba yi rnam pa lnga yis byugs/ /kha dog dkar po byas nas kyang / /dri dkar 'o ma me tog dor/ /dkyil du rdo rje sor brgyad pa/ /nang du rdo rjes — bskor nas kyang / /tha ma me yi 'od zer can/ /bya ba thab khung rim pa'o/ / tsan+dan pā 4la sha dag dang / /byang chub shing dang n+ya gro dha/ /dri bzangs dri zhim pa yi shing / /srog chags med cing ma rul ba/ /gsar pa khru gang tshad la ni/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi thubran nas kyang / /dri zhim pa yi chu yis gtor/ /thab kyi kho ra khor yug tu/ /ku sha rtse mo phyir bstan patre// /bkram la bud shing brtsig 7par bya/ /thab bas mtho na nyes par 'gyur/ /de ni bud shing rim pa'o/ /37—982

rtse mo'i cha las byung ba yi/ /yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis la/ /gsar zhing 'dab ma bcas pa dang / /drang zhing bla skams med pa ste/ /skyon dang bral ba'i yam shing la/ /mngar gsum dkar gsum dag gis bran/ /dri yi tshogs kyis bsangs nas kyang / /mchod pa'i don du g.yas su gzhag /de ni yam shing rim pa'o /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras chan dang / /'bras thug lag pan 7la du dang / /sman sna tshogs dang bza' ba'i rdzas/ /til la sogs pa ji snyed kun / /bsreg pa'i don du g.yas su gzhag /mar khu rdo rje dril bu dang / /dgang gzar blugs gzar mdun du'o/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri/ /bshos gtsang rol mo ji snyed pa/ /mchod pa'i don du g.yon du gzhag /mchod yon las kyi bum pa ni/ /mnyes dang bsang 2phyir g.yas su gzhag /mchod rdzas bsreg shurdzas rim pa'o/ /de nas skad cig lhar bskyed la/ /dus nas brtsams te mngon rtogs kyi4 //cho ga'i rim pa ji snyed pa/ /sgrub thabs bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /de ni rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyi/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas thab ni bsang byas la/ /a las pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang / /dkar zhing zlum pa mdzes pa bskyed/ /baṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /de steng paṃ las pad+ma'o/ /a dang ma las nyi ma'i gdan/ /hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po ste / /der bskyed pa ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhu bar 5re las gru gsum me/ /de nas me lha'i rgyal po ni/ /dkar zhing zhi la sgeg pa ste/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi skyil krung phyed/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / /tshangs pa'i 37—983

sgud pa se ral gzar1/ /g.yas na dbyug pa spyi blugs te/ /g.yon na phreng ba ku mu ta/ /dbu rgyan la sogs rgyan rab mdzes/ /bskyed la ye shes me lha dgug /gong ltar mchod pas mnyes byas la/ /dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ4sa dgug gzhug bya/ /dbang bsgur ba dang byin brlab pa/ /mchod pas rab tu mnyes byas nas/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di dag kyang / /rdo rje dril bu ldan pas kyang / /klu dang ldan pas bstod pa bya/ /hūṃ me lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa mchog gi sras / / me lha'i rgyal po dag gis dbang bsgur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid 9la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas dgang gzar blugs gzar ni/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon thogs nas kyang / /me lha bdud rtsi'i zhal nyid du/ /sngags 'di dag gis bsreg par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra agha ye ma hā byu tā dzā la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba duṭ+wān 1hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥ5che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ shābyeṅku 1 ru ye swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam lnga bcu ste/ /nyi shu lnga'am bdun du dbul/ /de ni me lha'i rim pa'o / /de nas me lha'i thugs ka'i nang / /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs sus/ /hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po ste/ /de las rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /gsal ba nyid du bskyed par bya/ /de nas mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /bstod pa dag kyang rab tu brjod/ /de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba ni / /rtsa ba'i sngags ni 'ba' zhig la/ /sreg sngags 'di dag btags la dbul / /oṃ sarba pū slodza me gha rat+na a gar+bha na maḥ7che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di shādhid+ku ru swā hā/ ji snyed spros pa phul nas kyang / /de nas mchod bstod yang byas te/ /gshegs dang bzod pa gsol nas kyang / /bsngo dang smon lam 37—984

gdab par bya/ /oṃ āḥ1hūṃ muḥ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig rang gi snying gar bsdu/ /mchod dang bsreg pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /lhag ma ji snyed yod pa yis/ /me lha mnyes par yang byas te/ /mchod pa la sogs gong bzhin no/ /ye shes me lha gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig 'bar ba'i rnam par bstem/ /bdag gis sbyin sreg sbyar ba yis/ /dngos grub myur du 'grub gyur cig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //slob dpon chen po ba su dha badz+ras mdzad pa'o// //brtsar mchan/982 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang la sa blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉8'i spyin sreb bi cho ga bzhugs / 〈〈snar 〉thab/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉rje/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉tsan dan pa / 〈〈snar 〉〉dz+ran nga// 5〈〈pe 〉〉rtsis— 6〈〈pe 〉phro/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉rtsig983 1〈〈pe 〉〉pran/ 2〈〈pe 〉sngasang / 〈〈snar 〉hreg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kus// 5〈〈pe 〉tha/984 1〈〈pe 〉sngagazad/ 〈〈snar 〉thazad/ 2〈〈snar 〉dze+e/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 5〈〈snar 〉ra/sa/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉des/7〈〈pe 〉〉lha yi/ 8〈〈snar 〉ra sreg 〈〈snar 〉〉nyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dha ta/ 〈〈snar 〉〉byu ta/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉duṣ+ṭi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉shan ting ku/ 〈〈snar 〉masatid+ku/ 5〈〈snar 〉ya/'o/ sa〈〈sna ra 〉lkeng du—/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ /〈〈pe 〉〉shan ting ku/ 〈〈snar 〉ma' tad+ku/ 〈〈pe 〉ra/sa/985 1〈〈snar 〉riḥ/37—985
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1637)37wa 986

༄ga /rdo rje 'dze+en pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/51 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra dha ra ba bo bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las rnams kun gyi sngon 'gro ba/ /bshad phyir bla ma la btud de/ /thams cad tshim rtepar byed pa yi/ /gtor ma'i cho ga de bshad bya/ /de la dang por rdo rje 'dzin/ sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis/rin po che las snod rgya che ba bzang la mnyam 4pa de dag gi nang du/ 'bras chan la sogs pa chan gyi tshogs dang / khur ba la sogs pa bza' ba'i tshogs dang / nya sha la sogs pa sha'i tshogs dang / 'o ma la sogs pa btung ba'i tshogs dang / bu ram la sogs te myang ba'i tshogs dang / bil ba la sogs te shing thog gi tshogs dang / til la sogs te 5'bru'i tshogs dang / ut+pal la 6sogs te me tog gi tshogs dang / a ga ru la sogs te bdug pa'i tshogs 37byed987

dang / rin po che la sogs te snang ba'i tshogs dang du ru ka dang dri zhim sbyar ba la sogs te dri'i tshogs dang / ga bur la sogs te sman gyi tshogs dang /rol mo dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / ras bzang po la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i yo byad bshams te/ maṇ+ḍal sngon po dag gi steng du me tog chal par 1bkram la de'i steng du gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid mngon par rtogs pa'i cho ga ltar bskyed la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du dri sbyar ba'i chu blugs la/ oṃ sarba bibyān 2nā sha ya a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gabyug tu brjod do/ /oṃ āḥbibyān+ta kṛta 4hūṃ phaṭa ces pas gtor ma lan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas yi ge t+t+waṃ 5ser po las bskyed pa'i snod kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ rdzas kyi 6dngos po dpag tu med pa bsams te/ de'i steng du zla ba'i 7hūṃ gis mtshan pa dag gi 'od kyis bsregs shing sbyangs pa'i bdud rtsi'i dngos por gyur par bsam mo de nas thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i 9rgyun lta bu 'bab pas snod gang bar bsams la/ o badz+ra pā ṇi rat+na dha rā ya/1 oṃ ya zhes lan bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa spyan drangs la badz+ra dzi hwa zhes lce rta byin kyis brlabs la sngags 'di lan bdun brjod la dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dha rā ya/ kā ya bā ka tsit+ta dhū 5pa/ puṣ+pe/ dī pa/ gabye ba bo/ ar+gha 5ta ba bo sam da māṃ sa i rda kṛṇ+ḍi 7khā hi khā hi bhuñja ho/ pi pa ho/ a ti kra ma ye swā hā / de nas thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis khams gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs 27—988

ma lus pa bkug ste/ oṃ badz+ra hūṃ ka ra ka ṭa ka ṭa 1phaṭa/ ces bya bas sbyar ro2 / /de thams cad rdo rje 'dzin gyi ngo bor gyur par bsams te/ yi ge gsum bkod la lce byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta4/ oṃ snyahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas 'byung po'i tshogs de dag mnyes par gyur nas/ rgyal bar gyur cig ces brjod par bsam mo/ /de nas 5lag tu me tog thogs te/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ bzod pa gsol ba ni/ t+t+waṃ lhag pa dang ni chad pas kyang / /bdag gis brjed ngas gang bgyis pa/ /mgon po khyod kyis bzod mdzad nas/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod la/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slang yang 'byon 6par mdzad du gsol//oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ de nas/ phyag rgya bkrol te/ gtor ma gtsang ma'i sa phyogs su bskyal 7la/ ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchod pa'i phyir/ /mchod spyin 'di brtsams bsod nams kyis/ /'go ba thams cad rgyas gyur te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// //slob dpon ba su dha badz+ras mdzad nga 'o// //27— 989

༄༅/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga las thams cad pa zhes bya ba/ 3—༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma sarba rak+ṣa bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/bsrung ba'i cho ga las thams cad pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang / /mi mthun thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bsrung ba'i 3 dam pa'i rim pa 'di/ /phan phyir bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis/dben pa'i sa phyogs su maṇ+ḍal logs re la khru re yod pa/ gru bzhi pa 'phangs su 4sor brgyad pa/ ngos shin tu mnyam pa brtsigs la/ de la ba'i rnam pa lngas byug pa bya'o/ /de'i steng du tsan+dan dang gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang po rnams kyis tresnyoms par byug par bya'o/ /de'i steng du me tog dri dang kha dog dang ldan pas rtselegs par spungs te/ de'i steng du srung 3ba'i 'khor lo bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ ras sam gos bzang bri ba ni3—/ /gur gum chu 37—991

yis 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gnyis bcas la/ /rgya gram nang du chud pa bri/ /oṃ dang swā hā'i bar dag tu/ /na mo ming dang spel ba ni/ /dri sna tshogs kyis 1thig le byas/ /lte ba dag tu dgod par bya/ /tsan+dan la sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /oṃ tsū phaṭa mthar bsres pa ni/ /rtsibs brgyad dag la rim bzhin no/ /mu khyud nang gi rim pa la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di kā ya bāka tsit+ta ā yu ṣe dz+re baṃ shrī te dza sarba rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/nang du lta ba'i tshul gyis bri4/ /phyi rol mu khyud yang de bzhin/ /mtshal dang dngul gyi khu ba yis/ /g.yas g.yon dag tu bri bar bya/ /ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa shwe ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ཿha ha 5ṭaṣ+ṭa/ a ā/ i yī u spru ṛ dzā lo shā6/ e i o au i aḥde nas 'khor lo de dag nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed bya ste/ /dgug gzhug mchod bstod byas nas kyang / /'khor lo'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ /rtsa ba ming dang bsrung ba'i sngags/ /spel ba'i bzlas pa stong du bya/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ cho ga'i rim pa 'di dag las nyams par mi bya'o/ /'di dag gis ni brgya byin la sogs pa gnod pa ches che ba dag kyang ma lus pa snye bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba dag kyang ma lus pa 8bsrung zhing (/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba dag kyang nges par bzlog rka par 'gyur ro/ /sngags mkhan 'di dag ni tshangs spyod kyi dka' thub kyis gnas par bya'o/ /tshes brgyad nas brtsams te bco lnga'i bar kyis cho ga'i rim pa 1 ji lta bar bya'o/ /bcu drug la 5'gro ba mnyes pa'i mchod rten sabya'o/ /sgo gsum gnod pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis bsrung mchog la legs sbyangs/ /'di la nye bar gzhol ba 37—992

༄ga /khro bo'i rgyal po phrag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sgrub pa'i thabs sna ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ byā dze+e ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi kro dha rā dza 5sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sgrub pa'i thabs / phyag na rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis ri bong 'dzin pa la/ /legs bzhugs khro rgyal klu dgra de btud nas/ /de bsnyen cho ga bla ma bzang po las/ /ji ltar 'ongs pa bdag nyid dran par bri/ /de la khro bo'i bdag po yang dag par bsnyen par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas tho rangs nyid du gdong bkru 4ba la sogs pa byas nas bsam gtan gyi sa la me tog gcal du bkram pas dga' bar byas pa'i dbus su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/rang gi snying gar yi ge hūṃ sngon po bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis rje btsun bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang rgyal ba'i sras thams cad bskul te/ de dag gi mdun du yang dag par mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa 5bya'o//37—994

de'i 'og tu oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho1haṃ/ tshig gi don dang bcas par stong pa nyid du rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ mthing ga 'od dang bcas par bsams te/ de'i 'od kyis 2'gro ba ma lus par sbyangs shing /rang gi lhag pa'i skur gyur te/ de dag thams cad 'dus nas sa bon gyi yi ge la bzhugs pa dang / rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs par gyur pa blta —ste/ de nas yang de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can ma lus par rab tu drangs te/ rdo rje la zhugs pa dang / de nas de yongs su gyur pa las kha dog sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /rab tu khros shing 'dug pa ste/ /g.yon brkyang pa yis legs brten pa/ /bcu drug lo lon lta bu la/ /rab tu khros pa'i lta stangs can/ /lto 'phye brgyad kyis rnam brgyan cing / /zla ba'i gdan la legs bzhugs pa5/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /bsnun pa'i tshul gyis legs bzung spyozhing / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 'dzin mdzad pa/ /smad g.yogs sngon po legs bsnams shing / /spyan dmar mche ba rnam gabyugs pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od can mgo skyes ni/ /dmar ser gyen phyogs cod pan can/ /ha ha 'o dod chen po yis/ /log 'dren la sogs 7skrag byed pa/ /'jigs byed khro bo'i bdag por ni/ /bdag nyid rnam par bsam par bya/ /de'i rjes su nyid kyi thugs ka'i 8hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ yang dag par mchod la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas/ de dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dgyes par bya'o / /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir spyi bo dang mgrin pa 37—995

—dang snying ga'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du 1dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'i oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams rnam par bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu spro ba dang bsnyu ba'i rim pas 2ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du bsgom par bya zhing skyo bar gyur na sngags bzlas par bya ste/ skyen pa dang bal 4ba dang shin tu gsal ba dang mi gsal ba yang ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa spangs pas so/ /de nas bzlas pas skyo na/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gtor ma nye bar phul te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ /badz+ra satwa twe no ba tiṣ+ṭha / dṛ 5rnyo me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sirnyim+me 6pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shri 7yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān / sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ ༷zhes bya bas lhag pa dang ma tshang ba dag yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su ye shes sems dpa' yang dag par mchod pas/ oṃ kro dha bha ba sarba satārja / sidhā tat+ta ya tha mu gats+tsha dha/ budhe bi shwa ya ma/ pu nar ga ma nā ya muḥzhes bya ba 'dis gshegs par bya'o/ /de la 1 'dir yang dag par bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi t+t+waṃ phaṭa ces bya'o/ /de ltar sgrub la mngon —brtson saskal ldan rnams kyis ni/ /bsgrims sate rang gi bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi gang / /'thungs pas lus sogs rab rgyas sngags rtsa skyes pa yis/ /rtogs 8pas bstan pa'i las la 1 rab sbyar bde ba ni/ /de yis gnod pa ma lus bsal bar phod pa ste/ /gang dag skal ldan sngon gye skye bar bsnyen 2rkabyas pa/ /de dag bla ma bzang pos nyer bstan thob tsam gyis/ /sngon du bsten pa ma byas rtog par sbyar bas kyang / /dgos pa lus med mi ring 37——996

nyid kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar bla mas gang bshad phan byung bdud rtsi yisnye1 / /thigs pas sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di ni 'dir gtor 2 bas/ /skye bo rtog pa'i dug ni da nad med nyams gyur pa/ /de rtogs thurtog skyes nad dang nyer 'tshe zhi bar shog / bdag gis 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ /bsod nams gang dang gang bgyis pa/ /bsod nams de yis mgon po rnams/ /rtag tu bdag gis mthong bar shog /hūṃkhro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub 6 thabs—/ slob dpon su tsan+d+ra bha dra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi na ya tsan+d+ra dang / lo tsā dzab dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //ri 8bsdur mchan/994 shesnamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄4/ /khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ / —〈〈snar 〉ra badz+ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo—/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ satsho 〈〈snar 〉ṅkapa/995 lku〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gi3/ ( ——〈〈pe 〉7)/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉 mo/ 5〈〈pe 〉skorakhrug par blta/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'khrugs par gyur pa lta/ tre 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 6 〈〈snar 〉sngagazung / ) 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags pa/ she 〈〈pe 〉7)/996 tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉rkyen/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skyon/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄la/bla〈〈pe 〉〉ṭi/ 〈〈snar 〉tsā/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadhi me/ mu〈〈pe 〉wā/ ldu〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ she 〈〈snar 〉than/zhe〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ skya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra twa rba/ birnyi/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ 1— 〈〈pe 〉〉gil/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉ra sgrub la mngon brtson/ me〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub la mngon par brtson pa'i/ sa〈〈snar 〉〉sgrims/ nyu 〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ 1shā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog spyo〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ bye 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ —1〈〈pe 〉sngaganyen/997 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis/ 5〈〈snar 〉sngagatogs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibadag gis 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ / rtag tu bdag gis mthong bar sgog / 6 〈〈pe 〉thasgrub/)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ re 〈〈pe 〉tha/ /dge'o// //37—997
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (164༷) 37wa 998

༄/ /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhū ta ḍā ma ra maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal 'byung bo 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal 'byung po 'dul byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga'i dbye ba'i rang bzhin dri med grub pa ster ba mi rnams bsgral ba'i don du stong nyid don rtogs blo bzang skyong ba bdag gis bshad/ 'di ltar sngon du bsnyen pa'i bya ba byas pas sam/rtag tu bzlas pa'am/ lo'i nang du'am/ zla ba gcig gi nang du bsnyen pa byas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de yang ji ltar 'chad pa'i rim pas so / /de yang mi'i rus pa btags pas bgegs bsal ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/slob ma'i don du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba/ nyes pa 'joms pa'i sngags brjod la / phyogs bcu'i bgegs la phur pas btab ste/ gnas bsrung bar byas la/pus mo'i bar du brkos la/ yang na brla 'am rked pa'i bar du brkos pa ni/37—999

—mchog dang bar dang tha ma'i grub pa ster ro/ /skra la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad bsal la/ dri bzang po'i chus gtor te dag par bya'o/ /nyes pa 'joms par byed pa'i sngags brjod cing / yang na sa gzhan gyis dgang bar bya'o / /rin po che lnga dang / sman lnga dang / 'bru lnga yang gzhug cing mnyam par byas la/ dri zhim po'i chus byug go/ /de ltar sa la brtag pa la ni/zhal dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang rnying pa mchog yin la/ bye ma dang yungs kar dang chu dang bcas pa la lan bdun bsngags te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gtor bar bya'o/ /rin po che dang / ba'i rnam pa lnga dang / sngon gyi sman rnam/sa kyis kyang byug par bya ste/ sa dag par bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas yi ge baṃ yongs su rdzogs pa las/ gter gyi bum pa thogs pa'i sa'i lha mo de yang sgu phyed 'thon pa la bstod cing mchod pa bya ste/ spyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//dpang du gyur pa'i lha mo khyod/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par gyi/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de tshe khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas la dkyil 'khor bri/ /'dir ni mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas bstod pa byas la / me tog la sogs lngas mchod de/ mchod yon la sogs pa yang byen la/de'i rjes su lha mo yang dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam zhing / de nas me tog la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor la lag pa reg la/ hūṃ nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ slob dpon 'dug la/ bdag nyid dga' ba bskyed par bya ste/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /byang chub sems dang 37——/000

bdag ldan no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes dang / /bdag kyang da ni ldan par 'gyur/ /de ring rdo rje'i rigs su skyes/ /de ring bdag ni gces pa'i mchog /mchod sbyin mchog gi 'bras bu bdag /lus kyi mchog tu bdag gyur to/ /de nas rang gi lag tu spos thogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su dgongs par bsams te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /ding du bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge zhes bya'i rdor 'dzin bdag /dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dir byon cig /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /dngos grub dam pa sprul du gsol/ /de skad ces brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ 'od zer 'phros shing bsdus pa las bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur blta bar bya'o/ /de nas khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags brjod cing / phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje slob dpon shar phyogs su 'dug la/ lho phyogs kyis dang por byas pa'i lan gsum bskor te/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga yis mchod la/ dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs kyis shar phyogs nas dkyil 'khor zhu bar bya'o/ /phyogs gzhan nas kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas slob ma byang chub sems dpas brjod par bya/ 'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po chen po khyod/ /'byung po kun dang klu rnams dang / /gnod sbyin rig pa 'dzin rnams 'jigs/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs thams cad 'joms/ /gza' rnams kun dang ro langs dang / /yi dwags dang ni bdud rnams 'joms/ /grub pa thams cad ster mdzad pa'i/ /dkyil 37—/001

byeda'akhor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje slob dpon langs la/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsams la/phyag byas la/ bdag ni legs mdzad rdo rje che/ /bdag ni rdo rje stobs po che//bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /lag na rdo rje brtan par gnas/ /bdag ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /byin gyis brlabs pa mi gtong ngo/ /de nas rdo rje slob dngo/na dam tshig gsum gyi rnyed pa dang ldan pas/ rang nyid kyi phyag rgya rdo rje dang dril bu bzung la/ rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams thams cad la/ /'di nyid bzung nas bya ba yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bltas la/rang nyid langs la khro bo'i lta bas yi ge hiḥlas skyes pa'i mig gnyis blta bas bgegs thams cad bsregs te/ de nas khro bo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ phyogs thams cad du blta zhing 'gro bar bya'o/ /rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sngags brjod par bya ste/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'od zer gyis sa gzhi thams cad khengs par bsam zhing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bcags par bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams dang / phyogs kyi yang phur bus btab la/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur bsams te/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang spyor bas/ /ko sko mas mdud pa mnan la/ /g.yon nga rgyal du blta bas dpa'/ /phyogs brgyad 'khor lor gnas pa dang / /steng dang 'og kyang byin gyis brlab/ /bhur bhu ba pa rtsa ban+dha ya ta/ sngags kyi rgyal po hūṃ brjod pas/ /nyes pa kun gyis tshugs ma yin/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ dzaḥ / 'di yis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brkyang la/ gsang ba'i dkyil 37—/002

'khor dgug par bya ste/ zhal bzhi pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgug par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra badz+re a bye tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi hūṃ/de nas rdo rje bskor ba'i phyag rgya byas te brtan par bya'o/ /de nas seng ldeng gi phur pa la bzlas pa byas te/ kun dga' ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang /sprin gyi dbang phyug dang / gsus po che dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / ji lta ba'i rim pas/ 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba dang / gshin rje gshed dang / stobs po che dang / rta mgrin dang / bdud rtsi 'khyel pa dang /de dag kyang sku smad phur pa'i dpal dang ldan pa/ tsan+dan dmar po'i rang bzhin dang / sgud pa dmar pos dkris te/ me tog dmar pos brgyan te/dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi zur dang / phyogs rnams su lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pas brtan par bya'o/ /log 'dren gyi mtshams la sogs pa ru/ sngags 'dis phur bu brdeg par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kri li tī lā ya sarba biṭ+wāṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dir de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi khu tshur gyis go bgo ste/ bcing bar byas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgor nyes pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sngags brjod la/ bum pa lhag par gnas par bya ste/ dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i chu blugs te/ lha thams cad kyi ming dang bcas pa nam mkha' la gnas pa/ snying bo'i 'od zer gyis bkug ste/yang dag par mchod nas/ gtor ma yang phul la/ bum par gzhug par bya'o//bum pa yang nag po spangs pa mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lto ba rgyas pa/me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa'i ras zung gis mgul dkris/ 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing gis brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / rigs 37—/003

—kyi lha'i mtshan ma dang bcas pa/ rin po che bdun nam rdza las byas pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'o/ /de yang nang du byi ru dang / gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang / pad+ma rā ga'i rin po che rnams nang du bcug la/ gzhan yang sman bṛ ha ti dang / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / ma hā daṇ+ḍa a la dang / a pa rā dze+e ta dkar po dang / 'bras khar ma dang / gro dang / sran ma dang / til dang / 'bru rnams kyis kyang ngo / /nang brgyan la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ mchod yon dang / zhabs bsel dang bcas mchod cing bstod de/ yi ge hūṃ brjod pa las/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgur bltas la rab tu mchod de/ bgegs rnams 'joms par byed pa'i sngags brjod cing / phreng ba'am ma brgyus pa'i me tog gam / spos kyis kyang mchod la/ de nas yi ge bzhi pa'i sngags kyis yang dag par bsrungs la/ las thams cad bya ste/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par bya ste/ thun gsum du yang dag par mchod cing / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du bum pa gzhag par bya ste/ 'di ni bum pa rab tu gnas par bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas brgya byin la sogs pa shar la sogs pa'i phyogs nas rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ mchod yon la sogs pa phul te/ me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/oṃ sa ra sa ra gats+tsha gats+tshaḥ/ de la sogs pas gshegs su gsol te/ steng nas kyang zla ba dang nyi ma dang / tshangs pa dang / mig gyen du bltas te gshegs/'og tu yang a su re bh+yaḥswā hā/ nā ge byuḥswā hā/ so sor yang rdo rje'i sor mo gyen du phye nas/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas gtor ma byin la/ de nas yang /37—10071

gzhan gtor ma dmar po/ me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtor ma byin zhing lha rnams sbyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas ras dkar pos bum pa rnams g.yogs te/ lha rnams kha spyor dang ldan pa 'byung po dang bcas pa la / ye ta ya te ma hā byu to ro tras+thā na pra muñcan+tu 1swā hā/ de nas sngags de nyid kyis lha bshos la sogs pa dbul te/ so sor 'byung po chen po rnams/rang rang gnas su ci bder gshegs par bya'o/ /dur khrod chen po lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shing gcig dang ni chu bo'i gnas rnams dang / /lam gyi bzhi mdo liṅga gcig pa dang / /lha'i gnas rnams su myur du gshegs byas la/ /dam tshig gnas la rab tu gnas par mdzod/ /ji ltar khyod ni mi 'gro na/ /khyed kyi mgo ni rdo rjes 'gems/ /yud tsam gyis ni nyams par 'gyur/ /dmyal ba chen por 'jug par byed/ /ji lta ji ltar ci bde bar/ /rang gi gnas su bde bar song / /yang mchod yon la sogs pa byen la/ mchod de ci bde bar gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod dang / lha'i gnas dang / ri'i rtse mo dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / de dag tu myur du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ gtor ma byin pas so/ /dam tshig la rab tu brtan par dam tshig rnams rab tu skyong zhing / khro bo chen po'i bka' sruX ji ltar mnos pas/ rang rang gi las rnams byed par 'gyur te/ ru tras+thā na pra muñcan+tu swā hā/ de nas oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā t+t+waṃ at+yā nut+pan+da tāta/ 'di ni dbyangs chen pos 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /mchod yon la sogs pa sbyin pa 'di ni gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin nam/rgyas pa la nyes pa rnams 'joms par bya ba'i phyir/ rnam par grol gdong gis/37—/005

sngags brgya phrag brgyad bzlas la/ 'khor lo'i lha rnams mchod de/ mchod yon yang phul la/ slob ma lhag par gnas par bya ste/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgo la me tog bzhag ste/ slob mas lag par me tog thogs te/'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen po/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems mgon brtan pa po/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /bdag la byang chub sems kyang stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor slob ma bzhag la/ snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ las ḍi las bskyed pa'i rdo rje bsams la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje bzung la/ slob ma'i snying gar reg cing / su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho badz+ra sidh+ya 1ya thā su khaṃ/ sa 'dir slob dpon gyis sdig pa bshags par bya ba'i don du/ /phyag 'tshal bde gshegs thams cad la/ /ji ltar thams cad mkhyen pa po/ /'khor ba kun gyi skyabs mdzod cig /bdag ni nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo kun du bsgom par bgye/ /sdug bsngal gsum las grol ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal bdag gis mthong thams cad byed nga/ra gnas nga/ yi/ /sbug bsngal gsum gyis thams cad gdungs/ /bdag ni khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgye/ /phyin chad sdig pa bdag mi bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rangs/ /byas dang byed bcug dge ba la/ /bdag ni de bzhin mngon par dga'/ /chos gsung mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas 37—/006

rnams / /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir—/ /mchog tu rtsol ba chen po yis/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas dbang phyug gnas pa yis/ /'khor ba thams cad bsgral don du/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mthar phyin te/ /sangs rgyas rgyu la bkod pa'i phyir / /ji ltar bzod pa'i stobs rnams kyis/ /smon lam chen po gdab par bgyi/ /de ltar gyur pa'i stobs kyis su/ /'di ltar rigs dang rigs skyes kyang / /thabs kyis 'gro ba bsgral bar bgyi/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i go 'phang pa/ /dri med stong pa'i yon tan can/ /rigs las byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /byas dang byed du bcug pa yi/ /bdag gi bsod nams ci mchis pas/ /grub cing bde ba'i gnas phyin shog /de nas rin chen dpal mos lag pa na dri thogs pa/ dpal mos me tog dang / thig le mchog mas bdug spos dang / ri bong 'dzin mas mar me thogs pa rnams kyis mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra hā gye hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis/ u dus+thā ra dang /byang chub kyi shing las byas pa'i so shing dri dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/so 'brud pa'i tshul gyis gzung la dor bar bya'o/ /rdo rje chos kyis bzlas pa'i dri bzang po'i mchod yon kyi chus kha bshal byin la/ oṃ dīḥbi shud+dhāḥ1sarba dharma sarba pā pa rgo tsa gya sarba bi kaspran a pa na ya hūṃ/ /rdo rje rnon po chen po 'di/ /yongs su rdzogs shing ma nyams pa/ /gcig ni mgo bo gzhan ni bstan/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ bzlas pa sbyin par bya ste/ sngas dang stan du byin la/ rdo rje'i go bskon te/ skud pa sum sgril rang gis slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /de yang yi ge drug pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /bsrung 37—1007

keb byas la/ slob ma la chos bshad par bya ste/ /de ring khyod ni dga' ba yi//rnyed pa chen po khyed kyis rnyed/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras po dam nga/ khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rjes su bzung / /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba'i sras/ /khyod ni theg pa chen po la/ /dga' ba'i rigs can thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni lam gyi mchog yin te/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i jeg pa che/ /lam 'di la ni khyod phyin na/ /de bzhin gshegs par khyod 'gyur ro/ /rang byung skal ba che dang ldan/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod par 'gyur / /yod dang med pa'i de nyid spangs/ /nam mkha' 1lta bur dri ma med/ /zab mo rtog ge'i yul las 'das/ /rtog dpyod yul las 'das pa po/ /thams cad lnga ru gnas pas te/ /lnga pa kun kyang de bzhin no/ /las dang spyod par gnas pa kun/ /gnyis med bden pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /'di ni theg pa chen po'i mchog /'di 'dra khyod kyis thob par 'gyur/ /de skad ces slob ma la brjod par byas la slob ma rnams bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' drin gyis khyed kyis nang par gol ba'i krong khyer chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdug pa la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams shoms shig /bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal te/dkyil 'khor snying rje chen po bdag /nang par bdag ni 'dri bar 'dod/ /slob ma rjes su gzung phyir dang / /spyod rnams cis kyang mchod pa'i phyir/ /'di ltar bdag ni gus pa la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' drin mdzod/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ /che ge dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i mchog /27—/008

nang par sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bri/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i stobs kyis so/ /rjes su gzung ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gang yin la/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /de skad ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor legs par mchod la/ mchod yon la sogs pa yang phul te/las kyi rdo rjes slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su nyal la 'dug par bya'o/ /gzhan nyi ma la lha'i rnal 'byor byas la/ dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bltas te/dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po dang / dri bzang pos byugs la/ don grub btags pas kyang byugs te/ de ltar skud pa lnga rnams so sor bzhag ste/ oṃ t+t+waṃ byāḥ.aḥhūṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su bsams la/ de dag kyang rang rang gi gnas su byin gyis brlab cing sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa dang / rang gi snying ga las kyang 'od zer 'phros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /o dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi saṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ 'di ni mig lhag par gnas pa'o/ /mig phyogs thams cad du blta bar bya'o/ /rdzi ma brdabs te mig rab tu bgrad pas/ srad bu nam mkha' la brkyang ba la blta bar bya'o/ /chos rnams thams cad rjes su gabyug pa la/ /spro zhing bsdus pas rjes su brtan par byas/ chos rnams thams cad de nyid gabyug pa yin/ /hūṃ zhes brjod la gcig tu bsgril lo/ /de nas gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag cing mchod la/rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ 'di ni lan brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod la/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ nam mkha' la gnas pa rnams rab tu brtan 37—1009

—pa la/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ mig gnyis su yi ge dzaḥyongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la/ byang phyogs kyi sgrub pa po bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i gzugs kyis/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis sgud pa lte bar bzung ste/ oṃ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥde skad ces brjod pas/ byang phyogs kyi sgrub pa pos kyang / yang oṃ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing slob dpon gyi lag tu gtad do/ /de ltar slob dpon dang slob ma gdong phyogs pas/ nub dang lho yang slob dpon gyi gnas yin/ shar dang byang na slob dpon gyi gnas so / /de skad ces nam mkha' la thig btab la/ sems kyis phyogs dang mtshams thams cad kyi phyogs mnyam par bgos te/ de nyid kyi rim pas sa gzhi la tshangs pa'i thig la sogs pa gdab ste/ thig skud sboms su dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i nyi shu cha/ dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur gyi tshad do/ /de yang rdo rje khu tshur kyis sgud pa shar phyogs su bzung la/ nub tu 'ang de bzhin no/ /gnod sbyin dang yi dwags dang lha dang / klu dang dbang phyug dang bden bral gyi phyogs su gdong blta zhing / me dang rlung du ni slob dpon gyi gnas yin la/shar dang nub dang byang dang phyogs bzhir mnyam par thig btab la/ de yang cha brgyad du mnyam par bya ste/ de yang skud pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs zhing dgongs par bsam mo/ /de yang slob dpon slob ma'i g.yas su bskor zhing 'gro bar bya ste/ me dang rlung ni rtag tu slob dpon gyi gnas yin/ srin po dang dbang ldan rnams su yang zur gyi thig rnams gdab po//gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /cha rnams bcu drug dang ldan zhing / /rdo rje'i ra bas kun nas bskor/ /de ltar du ni bshad 27——/0/0

pa yin/ /phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas bzhi ste/ snying po'i lte ba dang re'u mig brgyad dang ldan pa/ phyi rol nas rdo rje'i ra bas kun nas bskor ba/gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa'i cha gsum dang / thams cad kyi dbus su brgyad cha'i sgo tshad dang / sgo'i phyed kyis sgo khyud dang / 'gram dang / logs kyang ngo / /'gram pa'i phyed kyis rdul tshon gyi sa dang / /de nas 'gram pa'i tshad kyis dang / mchod pa'i snam bu'i tshad kyis dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i sa'o/ /rdo rje'i ka ba brgyad kyis ni rdul tshon gyi sa yin la/ sgo'i sum 'gyur gyis rta babs so/ /phyogs kyi gnas dang snying po'i gnas de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /'khor lo dang / zur la rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / rnga yab dang /dpag bsam gyi shing dang / de nas dkyil 'khor lte bar phur pa btab la/phyi rol nas kun nas bskor bar bya ste/ rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / de bzhin ri mo gnyis kyis bskor/ gsum yang bskor la/ kha dog lnga pa'i bzhi yang /ring po bzhi pa'i yang / 'khor lo gru bzhi mnyam pa la bskor bar bya ri mo bcu bdun/ cha bcu drug dang ldan pa/ gnas brgyad zlum por bskor te/rdo rje phreng bas kun nas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang sngon du bshad pa'i mdog dang ldan pa'o/ /de nas yi ge hi las mig g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa gnyis zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du byas la/ dkyil 'khor la bltas la/ye shes kyi thig gshegs su gsol te/ de nas baṃ lam̐ ram̐ haṃ rdza gi sa bon las/rim pa bzhin yongs su dze+egs par byas la/ skud pa'i kha dog bzhin du dkar po la sogs pa rnams kyang byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ rin po che lnga dang /lcags lnga'am/ ba bla la sogs pa'i khams gzhan nam/ 'bras khar ba la 37—/0//
