khyad par du bdud rtsi thab spyor gyis sa gzung 1ngo / /sa brtag pa ni ri bo mchog gi 2dngos grub 'thob po/ /mtsho 'gram du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'thob 4po/ /dur khrod la sogs par 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'thob 5po /ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten kyi drung du sngags kyi dngos grub 'thob 6po/ /'bab chu'i 'gram du rig sngags 'grub po/ /nags tshal du gnod sbyin mo 'grub po/ /phug tu mngag gzhug pa rnams 'grub po/ /bsnyen pa'i tshe tshar gcad 2pa'i cho ga sngar bshad pa bzhin du byas pas ni sa bsrung bar 'gyur ro9/ /de nas rdo rje 7slob dpon dang / sgrub 1 pa'i grogs pos sngar bshad pa bzhin du khrus dang gos dang rgyan btags pa dang / mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab cing snga ma bzhin du bdag nyid cho ga drug gis lhar bskyed la/ snga ma bzhin du ri rab kyi rtse mor bsams nas / rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i phyag rgyas sa'i lha mo spyan drang bar bya ste/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya las gung mo lcags kyus g.yab pa dang / na mo rītsu ru kun+da/ tsu ru kun+da badz+ra pā ṇi—/ na mo bud+dhā ya saswā hā/oṃ pra ti sa sa pi pa ya tra san+ni hi to ྾bha ba zhes brjod cing bzhugs su gsol lo/ /de nas mchod yon dang bcas pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la 7/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi // /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /spyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes bya bas dpang du gsol lo/ /mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas sa la lan gsum reg par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor la gtor ma byin gyis brlab 19 cing bsngos nas/ sa'i lha mo dang bcas 2 pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /37—/063

de nas sta gon gyi 1bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga byas te rngum dang ṭa snyelas mig gnyis su nyi ma dang zla ba bskyed la/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed par bya'o / /rkang mthil du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la khro bo'i skur bsgoms la/sgrub 4pa'i grogs mchog gis ngan song sbyong ba nas 'byung ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod la de'i rjes la slob dpon gyis khro bo'i bstod pa bya ste/ chos dbyings stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spang 5ste/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs 'ubyed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa/ /zhes pas kyang bka' me bsgo ste/ de rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug che ge mo zhes bya ba dang / rig sngags 'chang grub pa rgan po dang /rgan mo rnams dengs shig ces bya bas bgegs bskrad pa dang / hūṃ hūṃ 'gro ba 'dzin pa yis ni byas zin gyi/ /hūṃ hūṃ gdug pa'i yid can gang yin pha zad song / /hūṃ hūṃ khro bo'i 8rgyal po sdang mig 'bar ba yis/ /hūṃ hūṃ bsregs nas thal ba bzhin du byas sa re/ /shar phyogs nas ni char chen 'bab/ /me phyogs glo bur snang ba 'byung / /gshin rje 'chi bdag gzugs su 'byung / /bden bral sems can la 'jigs byed/ /chu phyogs gshin rje bye'abrug sgra sgrogs/ /rlung gi phyogs nas 'tshub 7ma 'byung / /gnod sbyin pho mo /3byang phyogs gnas/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas sna tshogs gzugs/ /steng nas mthu chen lha rnams dang / /'og nas sa 'gas g.yo byed pa/ /gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'gro bar kyis/ /zhes bya ba 12brjod la bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags ring gis sabagegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor — 37—1064

ba lan gsum byas la 'greng la thal mo mtshog tshomar gzhag la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bul phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags ni sngar bshad pas bya'o/ / de nas stang stabs bya ste/ g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang gis phyogs bzhir bya ba dang /thal mo sbyar te rked pa'i gnas thusu gzhag la/ rting pa phrad de mig thur la bltas la/ rdo rje phur bu sred med kyi bus sa 'og rim pa bdun g.yo bar bya'o/ /hūṃ 'brug gi sgra lta bu dang / rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing rdo rje gar bskor nas legs par blangs pa'i rdo rje 'phen pa dang bsdu ba bya'o/ /de nas khro bo dang phyag brnyan dang bran mo dang pho nya mo rnams spro zhing / rdo rje be con thogs pa'i g.yas brkyang dang / dbyug pa dang mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang /'khor lo dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing la sogs pa thogs pa'i khro bo bgegs gzhom pa'i stang stabs bya'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas man chad gser gyi sa gzhi yan chad kyi 5lha dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin rnams gabyug tu bsdus nas/ rdo rje me dang rlung gi khro bos bskrad par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su seng ge'i tshul du mchongs nas g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang bya ba dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rked par bzhag nas lus po 'gul zhing gar bya ba dang / rdo rje gsor zhing rkang pa g.yas g.yon sa la gdab pa dang / bung ba'i 'phur stangs pya bya ste/ rkang pa brlar 3gzhag la lus po bskor bar bya'o/ /g.yon pa'i kyerdo rje'i khu tshur kyi nang du g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum btsugs pa bton la ral gri shubs nas 'byin pa bzhin du ral gri'i phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad pa dang / rkang pa gnyis gshibs 9la rdo rje spyi bo la bskor zhing 'khor lo 'phang ba'i khutshul du bya'o/ /rgyas par ni phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud 37—1065

dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud phyi ma las blta 1 bar bya'o/ /de ltar stang stabs rdzogs 3nas/ sngar bshad pa'i tshar bcad pa'i cho gas kyang 'dir ra ba dang dra bas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas seng sdeng ngam lcags las ༄ byas pa'i phur bu stod khro bo smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu bskyed la phur bu'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya zhing dbus dang / zur bzhir btsugs la/ skud pa dmar po thubatags pa dang /me tog gi phyaphreng ba dang / dri dang gu gul gyi dud pa dang / go cha bskon pa'i bar du phur bu'i cho ga sdogs par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor drug gang yang rung bar byed par 'dod pas rgyu gyelas gzhal yas khang bskyed la ba'i rnam pa lnga dang / tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dris byugs te/ dkyil 'khor drug gi 3lha dang mthun pa'i so so'i sngags zlos shing dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor drug gang byed 'dod pa'i lhar bskyed la/ me tog gi sil ma gtor te/ sngags dang phyag rgyas sgo phye la/ sngar gyi dzubasnyen pa bzhin du spyan drang ba dang / sbyang ba dang bcing ba dang / phyir bzlog pa dang / lhag pa dang ma tshang ba bskang ba dang /lha tshim nga/ra bya ba'i phyir mchod pa 9rgyas pa snga ma bzhin du dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa lhag par gnas pa bya ste/ rtsa ba nag nog med pa/ kha gyed pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ ras dang /dar gyis mgul pa bcings pa 'bras sa can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du sman lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang / rin po che lnga dang / spos lnga dang / snying po lnga spos chu dang bcas pa bcug la ram̐ las bum pa snga ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 37byed/066

stong par bsams la rgyu thu las gzhal yas khang du bsams la baṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba dang pad+ma bsams la de'i steng du lha so so'i sngags kyis lhar bskyed par bya'o/ /yod cing 'byor na dkyil 'khor drug gi so so'i lha dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'i steng du las thams cad pa'i bum pa bya ba'am—/ /mi 'byor na lnga'am las thams cad pa dang gnyis bya'o/ /de nas sngags dang phyag rgyas sgo 2phye ste lha spyan drang bar bya'o/ /hūṃ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod khams bdud rnams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms/ /log 'dren srin po yang dag 'dul ba'o/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs su gsol/ /log 'dren 'joms pa'i slad du spyan 'dren gyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis 7gshegs su gsol/ /ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing 4/ na mo tsur kun+dha/ tsur kurnya/3 badz+ra pā ṇi budha sa /6su/ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥ7zhes bya bas sbyan drang ngo / /oṃ pra ba ra sad+ku ra pra tre+ets+tsha swā hā/ zhes bya bas zhabs bsil dang / pushā mā la ༄ ye swā hā/zhes bya bas me tog gi gdan dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pas lha'i phyi nas 'ongs pa'i bgegs bskrad la/ phaṭa ma hā kā la hūṃ 1zhes bya bas sgo bcad 3 de/ rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya dang / badz+ra j-ika ces bya ba'i spyi'i snying po yang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor drug gang byed pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya bstan te/ /sgu mdog dang phyag mtshan yang bum pa'i nang du gsal bar dmigs nas sku phyag rgya chen bo bsgoms te/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'don pa dang / rdo rje 37—/067

rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyang tshar gcig gdon par bya'o/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa dang bral bar gyur cig /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig ces bya ba'i smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa yang bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dbang bskur ba dang khrus bya bar yang gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg lhag par gnas par bya ste/ zhi ba byed na dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar gyi mtshams su thab khung zlum po sor bzhi phyir rmyedor ba'i kha khyer zlum po dang / sor bzhi steng du brtsegs pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor ba dang / sor bzhi phyi rol du bskor ba rdukha khyer la rig pa mchog dang ngan song sbyong ①ba'i rgyud nas 'byung ba bzhin du phyag mtshan bkod de/ tshon rtsi dkar pos byugs te 'o ma can gyi shing la mar dang 'o ma dang / sbrang rtsir bcas pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /byang phyogs su rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi pa kha khyer sor brgyad pa rim pa gsum dang bcas pa snga ma'i rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du phyag mtshan bkod de sdes ser byugs te/ zho dang 'bras chan dang bcas pa khyesbyin sreg bya'o/ /nub phyogs su gzhu lta bu'i thab khung la/ rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed/ zheng du yang khru phyed yod pa/ kha khyer ni sor phyabazhi pa rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba/ rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du phyag mtshan bkod la/ btsag 3gis byugs te/ mar dang ༄ sna/ sbrang rtsi dang / me tog la sogs pas dbang gi kye3sbyin sreg bya'o/ /lho phyogs su dkyil 'khor gru gsum kha khyer sum brtsegs dang bcas pa sor 37—1068

gsum pa'i tshad la/ rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du khro bo'i phyag mtshan bkod la tshon rtsi sngo 1nag gis byugs la dug dang khrag dang ske tshe dang / lan tshwa la sogs pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /yang na gru gsum sgo nub tu btod pa'i dkyil 'khor bris la de'i dbus su gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon mthu chen legs par grub pa zhes bya ba dang / phyogs gcig tu dbyig pa khu tshur rdo rje lcags kyu tī li khri dro la 'jigs byed/ ser skya dang / thog thog dang / lu gu rgyud dang / rnam rgyal dang / nag po dgod do/ /sgor ni dga' byed gdong dang rdo rje sde dang /lag bzangs gsum dgod do/ /gru gsum kha ran can la/ yam shing seng ldeng dang nim pa dang dur khrod las skyes pa dang / dug dang khrag dang ske tshe dang yungs kar dang 1gzugs brnyan gyi steng du gnas nas bsreg pa'am/ mjug tu gzugs brnyan gtub cing bsreg par bya'o/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms la ma mo bcus bskor ba'i snying po ma bye zhes bya ba yin par legs par 'grub 5pa las gsungs so/ /yang na las thams cad pa'i thab khung zhi ba dang mtshungs pa las—/ cung zad kha phyir gyed pa la/ dkyil 'khor drug gang byed pa'i lha bkod la/ 'o ma can gyi shing la me sbar la/ a las pad+ma'i steng du me lha ser po zhal gcig spyan gsum pa tshangs pa'i gzugs can ril pa spyi blugs dang /phreng ba thogs pa mchod phyir thogs dang / thal ris gsum pas mtshan pa/ra skyes la zhon pa'i me trelha bskyed de me sbar nas7/ me lha ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ tshur gshegs tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me yi rnyirgya'/ po drang srong che/ /sreg /(snablugs zhal zas 'di bzhes la/ /'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ skyabs sbyin kyi phyag rgya las mthe bo srin 37—1069

lag gi drung du gzhag la/ abhe e bye hi ma hā bhū ta/ de ba ṛ k+ṣ-i skyedī dza sarbot+ta ma kṛ hi to32 hu ti ma hā rasma — san+ni hi to bha ba zhes pa'i sngags kyis bzhugs su gsol lo/ mchod yon dang zhabs bkru ba dang / gdan dang sgu khrus gsol ba dang / dris byug thusnapa dang / me tog dang spos la sogs pas mchod pa dang 'o ma dang nas dang 'bras yos la sogs pas mchod la dgang gzar mar gyis bkang ba dang / asne ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya ā di bya ā di bya ba ha nā 6ya swā hā zhes bya bas dgang blugs dbul lo/ /de nas me brtag par bya ste / du ba med cing gser gyi mdog ltar gdangasaje/ /rab tu che la me lce g.yas su 'khyil/ /kha dog 'ja' 'dra yang na dkar yang rung / /yang na byi ru bcag pa'i kha dog 'dra/ /shin tu snum la me lce 'gab nas 'phro/ /rab tu 'bar ba nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ /dbyibs ni bum pa rgyal mtshan gdugs dang 'dra / /dpal be+e'u dung dang pad+ma blugs gzar 'dra/ /me lce tri shul rdo rje ral gri 'dra/ /yang na shing rta mchog dang rnga yab 'dra/ /sgra dang ga da rdza rnga gling bu'i sgra/ /du ba me lce dri zhim me stag bzang / /yang na mi tsasbar bar (yang 'bar bar 'gyur/ /de tshe dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /du ba che zhing me stag rgod pa dang / /'bar ba dka' zhing cung zad cung zad 'bar/ /me lce rnam par 'chad byung gzi mdangs med/ /rtsub nag sprin dang pā sbyil sha yi mdog /gsal shing dang 'dra zhib ma'i gzugs kyang 'dra/ /phyugs kyi tso mgo 'dra sgra yang rab tu rtsub/ /me lce 'phro bas sbyin sreg byed pa'i mchog /mi ro'i dri nga dngos grub med par ston/ /me yi mtshan ma 'di dag mthong nas ni/ /stobs po che yi mar gyis musbyin sreg bya/ /de nas til dang nas dang zho dang 'o 37—1070

ma'i sbyin sreg byas la me lha la lngobastod do 3// /me lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor drug gang yang rung ba'i lha bkod do zu/ /mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bsreg rdzas dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas me lha'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du phyir bzhugs su gsol la ge/ me lha gshegs su gsol cing me lha'i dam tshig sems dpa' me tha mal pa la thim par bsam mo/ sbyin sreg sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /zhi gtor ma sta gon du gnas pa ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis gtor ma bsangs la/ khro bo 'chol ba'i sngags kyis bsrungs nas/ sangs rgyas spyan dang nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel te/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis bsngos la/dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud nas 'byung ba bzhin du gdon rnams la sngon du mchod pa thuphyogs skyong ba rnams la phyis mchod par bya'o/ /phyogs skyong gi sngags ni dbang ldan la ru dā ya swā hā/ dbang po la sha krā ya swā hā/ me lha la asne ye swā hā/ gshin rje la be+e ba sā 1 dha ye swā hā/ bden bral la rāk+ṣa sā bye 7 pa ta ya hūṃswā hā/ chu lha la ba ru shā 1rkyeye swā hā/ rlung lha la bā ya mibe+e swā hā/ku be+e ra la yak+ṣa sidha khyere swā hā/ srin po la krad ke ri swā hā/ sha za la mi tsi mi tsi / 'byung po la gung gung / gdon rnams kyi ni sat+tha de ba nā ga yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sā 7a su ra kin+da kher ma ho ra ga ma z-i ga ṇa 8pi shā tsi/ gro ta/she/ a pa sma ra ka ta pū ta na / ru ru sgu ru/ dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha kyesidhi lo tsa na sat+tha ༄ 5 arja sā dha 2 ni swā hā/ zhes pas bsngos la gtang bar bya'o/ /khyad par gyi 'byung po la gcig sbyin par bya'o/ /gtor ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas sngar bstan pa'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lhag par gnas 37—1071

par 'dod na/ de nas gshegs pa la mchod yon dang / mchod pa phul la / na bza' re re 'am/ spyir zung 7rmegacig phul la/ bde gshegs rdo rje'i rigs bdag po/ /rdo rje 'chang ba thugs rje'i bdagarusna /bdag la mnyes shing dgyes pa dang / /byin gyis brlab ricing dngos grub sprul/ /zhes gsol ba btab la rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas slob ma dgug pa dang / lcags sgrog gis bcing ba dang / rdo rje ser ba'i phyag rgyas bsdigs pa dang / khro bo be+e con dang stobs po ches dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug go④/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du bdun rnam dag byas la/ slob ma khro bo phyag na rdo rje'am /pebadud rtsi 'khyil par 6bskyed de/ yi ge hūṃ dang )rang gi sngags kyi byelha'i phyag rgya chen po bsams la/mā ma tī'i phyag rgyas gnas lngar byin gyis brlabs te④/ so shing dor ba dang /kha lan gsum du bkru ba dang / srung sgud rmye mdud pa gsum pa bcing ba dang /ku sha byin nas rmi lam brtag pa dang / sems dpa' gtsug tor dang / gzi brjid phung po bskyed pa dang / byams pa'i sngags kyis go cha bskon pa dang /hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags dang bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyis blubasrung ba dang / spos chus brlan pa'i lag pa mgo la gzhag la rig sngags kyi rgyal po lan bdun bzlas pa dang / de nas slob ma la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bshad par bya'o/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o / /phyade nas snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ lha rnams kun la gsan par gsol1snye //'di zhes bgyi ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'bri rmyebar 'tshal/ /37—1072

bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lagasadhi/ /de bas gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas mgon po brtser ldan dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom 3 dang / /gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i ①lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang yang lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan ④la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi ming ni 'di zhes bgyi/ /sang ni gdugs la dkyil 'khor ni/ /bzang po ming ni 'di zhes bkyi/ /yo byad ci ⑤'byor pas 'bri ④na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse ④bar dgongs su gsolabye/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes snyan gsan phab nas/ phyag 'tshal nas bstod do/ /sta gon gyi lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /sta gon gyi cho ga bsgrub pa sdogs so// //sgrub khyepa chen po dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ slob dpon dang slob ma ku sha'i stan dang sngas la nyal nas⑫/ nang par slob ma la snying brtse ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor byas te/7/ slob ma la rmi lam ci mthong zhes kyang dri bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang mchod rten dang sku gzugs la sogs pa mthong na ⑫dge'o/ /phyag na rdo rje kun nas btus pa las 'byung ba bzhin du rmi lam brtags nas/ rmi lam mi shis na gtor ma dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa bya'o//nang par sngar bshad pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas gos dkar po gon nas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags zlos shing /1/ tshon sna lnga'i srad bu sar pa gtsang ma mdzes 37—1073

pa / shin tu ran pa dri zhim pa reg na bde ba/ legs par bkal ba sra ba tsho7sbom phra med pa/ 'jur mdud med pa'i thig skud la/ dkar po la ram̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ dmar po la shaṃ gser thub ༄9kyi rang bzhin/ ser po la e thub pa byang chub snying po'i rang bzhin/ ljang gu la paṃ phyag na rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ /sngon po la hūṃ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rang bzhin du bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya mā ti rngo kra ma hūṃ zhes bya bas bzlas ④la/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas thig gdab par bya'o/ /thig gi cho ga ni thun mong gi cho ga las shes par bya'o/ /srad bu chad na bla ma 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na na bar 'gyur5 / /phyogs 'khrul slob ma myos par 'gyur/ /ltas ༅ngan byung na tso dngos mi 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas ba'i rnam rkyelngas sa gzhi kho ra khor yug tu chag chag btab la byugs teshesna/ byung na rin po che'i phye ma'am/sā lu'i phye ma'am sa'i phye mas bya'o/ /de nas tshon rtsi la oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / rig sngags kyi rgyal po phyag na rdo rje'i sngags kyis bsang gtor bya / mchod pa phul la/ dang po gzugs su bri bar bshad/ /gnyis pa dag ni phyag rgyar bshad/ /gsum pa stan dang gnas dag dang / /yig 'bru bri bar rab tu bsngags/ /de la dkyil 'khor dang po lha nyi shu rtsa gcig pa dgod do / /dbus kyi lte ba rtsibs lnga pa la dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sngar bshad pa bzhin du bri ba dang / 'khor lo'i thenyartsibs bzhi la/g.yas su mā ma tī/ g.yon du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ mā ma shī'i rtags rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ byang du rdo rje rtse gsum pa dbyug pa la btsugs ⑩pa/ dbus su rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis chang zungs drang por 'dug la/ chang zungs kyi lte ba la 37—/074

dgra sta srab mo kha phyir bltas pa bri bar bya'o/ /mdun du skem byed kyi dbyeg pa/rgyab tu gzhon nu'i 'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsibs bcu gnyis la/ shar du rgyal ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa me lce 'phro ba/ rdo rje mtshan gyi 1rdo rje rtse gsum pa shar du dgod do/ /byang du 2rdo rje rtags kyi rdo rje nartse gsum pa/ bkra shis kyi rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ shin tu bkra shis kyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa pad+mas mtshan pa'o/ /lhor pad+ma'i mtshan gyi pad+ma'i sdong bu kha cung zad bye ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang bcas pa'o/ /pad+ma phreng gi pad+ma'i sdong bu kha bye ba dbus na rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'o/ /nub tu g.yung drung ris kyi 5ni gru bzhi bsnol ba'i dbus su g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i rtse mor shing thog sgyu ru ra'i 'bras bu rin po ches mtshan pa'o / /mdung rtse gsum pa dang 6/ rdo rje ni 7kha gnyis pa rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma nas 'bras kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa'o/ /mche ba be+e pad+ma'i sdong bu la mche ba gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'o/ /nang gi sgo bzhir mdung rtse gcig pa dang / sbrul gyi zhags pa me lce dang bcas pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa sprul gye zhags pa dang bcas pa dang /ral gri bris la/ pañca rā ga'i rtsig pa dang / 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang /rin po che'i mda' yab dang / dra ba dra 1 phyed dang / dar yol dang / rta babs dang / rdo rje ra ba me 'od dang bcas pa bri'o/ /dgod pa'i sngags dang phyag 1 rgya ni sngar bshad zin to / /( dkyil 'khor gnyis pa ni sngar bshad pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dbus su rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog sngon po khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag 37—/075

rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/rig pa mchog las gsungs pa bzhin bsam par bya'o/ /shar gyi khro bo 1dkar po rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ lho'i khro bo ser po rin po che dang sdigs mdzub/nub kyi khro bo dmar po pad+ma dang sdigs mdzub/ byang gi khro bo ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi'i sgu mdog nag po'o/ /shar lhor rdo rje'i phur bu bsnams pa'o/ /lho nub tu rin po che'i phur bu bsnams pa'o / /nub byang du pad+ma'i phur bu bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i phur bu bsnams pa'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang / dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no / /2lnga lnga pa ni sgu mdog dang phyag mtshan snga ma bzhin du bkod la/ /phyogs skyong ba bcu yang sta gon gyi gtor ma'i sngags dang / rdo rje bsnams pa las gung mo myu gu ltar gshibs te/ bsgreng la mthe bong dang / mthe'u sachung so sor bsgreng 6la spyi'i phyag rgyas dgod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa 'khrul 'khor yang khro bor bskyed pa'i tshe dbus kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa 7sdigs mdzub/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ dbang phyug chen po khyo shug 7mnan pa'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po'o/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ shar du rdo rje be+e con/ lhor rdo rje 'chol pa rdo rje bsnams pa/ nub tu rdo rje tho ba/byang du rdo rje lcags kyu/ shar lhor rdo rje lcags sgrog /lho nub tu rdo rje ser ba/nub byang du rdo rje gnod mdzes/ byang shar du rdo rje rmongs byed/ shar sgor rdo rje stobs po che/ lho sgor rdo rje bzhad pa/ nub sgor rdo rje seng ge'i gdan/37—1076

byang sgor rdo rje gtum po/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ skra dang sma ra 'bar ba bri bar bya'o/ /lhag ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /yang rdo rje pho nya mo bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor ni dbus su rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa snga ma bzhin du bris la/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i rtsibs dang po blo gros rdo rje ma rdo rje bsnams pa/ gnyis pa rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/gsum pa rdo rje nag mo 1rdo rje rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ bzhi pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa be con bsnams pa/ lnga pa rdo rje rol pa rdo rje ste gcig pa bsnams pa/drug pa rdo rje ska rags rdo rje rtse gsum pa 2bsnams pa/ bdun pa rdo rje shugs mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ brgyad pa rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje 'bar ba bsnams pa/dgu pa rdo rje dbyig pa rdo rje dbyug tho 4bsnams pa/ bcu pa rdo rje bden pa sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa bri bar bya ste/ de sgrub pa'i 5sngags dang phyag rgya ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya las srin lag nang du bcug la/ na maḥ4sa man+ta shudha badz+ra rde tsaṇ+ḍa 7ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya bar bri bar bya'o / /yang na rdo rje nyid bstod de/ bstan pa ni pho nya mo rnams kyi ste/na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo badz+ra dha ra pra na ma bit+yā ga ṇa 7gye swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhis 11bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la shar phyogs su rdo rje rigs kyi dang po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa mdangs dkar ma/ gsum pa rdo rje rgyal ba7/ rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/rdo rje gdong dmar/ rdo rje 'od zer phreng / rdo rje rna cha'i gdong / rdo rje dga' byed gdong / rdo rje sde/ rdo rje lag bzang 2/ rdo rje khro bo/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje snying po'i rgyal po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams gzhag par 37—/077

bya'o / /lhor rin po che'i rigs rdo rje'i 1ske rags/ rdo rje klu mgo can/rdo rje klu 'dzin/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo/ rdo rje klu chen mo/ rdo rje 'phrog pa/rdo rje dga' ba 2nye dga'/ rdo rje kha 'bar ma/ rdo rje dka' thub zlog /rdo rje dbyig pa/ rdo rje 'od zer phrang 4/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ dpal gyi blo gros / khro bo shī li tī lā ya5/ khro bo su ru su ru/ dpal lha mo/ nub phyogs pad+ma'i rigs la/ ma taṅgi/ mig sna ma'i gdong / rdo rje rtse mo/skrag byed chen mo/ byeṅgi 6ri ti/ rdo rje ser skya/ rdo rje gtsug 'chang / rdo rje lcags sgrog /rdo rje sel byed/ rdo rje gdong / nam mkha'i gdong / rdo rje gnod 'joms/ rdo rje mi bzad pa/ rdo rje 'jigs pa/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud/rdo rje thog thog rnams bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs su las kyi rigs rdo rje dbyig pa/'jigs byed chen po/ bdud rtsi thab 7spyor/ pad+ma yangs pa/ rdo rje legs pa/rdo rje dgra sta/ rdo rje seng ge'i khri/ rdo rje lcags mda'/ rdo rje mtshon cha mchog /rdo rje mtshon cha'i shugs/ rdo rje mtshon cha'i snying po/ dam tshig chen po/ rdo rje dbyug pa/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ rdo rje 'dod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo 9de rnams bri ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya ni sngar bstan pa'i spyi'i de nyid kyis bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor drug bris nas/ gdugs bzhi dang / ba dan bzhi gur gum dang rgya skyegs las btsos pa shing ring bzhi'i rtse mo la btags pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas dang / phyag na rdo rje dbang bsgur ba'i rgyud nas 'byung ba bzhin du bsrung ba'i yan lag phyogs bzhir mdo bzhi bklag 1 pa dang / mda' bcu dang phur bu 1 gdab pa dang / ral gri bcu 1 dang /37—1078

mtshon thag btags pa dang / sngar bshad pa bzhin du bsrung ba'i yan lag rnams dang / mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad dang / bum pa dang sbyin sreg dang /gtor ma'i rdzas thams cad bsags la rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid sngar bshad pa bzhin du khrus dang gos bgo ba byas nas/ cho ga drug gis lhar bskyed de/ srung ba 1dang spyan drang sbyang ba dang / /phyag rgya bcing dang phyir bzlog gnon/ /bskang dang tshim par bya ba dang / /tshar gcod pa dang bskul ba dang / /'khrul cho'akhor spyin sreg khrus bya ba/ /zhes bshad pa'i cho ga bcu gnyis 'dir yang thams cad rdzogs par byas la/ bdag nyid dngos grub bsgrub pa'am 5 slob ma dbang bskur ba'i phyir cho ga thams cad spyad par bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa'i tshe don bcu gnyis ji ltar byas pa bzhin du nye ba'i bsnyen pa la 6yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /sgrub pa sta gon la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /sgrub pa chen po dkyil 'khor zhag kyang 7bcu gnyis snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor drug gang yang rung ba la/ slob ma dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por phyi'i 'jug pa ni sems rab tu dang ba'i slob ma snga ma bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa bdun rnam dag byas la/ sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis btab pa'i stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs dang gdong g.yogs bskon la dkyil 'khor gyi 9 bdag po'i sngags dang phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas sngags lan gsum bzlas nas/lha'i rigs kyi bsod nams ci 'dra ba de bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /des 37—1079

dkyil 'khor du 1dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje rigs kyi sngags bzlas la me tog 'phangs la gang la phog pa'i lha de ni de'i rigs kyi lhar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas dkyil 'khor bstan te/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos2/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes / /sngags dang rig 4pas byin gyis brlabs/ /'byor pa thams cad mngon du gyur5/ /rten dang dngos grub thams cad kyang / /khyod la mngon du phyogs 'gyur gyi6/ /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig srungs / /zhes brjod par bya'o / /de'i tshe me tog dbu la phog na mchog gi dngos grub 'thob8/ me tog rked pa la phog na thun mong gi dngos grub 'thobatsu / me tog rkang pa la phog na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /nang gi 'jug pa rdzogs nas/nas dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma la sogs pa 1zhi ba 'am/ yang na rgyas pa/ mngon spyod kyis 1 bkegs bzlog pas dbang bskur ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis btab pa'i rten sar pa la bzhag nas / sgrub nga/'i grogs pos bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad gdon par bya ste/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma sel mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed sal bde legs mdzad par shog /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud 7mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed 1 la bde legs mdzad par shog /ston pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir / /gang gi bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed 5la bde legs mdzad par shog /skyob pa gang gis byams pa yi /9/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag 27byed/080

kun / /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed 1la bde legs mdzad par shog /gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa ste/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing slu dab mi mnga' la/ /gsung gtsang gtsang bar mdzad pa ste/ /khyed 4la bde legs mdzad par shog /dpa' bo chen po gar skyes par/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing 5 /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa ste/ /khyed 6la bde legs mdzad par shog /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas par rab g.yos 7shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' byed/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog/byang chub snying por gang zhig gis/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa ste / /khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung ba/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gang byung ste7/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par shog /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kyi ni bsams pa yis/ / khyod kyi 'dod don mugang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub 'gyur shog /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog / rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog / khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs gyur—/ /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs gyur/ /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang sabade legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs 'gyur/ /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces 37—/08/

bkra shis brjod nas/ cho ga drug gis kyilhar bskyed nas gnas lngar 2byin gyis brlabs nas dkyil 'khor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i gdugs bteg la khro bo gnod mdzes kyi sngags bzlas pa'i bdug pas bdug cing rnga yab kyis g.yab —la glu dang sel snyan dang / rnga brdungs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun la gsol ba btab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags btab pa'i bum pas lan gsum bskor ba byed du bcug la chu'i dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing ba dang /sngags bzlas pas spyi bor gtug par bya'o/ /de nas gos sar pa bskon nas cod pan dang rgyan btags pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi phyag mtshan g.yas pa g.yas par sbyin/ g.yon pa g.yon par byin la/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba spyi bor bzhag la ming gdags par bya'o/ /de nas seng ge'i khri la 4bzhag la/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bsgrengs nas5 /rin po che sna bdun 6dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang 7lha rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa byin la/ rang rang gi ming dang lung bstan pa dang /gzengs 7bstod pa dang / dbugs dbyung bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags kyi gnang ba gi wang ngam gur gum gyis 2yi ge bris la slob ma dang slob dpon mnyam du lan bdun gyi bar du bklag par bya'o/ /des sngags kyi 1 gnang ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor mthong nas dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ slob dpon go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ /dang po'i dbang du bsgrags pa yin/ /rig sngags thams cad grub sapa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa'i dbang du bshad pa yin/ /bgegs ni 7rab tu gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa sbyor ba thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga bzang po de 37—/082

bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang po'o/ /rig 1sngags bzlas pa gnyis pa'o/ /bgegs rnams zhi ba gsum pa'o/ /dpal 'phel ba ni bzhi pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o༄ / /ngan song gsum du mi lhung ba dang / /mi khom pa brgyad spangs pa dang / /tshe rabs dran zhing longs spyod che//tshul khrims ldan zhing gzugs kyang 4bzang / /rtag tu mi dang lha rnams kyi/ /mtho ris gnas su skye bar shog /ces smon lam yang gdab par bya'o/ /gal te sdom pa 'dzin par mi nus pa'am/ /nad pa'am bar chad mang 5du 'byung ba'am/ 'byung po'i log 'dren gyis zin pa'am/ rig pa mchog las gsungs pa'i gdon rnams kyis gtses pa la khrus kyi cho ga bya ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil par bskyed la gnas lngar 6byin gyes brlabs te7/ lha rnams kyi sngags zlos 8shing yungs kar gyis brab pa dang / rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su phyag rgya bcings pa ni bin du 9pa la zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor gyi sngags zlos 7shing byab pa dang / ru dāk+ṣa 1 gdong gcig pa'i rin po che rma med pa lus la btags nas bsrung ba bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /mgon po thugs rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can/ /gnod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phyir/ /mgon po khyod kyis byin rlabs komadzod/ /ces brjod la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya ste/ bdag gi 12dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni sangs rgyas myur bar shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las grol / /zhes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / bzod par gsol bar bya ste/gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /37—1083

de nas rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor gyi snalha bum pa'i lha dang gcig tu bsres la/ rma bya'i sgos dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya rnams phyis nas khrus kyi gzhong pa bzhag ste/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje can gyi thabs chen gyi/ /zhi yang sems can don du ni/ /dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur / /zhes bstod la bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags rings kyis kyang mtshams bcad gnas lngar rdo rjes gtug cing byin gyis brlab / sems dpa' gtsug tor dang / gzi brjid phung po bskyed par bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la mdzod spur bzhag ste/ na maḥdas man+ta bud+dhā māṃ a bu dzu 4zhes bya bas mdzod sru bskyed par bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dap+ta 5od ka de u pi / sha du na du na hūṃ zhes bya bas gtsug tor bskyed par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chol pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang /gu gul gyi dud pas kyang bdug par bya'o/ //lams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra a sha ni t+t+waṃ phaṭa ces bya bas sran phye 7dang bag phye de'i bros la btab la/ sgrub pa'i grogs pos sngar bshad pa'i bkra shis kyi 9tshigs su bcad pa gdon zhing bum pa thams cad kyi lha zhu bar 1 bsams la de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / /bdud rtsi thab rkaspyor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de thams cad kyi mthu dang /byin gyi rlabs kyis che ge mo zhes bya ba'i gnod pa dang / gdon thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar du lus thams cad khrus bya'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sngags lan bdun bzlas pas spyi bor blugs pa dang / lan bdun bzlas shing snying gar blugs pa dang / lan bdun bzlas 27—/08

lha mo bzhi po bskyed/ /dhū pe dkar mo spos gzhong ser mo bsnams/ /badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ puṣ+pe ri1ser mo me tog gzhong pa bsnams/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe t+t+waṃ2/ mar me dmar skya me gzhong dmar po bsnams/ /badz+ra ā lo ke s+thāḥ dri chab ljang gu lcags kyi gzhong pa bsnams/ /badz+ra gadhe aḥkhyams la phyogs skyong bcu po bskyed/ /rdo rje me thab gru gsum dang / /be con ral gri sprul zhags dang / /ba dan dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 4ga /shar du nyi zla nub tu bum pa las/ /sngags 'di brjod la sku ru gsal bar bskyed/ /in+d+ra ye swā hā/ brgya byin dkar po phyag na rdo rje bsnams/ /asne 5ye swā hā/ asne dmar ser phyag na me thab bsnams/ /yā 6ma ye swā hā/gshin rje nag po phyag na be+e con bsnams/ /nai dṛ h+ye 7swā hā/ bden bral dmar ser phyag na ral gri bsnams/ /ba 8ru ṇa ye swā hā/ chu lha dmar po phyag na sbrul zhags bsnams/ bā / ya be+e swā hā/ rlung lha dmar ljang phyag na ba dan bsnams/ /ku be+e ra ya 1 swā hā/ gnod sbyin ljang gu phyag na dbyug to thogs / /i shwa na 5ye swā hā/ dbang ldan ljang skya phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /srur+ya tsan+d+ra ye swā hā/ tshangs pa sngo skya phyag na nyi zla bsnams/ / pra ti bh+ya rta ye swā hā/sa bdag mthing nag phyag na bum pa bsnams/ /dregs pa sems can kun gyi gdan la bzhugs/ /sgo bzhir phyag rgya lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu las/ /shar du ang ku sha dza—ཿ/ rta gdong dkar mo phyag na lcags kyu bsnams / /lhor pā sha hūṃ las/ phag sagadong nag mo mche zhags thogs pa'o//nub sgor sgo ṭa slobaṃ las/ nyi zla dmar mo lcags sgrog bsnams par bsgom mo/ /byang sgor ā be+e sha aḥ /las/ thal byed ljang nag dril bu 'khrol bar bskyed do/ /yang na khyams su bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad phyag mtshan brgyad las sgu mdog ser 37—/099

mo phyag na bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad bsnams pa bskyed do/ /badz+ra sin da ma/badz+ra tra ma ye/ badz+ra dzi ba ya1/ badz+ra sha lo ye/ badz+ra gu sha hūṃ/ yak+ṣa hūṃ/ba la hūṃ/ da la hūṃ/ zhes bskyed la/ 'od 2dkar gsum la/ dang po rdo rje ra ba la phyogs skyong bskyed/ pad+ma la lha srin sde brgyad bskyed—/ me 'od la bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bskyed dosnye/ /don gyi lha dgu/ rtsa ba'i lha lnga/ bskyed 6pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mchod pa'i lha stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa lnga'o/ /rtsa ba'i sngags brjod la phyag rgya bstan/ /snying po ti lnga dbu stengs su/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis ཿ dbang bsgur ba/ /ka ṭa 8badz+ra zhes brjod pas/ /spyi bor dbang bsgur byen gyis brlabs/ /bskyed 9pa'i lha rnams kun la ni/ /rigs kyi bdag po re re bsgom/ /dbang bskur lha rnams thams cad la/ /ma ṭa 7badz+ra zhes brjod pas/ /lus la rdo rje gos 1 gyon no/ /ma 7tha mi 'gyur ka nan btang rka / /a tha zhes ni bgegs kyang bskrad/ /su las rdo rje khang pa ni/ /rab tu brtan —par 'gyur ba dang mu/ /gzhi yi rnal 'byor lus rnams ni/ /badz+ra bdun gyis slobyin gyis brlab/ /rang bzhin gnas nas bskul ba ni/ /ha ra ha ra badz+ra bi dā ra/ /se gol drag tu brdabs pa yis/ /dzaḥtshiyi sprul pas snyan gsan dbab/ /pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhañja dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ / 'od zer lnga yi mdun du byon/ /ma tisbyi ra badz+ra/ de yis lha rnams cha gnyis dbye / su tispru ra badz+ra/ gdan gcig mi gnyis tshul du gcod/ /pra tisbi ra badz+ra/ de rnams 21gnyis med 'dres par bstem/ /ma hā badz+ra sgu brtan /a pra ti ha ta badz+ra gsung brtan / a mo gha badz+ra thugs brtanad+ku/ e bye hi badz+ra dgyes pa bskyed/ shī rgyu badz+ra dngos grub ma thob bar du bzhugs/ dam 37—1 100

tshig lha dang ye shes lha/ /gnyis med bsgrubs la mchod pas mchod/ /bsgom zhing bzlas pas bsgrub 1par bya/ /sngags rings nye ba'i snying po gnyis/ /bsdus rgyas lha yi bsnyen pa bskyal2/ /mtshan ma dus dang grangs la sogs/ /dam du bcas pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ /thun bzhi rim gyis nyin dang mtshan/ /bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la/ /sa dang sta gon rdul tshon rnams/ /mkhas pas rim par brtsam par bya/ /dang po sa yi cho ga ni/ /sa brtag bslang zhing sbyang ba dang / /byin gyis brlab byung gzung ba lnga/ /sa brtag pa la bzhi ru grangs / /nam mkha'i phyogs dang sa gzhi dang / /bdag po yod med brtag pa bzhi/ /sa sbyangs pa 4la gnyis yin te/ mngon pa mi la nyo bslang dang / /mi mngon bgegs la bslang ba'o/ /bden pa bdar te chos bshad bslang 5ba dang / mchod cing gsol ba gdab ste bslang ba'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi6/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa yi/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /ji ltar shākya seng ge yis / /bdud sde dpung bcas bcom pa bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes rdo rje brdabs 7pas sa'i ser ka nas/ /sa'i lha mo byon te sa gnang ngo / /sa'i lha mo dang sa bdag gnas kyi bdag po la mchod pa dang gtor mas mchod nas/ hūṃ gang yang sa la gnas pa dang / /sa la rgyu ba'i lha klu rnams/ /mchod dang gtor ma 'di long la/ /sems can kun la 8dge don du9/ /byams pa'i sems kyis 37—/ /01

gnang bar mdzod/ /pra ti bya dhū paṃ puṣ+pe—1/ ā lo ke gadhe 2nai bi bye pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ pra ti bya rgo sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tarja 4uta khaṃ ba bo ta khā hi/ sa sbyang ba ni/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba dang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba'o/ /chos nyid stong pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas stong par sbyang ba'o/ /las dang bya bas brkos te ro lnga bsal/ /'thas shing tshad dang ldan par bya/ /tshangs thig zur thig bzhi yang gdab/ /cha chen bcu drug bgo byas la/ /lha snam min 5pa bzhi bzhir bgo /zlum skor khurim pa brgyad du bskor/ /pho brang 'khor lo'i gong ras la/ /rim pa gnyis gnyis bzhi ru bskor / /rdo rje pad+ma me 'od la7/ /cha bran gnyis gnyis mnyam po ru/ /rim pa bzhin du bskor 8te gzhag /mthing ka dkar po ser le brgan/ /ljang gu la sogs pañca btang 9/ /yang na mthing ga dkar po dang / /dmar po sgu gsum tri rā ga /gong ras ljang gu gru chad ser/ /sgo dang lha snam phyogs tshon la/ /lnga rtse dmar po pha gu ser/ /dra ba dkar la chun 'phyang tsolcags/ /dkyil 'khor steng du sku gzugs bzhag /sa de sangs rgyas 11byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs kyis gzung saba'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum pa 1 gzhag pa ni / khro bo las thams cad pas sa gzung —ba'o/ /gnyis pa sta gon gnas par bya/ /lha dang 7bum pa slob ma dang / /sta gon dus kyi sbyin sreg go/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi gnas rnams su/ /tsan+dan gur gum dri yi thig le bya/ /rang rang sngags kyis sneskad cig bskyed/ /de las mchod dang gtor ma dang / /gsang ba sder bzangs mchod pa dbul/ /mchod de gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms ni/ /rig 37—/ /02

pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang / /sems can kun la brtse don du/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ri1ni/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo/ /bum pa sta gon du gnas pa ni/ bum pa'i rgyu bstan pa dang / bum pa'i bcud bstan pa dang / mgul chings bstan pa dang / kha rgyan bstan pa dang / bca' ba'i thabs bstan pa dang / /bzlas pa'i grangs bstan pa dang /bum pa'i grangs bstan pa'o/ /bca' ba'i thabs dang 2/ bum pa'i grangs ni bsdus pa drug ste/ dbang bsgur ba'i bum pa lnga/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum pa dang drug go/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma ni gur gum gyis ti lnga bri / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la hūṃ bri/ kha dog mthing ser dmar ljang ngo / /bdud rtsi srug gi kha dog can du bya'o/ /baṃ las bum pa gzhal yas khang / /baṃ las bdud rtsi'i gzhal yas bskyed4/ /rgya mtsho pad+ma'i gdan stengs su5/ /ti dang yo yig hūṃ las ni/ /lha bskyed spyan drangs mchod pa 'bul6/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa ni / /bum pa re la rdzogs par bya/ /yungs kar re la sngags re btab/ /des ni bum pa'i sta gon no / /7de nas slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni/ de la dang po khrus byas la gos gtsang ma gyon zhing / lag na me tog thogs la/ slob dpon lha la phyag byas la 'di skad zhu'o/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa pas8/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 9'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 37—1 103

dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po 1bdag ni 'jug par bgyi/ /de nas slob dpon gyis spro ba bskyed /la/ ho rtog pa rnams ni legs par bsdus nas su/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas 3blo la rdo rje rnam 'joms pa'i / /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /de nas slob mas sdig pa bshags pa/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bkyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid 4stsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog chen kyi/ /spyan sngar sdig pa ma lus so sor bshags/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod do/ /bdag gis sems can don du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /sdug bsngal gru las thar pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje rgya gram bcug la/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra gro dha kri li shā lā 5ya/zhes brjod la slob ma rdo rje rnam par 'joms par bskyed la/ hūṃ t+t+waṃ tweḥ.aḥ6zhes pas gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs te7/ rdo rje bsdams 8pa'i phyag rgyas snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje/ dpral bar ṭ+wāṃ 9las rin po che/ mgrin par tweḥ⑩las pad+ma/ spyi bor aḥ las sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed do/ /de ltar gnas bzhir ye shes bzhi rtags dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa dbul zhing snang bar byas te/ bdug spos lag tu gtad/ me tog lus la gtor/ dri thugs kar byug /mar me snang bar bstan/ lha bshos zhal du bcug /sil snyan rna bar bsgrags/ sngags dang phyag rgyas tshig rnams go bar brjod do / /kha.a shwat+tha la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog bcings pa de badz+ra hā sa ha 1 zhes sbyin par bya'o/ /ku sha sngon po badz+ra ṭīkyā 6zhes gtad la/ la la 37byed1 /04

sngas su gzhug la la stan du bting la nyol cig 1bsgo'o/ /de nas rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas pa'i srung skud mgul du gdags so/ /gsol ba gdab par bya'o//nang par bzhin bzangs longs shig /dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /lhag gnas slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor te/ badz+ra dṛbye maṭa 2ces nam mkha' la bteg la thig gdab par bya'o/ /gzhung dang mthun par bris nas ni/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga byas te/ dkyil 'khor de nam mkhar babe+eng bar bya ste/ rdo rje rgya gram phyag rgyas / badz+ra be+e ga 4kra ma hūṃ zhes gdeg par bya'o/ /phyag mtshan la sta gon gyi ye shes dbab ste/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa a/ badz+ra hu lu a/ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha a/badz+ra brnya a/ badz+ra ha na a/ badz+ra lā gye a/ zhes sgo ba 'be+ebs 5pa'i bar du dbab par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor byin dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gzungs kyis bsgrub par bya ste / bdag rdo rje rnam par 'joms par bsgoms la/ gzungs tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig bton pas/ kun kyang rdo rje'i gur dang sa gzhir gyur te/ mtshams bcad cing bar chad med par bsgrub par bya'o/ /lhag chad kyi nyes pa kha bskang bar bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje shugs kyis bsgrub 6par bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing / dril bu dkrol zhing lan bdun du dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya'o7/ /rdo rje shugs ni dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg ste bskor ba byas pas/ cho ga lhag pa dang ma tshang ba'i nyes pa dang / ma 'byor ba'i cho ga nyams pa thams cad sor chud par 'gyur ro/ /37—1105

—rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pa thams cad gsung yin/ lha thams cad kyi ༄4phyag mtshan gsal ba thugs/ de las sku gsal ba dbyer med du gyur par bsgom mo//dkyil 'khor gyi gdan thog tu phyag mtshan phab pa de rnams la/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha shī li shī lā ya zhes brjod pa gsung / rdo rje rgya gram du gsal ba de thugs / de las 'od zer 'phro 'du 5byas te skur dkrongs tser song ba de gsu/ma dbyer med pa de ga 6sku gsung thugs tha mi dad par bsgrub pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gye lha ye shes lha'i bdag nyid can du bsgrub pa'i chos brgyad de / rdo rje slob dpon gyis 3se gol brdab cing / badz+ra sa ma ya dza 3ཿhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drang ngo / /badz+ra gabye tshopra be sha phaṭa/ ces sgo dbye / badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥphyi nas nang du spyan drang / badz+ra pā sha hoḥ 1 gdan gcig la gzhug /badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ gnyis med bstem/ ā mube+e sha aḥ zhes dgyes pa bskyed/ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sarba bigha ṭ+wāṃ nā 7sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra karma/sa ra ba bya/ badz+ra sarnyi baṃ gyis 7sgo bcad tshido/ /yi ge gnyis 7kyis lha thams cad la rdo rje ka nan gtang 1na /phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab par bya ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te/oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa dṛ sh+ya dzaḥ 9hūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ a haṃ/oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ti/ rtsa ba'i lha'i snying po mthun te lnga'o 2/ /oṃ badz+ra 'di phye hūṃ/ mā le t+t+waṃ / gī ti s+thā ཿdṛ h+ye aḥ snye.oṃ badz+ra dhū d+kupe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa pubye t+t+waṃ / ā 2 lo ke dīḥ 8gan+dhe aḥ oṃ badz+ra sedhe — / oṃ badz+ra pra ma ye/ oṃ baja dzi ba ye/ oṃ badz+ra sha lo ye/ oṃ badz+ra gu sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badro ba la hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra da la hūṃ/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad ni phyag thal mo gzings 37——/ /06

pa'o / /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā 1be sha aḥ2zhes dam tshig phyag rgya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi ljags la badz+ra dharma 4dz+nyā na zhes bsgom mo/ /las kyi phyag rgya ni/ rigs lnga la/g.yas gdengs shing / g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsgreng 5ba'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pas/ sems can thams cad bsrung dze+eba'i las mdzad du gsol / rdo rje gtum pos zhi ba'i las mdzad du gsol7/ rdo rje phur bus rgyas pa'i las mdzad du gsol / rdo rje be+e con gyis dbang gi las mdzad du gsol9 / rdo rje tho bas sems can thams cad rengs pa'i las mdzad du gsol / gsang ba'i lha mo bzhis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes pa'i las mdzad du gsol/ mchod pa'i lha mo bzhis mchod pa'i las mdzad du gsol12 / bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis sems can thams cad re ba bskang ba'i las mdzad du gsolanyu// sgo ba bzhis de bzhin gshegs pa dgug gzhug gi — las mdzad du gsol lo/ /phyag rgya chen po rdo rje dril bu thogs la/ las kyi phyag rgya bzhin bca' zhing / hūṃ mu dra ma hā sa lha thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad du gsol lo / /kun gyi phrin las gcig yin pas/ /de nas re re ma bshad do/ /mchod pa rgyas par bar 'dir mchod par bya'o/ /mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i samachod pa rnam pa slolngas mchod/ bcom ldan khro bo gos sngon can/ /yon tan thams cad 'dus pa'i sgu/ /rdo rje rgya gram las rnams rdzogs/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni/ /mthing nag brjid pa'i cha lugs can/ /rdo rje rtse lnga sdigs mdzub 'gyed/ /rdo rje thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje phur bu be+e/ /ser nag 'jigs pa'i 37—1 107

cha lugs can/ /rdo rje phur bus las rnams mdzad/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje be+e con ni/ /dmar nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /be+e con 'bar bas gdug pa 'dul/ /dbang sdud sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan rdo rje tho ba ni/ /ljang nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can / /thod sbrul dar gyi rgyan cha can/ /phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod / /sgeg mo phreng ba gar dang dbyangs/ /mdzes pa'i me long phreng bas brgyan / /snyan pa'i pi wang gar sgyur snazhing / /gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdug pa me+e tog mar me dri/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i gzhong pa bsnams / /shangs spyan thugs 'od mchod pa 'bularte/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bkra shis lha mo las kyi sgu/ / btso ma gser mdog rgyas pa'i sgu/ /phyag na bkra shis rdzas brgyad bsnams/ /re skong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /dgug gzhug dgyes pa'i las mdzad ma/ /sgo ba rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshangs pa brgya byin me yi lha/ /gshin rje srin po chu yi lha/ /rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs kyi rgyal/ /sa bdag la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang // mkha' lding sngu'adab bzangs lus srul po/ /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /sde brgyad tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la5/ /gnas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag tshogs/ /so so rang gis 'khor 'dul zhing / /sa gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas bsgom zhing bzlas pas bsgrub par bya ste/ lha rnams rang 6gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la7/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ la rang rang gi 37—1 /08

sngags kyis bskor ba la bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags kyis lha mo 1mchod pa dang /sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / bgegs thon pa dang / dngos grub bsdu ba'i las bzhi'i 'phro 'du bya'o/ /de nas thun mtshams su sder bzangs kyi mchod pa dbul te/ tshe 'dzin zas kyi steng du ni/ /sbrang gi seng ge skyong bzhi gzhag /mar gyi tha ma zas kyi 2bcud / /bu ram dpag bsam dze+eng gi shing / /lan tshwa spod snamachog gangs ri srungs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul rnyi/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe 5pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ zhes lan gsum bar du btab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 6/rdo rje gtum po la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/bcom ldan rdo rje thugs khyod la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ bcom ldan rdo rje phur bu la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ bcom ldan rdo rje be+e con la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ bcom ldan rdo rje tho ba la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul / /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs 37—1109

nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā ti/1 dkyil 'khor gong ras 'khor lo'i mtshams/ /gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi po la/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ rgyas pa'i gru chad ser po la/ /las mdzad mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ 'bar ba'i bar khyams phyogs mtshams brgyad/ /yid 'ong bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ā hūṃ pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ye shes las kyi 2sgo bzhi nas/ /sgo ma dgug gzhug las mdzad cing / /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul/ /tshogs bsags byang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥt+t+waṃ pa na dze pen ku rak+ṣa khā hi/ rdo rje pad+ma me 'od las/ /phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs/ /snying po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul4/ /tshogs bsags skubyang chub lam sbyang phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ gyis nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag /āḥyis bdud rtsi chen por gyur6/ /hūṃ gis spros te mchod pa 'bul/ /pa na pe pen ku rak+ṣa 7khā hi/ phud tsho bcu'i mchod pa 'bul lo/ /de nas nang du 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis mchod / de nas sgo'i phyi rol 'od kor la/ 'jig rten pa rnams gtor ma cha 37byed /10

gsum gyis mchod/ dkyil 'khor bris pa'i rjes la dkyil 'khor bslang zhing ye shes phab la/ bum pa rnams dgram ste/ rigs kyi bum pa lnga phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar dgod/ bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i bum pa 'jug pa sgo'i g.yon logs su dgod/ de rnams lhar bskyed la mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod/bsgom zhing bzlas pa'i skabs su/ bum pa re la snying po brgya rtsa brgyad sngags kyis bskyal 1lo/ /dang po dkyil 'khor bslang 2zhing ye shes dbab pa'i bsgrub pa byas la/ bum pa dgram pa sngon du 'gro ba mchod pa rnam pa ༄ —lngas mchod/dkyil 'khor de byin dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje gzungs kyi sgrub pa byas la / lhag chad kyi nyes pa bskang ba rdo rje shugs kyi bsgrub 4pa bya/ sku gsung thugs tha mi dad pa'i bsgrub pa bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ye shes kyi lha'i bdag nyid bsgrubs la/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab ste/ mchod pa rgyas pas mchod/rtsa ba'i lha bsgom zhing sgrub 5pa byas te/ sder bzangs tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/nang du 'jig rten las 'das pa la sbyin sreg gis mchod/ phyi rol du 'jig rten pa la gtor ma cha gsum gyis mchod la de ltar mchod cing bsgrub pa'i chos bcu gcig la gnas nas dbang bskur bar bya ste/de yang dang po la slob ma lhag gnas kyi 9dus kyi/ dbang bskur ba smin pa'i chos bcu po bya/ slob ma dang po lus khrus byas la slob dpon la gsol ba gdab / de nas slob dpon gyis spro ba bskyed/ slob mas rang gi sdog pa bshags nas sems bskyed/ sems 7kyi 'bras bu lhar bskyed/ lha'i gnas gzhi 8byin gyis brlab slob ma'i lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs la/37—/ 11 1

—— — — byedabyed byed slo/ba dngo/na gyis/ de la mchod pa 'bul/ lha gang la dbang thob pa'i dkyil 'khor du spyan bkab 'a/ so shing bsgyur/ dbang la bar chad bskyab phyir srung n+tu/da 1 gdags/ so/ /hūṃ srung sgud sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /lha yi mgul du dbang bsku/ra bas/ /cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bsrung du gsol lo/ /bar chad cis kyang mi tshugs pa'i rdo rje'i go cha gyon par bsam mo/ /de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du bcug la dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /dang bo bum pa thogs te 'di skad du / bum pa dag byed chos nyid spyos bral sku/ /kun gzhi nyon mongs gnas gyur 4lus/ dag ste/ /rnge long lta bu'i ye shes mthar rtogs nas/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms/ sgu ru sa/ngas rgyas shog /na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ trīḥ.aḥ lan lnga brjod pa gong mas 'gre/ bum pa chu yi dbang bsgur bas/ /lus kyi sgrib pa dag pa ste/ /me long lta bu'i don mchog ni/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i don rtogs par gyur cig /de nas dbu rgyan thogs la 'di skad do/ /dbu rgyan rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi sku/ /nyon mongs lnga yi gnas ni dag 'gyur te/ /lus kyi sgrib pa dag ste mnyam nyid rtogs/ /rin chen 'byung ldan sgu ru sa/ngas rgyas shog /rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang mo'i phyag rgya bcas te/yo/ badz+ra dhā twe shwa ri ne+e hūṃ/ badz+ra ṇi 6a bye ṣiñca māṃ / badz+ra badz+re ṇi hūṃ/ raṇ+ḍa badz+re ṇi t+t+waṃ / dharma/ badz+re ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ karma badz+ra 9 ṇi hūṃ a bye ṣiñca māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khrod la dbu rgyan gyi rka dbang bsgur bas/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur pas mnyam nga/ nyid kyi ye shes rtogs te/ rin chen 'byung ldan sgur sangs rgyas/ par gyur cig /de nas rdo rje thogs la 'di skad do/ /rka hūṃ sangs rgyas 27 —— / / /2

—ye shes de ni bsod nams dang ye shes tshad med pa rnams kyi tshogs can/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas/ de'i phyir lag na rdo rje'i /—1lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas zhes bya bas/'byung ba chen po bzhi las grub pa lta bu ni ma yin gyi ye shes kyi lus can du bstan pa'o / /de'i phyir rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa zhes pa yang ye shes des chos kyi de kho na nyid shin tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo rdo rje ltar thogs pa med pas rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i gnas skabs la bya bar mngon no/ /ci'i phyir ye shes 'di las 2rdo rje zhes bya zhe na/ phyi rol gyi rdo rje rin po che dang chos mthun pa rnam pa bdun yod pa'i phyir dpe'i sgo nas nye bar mtshon pa yin te/de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa zhes bya ba rnams te/ de ni ye shes de nyid kyis rang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yang bstan to/ /de gzhan gyi don bstan pa ni/ thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sgo sna tshogs nas sems can kyi don mdzad pa ste/ khams gsum pa 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ phyin ci log gi lta ba can/ phyi dang nang nas bgegs dang log 'dren rnam 4par ldang ba'i rgyu5/ las kyi bag la nyal ba dang / kun nas ldang ba dang bcas pa de dag 'dul 6bar bya ba'i phyir sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa zhes bya ba nas/ sems can thams cad bsrung ba zhes bya ba dang / sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar du cho ga'i don rnam pa bco lngas bstan te/ de dag rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan gyi 37—1119
