babs kyis mdzes par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol stegs bu'i mtha' skor 1 du rtswa ku shas bskor cing / me tog gi sil ma dag kyang dgram mo/ /de nas phyi rol du byung ste/ 'byung po thams cad la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ bza' ba sha chang la phug la sogs bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes bya ba dag khyer nas/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lho 'phye grul/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bden pa bdar bar byas nas lag pa gnyis kyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las kha phye ste/ bkan 1nas bstan pa'i tshul du bya ba ni gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyag rgya ste/ 'byung po de dag la so so'i rig sngags dag 4brjod cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi rig pas byin gyis brlabs te bsngo'o5—/ /de nas slar yang 6log ste lha'i gnas su song la tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de dag mdun gyi bar snang la gyen du spag 7cing rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gdan seng ge dang pad+mar bcas pa'i gdan khri bsams nas der rig sngags kyi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang ba ni pho brang lcang lo can gyi dpal phyag na rdo rje ye shes kyi snang ba'i khyad par las byung ba'i/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba sku 8mdog ljang sngon zhal gyi smin ma khro gnyer can phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon pa dkur brten 9cing 'gying bag can / stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dar ljang gu'i tshig gu gsol ba/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'khor lo 1 rig sngags kyi lha dang / khro bo phyag brnyan 1grangs med pa'i tshogs can bdag nyid kyi 1 phyag rgyas spyan drang ste1trī/lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bcug la phan tshun bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad bkug par byas la/ gung mo 37—/ /23

— ————————byed gnyis/ gzhibs pa'i phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ bar nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par byas nas 1mje bong gnyis mje'u chung gnyis gzhibs la de'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la nā ya swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /yang na rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang ngo / /de nas thog mar dam tshig gi sngags dang 4phyag rgya bstan par bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mje'u chung gi sen mo mje bos mnan la/ lhag ma rnams rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas te/ de'i sngags ni oṃ/ shaṃ ka re ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas yang dkyil 'khor nang gi grwa bzhir khro bo bzhi gzhag ste/ byang shar mtshams nas bzung ཿ ste khro bo'i rgyal ngo/ rdo rje gtum po zhes bya ba sku mdog smug nag /bzhin khro gnyer can phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs par byas pa thogs par bsams te/ de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo snying ga'i phyogs su/ gzhag /g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum rdo rje ltar bya ste/ de nyid kyi sngags kyang 'di nyid las/ sbyin+da stson+da ma hā gī li kri lā ya swā hā/ zhes sbyar bar bya'o//de nas shar lho mtshams su/ rdo rje tī 1 lā ya zhes bya ba/ mdog ljang nag dpral ba khro gnyer can phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa ka na ya'i dbyebs 'dra ba thogs/ nga/ra bsams te1 / de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis khu tshur nang du bcangs/ te/ cung zad bsgol ba'e tshul du bcug ste mje bong gnyes gyen du gzhibs te rka bsgreng la/ de'i sngags ni/ ban+dha ban+dha kro dha gro dha shī li tī khā ya swā hā zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /de nas yang lho nub mtshams su rdo rje be con zhes bya ba sgu mdog mthing nag sma ra ser po gyen du 'khyel ba/ g.yas na be con gyi rtse mo rdo rjes mtshan pa bsams te de'i phyag rgya ni phyag 'tshal ba 5thal mo sbyar ba 37——/ /2 /

———byed—las mthe bong gnyis/ bsgreng te / tshigs bkug nas srin lag gi drung du gzugs par bya'o / /de'i sngags ni tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa tī li shī lā ya swā hā zhes 4sbyar ro/ /de nas nub byang 5mtshams su rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba mdog nag po shin tu khros nga/ 6mche ba gabyugs pa bsams/ te / de'i phyag rgya ni lag nga/ gnyis khu tshur bcangs te mje bong gnyis bsgreng ste mje'u chung gnyis/ nang du gzhug gorka / /de'i sngags ni tā sa ya tā sa ya badz+ra tī li tī lā ya swā hā zhes bya bar sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas de'i phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor rim pa gsum/ par dbang ldan la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dang / rnam rgyal la so/gas nga/ bkra shis kyi lha brgyad kyi phyag mtshan rnams dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya bcings la spyan drangs shing rang rang gnas/ su bkod nas gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gus pa khyad nga/ra can byas te/mchod yon dang me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa dang zhal zas dang mar ske'i mchog rnams rim bzhin du dbul lo/ /de nas phyogs bcu dag na ji ltar srid pa'i lha rdzas dang / kun du bzang po'i mchod pa dag gis/ kyang mchod la/nam mkha' mdzod kyi rig pas kyang byin gyis brlab ste/ 'di ltar na maḥsadze+e ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsan+d+ra tad khaṃ uṅga te sga ra ṇa hi 5rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ de nas reg sngags gdon pa ni/ lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad / /ces bya bas grangs nges par gsungs pa la/ rtsa ba'i rig sngags dang mjug nas yang snying gi sngags rnams dang gnyis bskul ba dang bcas par zlo na ni lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig zlos par 'gyur ro/ /yang na de rnam pa 1spyo 37—/ /25

gnyis ka zlos par mi nus na 1na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra zhes pa nas a mṛ 2te hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i bar ni rig sngags 'di'i yang snying ste bskul tshig dang bcas pa lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas brjod zin nas yon bdag dang slob ma gnyis ka yang dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su khri lta bu gzhag pa'i sar yang na ri mo yid kyis gdeg pa dang /yang na phyag rgya nyi tshe bya'o/ /de nas der bum pa rnams kyi chus blugs shing dbang bsgur te/ shu ti dang nye shing la sogs pas kyang bkru/ rol mo dang bkra shis la sogs pa yang gdon no/ /khrus zin nas sgor 'byung ba'i dus su zho dang mar dang snasman dang 'bras bu la sogs pa 4bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams la cho gar bstan pa rnams mthong ba dang reg pa dag ni phyabakag pa med do/ /de nas rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i cho ga'i phan yon 'byung ba mdor bsdus na gnyis su 'dus te/ sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa dang bde ba skyed 6par byed pa'o/ /de la sdug bsngal sel ba 7ni/ sems can dbang po nyams pa dang / /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang / /zhes bya ba nas/ de dag thams cad zhi bar 9 blta / /zhes bya ba dang / sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pa bzhis bstan to/ /bde ba byed par byed pa ni/ rgyud do cog gi 1 rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun kyis ni legs par brgyan/ /zhes bya ba nas/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /zhes bya ba rnams kyis bstan te/ de dag gis 1 phan yon mdor bsdus pa tsam du zad kyi/ gzhan yang rgyal po'i 1 chad pas 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun dang / me dang / chu 37—/ 126

dang / dug dang mtshon la sogs pa'i spre 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol bar rig par bya'o// //rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga'i 'grel pa slob dpon rdo rje go chas mdzad pa sdogs so// //bldur mchan/1118 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga'i 'grel pa/ bzhugs so/ / 〈〈snar 〉〉 raya/ /rdo rje rnam pa/ra 'joms pa'i khrus chog gi 'grel pa rdo rje cho gas mdzad pa/'o/ / zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gici ta/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/she 〈〈pe 〉rolas/ 5 〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/111 9 1 〈〈pe 〉〉rjer/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ 〈〈pe 〉sngarapham/ ji 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/sa/ 5 〈〈snar 〉〉rgyud / rtse 〈〈pe 〉sngagadul/11 2༷ she (〈snar 〉〉gitshig 3 〈〈snar 〉sngagasung ba/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikyang / 〈〈pe 〉rabakrus/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉pa/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉gib/ / ( 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibum pa/11 21 1 〈〈snar 〉〉ginyid do/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉girnam pa sna tshogs/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉nas ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 4 〈〈pe 〉thazhi pa ru sku/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi ru ku/ —zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya ste/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉dang ngo/sa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dang po/ dza 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang / 8 〈〈pe 〉〉bcags te/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉 rnam pa/ sna tshogs/ rka 〈〈pe 〉〉bye/ —1 〈〈pe 〉〉pas/〈〈snar 〉ra/ra/ sa 〈〈pe 〉8 ni/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉dur ba/ 〈〈snar 〉d+kurba/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du/1122 lku 〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ 2 〈〈pe 〉thakri/ 1 〈〈pe 〉7ni/ gi 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sha ka tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉—'bru sna tshogs rnams/ dzi 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs/ te 〈〈snar 〉stan/ te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giseng ge'i/ 12 〈〈snar 〉ngos/ ñjasnye〈〈pe 〉〉shar/〈〈snar 〉7nga shar/ thu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rirtse/ mu 〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ ka 〈〈pe 〉ṅkapa/ mu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yang /nyu8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gini/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉che/1123 zhe 〈〈snar 〉thaskor/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ 〈〈snar 〉thaskan/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dag 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉37byed1 1 27

༄ga /las kyi mtha' bco brgyad pa'i man ngag bzhugs/ 1༄tsho/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi mtha' bco brgyad pa'i sgrub thabs sil mar bshad pa la spyi don bzhir shes par bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang lha 2lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga dang / las su bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / mjug bsdu ba'i cho ga'o / /bsnyen pa'i cho ga spyir mthun no/ /lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga la lnga ste/ so so'i liṅga bca' ba dang / bdug pa'i rdzas/ gdab pa'i rdzas / brab pa'i rdzas/ byug pa'i rdzas so/ /las kyi mtha' bco brgyad kyang las bzhir bsdu na zhi ba la lce pog dkar po/ rgyas pa la gla rtsi dang ga bur/dbang la tsan+dan dang gur gum/ drag po la gu gul nag po'o/ /zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi shing / rgyas pa la gser can gyi shing / dbang la khrag can gyi shing /drag po la dug can gyi shing ngo / /sor bzhi dang / sor drug dang / sor 37—/ 129

brgyad dang / sor bcu gnyis pa bya zhing / rtse mchan zlum po dang / gru bzhi / zla gam/ zur gsum mo/ /de dag lte ba dang / dpung pa dang /gsang ba dang / snying gar so sor gdab po/ /gzhan yang / yungs kar kun gyi 1 gtsor byas te/ /til dang ske tshe shang tshe dang / /yungs kar brab pa'i las dang sbyar ro/ /lus 2su bya ba dkyil 'khor chen po dang mthun pa las/gro ga'am ras sam shing shun las gang 'dod pa'i gzugs dang ming bris te/dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su gang yang rung ba'i phur bus 'dzer te bzhag /bzlas nga/ la bab pa dang / tra ṭa nas saṃ gha'i pabar du yang snying rtsa sngags so sor sbyar ro/ /gtor ma'i cho ga yan chad rdzogs nas mjug bsdu ba'i cho ga shes par bya ste/ sems can gang zhig skrag 5par bya ba'i cho ga ni/ tra ṭa dang sbyar te ri mo bdun du blangs te/ rdo rje khro bo'i sngags bzlas shing lan brgya rtsa brgyad du gu gul nag po'i dud pas bdug cing phur pa snying gar btab ste/ brabs nas yul bā rā ṇa sbo'i sas byugs nas/ ri mo rlung chen po la 7phyar na gang la bya ba de kho na skrag par 'gyur ro/ /dmag gi dpung gzhil rab ni tho ṭa dang sbyar te/ spyor ba thams cad gong dang mthun 7pa las mjug bsdu ba'i cho ga'i dus su ri mo bdun du blangs te lce pog 1nadakar pos bdug /phur pas btab ste brabs nas mi rus kyi phye mas byugs nas 'bi 'bi'i nang du bcug la mchod rten byas te mchod nas skra mtshams su spyi gtsug tu 2sbas na/ dgra bgegs kyi dpung nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rig sngags thams cad gcod pa sgo saṭa dang sbyar te/ ri mo la bdug pa dang 7bral ba'i las byas nas thal chen gyis byugs la/ mtshon rnon pos gtubs la dug 7shing gi me la byad kyi rdzas 37—1 /30

gnyis dang mar nag tu byas pas sbyin sreg tu byas te/ thal ba chu chen por gtor na nges par gzhan gyi dmod 1pa zhi ba'o/ /rig sngags thams cad gnon pa ni/ sgo ṭa dang sbyar te/ thal chen gyis byugs pa yan chad mthun 2pa las rdzas dang bcas te mchod rten chen po'i 'og tu sbas na/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad kyi mgo gnon par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad 'joms pa ni gh+raṇ+ḍi dang sbyar te/ de ni lho phyogs kyi rgyal po stobs ldan kyi rnam smin mi bzad pa ste/ bram ze phur bu — rig pa 'dzin pa dang / mdo sde dang gzungs —sngags ltar bzlas pa'i rjes la rgyal po'i nad mi bzad pa de thams cad/ sat+tha 5bit+yā ghuṇ+ḍi 6mā ra ya ku ru ye swā hā/ bram ze chen po 7/ bzlas pa'i yon tan de tsam na/ /bsgrubs pa'i yon tan bsam las 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge bar gsungs/ /zhes pa dang / sgrub pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga gzhung ltar byas la bzlas pa'i dus su yang snying dang rtsa sngags la sadze+e bit+yā dang ghuṇ+ḍi 9sbyar ro/ /'jug pa dbang bsgur ba dang / mjug gi don bya ba dang / byab pa dang bsrung ba byas nas til nag po'i sdig pa byas te mtshon rnon pos gtubs te/ shing gsar 1 pa la sbyin sreg byas pas nges pa kho nar sngon gyi las bcom mo/ /gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa ni/ ghukyā pa 1 ya dang sbyar te/ gzhan dag las 'gran sems can gyi ming gang yin pa'i ri mo bris la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su gzhag ste/ cho ga yongs su rdzogs par byas te/ ri mo mdun du blangs te bdug pa dang brab pa byas te/ro'i sol bas byugs nas tsher ma can gyi me blangs te sbyin sreg bya ste/ thal ba rlung chen po la phyar na'o/ /dgra bgegs brlag par byed na ni/ sadz+dza —satwa 37—1 131

ni la sogs pa ni gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa ni bo bye 1dang sbyar te/ 'di ni thar par byed pa yin gyi brlag 2par mi byed de btson ra nas thar pa dang 'dra zhes pa'i tha tshig go/ /thar par 'dod pa'i ri mo dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus bu gzhag ste/ las mas cad gong ma dang 'dra ba las phur pa dang bcas pa la chas bril ༄/ba la/gser dang g.yu rgod dang / rdo rgod che ba g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa lus sam mgul du btags na/ gdon la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'byung po thams cad 'gugs pa ni pa bye 4dbang du bya ba dngos so/ /rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa ni saṃ bo dha 5dang sbyar te/ gro ga'am ras sam shog bu la gang 'dod kyi ming byang bris te/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bzhag ste/ cho ga rnams yongs su sgogs pa dang / bdug pa dang gdab pa dang / brab pa'i spyor ba byas te sbyar spos 6dang dri sna tshogs pas 7byugs te/tsan+dan la sogs pa'i shing dri bsung can gyi me lha sbyin sreg byas nas sol ba dang de nyid mar dkar dang bsres te/ bza' ba dang byug pa byas na nges par 'grub po/ /ma grub pa grub par byed pa ni phra ma dang sbyar te/ gang grub par 'dod pa'i ri mo bris la/ cho ga gong ma nyid dang mthun 9no/ /yang ni 7ming mgul khug du gzhug go/ /grub pa chud mi za bar byed pa ni/ saṃ bh+ra ma dang 1 sbyar te/ gang mngon du gyur pa'i nor rdzas kyi ming bris te/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su gzhag la bdug pa dang gdab pa dang brab pa rdzogs pa dang a shwat+pā'i 1 khu bas byugs nas za ma tog tu bcug la ras gtsang mas rnyidakris nas phur pa dang bcas te rgyas btab la/ sku gzugs sasam mchod rten gyis mnan 37—1 /32

te / shin tu dbe+en pa'i sar bzhag na 1nges par chud mi za'o/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa ni ku ṭa dang sbyar te/ de la lnga ste/ bu sbyin pa dang nor sbyin pa dang / 'bru sbyin pa dang / rkang mgyogs spyin pa dang / tshe dang bsod nams sbyin pa'o/ /bu sbyin pa ni bu 'dod pa'i ming byang bdug gdab brab par bya ste/ ga bur la sogs pa'i dris byugs te lung thang dang bo de tse dang 2bcas te/ ser po shing la me gtang la sbyin sreg bya ste/ sol ba 'bru mar dang sbyar te byen na bu med pa bu yod par gyur te/ nor dang 'bru 'dod pa la nor dang 'bru'i ming 4bris la bdug gdab pa bya ste/ phyug po'i bang mdzod dang / rgyal po'i dkor mdzod cha tshang 5gi nor sna tshogs pa tshags byas 6na 'grub po/ /dud 'gro'i ming bris te lcags la bzlas la 7byin na 'grub po/ /tshe dang bsod nams sbyin par ni bkra shis kyi zhal zas la brten te/ā yu wasnya ne+e puṣ+ṭi rwaku ru ye swā hā dang sbyar ro/ /de dag thams cad la 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa ni dkyil 'khor chen po dang mthun no/ /sems can thams cad bsrung ba ni saṃ kuṣ+ṭa ya dang sbyar te/ de la yang lnga ste/rims bsrung ba dang / gdon bsrung ba dang / 'khor dang nor phyugs bsrung ba dang / lo tog bsrung ba dang / sri'u bsrung ba'o/ /de dag ni gdams ngag las shes par bya'o/ /ser ba bsrung ba la spyi'i 'khor lo lus la bcings 7te/ so so'i 'khor lo'i thog tu gzugs pa dang / yang snying rtsa sngags dril te gdong bzlog bya'o11/ /rengs par byed pa ni gha ṭa dang sbyar te/gang rengs 1 par 'dod pa de'i ming bris te/ bdug gdab brab pa yan chod so so'i las kyi bye brag spyir mthun pa las thal chen byugs te shing bsrung ba'i sna 737byed/ /33

ma'i shing dag la me sbar te me tog ker btsugs ༄1dang / rlung gi rta mo dang /ril ma la sbyin sreg byas nas thal ba byi ba'i rlud bur blugs te yungs kar dang yungs nag tu sbyar nas gar gtor ba de rengs par byed do/ /rmugs par byed pa ni saṃ gha ṭā / ya dang sbyar te/ gang rmugs par 'dod pa'i ming byang bdug gdab brab pa byas nas la chas 4dril la/ rkang 'og dang lce 'og tu bcug na nges pa kho nar rmugs par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi mtha' bco brgyad pa'i man ngag slob dpon rdo rje go chas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bldur mchan/1129 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar brkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 〈〈sna ra 〉ra nga kha/113༷ 1〈〈snar 〉〉gigyi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉sbya ra ba'o/ /la sa/ 〈〈sna ra 〉rolas / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazir/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉ta nas sang ga'i/ 〈〈snar 〉ra nas sa ga'i/ 5〈〈snar 〉ra skrag 6〈〈pe 〉〉 ra na se'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa ra ṇa se'i / 7〈〈pe 〉sngalar / 8〈〈snar 〉snga thil / / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbya ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'thun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉'jug 〈〈snar 〉stanango/ga 〈〈snar 〉thacag —〈〈pe 〉〉'tshams su spyi tshugs su/ 〈〈snar 〉rnamatshams su spyi tshugs su/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyi / 7〈〈snar 〉〉gidang / 7〈〈snar 〉〉 gi/1131 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smod/ 2 〈〈sna ra 〉d+kuthun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉ze phru gu/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ze'i phru gu/ 4〈〈pe 〉razugs/5〈〈pe 〉srasarba/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ghuṇ+ḍi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge /sa/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉ra sams/9 〈〈pe 〉rasarba bya ti da ra ghur ṇ+ḍi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang / 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge la je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gisar/ rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ghu1 pā// sa〈〈pe 〉masarba/1132 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rlag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsāl/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉sham/ 〈〈snar 〉thashaṃ/zhe〈〈snar 〉shes/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉spros/ )〈〈snar 〉ra / 8〈〈snar 〉〉ging/'i/ 9〈〈snar 〉skorathun/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ nyu 〈〈snar 〉〉gidang / 〈〈snar 〉〉pon/ tso 〈〈pe 〉〉shā ta'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉shā ta yi/ ⑫〈〈snar〉〉ma—/ 7〈〈sna ra 〉sngagazug1133 1 〈〈pe 〉ras/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 glas dang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatang / 4〈〈snar 〉zad/ ye〈〈pe 〉〉37byed1 134

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra ṭī bi byeḥ /bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi yang gdug 'dul khro mchog sku 'dud de yi cho ga bshad/ rang skad cig gis lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs kyi sngags bsams la de'i 'od kyis 4sa/ngas rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / lam la gnas pa dang /lus dbul ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba byas la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho5haṃ zhes pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du lhag par mos par 37—/ /36

bya'o / /de'i rjes la gzungs kyi yi ge sgra tsam la dmigs pa dang / de yongs su gyur pa las/ gzungs kyi yig 'bru rnam par bsam pa dang / de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po gzungs kyi yi ge rnams gzungs kyi tshul du nang na gnas par bsams la/ de las phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang5rtesdug bsngal sbyangs te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod de/ slar 'dus nas zla ba la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kyi sprul pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang gu 2phyag g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje ngos gcig med pa bsnams pa g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs kyi yi ge rnams bsam mo/ /de'i sngags kyi 'od kyis mdun du ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas spyan drangs nas/me tog la sogs pas mchod nas bstod de/ de gnyis kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi sngags las 4'od 'phros pas sngags kyi 5yi ge rab 'od bskal pa'i me 'dra bar bsam/ ye shes sems dpa'i sku dang de'i thugs ka'i zla ba dang /de'i steng gi gzungs kyi yi ge la dmigs te gzungs gdon no/ /yang dam tshig sems dpa'i gsung la dmigs te gzungs gdon no/ /de bzhin du rim gyis thun bzhi ru gzungs 'bum bzlas pa ni sngon du bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas nad pa la sogs pa'i don du sa phyogs gtsang ma ru ba'i rnam pa lngas byugs te/ me tog gi sil ma dgram par bya'o/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'am / maṇ+ḍal gang yang rung ba byas la/ rin po che'am sa las byas pa'i 37—1 /37

bum pa rtsa ba mi gnag pa nag po ra ri med par —1rin po che sna lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang / sman lnga dang / snying po lnga dang / spos dri zhim po 3blugs te/ldum bus kha brgyan la mgrin par ras kyis dkri'o/ /hūṃ las rin po che'i bum par bskyed de baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ paṃ las pad+ma de'i steng du gong bzhin du bcom ldan 'das bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' sbyan drangs te mchod bstod byas la gtor ma btang ste/ gong bzhin shebazlas par bya'o/ /de nas nad pa sdom pa 'dzin du bcug la/ bum pa'i chus khrus byas na nad pa nad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon byang chub snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1136 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngag/ /rdo rje rnam pa/ra 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉〉g.yo/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ sa〈〈pe 〉mdopho/1137 1 〈〈snar 〉ridang / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skosan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉raku ru bsten/ 4〈〈snar 〉sum̐/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉—snga gas kyi/11 8 / 〈(pe 〉8/'i nang du/ 〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ sa 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkango// ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jum/ je〈〈pe 〉7du/37—1 138
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1646)37wa 1139

༄/ /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/41༄7/ /rnam par 'joms pa ye shes sku/ /rab tu btud nas mdor basbus bshad/ /dben gnas 'dug la maṇ+ḍal bca'/ /khrus byas gos bgos mchod pa bsham/ /spyan drangs la sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /tshad med bzhi po bsgom par bya/ /de nas stong pa nyid bsgoms te/ /rang sems zla bar hūṃ bsam sabya/ /hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /rdo rje ra ba dra ba dang / /'gro ba'i don mdzad tshur 'dus te/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /gnag byung 'bar ba'i me 'od bcas/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /sngar bzhin sems can don byas te/ /slar yang rdo rje nyid la 'dus/ /rdo rje yongs gyur sku ru gsal/ /sgu mdog mthing nag spyan gsum pa/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par gnon/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab brda/ /zhabs gnyis stag gi pags pa bsnams/ /klu lngas lus brgyan me dpung 'bar/ /37byed/ 140

de ltar rnam par bsgoms nas kyang / /ye shes khro bo spyan drangs te/ /mchod nas rang la gzhug par bya/ /nam mkhar sangs rgyas sbyan drangs te/ /sprul pa'i lha mos dbang bskur ro/ /spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bsam/ /spyan drangs lha rnams gshegs par gyur1/ /de nas rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis/ /spyi bo la sogs gnas gsum du/ /zla ba'i steng du yi ge gsum/ /yongs gyur mtshan ma gsum du gnas/ /de las bzlas pa byas pa ni/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs la/ /sngags dang 'od zer 2bcas pa las/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sku ru gsal/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i dbus dag na/ /bdag nyid khro bo chen ngo/ra gnas/ /kun gyi thugs kar nyi steng du/ /rnam par 'joms pa'i yi ge dgod / /phar spros don ni rdzogs pa dang / /tshur 'dus sgrub pa nus par ldan / /sngags kyi 'brug sgra lta bu ste/ /skyo na gtor ma gtang bar bya/ /mchod pa byas te ye shes gshegs/ /dam tshig nga rgyal kun spyod bya/ /'dis 4 ni sgrub pa mdor bsdus te/ /bsod nams mchog ni gang thob pa/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ /rnam par 'joms pa thob par shog /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub 5thabs mdor bsdus pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—/ 1 //

bsdur mchan/114༷ hu mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 〈 〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/1141 1 〈〈pe 〉sngaragyur/ 27〈〈snar 〉stanazer/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ ④〈〈pe 〉skoradi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1647)37wa 1 1 42

༄ga /rdo rje rjam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa maṇ+ḍal bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bo che/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo / /gang gis legs par smin byed pa'i/ /'khor lo'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bzang ldan pas4/ /legs par brtags pa'i slob ma la/ /tshul bzhin bsnyen pa sngon song nas/ /ri bo bzang sogs shis pa'i sar/ /bslang dang sbyang dang gzung 5ba dang / /bsrung ba'i cho ga legs byas pas/ /thog mar bum pa'i bya ba las6/ /gser ram dngul lam yang na zangs/ /kham las gnyis lnga nyi shu lnga7/ /dkar po'i rdzas kyis legs byugs la/ /rang lha'i mtshan ma ldan par bya/ /ma nyams ras kyis 9mgul dkris pa/ /dri zhim chu yis bkang ba dang / /'bru sman rin chen 37byed1 143

lngar ldan pa/ / bzang po'i 1shing gis kha brgyan nas/ /ku sha'i stan la yang dag gzhag /lha yi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / /bzlas mthar mchod zhu bdud rtsir bya/ /slob ma gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed pas/ /sgo gsum mi dge las bzlog cing / /kun du spyod pa gtsang ldan pas/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor brtson byed pa'i/ /dam tshig rjes su 'dzin pa la/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyur pa'i/ /mtshan ma gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje dang bcas dris reg dang / /mchod pa lnga yis legs mchod bya/ /dkyil 'khor byi dor legs byas par/ /dri dang me tog tshom bur bcas / /babyed dang gnyis med mchod pa la/ /bstod de nam mkhar gshegs gsol bya/ /dri dang ba yi lci ba yis/ /legs par byugs pa'i stegs bu la/ /gtsang ma'i ras kyi srad bu dang / /man ngag rig pas thig btab ste2/ /der ni kha dog lnga ldan pa'i/ /tshon gyis khro bo'i 'khor lo dz+re/ /gru bzhi kun nas sgo bzhi pa/ /twa ra na bzhis rnam par brgyan/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / /'bar ba'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /nang dbus rdo rje kha bzhi pa/ /'bar 4la rtsibs bcu'i 'khor lor ldan/ /der di rang lha 5mtshan ma rnams/ /ji ltar mthong ba'i rjes 'brang bri/ /der yang bum pa dgod pa dang / /bla re me tog phreng mdzes pas/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i bkod par ldan/ /dri zhim bum pa gtor ma bcas/ /slob dpon kun spyod gtsang ldan pas/ /gtsang ma chu yis khrus byas te/ /sar ba'i gos dang rab ldan pas/ /bde ba'i stan la legs 'dug ste/ /mdun gnas 'khor lo gtod 6pa yis/ /rnam sbyang dam tshig bskyed pa dang / /ye shes gnyis med byin rlabs dang / /dbang bskur 37—/ / 14

mchod dang bstod bzlas bya/ /dri zhim chu yis legs bkrus te/ /bzang po'i dri yis legs byugs shing / /sar ba'i gos dang rgyan ldan pa'i/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor nang bcug ste/ /ku sha'i stan la legs bzhag nas/ /thog mar bum pa'i chus 1dbang bsgur/ /rdo rjes dri yi thig le dang / /mngon par bsngags pa'i me tog phreng / /bkra shis tshigs bcad mgo la sbyin/ /bsgom dang bzlas dang gtad pa dang / /sbyin bya bsgrub bya sku dang gsung / /thugs dang yon tan phrin las la/ /'khrul 'khor sbyin sreg phur bu dang / /mnan pa'i las la dbang bar bya/ /de nas mchod dang gtor ma dang / /gshegs dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o/ /tshul 'dis smin byas slob ma ni/ /las dang dngos grub kun dbang phyug /gzhan la phan byed bdag nyid che/ /lha rigs 5sngags rnams kun nong 6'gyur/ /rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma yongs su smin byed pa'i/ /cho ga legs bkod bsod nams des/ /kun gyis bla med mchog thob shog /7rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bram ze dzā 8ya warmas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //37—1/ 45

bsdur mchan/1143 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ da 7〈〈pe 〉stu〈snarmepaṃ 〉stanas/ me〈〈pe 〉〉pa ge〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ kun 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/1144 she〈〈snar 〉〉bza' ba'i/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉te/ bye 〈〈snar 〉〉to/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraphar/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉lha'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉stong /1145 〈skye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉chu/ tsho(5〈〈snar 〉〉pangags/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉zag bcas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉zags bcas/ ghu〈〈snar 〉〉sbyin / 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig 5〈〈pe 〉〉smod/ 〈〈snar 〉〉panod/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉// // sdom〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdza/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (16zheng8)37wa 1146

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sā dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba'i gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song zhing / /byang chub sems dang rab ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor zhugs shing dbang blangs te/ /rjes su gnang ba thob pa dang / /ri bo bzang zhing 'jug ngogs sogs/ /rnam par dbe+en zhing nyams dga' bar/ /kun nas gtsang ba'i kun spyod kyis/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug pa dang / /rang snying pad zlar gnas pa yi/ /hūṃ yig mthing shun mdog lta bu / /'od zer phreng ba 'khrigs pa yis / /phyogs rnams kun du khyab pa dang / /rdo rje khro bo 'jigs chen po/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpar bcas/ /nam 37—/ 147

mkha' gang bar gsal dmigs te/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs bcu gcig bya/ /de rjes phung po la sogs pa'i/ /chos kun rnam par dben pa yi/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin la gnas pas/ /gsang sngags brjod de brtan 1par bya/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i paṃ yig dang / /a las pad+ma zla bar gnas/ /hūṃ yig 'od zer phreng 'phros pas/ /ra ba sa gzhi bla re gur/ /dra ba me yis yongs su bskor/ /de nas hūṃ las spros bsdus pas/ /khro bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /de yongs gyur las rang lha'i gzugs / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin mdog /g.yas dang g.yon kyi phyag gnyis kyis2/ /rab 'bar rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /dril bu bsgyings bcas sdigs mdzub bcas/ /rdo rje phreng ba rin chen sprul/ /stag gi pags pas rnam brgyan pa/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi gom 4pas bzhugs/ /kun nas 'od kyi tshogs 'phros pas/ /gdug pa ma lus sreg 5par bsgom/ /lus ngag yid kyi gnas gsum du/ /pad+ma nyi ma zla ba la/ /rdo rje rtse 6gsum rang yig gsum/ /dkar dang dmar dang nag por bsgom/ /hūṃ yig las 'phros 'od zer 7gyis/ /mdun du ye shes spyan drangs te / /mchod dang bstod pa sngon song bas/ /dbang bsgur de nas bzlas pa brtsacha/༄ //oṃ na maḥ tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu9/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig ye shes snying gar gnas/ /spyo dang bsdu ba'i bsam gtan can/ /khro bo'i skad gsang mthon po yis/ /sngags mchog yang dag bzlas par bya/ /bzlas pa'i mthar ni mchod pa dang / /bstod dang yi ge brgya pa gdon/ /mdun du ye shes gshegs gsol la/ /khro bo'i ngar 'dzin brtan pos gnas/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du/ /sgrub thabs yang dag bkod pa las / /dge ba thob pa gang yin des/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob par shog /37—/ 1 8

rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i si1 sgrub thabs dpal gi gā dha ras mdzad pa cardokra/ba/ cas// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā ba cog gru rab zhis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1147 )mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gzhu/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉〉rnam 'joms kyi sgrub bskor dpal ldan ga ga da ras mdzad pa bzhugs so// sa 〈〈pe 〉〉che ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dha ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉zer phreng bas 'khrigs pa/ yi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gzer phreng bas 'khris pa yi/1148 9she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ 2 〈〈snar 〉༄kye/ sa 〈〈pe 〉toragying / 4 〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i goms/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ba yis goms / ge 〈〈snar 〉〉bsregs/ ༅ 〈〈pe 〉〉wartse/ ge 〈〈snar 〉togazer/ 8 〈〈snar 〉〉brtsams 9 〈〈pe 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ glu lu hū lū 〈〈snar 〉〉tsan+d+ra badz+ra kro dha ya/ hū lu hu lu/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉pa/1149 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/(1649)37wa 1 1 49

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/3 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra bhā 2sā dha ṭaṃ/bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi rang bzhin zhi ba las/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i sku/ /ma rungs tshar gcod rdo rje can/ /rdo rje che la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /ji ltar bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ /legs rtogs gang de bri bar bya/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sgrub par 'dod pas dbe+en zhing yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su kun du spyod pa'i gtsang zhing 4gtsang ba dang ldan pa 5stan bde bar 6'dug ste/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal las bsgral la rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba la 'god 7pa'i blo sngon du btang ste rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dang / der a las bsil ba'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ hūṃ yig mthing shun gyi mdog lta bu bsam par bya'o/ /de 37—/ 150

las rnam par 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor mdun du dmigs la/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis tshoyang dag par mchod de/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa bya'o / /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /gdug pa tshar gcod khro bo'i sku/ /rdo rje chen po 'jigs chen po/ /rdo rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med 'khor bar log pa yi/ /rnam rtog dbang gyur sgo gsum gyis/ /sdig pa bgyid la bdag 'gyod cing / /mgon po'i spyan sngar rab tu bshags/ /nyan thos sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /so so'i skye bo byang chub sems4/ /kun gyi dge la dga' ba yis/ /bdag ni rjes su yi rang bgyid/ /sems can khams ni ma lus rnams/ /sangs rgyas bde la dgod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni dge kun ltos med par 57/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /'gro ba'i skyabs chen gcig pu pa/ /sangs rgyas theg pa mchog gi mchog6 /tshogs mchog phyir mi ldog pa la/ /bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal gyije/ /nyam thag mgon med gyur pa rnams/ /bla med bde la gzhag pa'i phyir/ /sems mchog yang dag bskyed par bgyi/ /lam gang gis ni der 'gro ba/ /sngags kyi jeg pa'i lam 'di la/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar//bdag ni tshul bzhin gnas par bgyi/ /zhes brjod la de nas byams pa dang /snying rje dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / kun la btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la brtan pa dang g.yo bar snang ba'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par 8dben pa'i don can du rig par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsarba d+dhārmaḥ9swa bhā ba burjopho haṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 11byin gyis brlab po/ /stong par 37—1 /51

gnas pa'i paṃ yig dang / /re las pad+ma nyi ma la/ /hūṃ byung ba las rgya gram gyi/ /rdo rje chen po rnam par bsgom/ /der gnas hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas ra ba sa gzhi gur yang bsgom/ /de nas rgyu dzo7 las gzhal yas khang / /kun nas gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /rtsibs brgyad 2'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /rgya gram rdo rje dang bcas bsgom/ /der yang zla ba nyi ma dang / /hūṃ byung rdo rje che las 'od/ /spyos shing bsnyus las khro bo che/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ /dbus gnas rdo rje'i lte dbus su/ /khro bo rdo rje 'joms chen po/ /char sprin sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rdo rje dril bu 'gying bcas 'dzin/ /shar phyogs rdo rje'i rwa dbus su/ /rdo rje khro bo phur bu che/ /ut+pal sngon po'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje phur bu 'dzin/ /lho yi phyogs su khro bo che/ /rdo rje be+e con stang zil mdog /g.yas na rdo rje be+e con te/ /rdo rje'i rwa 4dbus la gnas pa'o/ /nub gnas rdo rje'i rwa 5dbus su/ /rdo rje tho ba khro bo che/ /nam mkha'i mdog can phyag g.yas na/ /rdo rje tho ba phyar 6ba'o/ /byang gnas rdo rje khro bo che/ /gtum po bung pa'i mdog lta bu/ /rdo rje rgya gram phyag g.yas 'dzin / /rdo rje'i rwa 7dbus gnas par bsgom/ /phyi rol rdo rje'i rtsibs rnams la/ /gzhan kyis mi thub gshin rje gshed/ /rta mgrin rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyel / /ut+pal kun+da 8dza ba dang / /mar gad mdog can g.yas pa na/ /thod pa dbyig pa pad+ma dang / /rgya gram rdo rje 'phyar ba 'dzin/ /shar nas g.yas skor rim pas bsgom/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyig pa sngo/ /mi g.yo stobs chen sgu mdog gnag /g.yas rnams rim bzhin lcags kyu dang / /dbyig pa ral gri rtse gsum 'dzin/ /byang shar nas ni nub byang mthar 'di 37—1 /pya2

yang g.yas skor rim pas bsgom/ /mkhar gnas 7rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / /sa 'og gnod mdzes rdo rje che/ /mdog nag tsogayas na rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub zhags par ldan/ /kun kyang g.yon brkyang gom pa yis/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar/ /lhor gnas rdo rje zhags pa ser/ /nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar/ /rdo rje dril ljang byang sgor te/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dang / /dril bu 'dzin cing g.yon brkyang bas/ /nyi ma'i steng na gnas pa'o / /thams cad mche gadzigs spyan gsum zhal/ /dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes dang / /stag gi pags pas smad dkris 5shing / /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan mdzes pa6/ /rang snying zla bar sa bon dang / /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum bsgoms te/ /sa bon 'od kyi spyor ba yis/ /ye shes bkug mchod 7gnyis rnged bya/ /snying gar sngags kyi phreng bkod de/ /'khor lor gnas pa thams cad dang / /mgrin gcig skad gsang mthon po yis/ /sngags mchog yang dag bzlas par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 8ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ o ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā 9ra ya dhā 7ra ya badz+ra / dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ sbyin+da sbyin+da rkabadz+ra/ byen+da byen+da badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/na ma sh+tsaṇa ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni rdo rje khro bo rnams kyi thugs bskul nas/ /sgrub la bgegs med byed cing dngos grub ster ba'o/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du mngon par 2bzlas pa'i mthar/ /ye shes 'khor lo phyung nas mdun gzhag mchod pa 37—1153

dang / /yi ge brgya pa'i mthar ni rdo rje'i sngags brjod de/ /rang gnas gshegs la 'khor lo snying gar bsdu bar bya/ /rdo rje mernam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bram ze ma ṇi badz+ras gru mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā — ba rab zhi bshes gnyen kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/115༷ snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉g.yo/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ 'es bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgru ba thabs bzhugs so// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉dha ra ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dha ra ṇi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉—su 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 5〈〈pe 〉7sa/ tsho6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha la/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagod/1151 1 〈〈sna ra 〉〉kyi/ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉byu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra gyis/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉 dpa'/ chi5 〈〈pe 〉〉stos med pa/sa / 〈〈snar 〉ra lhos med par/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chos/ )〈〈pe 〉〉gyis/ 8 〈〈snar 〉〉girnam par/9 〈〈pe 〉〉shud sarba dharma/ 〈〈snar 〉lbād dha sasba dhan+d+ra/ khe〈〈pe 〉7lha/ /ce〈〈pe 〉7/1152 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thu/ 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacu/ — she sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ 6 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉'phyar / 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ 〈〈pe 〉〉thu da/ 9 〈〈snar 〉〉phyar/ —〈〈snar 〉donag1153 1 〈〈snar 〉donas/ 〈〈snar 〉sngaganag ༄ 〈〈snar 〉snga skyang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉sdes/ snye〈〈pe 〉ra kris/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ 7〈〈snar 〉thamachog 37〈〈pe 〉don/ 〈〈snar 〉〉’/ ( 7〈〈pe 〉〉dha/ 〈〈snar 〉snga / hūṃ :〈〈pe 〉〉〉na da tshin da/ 5〈〈pe 〉7ཿ/ pa 2〈〈pe 〉tsā/ 〈〈snar 〉7du/1154 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ na〈〈snar 〉the badz+ra/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagashes/37—1 154
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (165༷)37wa 1155

1724༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sto tra/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan ngang nyid las/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad sprul pa/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ /bcom ldan rdo rjes 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin chags sdang 2rnam bral yang / /gdul bya'i dbang gis khro la khro ba dang / /'dod chags can la chags can ltar smos pa/ /byang chub mchog gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa yis/ /'gro ba kun dang ji ltar mthun 4pa yi/ /gsang sngags rol pa rab tu ston mdzad pa/ /bsam yas sprul pa mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sdang dang gdug pa tshar gcad cing 5/ /sdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i sku/ /nyon 37—/ /56

mongs dug chen rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od dbus na/ /dpa' bo'i 1 stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul bzhugs pa/ /spyan gyi sdang mig nyi zla 'bar ba yis / /bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku/ /glog stong 'gyu 4tsho'adra khro gnyer mche ba gcigs / /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong bzhin sgrogs pas 5/ /bgegs 'dul khro rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa slob dpon bram ze ma ṇi badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra 6 shrī dang lo tsā 7ba rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1156 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa lta ra bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉snga / /dang/la rdo rje rnam pa ra 'joms la bstod pa/ bzhugs so// 2 〈〈snar 〉ra nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉'thun / 5〈〈pe 〉thacad phyir/ 〈〈snar 〉racod phyir/1157 —rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ 2 〈〈sna ra 〉(4/ 〈〈pe 〉rabag 〈〈snar 〉thasregs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ngagyur/ 5〈〈snar 〉tha//6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dz+nyā na/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bum pa'i cho ga7 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa 2 ka la sha bi byeḥ / bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bum pa'i cho ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sa yi char/ /kun du spyod pa 4gtsang ldan pas/ /gser ram dngul lam khams gzhan gyis5/ /bum pa mtshan nyid bzang ldan pa/ /legs bkrus dkar po'i rdzas kyis byugs/ /dris bdug ras kyis mgul pa dkres6/ /me tog srad bus mdzes byas par/ /rin chen rma med tsan+dan dri/ /rgyun 7'bab chu yis legs bkang ba/ /bzang po'i shing gis kha brgyan te/ /sa dang lci bar bsres pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad pad dbus su/ / drur ba'i 9stan la yang dag gzhag /dri zhim chu yis bkang ba'i snod/ /rdo rje me tog phreng bar ldan/ /rang lha'i bsam gtan la gzhol bas/ /stong pa'i sngags kyis rnam sbyangs te/ /rja rta 37—1 159

las rin chen gzhal yas khang / /baṃ byung 'o ma'i rgya mtshor ldan/ /paṃ pad a las zla dkyil 'khor/ /der gnas hūṃ yig spro bsdu 1las/ /khro bo khro mo'i 'khor lo bskyed/ /ye shes spyan drangs mchod pa dang / /bstod dang gnyis su med par bya/ /dbang bsgur be+er yang mchod bstod nas/ /rang snying sngags kyi —phreng bkod de/ /bzlas dang bum par spro bya bar/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs/ /ji srid mngon par 'dod pa'i mthar/ /mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba dang / /lha rnams ye shes bdud rtsi yis/ /rab bkrus gtsang 5mar gyur pa dang / /nad med bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang / /dpal du byed cing bkra shis dang / /phun sum tshogs min 'joms par byed/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bum pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //37—1 /60

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shāṅgi ho ma bi byeḥ / bod skad du/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa dang bral ba4/ /mi shes mtshan ma spangs pa dang / /ma rungs gdon bgegs mi gnas par/ /dkar zhing gtsang la 5snum pa'i sar/ /khru gang kun nas zlum pa'i 6dbyibs/ /khru phyed thur du brus pa'i khung / /kha khyer gyis mdzes zhi ba yi/ /mtshan ma dkar po'i rjas kyis byug /dkar zhing dri zhim 'o ma can/ /reg na zug rngu dang bral ba7/ /zla mdog me tog 'byung ba'i shing / /khung dang rjes mthun dbyibs su brtsigs/ /mchod pa 9bsreg pa'i yo byad rnams/ /las dang rjes mthun nyer bsags te/ /me sbar me dbus re las lha/ /mdog dkar bgrang phreng dbyu ⑩gu dang / /mi 'jigs spyi blugs 'dzin pa babyed/ /ye shes me bkug gnyis med bstem/ /mchod 37byed1 /62

dang bstod dang bsregs pa'i mthar/ /slar yang mchod bstod mnyes pa yi/ /me lha 'bar ba'i me dbus su/ /rang lhag lhar ba skyed ye shes bstem/ /der yang mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bsreg pa'i rdzas kyis mnyes pa dang / /mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab1/ /yi ge brgya pas yongs bskang 2 nas / /gshegs bsdu slar yang me lha yi/ /mchod bsreg — rdzas kyis tshim byas la / /'dod don las kyi gsol gdab ste/ /gshegs gsol nye bar bsdu bar bya/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 5gi cho ga rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1162 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga / /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉shan ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉r+sha ti/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhing / cho〈〈snar 〉phro/ 〈〈pe 〉tharlum pa'i/ 〈〈snar 〉d+kum po'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉tha yi/ 〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabyug1163 —1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngarang / 2〈〈snar 〉thaskangs/ 〈〈sna ra 〉stabag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg37—1163
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1653) tsho37wa / 164

༄khya/ /gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bye ba/ 1༄7 / /rgya gar skad du/ ba bo bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sha chang sgog btsong 'byung po'i zas/ /rnam par spangs pa'i kha zas ni2 / /rin chen snod du legs bshams te/ /khro bo'i sngags kyis bgegs med bsang 4/ /stong pa'i sngags kyis rnam sbyang ba/ /rja gyur sa 5las rin chen snod / /de nyid gsum gyis 6kha dog dang / /dri ro phun sum tshogs pa la/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyis mngon sprul la7/ /bsam yas mchod pa'i sprin dang ldan//rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyes/ /khro bo khro mo'i 8'khor lo bskor/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal mkha' spyod dang / /sa spyod sa 'og spyod ḍapa yi/ /'gro ba rnams bcas mdun bltas te/ /mchod bstod 'byung po kun sngags dang / /tshig brjod nas ni tshim byas nas/ /37—1 /65

༄ / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga—1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa karma tsa tuḥsā dha na bi byeḥ 2 /bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje can/ /ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i las/ /tshar gcad rjes su gzung ba bshad/ /sa phyogs gang du gnod pa'i las/ /sgrub par 'os pa der gnas te/ / tshwa sgo can nas sa blangs la/ /thab khung me dbyibs nag pos byug /gnag dang 'khyol 4dang dri nga dang / /srin gyes rnam par zos pa dang / /reg nas zug rngu bskyed thupa'i shing / /khung dang rjes mthun dbyibs su brtsig6 /gu gul nag po nā dz+wari'i sha /khwa yi gshog 8pa bong bu'i sbangs/ /mche ba can gyi rtug pa dang / /yungs kar gdon rnams tshar gcod byed/ /til dang me tog nag po dang / /ma sha la 37—1 167

sogs 'bru nag bcas/ /dug khrag tsha ba'i mar khu rnams/ /skyes pa'i yan lag las byung ba'i/ /snod dam yang na lcags kyi snod/ /nim 1pa'i shing lo'i snod bzhag nas/ /rdo gnyis gtsubs las byung ba 'am/ /rngon pa'i khyem blangs me sbar te/ /de'i 2dbus ram̐ las drag po'i me/ /khro gzugs 'jigs par byed pa po/ /mdog nag rnam par gcigs pa'i zhal/ /bgrang phreng mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang / /dbyu 4gu rtse gsum spyi blugs 'dzin/ /phyag bzhi 'jigs chen 'jigs mdzad pa/ /ra yi gdan 5la gnas pa bskyed/ /ye shes gre ni spyan drangs te/ /de dang gnyis su med byas la/ /mchod dang bstod pas mnyes par byas6/ /oṃ asne de wa/ kā 7la ru tra/ ma hā ru tra/ sangh+ru karma ma te shwa ra sarba duṣ+ṭha na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags bcas rdzas rnams tsha ba yi/ /mar la sbags te me la dbul/ /slar yang mchod dang bstod pa yis/ /mnyes par byas la me dbus su/ /rang lha bskyed dang ye shes gzhug /der yang mchod dang bstod byas te/ /tsha ba'i mar gyis sbags pa'i rdzas/ /sngags bcas bsregs pas lha mnyes byas/ /'dir yang de bzhin mchod pa dang / /bstod pas mnyes byas sgrub 11gsol dang / /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /yongs su dag pas mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyis lha gshegs te/ /slar yang mi dmigs mchod pa dang / /bsreg dang mchod dang las sgrub par/ /gsol btab nas ni gshegs gsol bya/ /'dis ni sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ /bgegs med dngos grub sbyin par byed/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las su bya ba me dang 'byel ba'o// //37—1168

thal ba mtshan ngan snod 3gzhag pa/ /der ni bgegs kyi gzugs bris la//dkyil 'khor dur khrod so phag gis/ /me gzugs bris pa'i steng du gzhag /rang lhar bsgoms pa'i snying ga yi/ /ye shes yi ge'i 'od zer 3 kyis/ /bgegs kun mdun gyi sngags la bsnyim/ /sngags 'od me bzhin tsha ba yis/ /bsreg 4 par bsam zhing bzlas pa'i mthar/ /yungs kar yungs nag ske tshe dug /gsang sngags bzlas dang bcas pas brab/ /skyes pa'i rkang ngam seng ldeng gi/ /phur bu sngags bcas snying gar bsnun/ /de mthar gzugs bcas thal ba la/ /rnam par 'thor ba'i spyor ba yis/ /tshar gcod bgegs med grub sbyin byed/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las su bya ba rlung dang 'brel pas 'thor ba'o 5 bsregs 6pa'i thal ba tshwa sgo — can/ /shing gcig rtsa ba 'jug ngogs sa/ /nim pa'i khu bas sbrus pa las/ /bgegs gzugs snying gar sngags bris gzhug /rang lha ye shes yi ge yi/ /'od kyis bgegs bkug gzugs la bsnyim/ /sngags 'od zhags pas 'ching ba yi8/ /bsam gtan ldan pas rig sngags bzlas / /'dzeg 9dang 'phar dang snying rje ba'itso / /nga ro 'don pa'i rtags thob nas/ /mchod rten mtshan ma gcig pa la/ /dur khrod ma mo'i khyim du sba/ /sbyor 'dis sgrub la bar gcod pa/ /bcings nas bgegs med dngos grub ster / /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las su bya ba sa dang 'brel pa mnan pa'o// //dbe+en par tshwa sgo sacan sa la/ /dug dang khrag sbyar chus sbags pas/ /37—1 /69

dkyil 'khor gru gsum dug dang khrag /ro bsregs shesol bas nag por byug /der ni bum pa kha dog gnag /sngon po'i ras kyis mgul dkris 3snate/ /gdug pa'i shing gis ne+ekha brgyan ngas / /rgyun bral chu yis legs bkang ste/ /der yang ming rus yungs kar 5dang / /dug khrag gu gul ske tshe gzhug /rang lha'i rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /bum nang yi ram̐ baṃ rgyu 6las/ /rlung gnas me steng chu dkyil 'khor/ /bsgoms te rang snying sa bon las/ /bgegs bkug 'khor lo'i lte bar gzhug /sngags kyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i rlung / /rnam par g.yos pas me sbar te/ /rab tu khol ba'i chu rlabs dang / /bsregs pa'i 'khor los bgegs kyi lus/ /nyam thag byed bsgom 3gsang sngags bzlas/ /spyor ba 'di yis ji srid du/ /mngon par 'dod pa rdzogs pa dang / /gang gi lus la chus reg pa/ /bgegs kyi gnod pa las grol 'gyur/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las su bya ba chu dang 'brel pas bkru ba'o / /8 rdo rje can gyi las gang gis9/ /ma rungs gdon bgegs tshar bcad nas//'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i las/ /'di ni gzhan phan byed pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga /bram ze ma ṇi badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā ba rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis bsgyur ba'o / / //37—1 /70

bsdur mchan/1167 )mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉༄7/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i cho ga bram ze ma ṇi badz+ra gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 〈〈〈pe 〉〉karmā tsa tu ra sā dha rna bi dhi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉kasmra tsa tu sā dha bi dhi/ tshonya〈〈pe 〉〉tsa rgo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsa sgo/ thu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torakhyog ge〈〈pe 〉〉na zug rngu skyed/ 〈〈snar 〉〉na zug ngu bskyed/ 46〈〈snar 〉sngagacig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉bshog1168 75)〈〈snar 〉〉rdom/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ du〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabyug nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stan/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka ⑧〈〈pe 〉sprosarba karmā he shwa sarba duṣ+ṭa/〈〈snar 〉risarba po/rma ma he shwa ra duṣ+ṭa/ 9〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ (1〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉gnod/1169 5skre〈〈snar 〉sngagazer/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkug sa〈〈pe 〉〉bsregs/ dzorgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 5〈〈snar 〉〉bsregasgo 〈〈pe 〉〉tsa rgo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsa sgo/ 7〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toratsheg 9〈〈pe 〉ston/ 〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub / (1〈〈pe 〉〉tsa rgo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsa sgo/117༷ te〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg (8〈〈pe 〉〉po ras kyi mgul dkres/ 〈〈snar 〉〉po ras kyis mgul dkres/ —4〈〈pe 〉stan/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa/ ge〈〈pe 〉stanakur/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ she〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ 487〈〈pe 〉〉 / she7〈〈snar 〉nyan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1655)37wa 1171

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las baji sgrub pa'i sprun sreg gi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa ka1 2tsa tu sā dha na ho ma bi byeḥ4/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang chen po khro bo'i skus/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang gdug pa 'joms/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal te/ /sbyin sreg las kyi rim pa bshad/ /bsnyen pas lha rnams nye bar byed / /sbyin sreg 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster/ /de bas gang bsgrub 5'bras yo/da par/ /'dod pa'i sbyin sreg las la 'bad/ /zhi bas nad dang gdon bgegs zhi/ /rgyas pas tshe stobs longs spyod spel/ /dbang gis bdag gzhan ‘dbang du byed/ /drag pos gdug pa tshar gcod pa'o/ /bgegs med dngos grub 'byung ba yi/ /gnas su zhi sogs brtsams pa dang / /gang na ma rungs bgegs gnas pa/ /der ni drag po bya ba nyid/ /dkar ba'i sa 37—1 /72

byedalas khru gang tshad/ /zlum po thur du khru phyed pa/ /zhi ba'i las la yang dag bsngagasaspyo/ /sa ser sa las gru bzhi'i dbyibs/ /khru do zabs su de yi phyed/ /rgyas pa'i thab tu shes par bya/ /dbang la dmar bo'i sa las ni/ /zla gam khru gang khru phyed thabs/ /gnag pa'i sa la sor nyi shu/ /thabs su de phyed mngon spyod la'o/ /bud shing dri zhim me tog mdzes/ /'bras bu bzang 'byung 'o mar ldan / /mdog dkar ser dang dmar ba ni/ /rim bzhin zhi rgyas dbang la'o//shing gang de las bzlog pa ste1/ /kha dog gnag 'khyog dri nga ba/ /reg na zug rngu bskyed pa ni/ /drag shul spyod la rab bsngags pa'o/ /las dang rjes mthun bud shing rnams/ /rang thab dbyibs dang mthun par brtsig /gang la bud shing bya ba'i shing / /de nyid la ni yam shing ste/ /rtse mo'i cha las byung ba ste / /sor ni bcu gnyis mkhas pas brtag /sngags 'chang las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /gos dang rgyan ldan cod pan ldan/ /las mthun mchod par ldan pa dang / /rdzas dang yo byad bkod par ldan/ /bram ze khyim bdag smad 'tshong dang / /dur khrod yang na rngon pa'i khyim/ /gang sgrub las dang mthun pa yi gu/ /me ni mkhas pas blang bar bya/ /oṃ asne dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ/gsang sngags 'di yis me sbar te/ /las mthun rigs kyi sa bon gyis/ /mar kyi dgang blugs gsum byin la/ /dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma brtag /dbyibs dang kha dog dri dang sgra/ /mi shis mtshan ma mthong ba na/ /oṃ āḥ birgyuta kṛta /hūṃ/ sngags 'dis sreg 4 blugs bdun byin pas/ /bgegs ni rnam par zlog par byed/ /bgegs med shes nas ma nyams pa'i/ /ku sha kha khyer kun du dgram/ /me dbus paṃ las pad+ma dang / /a las nyi mar ram̐ yig 37—/173

las / /me lha las mthun 1 kha dog can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bgrang phreng dang / /mi 'jigs dbyig gu spyi blugs 'dzin/ /ra yi stan la gnas pa bskyed//rang nyid yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes me ni nyer bkug ste/ /mdun gnas mchod dang bstod mnyes pa/ /dam tshig me dang gnyis med bya/ /slar yang mchod de bstod pa yis/ /mnyes bya de nas sbyin sreg ni/ /'bar ba'i me las yam sreg shing / /thog mar me yi sngags kyis sbyin/ /mar sbyin pa yang de nyid do/ /de 'og til la sogs pa kun/ /rang rang sngags dang 'brel bas so/ /oṃ asne de ba ta ye swā hā/ oṃ sadze+e pā paṃ 5da ha na san+d+ra zhwapā paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa 7ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā bit+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ rim bzhin me dang til dang 'bras/ /gro dang nas dang sran ma ste/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /dbye skyon 8man ngag rim pas bsreg /rdzas rnams ji ltar 'byor phul bas/ /slar yang mchod de bstod par bya/ /me yi lha ni gzi brjid che/ /'dod don thams cad ster ba po/ /bdag dang gzhan don mdzad pa yi/ /drang srong che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jig rten mgon shemadzad tshangs pa'i sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po dag byed mchog /bgegs rnams ma lus sreg bhemadzad pa/ /'jigs byed che la phyag 'tshal bstod rka/ /ye shes 'od kyis nyon mongs bsreg(rta /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan/ /nyes pa'i skyon rnams tshangs par mdzadanye5/ /thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bden pa'i tshig gis —mi slu ba/ /'jig rten skyong rnams kun gyi gtso/ /tshangs par gyur pa'i ngag ldan pa/ /rnam 'dren khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas zhi la til dang mar/ / drur ba ṅka 37—1174

me tog dkar po bsreg1 /rgyas la 'bru gzhan me tog ser/ /mngar ba'i rdzas la rnam par spags/ /dbang la 'bru dang me tog dmar/ /lan tshwar bcas pa bsreg par bya/ /drag po yungs nag ske tshe dang / /me tog nag po khrag bcas bsreg /zhi la shādz+rī oṃ swā hā/ / rgyas la puṣ+ṭi tram̐ swā hā/ /4dbang la tweḥbacas pa shaṃ 5ldan/ /drag po hūṃ phaṭa mā ra ya/ /sngar bstan me yi sngags nyid la/ /rnam par sbyar ba ji srid du/ /mngon par 'dod pa de bsregs pas/ /las de nye bar 'grub par byed/ /de nas me lha 'bar ba'i mer / /bltas te de dbus rang gi lha/ /mngon par brjod pa'i 6rim pa yis/ /bskyed pa ye shes gnyis med pa/ /sngon du mchod dang bstod pa yis/ /mnyes bya rang lhag lha sngags kyis/ /yam shing mar dbul rdzas gzhan rnams/ /sngar bstan sngags kyis ji lta ba'o7/ /de 'og mchod dang bstod byas te/ /khyad par las kyi sbyin sreg kyang / /sngar bzhin rang lha'i sngags kyis bya/ /de yang mchod dang bstod pa dang / /'dod don las kyi gsol btab ste/ /gshegs gsol nye bar bsdu ba'o/ /de nas slar yang me dbus su/ /lha gzugs mngon par bltas pa la/ /gang du brjod pa ji lta bar/ /mchod dang sreg dbul rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /gang 'dod las kyi bsgrub 9gsol te/ /gshegs dang mi dmigs blta bar bya/ /gang zhig de 7brten je tshom bral/ /rang lhag lha la legs bsnyen pas/ /tshul 'di la ni mngon gzhol pa/ /'dod bral 11yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs/ /sgrub la phan pa mchog ster ba'i/ /cho ga legs bkod bsod nams des/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don 'byung ba'i/ /bla med go 'phang thob par shog /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las 37—/ /75

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1656)37wa 1177

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las baji sgrub pa'i bum pa'i cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa karma 2tsa tuḥ sā dha na 4ka la sha bi byeḥ5/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i bum pa'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rang lha legs bsnyen pas/ /bum pa'i cho ga zhi la sogs/ /las bzhi mngon par bsgrub 6'dod pas/ /las mthun gnas su brtsam par bya/ /zhi la dngul dang rgyas la gser/ /dbang la zangs te drag po lcags/ /yang na kham nga/'am ⑫ shing yang rung / / las mthun kha dog can du bya/ / las mthun ras kyis mgul pa dkri/ /dge ba'i shing ngam gdug pa can/ /las dang mthun pas kha brgyan te/ /su ru bha ti tsan+dan dkar/ /dmar dang 'bru sman rin chen lnga/ /rgyun 'bab chus bkang las gsum la'o/ /drag po a gar nag po dang / /gu gul rgyun bral chu yis dgang / /rang lha'i bsam gtan 37—1 /78

ldan pa yis/ /bum par las mthun lha 1bskyed de/ /ye shes mchod pa 2gnyis med bsnyim/ /slar yang mchod de bstod mnyes bya/ /sngags bzlas zhi la dkar ba yis/ /'od zer bsel ba rnam par spro/ /rgyas la btso ma'i gser 'od dang / /dbang la pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /drag po la 'od kha dog nag /dri nga gdung ba bskyed pa yis/ /gang reg nad dang gdon sdig zhi/ /tshe dang stobs 'phel longs spyod rgyas/ /dbang du byed dang tshar gcod par/ /bsgom dang bzlas la shāk+ṣiṃ dang / /puṣ+ṭi 4wa shaṃ mā ra ya/ /spel ba gang 'dod las 'grub byed/ /ji srid mngon par 'dod pa yis/ /bzlas pa rdzogs mthar lha 'od zhu/ /sngags kyi chu yis gang bkrus pa/ /de la zhi sogs 'dod 'bras ster/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i bum pa'i cho ga /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā 5ba rab zhis bsgyur ba'o// //37—1179

bsdur mchan/1178 ༄1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉karma/ 〈〈snar 〉〉karmā/rī ci〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/ཿ/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wan/ rdzoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ 61〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ she〈〈pe 〉〉khams pa'am/ 〈〈snar 〉skabams 'am/ me 〈〈snar 〉〉walas mthun kha dog can du bya/ / 6〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/1179 1〈〈snar 〉〉la/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉bkug mchod/ (〈〈snar 〉〉girnya/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉puṭaṃ/ 35〈〈pe 〉〉tsa/〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1657)

༄ / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa karma 2tsa tuḥ sā dha na tsakra bi byeḥ5/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang lha nye bar bsnyen pa yis/ /'khor los las kun 'grub pa'i phyir/ /phyi rabs sgrub la phan byed pa'i/ /'khor lo'i man ngag bshad par bya/ /thog mar las kun 'grub 6byed pa'i/ /'khor lo'i mtshan nyid brjod bya ste/ / re khā 7bcu yis yongs bskor ba'i/ /rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo pad 'dab brgyad/ /slar yang rtsibs brgyad gnyis par ldan/ /rtse gsum kha drug rdo rje mdzes/ /der sngags dgod pa'i rim pa ni/ /nang gi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad par / /na maḥ9tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ya/ zhes pa'i yi ge brgyad nyid dang / /phyi rol pad+ma'i 'dab rnams la/ /hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+ta5 / ha na ha na/37—1 181

zhes pa'i sngags tshig brgyad po dang / /de'i phyi rol mu khyud la a mṛ 1te hūṃ phaṭa/ces 2sngags yi ge lnga yis bskor/ /'khor lo gnyis pa'i rtsibs rnams la/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 5ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha 6badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ha na ha na badz+ra/ zhes pa'i sngags rkang brgyad po dang / kha drug rdo rje'i rwa dbus la / /pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā rā ya dhā rā ya badz+ra/dā ru ṇa 8dā ru ṇa 9badz+ra/ ts+tshan+da stson+da 7badz+ra/ bhen+da bhin+da badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi rkang pa drug nyid dang / /mu khyud bzhi la rim bzhin du/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya / na maḥrta tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 2ye/ sngags rkang gsum rim dang po la'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ sgu ṭa sgu ṭa/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ghuṇ+ḍi ghuṇ+ḍi/ ghutsā pa ya ghuṭ+wā pa ya/ sat+tha satā rgo/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bo 5dha ya saṃ bo sadha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+ra ma ya saṃ bh+ra ma ya/ sarba bhū ta māṃ gluku ṭa ku ṭa/ saṃ ku ṭa ya saṃ ku ṭa ya/ sat+tha sha t+t+waṃ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bibyā 7badz+ra badz+ra/ sgo ṭa 8badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa 1 badz+ra badz+ra/ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ badz+ra aṣ+ṭa hā sa badz+ra badz+ra/ nī la badz+ra/su badzā ya swā hā/ rim gnyis la dgod gsang 1sngags so/ /te phu lu ni ḍa sheru phu lu/ gra ṇ+ḍi ku lu mi li tsu lu/ ku ru ku lu/ badz+ra bi dzā yā 4ya swā hā/ tī li tī lā 5ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya 7/ badz+ra bi dā ra zla ya swā hā/ tshin+da byudza bhen+da bhin+da ma hā tī li kri khā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha kro dha kro dha 2 kri li khri lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa shī li kri lā 37—1 182

ya swā hā/ tā sa ya tā sa ya badz+ra tī li tī khā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha rā 1ya swā hā/ pra ha 2ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhañja nā ya swā hā/ ma tisbi ra badz+ra su tisbi ra badz+ra/ pra tisbi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/rim pa gsum pa la dgod pa'o/ /e chohi badz+ra/ shī rgyu badz+ra dhā rā ya 5swā hā/dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri bye ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sadze+e thubadz+ra ku lo ā brta nā ya )swā hā/a mu shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra rde/ sazla 9ba lo ā brta ya ma hā ba le ka ta be+e ta ta le/ a tsa le maṇ+ḍa la ma 1 ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/be ga ra ṇa/ a dzi te dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi piṅga nyu1le/ da ha da ha te dzo ba ti/ ti li ti li mubhan+da bhan+da/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dadz+wa la ye —swā hā/rim pa bzhi par bri ba'i sngags rnams so/ /sngags rnams thams cad g.yas skor mute/ /zhi rgyas bsrung dang dbang byas la/ /yig mgo phyir bstan mngon spyod la/ /de las bzlog par shes par bya/ /zhi la gtsang ma'i ras dkar ram//dge ba'i shing gi lo ma la/ /rgyas la ras gang ser po dang / /gro ga bzang po'i shing 'dab la/ /dmar po'i ras sam shing gang la/ /me tog dmar 'byung 'dab shun dbang / / de las bzlog par shes par bya/ /྾'dab shun ro ras drag po la'o/ /zhi la tsan+dan dkar 'o ma/ /rgyas la gi wang gur gum bzang / /dbang la rgya skyegs drag po la/ /ro sol dug dang khrag gis bri7 / /las mthun rang lha'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /'khor lo maṇ+ḍal steng mdun gzhag /lha bskyed ye shes spyan drangs bsnyim/ /mchod bstod sngags yig gnyis med blta18//sngags bzlas 'khor lo las 'phros 'od/ /dkar pos nad sogs zhi ba dang / /ser pos tshe stobs longs spyod spel/ /dmar pos gang reg dbang du byed/ /37—1183

nag po rnam par tshar gcod pa'o/ /shābye 7 ku ru swā hā zhi/ /rgyas la puṣ+ṭing sabheku ru oṃ/ /wa shaṃ mā na ya hoḥdabang / /bsad bye — la mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /sngags kyi mthar sbyar bzlas pa dang / /bri la 'khor lo'i lte bar ro/ /gang sgrub las kyi 'bras sbyin byed/ /dpal 4rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi'i 'khor lo'i cho ga /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā sprib rab zhis bsgyur ba'o// / /bsdur mchan/1181 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉sngagar ma/ 〈〈snar 〉〉karmā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7na/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/1 〈〈pe 〉'ag pa// 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ she〈〈pe 〉7ཿ/ rka〈〈pe 〉wān dha bhan dha/1182 1 〈〈pe 〉phro a rngi/ 〈〈snar 〉phros a mṛ/ 3/〈〈snar 〉ṅkapa'i/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tra/ 4〈〈pe 〉riḥ 3〈〈pe 〉〉na / 6〈〈pe 〉〉ḍa ma ḍa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thā ma thā/ 7〈〈snar 〉༄/ 9 〈〈pe 〉ra/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉na dha tshin dha/ 〈〈pe 〉7ཿ/ te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra/ 1 〈〈pe 〉7rba/ 2sa〈〈pe 〉lha/ le〈〈snar 〉snga rnya bosnya ni—/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉marba bid t+yā/ 〈〈snar 〉srasat+tha bibyā/ 181(〈〈pe 〉〉 ya/ ༄ tsho〈〈pe 〉mas ta hā sa/ 1〈〈snar〉〉gsal / rta〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉gyit+na kuglu mi li ci'i/ 〈〈snar 〉masaṇ+ḍa ku lu mi li tsu lu/ 〈〈snar 〉〉giyā/ ༄’〈〈pe 〉ra dz+ra ki li ki li/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉gimāraya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉nga/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉 ma hā/1182 1 〈〈pe 〉〉dhu ra/ 2 〈〈snar 〉wā/ 4〈〈snar 〉7bye/ she〈〈pe 〉zo / 〈〈snar 〉〉d+ma ra yā / 6〈〈pe 〉masarba/7 〈〈pe 〉thar t+ta nā yi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 swā hā 9 〈〈pe 〉〉marba/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi nga ga 12〈〈snar 〉〉 nyi li/ 〈〈pe 〉ra dz+re ku/ 〈〈snar 〉ra rdza ga —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ sa〈〈snar 〉〉bskor—/ ྾〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngas gang shing gang me tog nag / —〈〈pe 〉sngags bris/ 〈〈snar 〉(gi bri—/ 18〈〈snar 〉〉lta/1184 3 〈〈pe 〉〉shan ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉shaṃ ti/ 2 〈〈pe 〉༄sa ting / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngasad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dpal/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/37byed/ 184

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa 2 kan+d+ra bi dhi sru dha rgo /bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang lha'i dmigs pa gsal ba dang /sngags kyi bzlas pa mthar phyin pas/ /rig sngags thogs pa med pa dang / /pha rol sde las rgyal ba dang / /skrag dang mthu stobs gzhig pa dang / /rig sngags gcad dang mnan pa dang / /las gzhol pha rol las gzhig dang / /gdon brlag gdon 'a/sa grol ba dang / /'byung po dgug dang mnan 4pa dang //las rnams ma grub spogs pa dang / /grub pa'i 'bras bu mthar dbyung dang / /'dod 'bras dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / /bsrung dang zhi dang rgyas pa dang / /rengs dang rmugs par byed pa yi5/ /thun mong khyad par bdag nyid kyi/ /cho ga nyi shu'i spyor ba rnams/ /ji ltar bla ma'i man ngag las/ /rtogs pa'i rim 37—/ /86

pa gsal bar bya/ /de la las gang sgrub kyang thog ma nyid du rang gi rig sngags kyi mthu 1thogs pa med par bya ba las/ de'i rim pa rgo 'di yin te/ dben zhing rab tu shis pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su thab khung brus te/ der dri bzang po dang ldan pa'i bud shing brtsig la/ sgrub 2pa po'i khyim nas me blangs te sbar ba'i dbus su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i rim pas rang gi lha gsal bar dmigs la/ de la mchod pa dang bstod pa sngon du song ba'i mar gyi sreg blugs phul te/ de nas gzhan du longs ma spyad pa'i me tog sngon po dkar gsum dang mngar gsum gyis rnam par sbags la/ gang la bsnyen pa byas pa'i sngags kyis thab tu dbul zhing bsreg par bya'o/ /ji srid mngon par 'dod pa'i sbyin sreg gi mthar rig sngags kyi mthu thogs pa med pa'i don gsol nas4/yi ge brgya pa muḥ'i mtha' can gyis gshegs shing bsdu'o/ /rim pa 'dis bsten pa ji tsam du 5byas pa'i grangs kyi bcu'i cha'i sbyin sreg yongs su rdzogs par byas na rig sngags kyi las gang sgrub kyang mthu thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang de'i sbyor ba la/ /me dbus bdag gi lha dmigs te/ /sngags bcas mar la bsnyugs pa yi/ /drur ba bsregs pa khri phrag gis/ /gang la bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi las/ /thogs pa med par byed pa'o/ /'jug ngogs bye ma'i mchod rten 'bum/ /sngags bcas bgegs sgrib zhi ba yis/ /sgrub pos gang gi las sgrub pa'i/ /rig sngags thogs pa med par byed/ /pha rol gyi dmag dpung las rgyal bar 'dod na lha chen po la phul ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi ras sam/ 'gegs nas shi ba'i ro las 6bshus pa'i ras la dug dang khrag dang dur khrod kyi sol bas re khā bcu yongs su bskor ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa phyi rol du pad+ma 'dab ma 37—1/87

brgyad pa dang ldan pa/ de'i phyi rol du slar yang 'khor lo 1rtsibs brgyad pa kha drug pa rdo rje dang bcas pa la bla ma'i man ngag rnam par rig pas sngags kyi yi ge rnams yang dag par bkod pa'i lte bar che ge mo'i dmag dpung stam+bha ya nan/zhes pa'i bskul tshig dang bcas pa bris te/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor byas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs nas de las rnam par spros pa'i sprul pa'i pho nyas 4pha rol gyi dmag dpung stong chogrogs kyi lha dang bcas pa bkug cing 'khor lo'i lte bar bstems 6la/ dmigs pas sngags kyi bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang / 'khor lo thod pa kha sbyar du bcug ste/ dbang chen dang ri bo la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rjes 7rgyas btab nas gang du g.yul 'gyed pa'i gnas der sbas pas thams cad du rang gi sde rnams pha rol las rgyal bar byed do / / ri —yang pha rol dang rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'dod pas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar che ge mo'i ngag stam+bha ya nan zhes /pa dang bcas pa bris nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs te/ de las sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis 1 pha rol kyi ngag gi stobs thams cad bkug cing 'khor lo'i lte bar bsnyim pa dang / grog 11mkhar gyi sa la gzugs brnyan byas pa'i snying gar bcug nas de la 'ang bsgrub bya'i rnam par shes pa bcug ste/ de nas sngags dang bcas pa'i seng ldeng gi tsher ma dug gi chu la sbags pa lce la bsnun pa dang / mthar thod pa kha sbyar du bcug nas rig sngags mnan pa'i spyor ba byas na pha rol dang rtsod pa las rgyal bar byed do / / 1237—1/88

'byung po'i gdon skrag par bya bar 'dod pas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar skrag cing tshar gcod 1pa'i 'byung po'i ming bris nas grog mkhar gyi sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar bcug ste rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs shing / des las rnam par spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkug cing bstem pa dang / de nas sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis brab 2pa'i mthar dug dang khrag dang gu gul dang byi la'i ril ma dang khyi'i rtug pa sbyar ba'i bdug pas bdugs ༄ na rnam par skrag cing tshar gcod par byed do / /4 pha rol gyi mthu stobs gzhil bar 'dod na sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar gang gi mthu stobs gzhil bar 'dod pa de'i ming bskul tshig dang bcas pa bris nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lhar dmigs pa de 5las spros pa'i pho nya rnams kyis pha rol gyi sbyor ba las byung ba'i mthu stobs bkug nas 'khor lo'i lte bar bstems 6la dmigs te/ sngags kyi bzlas pa byas pa'i mthar thod pa kha sbyar du bcug nas/ dbang chen ri rab la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rjes 7rgyas btab pa spyor ba po'i jem 'og tu sbas na pha rol gyi spyor ba las byung ba'i mthu stobs thams cad 'jil bar byed do/ /gzhan kyi rig sngags gcad bor 5'dod pas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar che ge mo'i rig sngags stson+da stson+da zhes 9pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang / mdun du lhag pa'i lha dmigs te/ de las spyos pa'i 37—1189

pho nya'i tshogs kyis pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi spyor ba las byung ba'i mthu thams cad 'khor lo'i lte bar bsdus pa dang / rang gi rig pa'i mthu las byung ba'i mtshon cha dang me'i tshogs kyis dum bur byas shing bsreg pa la dmigs nas sngags bzlas so/ /de nas 'khor lo dum bur gtubs nas sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal ba rlung la bskur na 1gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi las thams cad gcod par byed do / /3 pha rol gyi rig sngags mnan par 'dod na sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar che ge mo'i rig sngags stam+bha ya nan zhes 4pa'i spel tshig bkod pa bris la/rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lhar 5dmigs shing de las spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis pha rol kyi 6rig sngags kyi mthu thams cad 'khor lo'i lte bar bsdus pa dang / rang gi sngags las byung ba'i dbang chen la gnas pa'i ri bo rdo rje dang bcas pas mnan par bsgom zhing sngags bzlas la/mthar thod pa kha sbyar du bcug ste dbang chen la sogs pa'i rgyas btab nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan na pha rol gyi rig sngags mnan par 'gyur ro / /7gal te rang gi mi dge ba'i las thams cad 'joms par 'dod na rin po che'i snod du tsan+dan kyi sol ba la me bus te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du til gyi snod gzhag la snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis lhag pa'i lha mdun du spyan drangs nasarke/ de las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi lus khyab par 9mi dge ba'i las kyis bsags pa'i dri ma rnams snying gar 'dus nas mi sdug pa'i 37—1 190

gzugs can du gyur pa sna'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ til la thim par bsams la sngags 1brjod pa dang bcas pa bsregs pa'i mthar mdun gyi 2lha'i lus las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bdag nyid kyi lus kun du gang bar bsgoms la/yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod nas gshegs pa'o/ /'dis ni mi dge ba'i las thams cad bcom ste 'bras bu mi 'byin par byed do / / yang gzhan kyi mi dge ba'i las 'jig par 'dod na de'i rim pa 'di yin te / dbe+en zhing nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs su zhi ba'i las dang mthun pa'i thab khung du bud shing brtsig ste4/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas der me sbar ba'i 5dbus su lhag pa'i lha la kun nas dkar ba'i kha dog can du dmigs la/ de'i lus la dkar zhing bsel ba'i 'od zer 6byung bas pha rol po'i sdig pa thams cad 'jig par dmigs nas sngags dang bcas pa'i til gyi sbyin sreg byas pa'i mthar mchod bstod dang yi ge brgya pa brjod la gshegs su gsol de ltar pha rol po la dmigs nas yang dang yang du byas na de'i las thams cad nges par 'jig par byed do / /7yang lha la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad rlag 8par byed 'dod pas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar gang dag brlag par bya ba'i gdon kyi ming spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas grog mkhar dang tshwa 9sgo can dang 'jug ngogs dang shing rkang gcig gi sa dur khrod kyi thal ba dang lhan cig sbrus pa las gzugs brnyan byas pa'i snying gar bcug ste/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang mdun du lhag 37—1 191

pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs nas/ rnam par spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkug cing bcug ste/ 'tshe zhing dum bur gtub pa dang bsreg cing thal bar byed pa la dmigs nas sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i yungs kar gyis brabs pa'i mthar sbyin sreg byas te/ thal ba rlung la phyar na gang la dmigs pa'i gdon de rlag 1par byed pa la the tshom med do / /2gal te gza' la sogs pa'i gdon gyis bzung ba'i gnod pa thams cad las thar bar 'dod na gtsang zhing nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs su maṇ+ḍal byas te/der bum pa gtsang ma'i dri'i chu la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad dang bcas pa gzhag ste/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas pas bum pa'i nang du'ang lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs la gzungs kyi bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i mthar chu'i ngo bor bsams 4pas lus bkrus te/ sngags kyis 5mngon par bsngags pa'i sa rdza na'i bdug pa byin na gdon gyis bzung ba las thar bar 'gyur ro / /6'byung po dgug par 'dod na smad 'tshong gi ras la rgya skregs kyi khu bas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar nu tā ā kār+ṣa ya dzaḥ7zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas grog mkhar la sogs pa'i sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan kyi snying gar bcug ste/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bram ze'i thod par gzhag la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs te/ de las spyos pa'i pho nyas bkug cing gzhug pa'ang byas te/ sngags kyi mthar 'byung po ā kār+ṣa 8ya dzaḥzhes 9pa bzlas shing / 'bras chan dang 'bru'i thug pa dang la phug 37—/ 192

la sogs pa 'byung po'i gtor ma'i nye bar sbyor ba byas na 'byung po zhugs nas bdag gis 1las ci bya zer ba 'byung ste/ 'byung po dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug par mngag pa ni/sngar bstan pa'i gtor ma dus gsum du sbyin zhing / bhū 2ta wa shaṃ mā na ya zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags bzlas te/ bram ze mo gtsang ma'i zla mtshan gyis bsgos pa'i ras dang sa rdza na'i bdug pa 4byin nas/ mngon par bsngags pa'i tsan+dan dmar po'i thig le dpral bar byas na ci bsgo 5ba nyan cing mngag gzhug gi las byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dbang du gyur pa de rig sngags kyi las gang bsngags kyang myur du grub pa'i grogs 6byed do / /7gal te las ma grub na spogs pa'i cho gas grub par byed pa ni rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas te/ der 'dod pa'i lha'i sku gzugs bzhugs la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lhag pa'i lha mdun du gsal bar dmigs nas/de las sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i me tog khri phrag gcig phul la/ de nas me tog de rnams bsdus te/ de nyid kyis bsreg rdzas byas pa'i sbyin sreg de nyid du byas na las ma grub pa rnams grub par byed par 'gyur ro / /9grub pa chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir las kyi 'bras bu dbyung ba ni/ las dang mthun pa'i thab khung du bud shing brtsigs nas me sbar ba'i dbus su lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs la/ de nas las gang sgrub kyi spel tshig dang bcas 37—/ 193

pa'i sngags kyis 1de dang mthun pa'i sbyin sreg byas na bsgrubs 2pa'i las rnams chud mi za bar gang mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu des 'byin par byed do/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu sgrub par 'dod na gnas dbe+en par maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du lhag pa'i lha'i sku gzugs bzhugs la/ de'i drung du rin po che'i snod du dngos grub kyi rdzas bzhag nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs te/ de la mchod pa dang bstod pa sngon du song bas sngags kyi bzlas pa bya zhing / pho nya'i tshogs spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sbyor bas dngos grub sgrub par dmigs te/ dro ba dang du ba 'thul ba dang 'bar ba las mkha' spyod dang sa spyod dang sa 'og gi dngos grub spyin par byed do/ /sems can thams cad bsrung bar 'dod na tshes grangs dang dus tshod bzang po la sgrub pa po shar du mngon par phyogs pas gro ga 'am ras la gur gum mam gi wang gis sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar ming spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha spyan drangs nas 5mchod bstod byas te/ 'khor lo'i sngags dang dbyer med du bstems tshonas bzlas pa ci rigs byas na 7mgo'am mgul pa'am dpung pa la btags na gang la btags pa'i sems can thams cad 8nad dang gdon la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad srung ḍabar byed do / /—gal te rang bzhin 11gyi nad dang gdon la sogs pa zhi bar 'dod na/37—1 19 4

dge ba'i shing gi lo ma la tsan+dan dkar po'i khu bas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar zhi ba'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang mdun du lhag pa'i lha dmigs nas de'i lus kyi 'od zer gyis 'khor lo dang / 'khor lo las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya'i lus 1kun nas 'gengs par bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa'i mthar 'khor lo 'o mas bkrus nas/ des gang la khrus byas pa de'i nad gdon zhi bar 'gyur ro / / yang tshe dang longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas par 'dod na rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha gsal bar bltas la/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags bzlas shing mdun gyi lha las gser btso 4ma lta bu'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba spros pas gang la dmigs nas las sgrub 5pa de'i lus kun du khyab cing yongs su rgyas par bsgoms pas tshe dang longs 6spyod la sogs pa rgyas par byed do / / 7gal te rengs pa'i las sgrub par 'dod na dur khrod kyi ras la yung ba'i khu bas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo che ge mo'i kā ya wāka 8 tsit+ta ste bha ya lo zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris la/ grog mkhar la sogs pa'i sa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar 9bcug ste/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du lhag pa'i lha dmigs nas/ de la rnam par spros pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis bsgrub bya bkug cing bstems la/ de nas sngags bzlas pa dang / rig pa'i mthu las byung ba'i dbang chen dang / ri bo la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i tshogs 37—sde195

kyis lus dang yan lag thams cad rnam par gtams shing mi g.yo bar bsams na rengs pa la —1the tshom med do / /2gzhan yang rmugs par bya bar 'dod na/ dur khrod kyi ras la myos byed kyi khu ba dang nim pa'i 'dab 4mas sngar bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar che ge mo mo ha ya zhes pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas/ grog mkhar gyi sa las byas pa'i gzugs kyi snying gar bcug ste/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang mdun du lhag pa'i lha dmigs la/ de las spros pa'i pho nyas bsgrub bya bkug cing bstems te/de nas gsang sngags bzlas pa'i 5rig pa'i mthu las byung ba'i dbang chen dang ri bo la gnas pa'i rdo rje snying gar mnan te/ dran pa dang bral bar bsams na rmugs par byed pa la je tshom med do / /6gang la bsnyen pa byas pa'i sngags/ /las sgrub pa 'ang de nyid de/ /dad brtan je tshom med pa la/ /sngags ni yid bzhin nor ltar 'grub/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa/ dpal gi gā 7dha ra'i sras kyi thu bo bram ze ma ṇi badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā 8ba rab zhi bshes gnyen kyis bsgyur ba'o// //37byed/ 196
