༄ga /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ri1༄go/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar zhing srog chags nyung ba dang / /zug rngu med cing snum pa'i sa2sgyu/ /zhi ba'i thab khung shing brtsigs ཿte/ /me dbus rang lhag lha bskyed la/ /ye shes gzhug mchod bstod byas te/ /sngags mthar pā paṃ shāje sbyar/ /til dang me tog dkar bsregs la / /'bad bcas thun bzhi'i spyor ba yi / /chu bor 'jug dang gos dkar gyon//'khru dang sgyugs mudang khrag 'dzag sogs/ /rmis 6ltas mtshan ma mthong ba yi7 / /sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed/ /bum pa dkar po mtshan nyid bzang / /dkar po'i ras kyis mgul pa dkris/ /dge ba'i shing gis kha brgyan par/ /rgyun 'bab chu dang dkar po'i dris/ /bkang bar rang gi lha bskyed la bye// /ye shes gzhug dang mchod bstod bya/ /sngags mthar sdug bsngal shāk+ṣiṃ ⑫sbyar/ /dkar 'od spro dang bsdu ba'i mthar/ /lha gzhug bdud rtsi nyu1chus bkrus pas/ /37byed1199

sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed / /1ser ba'i sa las byas pa'i thab/ /me tog 'bras bu bzang 'byung zhing / /me dbus lha bskyed ye shes bcug /mchod dang bstod 2pas mnyes byas la/ /sngags mthar puṣ+ṭi ku ru sbyar/ /'bras bu bzang dang me tog ser/ /mngar ba'i rdzas rnams bsregs pa yis/ /dpal ni rnam par 'phel bar byed / /4rin chen bum pa 5dri zhim chu/ /gtsang ma'i ras kyis mgul pa dkris6/ /bzang po'i shing gis kha brgyan pa/ /lha bskyed ye shes gnyis med la/ /mchod dang bstod pas mnyes byas te/ /in+d+ra bi sho dha na ya/ /sngags mthar sbyar ba bzlas pa'i chus/ /legs bkrus dbang po rnam par sbyor/ /7rgyas pa'i thab tu dri bzang shing / /me dbus rang lhag lha bskyed de/ /ye shes gnyis med mchod dang bstod/ /sngags mthar ā yu dhā ra sbyar/ / drur ba 8me tog ser bsregs pas/ /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams skyob / /9sngar bstan thab tu bzang po'i shing / /me dbus lha bskyed ye shes bstemasatre/ /mchod dang bstod pas legs mnyes byas 1/ /sngags mthar rgyas pa'i spel tshig dang / /'bru ser me tog ser bsregs pas/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'phel bar byed / / bum bzang gtsang ma'i chus bkang ste/ /'bru sman rin chen snying po dri/ /ma nyams ras kyis mgul dkris shing / /bzang po'i shing gis kha brgyan par/ /lha bskyed ye shes gzhug mchod bstod/ /sho dha ya bi 1—sho dha ya/ mthar sbyar sngags bzlas legs bkrus pas/ /lha rnams mdun gyi nye bar gnas / / — dmar ba'i sa la dbang byed thab/ /me tog dmar 'byung shing brtsigs shepa'i / /me dbus lha bskyed ye shes bcug /mchod bstod wa shaṃ mā na ya/ /37byed/200

sngags kyi mthar sbyar me tog dmar/ /bsregs pas mdza' sdug dbang du byed / /༄rte tshe ra'i tshil bu 2gu gul dang / /yungs kar ce spyang glad par sbyar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon bsngags pa/ /dur khrod sol ba'i me la bsregs/ /bdugs 1 pas bran bza' sogs lus bdugs4/ /gdon gyis gtses las thar bar byed / /3pad+ma'i rtsa ba tsan+dan dmar/ /mngon par bsngags pa'i me sbar te/ /rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i/ /drur bas 6rang gi mig bskus na/ /phan tshun mi mthun gnas pa yang / /bltas pa tsam gyis mdza' bor 'gyur / /3rgyas pa'i thab tu shing brtsigs nas/ /me dbus lha bskyed byeye shes bstem/ /mchod dang bstod pas legs mnyes bya/ /puṣ+ṭi ku ru mthar sbyar ba'i/ /sngags bcas 'bru rnams bsregs / pa yis/ /nor 'phel nor 'grib 'joms par byed / /7bzang po'i bum par gtsang ma'i chu/ /'bru sman rin chen dri bzang ldan/ /mngon par bsngags pas legs bkrus 1pas/ /mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa 'joms/ /bla gos mtha' la brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mngon bsngags mdud pa bdun bor nas/ /lam du zhugs na mi bzad pa'i/ /'jigs dang nyam nga las sgrol 1 byed / / tho rangs lha yi bsam gtan ldan/ /sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa yi/ /chu dang thal ba yungs kar kyis/ /phyogs mtshams bcings pas phongs —pa 'joms/ /rig sngags kyis sabasngags sa ྾rdza na'i / /bdugs 7pas gza' las thar ba dang / /gu gul bdug pas lus bdugs pas/ /rgyu skar gnod pa 'joms par byed/ /kha dog lnga yi skud pa la / /rig sngags stong phrag bdun bzlas nas/ /gang gi mgul lam dpung pa las / /bcings pas byad stems las grol byed / / 1mi bzad gdon 37—1201

gyis nyen pa la/ /sngags kyi chu yis lus bkrus nas/ /gu gul yungs nag yi dwags skra/ /khwa yi gshog pa rma bya'i sha /ce sbyang rtug pa sngags bcas pa'i/ /bdugs 4pas nges par thar bar byed / /snye rmi lam sdog pa'i mtshan ma mthong / /gtsang ma'i gos gyon dris bdugs te/ /shar du mngon par phyogs pa yis/ /rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i/ /chu yis khrus byas dge ba dang / /sdig med dpal dang ldan par byed / /bye dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dz+nyā na shrī dang / lo tsā —ba rab zhis bsgyur ba'o// / /bsdur mchan/1199 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉ltar bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ra/ /〈〈snar 〉ngocigs/ sngu〈〈pe 〉〉yis 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyug 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rmi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(2sa/ 8 〈〈pe 〉7)/ 9 〈〈snar 〉〉skyed de —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sharnying / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ bdud rtsi'i/12spyoX 1 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 2 〈〈snar 〉〉stod/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉pus ting / 4〈〈pe 〉〉// // 57〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/6〈〈snar 〉tha/ra kris/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉sbyo ra// // 〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉dur ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉durba/9 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stem/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rna/ 12〈〈pe 〉〉// // tsho 〈〈snar 〉〉t+ta/ཿ〈〈pe 〉〉// // sa〈〈snar 〉sngagacigs/12༷1 1 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 2 〈〈sna ra 〉ribu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg /bdug 4〈〈snar 〉thadug 5〈〈pe 〉〉 / / // 6〈〈snar 〉〉dus/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉// // 8〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/ 9 〈〈snar 〉snga sreg 7〈〈pe 〉〉/ //nyu1〈〈pe 〉〉dkrus/ 〈〈snar 〉shesal/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉// // —〈〈pe 〉skoraphungs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'phongs/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉kyi / sa〈〈pe 〉〉gis/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dug nyushā〈〈pe 〉skoradugs/ 〈〈snar 〉ra dug shā 〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ 〈〈pe 〉〉// //12༷2 1 〈〈snar 〉rdzanyen/ 2 〈〈snar 〉rag 〈〈snar 〉thashog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadug 5 6〈〈pe 〉〉// //37—1202

༄ / /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa jes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhib mo dang bcas pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra be+e 2 sā dha rgo sa kadze+e/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhib mo dang bcas pa / 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen lta bu don bdun ldan pas rang don sgu gcig mi shigs rdo rjer 4ldan/ /gzhan don rdo rjes 5'joms pas gnyis med rdo rje'i sku gnyis snang / /thams cad rnam pa kun mchog ldan zhing mi phyed mi shigs pa/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje'i sku ste 'jigs byed zung la 'dud / /bya ba'i rgyud mchog rtog pa bye brag rdo rje rigs kyi don/ /bdag gzhan don rnams rdzogs byed sangs rgyas kyis gsungs te/ /bla ma rgyal de grub brnyes byin rlabs 6de thob 'di yi zhal mthong ste/ /gnang ba byin dang ldan pas bdag nyid bram ze gzhon nu ste/ /rig sngags ma lus 'chad 'gyur 'di 37—/20

bsgoms nus thob la/ /slob ma sangs rgyas gsang bas bskul phyir 'di bshad bya/ /gang zhig 'di la dad mos nas/ /bsgrubs nas kyiyon tan rdo rje 'byung / /'di yi dgongs pa'i bsam 2yas kyang — / /lhun po ri rab zom rgyud du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'di skad gsungs/ /sngon gyi 'phrul pa la brten nas/ /ma 'ongs man ngag rnam gnyis te/ /bdag don rdo rje'i bsnyen pa dang / /gzhan don rdo rje'i las spyor bcas/ /de tsam ma bshad do zhe na/ gang dag tu ni 4rang nyid kyi/phya/ /las kyi cho ga med pa lasazhwa/ /de bzhin phyi 7yi rgyud chen las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga 'dir bstan bya/ / de yi dus ni bzang zhing 9shis pa la/ /rdo rje'i gnas te bkra shis zhi gnas su/ /bar chad zhi sogs kun byas rdo rje'i g.yog dam dang / /rdo rje sgrub po shes rab la sogs lung las bsngags pa ni/ /bya ba'i dbang dang 11dam tshig man ngag murab shes des1 / /lus dang ngag sems gtsang zhing 7yid dge bas/ /rdo rje'i sbyor ba kun dang ldan pas bsgrubamu/ /sa phyogs rab tu nyams dga' bar/ /sa yi cho ga kun shes nas/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri bcas pas/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon po me tog bcas / /der ni rten rnams ldan pa dang / /mchod pa lnga dang mchod yon bcas / /khrus kyi bum pa bzang po dang / /lha yi bum pa bzang por bya/ /de yang gser sogs dag las 'byung / /mtshan nyid ldan der chu klung chu/ /'o ma dri lnga ྾sman dang 'bru/ /rin chen snying po me tog bcas/ /shel dang pha lam mu tig dang / /kha rgyan —mgul gsum pa yis bcang / /drur 8ba bdun dang ku sha dang / /rma bya'i sgro dang rdo rjer ldan/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /legs byas bskrad la sgrub rdzas ni/ /rin chen snod kyi — steng du gnas/ /37—/205

maṇ+ḍal steng du de gzhag la/ /ras sogs gtsang ma gon 1pa yis/ /phyi rol khrus kyi rdzing bu ni/ /nyams dga' der ni nyin phyed na/ /khrus bya 2 der yang sa rab bsngags/ /stong pas dri ma rnam par sbyang / /der song khro bos khro bo sprul / /se gol sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ /chu de lag g.yon gsum du gtor / /spyi bor gcig gzhag kha bshal te/ /khrus byas nye reg 'thor 'thung bsngags/ /de bzhin bum pas snga bar bya/ /bud med sha chang la sogs ni / /ku ba'i zas ni rnam lnga spang / /bshang sogs mi gtsang sbyor ba la/ /mnol 4ba med par sprul nas ni/ /de yi sngags dang phyag rgyas gdab/ /thams cad nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /gtsang khang nyams dgar log nas ni/ /se gol 'chi med khro bos bskrad/ /rdo rjes sgo gcod stan yang ni/ /'jam bder ku shar ldan pa la/ /nub tu kha bltas brtan par gnas/ /skad cig mi phyed phyag rdor gyis/ /rnam 5'joms dpag med rab bstan 'unas/ /skyod pa'i phyag rgyas sngags rdo rje/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni gtor byed par/ /rnam snang khro bo gnyis ldan pas/ /tshangs la sogs pa'i gdon sogs bskrad/ /'od zer rdo rje'i rwa 3sogs bsam/ /bar chad bgegs kyis mi tshugs so/ /rnam 'joms yang snying dri chab kyis/ /'byor pa bsangs te skad cig gis/ /mchod pa dag par bya phyir brlab/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /sangs rgyas gnyis dang 'jigs byed drug /de la yid kyi las kun bya9/ /rang bzhin rnam dag sngags kyis ni/ /nyams dang stong pa'i ye shes bya/ /rin chen khang pa yid 'ong ste7/ /rdo rje'i brag tu rnam par bsam/ /der ni lha chen drag por bya/ /bdag nyid 'jigs pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /shākya seng ge 'khor 37—1206

bcas la/ /gsol gdab rdo rje'i bsam gtan gnyis/ /'dres byas 'dres pa stong pa na/ /rdo rje'i rnam par bsam sngags brjod/ /bdag don rdo rje stong pa'i lha/ /de nas gzhan don yi ge ste/ /thog med las ni gsal ba ste/ /de la yig gnyis sngo spras pa1/ /nus ldan yi ge'i lha yin no/ /de la rdo rje 3 sngags kyi sgra/ /stong pa mtshon byed khams rnams su/ /dam pa gnyis byas de la bsnyim/ /de ni sgra'i lha zhes bya ste/ /de gyur dam pa kun 1thim pas rdo rje nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag /stobs chen khro bo 'jigs cha byad/ /sngo nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ /ral pa la sogs kun ldan pas/ /'byung po bsdigs 5pa gzugs brnyan tshul/ /'di ni gzugs kyi lha zhes grags/ /de nas de ni gsal brtan phyir/ /ro bo 'bigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / /rdo rje yan lag 'bar ba yi/ /sngags kyis 6spyi bo sogs bzhag pas/ /gtsug tor la sogs grub cing bsrung / /de yang phyag rgya'i lha ru bstan/ /de nas dus ni thams cad du/ /de dang mi 'bral kun byed pa/ /mtshan ma'am rnam rtog lha zhes gsungs/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum dang / /don gnyis grub cing 'od dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul nus pa ston byed pas/ /lha zhes shākya mchog gis gsungs/ /de nas bum pa mi dmigs las/ /rin chen khang par 7'dam skyes bzhi/ /ge sar sogs la bsil rdo rje/ /rdo rje man ngag ldan par bsam/ /dbus su sprin sgra gyur pa las9/ /phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi mchog /rdo rje rnam 'joms khro bo ni/ /bdag mtshungs las kyi rdo rje la/ /zla ba med pa bsnams pa'o/ /de yi mdun du mā ma tī/ /sngo zhing dga' ldan at+pal sngo/ /dam tshig rgyas 'debs bsnams pa'o/ /dran pa bzhi las byung ba 37—1207

ni / /kun kyang rim min byug car ro/ /shar lho rdo rje tī 1la ni/ /sngo dmar 'jigs pa kun ldan la/ /rdo rje phur bu g.yas na ste/ /g.yon pa kun ni bsdegs 2par mdzad/ /lho nub rdo rje be con —te/ /sngo nag rdo rje be+e con no//nub byang rdo rje tho ba ste/ /sngo skya de bzhin 'jigs pa la/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tho ba ste/ / byang shar rdo rje gtum po ni/ /mig sman 4mdog 'dra rdo rje ni/ /rtse gcig bsnams pa rab tu bsgom/ /kun kyang tsham ngam 3bdud bzhi 'joms/ /de rnams ye shes lnga ldan rigs/ /dbu la mi bskyod mgon po ni/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs bzhad khro ba/ / dpa' bo khu dag la rnam par gsungs/ /de nas 'od zer 'gugs byed kyis/ /'og nas 'khor bcas sbyan drangs nas/ /rig pa rig ma dam tshig can/ /dpag med byon gyur mi 'chi ba/ /thugs ka nas bton des bskrad bcad7/ /de la rang sngags bskul bcas kyis/ /mchod yon bzang po nyer bstan pa8/ /mi shigs phyag rgya rang sngags lngas/ /so so la ni gnyis med zhugs/ /phyogs skyong 'khor gyi 9phyi rim du'o/ /de nas dam tshig bstan ⑩bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin mi phyed khros pa yis/ /rigs kyi yum gyis rgyas 1btab pas/ /de yang rig pa rnam pa gnyis 1 / /mtha' med bar du zhugs phyir ro/ /bdag ni dam tshig ldan pa las/ /ye shes mi 'jug mtho dman tshul/ /de yang bya ba kun nas gsungs/ /de nas mchod pa rnam pa lnga/ /kun gyi rigs la de rigs dbul/ /sgra dang bzang po de bzhin no / /thal mo sbyar nas gus pa yis/ / rdo rje bsnams 7la bstod pa yin/ /gang gi rang bzhin chags sdang rnam bral yang / /gdul bya gdul saphyir khro la khro ba dang / /'dod chags can la chags can ltar ston pa/ /byang chub mchog 37—/208

gnas de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang zhig las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa yis/ /'gro ba kun dang ji ltar mthun pa yi1/ /gsang sngags gzugs kyis rjes su 'jug mdzad pa/ /sngags kyi rnam 'dren de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nad 2 gcod bdud 'joms mi rtog bzhi las byung / /las rnams 'joms mdzad khro bo 'bar bar snang / /nor bu rin chen lta bur gdul bya gdul5/ /khro bo khyed rnams la ni bstod phyag 'tshal/ /rig pa skyong ba'i lha rnams la/ /tshigs bcad bcu yis bstod pa yin/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don gsol gdab/ /de ltar 5bya ba rab rdzogs pas/ /don dang tshig gi lhar gnas shing / /bya ba rigs dang gdul bya'i phyir/ /bya rgyud rig pa 'dzin sde ste/ /der gnas sngags kyi bzlas bya ba/ /nor bu'i phreng ba'i bskul 7sngags kyis/ /byin rlabs lag pas legs gzung 8ste/ /mig gi lha thugs zla ba la/ /rdo rje gyes pa t+t+waṃ gnas bsam/ /lce rtse mi g.yo gzhan mi 9thos/ /yid kyis sngags kyi sgrar gnas pa/ /rdo rje'i sngags ni rgyas bsdus gsum/ /mos pa gcig ni bzlas par bya/ /thugs bskul bdag gzhan don rdzogs nas/ /sems can khams sbyangs 7sems can che 1 / /byin rlabs sarnam gnyis de gnas bsdu/ /don rnams rab tu rdzogs byed pas/ /zab mo bdag gi spyod yul te/ /sgra la gnas pa'i bzlas pa de/ /mi tshig g.yal dang dri ngan sogs/ /bar chad ngan pa spangs la bsgrub1 / /de yang dam bcas bar du'o/ /de dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba na/ /khrus byas kha bshal phyag rdor gyimu/ /yi ge brgya pas gsol gdab 'jug /thun drug sbyor ba de ltar bya/ /khrus 7gsum bya dang gos brje sogs/ /bya ba las gsungs rgyas par bya/ /tha mar nor bu bum pa dbul//37—/209

bsrung la ngo mtshar tshul du gang 1/ /bshang sogs spyod lam de bzhin bya/ /zas la bdud rtsir byen brlabs te/ /dbul dang bza' bas tshim pa'o /'khor la gtor ma gtang ba yang / /bdag byas cho ga bzhin du'o/ /de ltar yon tan tshang ba yis/ /mthong dang rig pa'i mtshan ma 'byung / /lha yi rten bzhad mthong sogs dang / /lus bde mngon sum la sogs so/ /de ltar grub pas gang byas kyang / /grub ste gzhan du nyams par 'gyur/ /rtag tu de byed rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje'i sku 4ni nges par 'grub/ /rdo rje'i 5las kun smos ci dgos/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs mchod dang / /bzod gsol dam tshig basbu byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal legs par byi dor bya/ /lhag zhwaganyis dpa' bo gcig pa ni/ /'byor pa chung bar shes par bya/ /de nas sgrub pa'i las sbyar te/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bya dang / /las kyi tshogs rnams sgrub pa'o/ /rdo rje khrus kyis dag bya ba/ /rgyas par dag byas khrus las shes7/ /bdag gam gzhan dag sdug bsngal sogs/ /ldan pa bsal 9phyir 'di dag brtsam/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma ni7/ /gos gtsang khrus bya dkar gsum bza'/ /shin tu spyod lam gtsang ba yis/ /nang gi sdom pa bsnyen gnas sogs/ /rten gyis blangs te bdag 1 gzhi can/ /de dag sta gon gnas pa ste/ /zhag gcig nyi ma la sogs bya/ /de nas sa yi las byas te/ /gtor ma rgyas pa gsungs pa bzhin / /bslang la sogs ni sngags dag dang / /bsam gtan dag gis cung zad yin/ /ma 'byor 'bru dang bye gtsang dang / /rten gyi dkyil 'khor tshul du bya/ /'byor pa ldan na 'di lta ste/ /byug pas legs byugs 7khru bzhi pa / /dge ba'i ras kyis thig btab nas/ /bkra shis tshon gyi 5'khor lo ni//37—/2/0

lte ba rtsibs bzhi la sogs bri/ /mtshan ma kun ni nges par dgod/ /sgo la phyag rgya bzhi yang ngo / /las kyi cho ga shes par bya/ /legs par nub tu sgo dbye'o—/ /lhag chad gso zhing de rgyan du/ /mda' sogs 'phen dang rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /lda ldi phreng bas nyams dgar mdzes/ /gong du gsungs pa'i bum pa gcig /khri la dbus su gnas par bya/ /mtshams 1bzhi de bzhin bum pa bzhi/ /bdag khrus bum pa nub tu'o/ /de nas rgyas par sngon bzhin du/ /khrus byas gsol gdab par ༄ bya'o/ /bum pa'i rdo rje thag bzung nas / /bsam gtan sngon bzhin ldan pa yis/ /khro bo'i ngag tu ring thung gnyis / /brgya rtsa brgyad dam rtsa gcig bzlas/ /las la de las mang mi dgos / /bdag dang lha sogs 'od zer kyis/ /bsgrub bya'i 'dod sgrub byas par bsam/ /de yang lha ni rdo rje chu/ /de nas las kyi cho ga ni/ /lha yi mtshan ma dug 'joms kyis/ /phyi ste nub kyi sgo nas ni/ /shar sgor ston pa thar bar bsam/ /dbus su khri steng de nas ni/ /rnam par 'joms pas nga rgyal bya/ /dri ma dag dang ldan bsams te/ /bden pa bdar 4zhing bka' bsgo nas / /sngags rnams kun du dril ba yis/ /dang 5por de la yungs kar kyis / /bskrad de de nas rma bya dang / / drur ba 6ku shas byabs pa la /nad sogs ma lus gdon par bya/ /de nas sngags bzlas grogs kyis ni/ /bkra shis bsgrags la chu dbang bskur/ /thams cad dag par bsam par bya /dung la sogs pa bkra shis sbyin/ /de nas de la lha bkod de/ /sngags kyi gnas su bsrung bar bya/ /dge ba'i las la srung 7'khor ni/ /rtsibs bzhi rgyan sngags spras pa yang / /rin po ches bris rab gnas la/ /byin rlabs 937—1211

bzlas te gdags par bya/ /de nas de la shel sgo 3nas/ /nub nas bton la rdo rje sbyin/ /rnam 'joms las kyang brlab 3par bya/ / de nas gyedabang bskur thob pa ste/ /nad la sogs pa las thar ba/ /zla ba sgra gcan las thar bzhin / /phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud kun ldan/ /yon tan ma lus rtsa bar 'gyur / /bde ba kun dang ldan pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad sel mdo bzhin / /sdig las grol te byang chub mchog /thun mong las ni nges par 'grub / /lan cig brtsams pas de sgrub na/ /rtag tu khrus byas smos ci dgos / /de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs mchod mul/ /bzod gsol dam tshig bsdu byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal legs par byi dor bya/ /lha gcig 6bum pa gcig pa ni/ /'byor pa chung bas shes par bya/ /de ltar shes pa'i sgrub 3pa pos/ /bdag gzhan 'dod pa 8sdogs don du/ /rdo rje las sngags ting 'dzin gyis/ /las rnams bsgrub 9par bya ba yin/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje'i zom rkalas ni/ /rdo rje'i rtsa ba 11'di ltar bgrol/ /bskrad 7pa la sogs bco lnga la/ /las kyi mtha' bsgyur sngags 'khor las/ /bsam gtan mkhas pas shes par bya/ /bsdu na rnam pa bzhi ru 'gyur/ /rig sngags mnan dang rig sngags gcad12/ /las gsum rmongs dang rengs pa'o/ /zhi ba la sogs las rnams ni/ /dus dang phyogs/ dang rdzas rnams dang / /bsam pa thabs dang lha dang sngags/ /'khor lo ming gis bsgyur ba'o/ /zhi bar bya ba la sogs rnams/ /lha yi rnam pa gsum 'gyur te/ /gtso 'khor gnyis su bsdebs pa dang / /gtso dang 'khor ni so so ste/ /kun la las kun rdzogs pa'o/ /sngags dang lha dang 'khor los shes/ /kun gyi 7las ni 'di ltar bya/ /zhi ba'i dus ni snga dro ste/ /37—/212

shar du kha bltas dkyil 'khor la/ /brten kyepa'am yang na bum pa la'o/ /shin tu dge ba'i las dag las/ /tsan+dan dkar pos 'khor lo bri3/ /rab gnas bum pa'i steng bzhag ste/ /lha rnams dkar po rnam par bsam/ /mchod pa de bzhin sngags mchog ni / /phyag 'tshal thams cad rig pa gnas/ /zhi ba gtso ste 'khor gyi yang / /bzhi la bod pa rab brtags 5tshote/ /kye nas blo gros bzlas pa yis/ /thams cad zhi bar bltas nas ni/ /'khor lo lus la gdags pa yis/ /nad sogs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /rgyas la 3ser po'i ras la ni/ /gur gum gyis ni 'khor lo bri/ /de bzhin bya ste lha rnams ser—/ /sngags ni de bzhin gtso bo yi/ /gcod byed 'khor lo'i 'dzin bskul lo/ /de yis rgyas bsams mchod na ni/ /tshe sogs thams cad rgyas par 'gyur/ /dbang la smad 'tshong zhabs 9ma la/ /rgya skyegs khu 1 bas 'khor lo bri/ /de bzhin bsam gtan dmar po la/ /sngags ni de mtshungs phur bu nas/ /phyag 'tshal bzlas pas dbang byas bsam/ /lam chen sbas na kun dbang 'gyur/ /gsad la gru gsum chos 'byung dang / /thams cad nag byas ro ras la/ /dug la sogs pas 'khor lo bri/ /kha sbyar phye la bkug bstems 11nas/ /lha rnams drag pos bsad par bsam/ /sngags ni gsod pa gsad par mubazlas/ /tha ma bsregs na thams cad 'chi/ /gzhan gyi porig sngags gcad pa ni/ /gi wang gis ni 'khor lo bri/ /lha kun drag por shes par bya/ /de bzhin gcad sa 1 ming bcas dang / /stobs chen bzlas ngag bcad sapar bsam/ /de nyid de yis rab gtugs rkan/ /des ni byad stems rig sngags kun/ /gcod byed de la the tshom med/ /rig sngags mnan la de 37—1213

bzhin du/ /mtshon gyi reg pas bris nas ni/ /las kyi 1rdo rjes mnan par bya / /sngags ni ming bcing bzlas bsdoms —bsreg /de yi sngags rnams mnan bsams shing / /lam chen rgya gram dag mnan na/ /nges par rig sngags kun gzhom 'gyur/ /rengs chol de bzhin kā ya s+t+waṃphya/ /rmongs la bi dhi tremo ha'o/ /ngag rengs wā ka s+t+waṃ 7zhes brjod8/ /skrag la bye ra ya hūṃ ngo / /'jil ba la bha / ya ka ra'o/ /'joms la ma ta 7zhes pa yin/ /las 'jil pre karma bhasgo'o/ / gdon mi za la a mri sod/ /tshabarlag la ta thā ya zhes te/ /thar la bi mo k+ṣa ya'o/ /dgug la ā kār+ṣa kyiya'o/ /las byed karma mukā ra ya/ /ma grub grub byed karma sidh+ya la/ /'dod la karma dha ya'o/ /srung la rak+ṣa 1 ku ru ste / /gza' skar bzlog pa la sogs pa/ /man ngag ldan pa'i mkhas pas nasbyar / /'dis ni las rnams 'grub par byed/ /bya ba bzhi (ni nges shes bya / /rdo rje lta bur thogs med pa/ / nan tan —k+ṣegyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /nan tan gyis ni bsgrub byas pas/ /bdag 2dang gzhan don nges par 'grub/ / nges par don mthong bya ba'i cho ga ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad byas de ni 'di ches te/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms cho ga 'di sbyar bas/ /khams gsum ma lus don rnams thob par shog / 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs 5 cho ga zhib mo dang bcas pa/ bram ze rig sngags 'chang ba samakhas pa chen po ku mā ra se nas mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po budhe gup+ta —dang / bod kyi lo tsā —/ba dpa' mañju shrī warmas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //phyis paṇ+ḍi ta zlon teng ha du dang / lo tsā cho ba da 'og bsod nams mos 37—1214

〉〉sdigs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 sngo skya de bzhin 'jigs pa la/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tho ba ste// she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sprin/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rngam/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbang po/ dza 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ ༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra zle 2e ka bī ra sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rdo rje bdag gzhan don4/ /rdzogs nas 5mthar phyin sgur gnas pa/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms phyag 'tshal te/ /bya ba nyung ba'i sgrub thabs bri/ /gang zhig shes rab chung gyur la/ /spros la mi dga' 6rnal 'byor pa/ /dam tshig dbang thob rjes gnang can/ /des ni don gnyis phyir 'di sgrub7/ /rgyas par yan lag bya ba kun/ /sgrub thabs che las 'byung bzhin bya/ /khyad par man ngag 'di lta ste/ /rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa yir/ /dus ngan bar chad bsal byas te/ /maṇ+ḍal la brten mchod pa dang / /bum pa gnyis dag 37—/2/8

legs byas te1/ /sngon du rdo rje nus pas mnyes2/ /tho rangs dus su khrus gnyis bya/ /sha sogs spangs te stan bde la/ /gnas pas yang snying gis bgegs bskrad/ /lha gnyis bla ma mdun bltas te/ /bdun po dag byas stong par bsams4/ /de la 5rdo rje'i khang pa ste/ /gdan bcas steng du lha drug gi6//bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer bsam/ /bum pa stong sogs gdan dag la/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rnam 'joms te/ /yum dang khro bo bcas par bsam/ /spyan drangs bgegs bskrad yon phul nas/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis bstem par bya/ / mchod de bstod la gsol ba gdab/ /7phreng ba byin brlab thugs zla la9/ /rdo rje lte bar sngags bsams te/ /ngag gsang gsum bzlas don gnyis byas/ /bar chad byung na bsal la bskyar/ /spyod lam legs byas 'bad pa yis/ /rtags byung nus pa thob pa'o7/ /de nas gzhan don sgrub pa ni/ /nad sogs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sta gon gnas las cho ga bya/ /dkyil 'khor bri zhing rdzas dgod pa/ /thig gdab pho brang zlum po la/ /rin chen phreng ba lha gnas gnyis/ /sgo ldan bris te rgyan bkram nas/ /bum pa dbus nas nub sgor te/ /khrus sogs sngar bzhin shes par bya/ /sngags gnyis grangs ldan grag pa'i sgras11/ /rdo rje 1 nad sogs 'joms par bsam/ /de nas khrus kyi las la sbyar/ /mtshan ma phyi 1 nas nub sgo nas/ /dbus su bzhag nas bgegs bskrad nas/ /byab dang bsrung ba kun bya ste/ /bum chu sngags dang bkra shis sgras/ /dbang bskur khrus bya nad sogs zhi/ /bsams te rdzas brgyad byin bya ste/ /nub nas bton te las kyang bslab/ /yon phul 5lan gsum gyis rdzogs 'baras/ /sngon gyi las kyang nges par 'jig /'phral gyi 37—/2/9

rkyen dag smos ci dgos/ /gshegs bsdu phyi 71la legs par gnas/ /'di ni basbus par gyur pa ste/ /lha gnyis bum pa gcig pa ni/ /'byor pa cung zad shes bya zhes/ /bla mas gsungs te de bsten 2byas/ /bdag gis 'di byas dge rtsa yis/ /khams gsum sems can nad gnyis can/ /de las grol te gsang bdag gi 7/ /go 'phang rnam gnyis thob par shog / 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs dpa' bo gcig pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas ri gangs trecan du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mkhan po de nyid dang / lo tsā 6ba dpa' mañju shrī warmas bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1218 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos nga ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs/ kyi sgrub thabs dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa'o// 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7na/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅phogs/ 5〈〈snar 〉ra/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodaga'i/ —〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ra 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'as/1219 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 ste/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnyan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thashang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ ༄7bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gimachod de bstod la gsol ba gdab/ /8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / rka〈〈snar 〉(4/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉sgra/ 1rta〈〈pe 〉〉rjes — / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉phyis / 2〈〈pe 〉〉dbul/ 7〈〈pe 〉skoragyur/ r+ṣa〈〈pe 〉torajigs/122༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyis/ 2 〈〈pe 〉ra rten/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉// // 5〈〈snar〉〉rigs / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/37byed/220

༄ / /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gtor malo cho ga'i rim pa jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra ṇi ba bo bi bye rdo kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi 4gtor ma'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don rnams ma lus rab mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms phyag 'tshal te/ /rnal 'byor kun la phan bskyed 5pa'i/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mdor bsdus bshad/ /bar chad zhi dang tshogs bsags 6dang / /'dod nga/ thams cad rab bsgrub ṭ+wāṃ phyir/ /zla ba zhag dang thun mtshams la/ /yo/ byad ci 'byor gtor ma gtang na/ /gtor ma'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ / blang byas g.yo yig gsum ltar byas/ /rnal 'byor don phyir bsnyus pa 'di/ /bdag byas cho gas kun la 'gro/ /de bas so so'i lha tshogs dang / /zhi sogs gang 'dod lha tshogs bsgyur/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal legs byas te/ /phyogs skyong 37—/222

bgegs la me tog dbul/ /rgyal la 1sogs pa de bzhin te/ /khri stengs rin chen snod gtsang ma/ /'bras chan khur ba sha sogs pa'i/ /gtor ma gsum mam gcig dag ste/ /mchod yon mchod 2snalnga bcas pa'o/ /sngags pa khrus byas gos gtsang gyon/ /yi dam lhar gnas bgegs bsal nas/ /yang snying gis sam yig gsum gyis/ /bdud rtsir byin rlabs nam mkha' mdzod 1/ /de yi sngags dang phyag rgya spel/ /de nas dgug 4byed phyag rgya dang / /dzaḥ7zhes pa yis phyogs skyong bgegs/ /bkra shis lha mo bcas te dgug /me tog stan 6la rab bzhag nas/ /yum gyi rgyas gdab dam tshig bstan/ /bsang gtor mchod yon mchod lnga dbul/ /de las lag g.yas snying gar gtad//g.yon pa rtse gsum gtor mar bstan/ /se gol brdab cing sngags 'dis )dbul / /oṃ badz+ra āḥ hūṃ a kā ro myu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde 9ār+ya nut+pan+da twata da sha di ka lo ka pā la dh+rika /sarba bispyo/ saṃ ga la de wī 1 aṣ+ṭa sa pa ri bā ra ba lo pū dza khā hirta2/ ma ma sarba kas+thā sā dha 1 ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lan gsum brjod la gtor ma de/ /bdud rtsi 'dod yon lnga ldan par/ /rdo rje zhal du 2rang sngags kyis/ /drangs pas sbyin pa gnyis rdzogs bsam/ /sbyin pa gnyis rdzogs tshigs bcad 5 brjod / /dbang po rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /phyogs skyong dag la bstod pa bya / /bgegs la bka' bsgo ྾lha mo la/ /bkra shis gsol gdab kun la yang / /zhi ba la sogs gang 'dod zhu/ /mchod pas mchod de se gol sgra/ /yi ge brgya pa muḥ bcas pas/ /bzod gsol rang gnas gshegs su gsol/ /gtor ma thag ring gnas bcas bzhag /dri ma ma yal 'byung po mnyes/ /de bas khyi bya dag la min/ /'di ni gang 'dod las 'grub ste/ /rang gi las 37—1223

zhes gsungs pas 1na/ /'bad de sgrub pa kun zhugs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gus byas na2/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis grogs su 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba bdag gis ni/ /'jam dpal go chas gsol btab nas/ /gtor ma'i rim pa bsdus pa yis / /dge bas kun kyang grol bar shog / 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga'i rim pa 5slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / lo tsā 6ba dpa' mdze+e shrī warmas bsgyur ba'o / / //bsdur mchan/1222 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉te/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 5〈〈pe〉〉skyed/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉btang / 9〈〈pe 〉〉tha byas g.yos/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bla mas g.yos/ 7〈〈snar 〉ra sum/1223 1〈〈pe 〉〉las/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs yig gsum kyis/ 4〈〈pe 〉skoragugs/5〈〈pe 〉〉ཿ/ /tsho〈〈snar 〉thastan/ 〈〈pe 〉thadab cing snga gas 'di'i/ 〈〈snar 〉thardab cing rang sngags/ 〈〈pe 〉rgaḥ/ 9〈〈pe 〉dza/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉la sgrig (〈snar 〉〉dh+rig 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉la/ 1 〈〈pe 〉tha re/bha li pu dza kha gyi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ri/ bi li pū dza kha hi/ 1 〈〈pe 〉sngagam sat+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉sngagasma sar+ya/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉'du / sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / slo〈〈snar 〉〉sgo / 〈〈pe 〉〉giḥ/ 8〈〈snar 〉〉〈ba/1224 1 〈〈smi ra 〉sko / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stos/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa pa/'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'phagasapa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/'i gtor ma/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅/37byed/22
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1663)37wa 1 225

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so//1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra dha ra ni sa dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shigs kun 'joms rdo rje 'dzin/ /khros shing gtum pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /rdo rje yon tan rdzogs btud de/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// //dad brtan g.yo dang nga rgyal med/ /ser sna chung zhing bla ma gus/ /'di 'a/ lhag nga/ra che dad pas/ /sgrub pa 'di 'bad bde legs shog /dang ngo/ra yid 'ong phyogs su 'ang / /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu 'di la brtson par bya/ /maṇa ḍal mchod dang gtor ma dang / /las dang po yi rnal 'byor pas/ //dmigs pa'i rten yang bri bar bya/ /rang nyid phyi nang khrus byas te/ /khyad par du ni lus kyi khrus/ /dri yi chu yis rtag tu bya/ /37—/226

bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rang snying zla ba sa bon bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis bla ma sogs/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su dmigs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab par gsol ba gdab/ /de nas sems can thams cad la/ /lhag par byams pa bskyed par bya/ /de bzhin snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshul bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de rjes rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de la cung zad dmigs nas ni/ /rnam par rtog par ldang bar bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa mi dmigs kyang / /sngags kyi sgra ru bsgom par bya/ /de rjes rang gi shes pas ni/ /sngags kyi phreng ba bsgom par bya/ /gsung gi rnam par rdzogs pa yis/ /phra zhing gsal ba'i rnam par ro/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de/ /gsal zhing cha ma 'dres par bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam par 'joms par byas nas ni/ /tshur la bsnyu ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rang nyid rnam par 'joms par bsgom/ /zhabs gnyis chu 'dzin dag la ni/ /g.yon brkyang ba ni rnam par bzhugs/ /skra ni in dra ni la dang / /rdo yi snying po dang yang mtshungs/ /mche ba rnam pa gabyugs pa ste/ /spyan dmar dpral ba khro gnyer can/ /mgo skyes dmar ser gyen 'greng ba/ /gsus pa che zhing sbrul kyis brgyan/ /sman ni ma nyis mnan pa ste/ /sku stod dar la yis dkris pa/ /rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ /rang gi bdag po dbu la gnas/ /g.yas pa rgya gram phyogs gsum bsnams/ /g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub thugs khar 'dzin/ /sra zhing mkhregs pa'i sgu dang ldan/ /'ja' ltar gsal ba'i bdag nyid du/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsam par bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab bya zhing / /gnas lnga 37—1227

rtag tu gtug par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la na ya swā hā/ de nas rang mdog phyag mtshan dang / /blo yis gsal bar bsgom par bya/ /gsal ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsam par bya/ /de la skyo na sngags bzlas pa/ /de ni phyi dang nang gi'o/ /de la nang gi bshad bya ste/ /rang nyid zla ba rang sa bon / /de yi mtha' ma gsang sngags rgyal/ /mu tig 'ja' dang mar me ltar//rnam pa de ldan zla bar bsgom/ /de la cung zhig dmigs nas ni/ /yang ni gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas/ /de dag ni na mo rad na tra yā ya zhes pa nas a mri te hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i bar du'o/ /de ni sgra dang bcas pa'o/ /rang snying khro bo'i tshigs spros te/ /kun kyang gsang sngags rgyal po bzlos/ /sngags kyi 'brug gi sgra dang bcas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rnam par spro/ /gdug pa can rnams sdigs par mdzad/ /de bzhin spyo zhing bsdu ba ni/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo drag spyod la/ /zhi la 'od zer dkar po ste/ /dbang la lcags kyu dmar po'o/ /rgyas pa la ni ser po ste/ /de ltar las dang rjes mthun par/ /'od zer dag kyang spyo bar bya/ /phyi ni nam mkha'i zla dkyil du/ /yi ge'i phreng ba bsam byas te / /rgyud las ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan bya//de ltar bsam gtan 'bum gyi bar/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas ni/ /las rnams kun du spyad par bya/ /de dag rab tu bshad pa ni/ /rig sngags gcad dang bcing ba dang / phur bus gdab cing mnan pa bya/ /de bzhin nor sogs rgyas pa dang / /sdig sogs zhi dang dbang du bya/ /de la dbang du bya ba ni/ /byi ru dmar 'dra'i sa gzhi la/ /mo yi pad+ma'i dbyibs 'dra ba'i/ /thab khung dag ni bca' zhing bsam/ /de 37—/228

nas star bu'i me bus te/ /de yi lha ni bdag po nyid/ /dmar po lcags kyu thogs bsams nas/ /mngon byas nas ni 'od zer spro/ /gsang sngags 'jug pa las mthun gdags/ /star bu'i 'bru dang me tog dmar/ /phub ma dag ni brgya stong bsreg /de yi gang 'dod de bzhin no/ /pad ltar dkar ba'i sa gzhi la/ /zla rgyas 'dra ba'i thab khung du/ /tsan dan dkar po'i me sbar te/ /rang lha dkar po bdud rtsir ldan/ /de la skad cig dmigs byas la//tsan dan dkar po'i 'o ma sbag /de bzhin dkar po'i rdzas rnams la/ /de bzhin yang ni sngags bzlas te/ /ci tsam nus pa'i spyin bsreg bya/ /sa gzhi ser zhing phos pa na/ /dbang chen lta bu'i dbyibs su bya/ /mkhas pas thab ni bca' bya zhing / /star ka a ru ra yi me/ /cho ga dang bcas sbar bya ste/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i yam shing la/ /de bzhin ba ru la sogs kyis/ /dbang chen la gnas bcom ldan 'das/ /gser mdog 'dra zhing dbang chen 'phro/ /de la sbyin sreg stong byas nas/ /gang dag 'dod pa rgyas par bya/ /de dag las kyi rim pa ste/ /rang nyid bsnyen pa rdzogs pas su/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran bya/ /gang dag gdon gyi nyen pa yi/ /cho ga la sogs bshad par bya / /dkyil 'khor legs par byas nas ni/ /bum pa rdzas sogs ldan par bri / /gsang sngags brgya dang gcig bzlas te/ /sgrub bya dkyil 'khor steng gzhag te/ /de la khrus ni lan gsum bya/ /srung skud mdud pa gsum pa ni/ /dpung pa'am srin lag dag la bcing / /des ni grol bar je tshom med/ /'khor lo dag gis bsrung bya na/ /rtsibs bzhi'i 'tshams su mtshon char ldan/ /mu khyud me ri rdo rjes bskor/ /gur gum ghi wang dag la bris nas ni/ /snga gro 37—/229

cho ga ldan par srung bar bya/ /de ltar 'di ni srung ba'i rgyal po te/ /'gro ba rnams la gsang sngags rgyal pos brlab/ /de rgyud 'di dang gzhan las gsungs pa'o / /o badz+ra dz+wa la na ya swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsan ḍā ki li ki khā ya swā hā/oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya badz+ra ki li ki la ya swā hā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dhā ra ya swā hā/oṃ pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra bra bhanya dza nā yā swā hā/ bsrung ba yi'o/ /na mo rad na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇa ḍa badz+ra pā na ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tat+ya thā/oṃ sarba bya ti/ sarba bigha nan/ sarba dur sam ni/ sarba dur mi haṃ/ sarba gra te/ sarba dza re/ sarba ka ya la smri du/ sarba u pa te pe bya/ sarba sha bye/sarba pa paṃ shan ting ku ru swā hā/ zhes khrus kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pus sta ye pu steng ku ru ye swā hā/ rgyas pa yi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pa shang ku ru swā hā/ zhes dbang du bya'o / /'di rnams las dang mthun pa'i sngags kha las kyang shes par bya'o/ /'di ni rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs rgyud dang 'byel ba'i las dang bcas pas shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'dir ma bkod pa rnams bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /'di ni sgrub thabs kun gyi rgyal/ /sems mos pa'i rjes 'byel pa'i/ /rtog pa dang bcas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnal 'byor rnams la phan byed yin/ /'di byas bsod nams dri med pa/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /'gro rnams mos pa'i bye brag 'grub 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'joms pa'i sgur 'grub shog/ //mkhas pa ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs las dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //37—1230
bsdur mchan/1226 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉skabo na 75 basbyo/ba/thag/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1664)37wa 1231

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ u pā 2ya karma nā ma/ bod skad du/las kyi thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje can rnams rgyal 'gyur ba'i/ / rdo rje rnam 'joms phyag 'tshal te/ / rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi/ /gza' skar byad stems bzlog 4pa bshad/ /byad ni mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i/ /rig sngags gang yin de yi mthus/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba bstan 5pa ste/ /de bzlog rig sngags bcas mnan 6bzhin/ /gang dag gza' skar btsas pa 'am/ /de la babs 7nas las ngan la/ /'di byas gnod pa med par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad dam bzhi pa la/ /yang na gcod byed med pa la/ /gza' brgyad rgyu skar gzugs rnams ni/ /lha yi snam bur dgod par bya/ /gtor ma mchod pa de dag mtshungs/ /bum pa lnga 'am bcu gsum mam/ /gcig pa thams cad bshams te gzhag /de 37—/232

nas khrus byas bsrung 1ldan pas/ /bcu gsum lnga 'am dpa' bo gcig /bskyed rdo rdzogs de dag 'dra shes bya/ /gza' rnams grwa las nag po che/ /bum pa rtse gsum thogs pa'o/ /rgyu skar 'od gzhon bum pa dang / /glog phreng thog skyes 5spyan drangs nas/ /bstems te mchod pa byas nas ni/ /rdo rje'i gzungs sngags dag la ni/ /oṃ asta na gra gra ha he dz+wa 7na gra asta dha dha ra rā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ de dang ldan pas bzlas pa yis/ /nus pa kun du byas bsams shing / /bka' yi bden pa bsgrags byas te/ /mchod nas de dag mkha' la gshegs/ /bum pas phyi bzhin khrus byas na/ /de dag las ni thar bar 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang las rnams ni/ /rgyas par 'grel dang sgrub thabs te/ /so sor sbyar na 'di dag ni / /dkyil 'khor rdzas dang yo byad dang / /lha dang sngags ni so so la/ /mkhas pas de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs kun la sbyar/ /dang por bdag la 9don mchod sogs/ /bdun grub 'dod nas sarba bid/ /de la sogs pa bdun sbyar ro/ /gzhan don las dag bshad pa yin1rta/ /sems can thams cad skrag pa la/ /tra ṭa la sogs rnam par shes/ /'jil la sasarba ta thā sogs/ /rig sngags gcod la sbyin+da sogs/ /gnon la brnya ya sogs yin/ /las rnams 'joms la te sogs sbyar/ /las 'jig pa la ki li sogs/ /gdon 7brlag pa la sā da ni/ /bhū muta la sogs de bzhin no/ /de las thar la tsa ra sogs/ /dgug lal ghur+ṇa la sogs yin—/ /las byed pa la tsu ru sogs/ /ma grub grub byed e hi sogs / /grub pa brtan la ma ti sogs/ /nges par sbyar bas 'grub par 'gyur / /gnod sbyin na maḥ1 la sogs yin/ /srung la man sogs nges par 37—1233

bya / /zhi la ti ti la sogs so/ /rgyas la te dza la sogs te/ /rengs shing bsad 1la a mu sogs/ /rmugs la ban+dha sogs sbyar te/ /ting 'dzin la sogs nges par sbyar/ /de dag 'grub par 2rgyal bas gsungs/ /yang na bsdus pa 'di lta ste/ /sems can skrag par bya bas na 4/ /rmugs pa'i bar du bco lnga la/ /ha ra nas ni hūṃ phaṭa bar/ /bco lnga mkhas pas rim bzhin sbyar / /gzhan yang las rnams dag ni 'di lta ste/ /sdig sbyong ba la sarba pā 3ba'o / /bshags dang dag pa bsams la 6de bzhin bya/ /duḥkhats+tsha da sdug bsngal med la ste/ /thams cad tsi la tan+t+ra mū 8la'o/ /dpal ldan shrī 9rma de bzhin nges par sbyar/ /dbang po nyams phyir in+d+ra pu ṣa ye/ /tshe zad bsrid 1 pa ā yurda de 1 ste/ /tshe nyams rgyas la ā yu puṣ+ṭa la'o/ /byur la sadza ti yang nges par bya/ /lha rengs pa nyu/la de ba u ya'ong/ /mdza' sdang ba la pre dag pre ya sabya/ /rigs bzhis gtses 7la tsa tur ku la dang / /shārnyi 7ku ru bri ya nges zhes bya/ /'khrug la ma na a sha a kad do/ /nor zad a rwa sa ra na dhe'o//mya ngan las byung a shod pa ya'o/ /'jigs la a shar+bha yo shane+e 1 ste/ /phongs la a sha ra yang sbyar bar bya/ /gza' la sogs pa gong bzhin 'dir shes te/ /gdon la da sha u tsa ta ya'o/ /mya ngan de bzhin a sho su dha ya/ /rmi lam ngan la 2 dhur ban ka ra ste/ /mdze la ko ra pri 2mo ka ya'o/ /bsod nams 'phel phyir phu phyar dha ya bzlas/ /'byor la mkhas pas mi 'grub gang yang med//kun la khrus sogs rab tu bsngags /pa yin/ /rnal 'byor gtsang sbra ldan pas bsgrubs na 'grub/ /de min byas na lha ni mi 'grub pas/ /de phyir lus ngag bya ba dag la 'bad par bya/ /'di byas bsod nams sems can kun la'o/ /37—1234

༄ / /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'asgoms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa 2nā ma a bye se ka bi byeḥci/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga /dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba dag dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / rje'u 5rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / dge spyong dang / bram ze gang dag srid pa'i rgya mtsho las ma rgal ba dag la nad thams cad 6dang gdon dang / byad la sogs pa gzhan kyi gnod pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa de dag la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rig sngags kyi cho gas grol bar gyur cig7 /de'i phyir de dag rnam par dbye ba'i rim pa brtsam par bya'o/ /mdo 'di'i mtshan rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ming gi nges pa 8bstan te/ ji ltar zhe na/rdo rje zhes bya ba ni 'phags pa rnams kyi yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi tshig bla dwags te/37byed/237

ye shes de ni bsod nams dang ye shes tshad med pa'i tshogs can/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas de'i phyir lag na rdo rjes lus thams cad rdo rjer byen gyis brlabs 1nas zhes bya bas/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi las grub pa lta bu ni 2ma yin gyi ye shes kyi lus can du bstan to/ /de'i phyir rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so zhes bya ba yang ye shes de chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid shin tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo rdo rje ltar thogs pa med pas/ rtse gabyug tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i gnas skabs la bya bar mngon no/ /ci'i phyir ye shes 'di la rdo rje zhes bya 4zhe na/ phyi rol gyi rdo rje rin po che dang chos mthun pa rnam pa 5bdun yod pa'i phyir dpe'i sgo nas don nye bar mtshon pa yin te/ 'di 6dag kyang 'di ltar/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa / sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa zhes bya ba rnams te/ des ni ye shes de nyid kyi rang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 7bstan to/ /de nas gzhan gyi don bstan 9pa ni/thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sgo sna tshogs nas sems can kyi don mdzad nga/ ste/ khams gsum pa'i 'jig tshogs la 1lta ba phyin ci log gi bsam nga/ can/ /phyi dang nang nas bgegs dang log 'dren rnam par lta 1 ba'i rgyu las kyi bag la nya'/ dang / kun nas ldang bar bcas pa de dag 'dul ba'i phyir/sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa zhes bya ba nas sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i zhes bya ba'i bar du tshig don bco lngas bstan te/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don mdzad par bstan te/ zhi dang 37—1238

rgyas dang drag spyod dang / /dbang sogs las rnam 1bzhi po dag /thabs kyis 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /ci rigs par ni sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar de dag ye shes kyi rdo rje des 'dul bar mdzad/ sel bar mdzad/ 'joms par mdzad pa'i phyir rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas gsang sngags kyi tshig gang dag gsungs pa de dag kyang ye shes de'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir thogs pa med pa rdo rje'i tshig tu rig par bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ cho gar bya ba thams cad kyang gtso bor slob dpon la brten pa yin pas/ de'i 2phyir slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yin4/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan 5par bya/ gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing / /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /zhes bya ba la shin tu khrus bya ba dang gos gtsang ma gyon pa ni phyi'i gtsang sbra'o/ /sgo gsum nas sdig pa mi dge ba mi byed pa ni 7yid dge ba'o/ /byang chub tu smon pa ni sems dang ba ste de dag ni nang gi gtsang sbra'o/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ /zhes pa'i don ni rig sngags de dag ye shes las byung bar khong du chud par bya'o//zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /zhes bya ba yang ye shes de'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa nyid do/ /de nas slob dpon kyi cho gar bya ba ni mdo 'di nyid las dbang bskur ba'i yan lag tu bum pa bstan pa tsam du zad do/ / /dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i cho ga ma gsungs pa de dag 'di nyid du gsungs pa la mi mngon par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na spyi rgyud las gsal ba'i phyir ram de dag tu ma bstan pa ni gnyis ka ltar na yang de ltar sbyar ba nyid de/ de las ni/37—/239

phyugs lhas shing gcig lha yi khang pa'am/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am 1khang stong nags tshal du/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa gru bzhi'i 2tshad/ /tshon rtsi rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis bri/ /phyogs kyi lha rnams gnas ni yongs su gzung 4/ /sgo bzhi'i sa 5la ku sha'i rtswa yang dgram/ /zhes gsungs pa las rig par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bya ba yang slob dpon gyis dang po sa babe+eng bar bya 6ba dang sbyang ba la sogs pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byas pa ste/ 'thas par bcags la ba'i rnam pa lnga dang spos chu gtsang mas byug go/ /steng du yang bla re bye zhing dar gyi lda ldi dang me+e tog gi phreng ba dang me long dag gis kyang brgyan par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la bkra shis kyi bum pa tshul dang ldan pas yon tan 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'di nyid las de'i rgyu bstan pa ni/ gser ram yang na ni/ /dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung / /zhes bya bas bstan to/ /de dag gi nang dgang ba ni chu'o zhes bya ba smos te/ tsan+dan dang ga pur dang 7gur gum la sogs pa'i chus nang bkang la/ de dang lhan cig dang 9ldan pa'i rin po che dang shel dang zhes bya ba ni ༷dngos su zad do/ /nor bu zhes bya ba rgo spyi tshig tu smos pa ste/ rnam par phye na pad+ma rā ga dang in+d+ra byā la la 1sogs pa rin po che'i rigs su gtogs pa mu tig dang sa le sbram la sogs pa dag ste de dag kyang gas chag rnged pa rgyan gyi bya ba byed nus pa dag ni rma med ces bya'o/ /gzhan yang de'i zla la yungs kar dang / rtswa drar ba 1 dang me tog rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /tshul ཿbzhin du spyi'i rgyud las kyang / bum pa pad+ma dmar po'i mdog 'dra zhing / /nag po ra ri med pa rin chen bcas/ /sman dang 'bru dang spos chus bkang ba dag /ldum bus kha brgyan ras kyis glumagul 37—/2/0

pa dkri1/ /zhes bstan te/ de dag gi ltor ni chu bye gang shong ba las bya bar 2 bstan to/ /mtshan nyid gzhan ni rgyud gzhan dag las rig par bya'o/ /yang gong ma 'bru dang sman dang zhes bya ba la/ bya kṛ dang seng kre la sogs pa'i sman 4rnam pa lnga dang / til dang sran ma la sogs pa 'bru sna lnga rnams rgyud las grags pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /mgul chings 5ni gtsang ma'i gos zhes 6bya ba ma spyad pa ma bab pa'i ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa 7dang bcas pa'o/ / dkri zhing 8dgang ba ni gong du bstan pa'i rdzas rnams kyi don mdor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /bum pa de ltar bca' ba de yang rtog pa 9gzhan gyi —cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin du grangs bzhi 'am lnga dag gu gul la sogs pa la rdo rje khro bo'i sngags kyis btab ste bdugs la dbus dang grwa bzhi ru gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid las kyi khro bor bsgyur la lag tu rdo rje dang yungs kar blangs te/ bskrad cing bsrung ba dang / mtshams bcad pa dag byas nas/thig skud lag tu blangs te phyogs ma 'khrul bar bcad la rim pa gsum par thig gdab po/ /de nas lha'i ri mo bris te7/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du gtso bo phyag na rdo rje rgya gram phyogs gcig med pa pad+ma dang seng ge'i khri sastengs su zhag go/ /de'i grwa spyobazhir 'khor rnams kyi phyag rgya byang shar mtshams nas bzung ste khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdengs pa dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang /be con rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / rdo rje tho ba rnams bri'o/ /de nas rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan la sogs par 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dang / bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad kyi mtshan ma dag bri'o/ /rim pa gsum par rin po che'i chun 'phyang dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dag dgod do/ /phyogs bzhir sgo khyud 737—/2 /

dang rta babs dag gis mdzes par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol stegs bu'i mtha' skor 1du yang rtswa ku shas bskor cing me tog gi sil ma dag kyang bkram 2mo/ /de nas phyi rol du byung ste 'byung po rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ bza' dang sha chang la phug la sogs bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes bya ba dag khyer nas/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i 4bstod pa'i bden pa bdar 5la/ lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las kha phye ste bkan nas bstan pa'i 6tshul du byas pa ni gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyag rgya ste/ 'byung po de dag la so so'i rig sngags dag brjod 7cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi rig pas kyang byen gyis brlabs la bsngo'o/ /de nas slar log ste lha'i gnas su song la tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de dag mdun gyi nam mkha' la gyen du dpag cing / rin po che'i gzhal yas khang pad+ma dang seng ge'i gdan khrir bcas pa bsams nas/ der rigs kyi sngags kyi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang ba ni pho brang lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje ye shes kyi khyad par las byung ba dpal 9rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gyi smin ma khro gnyer can/ phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yon pa dkur brten cing 'gying ba/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang dar pa ti 'am tshi sagu gsol ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor gsang sngags dang rig sngags 5kyi khro bo dang / khro mo phyag brnyan 1 grangs med pa'i tshogs can dag rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs te/ lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bkug ste phan tshun bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad dbyung bar byas 37—/2/2

la / gung mo gnyis gzhibs pa'i phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste/ bar nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par byas la mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis 1 gzhibs par bya'o/ /de'i sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa 3la na ye swā hā/ zhes bya'o//yang na rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang ngo / /de nas thog mar dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mje'u chung gi sen mo mthe bos mnan la lhag ma rnams rdo rje rtse gsum gyi tshul du byas la/de'i sngags ni/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes so/ /4de nas dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir khro bo bzhi gzhag ste/ byang shar mtshams nas bzung 5ste khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtum po zhes bya ba mdog smrag nag bzhin khro gnyer can phyag g.yas pa na khro bo'i 6rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdengs pa 7phyar te thogs par bsam mo / /de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yon pa'i 9mdzub mo snying ga'i logs su gzhag /g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum rdo rje ltar byas te/ de'i sngags kyang 'di nyid las/oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa 7badz+ra tī li gī khā ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /de nas shar lto'i mtshams su rdo rje gī li tī lā ya zhes bya ba mdog ljang nag sadapral ba khro gnyer can/ phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje rtse gcig pa ka na ya'i dbyibs 'dra ba thogs pa bsam ste/ de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la cung zad bsgol ba'i tshul du byas la/ mje bong 7gnyis gyen du gzhibs sal bsgreng ngo / /de'i sngags ni/ oṃ tra sa ya 15tra sa ya rta7badz+ra tī li shī lā ya swā hā/zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /de nas lho nub kyi mtshams nasu rdo rje be con zhes bya ba mdog mthing nag sma ra ser po 'khyel pa/ phyag g.yas na be+e con kyi rtse mo rdo rjes mtshan pa bsnams pa ste/ de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis 19phyag 'tshal ba'i 37—/243

thal mo las mthe bo gnyis bsgreng ste tshigs bkug nas srin lag lkudrung du gzugs par bya ste/ de'i sngags la/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha rā 2ya swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /de nas nub byang gi mtshams su rdo rje tho ba zhes bya ba mdog nag po shin tu khros pa mche ba gcigs pa bsams te/ de'i phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs te mje bong gnyis bsgreng mthe'u ༄chung gnyis nang du gzhug go/ /de'i sngags ni/ oṃ pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bha spru nā ya 5swā hā/zhes bya ba dang sbyar ro/ /de nas phyi rol gyi rim pa gnyis par dbang bdag la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dang / rgyal ma la 6sogs pa bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad kyi phyag rgya bsgom ste/ de dag so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya babyungs te spyan drang zhing rang rang gi gnas su bkod la/ gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa de rnams la gus pa'i mchod pas khyab par bya ste/ mchod yon byug spos me tog bdug pa dang / /zhal zas mar me'i tshogs rnams rim bzhin dbul/ /de nas phyogs bcu dag na 7ji ltar srid pa'i lha rdzas dag kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin 8dag gis mchod la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi rig pas kyang byin gyes brlabs te/'di ltar ro/ /na maḥ( sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ7/ sarba tasgo uṅga te sga ra ṇa 1 hi oṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas bstod pa ci shes pas kyang bstod do//de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /ces pa grangs ma nges par gsungs pa la rtsa ba'i rig sngags mjug snying po'i rig sngags rnam pa gnyis bskul tshig dang bcas par zlos pa ni nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /yang na de rnam pa 5gnyis ka gdon par mi nus na mjug san/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa 1 badz+ra zhes bya ba nas a mṛ 18te hūṃ 37—/24 4

phaṭa ces bya ba'i bar ni rig sngags 'di'i snying po yin te bsgul tshig dang dzobacas par lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad gdon par bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas brjod zin nas yon bdag gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba 2la sogs pa byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khri'u lta bu bzhag pa'i sar ri mo yid kyis bteg pa dang /yang na phyag rgya nyi tshe dbyi bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa rnams kyi chu blugs shing dbang bsgur te/ shu ti dang nye shing la sogs pas khrus bya'o/ /rol mo dang bkra shis kyang gdon no4/ /khrus zin nas sgor 'byung ba'i dus su zho dang sman dang 'bras la sogs pa bkra shis kyi rdzas la sogs pa 5cho gar bstan pa rnams 6mthong ba 'am rig 7par bya ba dag ni bkag pa med do/ /de nas rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i cho ga'i phan yon 'byung ba yang mdor bsdu na gnyis te/ sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa dang / bde ba skyed par byed pa'o/ /sbug bsngal sel bar byed pa ni/ sems can dbang po nyams pa dang / /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang / /zhes bya ba nas/ de dag thams cad zhi bar lta/ /zhes bya ba'i bar dang / phan yon ni9/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /snyug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ /ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhis bstan to/ /bde ba byed par byed pa ni/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /zhes bya ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur / /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /zhes bya ba rnams kyis bstan to//de dag kyang phan yon mdor basbus pa tsam du zad kyi/ gzhan yang rgyal po'i chad pa dang / chom rkun dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang /mtshon la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las sgol bar rig par bya'o/ /37—/245

༄7/ /khrus kyi cho ga'i rim pa bzhugs/—1༄go/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga ru/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje can gyis ni2/ /rjes mthun phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba/ /dam bcas phrin las de ni rjes dgongs la/ /de phyir bgegs dang log 'dren tshar gcad cing / /'gro ba 'di la rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal nges bsal bde mchog 'byor pa po/ /khro rgyal khyod kyis de ring byin brlab 4mdzod/ /khrus kyi skyes bu la dang por bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi sngags lan gsum brjod pas bskrad / de nas rdo rje khu tshur gye sngags lan bdun nam/ gsum brjod pas bdug /de nas yungs kar la pra tsa ta zhes pa dang / / dha ra dha 5ra zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas la gtor ro/ /de nas chu'i khrus dang / byab pa 6dang bsrung ba rim pa bzhin du bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rdo rje go cha dang /bsrung ba chen po'i 7sngags dang phyag rgyas kyang rim pa bzhin du bsrung ngo / /37—/248

dog nag mo khro gnyer bsnyer 1ba smad g.yogs nag po gyon pa 'jig rten gyi khams rang gi 'od kyi snang bas 'bar bar byed pa dbyug pa 2thogs pa'o/ /tsa ba sak+ka/ phyag rgya ni thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las/ mdzub mo gnyis dang gung mo gnyis nang du bkug ste mthe bo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis mthe'u chung gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /sngags la/ na 5maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥce7/ sarba bha ya bi ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ2/ sarba thā haṃ shekhaṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma hā ba le/sarba ta thā ga te sgu ṇa ni rdza sa te 1 hūṃ hūṃ/ tra ṭa tra ṭa nyu a pra ti ha te swā hā/rdo rje khu tshur gyi sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra da ma da ma hūṃ sgo ṭa ya bhasmi saku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / bskrad pa dang / bdug pa dang / chu'i khrus dang / byab pa dang /bsrung ba rim pa bzhin du bya'o/ /khrus kyi cho ga'i rim pa sdogs so — // //bsdur mchan/1248 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉rdza ra bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉7ni/ 〈〈pe〉rasal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs 5〈〈pe 〉ra ra da/ 6〈〈snar 〉khya ba/ 7〈〈snar 〉༅'i/1249 1〈〈pe 〉〉ta bi pi ta sa pa// 〈〈snar 〉〉ṭa ku bi ta sangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 phaṭa/ 〈〈pe 〉7ཿ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉be+e/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉nga r+ya yā / 6〈〈pe 〉wagha naṇa/ 〈〈snar 〉waghā māṃ/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉thā ma thā/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉duṣ+ṭhan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bhas rmi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bigadz+re 〈〈snar 〉wartswa rna/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bh+ya ti bh+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉ra ti khyuḥ/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bh+ya/ sa〈〈pe 〉thad kyu be bh+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉tha kyu byuḥ/ —〈〈pe 〉d+kuza bh+ya/ —〈〈pe 〉'a dwa bh+ya/ 1 〈〈pe 〉d+ku ba ni khyu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉dur du/ 〈〈sna ra 〉〉dur ni/ 〈〈pe 〉〉giḥ/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉bh+ya/ 〈〈sna 〉〉ta bya/ 5〈〈pe〉7ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉ra ye/ 〈〈pe 〉7)ga sgo/ 〈〈snar 〉spro ghā rna/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉bh+ya ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉byu ti/ spyo 〈〈pe〉〉giḥ/ 28〈〈pe〉〉ste/ 9〈〈pe 〉wab nan rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉 ga te na rakya rakla/ 〈〈snar 〉〉// // 〈〈pe 〉〉bh+ya ti bh+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉37—/2pya0

༄ / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi man ngag1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā 2ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra dhī u pa de 4 sha /bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi man ngag /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir bla ma dam pa'i 5man ngag gi 6las kyi tshogs cung zad dran pa rnams dgod par bya'o/ /de la las kyi rnam par dbye ba 7mang mod kyang / 'dir ni phrin las bco brgyad las ma gsungs pas de dag gi don yang 8bsdu na gnyis nyid de/ phan gdags pas rjes su gzung ba dang rte/ tshar gcad pas rjes su gzung ba'o/ /de dag kyang zhi ba la sogs pa phrin las bzhis 'grub par 'gyur la phrin las kyang sgrub pa po tshad dang ldan pas yin gyi gzhan du na don med par 'gyur ro/ /thog mar sngags pa snying rje chen pos bskul ba'i bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs par byas la de'i 'og tu 1las dang 1 mthun pa'i 'khrul 'khor bri 37—1252

bar bya'o/ /de yang zhi ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni dkar po'i 1phyogs kyi tshes gang yang rung ba la 2ras sam shing shun la sogs pa ras gagazhi dkar po la pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'khor lo gur gum la sogs pas gtsang sbra la gnas par bri'o / /de'i lte ba la na mo rat+na tra yā ya5/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa khuye ma hā ya k+ṣa se nā 7pa ta ye che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes spel la bri'o/ /rtsibs rnams la rim pa bzhin du gnod par byed pa rnams tra ṭa tra ṭa tro ṭa ya tro 8ṭa ya che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes bri'o/ /de'i mu khyud phyi ma la yang snying po bri bar byas te9/sngags de thams cad mgo phyir bstan pa'o/ /de ltar dz+res pa'i 'khrul 'khor de la sngags pas 'di ltar las la sbyar bar bya ste/ rang nyid yud tsam kyis lhar bsams 1 la mdun gyi nam mkha' la bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa bskyed la gsol ba btab 11pa ni bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po khyod ni thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin na de yang 1 che ge mo 'di'i gnod pa 'di dag nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes ngag gam yid kyis 1 lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya ste bar gyi tshig spel 1 la phrin las gzhan la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas bdag dang bsgrub bya la byin gyis brlabs nas 'di ltar 'dod pa grub par bsams te/ slar yang bcom ldan 'das 'khrul 'khor gyi lte ba la bzhugs te rgyun mi chad 15par byin gyis brlab pa mdzad 1 par bsams la spel ba dang bcas pa'i bzlas pa rte bya'o / /zin pa dang mchod de bstod pa yang byas la ༄ 8thams cad zhu ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i thugs kar bsgrub 19bya tshud pas mchog tu bde zhing gnas par bsams la de bzhin nyid kyi blos me tog la yang 37—/253

snying ngo/ ci nus par bzlas la 'khor lo la gtor bar bya'o/ /de ni rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ste 'khor lo dril la bsgrub bya la btags 1te/ de la 'gom nga/ra mi bya ba ni dam tshig go / /sems can thams cad gzhil bar byed pa dang /zhi ba dang bsrung ba ste/ las gsum dang 'byel pa'i zhi ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyi rnam par dbye ba rdzogs so// //ji ltar sngar bstan pa'i tshul byus bar gyi tshig 'dis spel la 'dir yang sbyar te rgyas pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni gzhi ser po la rin po che'i phung po lta bu'i dbyibs can bris la ming 'di zhes bya ba'i che ge mo rab tu gnas par rgyas par mdzod cig ces spel bar bri zhing mu khyud phyi ma la ni yang snying 4bri'o/ /de nas gsol ba 5gdab pa la sogs sngar bzhin no/ /de la 'dir khyad par gyi 6gdams ngag ni 'di yin te/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na yo byad don du gnyer bas nor gyi 7bdag po la bskul bar bya'o / /de yang 'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor ba spangs nas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu la spos la sogs pa'i 8 dri stsal te dngos su 'am bsams pas rnal 'byor pas yud tsam gyis rnam par snang mdzad du bsams la mdun gyi nam mkha' 'a/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam zhing de bas dma' bar ji ltar 'dod pa'i nor gyi lha bsams rta te/ bdag sani dbul te de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang dbul po rnams la phan pa'i nus pa med pa la ji ltar bya snyam du 'dun pa drag po byas la/ yang 'di snyam du dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa'i yo byad kyi don du dzam+bha la khyod la nor gyi 5dngos grub 'byung gis bdag la myur du 37—/237/

longs 1spyod rgya chen bo sprul du gsol zhes dngos sam yid kyis brjod la/ de'i ngang la yang snying po brgya rtsa brgyad 2pa'i chu lag pa g.yas pas dzam+bha la'i spyi bor blugs par bsams te de la chu sbyin no/ /de'i tshe dzam+bha las sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan 3sngar ji ltar khas blangs pa dang / de ltar 5chu ster ba'i dus su yang bcom ldan 'das dpang po'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang / bdag ni bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa'i sku yin la de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi 6gsang ba'i bdag nyid kyang yin te lag na rdo rje'o/ /lag na rdo rje ni gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon yin la dzam+bha la yang gnod sbyin yin pas na/ /7dpon lag na rdo rje yin pas 'bangs sam 'khor dzam+bha la la bka' stsal pa ni mi slu bas na sngags 9pa'i 'dod pa thams cad dzam+bha las rab tu sbyin par 'gyur te 'di ni nges pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa 'di ni gnas dbe+en par mchod cing gzhag par bya'o/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i las dang 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa dang / ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa dang / grub pa rnams chud mi za ba ste phrin las rnam pa bzhi po de ni rgyas pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las su rig par bya ba sdogs so// //dbang gi 'khrul 'khor dmar po zla gam kibris la dbus su t+t+waṃ nag po bri zhing de'i g.yas dang g.yon du dīḥ dmar po re re bris te/ mu khyud zlum pos bskor ba la yang snying bris la stegs bu la bzhag go/ /de nas sngags pas gos dmar po bgos la 7nub phyogs su kha sabaltas te/ de nas brtsams te che ge mo dbang du bsdu'o sasnyam pa'i blo dang 1 gsol ba la sogs pa byas la de'i rjes la rang gi lus 'khrul 'khor gyi lte ba'i hūṃ la thim nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las 837—1255

rnam par 'joms mdzad du rang nyid bsam mo/ /las myur bar 1bsgrub pa ni lag pa nyid myur bas na rang gi srin lag g.yas pa las dhīḥ snadamar po cig byung nas rang gi g.yas na 'dug par bsams 4la/ g.yon pa las kyang de bzhin te s+thāḥde 5las 'od zer 6dmar po 'phro zhing rang 'dod pa'i las byas te 7slar yang de nyid la 'dus pas sngags kyang rang gi spel bas bzla'o/ /de'i tshe na yang sngar gyi mdun gyi 9nam mkha'i bcom ldan 'das ni ji srid 'dod kyi bar du byen gyis rlob cing bzhugs par bsam mo/ /'dod pa'i don grub nas tweḥ1 ni rang la basbus la rang yang zhu nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshul du gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i 2'khrul 'khor ni ting nge 1 'dzin nyid kyang rung ngo / /'dis ni 'byung po thams cad 'gugs pa dang / gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa la sogs pa phrin las gnyis gtso bor byed do/ /dbang gi phrin las kyi rim pa rdzogs so// //bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon spyod la gnyis te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dbye bas so/ /'khor lo bris la lte ba'i gru gsum la bsgrub bya'i timing dang mā ra ya sod nan zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i spel tshig sadang bcas pa bri'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la sarba mu sha t+t+waṃ māṃ/ gha ṭa gha ṭa che ge mo mā ra ya rbad ces bri'o/ /g.yon du bskor ba'i rtsibs la saṃ gha ṭa ya che ge mo mā ra ya 4 rbad ces so/ /rtsibs gcig la a mu kai mā ra ya phaṭa/ na ma ཿsan+ta badzā rde sarba ba waṃ ā brta ya 1ma hā ba le che ge mo mā ra ya rbad ces bri zhing mu khyud la yang sngags de dag nyid do/ / sngags 37byed/256

de dag ni mgo nang du bstan pas so1/ /de nas yang gsol ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das ni 2shin tu khro bar bzhugs pa la gsol ba gdab po/ /rang nyid rnam par 'joms mdzad du bsams 1pa'i zhal nas sngags brjod pas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros nas gang la bya ba'i lus la phog pas de yongs su zhu nas rnam shes yig 'bru gcig tu gyur pa 'phen 4pa'i rlung gis bteg ste5/ yi ge yo gi steng na dṛ 6sngo nag tu gnas pa bkug nas 'khor lo'i lte bar tshud par bsams la/ de yang 'dar zhing 'phar la mi bzod bzhin du gnas par bsam mo/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mo la yang gzugs brnyan bri ba'am bsam par bya'o/ /rab tu bsgrim par bya'i gzhan du na rang gi srog kyang g.yo bar 'gyur 8na dgra bgegs lta ci smos/ zin pa dang las kyi mtha' bsreg pa'am mnan pa gang yang rung ba bya'o/ /'dir yang man ngag ni 'di yin te/ rig sngags gcod par byed 9pa zhes bya ba'i skabs su sgud pa sngon po la sum bsgril byas nas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te rdo rje lta bu'i mdud pa'am / lcags sgrog 1 gam zhags pa lta bu'i mdud pa dor zhing / mdud pa re re'i nang du pha rol gyis rbad 1 pa'i mi ma yin pa dang de rbod 1 par byed pa po'i dngos po rnams chud cing rab tu bsdams 1 nas sngags bzlas pas de ltar gyur te de mgul du gdags so/ /gang gi tshe mi ཿdgos pa'i tshe mdud pa dgrol bar bya'o/ /gzhan du bsod nams ma yin pa sog sapar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 1 rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa zhes pa 1 de la yang man ngag gi gnad na 'di lta bu brtsam par bya'o/ /'khrul 'khor gzhung ltar bris la 'khrul 'khor gyi lte bar bsgrub bya'i gzugs lce shin tu che ba bris la/ lce la 37—/257

rtsibs kyi sngags rnams dang / che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba'i ngag rengs par gyis shig ces 1spel te bri'o/ /de la sgrub 2pa byas la ri rab sa nag po las byas pa'i stod du 4rnam par 'joms mdzad kyi sngags shog bu la sogs pa la bris pa stsal / smad du bug pa gru gsum brus 5la de'i nang du 6'khrul 'khor bris 7pa de bcug la mnan par bya'o/ /'di ni sngags kyi nus pa'am rbod gtor nye bar zhi bar byed pa ste mngon spyod kyi khyad par ro // // 9 yang sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa zhes bya ba la 'khrul 'khor spangs la rta nag po'i rnga ma la bshang ba'i srin bu brgyus te phreng ba byas nas gang la bya ba la dmigs te khros pas sngags bzlas na/ grong khyer la sogs pa nyu1 'jigs shing skrag par 'gyur te sngags las su rung na las de dag la the tshom mi za'o / /mngon spyod kyi 'khrul 'khor ni skrag pa dang rig sngags gcod pa dang rig sngags gnon pa dang / las 'joms pa dang rig sngags kyi las byed du 'jug pa dang / rengs par byed pa ste las drug byed pa'o/ /dgra'i samangon spyod kyi 'khrul 'khor rnam par phye ba'i rim pa rdzogs so// //da ni bgegs kyi mngon spyod kyi 'khrul 'khor brtsam par bya ste/ ro ras la sogs pa la 'khrul 'khor gru gsum sum brtsegs su khobyas la grwa 7rnams la/oṃ sbyin+da che ge mo stson+da bhen+da 15che ge mo bhen+da 7ma hā khri li kri lā ya che ge mo mā 1 ra ya phaṭa ces bri'o/ /dbus su bgegs kyi gzugs dang mā ra ya zhes spel la bri'o/ /yang gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa byas la rang nyid chu'i zla ba lta bu'i rnam par 'joms mdzad du sku che la yan lag rags par bsgom mo/ /de nas rab tu 37—/258

bsgrims nas sngags ring po 'ba' zhig bzlas par bya ste1/ sngags kyi 'od 2kyis gang la bya ba'i lus la phog pas rab tu gzir zhing mi bzod par bsams te4 / dper na lo thog 5la ser ba bab pa lta bur dmigs shing khros pas bzla'o / /zin pa dang las kyi zhabs bsreg pa dang / mnan pa gang 'dod pa bya'o/ /'khrul 'khor 'di ni phal 7cher bgegs la bshad kyis 'on kyang rnal 'byor las su rung ba'i sngags pas 'khrul 'khor gcig gis kyang las thams cad la 8sbyar bar nus so / /'dis gdon rlag par byed pa dang / rmugs par byed pa'i las gnyis 'grub po/ /de ltar phrin las bcu bdun no/ /gzhan gyi las 'jig pa ni sdig pa ste de dag par byed pa ni bum pa la sogs pa'i khrus dang 'brel phyir 'dir ma smos so/ /thams cad la ni spel ba'i tshig ni so so'i skabs dang sbyar ro/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i man ngag paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dz+nyā na shīrtis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid kyis bsgyur ba'o// //37—/259
